comments: sarah and her family were very nice as hosts. her place is located close to the 1 subway station and multiple buses which is very convenient, a shortish walk to columbia university. i would definitely recommend it for exploring manhattan solo and on a budget!

paco & pamela’s loft is absolutely gorgeous. a true nyc vibe in a great neighborhood. as a solo female traveller i felt extremely comfortable navigating the area on my own and the apartment was well equipped with everything needed for a comfortable stay. i would love to stay here again!
great location for a mets game

we had a very nice stay at joni and carsten's apartment. the property is located on quiet residential street but with plenty of shops, restaurants, bars and cafés at a short walking distance. there are also two underground stations close by. the apartment is fresh and spacious and the bedroom is very quiet at night. we only used the kitchen for breakfast, but it is well-equiped for more advanced meals. carsten and joni are great hosts, always ready to answer your questions, even before we arrived in ny.

i had a great experience at patricia's place. everything was clean and tidy, the room has enough space and it's very comfortable. greenpoint is a very nice place, within walking distance of williamsburg, and there are plenty of options around the apartment. unfortunately patricia couldn't be there during my stay, but we could sort everything out really well through distance. if you're going to spend some time in new york city, staying in brooklyn is a really interesting alternative because you have a better taste of both brooklyn and manhattan (since you'll be spending most of the time there anyway) and patricia's place is a great way to go.

ryan’s home was one of the most incredible spaces i’ve stayed in. organized, comfy, zen, ‘smart’...was the perfect space to spend with my mom sister and niece for the weekend. to top off the experience, ryan was unbelievably accommodating with his response time when we had questions. really setting the bar high for my first airbnb rental!!!

i had a fantastic stay at leila's place! the attention to detail and friendliness were outstanding. the space was not only clean and comfortable but also beautifully decorated. leila was a gracious host, always ready to assist and respond asap. i highly recommend her place to anyone looking for a delightful and welcoming airbnb experience. thanks, leila, for making my stay memorable!
very clean and safe!
great view, location, and apartment
had a great stay! highly recommended!

awesome gem near jfk. i had overnight layover from vietnam so i was exhausted. lakshmee’s place was perfect. i stayed in room 1 and it was clean, simple yet stylish. had a restful night. great local tips. lakshmee is such a friendly delightful host i will definitely stay again.
paul was very nice to us and the place was just perfect
clean and comfortable space near marine park .
chris was a phenomenal host! it was my first airbnb stay, and he made it simple and effortless. i will definitely look him up when i'm back in ny!

the location was spot on. midtown at it's best. you can get the whole manhattan skyscraper vibe and you can go to residential areas (lower man.) the subway was 4 mins away. the room had everything you'd need. it was perfect. thank you koichi

my family had a lovely time here! the location is great with a subway station and many good restaurants just a short walk away. the room itself was perfect because it fit all of our requirements with the refrigerator, microwave, iron, etc. the only thing that could’ve been better was the water pressure of the shower. other than that, our stay was very pleasant 😊

we enjoyed staying, as we felt comfortable in the space. our host was kind enough to watch our luggage as we explored- even after check out, which was greatly appreciated!! she was very responsive and helpful.
menachem's place was clean and cozy. he was a great communicator prior to and during our stay.

chateau in the trees provided an excellent respite from the city. the trees just outside the window, and the light filtered through them made for a peaceful setting. the apartment was spotless, and had exactly what we needed for our stay. communication was excellent, bed was comfortable, and there were great places to eat nearby. great space for two people for three or four nights, but solo someone could really be comfortable here for much longer.
nick's studio was perfect for my needs. the location is great, just 5 minutes from prospect park and on such a lovely street. nick was very responsive. i would definitely recommend.
great location and base to explore ny

best airbnb stay ever. the apartment was absolutely beautiful, well furnished, and clean. all questions were promptly answered. the hosts went above and beyond and provided points of interest for us to check out. clearly there is great pride taken in their community and neighborhood. thanks for letting us be a part of it.

this place was amazing! i was astounded by the size of the room for the price! it was clean, beautifully decorated, and in a safe neighborhood. the room was also quiet and i barely saw the other guests even though we shared a bathroom. my only regret is that i couldn't stay longer.

justine is an awesome host - great communication and very accommodating. her place is in a quiet building far enough away from the hustle and bustle of times square but conveniently located near a subway stop that will take you anywhere in no time. central park is a few blocks away. the location is the bomb! the apartment is very quiet, clean, and comfortable. justine also has great style. i hope we will get to stay here again someday.
a good place to stay and the host is very nice

danica is an excellent host, she is available to solve guests needs. the apartment is confortable and fully equipped including relevant details. i strongly recommend danica's apartment if you are looking for a suitable place to experience ny!
lauren’s spot is great! close to the beach, right across the street from a playground, and very cute apartment. we stayed for a week and it was a much needed break from the city heat. thanks & best!
we had a great time, dora is very friendly and the apartment is clean and very nice located. we definitely would book it again!

the apartment was super cute! just a 10 minute walk to the subway station, and then 30ish minutes from all the touristy things. bed was super comfy and everything was sparkly clean! plus we got some tasty cookies! would definitely stay here again.
claude made me feel welcome right away. the unit had everything i needed and was comfortable and quiet.

miss sharon’s place was excellent and extremely convenient for my weekend stay whilst i was transferring flights. the home itself was pristine, i felt absolutely comfortable. the bed is amazing. superbly comfortable. miss sharon’s check in instructions were clear and concise. i was able to find and access the properly with ease. everything else inside is pretty self explanatory and she was always on hand to provide further assistance should i have needed it. i highly recommend miss sharon’s place to others especially those flying into jfk late or catching early morning flights. the airport is literally 10mins away. the neighbourhood is extremely pleasant and i felt safe at all times. convenience stores and restaurants close by were also handy, especially the jamaican restaurant! i will definitely choose miss sharon’s place to stay again if i was ever in nyc again for a short or longer trip. excellent value for money, a great home and a great host!
loved the apartment and the location. hosts are responsive and kind. good place to stay.
my husband and i have stayed twice and it was amazing both times!!! a beautiful beach retreat you forget is in nyc.
we had a very good time in nyc. lillian was nice & the apt was comfortabel.
great place. private. clean. lots of amenities included. has a parking spot. very accommodating to a late arrival. will definitely return when back in the area.
my family and i had an amazing stay at devora’s place. it was very clean and in a great location. the host had great communication throughout the entire stay. i will definitely be back.

description of this space is spot on. located in a beautiful section of brownstones in brooklyn (boerum hills). the apartment is spacious, spotlessly clean and well cared for. it is minutes from the barclay center and a subway terminal allowing easy access to anywhere in the city. timothy and zainab are accessible and extremely helpful for any additional information or needs. would highly recommend this spot if visiting new york. one of our best airbnb experiences. my wife and i hope to return!

spacious, updated and clean. excellent accommodations. could easily handle two families w children. provided cooking gear, utensils and staples. quiet and safe neighborhood within 2 blocks walking of subway. bodegas nearby w supermarkets mile or so away. if budget conscious, eating in greatly preferable to dining out. highly recommend.
olga’s place was very nice and clean. i appreciated the fast responses. thank you for being a great hostess.
amazing location for a super confortable full equipped apt
perfect location, near by metro statiton - 111 st, 6min by foot. the self check-in was clear and fast. the room was located in the basement, little bit darker. fredy’s response was quick.
great location. easy check in/check out. one downside was the bed. definitely a full size not a queen and very uncomfortable.

my friend and i had a wonderful stay at amy’s place. the location was perfect for with options to use lyft, subway, or walk as we felt inclined. the studio is adorable with a nice view and a very authentic feel. we slept like rocks and loved the stylish design touches of the whole place. check in was by appointment and amy was patient when we took longer to arrive than we’d anticipated. we cruised all over manhattan, but our favorite meal was right around the corner from amy’s studio (mountain bird!!!). highly recommend this airbnb !
gracious host. good amenities. good location. easy access to subway and all other modes of transportation.
the place is very clean and comfortable. the hosts respond quickly. i will recommend this place and i will definitely stay again.
the location is just apt. metro, park, restaurants all at arms length. the metro to manhattan was a 20.minute drive. its clean, has the required amenities and felt very safe
a lovely spot, with a windowless bedroom, in a great location.
very good studio-like accomodation. although i am new to airbnb, i recommend this place without hesitation. i may in fact book there again in a near future!

janet was a very welcoming and supportive host. she was very easily reachable when we had a question. we also appreciated her keeping our luggage at her house as we had a late flight. the house was very nicely situated and we enjoyed our time there. thank you very much, janet…

⭐️⭐️⭐️☆☆ – beautiful space and great location, but not an accommodating experience we recently stayed at this airbnb in new york and found the home itself to be beautiful and in a fantastic location. the neighborhood was vibrant and safe, and the interior was clean, stylish, and exactly as described. however, as fellow airbnb hosts ourselves, we’re very familiar with airbnb policies and the importance of going above and beyond to earn a five-star review. unfortunately, this stay didn’t reflect that level of hospitality. the listing stated that early check-in and late check-out were available for a fee, which was a major reason we chose this property. but when we asked, the host cited a strict 11am checkout policy—implying it was a new york requirement—and said early check-in wasn’t possible. we also arrived on an early flight and simply requested to drop off our bags before the 4pm check-in time, but that accommodation was declined as well. because of this, we ended up paying $150 for
everything went great. place is accurately described and is a good value for money. my recommendation!

everything perfect! nice and clean apartment, just a little bit further from the city centre than we expected, but it is pretty close to a tube station - roughly 8 min walking. filomena is a lovely lady and always very kind and ready to help. i will definitely stay again in her apartment in my forthcoming visits to nyc.

staying at deborah’s place made my arrival in the us very enjoyable. she went out of her way to help me carry all of my luggage up the stairs at midnight (my flight was delayed 4+ hours), which i really appreciated. she also gave great coffee spot recommendations in the area. i would 100% recommend staying with her :) thanks again deborah!
burke was awesome, what an incredible place i will stay there more if not just to grab a drink with her and hangout!

we had an amazing stay at this airbnb! from the moment we arrived, everything exceeded our expectations. the space was spotless, beautifully decorated, and exactly as described in the listing. it was clear that a lot of thought and care went into making guests feel comfortable. the host was incredibly responsive, welcoming, and helpful throughout our stay. they made the check-in process easy and were available if we needed anything. the location was also perfect—quiet, convenient, and close to everything we wanted to do. we truly felt at home and would absolutely stay here again. highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a relaxing and enjoyable stay!
clean room, near the train station. would definitely stay again.
nice hotel but room was cramped and nowhere to put toiletries also not a lot of hot water and music in lobby way too loud.
perfect view of da city
everything was on point from checking to checkout. very clean and private. will be back soon
exactly as advertised!

i spent 2 great days at tokunbo's place. the apartment is great, you have space, it's well decorated, the brick walls, the bar, everything is perfect. tokunbo was very nice and helpful (answering emails right away!). also, the neighborhood is actually agreeable, you can walk for 2 minutes and be in nice streets with places where to have breakfast or lunch. the train is passing by but it was not annoying at all. first, it gives the place a nice nyc touch, then, it's a train, not the subway, so there are less of them, and it stops early. plus the windows muffle the sounds, so i was never bothered. my girlfriend used the earplugs tokunbo had provided, but only because she loves total silence. we had everything, sun, rain, snow, and were never cold. 7/eleven across the street can also be helpful. thank you tokunbo, we had a fantastic time!

staying at stephanies was like being in a luxury hotel, the beds were so so comfortable. great location, walkable restaurants, close to the beach, coney island and a subway station that takes you straight to times square manhattan.
great location, right around the corner from times square. staff were all friendly and accommodating. rooms and bathrooms are a bit dated, but was expected. overall a decent value stay.
nice space to crash when going to a show at forest hills

tiffany's place was a great launching pad for our new york adventure. the home itself was clean, comfortable and well appointed. we were minutes away from the subway and tons of shops. tiffany was very responsive to all of questions. overall a great place for our family to stay in the city!
great host, great space! would stay here again next visit.
great stay. far quieter than most places in brooklyn

we had very good time spending 6 days in keishara's apartment. keishara was very welcoming and gave us a lot practical info. the apartment was very comfortable and well equipped. we really liked it and would stay again or recommendt it to our friends.
this is a cosy, comfortable space with just about every amenity you might need. the location is excellent too! the nearest subway station is just a minute away and prospect park isn't much farther.
david and rick are very nice gentlemen and made my 5-night stay easy and comfortable. the guest area is extremely clean and quiet and i slept great. you never hear the sounds of manhattan.
great location in new york, walkable to restaurants and easy access to manhattan.
very clean and modern.
great place to stay alone or with one other person!

it’s a very cozy and quiet place with all you need for an excellent stay. nick is very attentive and always responds doubts. the neighborhood is quiet and the walk to the nearest subway station is about 15 minutes. nick recommends some great places to dine nearby and we try a few that did not disappoint. i recommend this place for sure.

five of us fit comfortably in the space. the location is in korea town close to flat iron and empire state so it is ideal as a tourist. the bed was comfy as well. eliza was very responsive and the staff at the lobby was also helpful. one should set their expectations in booking the place since the building is quite old, the room only has one toilet (there is a shared toilet in every floor tho) and the room felt dated. we also found cockroaches in the bathroom (it’s normal in nyc apparently). overall, you get what you pay for. if you plan on staying outside most of the time, then the unit is bearable. would recommend to others on a budget. thanks eliza & team!

peter's apartment is in a really cool area. there are lots of venues, bars, restaurants, cafes, etc. in just a few block radius. this also means it can be noisy, but as musicians who enjoy the night life, this was just fine for us. peter was an excellent communicator, had repairs done in a timely manner, and the super for the building, rocky, was helpful. the apartment itself was really nice with a decent sized common area and kitchen. i would stay here again.

staying with victoria felt like a home away from home. the apartment is beautiful, spacious, and comfortable and victoria is a thoughtful and responsive host who ensures you have all you need for your stay. this was my second visit and we will be back!
great location! close to times square and we had everything we needed in this space
young was so sweet and responsive to messages. the place was very easy to find and very clean. left us snacks and had a water station which was very appreciated. 10/10!!
great place to stay.

this was a great experience. richard was friendly and accommodating to my arrival schedule. the room was fully stocked with snacks and everything a traveler could want, including soap, lotion, toothbrush, moisturizer, alarm clock, iron and ironing board. i loved that the room was totally private, it was my own mini-apartment and after a long day, i just want to come back and crash in peace. mission accomplished. the neighborhood is super convenient. the subway is literally around the corner and there's a deli/grocery, chinese food, mexican food, dunkin donuts - all within 500 feet.

thanks for being such a great host. two beds, a set of keys each and room was very clean. bagels and coffee each morning was so handy! great location just off queens blvd, very near subway stop into manhattan. would recommend others to stay with ester! :)
really nice place to stay. smooth check-in, clean apartment and great location. special thanks to the host and their responsiveness. i recommend this place!
very nice room. good on privacy. if i came back to bk i would look for this again

my friend and i stayed in jesse's shared room in october for a week. jesse was very helpful, welcoming and hospitable. the room was large very clean and spacious. jesse gave us clean towels half way through the week. there were two very clean and well kept bathrooms. there were maps, computer and phone available for our use. we were given keys to allow us to come and go as we liked. jesse supplies secure lockers for your belongings, provide your own padlock. i highly recommend staying here for a visit to new york. it is ideally situated in easy walking distance to times square in a safe neighbourhood and there is a great 99cent pizza store across the street. thank you jesse for a great stay.

margaret’s home is a real rare and gem of a find! my husband and i use airbnb for all of our travels, both big and small - this one by far is one of our favorites to date. her communication with us was smooth and easy prior to our arrival, ensuring we understood check in and the space. total privacy as there’s a separate entrance just for guests. the space is well stocked with everything you’d expect, but the kitchen was such a pleasant surprise. we barely needed to do any shopping for our 9 day stay as her groceries, coffee, and snacks fed us every morning. her endless reviews speak for themselves, but the cherry on top was her sweet and thoughtful attitude. local subways are all a quick dash away, easy commute to all attractions. if your trip is short, 7th and 5th in park slope is a quick walk for all the food and eats! would definitely recommend and truly hope she has availability for us to stay again in the future! margaret we adore you!!!
best place to stay when visiting new york
location couldnt be better!

tight stairs leading up to apartment on 4th floor. kitchen sink was not connected so water would run straight onto the floor. tv and wifi would not work most of the trip. lofted platform is not equipped with bedding. close walk to central park but i would overall probably not recommend.

perfect location- completely adorable design aesthetic . beautiful room with great cozy bed/linens (i’d like to buy those pillows!) lots of extra details, like welcome drinks/snacks, water bottle refills, great water pressure/hairdryer + very clean. every inch was so thoughtfully designed, maxed out with features so even tho it’s small it doesn’t feel like it. staff were all super nice and helpful. one of my favorite hotel stays :) thanks!

our stay was wonderful with a perfect location close to the park and great connection to all other parts in the city. communication with the host was seamless and always helpful. thank you very much and we would be glad to stay at one of your properties again!

just returned from a week's stay at mike's brooklyn apartment and can't fault it - it was all i expected and more. my son [18] and i were visiting new york and weren't sure about whether we'd miss out staying in brooklyn in terms of travel time etc into manhattan but it was so easy. the apartment is only a 5/10 minute walk from a metro station and once you get used to the varoius train routes that stop there you can get into manhattan in 20/25 minutes on the q train. the apartment was lovely - great air con which was needed as we had a heat wave for the last few days - with every amenity you need. when we arrived we were met by dave who handed over the keys and showed us the ropes. he was very friendly and gave us loads of useful tips and info on travel, things to see etc. the park slope area is lovely and a great break from the hustle of manhattan infact i wish we could have stayed longer and seen more of brooklyn itself. lots of really good reasonably priced restaurants within walking distance, a little shop on the corner [2mins walk] which sells all the basics and everyone very friendly and helpful. felt very safe walking around the area even very late at night.. would definitely recommend this apartment and can't wait to stay again - you get so much more for your money than in a hotel and feel more like you are part of everything. am starting to save for another trip!
abdon’s apartment is very well located. it was a great experience in the city, accessible and comfortable. abdon was always communicative and very helpful. thanks!
great place to stay

nice place, definently would stay again. great area to easily get around anywhere in the city, with easy subway access. audrey was very welcoming and gracious including, when i needed to check in early. she has two very friendly cats that love attention. the room is a bit small and can be a bit stuffy at points but a fan is provided so it isn't much of a problem. great spot, has everything you would need at a good price

ron was an excellent host; and the room was quite cozy and quiet most of the time, though it could be a bit noisy outside of the apartment due to people at the bar downstairs. it also has a lot of cool posters and decor. anyway, i was quite satisfied with the overall experience.

great location and price. but photos don’t match the description. a lot of clutter in the house. no place to hang clothes. it was clean and the bed was comfortable so we still made the best out of it thank you
beautiful view of the city and mary was accommodating during our stay.

once again our stay at alan's loft was excellent. alan was at the loft to welcome us and get our baggage up to his apartment. to our surprise alan left essentials for us in the fridge as well as a bottle of bubbly! the location could not be better. excellent restaurants and shops at your doorstep. can't wait for our next stay.

marjorie is such an amazing host. i was there an entire week with my two teen daughters. the space was perfect for us. we really enjoyed getting an authentic ny experience vs staying at a hotel. we had everything we needed and she was so detailed and great with communication. i love that she greeted us upon arrival and immediately gave us some tips and recommendations for the area. the room was really comfortable and fun. we enjoyed the books, art and the record player. the ac cooled the room so well on the hot days. and i was surprised at how quiet the room was through the night. the location is great as well. it is an easy walk to several subway stations and if you use the curb app the taxis will pick you up right at the front door. there are so many restaurants to choose from within just a couple of blocks. some of our favorites were frisson (coffee shop), pure thai cookhouse, e.a.k. ramen, and hudson bagel (for breakfast). it is also close to grocers, pharmacies and convenience stores, as well as an easy walk to times square. i would definitely stay here again.

the space was very clean and kept together. the host was downstairs and was willing to help with anything. it was good, but we were under the impression that it would be a little bigger. still overall a good space would book again.
rooms are very small and dated, carpets are worn but clean and comfortable. staff was friendly, price was right and location is very convenient to enter and exit the city. we will stay here again.
listing could use more photos but everything went well. clean, simple, and no more or less than you need. karen was quick with her communication, would stay again. great value!

expect the following: early luggage drop off. consistent hot water in shower. tidy bathroom at the beginning and end of day. a workout via walking to the metro station. however the bus service is good for those who do not like to walk. heat.
great host. highly recommend if you want to stay in queens.
staff was very responsive to requests and happy to help. great stay!
i had a very pleasant and cozy stay at kara's. would definitely recommend.
the bed is very comfortable and henry is very timely when he communicates.
clean and really nice neighborhood after waking around
my husband stayed at snow effect listing because he had a flight from jfk and he loved it. the host was very responsive and the place was as described.

excellent hotel! we loved the location and the view from our room! we had a small hiccup trying to check in, but it was quickly corrected! the shower pressure was great and the water was nice and hot! we loved that they provided a noise machine for sleeping and all the amenities in the lobby! we also loved that they kept the hotel locked and we could easily let ourselves in daily with the key code. it was a fantastic experience staying at this hotel and being able to walk to all the close by attractions and food!
simple, but did the trick. good location in a nice neighbourhood. bed was a little uncomfortable, but good base to explore ny.
great place! super cute and in a great location, with everything you would need. s&g were communicative and great hosts!

sophie was an amazing host. very communicative, and available to answer questions. the brooklyn carriage house was perfect for two people for a couple days. spacious, tall ceilings, comfortable bed, nice shower. also, great location that was close to multiple subway lines. we hope to stay here again in the future.
amazing host, very helpful!
a beautiful hotel within walking distance of the subway and busses. many food options near by. the hotel staff was always friendly and very helpful!

marissas apartment made for a very comfortable stay in park slope! she thought of everything we needed and even had some extra special perks like an essential oil diffuser as well as yeas and chocolates upon our arrival.

perfect getaway right in the middle of it all. we had a great time at dalia & marina's place. the communication was super easy and quick and the place looks exactly like it does on the pictures. the neighborhood is very conveniently located and although it’s a lively neighborhood the apartment is very quiet! would absolutely recommend to stay there as i will definitely be coming back, soon! thank you :)

5 stars – a perfect stay for a special weekend! we had an amazing long weekend in nyc over the 4th of july, celebrating our civil wedding—and lucas’ place couldn’t have been more perfect for the occasion. the flat was beautifully designed, spotless, and had everything we needed for a comfortable and memorable stay. lucas was a thoughtful and responsive host, making everything seamless from check-in to check-out. the location was fantastic, with great access to everything we wanted to do, but also felt like a peaceful retreat from the city buzz.

we loved our stay! the bedrooms are large and comfortable. being half a block from the subway was so convenient. there is construction going on at the moment (not sure how long it will last) so bring ear plugs. the shower changes from cold to hot but doesn't mix into warm well so be prepared for that.
what can i say, best space in nyc. trust me you wanna be here, smart home, they have thought of it all. it' was hard to leave. we will return. thanx so much for your hospitality.
very clean and large! very close to the metro
i loved it there.. will be coming back to this airbnb

jim's place was perfect for a couple! clean, quiet, great location, and within walking distance of penn station/several subway stops. would be awesome if you were going to see a show at madison square garden, too. he was a great host, easy to communicate with and i would definitely stay here when in new york again.
don’s place is close to public transportation, restaurants and groceries. don always replied fast which is always a plus. check in and out was very simple.
wonderful place and hosts
very nice and cozy apartment with very attentive hosts. we can recommend it. however, the surroundings don’t feel very safe.

sheila was awesome, before arriving she sent me a detailed message of what the neighborhood was like, great places to visit, and fun things to do. the apartment was hair as pictures and very cozy! the neighborhood was amazing. it had lots of great restaurants shops and was very safe
water bottles were ready for us right when we arrived, and it was so fun to explore the surrounding area. we felt safe and comfortable the whole time

ming was a great host. she helpd us a lot and she is very friendly. the room and location was great. the neiberhood is very safe and quiet. so anyone who is reading the rewievs and making decision by them where to stay in nyc, i would strongly recomend to choose mings apartment.

just got back to the city after a quick staycation with my boyfriend and we miss it already! the area was so nice and peaceful and away from all of the city craziness. we were able to check in early and check out a little later and the host was so responsive and accommodating to our needs. everything in the photos and description matched what was in the airbnb and we truly had such a wonderful stay! the best part was the jacuzzi.. so relaxing and awesome! would love to stay here again!
warm and attentive host, great room and went the extra mile to make me feel comfortable. ruled of the house were clear and easy to follow.

the views alone make this an amazing spot. the space was spacious, immaculate and clean, and came with everything we needed. with views in all four directions, we spent the evening gazing out at the manhattan skyline from the very nice solarium-esque living room. we would return in a heartbeat. building was safe and easy to walk to both the subway and various stores.
great place and nice host.
what a great apartment! for two couples who felt comfortable navigating the city this place was wonderful. thanks guys!

this is the best experience i have ever had with airbnb. md and his wife are simply awesome. we arrived late and couldn't find street parking, so they moved their own car and allowed us to park there the house was excellent and very very clean in a good neighboorhod. very safe
jack and rachel were excellent hosts and were very welcoming and flexible with my arrival time. the apartment was excellent and in a great location close to a train station and a main street etc
amazing apartment. you will not find a better space in new york at this price
it was a nice easy stay that i was able to find for a last minute booking!
recommended. had no issues with the place.
great loft! very large, very comfortable, very stylish, and a great location!
great place! super clean ! gabriel was super responsive. recommend 💯

marissa's home was beautiful and her family was welcoming! the space was clean and the location was awesome. everything we needed or wanted was only a block or two away! i would most definitely recommend this home for a comfortable, friendly stay!

this apartment was great! it is a 5 story walk up, but other than that, the space was clean, they always accommodated me when i reached out. i booked for a very last minute trip and they were quick to help me out. there was a light out in the kitchen, i reached out and they fixed it the same day. the bathroom is a decent size, full sized fridge, and the in unit washer/dryer was so convenient. it had everything i needed for my long stay. i felt safe there and it was walking distance to everything. i’d stay there again in a heartbeat!

we had a lovely stay in brady's house. it was clean and comfortable in a great location near the subway. but felt the need to get a taxi late at night because the subway line was pretty isolated and the area a bit dodgy in places. their recommendation of mannys cafe a few blocks down was amazing for breakfast. the hosts were really helpful too answering any questions we had.

the room was very comfortable for me and my spouse. host was responsive and nice. the subway station is walkable so we didn’t have to take uber to go to places. i would recommend for people to stay at jiyoun’s place. once i go back to new york, i’d definitely book again.

such a lovely cozy place! the house was clean, fred was to talk to, and he would reply immediately! accommodated my family and i at a very last minute after a horrible experience with a different host at a different place. when told something was off or not working, instead of getting upset about it he fixed the problem immediately and was apologetic! on top of that my family's flight was moved at a later time and he helped us out. place is also located in a safe area in brooklyn! i would definitely stay there again and would love to have them as hosts again!
really really good experience from kara! good condition of house and many considerate things provided！so happy to choose this place!
great place to stay for a big group
fantastic place! good location and comfortable spaces. would definitely stay there again.
great place to stay, clean. easy to get in. would recommend on staying here again.

lauren & anthony’s place was located close to public transportation and easily accessible from the airport. check in was easy and the place was spotless when we arrived. the apartment is true to its pictures! i appreciated the extra pillows and blankets which made it comfortable to lay on the couch at night to relax. the apartment was very well heated which was greatly appreciated during the cold weather. check out was easy too. i would highly recommend and would return here for future stays.
thank you amelia, we enjoyed meeting you and your family. hope to stay again.
has all you need for an easy stay close to manhattan. great for a short trip!
the host was very nice and answered right away for my questions! i'm really appreciate it! thank you so much!
mike's place was well located and is a reasonable distance from everything in manhattan. mike is excellent at communication and is an awesome host.

this apartment is wonderful. it is clean and has a great aesthetic going on. alex welcomed me with maps and suggestions for local eats and orientation to red hook. i found it to be the perfect place while i was in town for a symposium in red hook.
really nice place to live in. and the host was really kind.
great place in middle village. host was quick respond to all messages and gave clear directions for check in. we will look to stay again when we go back to ny.
amazing apartment, host and location! we loved everything about it and hope to come back again soon! thank you, elise!
unforgettable experience!
great comfortable room for a short stay

we loved the location...beautiful brownstone building in a residential street yet close to public transport, good restaurants and deli's. the bedroom can get claustrophobic due to slanted ceiling and bright colors so not an ideal space to spend too much time, but there's plenty of space to pack/unpack in the room and the living room/kitchen area are nicely decorated for relaxing. bathroom was clean considering it was shared with numerous other rooms. it has a hostel feel to it which can be very convenient. would stay there again for sure!
beautiful home in a perfect location! this was my family's second stay and loved it just as much as the first. highly recommend to anyone looking for a fun and relaxing beach vacation.
great experience overall!
perfect stay! nice room, awesome flat! location is really good only a few minutes with the metro to manhatten.

this unit is awesome and the beekman tower is awesome. hector, at the front desk, was welcoming, engaging, and helpful. perfectly located in a quiet part of manhattan, but near some lively eating establishments on 2nd ave. million dollar view of east river.
great location. fantastic communication. would stay again.

my husband and i wanted somewhere close to the city to get away, just for the night without our kids or worrying about driving in to eat at our fave restaurant. erika's place provided that privacy we wanted. as everyone explained, the outside is unassuming but you'll have a whole floor to yourself, equipped with wi-fi. while it wasn't super high gloss, it was homey and sparkling clean. parking is free on the under pass, but you have to pay attention to the signs under the side you parked on. we didn't, and ended up getting ticketed. also, the train into manhattan is 23mins by foot away, maybe 5 by car. we took a taxi back because we couldn't be bothered and it wasn't hefty, so keep that in mind as another option. all in all, we are glad we chose erika's apartment and would do so again.

ted and diane are lovely, kind, patient, and very accommodating. the apartments are adorable, clean, better than pictured in the profile in my opinion. thoroughly enjoyed them as my first hosts of an airbnb booking. happy to say i'm staying with them again in a few weeks.

not the best air bnb i’ve stayed at by any means, but did the trick. hosts were a bit cold, messy place after they threw a party the first night i stayed ( which they informed me about ) very loud room, next to the main door of the building where people hang outside late every night playing music.

irina was responsive to all our communications. she met us upon arrival, showed us around the apartment, and offered to be available if we needed anything. the apartment is spacious, well equipped, spotlessly clean and very comfortable, especially the wonderful king bed. surprisingly quiet too!
perfect place to stay for checking out brooklyn for a few days. the beds and bathroom are great. the back patio is awesome!

our stay was absolutely wonderful. while the city is a little hectic and exhausting it was always nice at the end of a day to come back, have hot tea, and just relax. we had never stayed in a bnb before and this was a great experience. i would recommend demetria’s home to anyone looking for a place to stay.
clean and very easy to access home, very enjoyable weekend stay.
convenient location. quick response from the host when questions were asked.

this was my first experience with airbnb and it could not have been better. i spent three weeks at lidia's house and i always felt very comfortable. she is very kind, attentive and always willing to help if you need something. i highly recommend her. thank you, lidia, for treating me as a member of your family. i hope to come back soon.

jacqueline was super responsive and communicative, providing very clear instructions to facilitate a good experience. even though it’s an older building, the apartment was clean and so cute, and the walk up provided a little exercise lol. there were plenty of restaurants in the area, it was walkable and easily accessible. i would definitely stay here again. thanks for being a great host!

host is very responsive when we had issues. so high marks for christina on helping us out when we needed it. the space itself definitely had multiple issues while my mother in law stayed there for full a month. toilet routinely backed up, during one of coldest nights of the year the heater cracked and had cold air exposed with draft into the apartment. multiple leaks from plumbing issues in ceiling above kitchen. hot water seems to be shared through one source throughout the building so my mother in law had to cold shower on multiple occasions during winter. sink was backed up and clogged upon check-in. all these maintenance issues were a real drag, especially the water leaking. christina did everything she could to quickly have plumbers and handyman come fix them quickly to get credit. i hope the unit is fully repaired and better in shape for future guests. probably not an issue for a short visit but anything week or over was pretty noticeable z
great location & great hospitality
good luck and break a leg with that show! i will look for you. let me know about the love seat. super cute!

terrific little apartment, ideal for our family visit. four adults and a 6-year old, and it had everything we needed. we were quite pleased with the amenities. yes, it's close to the train as some have commented , but it's ny, folks, and honestly it's not very loud. mini-splits in both bedrooms, a generously-sized bathroom, well-appointed kitchen. the back yard is a neat, private little area, too. jovanny was very responsive throughout, and we couldn't have been happier with our stay. we plan to return in the spring.
great hosts, very clean apartment, super communication, perfect location in hell's kitchen. would always come back. 100% recommended.

lolita's place is perfect for those who are spending the whole day out in the city and then need a bed to crash. super clean and peaceful! this past weekend was freezing but the room was so nice and warm and made for a pleasant sleep. the only downside is sharing the bathroom and having to wait until other guests are done, but it wasn't too bad. it's an amazing price for staying in nyc.
i had a really great time during this stay. location was awesome :)

this is an extremely beautiful apartment located in a beautiful neighborhood. the place was clean, comfortable and chic and the host was very flexible. if you’re ever visiting the bronx or new york city in general, this is the place to stay!
great location by times square. typical hotel room with front desk check in etc
great place for a quick stop in manhattan. close proximity to subway stations.
spacious and clean, one bedroom in the heart of brooklyn. many accommodations perfect for short or long term stays. great communication from host, was always available for any needs.
worth every penny. great deal for the price, amazing location. i strongly recommend for people looking for a light stay.

ron was the perfect host. the space was great and was in a very convenient location for the theatre district. the towels provided were very nice and everything worked great. any little questions that we had he was able to answer for us very quickly. highly recommend this space and would definitely return here!
tanya was very friendly and paid so much attention to detail. only stayed for a night but would definitely stay again!

carla welcomed me at her place on the day of her arrival. it was easy to find, and is in a great location! the most commendable thing about carla's house is how clean it was. the bed was really comfortable, and the room was nice and cool. carla was very friendly, we had nice chats and she had given me really good restaurant choices. i am someone who appreciates privacy, and was happy that the room was able to cater to that. overall, it was a really good experience and i would recommend this place!
this home has all the amenities you will need to have a pleasurable stay. yvonne is very respectful and i would highly recommend for anyone looking to stay in queens.
easy access to subway. safe neighborhood, good pizza and dunkin doughnuts close.
amazing stay! warm cozy place right in the middle of the action. my favourite thing was the bed, it was the softest thing ever. would definitely stay there again.

amazing airbnb!!! i stayed at lakishas for about 3 weeks and i was so happy with the experience the entire time. it was a great location, very clean, had a lock on the door to my room, and lakisha is super kind and a wonderful host. highly highly highly recommend.
place was nice & neighborhood quiet we enjoyed our stay
maria was a fantastic host and very responsive! definitely would choose to stay with her again!
maki is a gracious and quiet host, the room is clean and tidy and the bed is comfortable. no complaints!

a good size and well kept loft space in soho/edge of chinatown. alex was very responsive and friendly. great location to walk everywhere downtown in manhattan with easy access to brooklyn. good airconditioning and facilities in the apartment. there are three flights of stairs to walk-up.

the place was exactly what i needed, a nice, clean place to stay for the night. it's right near public transit stop, there's stores and stuff nearby, and straightforward to get into. definitely recommend
great, clean modern apartment, just the water in the shower wasn’t very hot.
brady was really caring and flexible for my need. check in and out were easy and smooth. nice neighbourhood and super cute decorations in the house!

location is great except it’s very noisy (noisier than usual for nyc.) the bedrooms face e. 60th st so you not only hear the everyday/nite blaring of car horns but also traffic coming off the bridge. there was also construction across the street & garbage pickup from patsy’s restaurant. the restaurant is located on the first floor of the same building. you walk up 2 flights of stairs to the unit & there were ppl in the unit above (3rd floor) that were up late walking about & playing loud music. idk if these ppl were owners or renters so you may not experience this. we also had one day waking up to no hot water but dina remedied this issue very quickly. amenities were very nice.

tucker's place was the cleanest airbnb i've ever been to. the room was really cozy and comfortable with plenty of space. he was also super friendly and flexible and let me drop my bag off 6 hours before check in. would definitely recommend staying here!

charlie and sam have created a peaceful and clean room. furnished with high quality linens and towels, soft lighting and daylight. very comfy, an oasis in an urban area. sam was personable and we had a pleasant chat. i highly recommend, and will go back in the future!

nice place. the location isn't the pretiest but that is expected if you know a little about ny and its surroundings. it was conveniently located to the train. the bathroom and ac need a little bit of work but the host is aware and working on it. he was very responsive and attentive to our needs.
really well operated hostel-style stay. free breakfast and other amenities. staff is helpful and courteous, and the other guests were respectful.

i stayed at jennifer's charming home for three nights while i was house hunting in brooklyn. first off, jennifer is a phenomenal host. she offers something really really good in the heart of one of brooklyn's coolest nabes, bedstuy, and she does so in her own unique style that made me feel at home minutes after stepped into her space. i thought the space is actually better than what's suggested in the listing. i slept like a baby every night and there were so many great bars and restaurants within a few minutes in all directions, including do or dive - the best bar in america. would definitely come back and highly recommend!
loved my stay at this beautiful garden space. wish i brought a sweater? it was cold. but everything else was awesome!! i will be back to ny soon and hope to stay here again
nice apartment with a convenient location. i felt safe when i had to come home late.

i stayed in elem apartment for 5 weeks and everything was perfect! elem was very helpful during my stay and always available. the apartment is located in a great place, quiet and secure. there are a lot of restaurants and supermarkets nearby. the house was very clean and equipped with everything i needed for my stay. i would definitely recommend elem's place. great choice!

nice one bedroom apartment, great for one to two people. the place was clean and the bed was really comfortable. i also like the small balcony as well. it's walking distance to the subway and a bunch of bars and restaurants.
great apartment, exactly as pictured! perfect location and made us feel like true new yorkers! mark was very communicative and helpful!

michael and bethany’s place is cozy and sweet. it was clean, well maintained, and nicely decorated. the back patio/garden was a nice, private setting to enjoy a meal and get some fresh air. easy access to the subway and directly across the street from a cute cafe/bakery. we (two women) felt comfortable walking home at night. i would absolutely stay here again.

great stay! just a little small in the shower space. we had to find our own parking which luckily wasn’t too hard. nice decorations and smells good! clean rooms, little awkward went on a weekend and was told to put the toilet paper in the trash after going to the bathroom.. but everything else was great!!
excellent communication, easy to find and access. the place was clean, cozy and perfect!
excellent stay, great location!

great place to stay, lovely neighborhood & easy access to transportation. the room was alittle warm even with the ac but the overall hospitality was indeed very pleasant! will be back again, thank you!

samir's apartment is incredibly spacious for new york city, and in one of the best locations you could ask for with easy access to restaurants, bars, grocery stores, pharmacy, parks, and public transportation. we stayed here for 3 weeks, and it was a great spot from which we could explore the city. samir was also very responsive and check-in was really simple, which is not always the case in nyc. the description also mentions street noise, but we didn't hear any of that in the apartment, which made sleeping that much easier. we did have a few issues though. the bed is soft, which at first was great, but after a little while made our backs ache. there also wasn't much room to hang up our clothes, which is ok once again for a short stay, but for a longer stay made things more inconvenient. there were also some cleaning issues, some of which we resolved ourselves, and others which samir helped us with, but would have loved to have not been an issue to begin with. all in all, samir's place is a great spot from which to explore nyc without having to compromise on space.

maría was absolutely amazing. fast response great location and the stay? smelled amazing! it was so relaxing and the host provided plenty of extra bedding for guests. there was also a nice little “free” section in the bathroom where maría has left basic toiletries available to guest who may need to borrow them throughout the stay. we only stayed one night due to sn overnight layover but overall 10/10 would stay again
the bed was comfortable

this was a lovely place to stay. it was very comfortable, with a great vibe. everything was just as pictured, and kelly was great with communication. in addition, the neighborhood is great. subways are really close, and there are a lot of nice restaurants in the area. would love to stay again!

the airbnb was beautiful and exactly as advertised. jiyoun was so kind and accommodating throughout my stay. the location was easy to access from the subway and felt very safe and cozy. i had a concert at the brooklyn mirage and it was a quick 15 minute uber ride away. i wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again, highly recommend!
this was a wonderful place to stay i would highly recommend it of all the places i've stayed in new york had an airbnb i would say this is by far the best.
quiet, clean place to stay!
great visit ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

it was a quiet neighborhood. win was awesome and respectful to my husband and i. he made sure to communicate efficiently and letting us know to give him a call if we needed something. clear instructions when entering. it was warm and welcoming.
i only had one night visit in queens and belgin's apt. it is super cute, clean, and convenient. the shower's water pressure is amazing and the bed is very comfortable. i highly recommend.

william's place was a cozy studio apartment in brooklyn. the location was conveniently close to several restaurants and two different lines. the bed was comfortable and the washroom was spacious. thank you for having us william!
i love staying here it’s my second stay and it’s always super clean and very centrally located in brooklyn i’ll be back for sure.

this is the best airbnb i have ever seen in my entire life, for a trip i have been looking forward too for so long, that was such a dream come true. i will definitely come again on my next trip, thanks to the kindness and professionalism of the hosts.

it is a charming place, in the middle of lots to do, easy in, easy out, instructions were clear. my phone died as i arrived, but i could remember some of the things min wrote, and the rest were obvious - the right lockbox, which key for which door, all worked smoothly. i’ll stay again when i return.

the location is so great. subway is just at end of the block. check-in was easy and we are able to have the keys to let ourselves in and out during our stay. carlyn and dave are very friendly and thoughtful. i will definitely recommend this place to my friends when they come to new york.

had a great stay at lou’s place. communication with him was a+, room looked exactly like the pictures and the place is super close to a subway station. the only issue was one bathroom for a 3 full rooms so we had to wait a little. everything else was great.

thomas provided very helpful instructions and was very responsive during my stay. the loft and apartment was very clean and interesting to stay in. i would have appreciated a reminder about the other guest coming to stay in the second loft but other than that, i would highly recommend his place! the location has great access to the subway and other parts of new york! the loft is a fun, creative space to stay in.
great stay. very clean and welcoming .
everything was just as described. ana maria left us a welcome letter with information about the subway, bus stops, grocery store and even info about the nearby laundromat.
amazing location, and a very accommodating host — we really enjoyed our stay! earplugs may come in handy as the street noise can be a bit loud.
clean place, and very responsive team.
nice clean room! would stay there again.
easy to find, good location, and cozy. we had to cut our trip short due to unfortunate circumstances and the host was accommodating and helpful when we left behind valuables in our rush to fly home.
the place was very clean !! easy check in and very accessible

perfect room. wonderful location. i would love the chance to stay in the blue room again. julia was very welcoming and the loft is so unique. just a quick walk away from brooklyn bridge park which made for a nice stroll in the am.
it’s a very nice place near forest park. you can enjoy a pleasant walk there, and the host is amazing.
sarah’s place was just what i needed for the weekend. the room was clean and bright and overall location was very accessible. would definitely stay here again.
loved my stay here! great location and very comfortable.

chris and steve were so friendly. the place was really cute, nice and very clean. also it includes everything you need. if you want a centric and gorgeous place to stay in new york city, this is definitely the best option. definitely recommend it!
it was a nice stay and walking distance to subway, stores, and local small businesses.
stay was lovely. casimir is friendly and very responsive. would book again!

i really enjoyed my stay here. a few pros and cons. the neighborhood was beautiful! restaurants and little shops were easily a walkable distance. the room itself was clearly new and seemed pretty clean for the most part, only thing is that the towels seemed a bit dusty, nothing too serious though. my only complaint would be the bathroom, as it is not as updated as the room itself, it was kind of dirty around the toilet area, something seemed to be leaking. i let the hosts know and they were very responsive and were inclined to resolve the issue. other than that, my stay was great.

this place was amazing and the host were very communicative and helpful as well as the neighborhood everything is walkable and easily accessible to get to. the space was very comfortable and very spacious as well with lots of lighting and a cute sky light
it was a great stay, there wasn’t anything bad about it while i was there.
spacious, there was enough sleeping space for our party of 5+. 10 minute walk to the metro. alex was very hospitable. did i mention, the apartment comes with a private parking space. came in handy.
it was amazinggg. gorgeous room and hotel. it had a bar downstairs and rooftop. loved it.
great base for exploring nyc. a 10 minute walk to the metro into manhattan. astoria is a nice neighbourhood with some nice places to eat and drink.
juliet's place was extremely clean, decorated nicely and she was a great host. would book again
great place, walkable to many places. quiet place at night
they were very convenient in responding & assisting me with my needs of a last minute stay , will definitely recommend!
we had an amazing time staying at the hotel. it is located in a quieter street, but only a few blocks away from time square. it was clean and comfy.

the location was perfect. we were a few blocks from the empire state building. the walk from our broadway show was an easy walk. took about a half an hour. so perfect with the exposed brick. loved it!!

we enjoyed this charming garden apartment which was perfect for our family of three, including our 7 mos old daughter. the apartment and kitchen was stocked with essentials and the host even put out a baby bottle drying rack for our use. shower water pressure was excellent. the apartment is spacious and on a quiet street but near everything! you really can’t beat this area for a brooklyn stay- charming homes all around and close to the buzzing smith street bistros and bars. we capped off our stay by enjoying the garden and some wine. we look forward to coming back soon.

anna’s place is in a perfect location in manhattan! real close to the original macy’s, empire state, subways and tons of food! central to everything! was really nice to have the bag check in before our room check-in! the room was very clean. had a great shower with good water pressure and the beds were very comfortable. had everything we needed! would definitely stay here again!
the hostess contacted me and provided details on the key location and code, she was also very accommodating and quick to respond when i contacted her. great place, modern, clean, cozy
seth was a great host, with a very cozy place in nyc to stay at. it was a nice place to return to after a day full of adventures!
great stay! highly recommend the place. thanks winston!

this place was exactly what the pictures showed. the hosts were amazing, they were great communicating before, during, and after check-out. not to mention, this place is in a great location. if you’re a tourist you are walking distance from all the touristy attractions but also away from the chaos and madness those attractions bring. this area is very quiet and has many convenient stores close by like the 45 deli directly across the street from the room and la trattoria pizza in the building next to the room. overall, with the hosts communication and the convenient location this place is a 10/10.
nice location, very close to the subway. nice road. beautiful house!
great place in a good location.
sergo was amazing and the place was so clean. he was great help with answering any questions i had. i look forward to staying here in the future.
great location at central nyc. very nice host.

denae was great in every single way! i’ve never been inside, let alone stay, in an apartment in ny before. her apartment was so cute. denae’s place is convenient to everything (transportation included). i would definitely stay here again! absolutely loved being here.
the place is perfect for us, very close to the subway , easy to go anywhere, convenient to get all we need. def gonna stay here again if we visit new york next time!
great stay and very close to the subway!

jan is a great host, easy to communicate with! location is perfect and space is filled with personal touches and a notebook of great recommendations for things to do around brooklyn and nyc. we look forward to staying here again!

cella’s flat is great, very stylish and homely. in a great location being able to walk into williamsburg in 10 or so minutes and a few metro stops very close offering a range of transport options. celia is a great host, very accommodating and offering great availability of communication throughout. would definitely stay again.

overall nice accomodation, a compact but clean room with a comfy bed. nate was friendly and helpful. the location was a bit of a walk away from the stations though, and pretty far from manhattan. also to our unfortune the metro lines had multiple schedule changes and cancellations due to renovations. however, the area is beautiful, stores available on many corners! safe to walk around even in the night time. best toilet paper in the city! 🙏 and ultimate butter complimentary popcorn! would recommend for people mostly staying in brooklyn! :) thank you nate!
good location, friendly host, rooms a small but ok.
nice apartment. easy to find. good parking. no complaints.
gonzalo and nora are exceptional hosts. they are extremely responsive, helpful and always pleasant. the place was exactly as pictured and very clean. i would recommend their place to anyone!
ryan’s place is perfect for exploring all that greenpoint has to offer. the apartment is comfortable and it’s equipped with everything you need for your stay.
great stay with spacious rooms

alexa and james were wonderful hosts, and their space is really charming. super close to everything we wanted to do (beach, restaurants, bars, bay, etc.), and nicely decorated and comfortably furnished. we loved being able to use the outdoor back deck. good communication and super helpful hosts. we'd happily stay with alexa and james again.

we were very happy to have found this listing. it allowed us to visit family at the local hospital, which was within walking distance. it was a nice, quiet residential neighborhood and we had all that we needed for a good night's sleep, with plenty of refrigerator space and utensils. we even had access to two bathrooms. we were on the second floor, so if you don't climb many stairs it can be an issue. it was not for us, so it was perfect. we would definitely stay here again if we were in the area again. we highly recommend this spot.

amy’s place was the perfect home base for our trip to nyc! the on-site parking is a massive plus, so we were able to leave our vehicle all weekend and make the quick walk to the q train to explore brooklyn, manhattan, and even nearby coney island with ease. the apartment itself was spotless, spacious, and inviting for our group of 6. amy was extremely communicative and friendly- she even made up the sofa bed before we arrived! overall i would heartily recommend this place to anyone and hope to stay here again someday
thanks german for you hospitality, my boyfriend and i loved your place and your coffee, we hope to come back soon!

the room/apartment was in a super convenient part of brooklyn, close to the train and within walking distance of many great places to dine or head out for a few drinks. waldemar was flexible on check-in time and made us feel immediately welcome. the room we stayed in was comfortable so no complaints there. overall great experience and i wouldn't hesitate to stay there again!

staff are so friendly. rooms are clean and have everything you need. host is very responsive, we asked to change to a bigger room and we got a response instantly. complimentary coffee was an excellent perk. thanks for a wonderful stay!

leo was an an amazing host and i would recommend his place for anyone who is looking in the area! he was always easy to get a response from and gave many suggestions and could tell he has local knowledge. the location was great and plenty to do in the area!
saved me big time when i locked myself out - thanks for being super responsive
super nice host. the apartment is so close to the metro, laundry mat, markets, great thai bistro restaurant and mexican food! i recommend this place, it has all that you need to enjoy your vacation.
its on a nice and quiet block everyone are so nice stores are in walking distance
nicely situated in greenpoint and very quiet

i really enjoyed my stay at carol's - it was indeed a clean comfortable private room & bath and conveniently located in a nice neighborhood with easy access to so many things - the park, coffee, food, etc. !

spacious, unique loft space in brooklyn. lots of beautiful wood, exposed brick, garden/patio space, nice lighting. close to lots of shops, bars, train. great communication, easy check-in, the host was very friendly and welcoming. highly recommend!!

we had an amazing stay in sandrine’s luxury guest house. contemporary and cosy in a great and interesting brooklyn location. close to transport links, deli groceries and eateries, it really felt like the perfect choice. an easy journey to the hustle and bustle of manhattan and all the main attractions, whilst also being a nice retreat in an authentic, distinct part of brooklyn. sandrine gave us a great list of places to eat too and was always available for advice if needed. we will definitely stay at sandrine’s accommodation in brooklyn if we get the chance to again. we loved it!

great travel experience! michelle is so hospitable and thoughtful. starting with excellent communications, to arriving and advising on places to visit, it could not have been smoother. the place was very clean and comfortable. the stay was truly first class. highly recommended!

this airbnb host and room are so special!! yochi went above and beyond at every step. the space is beautiful and clean. the amenities are unbelievable. we were treated to "samples" from a dinner party yochi hosted (which were delicious!) we were able to do so much because of the convenient location near all train lines. we were in town for less than 48 hours and dined at my favorite restaurant in washington heights, saw a concert in prospect park, took the ferry to rockaway beach, ate dinner at stk (restaurant week!), and saw a show at msg. we felt right at home at yochi's and had great rests so we could get back out to everything we wanted to see and do in the city. i'm very thankful for yochi's hospitality and would love to stay here again
lashauna’s place is exactly as described. self check in was easy, accessible parking & the softest bed ever! i would definitely stay again
they were super accommodating. the house was very cozy. thanks mony and family.
great apartment, suitable for multiple guests and spacious living room.

vitaliy was a great host and his apartment was clean, comfortable and the kitchen was very well equipped. the location is fantastic, shops and restaurants right on your doorstep and the subway is so close. we are a family of two adults and three children and the apartment was perfect for us. the couches were easy to turn into beds, the internet connection worked well and the leftover pantry stock from previous guests was very helpful! being able to walk to central park was wonderful too. this is a great place to stay.
it was a great place, with good amplacement, the host helped us every time we needed so that everything can be perfect

the apartment was really nice! we enjoyed our stay and had an awesome time. the contact was perfect and everything went super well. edwin was really helpfull and seemed to be a cool guy! the neiberhood was totally save and wie felt secure all the time, even in the middle of the night. a grocery store is just around the corner and the subway is easy to reach too, so that you are quick downtown. central park is in walking distance which was great, cause our little daugther loved the playgrounds and we enjoyed to escape the trouble. if we're coming back, we're going to stay there for sure again!
a great place and gordon is a responsive and welcoming host. it was comfortable, clean and had everything we needed. terrific space and a great location! would definitely visit again.
barry is a great host. i had the best sleep.

we enjoyed our stay at this cute little condo. we were a party of 6 adults managed well. the condo is close to great restaurants and subway lines. there are constant taxis passing by as well. 2 beds were very comfortable, one not as comfortable but was fine. the condo was exactly as pictured and we really enjoyed the views from three different angles! there were easy to follow directions for all the amenities with in. i nice plus was there was a men’s and woman’s bathroom down the hall with 2 toilets and 2 showers! easy way to empire state building as we easily walked to times square. we easily made due. we felt safe in this area day and night. will definitely stay here again.
surprisingly big new york apartment. very helpful and hospitable hosts.
beautiful apartment, very quiet and cozy. the location was excellent, close to many restaurants, stores, sights and the subway.
great location, close to buses and subways. check out oui oui and astor row café, if you prefer to be among hipsters, lennox coffee.
