this place was a great! it's a bit tucked away in brooklyn, but the trains were relatively close-by, and getting to and from laguardia airport was very easy. definitely recommend it!
perfect host…quiet place….good value

german’s place is a gem! beautiful, cozy, comfortable. check in was easy and german was a great host. unfortunately, i got sick with covid during the middle of my stay so i didn’t get to take full advantage of everything bed stuy and bushwick have to offer.
great hosts in a very friendly atmosphere highly recommendable

as always, dimitrios's place is my favorite spot in ny for my weekend trips to go to knockdown center. location, easy access, great communication, and always very helpful and attentive to his guests. will certainly be coming back many more times in the future.
luke was a wonderful guest. the apartment was spacious, very well situated and the amenities were fantastic and new. i definitely recommend this apartment.
i liked a lot that room !

staying at the hilton was a wonderful experience! check in and check out was a breeze, the rooms were nicely furnished with the typical hotel items, and everything was clean and comfortable. plus, it was easy to get around brooklyn with the location’s ease of access to different subway stations. can’t complain about a thing.
i would like to come back for sure!
great clean place, awesome location (right by astoria park!), and the host is very communicative and accommodating.
looks just like the pictures, nice property…easy check in! no issues

my stay at jose's place was excellent as always. he is an awesome host and makes you feel right at home. that is something that i can truly appreciate. check in was a breeze, room was the perfect size and the location is amazing! i highly recommend staying at jose's place.

the way that lauren was able to help me was amazing. she made me feel absolutely comfortable and happy to be there. the house was clean and tidy. spacious and comfortable. the neighborhood was quiet and friendly.
hopefully it gets better
the host was very generous and welcome me very kindly. i felt like at home. i recommend because of the good feeling during my visit in ny. the location is exelent. i felt very comfortable.

the experience was great overall. i extended my stay for a couple weeks. the apartment was nice and in a good area. i would stay again. the only thing i’d say is that there was a 5 day period where harrie invited his friend to stay. i enjoyed getting to know his friend but just wish harrie would of mentioned that his friend was staying over. i found out when i came back from running errands and saw his friend in the kitchen. his friend was super nice and it wasn’t a big deal at all just wish the communication was better from harrie’s end. i think if he communicated this upfront, i would of given this experience a 5 star overall. like i said i would definitely book again though. harrie is a good guy and appreciate his help while i was dealing with a shoulder injury. thanks harrie!

olivier was a great host! the directions to the apartment were clear and easy to understand and to navigate from jfk to brooklyn. the apartment and bedroom were clean and spacious and most importantly comfortable. even though olivier wasn't there he messaged me to make sure i was ok and made sure my stay was comfortable. i have no hesitation in recommending olivier and his apartment. thank you for a great stay!!!
it was a great place with nice beach equipment and a very helpful host.
great value for a lovely private dwelling. great local restaurants and cute decor. amy was very communicative and responsive. lovely time!!
i enjoyed very much staying at shuly's house. i recommend it to everybody.
great location, superbly helpful staff......thank you, you provided a great nyc experience!
such a great place! quite spacious for nyc too.

staying at ethan’s place was okay. for the price it was worth it but prepare yourself for spartan living conditions. request for additional towels made ahead of time was not met. there were no toiletries. there was a roll of paper towel but it was already used by the time we got there. when we had issues or additional requests, ethan would be slow to respond and very apathetic when talking over the phone. the place although advertised ac had none. our time staying in the unit was during a heat wave and even for a basement apartment it was warm. water service was okay. we lost hot water one night and had to shower in the cold. flies and ants were present in the unit, with my friend getting bitten by a bug from the air mattress. overall the place was okay. for the price it was worth it. but i would not come back
was very happy with stay but would like to see an instruction pack, as had to keep asking host questions.
very nice place and had everything we needed! also close to subway stations.
andrew and adriana are very friendly and responsive hosts! the place was clean and close to the subway, as advertised.
it wasn't what i expected, but better.

the place is clean, located close to the bus that takes you straight to jfk, quiet (except for street noises), in a decent working class neighborhood. my stay was more than great especially considering i didn't have to break the bank. jason checked in often to make sure everything was to my satisfaction. i'd recommend to anyone coming to brooklyn.

the location in cobble hill couldn't be more perfect--there is so much to do/eat/drink within steps of the apartment. sheila was incredibly well-organized--everything was perfectly set up and she was very responsive when we had questions. a perfect stay!
we had a great time
great location. safe neighborhood. room looks exactly as described. great for long term stays. had a pleasant stay overall. highly recommend for any solo traveler/ couple staying long term.

excellent location! lots of things to do in walking distance and close proximity to subway stops. apartment was as described. very clean. space was typical nyc studio. stairs are narrow and steep, but manageable for average able bodied people. if you are particular about shampoo and soap, recommend bringing your own (as with most airbnbs). took a cab from lga getting into the city as it was raining and wanted to be dropped off at the door. was super easy to take the e train to the q70 lga link bus to get back to the airport. you only need to pay the subway fare.
stay was nice. small but clean.
wonderful hosts, very responsive. even allowed us to check in early. and the space was clean and beautiful!

i was in nyc for three months, in three different places and this was without a doubt the best. there are several subway lines 3 minutes away and getting to manhattan takes 10-15 minutes. there is a trader joes also 3 minutes away which is key to saving on groceries. 15 minutes away is hunters point park that has a nice view of manhattan, many places to eat and do some exercise. the whole area is quite safe and there are a lot of young people. the common areas of the house were always clean. the kitchen had almost everything you need and the bathroom is quite spacious. the subway is very noisy in the living room but in our room it was almost inaudible. despite the fact that there are several tenants, we never had problems with the availability of the bathroom. i would not hesitate to stay at nia's place again.

yelena and her husband have been excellent hosts. due to flight caused issues we arrived at 4am instead of 8pm and they waited for us. air conditioning was readied as unusually warm temperature was in the forecast. yelena helped us out with coins needed for the washer and drier. the apartment was clean, well furnished, spacious and comfortable. it is light and the bedroom windows open to a quiet backyard. one item on our wish list: a microwave. we had a car and with a little patience we always found free parking nearby. the subway and buses are within a short walk. we found everything we needed and had a great time in rego park. loved the many ethnic stores and restaurants. a short walk to 108th street is worth the time. visit carmel and some of the other stored nearby. we will return when next time in nyc, if the apartment will be available. highly recommended.
daniel's stay is just as pictured. super clean, big space, comfy bed and everything was good. i do recommend this place to stay!

small room, the smell was bad, i complained at the front desk and they told me that somebody was going to take care of the problem but nobody came. we were charged 160 dollars for taxes in addition to what we paid to airbnb, that never happened before, airbnb payment is the final amount, but not in this case, which made the whole deal more expensive and if we knew we would’ve rented a different apartment.
beautiful, clean, spacious, and - importantly - quiet apartment in a nice area of manhattan. easy check-in and great communication. highly recommend!

our stay at gisela’s apartment was cozy and comfortable. the street is quiet and close to some great local spots (we loved the french bakery around the corner). note that you’ll have to cross the expressway to get to most businesses in the carroll gardens neighborhood (including the nearest subway stop), but it’s only a 10-15 min walk. the bedroom is really large with plenty of light, kept cool by a window ac unit. all communication with gisela was easy and prompt. we would definitely stay here again!
good location, easy access

my friends and i stayed at paul's place for a girls trip. we enjoyed having the full floor to ourselves and had just enough space to stretch out. the location is just a quick 5 min walk to the c train - perfect for getting into the city or out to jfk airport. paul was a super responsive host and helped us graciously with a package that was left behind. would stay with paul again.
great spot! subway was around the corner.

great place to stay at. short walk to delis, restaurants and the subway (about 45 minutes to broadway/manhattan with the q or b train) peaceful and very quite at night. great livingroom with a well equipped kitchen, nice bathroom and a big bedroom. highly recommend and friendly hosts:)

louann's place is amazing. i never expect food is prepared for guests. my room has drinks, chocolate, sweets. also shampoo, conditioner, soap and towels are also prepared in case that guests forget any of them. the house is near the airport and noise from plane could be disturbing. louann prepares ear plugs, which is really thoughtful. overall great stay. louann is great host. the service is totally beyond my expectation in terms of the price. would definitely stay next time. highly recommended
great location. perfect space and lovely private outdoor area.
great place in a great location yet quiet

the place is clean, walking distance to subway station at around 8 minutes, quite convenient. but need to walk 6 floors without elevator, so if have big luggage, need to think about this. also, need to keep very quiet during the night time, sometimes maybe not very convenient. so far the experience is ok.

everything was perfect. the place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully equipped. communication was smooth and easy, and the stay exceeded all expectations. i would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting.
the place is really nice and clean. they also accommodated our earlier check in and responded quickly to questions.
i really love this place definitely recommend it and would go again back

a very pleasant apartment, clean and well-prepared. it was really very pretty. i had warned the hosts that i would arrive late and they stayed up late to greet me. it was my first airbnb use and everything worked well.

i loved it! everything was like the pictures, really clean and organized. the neighborhood was really nice and the subway was like 10 meter from the home entrance. have in consideration that it does not provide wifi so you have to use a public one.

amazing space for 1-2 people. there’s a full kitchen not pictured. quiet neighborhood. 10-15 min walk to the train station which would probably feel shorter in the summer. the space was clean and smelled lovely.

we had a wonderful stay at andrew’s. the home is very cozy and quiet. the bedroom and bathroom were clean. the location is perfect, just a 10-minute walk to the subway. i highly recommend it and won’t hesitate to come back for my next trip to new york.
i enjoyed my stay, very clean, easy to access and a small cozy place!
marjorie is a great host and her place is beautiful! super stylish and the area is quiet. really enjoyed my time here!

rafael's airbnb was fantastic! his hospitality was exceptional, the location was convenient, and the apartment was cozy and clean. rafael's local tips made our nyc experience memorable. highly recommend for a great stay in the city. thank you, rafael!

good value. great location. in walking distance with luggage fron penn station. could store our luggage for free until our departure fron nyc. extremely important for most travellers. nice to have door men at the reception at all times. very clean, modern interior. great lighting. fresh look. pillows were really bad - which is the only bad thing i can say about the stay

as my first time in airbnb i wasn't expecting much, but when i got there i was suprised! the apartment is just like the photos, location is great, you can catch the subway easily and go anywhere. there is a pharmacy and little market just 3 blocks away and, in the apartment you also find everything you need to cook your own meal. maribel is an incredible host, she left some instructions, basic food, and helped promptly when needed. definitely recomend and will return.

lyndon is the best host ever! he owns crown heights cafe right across the street and is always available and accessible. the apartment is a cozy, comfortable, and quiet space on a very lively street in crown heights. walk out the door and you feel like you are completely connected to a super urban brooklyn vibe. because the apartment is oriented away from the street, you feel completely disconnected from the urban scene when you go inside. we were there during an unrelenting heat wave, but his ac cooled the place well. we were there with our 11 year old while she was at camp, so being able to relax at the end of the day in the hot sun was critical. the three of us were able to get our space when we needed it but in an instant we could re-enter the vibrant neighborhood with its eateries and local shops. prospect park is close as is plenty of brooklyn culture. super experience and thank you lyndon for the daily coffee and croissants!
the room was as listed and anna responded in a timely matter to any questions or concerns that i had. great location and a lot to do around the neighborhood!
shai was super responsive to any request during my stay. the apartment was very well located in hell’s kitchen and very clean.

we had a great stay at the art loft and richard was easy going and responsive. lots of great coffee shops, restaurants and shops nearby. easy to get into the city. place was as described, clean and cozy. there is noise from the train if you’re not a city goer but that’s to be expected! thanks for everything!

we stayed at xiren's apartment for eight nights. the place was right in the thick of it, we couldn't have been closer to the sights of east village. we didn't get to meet xiren but the keys were easy to pick up/drop off at the local deli. we didn't spend much time in the apartment but it was good for our needs - a comfortable bed and great location. the stairs are formidable but we were only using them once a day so no big deal.
aracelis was a great host! she was very good at communicating, answering questions, and helping us out with our stay.

had such a fantastic stay here. place was really great and spacious, rare for new york. really great 24 hr. bodega down the road (great chop cheese samich and a lot of other great things!) liquor store across the street was nice too. location to times square was fantastic and easy walking distance to so much more. apartment was clean, spacious, and just perfect. neighbors were nice and felt completely safe in the neighborhood. would 100% stay here again. only slight issue was it does get hot in the apt. if you don't have the floor fan going. besides that, place is pretty fantastic, especially for the price! angelica as a host allowed flexible check-in times and was very responsive and kind. check in was very easy and building was nice with a very old new york charm. 9.5/10
great location with easy access to subways or walking!
wonderful place! it looked exactly like the photos and has such a beautiful back yard. check in was easy as was finding parking. definitely recommend.

stayed at teedo’s for a month and our stay was pleasant. the neighborhood was pretty safe and we didn’t experience any unfortunate incidents in the area. teedo is very accommodating, answers all my questions and he is very detailed with instructions for checking in and recommendations of places in the area. will definitely reconsider his place again on our next trip to nyc!
teresa is a friendly and attentive host. the location is terrific for a nyc visit and everything is just as shown in the listing.
great stay!! it was cozy and felt just like home!! it was only 10 mins from jfk, definitely recommend staying here!
maxine is a wonderful host, very responsive.
lovely clean amenities. excellent and timely communication with hosts. we had a great time

alina was very helpful in arranging for a friend to be there when we got in at 10pm (she was away). we were driving up and got stuck in traffic. the apartment is as billed. great neighborhood. it is an older prewar apartment with some of the quirks of such buildings e.g. the apartment was toasty warm with the heat off:). all in all a nice place to stay for one person in the city. will likely rent again as i am often in nyc.
very lovely place in a good neighborhood.
clean, comfortable, and well located room.
great host, great spot. i look forward to coming back and staying with kwadwo.

steve’s place is amazing. located near central park and with a metro station right at the doorstep it has everything you need for an amazing time in nyc. and it‘s beautiful and clean. next time in new york we‘ll be at steve‘s ;)

i reserved robert's place for 7 weeks in the summer because i was attending a program at columbia. i had to cancel my program at columbia so i only was able to stay in robert's place for 4 weeks. overall i thought it was a excellently located, safe, spacious, clean apartment.

the place is as nice as it looks on photos. peter respond quickly to every message but we haven't seen him so we can't tell you much. but it was a deception: you don't have the address before a first non-refundable payment and i learned quickly why: the apartment is very close to what peter named in the description here a «sanation garage» which is, in fact, 12 (more?) garbage trucks parked in the street, next to the house. the street was a small river of a smelly garbage juice (to the point where we didn't want to turn on the air conditioning - to make sure the smell doesn't enter the apart.) the houses nearby have placarded windows (but not abandoned) - that doesn't contribute to make you feel safe, even though i didn't have any problem - and it was an unbelievably noisy at night with crowdy parties - music, cars, people outside...) well, not a place for kids. sadly, i had 2 with me.
very good stay, very clean and description was accurate. also very good communication.
ben has a great place in brooklyn. we felt very at home.
the bed was comfortable, and the people at the reception are friendly and helpful, simply it was a very good experience.
conveniently located and very pleasant.
great location, good for any first timers stay

great place! great location! very clean. perfect for two people. david is very responsive and even checked in just to confirm we had everything we needed and if we were having a good time. excellent host!
we had a great stay, location is great an most things are within walking distance
good destination near subway, clear room, good comunication.
casimir’s place was as expected, easy check in and the neighborhood was quiet and easy street parking. i will definitely stay again upon my return.
janice provide a beautiful room and lots of amenities to make it a very warm and friendly place to stay. i would highly recommend her place to anyone staying in brooklyn.

great stay at waldemar’s place. room and bathroom were spacious and we enjoyed the deck outside as well. communication was quick and easy and the location is fantastic. kind and friendly host, would definitely recommend and stay again.

i think azime is a great host, very helpful, big room, very big closet. but the room doesn't have much furniture. the bathroom is clean. the room is not very far from the train station. the location also has a lot of grocery stores. near a laundry shop and a restaurant.
we had a comfortable stay! room is clean & accessible to public transportation. deigo has been very responsive to all my queries. worth the price!
very good place to stay! staff is responsive and friendly.
the place had a really good location and it was also super clean. will stay there again if i go to ny! tim was super good host by the way.

i can't speak more highly of my stay here and would highly recommend anyone visiting nyc to stay here!! evie and nader are very warm, welcoming, and communicative as well which made my stay so pleasant and comfortable. in addition, the location of this airbnb is so prime - surrounded by amazing restaurants, cafes, galleries, cute little stores, etc. while also still being very safe, peaceful and quiet. you also get a lot of privacy with your own private entrance, bathroom, bedroom and balcony with amazing views. i will definitely be returning here the next time i visit nyc :)
great place for exploring the east village, and a nice base to have.
very friendly folks, very communicative, and a cute little spot right in the place we wanted to be. thanks, isabelle & jack!
great deal for the new york city, near public transportation

caitlin place is ideally located in the upper westside of manhattan close to restaurants, shops and a subway stop. she is 3 block from central park. we had a lovely stay at caitlin’s place. she is a great host, gives good recommendations. her place is charming and very clean. the next time i am in nyc i will definitely be staying with caitlin. i highly recommend her place.
perfect location for our visit and graduation celebration.

we stayed a sen's place for 4 weeks while we looked for permanent residence. it was great! sen was very quick to respond and would stop by to help whenever there was an issue or we had a question. the space is big and had lots of room to spread out which is nice. we always felt safe in the neighborhood and enjoyed the quick commute to the subway. thanks again sen!

neida was a great host. she was very clear in her check-in instructions and was flexible with my check-in time which helped me out a lot. she also let me be on my own which is what i prefer, and we did have a nice long chat the day i was leaving. the apartment itself is nice, the building could use some cleaning but that's beyond neida's responsibility. the walls are a bit thin, so you can hear the neighbors sometimes (mainly one guy was snoring) but i didn't have any trouble falling asleep. overall had a nice and pleasant stay, would recommend!
beautiful place!
great stay! bowen was an amazing host would recommend this to anyone looking to a comfortable and homey stay in brooklyn.
amazing room view & rooftop made up for the small space. still loved it.
great place to stay, vincent is very & welcoming location is good as there is a lot to do in the area also would recommend thanks for the stay
the location is perfect if you like being close to lower manhattan. we were in a a short walking distance to coffee shops, restaurants, shopping and museums!
ruby was very kind and accommodating, and the place was very nice - comfortable bed and huge bathroom. great value!
my stay at the fidi hotel was lovely! walking distance to many resturaunts and concert venue, pier 7. staff were polite and attentive. hotel room was peaceful and quiet.
great place! stayed for about a month during a school rotation and had zero issues. place was very clean and in an amazing location. would 100 percent stay there again !!
jay's apartment was exactly as advertised - very spacious, very quiet and in a great location! jay was also super accommodating and helpful.
great stay! highly recommend!

eran’s place is super cool! the location can’t be beaten, surrounded by lots of trendy bars and restaurants and easy walk to time square and broadways! the apartment is very modern and cozy with subtle touch. check in and out is very easy and smooth. we will have no doubt to stay here again next time in manhattan!

i had an amazing stay at frank’s place! it had all the amenities i needed, and the air conditioner was incredibly powerful, it kept us very comfortable. the bed was truly a 10/10, one of the best i’ve ever slept in at any airbnb. i also loved meeting their pups, they’re such calm and gentle fur babies. the location was perfect: the train was right around the corner, making it super easy to get anywhere we needed to go, and there’s even a pharmacy nearby. frank also gave us some great recommendations for local restaurants in the neighborhood, which we really appreciated. thank you so much for allowing us to stay with you and meet your pups. we’ll definitely be back next time!
thank you for the pleasant stay. the balcony scenery was breathtaking.
everything was great! the views from the rooftop was beautiful, the hosts were extremely pleasant, and the room and place was clean.
it was the best sleep that i had in a while, no regrets. compty, cozy, convenient, respectful and peaceful.
perfect stay for the 3 of us. we loved the bar in the hotel (broken shaker), and the room was very nice. would definitely recommend

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5 stars!!! i had an amazing stay at this airbnb in brooklyn. the location was perfect just a short walk to the nearest train station, making it easy to get around the city. there were plenty of great food spots nearby, which was a huge plus. the place was very clean, comfortable, and had everything i needed for my stay. the room was a 10/10, and the space was well-equipped with a kitchenette, bathroom, and a couch that converts into a bed, making it both convenient and functional. the bed was also incredibly soft and comfortable, and i slept great throughout my stay. the hosts were absolutely amazing, friendly, responsive, and incredibly helpful throughout my stay. i couldn't have asked for a better experience and would definitely stay here again. highly recommend so book them today!!! 😊

beautifully renovated and artfully decorated. great location in crown heights and an easy walk to franklin ave. quiet neighborhood, nearby grocers, cafes, restaurants. had a fully stocked kitchen which we did not even use! please note, this is a 3rd floor apt accessible by stairs only.
this place is stylish and well kept with a good kitchen and good beds. great original art! back yard with nice little porch.
lovely place, recommend it!

here’s the thing… if you are not staying out late or will be using cab/uber then it’s fine. it’s a dangerous location after dark so if you’ll be using the subway/walking after dark then it’s a no. all the furniture is literally falling apart!!! it’s very hot at night, the ac does not work, there’s no place to put your suitcase, and the bathroom was not very clean. it was me, my husband, and my mom… we made it work, but we paid about $800 and just with that money the host could replace his falling apart ikea furniture. the apt gets you quick access to a bunch of stuff and since i’ve lived in ny before moving south staying in town helped get faster access to the touristy places. sadly the host blamed us for scratching his dishwasher which was so absurd to me to even hear that!! i’ve never had that kind of issue and was astounded, but i’ve told him i refuse to own responsibility of something i’ve not done, so many things wrong with the place but we did not complain to him.
very good accommodation and very convenient!
phil was a helpful host. the place was good for its price and it had a great location, close to the subway and commerce.

we’re so glad to have found wing’s place. it was the perfect spot for an overnight stay and close to jfk. wing was so friendly and helpful. the only bad part is that we wish we would’ve had a longer stay!

kristen was a great host, very helpful, considerate and friendly. we enjoyed very much the welcoming atmosphere and the perfectly renovated brownstone flat equipped with everything we needed. a perfect and quiet place to stay. highly recommended.
great stay , i booked last minute and great communication. great hospitality

my girlfriend and i had an amazing time at doyen’s place. the place is just as the photos portray and it was really clean. the location was pretty good, it’s a quite neighborhood but still close to a lot businesses so u can easily get most of things u need within a 5 mile radius. as for doyen, he is an amazing host, he’s so quick to reply whenever we reached out with questions or needed help. he did everything he could to make our stay enjoyable and we really appreciated that. we’ll definitely stay again whenever we’re in new york.
the apartment was lovely and anna was very accommodating, friendly and responsive. lots of great stuff to do around the neighbourhood and many good restaurants nearby!

great place. there are some reviews about the ac but it’s pretty simple on how to operate. people out front are a bit sketchy but it’s not unsafe if that makes sense. the apartment is great, the controls make it nice. the bathroom is super cool. balcony. it was a great stay. i’ll be staying here for all my ny stays.
great stay! would definitely stay again. very responsive and kind host.
lorna was communicative, addressed any issues promptly, and was very sensitive to all our needs.

we really enjoyed flo's apartment. we've had some troubles at our first day, but flo was super-professional and solved everything right the way it supposed to be. the room is very nice, but the house doesn't have an elevator - please consider that, in case you will need that. i can't think of any minuses, our trip to new york was beautiful and everything thanks to flo. she's great host and i would highly recommend her place if you'll think of visiting ny.
the place is dirty there were mice
fun place , the kids running it were great !
great place to stay for the price! easy to get to the 1 train and into columbus circle in 30min. they are very friendly people, and i would stay here again.

excellent apartment, had everything we needed. exactly as described, real soho apartment experience. super area, coffee shops, restaurants, trader joe’s, subway station all within a few minutes walk. really comfortable apartment. great run routes along the hudson and brooklyn/manhatten bridges nearby. lovely hosts, always communicative.
very nice house and very clean as well with street parking available.

maria was an incredible host! she was very responsive and the stay was smooth. the entire place was spotless and i was able to get a great nights sleep knowing that. there was a lot of privacy as well, which was exactly what i was looking for. i would recommend her listing and if in the area again will definitely re-book.

a wonderfully spacious ground floor apartment with a large back garden.. lots of old world charm; parquet floors, tin ceilings and wood paneling. kitchenette and bathroom are nicely tiled and modern. location was great; on a block of typical brooklyn brownstones, just a very short walk to restaurants, markets and fort green park. jane was flexible and quick about responding to questions. we'd definitely stay there again.
amazing place. mandi had great communication. would definitely recommend.
great place, super clean and comfortable

anna & toms renovated brownstone was the perfect place to relax after a long day of being out and about. the neighborhood is lively and close to the j train which was great for getting around brooklyn and manhattan. it's also close to a city bike station which we got great use out of as well. some cute restaurants and coffee spots scattered throughout the neighborhood and about a 15 walk to a street with a few recommended restaurants. all the appliances are fairly new and high end and the giant bathtub was amazing. also very nice to relax outside in the little yard. great neighborhood vibes!

i recommend this place. the room is wonderful, spacious, with nice furnitures. the bed is comfortable and large. it's very clean. it’s calm. the bathroom is also good. the house is well located, 3 mn walk from the metro, 10/15 mn walk from the main street of harlem (you can go to the apollo theater by foot). communication is easy with judie and steven.
rosas great. right in the heart of the neighborhood and very accommodating. 10/10

celina and felipe were the most kind and friendliest hosts we have ever encountered. they both go out of their way to help you feel comfortable and at home in any way they can. the home was clean, bright, and inviting. the location was ideal and accessible as well. would 1000% stay with them again the next time we return to nyc. great hosts and even greater humans!!

esther and her niece are the kindest hosts i've met to date. they really made sure i felt comfortable and welcome in their home. will definitely stay again! cute apartment and roosevelt island is a gem!
i would definitely recommend this place, but would rent with private bathroom.
i love love love this hotel!! it’s so beautiful and clean and stylish the staff is amazing and super nice. i def recommend this place to anyone i know visiting new york

it is ok for the money. however, the room is in a basement without a window. no fresh air at all. air conditioning smells bad when is on. the smell in the room is not good either. it is not good for light sleepers since you can hear every move of another person in the house. overall it was clean except the smell.

hands down one of the best places i got to stay at, absolutely clean and modern. ramis and svetlana are absolutely amazing super hosts, rapid response, very hospitable and accurately professionals. beautiful brownstone house strategically centered and close to all, from place to nyc about 15-20 minutes, and just a short ride distance from a lot of attractions. i highly recommend this place to anyone. thanks ramis and svetlana.

we loved this place! it's exactly as described and nicole the host was responsive and friendly. perfect for a couple, equidistant to 3 different subway lines so it's easy to get around. highly recommend this place!

cynthia is an amazing host and her home a beautiful piece of art. i was really impressed with how spotlessly clean the place is. this is without a doubt the best place for the price in all of manhattan...and nicer i'm sure than most places twice the price.
if you're looking for a place to stay that is on the cheaper end of ny hotels but is still nice, look no further. clean rooms, nice and helpful staff, and breakfast included.
kevin made sure to take care of any issues we had quickly, and was very responsive. it was a great time and we enjoyed our stay!

excellent area. the room was nice but dated. but it gave the charm of nyc. the staff is amazing. i never had an issue getting what i needed. the fact that there is 24 hour front desk is a plus. weekly housekeeping is great. did not like the laundry room. very old. but a very reasonable wash and fold laundromat a few doors down.
the pictures don't do it justice! beautiful space, great neighborhood, great host! i highly recommend staying here!
shared space and bathroom mid-town manhattan.
such a beautiful and spotless place! it felt like home the moment i arrived, and i’d come back again in a heartbeat.

i stayed at this house and my family and i enjoyed it very much; it had a very pleasant and beautiful atmosphere. mrs. sonya is a very kind and attentive host. i definitely recommend this place and would return.
thank you for the stay

i had a great stay with desiree! the room is nice a spacious, beds comfy, great location close to multiple trains and the park! desiree was super welcoming and has a super friendly kitty names melody that likes to cuddle. 10/10!

this place is marvelous! the location was great, close to many popular flat bush restaurants and bars. the owners were very good at communicating and check on me periodically to make sure everything was good to go. i definitely highly recommend to any future customers to stay. excellent professional service! thank you dawn and vernon i hope we can do business in the near future.
10/10 stay. amazing accommodations. second time booking with them and never disappointed.
great place!
always a stellar stay in these tiny but mighty spaces - big thanks to mo at the front desk for always being so helpful and the staff for being rockstars.

emmy's place is the best you can find in this segment. quiet, calm, very green area. lots of inexpensive cafes and shops nearby. bus stop 5 minutes walk from the house. express train f which will take you to manhattan in 25-30 minutes .the room itself is very cozy and stylish, emmy took care of everything in advance. a fully equipped kitchen is at your disposal. large living room with soft sofas too. i have seen two other rooms in this house and i must say that they are even better. they look like an expensive hotel. emmy and menandro respond quickly to requests and are always available. all in all, a perfect place in every sense. highly, super, extremely recommended!!

the room was nice and the check in process was easy. there was a mixup and someone else tried to enter our room about 30 minutes after we checked in, which was a bit unsettling. additionally, we tripped a breaker while using the provided hair dryer and were without power to our outlets for most of our stay. they were responsive to try and fix the issue, but it was unable to be resolved before we left. overall, the beds were comfortable and it was in a convenient location and i would be willing to give it another try in the future.

the room is small but fine for one person. julie was a very good host, she has her the apartment in very clean condition also. the neighbourhood is very nice too and the place is only two blocks away from the subway.

i used mei’s place as a crash pad for a two-day visit with my family. i checked in late (10pm) on the first evening and mei was there to welcome me to her home. super easy as we communicated clearly on when i would arrive. the bedroom was clean and spare, the bed quite comfortable with a bathroom next door and a shower/bathroom downstairs. i checked out early (6 am) when i left. no issues. just locked the door behind me. this is the first time i took a room vs a whole unit to myself. my stay was brief but it worked out really well for my needs. mei was very welcoming and i really felt at ease coming into her home. she was quite responsive using the airbnb message feature for any questions i had. i was very pleased with the experience.
great location a few blocks from the heart of williamsburg and 5 min walking from subway.

this place was excellent for the price and location. had everything i needed (and then some). just know that the toilet is not in the apartment - but is directly across the hall. the tub is in the apartment. the whole situation worked out well. highly recommend.
super little apartment,great communication with negra. super neighbourhood. we had a great holiday.
nice and good to stay.

great place, really captures the atmosphere of brooklyn. felt very at home there. location is perfect: quiet and calm yet near everything you need. subway connection is excellent, almost every line within a 10 min walk. would definitely recommend this place!
very comfortable stay in a great location! the kitchen was very mindfully stocked and easy to use which was a bonus.
extremely clean and organized place. highly recomended.

this location can't be beat - close to food, attractions, and several subway entrances to make travel so simple. we had five adults and were surprised with how comfortable the airbnb was. despite being a studio, we were able to all sleep, shower, etc. with no issues. the hosts were do easy to communicate with and proactively checked in to make sure we had everything we needed. we would definitely book again!
highly recommend this listing. one of the most stunning views that i still think about! clean with great amenities, close to the subway station and plenty to explore within the area.
i had a great stay at brady’s place! it was very peaceful and clean! also very easy to get into the city for work and also some great food spots within walking distance !
awesome location
i loved everything about my stay i felt so at home and relaxed even though in the big city with so much chaos it can he hard to find some peace but this spot was amazing and recommended for anyone!

louann is the most attentive airbnb host i’ve ever had. she personally greeted us and showed us around, and she even offered us food when our uber eats driver cancelled on us at 1 am after a long flight.
very clean bachelor apartment, had everything we needed. easy walk to the j line. jade was easy to communicate with. definitely recommend!

shahram was an exceptionally wonderful and attentive host. i was part of a small bridesmaid party staying there so he had a great bottle of red waiting for us when we arrived. also, when i asked of a good place to eat, he sent me an email with plenty of recommendations. the place is beautifully furnished, comfortable and quiet. it's in a nice neighborhood with plenty of restaurants and shops very close by, all walking distance. if planning a relaxing visit to brooklyn, i highly recommend staying here.
anthony’s home was a good stay. he communicated very well. besides the third floor shower not working this place was good for my group’s needs.
excellent place to stay. the value for the price is perfect. the host’s attention was great, the place was very clean, and overall it’s definitely worth staying here. highly recommended.

new york, new york... :-) sharon's room was how describe cozy, sunny and very clean. brooklyn from my experience its safe and friendly area. many shops, restaurant and graet atmosphere. lokation ist perfect with subway and bus you can fast get to all directions nyc. i recommend from all my heart.

i reserved this apartment/room for two friends that were visiting from out of town. i tried a number of listings on airbnb, and this was more or less the last resort before i turned to a much more expensive hotel search. this was a perfect stay! at first, i booked three separate stays because there was no one continuous stay available, so my friends would've had to move twice throughout their stay. however, when i arrived to the room with my friends, i found out that the hotel was able to keep them in the same room for the full duration. a pleasant & convenient surprise!! the location was great. the room was great. the service was great. the people were great. everything was...well...great! next time i need a place to stay for out of town friends, i know where i'll be going. huge thanks to dana and the box house hotel!

the surrounding area is a residential district, and living here feels safe. there is a bus stop within a five-minute walk. the rooms near the highway can be a bit noisy, but it doesn't affect my sleep. the landlord is very kind and has helped me promptly when i had difficulties. overall, it was a good experience!
great spot to stay

bobby and molly are amazing hosts. they went above and beyond to accommodate my family and i. proximity to the beach and children’s playground with sprinkles is perfect. i would definitely return to enjoy the rockaway’s through bobby’s hospitality. thank you bobby and molly

it was great to stay at this place. loved their cats.
thank you for a private and clean space for my family.

niko was a very friendly and helpful before , during and at the end of the stay. he made us feel at home and showed us around in his apartment and the neighbourhood - it is clear he is a big fan of a local italian restaurant. he is completely right. i loved it was really quite at night, you didn't hear anything of the traffic outside. he was also well organised by having the room ready on arriving, and having an alternative way to return the keys. overal i really recommend niko if you are staying in nyc. thanks again for your hospitality!

shannon's place is very spacious and tastefully decorated. everything is so clean. the beds are super comfortable (likely the most comfortable i have come across in all my airbnb stays) and the linens have the nice clean smell and feel. the house is in a convenient location with a short walk to subway and shops and restaurants. it is not far from prospect park where one can have a walk or run.
great place

barry is an honest hardworking host who is seen cleaning one room or another at least once a day. his place is humble as advertised and fair for the price. it is mostly quiet but i could hear people chatting outside(?) in the evening. i did not cook, but the kitchen is available. there are ant/roach catcher devices placed throughout. the photo of the workspace is not from the same room as the photo with the bed. breakfast/snacks are not provided (erroneously listed under services).
everything was great only thing is there are two different elevators for the roof top access but a tenant told us how to get to it which it was beautiful will stay again in the future
a nice place and good price. very quiet place. very nice personal touches in the room like dishes and toothpaste.
janet's apartment is very nice. she was really kind and lets us food and cookies and explained us everything about the apartment and the neighborhood. i recommend highly the place.

place was nice and clean and very quiet of your looking for some quiet time but the only thing i didn’t like was that someone was able to walk-in the place didn’t feel like there was enough privacy but other than that nice place to enjoy your quiet time.

our stay at "serene in sunset" was 1st rate.dan is a wonderful host who goes the extra mile to make sure your stay is a good experience. don't be afraid to ask questions.dan has a vast knowledge nyc and he is happy to share with you.the apartment was very clean and has all the comforts of home.you couldn't ask for more.the neighborhood is diverse and welcoming.a great place to explore. access to the subway was easy and the subway line was a good line to go reach your destination in any part of nyc. it was a great experience!!!!

great location! walking distance from so much! typical nyc room size, but the futon does make it a little trick getting around the room. first floor is definitely a bit noisy due to the bar underneath. would definitely recommend for walkability and price!

we had a very nice stay from arrival to departure easy to access and very clean and comfortable . they even had snacks and coffee for our enjoyment. i had a question and they were quick to respond. plenty of places to eat nearby and easy to get to public transportation. thanks a bunch

we had an amazing experience at melissa's place. so clean and comfortable! the apartment is very well located, close to several subway lines. melissa keeps the place up and clearly cares about the comfort of her guests. she was also very hospitable, responsive, and friendly. we really appreciated how well equipped the apartment is -- she's thought of everything! we will definitely be going again.
good amenities. very close to subway. great communication. very good trip all round
very clean and pretty place, safe and quiet neighborhood, street parking available, but take a while to find. will definitely come back again if i have needs.

great host, gives you privacy, he lets you enjoy the apt, location really near to the subway and a lot of super markets. i recommend him if you are planning to come to ny and you want to do some sightseeing, he will give you tips too.

the apartment was as pictured, except for minor details like the area rug or vase, etc. well kept, clean and cozy. also not pictured is the mud room, which is spacious and very convenient, especially when traveling with children who are coming in with wet boots and layers to pull off. also, keeping children in mind, the shower is a single standing shower with the shower overhead. there is no tub or easy accessibility to bath small children. overall we had a very pleasant and quite stay. my children loved the place and the coziness. it's very short walking distance to the train, supermarket, busy street with restaurants and shops. i could not have found a more convenient location.

edwin is a super host! he was attentive, kind and considerate. the room is exactly as described. it is comfortable, quiet and it is plenty of room for nyc. the bathroom and kitchen are also great and well-supplied. the location is perfect to explore manhattan and the other boroughs as it is close to subways and busses. there is also tons of great food in the neighborhood. i would stay again! thanks!

bayan was really communicative and friendly. the place is small but functional, and that was as expected. the neighbourhood is really interesting and we likely wouldn't have landed there without staying at this spot, so i'm grateful for that-- ate the best caribbean food of my life and there's an incredible park a few blocks away. it's walking distance to the subway which is nice, easy to get around in the daytime but we did have a bit of trouble getting back there from other boroughs late at night, so just make sure you plan for that ahead of time. the kitchen isn't super well-appointed, for example there wasn't a cutting board or coffee filters, and no table for eating at besides the coffee table-- not a huge deal but if you're planning to cook a lot it's worth noting. you need to move the couch basically against the bathroom door to sit at the workspace desk, but i just worked from the couch and it was fine. overall good value for money in nyc and a good experience!
this is really a boutique hotel using airbnb, and it is way better value than neighboring ny hotels. recommended
the best glad i chose her place
nice place, quiet neighbour and not far from the subway station. highly recommend it!

chris is one of the most hospitable and friendly hosts we’ve had at an airbnb. he greets you and is the friendliest guy. we stayed here for the ny half marathon, because the start line was nearby in grand army plaza, and because prospect heights is awesome! this private studio space is located in the first floor of chris and his family’s gorgeous home (they live on the top floors), the room has high ceilings, and it is secluded and very quiet (other than street noise, which is expected in brooklyn). there is a small kitchen area outside of the private room, too. there is easy subway access around the corner, and you can walk everywhere! the space is quaint and has the essentials, but is definitely a minimalist style, so if you prefer more luxuries - this isn’t the place for you (but it worked for us!). the queen bed is very very firm, there is a small table with two chairs, shelves and a dresser for your things. the bathroom is small, but has a great hot shower (most important for us). we felt comfortable here and it enriched our overall experience - we will stay again!
great host and a very clean room near jfk. perfect for an overnight stay if you are flying out of jfk. i have stayed with them before and will in the future. satisfied repeat customer!

eliza’s place was in a wonderful location! very close many wonderful nyc attractions, and only a 10-15 minute walk to time square which was so convenient! very close to an overnight parking garage as well. i recommend bringing your own hair dryer as well as toiletries as the hair dryer had hardly any power and the toiletries were small plastic bag portions. check in was very smooth and easy. there was a hefty reservation change fee for adding an extra guest fee even though i added the extra guest within the same day as booking, so i recommend shorting out those details in advance to save yourself the fee. i would definitely recommend this place though, wonderful location and very smooth check-in with kind receptionist. i hope to come back again :)
robson was such an amazing and helpful host. we were made to feel welcome from start to finish. he was so friendly and gracious. i would absolutely stay with robson again!
albert is a thoughtful host who makes it easy to use his place.

stay was nice. check in was very easy. was able to find street parking nearby. about a 10 minute walk from the train which was nice to go to manhattan. the beds are full size so it’s little snug with two people but not terrible. bathroom was clean and had plenty of towels.
the location and hotel were great for a short visit to nyc.
ephraim was a great host. his apartment was clean and cozy. he was available to assist me with things i needed help with. i would definitely stay here again

easy access to central park and broadway via subway, just a couple of blocks away. one or two blocks from great restaurants, shopping and grocery. i was surprised that the neighborhood was so quiet, as it is sandwiched between two busy avenues. very little traffic and the neighbors are courteous. would recommend this place for those who want to have access to the action but want to have a quiet safe haven to come back to.
the space was just as advertised and worked great for our trip to the mets game!

what a lovely place to stayed. i spend a week in maja s apartment and i can highly recommended. i will definitely booked her again ! it was a very nice experience and i am very happy finding this place to stay. thank you very much maja !

tj's place is a great place to stay for a weekend in thr city. the room was immaculately kept, and extremely comfortable. the listing was as described and i would definitely stay again if i were in the area!
great place! close to metro and you can get to manhattan in 20 mints. dominic was very hospitable​ and helpful. our stay in his home was quite enjoyable.
great location, apartment perfectly clean and how it’s described. hosts are very accommodating. i would definitely recommend!

caroline is an amazing host! starting off the airbnb had a very quick and easy check in process, she made sure everything in the house was clean and ready to go. she was extremely responsive, responding within minutes when something was needed. she allowed us to stay an extra hour after check out due to us running a bit later than planned and even went above and beyond as to check for something we left in the airbnb agreeing to ship it back to us. caroline is wonderful and i would highly recommend booking any of her properties.

everything was perfect! if i could rate the entire experience 10000 i would ❤️. the location had its own small view but what sold me was the walking distance. you literally are center mark to everything. i definitely will be back again. thank you priscilla for making my first stay in nyc a top notch experience.

celina's place was great! she was very responsive when i confused part of the checkin process. everything inside was well laid out. i appreciated the touches that gave a feel of being able to look outside despite not being able to. itis walking distance to many restaurants, delis and shops. walking distance to st johns univ. local busses nearby. this one of the best stays i've had in nyc. i highly recommend her place. you won't be disappointed.

great place and as advertised. i would use this again and recommend others as well. it was nice little guest house in behind the owners property, with own private entrance. owner was available when needed (which was rare since everything was working fine) but also gave us our privacy. they were also flexible with check and check out times. clean, modern and all the amenities one would need.
jill and carl did everything to make her home a very good place to stay for a visit to nyc, brooklyn, williamsburg, long island, ...

we had a great stay at rodrigo and cecilia's place. check-in was easy. the place looked exactly like the pictures. when we first arrived we were not satisfied with how clean the place was, but within hours of texting the hosts - their cleaning person came and did a great job! communication was great with both of them. we had some problems with allergies and the hosts went above and beyond to bring us an air purifier and address our needs. we were there for a whole month and the place was perfect for what we needed: close to various bus and subways lines, great food nearby, drop off laundry around the corner. we had been concerned about noise in the front of the apartment, but that wasn't a problem. the temperature was very hot in nyc, but the apartment stayed cool with the air conditioner in the livingroom. all in all, we would return the next time we are in nyc and recommend the place to friends and family.
great fun location and safe. hosts were always responsive. would recommend this place and would return again.
great location, really large size for a new york hotel room, friendly and helpful staff and great public space. would absolutely stay here again!
would recommend 10/10
can’t thank raheem and the team enough for their support in trying to assist us with an extremely early check in and being super responsive and being very accomodating to request by our family.
very prompt communication, property as advertised, convenient location, and within walking distance to the subway (longish walk). we’re very satisfied.

our family of 6 had a very comfortable week-long stay here. it’s a beautiful and homey place. the first thing i noticed was the lovely smell. it was so nice. there were a lot of thoughtful touches that i appreciated and set this place apart from many airbnbs we have stayed at like extra toothbrushes, plenty of toilet paper, lots of towels, etc. we enjoyed the record player. the subway was about a 10 to 15 minute walk, which worked out fine for us and it was a convenient way to get into the city. along the walk there is a lot of trash along the sidewalks and the neighborhood is generally rundown and noisy with a lot of honking and blaring radios, but we felt safe and never had any problems. there was a very nice, large laundromat in the neighborhood that we used. in the apartment we didn’t notice the noise of the streets much. the beds were comfortable. one child slept on the couch in the office, which wasn’t as comfortable naturally, but he was fine. lots of stairs coming in, so that’s something to be aware of. also, the shower takes longer than you might expect to warm up, but it does eventually get warm. we were very happy with our stay here and would do it again in a heartbeat.
the room is a little bit small and the condition is okay. the location is perfect: right located close to the wall street and it’s about 3 minutes walk from subway station.
thank you milton for your hospitality and responsiveness. staying at your cozy place, i felt like i was reliving memories of my harlem days in the city in real time.
great location and just what you need for a stay in nyc.

great place and amazing hosts. really much more than expected. and really affordable too! the house is clean and you have every basic thing at your disposal. it is one of the best stays i’ve had on rbnb for a while. highly recommended to anyone staying in queens!
clean spot, very small rooms but more affordable than other hotels in the area. very close to times square and broadway.

ester is a super host. she really looks after her guests. ester’s place is in a quiet neighbourhood and the location is convenient for both the tram and the subway to manhattan. the room was as described and the bed was super comfortable. the en-suite was a half bathroom and the full bathroom was shared with ester and her family. many thanks for being such a great host!

max is a wonderful host and his place is quite charming. we enjoyed both the cozy, private room upstairs as well as great conversation with max. max knows nyc very well and offered us great tips and recommendations. all in all, a very nice experience and we would definitely recommend staying with max :)

alexa was a fantastic host and her family is very charming! the space was clean, cool (air conditioned), and cozy. it is luxurious yet homey, with elements of the original brownstone architecture still intact. the kitchen includes a dishwasher and is stocked with utensils, plates, cups, etc., plus a few spices, tea, and coffee. the beds were extremely comfortable and there’s a desk in one room which was helpful on days when i needed to work from the apartment. the neighborhood is beautiful, vibrant, and filled with tons of local shops and delicious restaurants. the subway is within walking distance which makes further exploration easy. i had an excellent stay overall! don’t hesitate to book - you’ll love it here!

rebecca's place is beautiful, quiet and located very conveniently to subway stations, quaint coffee shops, prospect park and more. the apartment is spacious and filled with everything necessary for a visit to the city.
i had a very short stay of 16hrs but it was central to where i needed to be. the home was spotless and the hosts were very friendly!
place was great just as i expected . would stay here anytime
perfect location. nice house. best for price. highly recommended!

annette's place was just what we were looking for during our family vacation. easy access to the subway that got us everywhere we needed to go. the space was comfortable and quiet. the neighborhood had plenty of food and coffee options, and the cvs nearby was available for everything else we needed.

this beautiful, spacious and sparkling clean apartment is steps from the beach. john and ashley, the owners, live upstairs with their two young children and are lovely people. john is very responsive to any and all questions or concerns (not that there were any). this is a great spot for surfers, as it faces a long stretch of beach dedicated to surfing, and there are a couple of surf schools operating right off the boardwalk.
is exactly a picture. great location.
i enjoyed my stay at daniel’s to figure it out the cable it was a very soothing stay quiet neighborhood parking right in front and everything that i need it. i highly recommend.
great place and good communication from host. would recommend

frederique's home was immaculate, warm and spacious. i love all the beautiful decor in her home as well. their eye for detail is impressive. the flat is a peaceful refuge from the busy streets of new york. her apartment is close to so many amenities-restaurants, shops, really cool lounges and the subway is a 5 minute walk from their apartment. if you prefer, you could just as easily, step right outside and grab a cab. you honestly do not have to leave the neighborhood, there's so much to do within walking distance from her flat. dealing with frederique and her lovely family was a joy. they returned emails in a timely manner and were just all around good people. i will always check frederique's place first, for availability when visiting new york!
it was definitely a bit smaller than i had expected, but the staff was really friendly and the place itself was easy to locate and was right in the middle of the city with lots to do around it.
it was a spacious and great space. there was noise in the top floor early morning but overall it was a good place to stay
everything was perfect, and very good communication with the host as well!
charming place and lovely stay - ted was a great host!
thanks again nia

we had very good time at pattys appartement (very cute and confortable). the subway was also 5min away from it. perfect place for beeing, when you visit new york. patty was very helpful when we had questions. best regards!
amazing loft, the bed & ladder is up pretty high just fair warning, but it was a really nice stay
amazing location brand new apartment. thanks and i am coming again. recommended.

this place was very convenient for getting to jfk. the host was communicative and helpful, and the pets were friendly and adorable. despite having pets, both the room and bathroom were clean and completely free of fur.
all was good.

caleb and jabari were excellent hosts. the room was spacious and very well maintained with washer and dryer (a rare commodity in nyc). would definitely recommend the place for students rotating at bronx hospital - it was only a 10minute walk

we unfortunately had to check out a few hours after checking in because my wife did not feel comfortable at the place and in the area. upon entrance to the building the lobby smelled like weed, and although the unit was quite clean, it was clearly dated. william was very responsive throughout the process. the unit was on the 3rd floor and the steep stairs in the building may not be easy for elderly guests. there were sirens and loud music blasting intermittently outside the building. unfortunately the unit did not have the ambience we were hoping to get for a laid-back new york trip.

great nice, clean and very quiet apartment. it has everything you might need for your stay in brooklyn and it is walking distance from a very cool area with many nice restaurants! evan is a great and very responsive host. i strongly recommend this place for a nice stay in brooklyn.
small, but delicate and practical, a nice choice in manhattan ;)

christopher is very good host. he is very kindly and friendly. he helped me find the way to attractions and answered questions about nyc. flat is clear, bed comfortable and location near to subway. i would highly recommend!
the apartment was very clean and perfect for our stay!

run away from this place! if there was 0 stars i would definitely give it to that horrible hotel,the service was awful,the staff was completely rude. never experienced this degree of racism i have felt extremely disrespected and publicly humiliated compared to how the staff treats his other guests. his treatment of me has been as contentious as it has been continuous, and i feel it is a result of some racial and/or age discrimination he harbors towards people like me. i have to walk past him every time i come or go and i get nasty looks from him. when i asked if he didn't like me for some reason he started yelling at me and told me to go somewhere else but never give my refund and at that point i no longer feel safe. the hotel is worse than the pictures. they didn’t have everything on the list i asked for refrigerator the staff want to charge more money if i want it, i asked for iron but never got it no heating in the room you are paying for poor customer services and poor quality hotel. stay away!!
jingyi’s place is lovely! the view of the river is so calming, the space was clean and comfortable, and the host responds quickly to questions. i recommend!
great location, clean room, friendly staff. worth the money. would book again.
everyone was nice and professional. very clean and management was helpful.

christian was a very communicative and responsive host! we had no trouble checking in and he even messaged with restaurant recommendations, which was very thoughtful. the space itself is definitely a budget-friendly option. we had everything that we needed for our stay but i wouldn't recommend it to someone looking for a luxury experience. as stated in other reviews, this is a basement unit without windows, which leaves the space feeling a bit dark. it's also easy to hear folks walking around upstairs. lastly, although the water was great for drinking, i felt the bathroom and towels had a bit of a smell to them that i attributed to just being in the basement (although my partner didn't smell anything so it may have just been me!) overall, the space fit our needs for the weekend and helped us save some money on our trip!

manuel did an excellent job of communication and preparing the space. i also ended up getting sick as soon as i got off the plane, and he showed extra kindness and hospitality to me. highly recommend staying with him! side note—the room is a little bigger than it looks in the pictures (to me, at least) and was plenty of space for me on my solo visit to nyc!
we had a pleasant stay at tom and nicole's apartment. the communication was excellent and they were very helpful and kind to us.
great location, great room, thank you pat

nicole's place is just as described. it's actually bigger than it looks in the photos. check in was easy we were met on arrival at the door. nicole showed us the place and explained the parking( alternate sides). we moved the car once and had no problem finding a close spot when we got back. nicole gave us direction to shopping ( burlington, target, marshalls......)a few minutes away walking. the place is really clean and has everything we needed. the beds are comfy, wifi and tv work great. we got back late each night and felt very safe. subway is less than 5 minute walk. the cafe about a block away is great for breakfast, theres also pizza, burgers, dunkin donuts........within a 5 minute walk. we have been to a number of airbnb homes and this is by far one of our favorites. wonderful host! we hope to visit again.
excellent place, very quiet. great access to prospect park and subway lines. beautiful garden backyard. alaric and family were wonderful and even gave a tour of the victorian parlor!
susanna was really nice me and my kids. her home was very comfortable as we need a nice place to stay until we found our new home. was always able to get in contact with her if we needed to!!!
had a fantastic stay. the location is superb. the place was clean and just the right amount of space. could be a bit loud but it’s new york so that’s normal. nonetheless, i highly recommend.

staying at mikki and doni’s was wonderful. they are warm gracious hosts and always available if we had a question or request. we were very comfortable and the location was perfect for us, near beautiful prospect park, the subway (and our son’s apt!) we would love to come back and stay there when visiting again.
very nice place, pretty new and clean. emily is very considerate and responsible.

cute spot to go with your significant other. better in the summer because it was freezing and when i went there and had two small heaters ..it took about two hours for it to warm up. so if you go bring a blanket ! besides that everything was just like the picture.

had a wonderful stay . had everything we needed for a comfortable safe and cozy stay while visiting nyc. very close to train station makes it easy to get around. soon and family were friendly and eager to give any travelling tips to help. would stay again !

maria was great; very understanding, accommodating, and communicative. would def stay here again!
great stay at catia’s place! perfect location with easy access and felt right at home! will return!

koichi’s apartment was exactly what me and my partner needed while we stayed in new york, it’s in a nice area close to many things and we will absolutely be coming here when we visit new york again!!! we are very grateful for koichi’s kindness and welcomeness while we were here!!

great stay. tyrone's place is well designed and appointed. comfy bed and shower. well stocked kitchen. first floor was great for us oldtimers. tyrone was very helpful. nice neighborhood by a subway stop.

awesome location, less than 10 minutes walk to rockaway beach.

the room was just like the pictures. everything was clean and the bathroom itself was cleaned daily. the location was only a four minute walk from restaurants, grocery stores, and the subway station. it was also a 15 minute walk from central park. everything about this stay was great! would stay again when i get the chance.
unit was clean and recently renovated. location felt safe and transit links are reasonable. host was easy to communicate with and extended our stay with no issues

very nice area the unit was clean but me and my guest felt harassed and the host just had to many rules i rent airbnb’s a lot and the rules and regulations just was to much but i needed somewhere to stay so late notice i had been in the airport all night due to a delay but entering the unit the water heater was linking leaving a big puddle to where i couldn’t even get comfortable to sit on the couch such a big inconvenience
excellent service from the front desk and the breakfast staff—very impressive and helpful.
place was good, accessible and close to the train.

unfortunately, my family and i did not have a very good experience in the airbnb. upon arrival, the apartment had not been cleaned. after contacting the host, the housekeeper came 4 hours later to clean the apartment. the front bedroom mattress was like sleeping on a slope and the sofa was totally uncomfortable. the tv had 6 channels, 3 of which we could not interpret.

the best airbnb experience you can find in ny! super clean, friendly hosts, private, and inexpensive for the value you get. love the location too, trains are close. highly recommend🤌

mark's place is ideally located and a great place to explore nyc from. the subway is an easy 3 minute walk away and the neighbourhood is a great place to explore. mark was very accommodating and kind.

i stayed here for a month and a half and did not have any issues. the owner is very responsive and checks in frequently if you need anything. it is located on the first floor and i was slightly worried about safety, but there is a locked gate and a locked door that made me feel very safe. also great location. provided a cooktop stove, fridge, refreshments, coffee with keurig, and lots of fresh towels. highly recommend! very cute and decorative and the bed is pretty comfortable, too.
claudine's apt. is exactly as she described. it's very cozy and clean. i would truly recommend anyone going to brooklyn to stay there. she was a very gracious and accomendating host.

i had a wonderful stay at the ganham house. not only marquerite and her husband been perfect hosts, the apartment looked even better than on the pictures. a large, very clean and tastefully apartment, equipped with everything you need. as a girl i was very happy to find even a hairdryer. the bed was super comfortable and all in all i felt welcome and at home. the neighborhood is nice and secure. i would definitely recommend a stay at the the ganham house and come back any time. thank you for your hospitality marquerite :)
amazing place and sure quick responses, definitely gonna stay again!

frederick is a very gracious host and his home is the perfect new york experience. the location is unbelievable, and the history of the building is fantastic. he has the kind of style that those who live in brooklyn hope to share with visitors and i look forward to recommending his home to more friends when they visit! you won’t be disappointed.
cozy, clean, comfortable, chill, nice position and very helpfull owner. top in brooklyn ✌️

great location, perfect near everything. nice rooms basic clean good beds.

magnolia house and the warm and generous welcome from danforth and darwin are truly unique. we had a wonderful week there and the daily trips to manhattan on the staten island ferry were a breeze. there is such a sense of history with the house enlivened by our daily chats at the breakfast table. they were perfect hosts; an amazing experience!
gorgeous apartment, great location and lovely host!
clean, quiet and cozy

i am happy i chose jasmina’s place. i will definitely come back to her apartment when i’m in new york. location is safe, close to manhattan just 20 minutes by train and spacious room. almost everything you need in the house is provided like plates,cutlery, towel and the bed is so comfy as well.
great location and cool staff

enjoyed our time at marks’s place. it was the perfect launching pad for us and all our activities. gave us a very comfortable place to unwind after our long days.
great stay and great host!

nice cozy clean and quiet! perfect for our little getaway.

amazing host, amazing apartment.

great place! great location! daniel was very helpful and responsive. if you’re looking for a brooklyn vacation stay - check this one out!!

todd and adrian are the best hosts we have ever had. their 3 bedroom is amazing! space, quiet, amazing kitchen and back patio…best neighborhood in the city! everything one would want and need from a nyc stay.

this was our second time staying at margaret’s and we’re so happy we were able to book a stay. we were visiting a friend in park slope so the location was an easy win for us, but the home is a quick walk to the subway, prospect park, and about 15-20 min walk to restaurants and shops on 7th and 5th ave. the home has everything you might need for a quick stay: fridge/kitchen and bathroom are well stocked with the essentials. margaret’s hospitality is so appreciated! quick to respond and answer any questions. the home is a beautiful brownstone and the decor and furnishings are vintage with an antique and elegant feel. while gorgeous and perfect for a couple, i wouldn’t recommend for playful little ones!

nikki's place is as described in the listing. but i stayed at the weekend and i wouldn't exactly describe the neighborhood as tranquil. but that may have been that saturday in particular. other than that it was a great base for a short visit to new york. easy to get to/from on public transport from lga/jfk, and the subway is very close for transit to manhattan or wherever. the neighborhood has some nice convenience stores, delis, bars and cafes. overall i would recommend nikki's as good value.

the apartment is very clean and well maintained. ame was very accommodating. we were able to leave our luggage in the apartment after we checked out and could continue exploring the city without having to drag our luggage around. great location near restaurants and bars.

igor's place was even better than expected. it was spotlessly clean and very quiet. there was plenty of room for our family of 4. the neighbor was clean and felt safe. igor was easy to communicate with and very flexible. i'd definitely stay here next time we're in brooklyn.
what a great place! easily accommodated 4 of us. the amenities were great, the details provided left nothing to question, and scott is very responsive. you cannot go wrong here!

melissa is an excellent host. she is very helpful, kind and hospitable. her apartment is awesome. very clean and spacious. the location is also great, the subway and a deli is really close. me and my boyfriend stayed with her for a week and she made our stay nothing less than perfect. if you are looking for a room to stay in nyc this the place you should book. you will not be disappointed. thank you melissa for everything, we miss you and new york :)
great spot and amazing host.
great host. we had an amazing stay!
place was great and litza was great! definitely would stay there again.
had a great stay!
