pam and jullien were lovely hosts and there property was amazing.couldnt have found a better apartment or nicer people to stay with.will definitely stay here next time i'm in new york
i enjoyed my stay at jacqueline’s place. she was very accommodating.

lovely apartment in brooklyn. very close to barclays metro and a bunch of nice restaurants within walking distance. apartment is very spacious and has everything you need! bedroom, living room, kitchen and bathroom. jessica is a very friendly and welcoming host.
the hospitality was excellent a 10 star..view from my room was excellent...i will be back in the summer..i would recommend evoke place is the place to stay...in coney island..n nyc

beautiful place, great location close to restaurants and shops. jennifer was very kind and friendly, but also gave us lots of space for privacy. really comfy bed, lovely back yard, good coffee. thanks for the wonderful stay, jennifer. highly recommend!
great place!
thanks for being a great host. we couldn't have asked for more--clean home, treats, irons, towels, and even a restaurant list. very thoughtful and in a great and safe area.
the apartment is in a good position, a few steps from the subway. cemi was so kind to help us with directions and to satisfy our requests.
antonio place was perfect for my needs as i was able to reach my workplace in minutes! hopefully i’ll be back soon! was really nice to meet him
good place to stay if you’re looking for a budgeted olace.
we had a great stay at kamilah’s. there were very kind and responsive. and the apartment was great! highly recommend.

sheila had good communication. stepping 105 steps to her rooftop flat was well worth it. great windows, spacious vibe, and an apartment with plenty of personality. the balcony must be a real treat in the summer. it can be absurdly busy and chaotic on the street downstairs, but upstairs the quiet is wonderful. also a treat to feel so connected to the sky once inside their home. taking care of their lush & lovely plants will be a bonus for all plant lovers.

stay here! this place makes your trip a once in a lifetime experience. i loved the nearby gelato spot and the proximity to historic locations. convenient to most things you’ll want to do in nyc, there’s a reason all the celebrities live here. you can’t even get hotels in this area, so this place is special. charles is an easygoing and accommodating host. i will book again asap! 🔥

our stay was very enjoyable. renee was very accessible anytime we needed to communicate. all the information she provided was very helpful! we felt safe in this neighborhood. we are also happy we had parking in front of the house.
great spot! excellent host - even put in an ac unit when the weather turned hot.
1st time using airbnb and went exceptional. was the nice cozy quiet place we needed to get a good couple nights sleep. bus stop right on the corner.

close to the city with amazing amenities, agnes’s house was a great stay. there’s a dunkin’ across the road, a short walk to starbucks and the train station is right by the apartment. good security, not the safest neighbourhood as mentioned by others but never had an issue. house was lovely and quiet however the bed was very hard and quite uncomfortable. agnes is lovely and welcoming and even provided breakfast each morning. for the price this is a great spot, highly recommend!

maria was helpful and accommodating. called her up at 3 am because we just arrived from the airport at that time and she answered. clean place with lots of towels and nice touched such as a keurig, some water, and juice. not the best neighborhood for tourists but it’s close to the subway. 3rd floor walk up so not recommended for those who need to lug large luggages with them. overall great stay!
our stay was amazing. easy check in, dawud was such a nice host and responsive. no complaints will stay book another stay in the future!
very cozy place easy and prompt communication with host in a convenient area near to transportation and markets for sure we will come back thanks natalia

this is a really cool place. i originally assumed there was just a few couch beds in an open room, but there is actually a couple of separate bedrooms so me and my friend each had our own room plus the big studio space to hang out in which includes a big couch area, dining table and a kitchen. marcia was perfect and she had even developed a little guest info book. if you're an artsy person like me there is plenty of huge paintings to look at and the whole place has a combo california and nyc vibe. it's just a couple blocks from the subway and dumbo is the first f train stop in brooklyn so getting to and from manhattan is a piece of cake. "maus" the cat has a big personality and loves to play and hang out with you. the neighborhood has plenty to see right there so make sure you take a couple of hours to check out dumbo. it is right next to the train so you get the loud rumble of the train every few minutes. i personally love that and slept all night to the rhythm of the train. i could go on and on - it's a very cool spot. marcia is super lucky to live there! pretty hard to find something this awesome, big and clean for the price in nyc.

chef step is an extremely nice host. it's like finding a friend in the city. the place is ideal for someone who is traveling to see ny... they will have recommendations etc for you and you will never feel alone. also, very very open to feedback. i wanted to sleep in one day and they were fine enough to tip toe 😂
great location. super cute charming room and area. charles was very friendly and has lots of knowledge and recommendations. everything you need!
elizabeth’s place is in a great location in manhattan, walking distance to many of the main attractions or take the subway nearby. very comfortable bed and the most fluffy towels! highly recommend.

we had a wonderful week with our daughter and our dog in new york. caio’s place was a great home base, lots of space to play, nap and spend time together when we weren’t out and about. the back yard was a wonderful space. unfortunately for us the weather wasn’t great the days we stayed home so only the dog appreciated it. lots of delis close by. 6 min walk to nearest subway, 15 mins if you needed an accessibility entrance (utica station). got into manhattan is great time on the a train express service from utica). parking was easy enough, both sides of the street had limitations but we always found a spot and it was free!

i really liked staying here, as it was very cozy and relaxed feeling. having a little outside area and two bedrooms is really nice to have in nyc. the bed were cozy and the bus stops were down the street. loved being close to the park to see how people live on a day to day basis. overall very good place
darin was extremely nice and accommodating and the location was ideal. highly recommended!!!
quiet spot and cozy. lots of parking space around

first airbnb trip and really didn't know what to expect. the room and bathroom were clean and the bed was really comfortable. there were a lot of snacks and drinks which was really nice of agnes. the place is in an older apartment; just in outskirts of harlem. it is conveniently close to the subway. the rides to times square weren't too far but rides from lower east side were about 40 min (we always somehow manage to end up there). we also manage to take the subway to jfk when we left which save as a $35 cab/uber ride. if it was closer to a more tourist area of nyc that would've been fantastic. overall, great first experience with agnes!!!!
alex and lorelei are wonderful hosts and their space was a perfect basecamp for our nyc adventure - highly recommended !
it was perfect to stay there!
bathroom and bedroom was clean. lots of free parking on the same street!
daniel's house is amazing. i enjoyed ny life thanks to daniel's house. his mother is very very kind, so good! thank you.

stefanie and andrew’s place was wonderful for my friend and i to stay at during our short girls trip. i wish we could have stayed longer. so cozy and warm during the snow, equipped with everything we needed, and super close to the subway which took us all over for days of exploring. we had such a good time and are so grateful and fortunate we found this spot to stay. i hope to stay again soon!
great location

i have stayed in annie's apartment for 5 weeks. i really enjoyed the place from day 1: the bathroom is nice and big compared to nyc standards, the living room is functional and the bed is good. the large terrace is a big plus if you come in the spring / summer season. the apartment is quiet: the windows and terrace face the back of the street, and a good amount of natural light throughout the day. as stated, you are above a theater. i personally think it gives the apartment some unique charm, from the staircase nicely decorated to the overall atmosphere of the place. the noise level isn't bad and during the 5 weeks i stayed, i only had 2 nights with events going until 11.30pm. other than that, everything got quiet from 9pm maximum. all in all, it is a great place to stay for one person or a couple. i would definitely check out the availabilities next time i come in nyc.
all good had a great time perfect location

i really enjoyed my stay at miguel’s place, the room looks exactly like the picture, it’s clean and smells really good. miguel makes you feel at home, he’s very welcoming and responds very quickly to any concerns you might have. i will be staying there again.

maurice is a good guest, always complied with the request like later check out or add a table and chairs to dine in family. the refrigerator that you see in the photos is doesn’t works. but it is smaller, this can be a problem if you want to cook. the place it’s a spacious, quiet and equipped with just enough to spend few days. with small modification like wifi and fridge and the bath tube, it would improve a lot! if you think of a place with good price and distance. it's okay like spend the night and going to the city. to get to manhattan you have to walk about 10 minutes and then a subway of about 35/40 minutes.

max and sasha (the cat) were such a great hosts. sasha the cat is lovely, be sure you like kitties cause she will be always with you. she can also sleep with you. max is a gentleman and very kind. the house is 20 minutos walking from the subway.

natalie and orelvis were great hosts. the apartment was easy to find and on a very quiet street. they were very communicative for any question i had and the apartment was perfectly clean when i arrived. perfect space for one to two people. highly recommend.
ian's place was comfortable and cozy, and it's a short walk to prospect park. it's also close to many great restaurants and a few subway stops.

overall, our experience was positive. however, there are a few things that prevented us from leaving a five star review: - the air conditioning kept failing. to the host's credit, they were extremely responsive whenever we messaged them to ask if they could come fix it. but each time they came, they "fixed" the problem and then the air conditioning would stop working less than an hour after they left - the towels were damp and smelled like they had been so for a while - the shower liner was ineffective given the size of the shower, so water got on the bathroom floor easily
great location! check-in process is so easy. as others have mentioned, it’s very loud.

the location of the hotel is great. close to a subway station, only a block away from broadway ave, and many broadway theaters. the stuff was friendly. - the description of the room location said “central park” (and it was more expensive than “the city view”) , which to my mind understanding was “with the view of the park”. none of the rooms in the hotel have the view of the park (i asked the front desk). - the air quality in the room was really bad. we kept the windows open as much as we could, but my husband would wake up stuffed up every morning after inhaling all the dust mites all night :(i dropped something behind the tv , and while looking for it i couldn’t believe how much dust was on the floor. plus, there is no fan in the bathroom! it gets so steamy after showers, and it doesn’t air out. all the vents and wall are covered with moldy dust. disgusting. loved the location, but would not return to this hotel.

i can’t think of any ways the experience could be improved, especially at the price point. chris was super respectful and gave us a clean and tidy room. the bathroom felt good with hot water and good water pressure. the building felt a little old, but nothing crazy and the pictures were pretty true to life. his cats are adorable. if you are like us and just needed a place to sleep and recharge at night, i can’t think of a better recommendation on a budget. super close to rockaway ave station on the a line and broadway junction on the j and z line, so trips to other parts of brooklyn or manhattan are super easy. it is a shared bathroom setup, but we never had an issue with needing the bathroom when it was occupied because we only used it late at night after nights out. chris is also a super chill guy; anyone who stays with him is in good hands.

i had a great time staying at charlie & sam’s. they were very responsive and helpful in all messages, giving instructions and local recommendations. the place itself is beautiful and in such a great area, i highly recommend it for anyone wanting to see more of brooklyn and feel more like a local when visiting nyc.

i rented flips room for my husband and he loved his stay. flip was great with communicating with my husband when he arrived. room was clean and there was an air conditioner with it being as hot as it is right now in new york cool air was pricesless. the place is also very close to 2 different subways stations so it was easy to get around everywhere. also theres a late night deli right across the street that has pretty good sandwiches. i would def want to rent again if going to nyc.

jan's spot is the perfect place to stay in new york. in a beautiful, residential area of brooklyn with lots of fabulous restaurants and independent shops. i'd highly recommend staying here - the apartment was clean, well located and had everything you might need for a long weekend in new york!
always welcoming with a feel of home.
fantastic little place. very clear instructions provided for check in and check out. lovely location with lots to do and close to the subway!

such a wonderful experience! deborah's apartment is so beautiful, everywhere there's a different detail. i loved the bed - so comfortable. and she was really lovely to me, gave me great hints about the city!! the subway is right at the corner, around a great neighborhood! definitely recommending.
it was a beautiful suite, and i would definitely stay there again!
excellent host i highly recommend!

overall a nice apartment in a convenient area. stayed as a family of 4 and had plenty of space. enjoyed having the kitchen, washer and dryer, and beds very comfortable. bathroom were large and very nice. appliances high quality and worked well. close to subway station and also walkable to several sights. easy to find food or order groceries. building felt secure and safe. apartment was very clean, except sheets had not been changed between guests. this was handled quickly by the host. lots of construction noise outside which i realize was out of host’s control. rooftop patio not open as advertised. unable to use air conditioner despite 80 degree weather in nyc made the last night very toasty and the front desk unable to supply a fan. host did not respond to or acknowledge inquiries regarding this.
perfect location. very clean and organized.

ed has the place fixed up very nicely, top notch appliances and very good security. it was clean and close to where we needed to be (rumc) and also to the staten island ferry terminal. we really enjoyed staying there. i highly recommend this place , very comfortable. thanks ed.
fantastic location for getting around to all the sights and even with a heat wave the place was cool and quiet to sleep. great place great location.
very nice host. we were able to use the backyard and the house is in a pretty area. well maintained front and backyard. the apt. was very comfortable and cool, especially in the heat.
the place was good, really clean and really accesible

we loved the location! after a busy noisy day it was great to arrive to a nice quite place where we could rest and recharge. the near places to eat are a plus: daily provitions, shake shack, levain bakery, sushi of gari, sarabeth’s… excellent bathroom, king size bed, very clean. we didn’t really use the kitchen but it’s nice and appreciating that you find the basics: salt, oil, teas…
i really enjoy my stay in kaz’s place. really nice and it’s a good neighborhood!

this was a quintessential nyc apt-- small and crammed with stuff, but full of personality and in a fabulous location near restaurants and all kinds of fun places. air conditioning worked great, which was essential during our 91 degree days. bara and her helper john were super friendly and responded immediately to questions etc. living room is tiny and has no natural light, but who is in an apt in ny during the day anyway?? beds were comfortable and we didn't hear neighborhood noise. i wouldn't recommend this apt to someone planning to be inside a lot or who wanted to entertain or cook at home, but if you want a fun, well-located base on the upper west side for exploring the city, this is a great one with a responsive and friendly host.
he let us stay an extra day for free due to my difficult situation and it really made a difference. he is the standard i totally recommend

lovely, clean and comfortable apartment in a great area hosted by a really friendly and helpful guy, mairo. lots of thoughtful and environmentally-friendly touches and, as many others have said, in easy reach of lots of sights. we would definitely recommend.

sam is a great host and i had a fantastic stay. the location is a stone's throw away from the bedford avenue station and is within walking distance of eateries, grocery stores, and a large park. sam was always willing to provide recommendations for places to eat or explore and she is more than willing to share her kitchen utensils which was nice. would highly recommend!
second year in a row we’ve stayed here, we know it’ll be clean and the location is great

this was like the first airbnb stay i've slept through the night without tossing and turning. the room they provided me was clean, comfortable and homey. the host and cats were really welcoming. train station and essex market were around the corner, convenient for travelers.

excellent! our stay was amazing. everything in the apartment is perfect. you can find supermarkets very clase. metros station is 9 min walking. near we found a good area of bars and restaurants. ingrid is a super host! before and while we were there, comunication was very easy. she was always happy to help us and gave us good recommendations. definitely we recommended! *****
excellent apartment ,very clean , great location professional service 24 hours

this place has amazing value. it's really well located between manhattan and jfk: very close to subway 7 and close enough to subway e by foot. the price was much cheaper than the alternatives and i was happily surprised by the quality of the place for the price. it looks freshly renovated, it feels comfortable and quite big. plus the host was very welcoming and helpful.
bruce is an excellent host with amazing properties. i highly recommend him and his listings.

had a great time at dana's place in nyc. dana was very welcoming and helpful. she took the trouble to provide info about what to do and how to get around in nyc which was much appreciated . the place was as described, clean and tidy and most importantly conveniently located. it was close to shops/restaurants and particularly the subway. the area was pleasant and quiet. so dana's place was a great place to stay and we would recommend it to others.
comfortable stay that was close to the j train and supermarket. definitely works for a quick trip!
great location, very clean room/bathroom. the bed was a bit squeaky and hard, but other than that, it was very enjoyable!

the room and bathroom was very clean and the bed comfortable. we just feel there could have been a few more amenities that we have experienced at other airbnb’s. a couple of water bottles in the fridge on arrival and sugar & powdered milk to go with the coffee pods. only given two towels each for a 3 night stay. there is a large water leak in the closet so we where not able to hang our clothes, felt damp. don’t know if this happens every weekend but the music blasting into our room from the next street over kept us awake until 3am on saturday night. we feel for the money we paid we could have stayed at a hotel.

cathy was a discreet and very emphatic host who always immediately responded to our questions (in person as well as per mail/ digital). after 7 nights her place felt very homelike to us: the apt. provides a perfectly equipped kitchen (incl. spices, oven, microwave, a huuuge fridge and utensils) that allows you to easily make dinner for two. shopping for groceries is possible within a half-mile radius at two nearby supermarkets (and a lot of deli's we did not count). the garden-direction of the bedroom ensures absolutely quiet nights even with open windows. if you take a walk do not miss to check out the historic brownstone houses that are located within the historic district across malcom x blv! enjoyed our time and would definitely come back to stay here!

shelley’s home was so beautiful and well decorated. it was so nice to come home after running around the city to such a cozy home! the brownstone is well situated between two subway lines making our commute to the city a breeze. shelley was also very responsive to us. she was truly a great host. we always felt safe and comfortable in her home and the neighbourhood. thanks shelley!
lovely space, great location, and masoud was a delight. i have 0 complaints. will absolutely return the next time i'm in brooklyn :)

our stay at sam and brittney’s apartment in bushwick was perfect. they were wonderful hosts who always replied quickly to any questions we had. we had a small problem with the dishwasher leaking which was dealt with very well by sam, checking on it, getting a professional in to fix it and leaving us plenty of extra towels in the meantime. the apartment was clean and spacious, even with four of us staying there, and even nicer than it looks in the photos. the beer and board games left by the hosts were much appreciated. the street itself was nice and quiet with a number of corner grocery stores nearby. the location was close to the convenient l train which gets you into manhattan easily. we would definitely stay here again. thanks again sam and brittney for being such great hosts.:)

living & working in brooklyn is such a unique & challenging experience so it was nice that nicolas's home is in the perfect location to get me started fast. everything you need is nearby: train & bus, a variety of restaurants, two well-stocked grocery stores, music & art. conveniently he has a washer & dryer at the home! thanks nicolas!

this was an amazing home. it was very very spacious. more than enough space for 5 people. the home has 3 levels and the inside of the home looks very rich. the host responds promptly which is always good. the home is located in harlem and is down the street (5 minute walk) from the subway so you can easily get around the entire city. the subway will take you to times square in about 15 minutes. there is plenty of good local food in the area as well, a lot better than the quick food in times square. overall, this was a great stay and we had a lot of fun.
we had a great time staying east village. this location is great for everything plus easy parking.

as a first airbnb experience, i can say éric’s home was a great choice. i got the privacy i needed and it was nicely decorated. the area was nice and was located right near a subway station which was perfect for my needs during my stay.

the facility was relatively nice. the apartment was clean other than it smelled really strong of marijuana, once i located that in the kitchen drawer. it was fine. a little put off that obviously they didn’t clean very through. although the bedding and bathroom did appear clean. over all it was fine and i’d stay again. the location was easy to find not a far walk from anything.
the apartment is comfortable, well located and private. it has a proper kitchen for cooking, comfortable bed and lovely bathroom. would happily return again!
beautiful cozy house. great welcoming. the host gives you a tour of the house, i would definitely stay here when i come back. great communication
paris’s apartment was the perfect place for us to stay exploring nyc for the weekend. great location
nice place, good location, responsive host.
the space was great! easily accessible, very clean, and michael was responsive if i had any questions or problems.

my first air bnb experience and it was an amazing stay. so quiet, clean and convenient. eric is a kind and respectful host. and you can tell there is so much attention to detail and care taken of the unit. it's personal and unique. absolutely loved it.
great stay, great neighborhood
beautiful place ! the owner is so nice and made sure we were comfortable and had everything we needed. definitely will make book again

to be clear, i think the space depends on how many people you have registered. i just had 1 bedroom with 2 twin beds since it was just me. the space was obviously ample enough for me as i was traveling solo, but just want to be clear for others since the host slept in the other room while i was there. she may have other sleeping arrangements, when there are more people. i did feel a bit conscious trying to leave since the floors are not quiet at all and it was very early in the morning when i was leaving for half of the days i was there. when i asked about breakfast, she said she no longer served it, but that she would go ahead and set something up for me. she did provide various options for the mornings we were both around for which i am grateful for. it sounded like she would no longer be providing that service though. the bathroom was huge, but it didn't feel very private since it didn't have any curtains on the windows or a shower curtain. it doesn't face the street but there are surrounding apartments. maybe it is a standard new york set up and i am a very consciously private person, so this may not bother anyone else. the shower head was one of those that has a long cord so you can move it around as you like, but it didn't have any wall attachment. it just hung down and hit your feet until you were ready to move it where you needed, so that was a bit uncomfortable. i did not have any issues with overlapping schedules while there so the shared bathroom went smoothly. the commute was really easy. it is like a 10-minute walk if even that to a subway station. the area was active, but no one ever bothered me. i came and went at pretty early/late hours. however, the outside number on her house was worn down, so it was a bit hard to read and check if i was at the right spot.
of course my stay was amazing as always. i swear this is like my second home when i visit nyc. totally amazing.
lindsey’s place was roomy, clean, comfortable and matched the description. communication was very responsive. we intend to return in the future when visiting family who live near by.
excellent stay: spacious, clean, lots of amenities, great location, easy communication. the apartment is large and beautiful, and the hosts were very responsive and considerate.

loved our stay here, conveniently located with train station a few minutes walk away & there's a few shops where you can pick-up food or other supplies too. the space was more than adequate for our family of 4, and clean too. would happily come back.

james was phenomenal. he was responsive and willing to help with anything i needed (although i strived to stay out of the way). the place was clean and felt inviting. the food in the neighborhood was great, and james had plenty of places to recommend. getting to the subway was not that bad and the neighborhood is very peaceful during the day and at night. overall, i thoroughly enjoyed my stay. if you’re looking to save a few bucks and know how to navigate mta, this is a great place to stay!

the staff is super friendly and they were so helpful whenever i had a question. the rooms are just like photos, small but well equipped. the mattress was comfortable and i loved the rain shower. already planning my next stay!

this is a fun boat to stay on. it's a bit like camping. there are showers shared by other members of the marina. the marina itself is not exactly cote d'azur but does the job. from the boat deck you have a nice view of some nearby wetlands, with a lot of different kinds of birds. there's no lock on the door to get inside the boat, and be aware that planes from nearby jfk fly overhead. the host is great and responds to questions promptly.
it’s so comfy and cozy. i’d like to come again! so kind host!
very good location, ample parking, very responsive hosts, larger space than expected. overall great setup.
friendly, responsive host.

this place is a perfect stay in a safe part of brooklyn. we were always returning home around midnight with almost empty and quiet streets. three subway stations are reachable in 10 min by foot. there is also good connection to buses. the host was very kind and carrying and the appartment very neat and clean. all the furniture was new, with plenty of equipment.
awesome place, very nice and clean, definitely worth the booking price. check in and check out were super easy. vienna is a great host, always quick to respond to any messages.

we have stayed in airbnb in iceland and holland and santa fe but never in nyc. i was hesitant. but this place jumped out. it is about as near perfect as is possible. the location is great: quiet and convenient and very safe. it was clean, and organized. the bed was firm but cozy. the instructions were clear and everything conspired to make our nyc stay go smoothly. two of my well-grown children live near by (in tiny apartments) so i will be returning often to our now regular "home" in the city. thank you rene!
great place would love to stay again
will stay again!

troy himself was kind, courteous, and ever accommodating. the room itself was smaller than expected and difficult to maneuver with two people. there were occasional safety concerns due to the buzzer of the street door getting stuck and perpetually buzzing for a few days straight. i recommend bringing a sleeping face mask if light keeps you awake, as there is a skylight that is always brightly lit from times square. my biggest complaint was the mattress- it was degraded to the point that the metal coils painfully dug into my skin; troy provided an extra comforter so i could lay it on the mattress which provided some additional padding. again, troy kindly tended to the issues we brought to his attention, so as a host, he was quite excellent. the shortcomings were with the actual accommodations itself.
not to far from subway big appartement that could accomodate a group. big parking place for at least two car

everything went very smoothly : sigfus was super nice and very helpful with everything we needed, and also flexible for checking in and out times. apartment was very clean and extremely close to the subway, with a 20 minutes ride to manhattan. small warning : the bed might be a little small for 2 large/tall people, but still manageable without issue. would definitely come again !

safety, was a priority at this location. there was always an officer nearby if help was needed. if trips to the city are part of the plan, take into account the tolls for the verrazano bridge and tunnels (coming and going).

great stay. close the franklin subway. close to bedford street, lots of stuff any which way you walk. about 30 minutes to manhattan. nice neighborhood. clean place and very comfy bed!!! easy stay and communication.
great stay, excellent service
great place to stay. relatively affordable (new york is very expensive). very nice apartment, easy to get to. responsive host.
very comfortable and stylish place, and the hosts are super friendly and nice!
as advertised, good spot to access manhattan

this apartment in the heart of chelsey was perfect for our 10 day stay, was as the beautiful as the fotos. vanessa welcomed us upon our arrival with the keys and as giving us a fantastic suggestion for visit and eat in the area. she printed a guide for us in spanish ny. all the amenities were there including fresh sheets and towels and couldn't have asked for anything more. would definitely stay here again next time! she and her family are lovely!!!
thank you, isaac! great stay. very clean. the christmas tree was a lovely, cozy touch!
excellent communications and flexibility. place reccomendable.
the studio is nice..could be bit refreshed but in complex is good. the instructions and all information are good. it was a nice stay overall
we had a great stay, the hosts were very nice and helpful with any request we had. the place itself is unique, clean, special and gives a remarkable memory of our trip. thank you!
great location. nice flat. recommended.
it's a good location, the subway is nearby, a lot of highly rated food places are close and it's a decent place to stay.

gorgeous unit with street parking and a very comfortable set up! we were in town for two nights and enjoyed dinners out and walks around the block during the day for mental breaks while we worked from inside the airbnb. wifi was strong and we enjoyed the free live pluto tv to catch the local news. didn't venture out into the lovely back yard. sunrise bagels was a short walk away and has excellent selections 24/7! would stay again for sure!

we loved our stay at ray and harriet's. the apartment was full of character and well located in a safe part of the upper west side. it was an easy walk to the subway and supermarket with our 3 kids. it was warm in winter. the apartment was very clean, the kitchen well stocked and the washer/ dryer worked well. we met both ray and harriet and they were both lovely. we would love to stay here again.

nice and cozy stay for solo travelers, good for a night. rory gave detailed directions and rules for the stay. make sure you go on directions in the app, since there are two different addresses and even if copied from here it can lead you to the different location (though there are not far).

i loved the experience of staying overnight in brooklyn & no better way to do it, than in a gorgeous brownstone. especially loved the raw brass fixtures! decor is just beautiful & apt was very cozy & welcoming. i wish i could’ve stayed another night & i will definitely be back. thank you for a wonderful getaway to your beautiful brownstone! i’m so glad i found it & will definitely share with my friends and family. btw, travis was wonderful!
easy to get to, close to subway and central park. happily recommend.
happening area and easily accessible. restaurants, metro and mart’s make it very convenient.

the best place to stay if you don’t went to be around a lot of people when you leave your apartment. has all the stores you need and you get to get the full new york experience staying here. will definitely stay here again if available.
this was perfect for our month in ny! great apt and building! the doormen were very friendly! great location! i would highly recommend staying here!

enjoyed my stay at liz’s place - she is a very thoughtful host who considers everything. loved the stocked kitchen. place was very quiet and ac unit worked well. liz provided detailed instructions leaving no question unanswered. also it was pretty spacious for manhattan. nice and comfortable bathroom with renovated vanity. oh and very clean and neat!
would come back!

this place was perfect for our little family. it is quiet and a well designed space. the available pack 'n play meant we did not have to lug ours around. proximity to the f train got us into manhattan easily. check-in and communication was all very smooth.
great location- very safe area- for solo travelers. awesome coffee shop right next door. walkable to all transportation and great bars/restaurants. the cute backyard is a nice touch as well.
it was a great location and felt safe walking alone at night. when there was an issue, she responded and was very helpful :) would recommend the place!!

place was extremely clean and street looks busy but extremely quit wit a few convenient stores just steps away it’s definitely a brooklyn love type of spot and also perfect for large group of 8 or less!

young was one of the most phenomenal airbnb host that me and my friend has had thus far. he was so attentive and so kind. you also gave us multiple kinds of snacks and drinks to accommodate our stay. he did a phenomenal job with a description of the place and also helped us with nearby parking. i will be planning to one day book here again!
great deal, especially if you need to sleep a lot of people. there is a ton of space to spread out!

larger than expected apartment that was great for our family with our 3 year old. building well-maintained. walking distance to multiple playgrounds and a bunch of great restaurants. 10 minute walk to subway and multiple bus lines running nearby. had everything we needed to enjoy our trip and it was a great home base to explore the city.

we enjoyed our stay here very much! the space was very clean and the room was exactly as pictured. the room was a bit chilly when we arrived at night but the host was responsive and proactive in helping us feel comfortable. tons of walkable food options. would stay again.

my stay at the mahogany suite was amazing! the location is superb, located in crown heights near the 3/4 trains. easy to get to manhattan and easy to navigate to other areas in brooklyn like bushwick, bedstuy, williamsburg, dumbo, etc. the experience staying in the house was amazing, i felt like a member of the family! the room has it’s own microwave and refrigerator, wfh desk set-up and more so it’s honestly like a mini-apartment. you will rarely have to leave your room if you don’t want to, but if you do there is even a workout area and tv in the main room. anything you’ll end up needing mahogany will be a call away to assist! the house is very quiet, peaceful and private. the backyard area looks amazing as well. it would be a loss for you to not book this stay! i would most definitely stay here again. it’s more so of an experience rather than it just being a stay. i booked the room to find an apartment in the city (i was able to find one) and my birthday just so happened to be during my stay and i was surprised with cupcakes and wine! not only that, but mahogany also bought me a few things for my apartment. i’m so happy i stayed here and connected with the household! i will definitely stay in touch for the years to come, i know if i ever needed anything as a new new york resident, mahogany would be there for me and is a call away! book this room!
great place to stay

my recently stay at christine's a was an exceptional experience. from the moment i arrived, christine's warm hospitality made me feel right at home. her apartment was clean, comfortable, and had everything i needed. christine also provided helpful advice and tips, and the metrocards she gave me were really useful and saved me money. one of the highlights was getting to know ronnie, christine's cat. initially, ronnie was a bit distant, but by the end of my stay, he had warmed up to me and even let me pet him! he was so cute! the neighborhood was incredibly peaceful, offering a refreshing contrast to the hustle and bustle of manhattan. the location is well connected to public transportation, making it easy to get around. and while the commute to the city was a bit lengthy, typically taking about an hour, it was manageable and well worth it for the serene environment christine provided. overall, i highly recommend christine's place. i would definitely stay there again!
we loved staying at hans and sandra's and am looking forward to our next trip to new york when we'll be staying with them again.
great location and chic space! has plenty of room to rest and lounge. highly suggested.
would rec. for a quick stay and easy travel to jfk
great location, match description, responsive host, overall great stay

great location! right by the train. brewery across the street. food festival across the street. world trade center memorial within 5 minute walk. wall street and statute of liberty viewpoint within 10 min walk. parking at icon parking for $60 a day. concierge will hold your bags before and after check out. checking in can take some time because there are only 2 people working the front desk. i was a little frustrated that our pull out couch didn’t come with sheets, blankets or pillows (when the hotel knew i booked a place for 3 people). we requested these things at 4pm. by 10pm we still hadn’t received them. when we called again we were told the hotel was out of blankets and pillows. we ended up getting a few sheets and 1 blanket (no pillows) by 11pm.

unfortunately i don’t recommend booking this hotel with airbnb. when i arrived with my confirmation of a king size bed, they said they didn’t have that reservation on their end, and unable to accommodate. after a few more minutes of pressing and involving a manager, magically a room appeared (thankful for that). there were other people hanging out at the hotel (friends of the workers) that had managed to add to our poor experience at check in. not to mention that as soon as we walked into the hotel the nypd evidence collectors were being escorted up to a room. just not a great feeling for a mom traveling with her daughter. the room was not a warm feeling but felt more like a concrete prison cell. the best part was the coffee shop across the street but otherwise would consider booking somewhere else.
great place with awesome location (close to subway, grocery store and restaurants.) highly recommend!
nice house, good location, affordable price! i love it

had a great stay! the place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. communication with the host was smooth and timely. check-in and check-out were hassle-free. overall, a pleasant experience — would definitely recommend!
d and mia (cute lovely dog) are great hosts. we had a nice time in new york with this place as good located base. nice neighbourhood, apartment located in small park area, with cute squirrels.
great place on a lovely block in bed stuy. perfection location for me to visit my son who lives a few blocks away.
if you are looking for an authentic stay in new york, this is it. thanks tony.

i stayed a little bit more than 3 months in the apartment with a friend. the living room was our favorite room as it was luminous and cozy. there were a lot of equipments in the kitchen, we were able to cook a lot. there is a super market a block away north and it was super convenient to find fresh products. the apartment is really clean, there was everything needed to keep it clean and the building is well kept. we liked the cupboards in both bedrooms, there were plenty enough room to store all our clothes. the apartment is close from the lines 6 and 2-3 which is convenient to reach both east and west sides of manhattan.
convenient location. great value.

great little gem on the top floor of a lovely house. very clean, great peaceful neighbourhood with a beautiful park next door and safe! close to local transport. heera is also lovely. i’d recommend staying here.

the apartment is located in a prime location. it is walking distance from restaurants and plenty of near by stores. the apartment is bright, colorful, and spacious. the bedroom is detached and down the hall from the living room, bathroom, and kitchen. the outdoor patio is a good area for pets but not for kids. overall, the apartment has all the essentials, wifi, and smart tvs.
great hosts! amazingly clean place! super spacious and private. would totally book again!

staying with mr and mrs mahmood is like visiting family. they are superhosts for a reason. the house is in a great location, close to snug harbor and close proximity to the ferry. parking is plentiful. if i return to the area, i would unquestionably want to stay with them again if they have availability. it is a truly enjoyable experience.

we stayed for almost six weeks at jennifer's apartment and if i need to describe our experience in one word it's: spectacular! the place itself was great, but also the very central location was fantastic. close to basically everything and still quit. the communication with jennifer was also great, always quick responses. looking forward to our next stay with jennifer.
pauline is a very detail-oriented & hospitable host. her apartment is also amazing! i highly recommend her places!

tanya and sanjay's place is located in an ideal spot for travelers who want to have everything they need within walking distance. there is no shortage of restaurants, bars, coffee shops, two groceries, a post office, dry cleaners, laundry and let's not forget the park! also, nikehawk cinema! all within a short walk. the b61 bus is just steps away and if you're a member of the ymca, it will take you to the front door. in my book, it's a perfect location for exploring park slope and the greater brooklyn areas.
incredible woman, clean space, the sheets smelled like very fresh laundry!
great quiet.. hard to find parking
wonderful work and fun trip in ny with daughter and her friend. would definitely stay here again!

we loved our stay with lauren and anthony. they were on vacation when we went but they had a friend stay upstairs. although we did not meet their friend, we felt more secure knowing someone was there. we were a bit scared the first day as we felt like little fishes in a big pond, but we quickly learned how to use the subway which is conveniently right around the corner from the house. the house itself is beautiful, and lauren and anthony provided wonderful little touches (and great advice and food suggestions in their guidebook). they left beer in the fridge for us that we enjoyed on a rainy night in the back patio while their cats hung around us. it made us feel like we were true locals and just having a comfortable afternoon at home. we will be thinking about our stay for a long time. we cannot recommend it enough.
such a clean and nice place, safe area as well

the room is spacious and the kitchen is well equipped with cooking equipment, air fryer, and a kettle. alexander is a kind, accommodating host who is very responsive and checks in to see if there is anything in the place that needs to be restocked. the place is in little caribbean with there’s a lot of culture and conveniently located a block away from the 2/5 line. would recommend staying here!

rena was an excellent host ! she puts alot of thought and care in providing a great stay for guests. everything was clean and organized. the instructions were clear and concise. rena is also a lovely individual and i would definitely recommend anyone to stay at her place. 5 stars all around !!
beautiful!! lots of space! wonderful location. the staff was amazing! will definitely be back!
great place to stay in brooklyn - close to public transportation, and a cool coffee place, til death. pretty small but clean and good for sleeping! host was very responsive. would stay here again!
room has little electric noise, but overall it’s good
jackee is super nice and so is her place! i recommend staying here.

my friends and i stayed here for three months this summer and found that the management was super great and responsive throughout our entire stay. i loved that the apartment was well-furnished and had modern furnishings and amenities. there was ample space for the cat furniture we brought as well. overall, i think this was a great place to stay!

cleveland was super accommodating and kind to us during our stay! the home is shared and all the tenants were very respectful. it was big for nyc and our bedroom was very spacious! beds were clean and comfortable and soaps and conditioners were offered in the shower. overall, great decor, great vibe, and super clean place. the neighborhood is quiet, felt very safe, and has ample free street parking! if you’re needing to stay by jfk this place was unbeatable.

the house was very clean and ready for the whole family. we found many many pleasant details like breakfast in the fridge or toys for the kids. aron was very quick to respond to all of our messages and everything was super easy. definitively a great value for money choice in new york.
place was nice. just a described. only spent the night but the following day we walked to mom's kitchen which is like a 15 minute walk from the apartment and it was definitely worth it.
when i come back to nyc or friends are coming here, i will recommend this beautiful brownstone.
wonderful place great host

i had an amazing stay with diana and perla. the energy and vibes of their home were absolutely positive and radiated love from every nook & corner thank you both again💛!! i can't think of a better place to stay next time i'm in brooklyn.
thank you for the hospitality at the last minute
a lovely apartment right in between some of my favorite neighborhoods. bedrooms were quiet and filled with sunshine every morning. couldn’t ask for anything more!
high level of privacy. the ladies have been wonderful and very friendly.

we had a great stay here with our family of four. nice place, clean and fairy spacious with nice decor. location was excellent right in the middle of lots of cool shops and restaurants. we took the subway a few times which was only a 9 minute walk and the one stop before you’re in manhattan. would definitely stay again!
great place--easy access to multiple subway lines. mellissa was extremely responsive and provided useful information about the neighborhood. definitely a great experience.
hiokit was a wonderful host. the room was clean and comfortable. i would definitely recommend it to a friend.

carrie’s place was beyond wonderful! she is a super communicative host and responded to any questions we had! she’s extremely friendly and there to have a chat but also happy to let you have your private time :) when we arrived we had come off of a 18 hour travel day and were completely exhausted. we came into the place to find exactly what was shown in the photos - a spacious place with lots of light, cozy bed, huge sofa, kitchen stocked with cereal and milk, bread & jelly, and a bunch of to go snacks (which were beyond useful for long walking days in the city!) and the most delicious brownies made by her pastry-chef husband!!! carries place is a 2 minute walk to the bus stop that takes you to to the ferry and is such a great alternative to paying the hefty $$$$$ for a smaller and louder space :)

a great value for the perfect west village location. near everything we wanted to do and the subway was close by for everything else. some lovely small parks near by. glad to have had the warning about the stairs…those are no joke, especially after walking around the city all day. wonderful bath products but an advance warning about the bathroom situation would have been appreciated. it might be awkward with more than 2 people. overall a wonderful stay at a homey, cozy, comfortable apartment.

pablo’s place is top tier. extremely clean and very comfortable. lots of little details that make this place feel like a home. i stayed here with my 2 children and felt very safe. pablo was attentive and responded quickly anytime we need him. the location is great. there is a bodega/deli on the corner that has delicious food and anything you could possibly need during your stay. the metro is a short 5 minute walk that will take you right into manhattan. we look forward to staying here again.

place was great, clean and guidance to find it was clearly explained. adam was very responsive for everything i needed. i would recommend this place if you want to stay to ny. i like walking and this place was perfect spot for me. i would recommend to anyone visiting ny city.

vanessa's home is in a great location and has a lot of character, especially since it's an older building. as such, any guest should level-set expectations on what comes with an older home and just nyc infrastructure in general (e.g. water turns cold if someone else in the building is using, presumably, the shower too; heater will kick on but you can't control the temperature because it's for the entire building; there is no central ac; sirens and trash collectors from the street; etc)
great communication. great location any problem we had were discussed and sorted.
annamarie was a pleasure to work with.
place was okay but washing machine had mold, tvs were glitchy, and bed sank down when laying or sitting on it.

the space looked exactly like the photos. everything was spotless. my only thing is that i saw a cockroach in the shower one night, and i wasn’t sure where it came from - but since everything else was okay and i didn’t see more than one - i didn’t find a need to report this or complain but i’m sure the host would have came around immediately. other than that, i have no complaints. there was a nice welcome note and complementary drinks and chocolates which was very warming. the host communicated well. she allowed me to check out a bit later than the scheduled checkout time. i’d definitely stay here again.

dealing with jason has been my best airbnb experience so far. he always answered promptly and was right there to meet us when we got there - no waiting outside for ages. he really has made a big effort to make the place comfortable with little extras. if we come back to new york we will for sure be staying again.
it was such a nice place to stay it felt like home and host was very welcoming and responsive. thank you

first of all wendell was very responsive, replying within minutes to my last minute request. wendell was so accommodating, he made me feel so welcomed and at home straight away. also happily kept my bag before and after check out without extra charges. the subway is literally 3min walk and it takes about half an hour to reach manhattan. wendell works with trust and respect and i m so happy i chose his accommodation for my stay. thank you for everything.
the place is according to the description.

i am lucky to have had many positive airbnb experiences in the past; however, stephan’s hospitality far exceeded my expectations. he was very welcoming, kind, and responsive. my only regret was not booking this place for a longer period of time. when i visit brooklyn again this will be my first choice stay.

the stay was exactly as expected. i am very thankful that i booked this place. the location was phenomenal and a walkers paradise. the room was as pictured. the communication with the hosts was great, and i’d definitely stay at this location again given the opportunity. what a great stay!
this place is amazing. 5 stars.
the hosts were very hospitable. the rooms are very clean. you feel very comfortable there. i had a pleasant stay with ines and her husband!
lovely apartment and very easily accessible! i rented this place for my sisters who were visiting from out of town, just a few blocks from my own apartment. they loved it!
i always choose to stay here during my visits to nyc—it’s a great location with friendly staff and great amenities!
great hosts and perfect location for a visit to family!
perfect location (metro and bus close) , calm, clean. super district fun and authentic. communication with ibrahim is really easy and he is really flexible. thanks a lot.
excellent host! excellent location!
good place to stay

the apartment is gorgeous. the location is amazing. the hosts and housekeeping are super friendly and helpful at all times. the apartment is extremely clean, with everything you need for your stay. most of all the price is super amazing, for the space and location you’re in. i will definitely be booking again, and recommend you book with carlene as well.

i love staying here, i always try to stay here when i travel to nyc for work. i love the location, easy to go into gp or williamsburg for food or drinks as well as a 20min or so away total trip into manhattan. the staff is really nice and helpful, the rooms are really spacious and comfortable, i actually look forward to heading back to my room and relax before heading out for dinner or drinks.

frederick offered a cozy space and a generous communication. the location is excellent for those who use the public transport, being 40 minutes from manhattan. the region is safe and offers good restaurants, markets and shops. we would definitely stay again.

the area is great, you have so many things nearby and the zone is quiet. our room had a good size for two people, in the kitchen we had salt, pepper, oil for our use and the bathroom was always clean. completely worth it

the apartment is really as nice as it appears on the web. check-in and check-out was pretty easy. it has good access to public transport and we were happy to find an interesting area to go out at night in a walking distance of about 15 minutes (can do this also by bus). in any case a highly recommendable place to stay.

it was very being your guest. very interesting and fun conversations, even though i was mostly out and about. always ready to chat and give recommendations. would definitely consider stay with him again.
beautiful beach with an amazing view

great location. about 4 blocks away from the subway. extremely close to the city. he's an amazing host. he waited outside for my brother and i to drop off our bags. early bags drop off was a major plus. room is perfect for 2 people.

joaquin's place definitely has character. when i first got there, i definitely had a bit of sticker shock for what i had paid for. however, the longer i stayed there (i had a 1 month stay) the more i grew to learn, love, and gain an appreciation for the space that joaquin had curated. he really has thought out mostly everything. pretty much everything is where you expect it to be and he has some additional things in the unit that really made the longer-term stay, easy living. i particularly enjoyed the dips bar! lol i do think that if joaquin reduced the price, the place would be an excellent stay. i think it needs some maintainence. the place is in need of some tlc, but nonetheless, it was mostly clean and a fantastic location. cannot speak highly enough about the views from the room and the rooftop! thank you joaquin!
nice place and great value for a nyc location. thank you ronnie for helping me secure a parking spot. would recommend to anyone and would definitely stay there again
very nice place, close by train stations, super easy to go wherever you want. there is a mini-market in the corner open 24 hrs and the neighborhood is pretty quiet.

the place was good and clean, very good host too but one of the beds was very short and small for 2 persons. it’s a bit far from manhattan but it’s well connected with the metro. the main bed is big enough for 2 people. i would not recommend it for 4 adults but maybe for 2 adults and 2 children.

thank you, tanzina, for making our christmas vacation stay so wonderful. we had a great experience at this property. the house is very spacious and impeccably clean, and it was well-stocked with all the necessary kitchen and bathroom supplies. tanzina was extremely helpful and responded to our messages almost instantly. the location is excellent — there is a supermarket right across the street, and the nearest metro station is about a 10-minute walk away. uber is always available and costs around $6–$8 if you prefer a ride. there are also plenty of restaurants nearby. there is also designated parking available upon request, which was a huge help for us in a city like new york. we highly recommend this place and would happily stay here again.
the location is really perfect for a visitor. kathleen is very welcome and kind. would definitely recommend to anyone who has a trip to new york.

amazing stay and extremely responsive hosts. i spent 3,5 months in the place, and loved it very much. the neighborhood is great, the place is very beautiful, and hosts were very quick to respond day and night, being very helpful with all my questions, issues and requests. i would definitely recommend staying in this place!

eryka and gizmo were both very welcoming! she accommodated a late 10pm check-in on a friday night even though she was out having dinner with her family. she is a wonderful and thoughtful host. she left clean towels and toothpaste/toiletries in the bathroom, and invited me to tea/coffee. the place itself was very nicely done - stylish, cozy and functional. the room was big and bright. the location is fantastic since it is close to the subway and has some great restaurants/bars in the neighborhood (gimme coffee, ohitashi, etc..) loved staying at eryka's!
great location, great host!

shelley's place was clean, cozy, warm and accessible through public transportation. it is located in a vibrant carribean neighborhood with close access to many shopping places. i had a wonderful stay and would consider booking with her in the future.

i had the opportunity to stay here for about 7 weeks for work purposes. noelva and alex were very welcoming and made sure i had everything i needed. it was great to be able to come back to this area after a day of work to be able to relax. it was always very quiet at night and all of the neighbors were very friendly. the apartment itself was perfect and just what i needed. the kitchen was fully stocked to cook meals. i was a little worried about closet space before i arrived due to my long stay, but there were three nice sized closets! everything is walking distance on city island and i took advantage of all the seafood restaurants. overall i had a wonderful stay here and i would highly recommend to anyone wanting to visit new york, but doesn't want to stay right in manhattan.

great quiet place to stay for a few days or if you have a long layover and want a quiet place to relax and sleep that isn't far from the airport, was very clean and comfortable, i highly recommend staying here of you have a 17 or more hour layover like i did. thank you for allowing me to stay, it was wonderful!
nice spot and good communication with the host. would stay again!

this was the perfect place for our weekend in brooklyn. cris was easy to contact and very hospitable. the place is clean, neat, well equipped, and private. nice neighborhood. very easy to get around and into the city. we took a subway to soho for the afternoon and decided to walk back because the weather was so nice.

we loved staying in this apartment. it's in a charming neighbourhood of pretty brownstones, nice restaurants and narrow, tree-lined streets. we walked to the hudson river park, little island, the whitney, the highline, chelsea market, union square, washington square park and soho shops. two subway stations nearby took us everywhere else. the apartment is spacious and bright, and we especially appreciated the large and comfortable bed, the dishwasher, and washing machine and dryer (both new and high quality, not the older-style ones shown in the photos). these are all things that seem to be rarely found in most nyc apartments. issues mentioned by other reviewers (slow hot water, leaky shower) were minor relative to the many benefits of staying here. it was noisy, but for us that was part of the experience of staying in manhattan. good communication with the owner. definitely recommend staying here, if you're lucky enough to find it available.

we had a wonderful weekend stay in this quiet neighborhood in queens! gregory was very responsive and helpful. the house was as described and even tidier than the pictures. manhattan and brooklyn were about 45 min-an hour away by uber. there is a train station 10 minutes away or so as well. definitely spacious and affordable for nyc. would stay again!
what a gem! i had a lovely stay in a great block with walkable grocery and shops.

benjamin was a great host, the apartment was just described, lovely and cosy on some cold new york spring days and all in all a perfect pad for us to explore the city. plenty of information on the apartment and on the local neighbourhood and general practicalities. benjamin and family had thought of everything to make the apartment a comfortable and welcome base.
adeola is a fantastic host! would definitely recommend and stay again!

we had a great stay at ness’s home. we had to pay for parking but that was really the only downside. the area is iffy at first glance but nothing happened and there weren’t any problems. the response time could’ve been better but overall it was a great stay and i really do recommend with staying with ness!
perfect little place, quiet neighborhood

beautiful apartment. every corner is very well thought. extra points for the bed and the pillows. the place has all you will ever need. the location was good. only 3 mins away from the subway that takes you to manhattan in about 30 mins. it felt safe enough. the only negative point is the train that is very close and passes by until late. but hey that's new york. i would totally recommend the place and jonathan was amazing too making sure everything was fine during my stay.

the apartment appeared as expected according to the description and pictures. i'd recommend not having a car. new york city is challenging to find parking and requires moving or sitting in the car on certain days for street cleaning regardless of the borough. in washington heights it was impossible at times and really difficult others. i ducked into the convenient garage on w 161 street a few times after 30-40 minutes searching and not seeing a car leave a space much less one available. there also is a fire house on the street and they respond to calls day and night with siren blaring. it does add to the "city" experience, but it also can wake you up. we enjoyed the opportunity to experience and explore a neighborhood of new york where we've never stayed before. the hudson river greenway was the best path for jogging, cycling or watching the sun set. if you've never visited the cloisters in inward park, you'll be transported to europe. enjoy!
it is a room and you share the kitchen and bathroom. it is perfect for backpacking or for visiting the city without luxuries.
definitely would stay again!

a true gem in forest hills, ny. the subway is a short walk away and direct to manhattan. the hosts were amazing in every way and the unit itself was top class! the local recommendations were brilliant and the quality of this stay was unmatched in my travels of the usa so far (14 states!). highly recommended.

we had a lovely week in ariela’s apartment. bed was comfy and the apartment had everything we needed. it was also easy to get in touch with ariela and check in was simple. the apartment is close to a subway station and it’s easy to travel to the rest of the city. thanks! :)
great location, super cool host, definitely recommend!
we had a great time in erika's cozy appartement!
it was good stay. susan was very helpful and cooperative with me. she tried to make most of things comfortable for me. with my thanks for her kindness.
i love judie and steven. great location and totally sophisticated airbnb

alejandro's place is in a great location, and just a few blocks from a great choice of restaurants and a huge grocery market. it was very comfortable and tastefully decorated. alejandro was very accessible when i had a questions, with a response right away. we appreciated the home he made and would highly recommend it to other travelers.
the room is great . the bnb having a wash machine is a great bonus . only downside is the kitchen & wash machines being in the basement but overall absolutely recommend this bnb.

the stay was pleasant, peaceful as well as being in an area that i am quite familiar with. i wound up adding an additional two weeks to my stay. i have already discussed with family members and friends. thanks again.
really lovely studio with separate kitchen and large walk-in closet, clean and well outfitted. the building is a vintage walk-up, very new york. location in the heart of clinton hill is fantastic.
this was an amazing place to stay. the interior was unique and the location was great. would definitely recommend staying here.

the place was absolutely spotless and the bed was very comfortable. check in was very easy. it was a great place to crash after a long flight. it is very close to penn station so also very easy to get to from the airport. a little noisy at times.

we really enjoyed our stay at jojo's place! it is genuinely so much bigger than it looks in the photos. they helped us with early check-in which was greatly appreciated. also, we had an issue with the ac units during our stay and they were super responsive in fixing the issue. the neighborhood isn't the most exciting but there are still some cool places around for a quick bite or a coffee and it's only about 10 minutes from the train. we did hear some noise from upstairs during our stay (once around 4am) in case that is something you are worried about.

we have enjoyed our stay at stephanie's apartment. what stands out is the excellent location and wonderful neighbourhood of greenpoint. apartment is in a very quiet and well maintained building with easy access to subway to get anywhere within 20-30mins. lots and lots of good bars and restaurants at walking distance. safe area as well. there were some issues with cleanliness and order in general which we have adressed to the owner for follow-up. this to help her maintain the 5-star rating of the apartment.
great place to stay, quite and comfortable. close to the train and the grocery stores. yahaira is a nice host!
rob and debbie are wonderful host. welcoming, helpful and diligent about cleanliness and safety, i couldn’t have felt more comfortable. highly recommend!

the place was great and patsy’s around the corner was definitely a spot to check out. we didn’t experience any of the issues with noise during the night or didn’t notice it at least. would stay again.
beautiful place, would definitely book again!
perfect spot for us and the apartment was so comfortable. would definitely come back again and recommend to anyone who wants to stay in brooklyn.

i stayed at this hotel about 10 years ago and was surprised by how it’s been maintained since. a lot of parts throughout the building need some tlc - it’s just looking/feeling a bit more than worn in. rooms are well sized, bed is comfortable. no coffee/tea is provided which i’ve never experienced with airbnb stays and the extra resort fees are high for what you get.

gretchen is an amazing hostess. the house was sparkling clean and very spacious and comfortable. even provided complementary shampoo, conditioner, and body wash. everything we needed was provided, didn't need to ask for anything. definitely recommend staying here if your in ny.
amazing amenities. comfortable beds and linens. plenty of space for a large group trip. thank you sol for a wonderful stay!
everything was just perfect! amazing oft and spot. great aerea, too. thank you very much!

great stay and great location! clara was very responsive and attentive - replying within the hour for our needs. it is an older building, but it has an elevator which is an amazing perk. multiple grocery stores and laundromats are nearby. close to many restaurants, bars, and cafes. safe and nice neighborhood. 5 minute walk from the train.
great stay, kevin was responsive and helpful

i am thankful for my stay here, i had to extend my stay and maurane was extremely kind and understanding. when i first booked my room, she was extremely responsive and fast with sharing with me clear instructions on how to access and find my room. made herself available to all of my questions including laundry and wifi and everything in between. i highly recommend any stay listed by maurane. bon voyage!

janet was a wonderful host! she was super responsive, helpful, and generous with local recommendations, even providing tips on navigating the transit system, which can be tricky at times. we felt comfortable throughout our stay and would gladly stay with her again!

this was a great place to stay while visiting nyc. it’s in a safe and peaceful area, and the neighborhood is not as fast-paced as manhattan, which was really ideal for us. dora was very responsive and easy to communicate with, and she was also very nice when we briefly met her in person. overall, this was a great home base for exploring the city.
patrick was very nice and helpful...can't wait to visit again.
lolita's home is immaculately clean. i love her neighborhood in queens because it's so easy to get to laguardia or take the subway to manhattan. hope to stay in her home again.

minetta and her home are beautiful, warm and inviting. i felt so comfortable and at home. the location is so convenient and i enjoyed staying in harlem, the subway & park are a 5 min walk, so many good coffee shops and whole foods is nearby. would absolutely stay again and recommend xxx
great house, quiet and well located.

stayed for 3 months for a nyc internship and i loved my time at this air bnb and the hells kitchen neighborhood in general. i never had a problem with the shared bathrooms as it was always available when i needed it and i loved the convenience of having the laundry in the basement of the building. it was super easy to get around with most train lines at the station at the corner of the block! the room was as expected and i actually found it cozy and had no issues. whenever anything needed to be checked out in the restrooms etc the hosts would look into it asap which was great. also enjoyed being two blocks from times square and only four blocks from my internship. would stay here again and would recommend it for anyone looking for a place to stay near times square/midtown.
as advertised
amazing space. clean, comfortable, near so much stuff. very communicative host.

the place has a queen bed, kitchenette (with microwave, stovefridge, and bathroom, for a reasonable price. the foyer is secure, which adds to the feeling of safety. there are two chests of drawers, some hanging space, and windows in the bedroom and kitchen, but they are small and the view is of a rubbish yard. there is a fold down bench and two stools, but no table to sit at, which makes eating meals a bit awkward. the listing description of the place as ‘executive’ is probably an overstatement, but it is fair to say that it provides a satisfactory level of comfort and facilities. the communication from the stay with vibe team is fairly clear and responsive, although a bit impersonal and anonymous.
scott’s apt is amazing for its artistic design, clean condition, and great location. i am very satisfied with my staying here!
this place has everything that can be offered: clean, excellent view from the terrace, plenty to do around the place and quick access to everything else nyc has to offer. all around excellent time!
nice refreshing stay after being in the city
it is a nice place, at a nice a spot. a lot of cats around
excellent all around. room as described, clean and functional. junior was a great host, very responsive and mindful. location is super convenient with the subway two blocks down. highly recommend!

great location in a nice part of harlem. two things that stood out: it is quiet (relative to the rest of nyc) and clean! it’s really a great value for the amount of space and the easy access to public transportation. just a couple blocks from the a train, which can put you in midtown in 2 stops. finally - very cool old historic building that has kept some charm with plenty of modern comfort.

first, liz is a fantastic communicator and was able to accommodate us on a very short notice after another host canceled with very little notice. check in was easy, if a bit scavenger hunt-ish, kind of fun. the apartment itself is a very nice space, wide plank pine flooring, tons of books, very comfy bed. steam heat, so it takes some getting used to in order to regulate the temperature, but once you get the hang of it, easy. this is a prewar building, so floors slope a bit. she has done a great job making the space usable and providing quite a bit of storage room. espresso maker was a godsend. as for criticisms, the bathroom door is glass. it has some decorative paint, but it is very much clear... know any fellow guests well before using or you will afterwards. it's on the 5th floor and a couple of the floors have stairs that need some attention. i hear this is common in nyc but it was scary, especially if you're a heavy person. all in all, i would not hesitate to stay at her place again and we had a wonderful experience.

this place is really amazing! it is spacious and clean! also, very accessible to manhattan or other popular places in ny since there are subway stations nearby. above all, nidia and her husband took care of us so kindly and it makes my trip more special.
the inside was just like described but the location was a few doors away from a deli and people hanging out.
very clean room. with good housekeeping, great location, walking distance to madison square, time square, empire state building. great subway connections.

we had a marvelous time at david and janet's. 3 main reasons: warm welcome (david and janet are extremely nice and helpful, do everything to make you feel at home, and the 2 dogs are great), excellent location, and original home built with shipping containers. we were traveling with our baby girl and it wasn't a problem for them (contrary to many other potential hosts) and they even provided a crib. we would definitely come again!
