if you want somewhere simple to stay that’s pretty easy to get to manhattan from and won’t break the bank, yves’ place is fine for that. the area is average but safe and quiet. it’s only 12 mins walk to the subway and 20 mins into manhattan. our issues with the apartment were related to communication. although yves himself was very responsive during check in etc, we didn’t see too much of him otherwise. we also would have appreciated a quick flat tour or introduction to the place as we didn’t get this and didn’t know what we could or couldn’t use. we also were extremely disappointed by the amass of strangers in our living space, who had not been introduced or even mentioned to us. we presumed they were other guests, however the poor communication meant we actually had no idea who they were. yves didn’t inform us of any changes. we also checked out with a woman we had never seen before and who didn’t even introduce herself. one day we even woke up with a random man doing yoga and burning a candle directly outside the door to our room. also, yves’ dog panda wasn’t an ideal addition to a holiday. we didn’t think this would be the case as we are both dog lovers, however panda constantly barked at us every day and left dog hairs all over the sofa, the floor and our clothes. however, everything else worked well. the appliances worked as they should and we had a good shower each day. the air con was a good addition. bed comfy.

great air bnb experience. walking distance to grand central terminal where you can catch multiple trains (we rode the 4,5,6,7 trains to get to multiple nyc attractions.) location is near a local coffee shop and deli/convenient store. bed was comfortable and we got hot water from shower (just wait a few minutes to heat up-it didn't bother us). we got to leave our luggage before check-in as well as after check-out which was super accomadating. would definitely recommend staying here!
exactly what i expected. a great stay.
spacious, great location, clean
everything was great about our stay. the neighbors in the building were quiet. . the house was clean. our host was very responsive! and was so pleasant. i would definitely stay here again

sandra's place was exactly how it looked in the pictures. she was always available with answers to my questions. i really loved the fact that she has sensor lights at night when you walk to the door, very nice touch. my only issue was the bed is very firm but other than that it was great. would definitely recommend
very good location and walkable to times square and the theaters.
comfortable space for group of 4 in a fantastic location.

the location is very convenient—subway can reach almost all attractions in new york directly, and rides are mostly within 30 to 50 minutes. the room is also lovely and cozy. zhiqin is such a kind person. i felt carsick on my first day here, and she even gave me food. thank you so much! i will definitely stay at zhiqin’s place again when i travel to new york next time!
perfect stay! great location! no issues checking in or leaving! very clean & biggest positive is you have your own bathroom!

easily one of the nicest airbnb's we've ever stayed at! never mind the great location and all the great aspects of the apartment, the place has a steinway piano!! one of our sons spent a good hour-a-day playing, which was a wonderful bonus for all of us. the apartment (as you can tell from the photos) is brilliant -- the decor is very artistically done, with a lot of cool and interesting art and items throughout the place, and the whole place feels very spacious. all the beds are very good and it was great having two full bathrooms. the location is hard to beat with all the great shops and restaurants from both prospect heights and park slope within easy walking distance. in fact, one of the nicest restaurants you'll find anywhere in nyc is literally 50 feet from the front steps -- be sure to try out gertrude's right on the corner. and finally, chauncey the host is as cool and wonderful as hosts get! he took brilliant care of us and was a treat for us all to meet!

i cannot recommend will & robin's space enough! the pictures don't even do justice to how beautiful the airbnb is. the location is incredible! they put so many thoughtful touches into the experience. i am already thinking about when i can come back to stay again! you won't regret staying here. it is a true brooklyn gem!

location, location, location, this place is in the middle of chelsea with easy access to major subway lines, groceries, dining, theater, etc. check in was very smooth and mio very very responsive as a host. for one person, it was just perfect.
ron was an amazing host and helped me greatly throughout my stay. the room was clean, the bed was comfortable, and i would 100% stay again!
a beautiful apartment on a typical brooklyn brownstone street, walking distance to major subway lines and plenty of local restaurants. we really enjoyed our stay, ravanna is a great host!

carmel is a very responsive and 'always available' host. while we did not manage to meet face to face during the stay, she was always a message away. her place is very conveniently located on amsterdam avenue at a striking distance from columbia university campus (12 min walk or 1 train stop).
the ridge was a perfect stay. excellent location, self check in was super easy. i would come again and recommend.

perfect location. he is very friendly and helpful. he answers your questions very quickly. flexible hours are available. he woke up for us at 6 am when we arrived and offered to hold our luggage until our check-in time. the house is as seen in the photos. don't expect much. you will feel comfortable. thanks for everything :)
amazing host and amazing location! thank you so much henri!!
excellent location i fb you are visiting sheepshead bay or brighton beach areas. nice,quiet street. clean apartment with great amenities.
great place and host! very clean and cozy. so close to water and domino park. many choices for food. we would stay here again. thanks ruet.
excellent stay. very close to restaurants and bars, yet quiet and peaceful during the night. would stay again and would definitely recommend to others.

the hosts are super nice, helpful and friendly, the apartment was very clean, private bathroom is a big convenience. the location is great, you have everything you need around and it’s close to the train station so you can easily move around the city. i definitely recommend to stay there! 😌

michael’s place was wonderful for our latest visit to nyc. the place was incredibly clean and welcoming. we found the kitchen to be well stocked and equipped. it was great to be able to have breakfast on our schedule each day prior to heading into manhattan. there was a wonderful sitting area to unwind in and the bed was very comfortable! the bathroom was very clean. communication with michael was very timely and helpful. we look forward to another stay the next time we visit nyc!
really lovely space, great location and very close to everything you need. jenni responded quickly to anything we needed. highly recommend.
great place. great location. very quiet.

joseph was an excellent host. everything was nice and clean and he helped us find some cool places to go. public transport is close. if you want to stay in williamsburg the location doesn't get much better. as soon as you walk outside there's plenty of bars and restaurants to choose from. would definitely stay here again.

lovely host, very communicative. great location. the property is very small and the heating is random, boiling hot when not needed and then not on for several days. the host has no control over the heating it would seem.

i would highly recommend staying at this place. it was clean, stylish and the perfect location to be able to explore nyc. not to mention how easy it was to communicate with sheila and manny. book asap!

henry was a real good host. the subway was at 5 min from home and close to chinatown, little italy,.... the room was really clean and the bed so comfortable !! we didn't see him only when we arrived and go back. the bathroom was clean as well. thanks a lot henry for your advice and see you in the futur :)

jen's place is beautiful and welcoming. the subway is a few steps from the front door, which was perfect for my commutes to midtown. groceries are available a short walk away at target. ac was fantastic, in the new york summer. jen is super responsive and very helpful! a great host.

staying at george’s place was amazing. i loved his local recommendations for what to do in the neighborhood and it was convenient to get to the 82nd st. 7 line for exploring other parts of queens and manhattan. would highly recommend staying with george as it is an amazing deal for the level of hospitality that you get! easiest 5 star review ever!

we loved mina’s space. it was clean and roomy. comfy bed, clean and modern kitchen, beautiful balcony with a wonderful view of the city! it was only 2 blocks from my sisters place. great grocery store at the bottom of the building and easy to get to the subway. we will definitely be back! thank you so much mina!
close to grocery stores, cafes, and restaurants. really close to central park.
had a lovely, peaceful stay. 1 minute walk to the subway and with delis and restaurants nearby. room was a bit dusty but everywhere else in the house was fine.
everything was great and as described. very easy to communicate with host and smooth stay.
great location for sure

i absolutely loved the place! it was modern, clean, and extremely comfortable. the pictures are exactly how the room looks. walkable distance from the 3 train. wayne and lucelia were so friendly and responsive to a tee. i am definitely considering going back on my next nyc visit. thank you so much for a stellar place!
great host with very clean bathroom, cute nice dog and cats

ohad's listing is perfect for a stay in brooklyn. it is in a great location just a few minutes from the barclay center. there are a lot of great places to grab food very close by and a number of bars in the area. the space itself was very clean and spacious. i recommend this listing wholeheartedly.

it was a real pleasure to stay at paul's apartment in bed stuy. the apartment is around the corner from fun restaurants - e.g. just steps away from saraghina - as well as a good grocery store where i was able to get what i needed for my week-long stay. the apartment is within comfortable walking distance of the subway, so my commute to upper west side manhattan was straightforward. the apartment is spacious and bright with high ceilings, and is stylishly decorated. paul is a great host. he's a clear communicator, friendly, and responsive. i would happily stay there again.
great place, would recommend
great stay! it’s cozy, private and very easy to navigate. amazing little kitchenette and living quarters. would highly recommend!

room is exactly as photographed. the common areas are beautiful and the rooftop is a privilege. i stayed here for one month and was happy with my experience. tomás is very responsive and cares about your wellbeing.

excellent stay at jorge and nancy’s, one of the best we’ve had on airbnb. the apartment had plenty of space, was clean, very well appointed and with clear information in a folder. it also happens to be within a genuine architectural gem, an 1899 brownstone with original features throughout - beautiful! nancy was clear and helpful via messages and made just the right amount of contact. if i can make only one suggestion it would be to improve the wifi speed/latency as we found that a little slow. thanks for a great stay!
perfect stay in the heart of manhattan, highly recommended

the studio was clean, quiet, adorable, safe and laura was a really good host. i've stayed in many airbnb's in astoria and this was the nicest one so far. upon arrival, the fridge had water, ginger ales and a few cans of soda as well as snacks on the counter. those small personal touches mean a lot when you are away from home. there are convenience stores, bars, restaurants and shopping in very close proximity. the subway is about a 13 min walk, which is on a several tree-lined blocks, so it's a nice way to start your day. i would definitely book this cute cozy studio again!

gary’s place was adorable, spacious and very nicely decorated. the location cannot be beat. i can’t say enough good things about our stay. the coffee shop was a bonus. gary’s guidance on neighborhood spots was indispensable. we didn’t want to leave.
susan was an amazing host! she was incredibly response and gave us a great list of places to check out in the area! would highly recommend!
we stayed with ryan earlier and came back for another month. we liked the space and would recommend to others for longer stays.

dee's place was perfect: as advertised, she gave us great recommendations for food, drinks and coffee in the local area. her place is near the subway which makes it easy to get to manhattan, although the journey takes a little while. highly recommended!

i had a great experience staying at eric's place. eric was a fantastic host! he was very quick to respond to my messages and was very accommodating. the bed was very comfortable and the room and bathroom were very clean. my flight home got cancelled the day i was supposed to check out due to bad weather conditions and eric was very understanding and allowed me to stay for an additional night with no issues. he truly is a great person and i would definitely recommend this air b and b to anyone interested in staying in brooklyn!

the stay was great the place was great i love it here went on the balcony a few times access to transportation was good supermarket was in walking distance and most of all the hose deserves six stars. i recommend this place and host.

visited nyc with my two college daughters. room was clean, comfortable, and perfect for our needs and the location of the hotel is absolutely prime. host was very responsive from start to finish; we will be coming back to this place on our next nyc trip. this hotel and location won’t disappoint - and that’s a fact! thank you for making our recurring nyc experience easy 😃
clean, well organized, and furnished! great area, clean building. jake was very responsive. would definitely stay again!
this is such a great place. it has everything i need for a few days in town for work. the location to 5th ave in park slope is also fantastic
great spot right in the heart of fidi. fabio’s a great host, highly recommend.
loved the place and the decor
pamela's place is at a great location. the place was very clean and pamela herself was friendly and welcoming.
tara’s room was everything i needed for my stay! tara was extremely helpful and a great host! i would love to return when i am back in town!

great location! about 5 minute walk to metro or less than 2 min walk to buses to get to the tourist areas. great value for location. if you're a traveler that just needs a clean place to sleep with a close location to nyny then this is great!

my family and i just ended a month stay at rover's apt in nyc. we had a great stay and look forward to returning. the apartment is as described and matched our requirements very well. it's very quiet and peaceful inside with light coming from the outside into the rooms. the neighborhood is amazing with lots to do, etc and shop groceries are right around the corner. great stay, great host.
great location and plenty of things to do in the surrounding area!
a very nice and intimate setting
sheila was a great host. would stay here again! good value.
this is absolutely worth it.
such a spacious place! great location and comfortable beds with plenty of room to spread out with two living rooms! steven was very responsive and helpful!
quiet,clean and safe. wendell was a great host with the sweetest cat. if you want something quiet and kept away during your time in brooklyn then this is the place.
loved it. would definitely come back. i felt safe and well taken care of. the room was cozy and free breakfast was plenty.
the room and facilities were perfect, just as advertized. nadia's family were exceptionally warm and welcoming. would definitely stay here again.
i am very happy with the visit to this place, raymond is an excellent host and makes you feel like you were friends from years ago. i hope to return to this place one day, thank you raymond.

the place was very clean, modern, and equipped with everything that we needed. we felt at ease in the neighborhood. the parking spot was very convenient for a brooklyn apartment since we travelled by car. the apartment is perfectly located close to public transportations, grocery stores, parks, restaurants and so forth. overall quint little place to come home to and relax after a long day in town.

a little oasis that felt like a local. 1 block from the closest subway station and just a few blocks from everything to do in chelsea and greenwich village. the place was very clean which doesn’t seem possible in nyc. beds were very comfortable to sleep in the city that never sleeps
great place. and the security and staff were excellent . clean welcoming. 10/10
it is near to target, supermarkets, amc theaters, etc. very clean and comfortable.
clean and comfortable and comparatively close to manhattan

this was a great place to stay. it’s a well appointed home with all the amenities you need. wonderful beds in high ceiling rooms. great location with nearby subway, really good cafe, restaurants. the neighborhood feels save and is quiet. the host is very responsive. we would stay again.
great place very cozy. the place had everything you can think off. would definitely stay there again. i highly recommended staying there!
thank you for your patience in helping me so much.
love this place
unbelievably gorgeous apartment in the best location!! so peaceful and relaxing inside, and with exciting east village just outside!! mich was a wonderful host!
cons: no parking or minimal parking no air conditioner ceilings are extremely low bedroom doors do not close completely pros: subway is directly across the street private entrance close to the beach
nice helpful host, worth the money for that price and well located area in manhatten!
i had a wonderful vacation in this house.
devins place was great. really enjoyed access and views of central park. would stay again
the place was very clean and decorated nicely. very clean and well stocked with supplies needed such as pots and pans (even to having washer pods). will recommend to firends.

we had the best time, the apartment has literally everything you need and it's so nice and clean and close to the m train. such a lovely neighborhood, quiet and with the best deli right at the corner :) totally recommend

josh and victoria are great hosts. friendly and helpful, especially after a delayed flight meant a late night check in. space has great nyc garden apt vibes and is next to subway (20 min into the city). thanks for hosting!

karen's apartment was a great place to stay for our new york visit. the apparent was just as described and very clean. there were a lot of house rules, and we were always a little afraid that we broke some of them, and the internet was more off than on, apart from that we enjoyed our stay very much. we really liked the neighborhood, and with karen's maps and suggestions to where we could go for groceries and food, it was no problem to find the good spots in a neighborhood that we probably would not have visited if we were not staying there. we felt really safe in the neighborhood.
great stay! very clean and exactly as described on listing
a perfect place for our nyc stay. walkable to many restaurants and coffee shops and a short subway ride to manhattan.

it's hard to beat the price for a hotel so close to the action. our only complaints were that our shower drain clogged very fast and the showers water temperature wasn't consistent. otherwise it was a pretty standard hotel, it was nice that they allowed early check in with bags specifically, that way we didn't have to carry around our luggage while we waited. security was nice and so we're the maids and all of the staff. would definitely stay again!

michael has a beautiful home with everything you will need for a relaxing stay. it is clean and spacious with high ceilings. i enjoyed his extensive library of books to peruse. the building is modern and quiet, though i did encounter some mild noise one night with the courtyard door constantly slamming from a downstairs get-together. i didn’t get a chance to meet michael due to a flight delay but he was completely welcoming and responsive via text, and the alternative check-in process was hassle free. recommended.
beware of false claims and be safe. stay at another place

this was our first shared apartment experience and it was great. raju and his wife were fantastic hosts ! he welcomed us w drinks & a tour of the guest wing. the space was roomy and comfortable w a stylish kitchen, bath and terrace. the bed and linens were clean and cozy… and the chai tea they prepared in the morning was delicious & so gracious! we would definitely stay here again.

great, central location and very friendly door staff. responded quickly and moved me to another room when i had an issue with the heating. no cooking facilities and more like a basic hotel room but great place to explore the city from.

ryan’s place was great for my 3 weeks stay, with many useful amenities inside the apartment. it is close to the ditmars subway station. it perfectly fit my need of a temporary cozy place. ryan was also responding very fast if there was anything i needed. he welcomed me in person and explained me everything i had to know about the apartment. i would definitely recommend this place !
nice atmosphere, private and easygoing place
daniel was great! very responsive.
this is an amazing place to stay and the hostess is very kind and welcoming. it’s affordable and remarkable place to stay very clean and nice spacious i enjoy staying there
patricia's place is the perfect location for accessing the beach. there were a generous number of towels and it was a super easy check-in.

showed up and the beds were slept in and messy, my partner and i had to get a different hotel costing $400 and the air bnb gave me a really hard time about refunding. worst experience ever. do not recommend.

kathleen was the most gracious hostess ever! she's genuinely caring and extremely nice. i couldn't have asked for a better host. her place was very welcoming and felt just like home. i would recommend her to everyone who wants to visit brooklyn. i can say with absolute certainty, i will be back!

this apartment comes highly recommended! reka is a great host, communication as well as check in were easy and she was really helpful. the apartment is on the 6th floor, has three bedrooms (two of which are frequently rented via airbnb), and laundry and a small gym are in the house. the bed is extremely comfortable, the room has more than enough space for all your things and the apartment is spotlessly clean and provides all that you need. most importantly, the rooftop terrace is amazing and offers a beautiful view over lower manhattan which rivals many of the rooftop bars in the area. the neighborhood is lovely with many cafes, bars, and restaurants. tompkins square park and east river park are just a short walk away.

this is an inexpensive airbnb for its location, so you shouldn’t expect the ritz. that said, the staff is incredibly friendly, the room was clean, the bathroom was imperfect, but fine, and this airbnb was exactly what we needed for a cheap, short stay in the middle of everything. the location can’t be beat. if you don’t mind some minor imperfections in the bathroom, and a very small bedroom, this hotel is perfect. once again, let me reiterate that the staff at this la quinta are incredibly friendly, responsive, respectful, and kind. i definitely plan to come back.
the hosts were wonderful, the place is very clean and lovely to stay at.
the location is great. good value and lots of space. spacious and stylish bathroom and bedrooms. we really enjoyed the free coffee in the morning.
what i would expect of a studio in new york - a little small, but a good stay for the price! def has a lived-in feel, so as long as you’re okay with that it’s a good stay!

the best are the people who work there - a lady specifically- and the location close to soho and trains . but the room was way too depressing and small . i saw the-one they sent in photos and it was next door . the bathroom downstairs for ppl to use in lobby is terrible . thanks !
they were very accommodating about check in and we were able to get into the room early, which was very nice!
another great stay. great hosts
perfect location and clear instructions

if you're looking for luxury and convince, look no further. this place has a large amount of space to sleep and play, the backyard takes the icing on the cake. there two kitchens in the home made cooking for a large party so easy, the home was fully equipped and clean. the sheets were so cozy and clean. the host is very responsive, welcoming, friendly, and down to earth. i had a party of 9 adults and we had an amazing time! would definitely book again.
was a lovely time. lina was welcoming and friendly
trey is a great host!

s&g's place was just what i needed. i felt safe and at peace here. as a woman traveling solo, i was very picky when choosing a place to stay, and the reasons i chose this location was not only the price and area, but its cleanliness, it is on the top floor, everyone knows each other in the building, you are in a private studio, the incredible hospitality provided by s&g because they had excellent reviews. great shower, hot water, refrigerator to store food, they provided me with snacks and coffee during my stay (so thoughtful!), robe and other items to make your stay memorable and pleasant. they have excellent communication and are flexible. i appreciated the early and late check-in accommodations. everything in the room was clean, ac and fan was helpful (the room always felt cool. look no further stay here. i would definitely stay here again.
great stay! very clean, and od was very responsive throughout the entire stay! highly recommend

richard's place is a very good deal as for nyc accommodation. everything is in a good condition . communication was easy. the neighborhood feels safe. commute was a bit long though (we usually spent around 50 min in the train) but the subway is right around the corner so it is still very convenient.
great place to stay. my first option everytime i go to nyc.

travelers, at this home away from home, you can expect a well taken care of location that is managed by the two most loving and caring people i and my family have ever met. the home is clean, well taken care of, and dare i say, luxurious!! the space is excellent and you will feel you are at home!!!

i had such a wonderful stay with amber! she is an incredible host who made me feel right at home from the moment i arrived. her communication was fantastic, and she was always there to help with anything i needed. the apartment is super nice! clean, well-kept, and stocked with everything you could need for a comfortable stay. plus, it’s really easy to get around using public transportation. overall, this has been my absolute favorite airbnb experience! i’d give it a big 11/10 and can’t wait to stay again!
jhone andres was very nice made me feel at home
really nice place, close to the train. had a good stay!
great place to stay

perfect location to explore manhattan. cool, eclectic neighbourhood and really close to the f train subway stop which allows you to explore the whole city. apartment is very bohemian and quirky. we stayed with our two young boys and they loved the space and enjoyed having a bath in the deep tub. there’s lots of bits and pieces around that little hands want to explore so might not suit a very young toddler but thankfully our 2 year old didn’t break anything! :) lovely hosts. very accommodating when our arrival plans changed last minute.
she was so sweet and sent us so many dining and activities options. she also turned up the heat when we were cold and gave us coffee. the place was just as described.

we really loved this hotel staff was very friendly the entire time, we loved the location. broad nosh bagels was a 3 minute walk and our favorite breakfast we had there. 3 minute walk to the subway, 5 minute walk to times square but you can see it from the hotel. the only thing we didn’t love was that the lobby is a bar open to the public so it never really felt like a lobby we could just hang out in but it was otherwise amazing.

we really enjoyed our stay at tash’s place! it was a 10 minute walk from the subway and easy to find, and tash was flexible with us arriving later than we had originally planned which we really appreciated. there were also a good amount of people around late so i wasn’t too nervous walking around at night. we did see a few cockroaches in the bedroom but it’s late spring in nyc and that’s pretty common. we also refilled our water bottles in the sink and the tap water was amazing :) we would definitely stay again!

this listing does not include that there are 5 rooms total being rented out on property. the bathroom is shared with the entire house, not just one other guest. this is a huge security breach. stella is the listed host for this property, but she was not home. her mother, jing, was very very very nice and hospitable. the ac unit in the upstairs room was broken and leaked onto the floor every night i was there. when i let stella know she told me i could just empty the unity myself so i did, in the shower. not the end of the world but not what i want to be doing after paying $400 to stay here. the upstairs shower is full of dirt and grime — if the host sees this and disagrees, go wipe your finger across the tile and you’ll see what i mean! absolutely disgusting. also the shelf was cluttered with old bath products from previous guests, which i do understand saving for future guests, but this was cluttered and dirty. absolutely not. stay in a hotel for cheaper.
great location, spacious, clean, and private space, responsive and kind host. you can't beat it! many thanks :)

ivan's apartment totally loved up to its description. he was very communicative with me prior to our stay. when we arrived for check-in, it was a smooth process due to the expliciti nstructions provided. the apartment was spotless and has a very modern, cool vibe; extra points for the star wars wallpaper in the bathroom. there is more than enough room for two people and you could easily fit a third in the living room using the pull-out sofa. the neighborhood has easy access to the subway and there are lots of convenience stores, restaurants and coffee shops within walking distance. i would not hesitate to book this place again!

meghan is a great host, very responsive. she is generous with her space and very knowledgeable about the area. the location of this unit really worked for me, as it was just a short walk to the ferry, which i took every day into manhattan. i also took advantage of the parking lot right across the street, as street parking is kind of challenging on staten island. the room was bright and cheerful, with views of the harbor. i would definitely stay again in the future!
amazing experience. very friendly and helpful will definitely be coming back and 100% recommend
diamond. well appointed, comfortable and showroom clean. the king bed is comfortable with great linen. my stat was short but comfortable, i would stay at the property again in heartbeat.

great place. we stayed with our two teenage kids and place was perfect since we were only there at night. close to the subway station and walking distance to times square and other attractions. henri was super nice and very responsive. strongly recommend.

i had never been to manhattan and i'm so happy that i was able to stay at brian's home. it was clean and comfortable. the location was amazing. i was steps from times square, convenient access to the subway, a very short walk to a broadway show and dinner in hell's kitchen!! brian was so helpful. he created a list of shows on broadway and have great tips on how to get tickets at the best price. i would definitely stay again.
karman is very friendly and responsive in communication. arriving late but self checkin was smooth. felt very welcomed by the warm apartment.

sia was very welcoming, if i needed anything she will provide it for my my use, iron to press my dresses, hairspray because i forgot to bring my own …. ronald was attentive and always telling me- be safe, be aware of your surroundings i really appreciate there hospitality

eduardo and matt's place was absolutely fantastic. what a gem in harlem. it has a certain character and feel to it. access to the trains was about a 5-7 minute walk but there is a bus stop just two minutes walk that takes you down to madison ave and to midtown manhattan. eduardo was a great host, he left wine for us as a welcoming present. and once he got back from his business trip, he was an amazing person to talk to. the place was super clean and easy to find. just overall great. we have no complaints at all. we will definitely stay again!
it was nice stay in here if you’re planning to visit manhattan its close to the ferry as well. can recommend the place
lovely flat, we really enjoyed our stay and madison had some great hints for us! highly recommendable :-)

report the roaches as soon as you see them!! it was horrible staying here, i couldn’t sleep and i would dread coming home. early on i found a centipede next to my bed which i killed before learning it usually means you have roaches. after seeing them every night (including in my bed) i realised that they were hiding in the wardrobe seam. i asked the host to treat them twice but i could still see the same number when i left. i even found one in my luggage back home in the uk! the host and airbnb refused to give me a partial refund for the whole stay, only from when i complained which took a while because i have never seen roaches before! i’m very upset by this experience. it is on the 4th floor without an elevator, was definitely in worse condition than the pictures with a broken blind, writing, dents and marks on the walls. the location is amazing but noisy. it was good to have my own bathroom. laundry is in the building next door. amenities were only provided for a couple of days.

great apartment in what is possibly the best location in ny. as stara said, the apartment is obviously not new, neither is the building, but that is part of the experience i guess. i was visiting during extremely cold weather, but the apartment was always nice and warm. stara's local recommendations were great and she was super easy to get in touch with. make sure you also listen to her warnings - particularly about how hot the hot water can be. do take into account there are two flights of stairs (not a big deal at all, but take your time with luggage).
thank you very much, was everythinh like she told me. the most important think, the place is closet to most of places to visit!
awesome place would kill to stay if i’m ever in the city again, thank you, much love.
nice place and conveniently located
i felt safe, it’s a great location and a nice spot to stay if you have a quick visit.
thank you for the lovely accommodations in park slope.
great stay and easy commute. good communication and well-cleaned room
it was fantastic thank you for everything!

as i read the reviews they are all spot on. we highly recommend mateo's studio. the hosts are so welcoming and kind to the point that i wish they were my neighbors. the home is in a historical area, close to restaurants, transportation, prospect park, the brooklyn museum and more. you will not be disappointed.
aminah is a helpful host.
it’s so good place.
good place for family staying

we had a great stay — christian&brysen were accommodating and helpful at our check in and helped confirm we parked alright. the room is comfortable, the place is located conveniently located very close by the metro, so easy traveling to manhattan.

not only will you get a great clean space it’s also very stylish. you can tell the space is well taken care of and jabari is always available to answer questions or offer suggestions. i would definitely recommend staying here if you are looking for comfort and cleanliness.

we really enjoyed our stay in harlem. this is a beautiful apartment which is well maintained and spotlessly clean. douglas is a great host who provided us with some great local recommendations. harlem shakes do the best burgers! i highly recommend this property and i hope to make a return visit soon.

the communication was direct and the key pickup was effortless. aspano offered an incredible amount of local knowledge regarding upper east sides restaurant scene during my daycation to ny! the apartment was stunning and i would highly recommend! 5 stars!
a little sanctuary! i’d definitely recommend this place to anyone! chris is a great host :)

ester's room was great for my brother and i. we had two comfortable beds, a tv with cable, ester left us bagels and coffee in the am, etc. the location was fantastic! the subway was around the corner...about 5 minutes away ...and we got into midtown in about 10 minutes! i also stayed in the upper east side and it was quicker to get into midtown from ester's place than it was from the upper east side. i would stay at ester's again and i highly recommend her place for anyone needing a place with two beds!
very kind and welcoming! made me feel right at home. the space is extremely clean! the room was exactly as described and just what i needed. thank you for your hospitality!
great place in soho. subway was right out the door. good food market right across the street. loud because right in the city, but they do provide air plugs at check-in.
sharon’s place was great for our short trip to new york! she was really accommodating and made us feel right at home.
it was very close to the airport . i would definitely stay here again. great host.

i've stayed w andrada twice now and i cannot speak highly enough about her or her establishment. perfect location, rooms are immaculate and amazingly well thought out. she has truly spared nothing. every detail in the rooms has been taken care of, bathrooms are spotless, even dispensers for soap in the showers. seriously doesn't get better. 15/10 will return and recommend to others.

when we first came in there was a baby roach on the kitchen counter. we saw about 5 during our 3 day stay, so we made sure not to leave any food out. the floors were very dirty. the hallway reeked of garbage, but i know that part was out of mory’s control. it was very conveniently close to the six train. only 20 minutes to time square and 40 minutes to soho.
very friendly host and felicia took care of everything when needed.

this place is an amazing value, i’d definitely recommend it for anyone looking for a great deal. the place isn’t “nice”, but it’s a larger space than the pictures convey, it had everything i needed, plus the king size bed is a plus. i’d certainly stay here again - especially with stella being such a great, attentive host!

we had a great time staying at carol's, it was very roomy and comfortable and convenient for transport (10-15 mins walk to multiple subway stations). we often had the place to ourselves, and loved the outdoor patio. highly recommended.

great location and central to most things. the hosts were very responsive and attentive too! really easy check in and i went with my best friend and the room was spacious for the both of us. would highly recommend!
it is very accurate as per the pictures and very well organized. very comfortable for 2 people
john place, great and close to the city

i needed a place to stay between moving apartments in nyc, and this place was exactly what i needed. the location is phenomenal! the apartment is on a quiet street, really close to the q train, which gets you to midtown manhattan in minutes. it’s a 10-minute walk to central park, grocery stores and ups are right down the street, and it’s surrounded by some of my favorite restaurants in the city. i can highly recommend this place — i had a wonderful stay!
very nice and well located appartement.
great location. easy access to subway, grand central station, and times square.

zhehong was a superb host and was always available whenever i reached out. the place was clean, cared for, and well put together. so, we felt right at home during our stay. we would definitely stay there again without hesitation.

great appartment and great host! gonzalo is really friendly and helpful. he gave us a lot of good information for our ny visit. you can reach the supermarkt, an awesome pizzaria and a nice bakery in around 5min by foot. if you want to go to manhatten you can take the bus (bus station is 2min away from the appartment) to jackson hight/roosevelt av. metro station (around 10-15min by bus) and there you can catch a train to the city (maybe annother 20-25 minutes). we had a great time and would definitly recommend this appartment :)

great value for money in manhattanville. clean, comfortable, basic, easy access to 1 train. host was hard to reach initially when an issue arose, but once engaged, she and her sister were very responsive and worked hard to resolve problems. i would stay here again.
everything was exactly as it was described

i had a great experience at megan’s place. even though my stay was shorter than planned due to an unexpected situation, i really loved the place from the moment i arrived. it was spotless, cozy, and beautifully decorated, and it immediately felt like home. the garden house was calm and quiet, with a lovely backyard. the bedroom was spacious and very comfortable, and the temperature inside was perfect, which was especially nice after coming from a colder place. the kitchen was brand new, very clean, and perfectly set up with everything you need for cooking—it truly felt like a real home, not just a short-term rental. megan was an amazing host, very kind and responsive. i can’t recommend her place enough for anyone looking for a cozy, peaceful, and comfortable stay.
good stuff
great stay no complaints and it’s a police station and a corner store right beside apt felt very safe and very convenient
luis is responsive and a diligent host. the place is beautiful and great for a solo traveler.

kishorie's b&b was an excellent place to stay. the room was comfortable and has plenty of essentials and amenities, especially for longer stays. she is a helpful and attentive host who will keep in contact in order to make sure you have everything you need on your visit.

the location is perfect and i’m from ny. the building is really nice and the gym is really good; there are no barbells but it’s multiple rooms and better than anything else in comparison to all my airbnb stays. the host is super sweet and responds right away. i had very little interaction with her and really didn’t even know if/ when she was there. true 5 star experience.

we had a great stay at cem and emily’s lovely home. not only was everything super clean, the bed was very comfortable and welcoming after many hours of sight seeing in the city. the bedroom has a good size dresser and large closet which provided lots of space for our suitcase, clothes and belongings and the decor throughout the unit is very nice. towels were super soft and linens comfy. we appreciated the tips provided from the hosts about local cafes, bars and restaurants. this was our first time visiting our daughter who recently moved to brooklyn/bushwick, and we enjoyed getting to experience the friendly neighborhood vibe when we walked over to her apartment every day. we had to change our plans and leave a little earlier than we wanted due to snow/inclement weather, and the hosts were flexible and accommodating. response time is almost immediate. thank you cem and emily for sharing your lovely home with us and we look forward to staying here again in the near future!
great place & good value for money .
cinthya’s place is large, comfortable, and stylish! close to the utica station to get into town if needed but also close to the wonderful experience brooklyn has to offer.
excellent location! we couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay to explore manhattan for our family holiday. allan (emily’s assistant) was super helpful and friendly throughout our stay.
perfect appartement for a stay in new york and to discover the city!

this place met and slightly exceeded my expectations, it was everything i needed in a short-term rental and kaz and his team were extremely responsive when the apartment needed something. cleanliness in the bathroom was a downside, but that's to be expected living with three other strangers. the area can be a bit noisy at night, being right on top of a bar too. overall though, it has everything you need for a short term stay. kaz was also willing to be flexible with extending my stay if i couldn't find a new apartment in time, which was greatly appreciated. good place to stay and very close to the 2/3 trains.

thomas was a great host . very nice and considerate. place looks exactly like pictures.he was very nice about check out . very responsive. the place was in a very walkable area and easy toget to different boroughs from there . thank you for allowing me to stay it was greatly appreciated
was very comfortable for 8 people! perfect location, had a great time a no issues at all. would stay here again!
extremely clean and tidy space just as advertised. i would recommend staying here if you don't want to spend extra to stay in the city

pamela was very welcoming and facilitated our trip by giving us good advice for the subway and the restaurants. she takes time to visit the appt with us. i saw some comments about the fact that there is only one bathroom (very clean) for four rooms but it was not a problem because, let's be honest, the visitors do not all have the same schedule!
everything is perfect, thank you manuel!
all good! we would stay here again

by far, my favorite airbnb in nyc thus far. the photos do not do the apartment justice. vanessa's apartment is incredibly spacious and comfortable. some other apartments in airbnb are sparsely furnished so you feel like a temporary visitor in a temporary space - but vanessa's house had all the amenities that made it feel like home. plenty of seating, all the kitchen utensils and supplies one would need, books, games, and a patio if you need even more space. and vanessa was a gracious host - even waking up to let me check in at 6 am (!) because i was on a red-eye and the apartment was available earlier in the day - much appreciated! location wise, so many things are right near by - from the subway, to coffee, restaurants, and things to do. i will certainly be staying here in all my future nyc visits! thank you vanessa!
cool spot. thank you!
great place, the neighborhood is quite, transportation is easy and the apartment had everything we need for our stay. di was very responsive and helpful.

the place is wonderful. very clean and spacious. we had everything needed. we were there for two weeks. the train is close, which takes you directly to times square. the area is safe. loved the garden. the bedroom warms up pretty fast, the living room was a bit cold for me. however it was a great stay and ray was very helpful all the time. so i can really recommend a stay in rays place. thank you very much

wonderful place with lots of character and charm! we were greeted very warmly and had a wonderful stay. close to bus stop and were provided with help on the bus schedule even by hans! great choice for a staten island stay.
room was very comfortable, great location in manhattan, quiet and safety place. i would definitely recommend to stay here if you go to nyc

lou was a great host, he has a good vibe and he welcomed us with some chocolates, that was a nice touch . for the price the place is very well located near restaurants, shops and subway and the place is kept clean. i had some minor inconveniences that lou was very willing to solve. i would definitely return to this lodging. 👍

nice and quiet room, not too far from the main attractions in the city. paul showed us around when we arrived, communication was very smooth. perfect privacy through the rest of our stay. would definitely recommend, especially when trying to save some money on your ny vacation.

great value, pleasant neighborhood, friendly hosts, very short walk to the station (more like 2-3 minutes vs. "1 minute" as stated in the listing). may not be a good choice for someone who's a light sleeper - even though the other lodgers are respectful of quiet hours, the dog downstairs isn't, and even just people walking in the hallway or up/down the stairs could be enough to wake a light sleeper. but it's adequate if you just need a bed and access to a basic kitchen and shared bathroom. i wouldn't hesitate to stay there again for a short visit. overall i feel fortunate to have found it for the price.
cool space easy, access to the city. host is amazing and other guests were respectful and clean.

i absolutely loved my stay. i stayed at chinomnso's place for 4 months and it allowed me to see how amazing the bronx is. the apartment was perfect and fulfilled every need. i didn't hear the neighbors at all and when we met in the halls, everyone was friendly. i was a le to walk to multiple options for restaurants, grocery stores, and shops. there was even a nice park just up the hill with lots of walking trails, kids practicing various sports and even a water feature for kids to play in. i truly loved it!

jane was really nice, we woke her up in the middle of the night as we get in ny very late and she was happy to do that .the apartment is close to the subway, about 30 min from times square. the room is clean and confortable, only a little bit noisy, but this is new york!!!
joslin is a wonderful host. very responsive to guests and super friendly. we were very pleased she was there to greet us after a late arrival.
rosy is a great host. she is very kind and caring.
we absolutely loved our stay! the hosts were very responsive and quick to fix any small issue that arose (like getting a new hdmi cable). great location, clean, and quiet. 10/10 would stay again.
great hospitality and a very clean place to stay. the hosts were very accommodating but also respected our privacy during the stay. great location, close to everything and get your own parking space.

my stay at jewel's place was great! 2 minutes to the b & q trains. the apartment is always clean, the room is spacious and the bed is very comfortable. there are tons of different guidebooks and suggestions for activities stocked in the room. jewel is helpful and friendly; overall great value and highly recommended!

illias is pretty good at communication. the room is exactly what he mentioned. he reminded me that the heater would have some noise in the night during the winter. the noise is louder than we expected. however, we bought the earplugs in the second day and it was way more better. the location is pretty good, very close to the subway.
had a great stay for a layover between jfk and lga!! clean and private! loved having my own bathroom. thank you so much!

i only met carol once, when i checked in and received my keys. she was friendly and showed me the room in the apartment. she was easy to communicate with online and by phone, and responded quickly. the room itself is very nice. it's big and beautiful with a huge bed and a fantastic private bathroom. there are other people staying in other parts of the large house, including another airbnb room, so you will hear them occasionally. i had trouble staying connected to the wifi. the location in the neighborhood is great. you can see experience the hustle and bustle of brooklyn, but you're not on a main thoroughfare. it is a short walk to the subway, buses, restaurants, fort greene park, and bodegas. downtown brooklyn is also a slightly longer walk away or you can take one of several buses. i would definitely stay here again.

erica's apartment was the perfect place to stay during our trip to the new york area to visit art colleges with our son. the pratt institute was nearly next door. the neighborhood felt quiet and safe and the subway was only a few minutes walk from the apartment. this was our first time using airbnb, and i'm now enthusiastically recommending it to my friends.

i had a great time visiting new york and moe’s place was super convenient and comfortable. the bed, bed linens, and pillows were very comfortable and i was definitely glad about that! i had everything i needed, and mo and his brother were super friendly. this is a great place to stay, and i will definitely look to book here the next time i visit my daughter who’s apartment is around the corner on dean street. thank you!
all easy peezy and exactly as advertised. great location, communication and cleanliness.
clean cozy apartment near subway in bushwick. would stay again. hosta are friendly and responsive to requests.

the place was so beautifully decorated and spacious, we loved the little touches like the diffuser in our room. everything was very clean and we don’t have a single complaint. fifi was so sweet and a great host, we were keeping to ourselves in the room and there was no problem with that she was very quiet and let us have our own space. loved the apartment and how close it is to the train station and a quick 10 minute walk to any restaurants, stores, etc. would absolutely recommend this place!

we stayed at david and roni’s for 4 nights while visiting our kids in bklyn. the apartment was spotless and roomy, with a very comfortable bed and soft sheets. the neighborhood is great, and was convenient for us. david is friendly and helpful. we will definitely stay again.

the room was a great location for staying near a saturday morning wedding at fordham. the neighborhood is full of delicous food and liveliness! wish we would have had more time to spend acting like locals.
i only had and one issue which was the temperature of the room. the room very good cleaned and the bathrom too. i stayed max 5 hours
clean, comfortable and as advertised.
loved this stay! a cute, quiet room in a residential part of brooklyn. close to coffee shops, the subway, and corner stores. dee was very friendly and accommodating!
a must! love this place proper modern and cozy . thx and till next time
great place to stay and easy access to wherever we wanted to go. dorion placed himself at our availability if we ever needed him and was very responsive to our needs.
loved this place, would definitely recommend

location could not be better if you're looking to explore park slope. we were thrilled with wall of books, it added a coziness you don't usually find in rentals. we felt like we had our own brooklyn brownstone. we'll be back!
nate is an amazing host. he was very accommodating with check in and everything was clean in the room and the common areas as well. great value!
very good. it had everything you need. neighborhood is nice and close to many bus stops.

olenka’s studio was immaculate upon arrival! she was very quick to respond from before we ever booked until the day of departure. clean fresh linen/towels. private entrance was great and i felt very safe. the location is great. easy access to bus/subway to get to manhattan. felt safe walking after dark around the neighborhood. grocery store within 5 minute walk. a great bbq restaurant/bar within 5 minute walk. there is no air conditioning in the studio and it was unusually warm when we were visiting so we had to sleep with the windows open and the neighbors are a bit loud, not at all olenkas fault. she did mention they usually have an ac unit but it wasn’t installed for the season yet. the studio is in the basement so you can hear walking, moving and some talking from above you. all in all, very happy with our stay and would definitely stay again.

we had a great time staying at jamal's place. very peaceful and quiet at night once in the bedroom, but lots of life and action out in the street. kind and fun people all around. everything you need is in walking distance.
good location

it was our first airbnb and it is very good because there was a nice welcome with a nice attention (we had something to celebrate) and because everything was okay. we had complete privacy and what is important to us (wc + shower) was ok! there is near a metro so you quickly everywhere. on foot the 3 miles to the brooklyn bridge. in addition to christophe, there is a nice bakery where you of a tasty breakfast you can enjoy. a little further on there is a bagelmarket which is also good for breakfast. this place to stay, i would anyone can recommend! and 2 loving cats are called you are still welcome!
great location and great host, the door can be a bit tricky to unlock but just make sure you practice a few times. lots of great restaurants within walking distance !

not a bad place to stay. the area is nice and has multiple restaurants within walking distance. it was easy to check in. please note that this is a shared unit with the host upstairs. we heard some normal noise such as walking around the apartment. however, during the last evening of our stay the host was arguing with someone very loudly. we could hear the entire conversation and it caused quite the disturbance. cleanliness of the apartment wasn’t what i had expected. the shower was also extremely slick and multiple people slipped during the stay.
great location and hosts were very helpful.
had an amazing stay at chris's place! great place and location and chris is a really nice person who made me feel right at home! thanks again!
great location to the subway! host was extreme accommodating!
easy check in. friendly and quick staff. close to train station & chinatown. con: it got a little too warm in the room & couldn’t get the heat to turn down
great location and nice space right in the heart of williamsburg. especially nice for little ones with lots of sweet toys, a crib and high chair.

staying in this place was really uncomfortable and awkward. the whole time we stayed in this place waldemar and his sister was present the entire time leaving us no privacy what so ever except in our bedroom. the bedroom was like a 5 star jail cell. we weren't able to lock our door from the inside; however it could be locked it from the outside. not to mention the door was designed like a caged door with a sliding bolt locked. the room had cobwebs and bugs. our last night there i saw a bug crawled on my son's face while he sleeps. there was no ac only a ceiling fan. the entire place was very hot and add to that a smell that is indistinct and unpleasant. they also have a cat that walks all over their sink and the kitchen area is always dirty from their dishes. waldemar is not very attentive to detail and rude. he charged me an extra $165 for my husband when i clearly mention as well as put 2 guest on my reservation a whole month prior and decide to notified me this two days before to checking in. he was rude to my brother who was helping me with my luggage (not staying there) questioning him with an attitude who he was. overall the stay with waldemar was definitely a one star for me. i hope his future guest will not experience the same experience we have.
lovely hosts in a diverse area. very tight spacing within the communal living. perhaps pricy for what is given but a solid stay nonetheless.

marcia's cozy and artistic flat in dumbo. we could reach easily to manhattan with f line(subway) and a ferry trip which arrives near dumbo erea was so cool. marcia has good manners and beautiful attitudes. she did her best as a host during our stay. the walk in closet of the room was very comfortable. we would come back here again.
great place to stay if you're planning to really explore the city. a good bed to come home to after a long day.

the airbnb was very clean, comfortable and we felt very safe, it was only a couple of blocks walk to the bust stop that took us straight to the subway. the hosts weee very accommodating and made sure we were comfortable and didn’t need anything, they answered all of our questions and were available at all times. we had a great experience!!!! thank you so much for making our vacation a memorable one!
perfect location to get around in the city! wonderfully pretty apartment with everything needed for a stay highly recommend 👌🏽

shireen was a lovely host and we had the privilege of being her first guests. the place was spotless, and beautifully designed and there were so many lovely thoughtful details like snacks and drinks available that was just a lovely touch. we will definitely stay again.

i enjoyed my stay at inna’s place. the apartment will make you feel right at home. everything was well organized and clean. it’s located near multiple train lines which made it easy to commute. inna was very sweet and provided great communication. the apartment’s ambiance and the view were so beautiful— i see myself staying here again.

paul space is magical. i slept for 12 hours in the comfy bed- that never happens! i am so glad i had a chance to chat with paul during my stay. he was very generous, kind and interesting. i hope to stay at his place in the future!
very accurate description, convenient and very close to the train!

what a little gem in brooklyn. this was my first visit to the nyc area, and this cozy abode made it feel like home while on vacation. the space itself was extremely clean, chic, comfortable, and very quiet. the amenities available were as-promised and attends useful during our stay. the temperature controls were easy to figure out, and the in-suite washer and dryer made it easy for me and my companion to keep ourselves neat and tidy. with markets nearby, it was easy to keep ourselves fed when we weren’t out and about. it was also an easy two-block walk from the subway, so that travel to the other boroughs was a snap! to top it all off, jamila and ms. debbie were responsive and so helpful. i cannot recommend this place enough. you will not be disappointed!
if you want a top of the line stay in brooklyn make sure you come to step
beautiful, artistic and spacious place. a gem in the east village!
beth's place was great. really cozy and easy to get to. close to all the best of the area. beth was very accommodating and communicative.
beautiful space in a lovely neighborhood. emily was very helpful throughout our stay.

this is a great place! very clean and quiet. evan was accommodating for our early check in and responds to messages very quickly. we would recommend this place to all our family and friends. definitely booking this place again the next time we visit nyc!

the apartment is just perfect for a couple. its location couldn’t be better, away from nyc craziness and still a few subway stops to major attractions. the place is quite big for a new york apartment, it’s on a basement but still have an outside are for fresh air, some people said it was a storage unit, it’s not true, it’s a real apartment without a stove, but who wants to cook in nyc, talking about food, so many good restaurants near by. if it’s vacant on my next trip to new york i will stay there again... thank you leo!

great olde-worldy place to stay. i stayed here for a month and worked from home during that time. the amenities (linens, paper towels, tp, soap, cleaning supplies) are limited, but the space itself is as advertised. internet connection was spotty during working hours, but anyone with a hotspot or a mifi could manage. great option in a neighborhood with limited short term options.

alberto was very communicative. place is just a few blocks from red, green, yellow and brown lines in metro. so it's pretty easy to move around manhattan or bk. i wish there was less noise in the apartment to be able to sleep, but if you bring earplugs you will be completely fine! there is nice restaurants and bars around, as well as pharmacy, food market (whole foods), 24 hrs stores for food and deli, as well as a few clothing stores! walkable distance to wall street, 9/11 memorial and soho if you like to walk :) i would recommend for a big group ! and would definitely stay again!
sayra’s place is a great place to stay in park slope
we had a very nice stay in antonio's lovely appartment. everything perfectly ok !

jason was a wonderful host and the place is great, spacious and clean, with a really interesting and friendly vibe. cool welcoming area and lots of local charm and flavour. would come back and totally recommend. right near subway but pretty quiet and calm.
the unit looked just like the pictures, the host was responsive, and it was a good alternative for a small family that needs a more beds than any midtown hotel.
great value for money! especially appreciated the free breakfast :) only issue was that the elevator went out at one point and i was on the 19th floor so it was a bit of an inconvenience

we loved staying at craig's place : the room is bright, wide, tastefully decorated and perfectly clean. the flat is close to the metro, and many hotspots of the dumbo district. craig is a great host, helpful and accommodating. we definitely encourage you to stay here!

anna’s place was exactly what we were looking for! it was nicely decorated, very clean and cozy. we would highly recommend staying here and will definitely stay here again while visiting relatives in staten island.
great place in a great location! jennifer has always been a great host!

only good things to say about this hotel. the staff was excellent, checked us in at 2 am because our flight was delayed and even helped us set up our sofa bed. the location is perfect and the space is beautiful. complementary rooftop yoga and pilates classes were a huge bonus. loved the complementary coffee and comfortable lounge spaces in the lobby area. would highly recommend and stay again.

kimberly was super friendly and helped accommodate us before our check in time. she gave us a list of great places to check out around the neighborhood. highly recommended this place because of location, central to everything.

from beginning to end this trip was spectacular. the unit was immaculate from the entrance to the back rooms. every area was nicely put together for our comfort and we felt right at home! pictures are exactly how the space is presented, plus some. we weren’t anticipating all the stairs to the property which was a little hectic with the stroller carseat and luggage & parking was a bit of a hassle but that was the least, we also went thanksgiving week for the streets were busy and …its nyc! . everything else from the comfort of the unit to all the extras (a bottle of wine, snacks for the children, pantry and bathroom items). this is definitely one of the best properties ever visited and we will be back again for sure. the only thing i would suggest is having the shower head changed to one with a hose to make for easier bathing for children as well as the water pressure in the bathroom was very low and could be corrected. otherwise, 100 out of 10 ! thank you naana and chenits!!

this is a very fine short term furnished rental with everything you need anticipated, and should it not be izi and elio are eager to provide. beautiful building, great uws location, meticulously maintained. very comfortable apartment hosted by super friendly and helpful people.
chris’s place is very close to subway that takes you directly to the manhattan. everything was great, chris is very friendly and helpful. would definitely recommend!

the place was lovely and, clean and comfortable, you have to climb couple sets of stairs but it's worth it, because the patio was a real plus. location is great and middle of brooklyn, which makes it great to commute from almost every where in brooklyn and manhattan, lots of local stores and restaurants, beautiful neighborhood if you're into exploring the area. serenity was very communicative and helped us get in on time. definitely recommend it for staying.
incredibly bright space and thoughtfully supplied. my mom and i loved looking out on the peach trees. i would spend time here again in a heartbeat.
daniel was extremely communicative and worked with me when i had to cancel my trip last minute. even though i was unable to go and stay at the airbnb he was a great host who i would recommend.

for my first try with air bnb this place did not disappoint. close to plenty of bus routes. a few shops, nail salon and bodega. uber and left had no problem finding the place. because most of the houses look the same i had to take a picture of the cross street but still easy to find.
very kind and helpful host! the place was super convenient as we were visiting family in the area. thanks for a pleasant stay!

the place was very comfortable and clean. short distance from the subway. we walked back from the subway at late hours of the night and felt safe. communication with the host was open and checked in regularly during our stay, which we appreciated.
all i can say is i will definitely be booking again!! i really enjoyed every minute of this stay. 10/10 i recommend everyone to stay here.
great, convenient stay! rooms are comfortable. check in was very easy
it is simple and nice, perfect for staying a few nights.

our stay at ruben’s was exactly what we expected. we loved how close the location was to what we wanted to do in the city, and it had everything we needed. ruben was very nice and accommodating. we wish we had more time to spend getting to know him because he seemed like a very interesting person, but we were so busy exploring new york each day. i would recommend ruben’s place to someone looking for a simple and affordable place to stay with easy access to getting around nyc.
i've been a guest in this space 3 years in a row. host handled any unexpected snafus with grace as usual.
clean room with private restroom - clean. 24 hour check in. fantastic mid town location. will store your bags for a fee. desk help very helpful. host very responsive.

my stay at sara’s place was great! the apartment matched the description perfectly - clean, comfortable, and well-located. sara was very responsive and made everything easy. would definitely recommend!

michal's apartment was just perfect for us, a haven from the heat and chaos of nyc! great food right on the doorstep and well positioned for a trip to visit nyc to avoid spending all your time travelling!

victoria was really welcoming and kind! she had suggestions ready and was flexible with my check-in time (my flight was delayed by 1.5hrs). i have to add, i felt really safe as a solo female traveler.
really nice flat, near subway station, about 40 minutes from manhattan.
we loved your place! the space feels light and airy and is in the perfect location. we also loved the terrace. thanks so much!
i had a great stay at this home. the location is amazing and the bed is extremely comfortable!
had a wonderful experience in williamsburg. neto’s place was perfectly located and we felt right at home. thank you!
jane was great to work with. the room was clean and spacious. definitely would recommend.
a convenient, well appointed, extremely clean, comfortable ues rental space. andrew went out of his way to be sure that we were well settled in.
great room with stunning views of the city!
i recommend this place! sara was available for my questions and the place was in a safe neighborhood and close to subway. very comfortable bed!
great stay! exactly as pictured and was great for my boyfriend and i. there is a subway station pretty close by which made getting around easy. thank you so much koichi!
i had a great stay here. the apartment is perfect, exactly as advertised. really well appointed kitchen and a great market walking distance. and the park is close, if it's a nice sunny day.
pipi's place was great! excellent communication, great location. would definitely stay again.

i could not believe how quiet it was once inside the unit, you could barely hear any street/city noise outside. it was cozy and comfortable. very convenient to the subway, unit matches the description.
very communicative, great local suggestions and the place is a great size. comfortable beds and everything else you need.

ruwaydah is a great host. she made our stay memorable. this was our first time using airbnb, and i must say i couldn't have found a better host than ruwaydah. the house was clean, and she had all the necessary stuff that we needed. she had fruits ready for us when we got to her house, which was very thoughtful. thank you, ruwaydah, for such great hospitality!
easy to find. clean, bed very comfortable. everything worked well except tv which is complex and it was hard to find what i wanted. however, we did not want to watch much tv anyway.

do not stay here. very dirty. our first room the ac did not work properly, the sink was full of cloudy water and would not drain. maintenance came and changed the air filter which was disgusting, it looked like it hadn’t been changed in over a year, and ac still did not work. we moved to a new room and it was just as dirty but had a fishy odor, there were stains all over the carpet, toilet and bedding, hair on the toilet seat and in the bathtub, dust everywhere, dirty walls/ light switches, handprints everywhere. both rooms looked like all they did between guests was vacuum and change the sheets. when mentioning this they never apologized just changed our room. we will never stay here again.

natalia's studio was better than advertised. located in the heart of the financial district and extremely convenient subway station across the street. very friendly and attentive doormen available at all times. quiet and safe in comparison to other areas. laundry room and gym were as advertised and always seemed to be un-used. the studio itself was clean and organized, and felt very cozy. would highly recommend.
we’ve stayed in both of viki’s apts and had wonderful stays. she is an attentive and helpful host! great location and cozy apartment. thanks again for a great stay

the staff was very friendly and allowed us to check in earlier than the time stated on the website. the hotel is very clean, offers complimentary water and snacks, has a beautiful view, and the rooms are extremely comfortable. definitely an excellent experience!
sheila was everything you could ask for in a host and more!. from helping find food delivery. and being available ! my go to place to stay again in new york!

i stayed with ester for two months and it was a wonderful experience. she was very nice and friendly. she gave me many local recommendations and often shared the food that she cooked, which was really nice. the place is at a very good location and easily accessible via subway and bus. the neighborhood feels very homely and well-mentained. the place has a good value for money because of the location and other amenities.

very wonderful host and super clean and beautiful home. she was extremely helpful with all the concerns and questions i had. it was one of the best experiences, especially traveling to a new area like new york. would recommend to anyone traveling in this area.
great space! emmanuel was super nice and responsive. ample street parking. close to local shops and restaurants. close to the highway.

the hotel and location were great-- lots to do nearby, cool area, cafe with free coffee and croissants. the room was nice but small for two people. hotel staff were friendly as well. would definitely stay again!

when you meet tyler you don't meet a host but you meet a friend! tyler is a very good guy who makes you feel at home. the room is quite big and the bed is comfortable. the location is fantastic! we will be back for sure!
the location was amazing, perfect to walk to the theater.
loved staying at this quiet neighborhood. the owner was very responsive. would stay here again.
the stay was more then expected... from the excellent communication to the valentines decorations❣️ anyone thinking to book here, i recommend it... you definitely won’t be disappointed 👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼

location was perfect, right in the middle of everything. rybner was very helpful during our check in process and responded immediately to our questions. the space is highly recommended for anyone looking to explore nyc.
this is a great place really close to lirr bayside station. cozy, very clean and comfortable, it has all you need if you want to get rid of the noise of nyc, while staying close to it.
great apartment, great neighborhood!!! very good location, eric was very helpfull we arrive at ny at 1 am and he waited to hand us the keys to the apartment. we would definitely stay here again.

just returned from a fantastic family trip to ny, staying in sunshine & remo's apartment. the facilities are great, just as described. the train into manhattan takes about 20-30 mins, lots of stops but an easy journey. there's a shop nearby and restaurants about 20 mins walk away or you can get a subway to brooklyn heights or dumbo. some train and road noise which might be a problem if you are a light sleeper. all in all a great find for a reasonably priced stay in nyc.

great location right in the heart of midtown next to 32nd st & 6th ave. totally convenient to lots of subway options, tons of food places and everything you could ask for in a central location. our room was exactly as described with a sitting area, separate bedroom and bathroom with a small but very usable kitchen. be aware, if you're not used to noise at night, be prepared. this is a very busy area at all hours of the day and night. the ac was loud but no issues with making the rooms as cold as you want. the front door staff was mostly very friendly and helpful if you had issues. highly recommended for a very reasonable price for the month long stay in manhattan. thank you again.
😩 i freaking loved it the view is amazing

perfect stay in this brooklyn/willliamsburg gem! thomas is a wonderful host, very kind and always fast in the response. the appartment is very comfortable, cozy but modern, wonderful furniture. very special with the architecture and design, the roof top and brooklyn and manhattan skyline views. note you need to climb the ladder to get to your bed. the neighbourhood is just great, try out the many coffee places or shops on berry street, or the view in domino park - all in walking distance. manhattan midtown is a 15 mins subway ride. perfect location, really, if you like a just a little bit quieter in (almost) the center of nyc.
one of the best airbnbs i have stayed in - hands down! clean, spacious, bright, stylish, and all for a reasonable price considering it’s distance to the city. definitely recommend!
the area is quiet and near to amenities. i would recommend and stay here again. i really appreciate her allowing us to utilize her space

we received all the information we needed pre arrival to ensure easy access and a problem free check in. viviana was very quick to answer any questions that we had with regards to the apartment, activities and transport in ny. even though we had no personal contact with our host, we felt that any queries would be and were answered very efficiently. the apartment had all requirements to meet our needs as a family with 3 kids.
