very great home honestly , not nosey
hugo’s hospitality is exceptional! i like the quiet, cozy room and the spacious kitchen and bathroom. the area is super convenient in terms of everyday life.
nice place, lovely host. she was super enthusiastic! very helpful too. everything was clean.

great location just steps from times square and easy walking distance to the many broadway theatres and all the crazy buzz. as described a cozy small room and we had our own ensuite, comfy bed. four flights up and 62 steps, keeps you fit as no lift. thanks troy for taking our bags up and being there in the wee hours for our check in.

chantal’s place was just as described. she responded quickly and made sure we had everything we needed. my family and i enjoyed our stay in this brooklyn home not too far from the city. i would definitely recommend!
great place if you are looking to stay around the bushwick area. walking distance to multiple train stops, quiet and comfortable, and incredibly clean. definitely would stay here again.

kv's apartment is beautiful and spacious—exactly as pictured. the living area is really stunning and an incredible amount of space. we were really comfortable working from home there and the internet worked great. as kv notes in the description, it is a bit of a walk to the subway but not too bad (about 12 minutes to the jzfm on myrtle ave). there are also multiple buses within two blocks of the apartment.

amazing room in a beautiful building, everything is as described and shown in photos. room and bathroom were well furnished, neat, and clean. host and staff are friendly, helpful, and professional. location is central to nightlife, restaurants, galleries, historical sites, and near the subway. about 15-20 minute walk from central park.
would recommend this apartment, good transport links, very clean and quiet 20 minute subway ride to central manhattan, 5 stars

kumar’s place was cute, clean and in a great location. it had everything we needed. kumar was very good about giving detailed instructions for check in, wifi recommendations etc. would stay here again.
julia & her associate were very responsive and flexible before and during our stay. the place served our purposes perfectly and the location was very good.
air conditioning not as well
mercedes was great host, her family was very welcoming and the place was clean...i would definitely come here again!!!

had an amazing time at michelle’s! i had trouble with the alexa but she quickly helped with that. everything was clean and the ambiance was delightful! so grateful she was willing to host my friend and i for our first time in new york! will definitely be booking with her in the future.

a great property! clean and very well appointed. the beds are very comfortable, and the ac was a lifesaver for heat lightweights like our seattle group. the kitchen is modern, and has everything a chef needs. the host responded to questions promptly. we enjoyed our stay immensely!
very nice, even. more spacious than the pictures show. the owners/operators were very nice and attentive. would stay there again. the backyard was verrrry cool.
really great place, easy to find, a lot of stuff to do around and really close to the subway.
very great place to stay. enjoyed it very much.

the room was very clean and spacious, (including the bathroom). win was very kind upon arrival, and willing to help out with any amenities! price was very reasonable, and would definitely recommend to anyone traveling to nyc!

caio's place was perfect for our quick trip to nyc. it is as described, very clean and close to a train station. th e size is great, much larger than getting a hotel in the city. he is very responsive and helpful with any question we had. we will definitely stay here again.
great stay, would stay again! very responsive host! perfect for what we wanted.
great stuff clean room, room small little bet but i enjoyed it 👍
great place, will come back here.
lovely space. it was very clean and salma was so sweet. very close walking distance to bus stop, restaurants and bars. highly suggest.
having done the broadway hotel thing many times this made a real nice change. see where real new yorkers live and stay in a spacious well appointed apartment with great hosts. can’t recommend enough!
the stay was perfect, everything as listed! close to the l line, there’s a deli next door. pretty easy to get there. thanks darina!

great place in a great neighborhood with great hosts! the space has great vibes and smells amazing. extra points for soft sheets and the gift of wine. quick walk to the subway. we ran all over brooklyn and spent a day in manhattan, but we did most of our dining at bed-stuy neighborhood eateries, and there was no shortage of delicious options nearby. i only wish we'd stayed longer!

my wife and i have stayed at many brooklyn airbnb's in the past five years, usually in a ground floor brownstone like emmanuel's. this was, hands down, the best. all five's. and this includes the host, who is an interesting, articulate man who is eager to share ideas and what he knows - if you are interested - and also is respectful of your privacy when that is what you need. you will be living in unit that is beneath a home with an active and lively family life. both the parents and the kids are respectful of their downstairs guests, but you will know they are there by the occasional pattering of feet above you or the sounds of games being played outside. we feel that adds to the experience of living in a real community. but that is not everyone's cup of tea. for those who don't want that, there are plenty of expensive hotels available in much less desirable neighborhoods.

neanna really goes the extra mile to make the place comfortable and fully appointed. the kitchen and bathroom had everything we needed (and more), comfortable bedroom and living room, good work space and backyard. you definitely hear the neighborhood noise - especially if it’s hot and you have the windows open - but that usually comes with the territory if you want to be close to the night life (plus she provides ear plugs if you need them). i hadn’t been back in brooklyn in years and it was fun to see how much the neighborhoods have changed and grown.

we were informed on the check-in day that the place wouldn't be ready until 5 pm and therefore had to reschedule our plans for the evening. after checking in, we noticed that the bedsheets, pillows and blankets were noticably dirty (with some hair). the place wasn't properly cleaned even though we were made to wait for the check-in. the place needs a lot of maintenance. the windows in the bedroom and the living room were sealed off using duct tape, and there was wind sneaking in thru the unsealed parts, that made the rooms cold. they provide very thin blankets, and when we asked for extra blankets, the host denied (even though the listing said they provide extra blankets).
high quality place with responsive management. loved my time and would come back!
really easy process for checking in and out, very clean area, and cute apartment :)) no complaints! i felt very comfortable inside their apartment!
great location. and the apartment is nice and spacious.
great spot. easy check-in. small room though. good as a home base for a long weekend.
everything was perfect and philip was available 24x7 to answer the phone calls whenever we needed. nice and clean house will prefer to stay again.
great location! very clean. and howard was so helpful to make sure we had everything we needed.

the location was absolutely perfect. the size of the apartment was just right. the neighborhood is quiet. you’re within walking distance to almost everything and if you’re not, it’s easy to take the a or c train straight down. was overly impressed!
we spent 3 nights at irma’s place. it was clean, comfortable and quiet. irma made sure we had everything we needed. the bed was super comfortable. we’d definitely stay there again.

if you are looking for a cool and unique place to stay, this is definitely the best! staying on roosevelt island was extremely quiet, and very peaceful! lots to do on such a small island, and the host were incredible! even though you’re sharing a bathroom with them, it doesn’t feel like it at all! the space is extremely clean, and everything is extremely tidy! i would definitely recommend this place to anyone coming to visit new york, and wanting a quiet place to stay!
best place to book.
spacious apartment very close to the subway and prospect park. the host was very responsive throughout the stay.

joey is a wonderful host and his place is just as wonderful. my daughter and i stayed for a few nights after spending the first half of our trip at a hotel. staying in a flat was the perfect way to end our trip. we had easy access to the park, the met, and the neighborhood restaurants and coffee shops were a treat. we hope to stay again in the future.
great place, near the station and dorina is very helpful as well. would recommend it to anyone! jack

this is a wonderful little apartment. it's small, but has everything you need for a home away from home. the neighborhood is quiet and all the neighbors i came across were pleasant. there is a fenced in back yard which made my dog very happy.
the place is so cute and very clean. it gives such a welcoming, homey feel. it felt like a home. the host is also wonderful and nice. i'd highly recommend this place! would definitely book again.

we had a major hiccup upon arrival. our room wreaked of marijuana and cigarettes. it was so strong it activated a member of my party’s asthma. the front desk tried to see if there was another room to accommodate us. there was not. instead they sent up air freshener. on our checkout i expressed to julyvette guerrero the operations manger my displeasure with the accommodation. she is a true “fred factor” of hospitality. her outstanding customer service, personal touch and immediate action was exceptional. she took care of us for breakfast, was extremely apologetic and offered us a discount on a future stay. whether i choose to stay there again or not, i will never forget how valued julyvette guerrero made me feel today! she rocks on every level!

i loved staying at hotel 17. the location is fantastic, clean room, and bathroom. close to many restaurants and the subway. l train is around the corner and union square is close by. wifi is free but not always working. i would definitely go back to hotel 17!
wonderful place. check in couldn’t be easier. great location. daughter and i stayed 4 days and it was perfect
another great stay. thanks!
beautiful room, easy public transit access. yeun-ah is extremely kind and helpful.

my booking was a last minute booking for one night due to an unexpected itinerary change. louann was very responsive and provided me with clear instructions. the place is a great value and convenient! everything was good!
amazing place and host!

their home is in a charming residential neighborhood, people in the area were very helpful in steering me the correct way (i came by public transportation), the apartment was as advertised and well kept. plus i had fun dining at a local restaurant en route, over all, a good experience.

zandy's apartment is delightful: clean, well laid out for living and wfh, lots of light and well connected to public transportation. zandy has all the qualities of a great host: welcoming, responsive, accommodating.
great spot, great room. very utilitarian and simple

pick this place, you'll not regret it. gary was such a great host, i stayed here for 10 days, and i feel like living at home, the room was clean and comfortable, the location is just great, close to most public transportation. you can expect to have a highly privacy here, almost like it's your own place.

studio is in a super old building (think 1890s?) with very high ceilings. definitely showing its age, but also the charm. old pull lights and radiator heating! it was extremely clean!! first floor, easy to get in and wide enough stairs to carry luggage up. host met us and let us in --- super nice, and welcoming. flexible with check-in and check-out timing. building in a very accessible area and we felt safe the whole time. also a very quiet building despite having a few neighbors --- you will hear the train run but its not obtrusive. normal amenities inside --- soap, paper towels, some spices, shower/shampoo, etc. full fridge, microwave, etc. enough mix of dishes, glassware, etc that you might need. stayed with 3 people (2 = couple) and the beds were divided by a high bookcase, which made us laugh --- not a lot of privacy in a studio but still a super fun space for a close group. bathroom was decent size (though no fan), lotta hot water and good water pressure in the shower. plenty of towels. definitely had a great stay --- had all the good les vibes!

i had such a lovely stay at evelyn’s place in greenpoint. i stayed for ~2 weeks while in nyc for work, and it was a wonderful place to call home for a little while! the apartment is quite spacious, cozy and clean. evelyn set me up with everything i needed and was very responsive whenever i had any questions. i would highly recommend the apartment for anyone looking to spend some time in nyc!
alexandra and david are great hosts and their place is amazing!

i really liked this place and baydaa is a very sweet and kind person. the service is fast and accurate. the breakfast was plentiful and i had a lot of choices. you will receive assistance at any time of the day. the place is well connected for those who need to move around brooklyn. i highly recommend it.

this room is in a great location-a few blocks from the subway to take you anywhere in nyc. yuval is a prompt communicator, even though he was out of the country while we stayed in the apartment. he quickly helped us with key and hot water problems and even gave us some breakfast recommendations. our room was small, but doable for two of us and the bed was comfortable. we shared the apartment with yuval's other housemates and only saw two of them in fleeting, so sharing their bathroom wasn't a problem. this place is a good value for a visit to nyc.
2nd time staying here they are great as always
will highly recommend this place is amazing a place away from home.
had a great stay

it was kinda confusing in the beginning lol because the pictures was mixed up on how to get into the room. but was my little slow self actually payed attention. and got in the room everything was great except 1 other thing. please check the heater because i felt like it never came on but all in all i would come back
great place to stay. excellent location and the staff is very kind, but the breakfast is very crowded and most of the time you can't take what you want.

absolutely loved jennifer’s place. it was perfect for us while visiting our daughter. wonderful shower and super comfortable bed. lots of local coffee shops to choose from (poppy’s) and enjoyed drinks with the family at the congress. we will definitely be back!
perfect location for exploring new york. the subway station is just a short walk from the apartment, and you can reach union square in about 20 minutes
the flat is really nice, warmly and very clean. it is also well located near subway g which goes through brooklyn.

this place was perfect! we were in town moving our son into his first apartment just a couple blocks away. i stressed beforehand about the parking (because there had just been a huge snowstorm) but it was easy. yay! this place was comfortable just like home. great spot and great owners. we followed their recommendations for food places and had great pizza delivered in. really enjoyed our stay. great for our family!
huge space and great location! close to the train, and so many interesting restaurants, eateries, and shops in walking distance.
will stay again

nice quiet space in nice neighborhood. close to subway. lots of local flavor nearby. host is very friendly, accessible, and was very interested in making sure we had everything we needed. will certainly rebook with him in future if possible. main bedroom was a king sized bed, and i believe second was a queen.
great large bathroom and extra quiet . great stay :)
attentive host, close to subway!
eva is a stellar host! very communicative and does her best to make guests feel welcome and at home. she was extremely accommodating of special requests for our stay and went above and beyond.

within 45 minutes of being in our room, someone (not with us) used a key to enter. we notified the front desk and all they said was "sorry about that". we chalked it up to being near check-in and left to go out to our event for the night. we arrived back around 10:40pm to 3inches of water in the tub and the shower faucet leaking. (we did not use anything before leaving) i checked our luggage - the jewelry in my container had been rearranged. i called the front desk they said they would send an engineer to look at the tub/shower. i asked for a different room because clearly someone had been in there while we were gone and was told they were sold out but would move us the next day. after 1 hour of waiting i went down to the front desk, the engineer returned to the room, pulled the tub plug and said "you're good. i'll look at the leak tomorrow." he never came back. the front desk never moved us and avoided our future contacts. we slept with a chair against the handle of the door.
the room is great! easy to find, clean, great deal. shanti's super friendly and communicative. great stay!

anna’s place is comfortable and bright (with night shades, of course). i had everything i could have possibly needed. though i never made coffee, or anything to eat ~ i could have. there are so many food and coffee options in the neighborhood however, there was no point. (if you’d love a fresh, flavorful take on doughnuts… try fan fan)! i enjoyed the shower and perfectly hot water. each night, i slept beautifully. the bed was huge with 4 pillows, varying in degrees of softness. (in other words, something for everyone). each morning i awoke fully rested. there’s a wonderful garden out back, which i didn’t use because it never stopped raining. regardless, i loved my experience. i wanted to feel what it felt like to live there. the outer world of nyc may be huge, but inside i felt cocooned. if you travel by car and are concerned about street parking, i found a space every time. just make sure to read the street signs carefully. many thanks to anna, who communicated kindly and made sure i had everything!

jamal was very responsive and the place was beautiful. the bed was more comfortable than most hotel rooms. i must say that the lock to the apartment did not work and had to be replaced during our stay. although it was fixed the next day, leaving an apartment unlocked in new york is not ideal. we appreciated the efforts and responsiveness by jamal but it was still an issue we had to address. if you want to use the subway to get around. it is about a 10 minute walk and at night did not feel safe and so we used uber which was an added expense. all in all it was a good experience and jamal was a wonderful host.
ivan was communicative and friendly! would recommend staying here!

words don’t do justice to how great chef and his place are there’s a reason he’s the highest rated host in nyc everything was great and he’s a highly rated chef that cooks for for you as well honestly everyone should start with him he’s a gentleman and overall great human being and the place is so good even had a rooftop relaxation area with a great view of the city
the stay at patrica's apartment was pleasant, the subway station and shops are very close. it is definitely a good option to stay and visit new york ☺️ i would stay there again

the garden apartment was perfect for our stay in brooklyn! it is on a beautiful tree-lined quiet street and was easy to find. amy provided all of the pertinent information for our arrival and even offered to help us with restaurant suggestions or other travel questions. a great host! we found the apartment to be very neat and clean, ready for us to have a great night's sleep after being at our trade show all day. kitchen items were available if needed, even basic cooking items that would have made cooking a meal easy. the neighborhood is fantastic. walking distance to plenty of restaurants, drug store, you name it. i wish i could have enjoyed it more!
carlos was a really nice host! we enjoyed our stay!

very cozy studio, ca. 45 minutes from manhattan. olenka is very friendly, also we could keep our suitcases in the studio till our afternoon flight. only one little think - the queensize bed is a bit squeaky (noisy).
great place! great location and very clean

we had a great stay at sara’s place. the bedrooms and bathrooms were clean and accommodating. also, the ability to reserve a parking spot was extra nice as we were in town with a large tour van. the hosts were communicative and friendly.
great location right in times square. easy to access, lots of elevators, close to tons! older place but still nice and worth the money.
a truly beautiful apartment, area is nice and quiet, i have absolutely no complaints about my stay here! will definitely be booking again!

our stay was very nice and anna was very responsive. the unit is very clean and has plenty of room. it was a great location to walk to the beach and surf. the new boardwalk is very nice on rockaway beach. there is a dunkin donuts a block or so away.
victor was very responsive to any issues.

very well-located place, everything worked out perfectly and we got exactly what we expected. the included breakfast is a very convenient extra. we would recommend staying here if you want to reach important sightseeing spots quickly
great location to lga.
great location in williamsburg. yoo mi is very discreet when sharing her place

location is super convenient as it has all train stations around, or to a short walk. place is very spacious & has all amenities needed! including a washing machine! cynthia & charlie are super attentive & responsive to anything you may need assistance with. would 100% come back!

william and angela are awesome hosts. william was very quick to respond to all our queries. parking is very difficult and expensive affair in ny so we were planning to book a spot thru spot hero even before reaching our destination but william gave us an awesome tip to reach during office hours and we found a spot just in front of door and parked our car for free all 3 days. this saved us both money and time. angela even walked to the condo when we reached ny to help us open the apartment and welcome us which was very touching. william also checked with us to ensure we were comfortable. the condo is sparkling clean with all modern amenities. they have also arranged extra beds, toys for kids, books, movies and enough storage space for everybody to arrange luggage. they have made apt use of available space. we completely enjoyed our stay at the house and would highly recommend angela and william’s place for an awesome ny experience.

i've been there with my girlfriend and all that i can say is: very good experience, we felt like right at home. the apartment was an excellent starting point for us for discovering manhattan and it's definitely something i could get used to: the piano, the kitchen, the bathroom, the washing machine etc. were all good and very usable. we had practically no issues during our stay. (the only minor issue was with the internet connection, which is probably verizon's fault anyway and we got a backup solution very quickly.) we really appreciated that our caretaker was always available for answering our questions. i can't compare it with other places (this was my first time in nyc), but it's a fairly calm place and it satisfied our needs pretty well, so i can totally recommend it.
great communication and instructions. easy access and the apartment was great for three fishermen on the way to canada. we enjoyed our stay with no problems and would happily stay there again.

gracious host and hostess. room was large, clean and comfortable on the second floor. . nice kitchen area connected to our room. our bathroom was down the hall a short distance. area felt safe and was close to grocery stores and restaurants. host lived downstairs and was available for any help that you needed. it was a bargain for the price. we look forward to going back.
the place has so much character. it’s beautiful. i would stay here again in a heartbeat. it felt like a very authentic nyc experience.

i really enjoyed my stay at patricia and cherisee 's home. they are quick to respond and were very hospitable towards me. excellent hosts! house was clean and decorated nicely. the fresh flowers in my room was a pleasant surprise. location is great, just under 10 minutes walk from the subway. direct train (n or d) to manhattan. wish that i could have spent more days in their home. i highly recommend this place. excellent value for money. thank you very much!
great apartment location! super quiet bedroom/apartment for nyc! host was great and understanding. everything you need.
she responded quickly and efficiently to make sure we had every comfort. she has a beautiful home in a nice neighborhood. thank you yande
comfortable, clean space near the subway. terrific value for brooklyn.

better than expected! the location was perfect for me, being near the subway and the places i wanted to visit. the airbnb was clean and well taken care of and larger than i expected. the communication before hand and the entry instructions were clear and concise. i’d definitely stay here again.

we had an excellent stay at this spacious apartment in a upcoming area. it is near the l subway which is a good connection to manhattan. i would recommend the well, which is in the same street, for a brooklyn brewery beer.

loved this place! it has everything you need. the check in process was seem less. you go to the kiosk and enter your information and get your card yourself. i love that process especially during covid. beautiful view and an amazing one night stay in the city. will be staying here again.
excellent place to stay.
thank you, conrad! lovely host, very patient and kind! i highly recommend staying at his place to anyone!
will decline to review publicly. i hope the owner will make improvements on her own and heed my suggestions.
great place! close to subway, would recommend!
great location and price. nice accommodation.

we were so pleased with our stay at placemakr and will definitely come back to stay in the future! very walkable area, amazing and friendly staff, and very clean property! i also think it’s a really nice touch that onsite laundry is free for residents. i really enjoyed our stay and the studio+ suite was super cute and clean. thanks again to china and the staffing crew!

we really liked our stay in general. the communication was rapid and clear. the room was nice and tidy when we moved in, however the closet looked kinda messy. moreover, one could tell the kitchen was being used by others. having the communal spaces a bit more cleaned would have improved our stay. nevertheless, we enjoyed our stay at nadia’s place.

wonderful location in a trendy neighborhood. we felt safe at all times. awesome restaurants all within walking distance and the subway lines are close. consider: this place has dim lighting all throughout apt. which drove me nuts not getting light, esp. in the bathroom, no toaster, no coffee machine/kettle, no hairdryer. my fault for not looking before renting. the pictures are accurate except now there's clutter and it's dirty. a rolled up old rug, old pictures on floor, unopened boxes of items, weeds everywhere in the planters outside (we never used the outside as it's just not cozy spot like it appears) dirty old bamboo wall, dirty outside furniture, the bathroom floor rug was so wet that i hung it outside for two days to dry out. there were long hairs and dusty floors. sticky fridge handle too. shervin mentions "cleaners", but i wonder if he ever self inspects? we made it work. someone lives here full time and just leaves when you rent. if you're ok with that, this might be ok.
great place in nyc, definitely worth the price
great location, lovely rooftop area, everything we needed.

that was my first airbnb experience and a very good one. me and my friend had a very good stay at victoria's appartment. the flat is small but really cute, clean, perfect for 1 or a couple. victoria was super helpful with giving us all the information about the city that no guide book provides. she is very flexible about check in / out hours. highly reccomend also due to perfect, safe location.
great place!
great place
wonderfull apartment, clean, beautiful, good prised
we enjoyed our stay once again. the place was clean and comfortable, and the host was accommodating. happy to have returned and would recommend.

jiang and her parents are all great hosts. we felt at home and were well accomondated throughout our stay. the room was kept clean and the shared common areas are as well. definitely would recommend to friends!
the apartment was clean, cozy, and convenient. about a 10 min walk to central park and time square. pretty quiet area at night (especially sunday-thursday). we loved it!

alexandra and her space were excellent. as a host, alexandra is communicative and accurate. as an apartment, the listing is accurate and then some! when i read the listing, i thought, “it seems nice. i hope it lives up to the listing.” it so does, people! it is a clean, stylish, calm and loving place, and walkable to a couple of great restaurants and bars. it is also a great space to call ride share and get virtually anywhere in ny. rent this place. you might have to walk up a few stairs, but it is worth it.
fantastic apartment with a real wow factor! fantastic location, lots of restaurants shops and galleries nearby. subway really close. loved it!

we had a wonderful stay at this 3-bedroom apartment! the place was very clean and well-maintained. the space was comfortable and perfect for our group, with plenty of room for everyone. the location was also super convenient - close to transportation, which made getting around the city easy. communication was smooth, and the overall experience was great. would definitely stay here again!

maxime truly went above and beyond in his hosting. kind, helpful, approachable, easily reached, and a great human being to boot! my partner and i would definitely stay at maxime's again-- he and his place are truly an airbnb gem! :d
marc's place is a perfect little les homebase, so close to amazing bars and restaurants but still on a quiet block. i would definitely stay there again.
great place, helpful host,safe neighborhood.
lovely home and convenient to subway. joslin was very communicative and responsive for our few needs!

we had a great stay. apartment was everything we had hoped for: clean, spacious, good connection to city, cosy, etc. joann was very welcoming and always easy to reach and very responsive. would definitely stay here again and also recommend to friends.

the host never sent check in instructions. did not respond to questions in days leading up to check in. and when we arrived at the house it was locked and we and airbnb rep didn’t get any response from the host. so we found ourselves looking for new accommodations at 7:30 at night when we have a 1 year old baby who needed to get to bed. total nightmare.
we loved our stay here. the place is nice and clean. everything was just as described. the host will was quick to respond. all in all it was great!
this place was even better than expected. so clean and welcoming!

ronan’s place was great! everything was exactly as described and pictured, there was tons of storage, and it’s only a few blocks from the train. the street is quiet enough that you don’t hear much noise, despite it being a garden apartment. ronan and his family were quiet upstairs neighbors and super accommodating in letting us check in super early. lots of great food/coffee options nearby as well. i’ve been to nyc probably 25+ times over the last decade and this is my favorite apartment i’ve stayed in. definitely recommend!
simple and easy. check in and check out went super smoothly and i felt safe and secure the whole time. more than content with my first airbnb experience
cute, clean and cozy space with very nice host. would stay here on my next visit. thanks again :)
great location. enjoyed my stay a lot.
the apartment was completely as presented if not better. would love to stay on our next visit. wonderful hosts with a beautiful place to relax and enjoy!

this is a great spot for a couple months stay. deborah is wonderful and very knowledgeable about the area, and fixed any issues promptly. the location is fantastic, just a 10-15min walk to east village, the best place in nyc for a foodie. we had an amazing time trying all the restaurants. the only minor complaint is the apartment is slightly too far from north-south subways (14min walk). the area is safe, nice, and quiet most times. that said, during our stay in late 2024, there is major construction happening on the other side of the street, a bit annoying daytime weekdays. the apartment itself is not particularly amazing but fairly standard for manhattan. the bedrooms barely fit a queen bed, the living room and kitchen countertops are tiny, and the building is old. that said, everything is well-maintained and clean, and the skylights are quite nice. cleaners come biweekly and are thorough & professional. overall we had a great time and would happily stay here again.

i stayed here for 2 months. location: i worked in manhattan, so i would take the 7 express from woodside-61st daily (~5 minute walk to the station + 20-30 minutes to get to grand central). this location was convenient for my needs. the area had lots of families and people walking around during the day/evening. the building and individual apartment was secure to enter with a pin pad lock. space: the shared space was clean and easy to use. each of the cabinets in the bathroom/kitchen and refrigerator had marked shelves for each unit to use, which minimized any crowding or fight for space. the space was cleaned 1-2 times a week, so i only had to worry about keeping my own unit's trash and room clean. the space in the room was large by ny standards. roommates: i was fortunate to have roommates that were clean and amicable. feedback: i could not keep a hand/body towel in the bathroom, so i would have to take it in and out every time i used the bathroom. this was to preserve cleanliness with the shared roommate, but it was slightly inconvenient. otherwise, i had a great experience!
ibrahim was very nice and helpful! the room was spacious, clean, and smelled really nice! i would definitely book with him again!!
the property manager was very helpful and quick to respond. great location and value. would highly recommend!

brooke and marie were great people to meet. their house it’s so beautiful and clean. if i get to came back to new york i will definitely came back to them since it’s such a great, clean, cozy place to stay.

the cottage is a nice stay away from home. kathleen made us feel very welcome. if you are looking for a place outside the big city, this is the one! there is a lot to do in staten island and there are many options to get to brooklyn or manhattan. (bus, train and (free!) ferry). bonus: the bananabread is yummy!
beautiful place!
very easy check-in and check-out. comfortable bed with great blackout curtains.

there were no sheets at all for either the bed or the foldout couch. there were not enough blankets. the heater fed only into the living room so we cooked there and froze in the bedroom.there was no backup paper towel nor coffee or filters or tea or sugar. i consider those very basic amenities. the place is very recently renovated so very clean but missing thoughtful pieces like a bedside table for the foldout bed. it was clean and nice, just not really ready for guests. second-floor inhabitants sounded like galloping horses. still nice place and i didn't hate it. just needs more thought.
loved the location of the place!!!
my husband and i love the hospitality. margaret gave us a lot of attention. the apartment is very clean and comfortable and the location is great. we love margaret's apartment.
great host. jonathan’s place is clean, cozy and in a good location. jonathan also offered me lots of useful tips on what to see and where to go in nyc. i highly recommend this host.
space was very clean, loved that christiana checked with me numerous times
brad place is what you see in the photo. clean and convenient

awesome location! super safe and nice neighborhood. very close to katz and a lot of great cafes. also close to the best vintage / thrift stores in nyc. will definitely be staying here again on my next trip to ny.
we had a great family vacation, we are a family of 5 and had plenty of room. the ability to get out and walk was great, easy to get to sites and plenty of great restaurants inside a block.

to the future folks who are looking at possibly staying with sarah and kaptan, you’re in for a real treat! these kind-hearted people are very welcoming, easy to communicate with, and hard-working people. they’ll bring you in to their home, make sure you’re all set, and will continue to make sure you’re happy the entire time there whether that’s with suggestions around the city or even peace and quiet (which is tough to find in nyc). i can promise you you’ll have a great time with great people in a great location of manhattan. go ahead and click that “book now” button.
lakshmee was a very helpful and kind host!

great stay! communication from brady was excellent and everything about the stay went very smoothly. location is good, a 5min walk to the nearest subway stop (gates) and you can take the j train straight into manhattan. neighbourhood is busy but the street itself is nice and peaceful and quiet. would defiantly recommend staying here! thanks
super close to trains and food. quiet building and beautiful apartment with lots of natural light. thank you simon!

my family and i stayed at janine’s place. the easy walk to the j station to get us to manhattan was a breeze. there were plenty of local restaurants around and the community is quiet at night. the host was very proactive on reaching out if anything was needed. i especially loved that they let us leave our pets for a brief while we explored the city. highly recommend this host and their place.

great, spacious, bright and well decorated apartment. situated nearby delicious restaurants in harlem, and just a quick 20mn subway ride, this was perfect for our family stay in nyc. the 2 bedrooms are large, clean, with comfortable beds: ideal for a family or friend trip. kareem is very quick to respond and everything went smoothly during our stay.

great little place! i needed to drop my husband off at jfk very early for a flight, and a friend & i were going to spend the day of it in nyc - this was perfect. two rooms, were just enough for us, and for my friend. ten mins to jfk, and a train ride away from manhattan. the place was spotless, the towels were plush and soft. it was very quiet, and my friend and i walked to the train station within 5 minutes. we would definitely stay again!

heather was an amazing host! she allowed us to drop our bags early and was very easy to talk too. she truly has thought of everything you need. the space for a ny apt was amazing. love the international vibe. short walk to the subway, lots of great restaurants within a 5 min walk. highly recommend.
silva is definitely a super host! we are very grateful for her kind and great attention! congratulation, the place and the service are excellent!
awesome place! definitely going to come back!
even though we didn't meet jason he was always available for any questions we had and did answer promptly logistically the apartment was ideal and the neighborhood was fine
overall, i'm satisfied with the stay. michael was very responsive to any of my needs and the place is well kept
a phenomenal host that you cannot be disappointed with. all the reviews on him are accurate.
an amazing place to stay with everything you could need. everything was well communicated. thank you so much for the great stay!

james is an excellent host. our train was late so he arranged an easy key pick-up, fabulous breakfast items to help us get up and out early, and he was always available to answer questions throughout the weekend. the location is ideal - a 5 minute walk from penn station. the flat itself is super clean and tidy with just the right amount of space for the two of us. i would totally recommend this flat for great weekend get-away in manhattan.

i actually did not meet patricia, cherrise handled the arrangements and is a friendly, beautiful soul, very gracious and accommodating, this situation worked very well for me on this trip and i would not hesitate to ask for it again. i loved the cats

our stay was great! esteban and his family are great hosts, will definitly stay with them for any future trips to queens!
edelmira and luis were lovely, friendly and made sure i had everything i needed. the place is homey and i am very happy with my stay.

definitely one of the best airbnb's i've stayed at. great price, location and dan's great. quick communication and helped us out when our flight was late in the evening by allowing us keep our bags there until it was time to pick them up for the flight. would definitely recommend.
good attention! nice stay
super adorable space! great location, easy access to the metro and bus. my husband and i would stay here again in the future.
evan is very sweet and such a wonderful location!

the previous communication with jenni was very fluid. the apartment is newly remodeled, very comfortable, with all the necessary elements in the kitchen and in perfect conditions of cleanliness. the neighborhood is very peaceful and close to all kinds of shops and restaurants, both in smith and in court st. a special comment for the backyard: we enjoyed it a lot during day and night. we will definitely be staying here again soon and fully recommend this place.
our stay at chris‘ place was impeccable! we felt welcomed the moment we arrived, as chris was incredibly friendly, helpful and accommodating. 10/10!
great location! perfect for access to subway and restaurants around astoria!

soho blu was prefect honestly. it is kinda loud from the street but it’s nyc, what do you expect? i liked it honestly lol. gave me that new york feel. the location is great, literally close to a lot of great spots that the city has to offer including bars, nightlife, and tourist attractions. definitely will stay here again when i come back to nyc.
lovely place! bright, clean and close to everything. highly recommended.
small, but affordable and comfortable place to stay.

very centrally located with lots of room. close to the subway and easy access from jfk via the air train and the e line. definitely go to the amish grocery a few blocks away, much nicer than whole foods.
the room was great, apartment was nice and the room mates are amazing people.
really amazing and caring host and fantastic location. right by the beach!
clean place and michael was very communicative and accessible
rosa is a lovely woman and you can’t beat this location if you’re looking to stay and explore greenpoint. steps from the g and easy walks to great places!

everything was absolutely perfect here! the home is even more beautiful in person than in the pictures! magdaline was amazing at communicating, responding, and making sure we had everything we needed! will definitely be booking again for my next stay in the area!
great place in upcoming part of brooklyn. chris and wes great host
great place! easy, clean, good access, great neighborhood.

lovely stay at the loft! it is very spacious and in a great location - absolutely fell in love with the area. very walkable, safe (police patrolling the area all the time, and often just hanging out outside the building), and just a perfect taste of the east village. also, chris is an excellent host and very responsive! some things to note for future guests: - unlike other long-stay places i've stayed in the kitchen is not stocked with any pantry items like spices, oil, etc. (might be nice for longer stays to not have to stock the kitchen from scratch, and just replace items as needed). - the place is very decorated. it is exactly as pictured, but there are some areas that are not photographed and with the amount of stuff and it does feel like staying in an antique store. as an artist this was fun, quirky & inspiring. a lot of the items and art pieces are beautiful! but i do think most guests might appreciate a little less clutter. overall, definitely recommend!
this is an apartment in a great location within walking distance of many places and quick subway access to most of new york. the place is comfortable and elegant with good facilities.

a beautiful stay at james apartment, more than what i expected, the apartment is clean, modern and huge! (7 people stayed and it did not feel like we were on top of each other), lisa was fantastic with getting back to us fast with queries, neighbourhood is very safe and friendly. easy to get into manhattan and other areas, would defiantly stay here again in the future!
alexis and her home were both lovely! would recommend to anyone

great place - clean and tidy with all facilities you’d need and bedrooms large and airy. hiwotie a great host - very responsive and accommodating. pretty easy to get in and out to manhattan and jfk (by bus) (and also bus to dyker heights christmas lights!). lively neighbourhood but no issues with that.
great clean space hotel staff super friendly and nice
great spot within east village. ed was very easy to contact and made us feel welcome. overall a great stay
great space , just like pictured. i’d bring a blanket for the bedroom as there was just a sheet.
great stay. aldi was very accommodating with my arrival and departure. there is some street noise, but i slept well with earplugs.

pros: location is great. l stop into manhattan is right out the door, and getting into the city was quick. immediate area wasn’t bad, had nice restaurants and amenities. if you’re not planning on being in the airbnb a lot and just need a spot while you’re out and about, good option. hosts were responsive and quick to try to fix any issues that came up. laundry wasn’t bad - had two options (in building and across the street). cons: i stayed here for a long stay while looking for an a longterm apartment, which i’m not sure this spot is great for. bathroom was a bit small, kitchen is very light, and just generally didn’t feel very cozy all the time. it’s a downstairs unit in the basement, so window really faces a wall like a few feet away. the stairs leading down can often get littered with trash from residents in the apartment unit which got gross. mattress was off, gave me some back pains but flipping it helped. can’t really recommend for longterm stay. might be tight for two people
great location and worth every penny

roberto was a great host. very responsive when we needed help and was so kind to let us know about any possible noise. was flexible with our checkout when we ran a bit behind to gather our things to leave. the area was perfect, close to alotnof great restaurants, coffee and bars. it was far enough away from a lot of noise but close enough to see major sites and a quick bike ride into manhattan. i would definitely recommend this place to friends.

this is the second time i stayed in jaleh's apartment and i had a great time! jaleh and her lovely daughter are always very responsive and make sure you have everything you need. they are also flexible and accommodating with the check-in and check-out time. the room is clean, and the apartment has a well-equipped bathroom and kitchen. it is in a very convenient location, close to columbia university, morningside park, central park and the subway on west 116th street. i definitely recommend this room to students and young couples visiting new york city!
everything is as expected, value for money with excellent hospitality
had an amazon stay

alaric, is a super cool person with a wealth of knowledge and experience. he gave me a very interesting history of the neighborhood and he film industry and some of its pioneers. i was in town for the book of how and it was literally the perfect location. i was also able to grab some good eats and walked past the brooklyn museum although it was closed. i hope to be back soon, for the spike lee exhibit and would definitely stay with alaric and his wife. i will say, i can wait to see the garden in full bloom but it was perfect for someone who likes the gloomy look, like myself. also, there is a cat that hangs out, and is a cute little fluff ball. the bed was comfortable and i found myself not wanting to get up and head to d.c. you will enjoy your stay. thanks again !!!
comfortable beds well equipped apartment
great value!

james & siobhan provided a beautiful, clean, fully loaded stay! we stayed there for our wedding in prospect park (boathouse) and their place provided the perfect stay for the weekend. check in & check our was super simple & straight forward. right when you walked into the place you can tell they put a lot of effort and detail into the house. the kitchen was stocked with the essentials, coffee, milk, eggs etc. they even left us some local snacks, and a bottle of champagne as a wedding gift! that was a nice touch. communication was really simple & straightforward. if i sent a message, it was usually responded too in less than 5 minutes. that was helpful when i had questions during the stay. each room was clean, spacious, and comfortable. lastly, the outdoor balcony was a popular hang out spot for me and my guests. all in all, it was an amazing stay, and a part of my wedding weekend that i will never forget.
wonderful place to stay, beautiful building, cozy location close to transport, and our host and her cute pooches were very friendly. would stay again.
great staff, great location. place is as advertised.
entrance keypad needs to be replaced
this is a great spot in rockaway. it's very close to the beach, train and restaurants. marek is a great host! and the place is just lovely (with lots of nice amenities)!
i had to leave the place in a hurry on my final day, but my residence there was phenomenal. i felt comfortable and safe, and the place very easily succeeded my expectations.

is saying michael's place is where we want to stay when we return a good enough review? :) great location, with grocery, pharmacy, bars and restaurants just minutes away. when we did use ride-share, we never had to wait more than two minutes. the private garden patio at michael's is a hidden gem ... peace among the population. comfortable bed, very clean, very quiet ... 5 stars. il passatore around the corner (about 300 feet away) is a great little italian restaurant. check out sage for great thai food and great people watching.

had a very comfortable stay at jennifer’s place! it was very accessible to other parts of the city and had so many great restaurant and shopping options nearby. would definitely recommend this place and stay here again if we’ll be back in the city. thanks for accommodating us!
skip was so friendly and willing to share all that new york has available! it was a joy to stay here and i would definitely stay again!

the houseboat is clean , spacious yet cozy. the crab shack two minutes away is delicious and a find. with uber and the subway, manhattan is an hour away. under no circumstances should you take their recommended car service.

gabe is an extraordinary host, kind, thoughtful and communicative. we felt warmly welcomed by him personally and a lovely personalized message on the whiteboard. when we needed to store our luggae for a few hours he went out of his way to facilitate us. gabe's place was airy and we felt like we could breathe after coming here after being in a tiny apartment in williamsburg. the rooms are normal sized but the common area and bathroom are very spacious. what was a further delight was seeing the design and ergonomic thought that has gone into this place. a bowl filled to the brim with pens, colour coordinated dish soap and a bathroom chipboard wall with every amenity one could imagine - or didnt even know one wanted. not only do things look interesting but everything also has a function. this apartment has everything one could need. the keycode access was super convenient. was a quick walk to the subway. i would highly recommend this place to everyone!
great value. location is wonderful. plenty of room for two, the washer / dryer is a plus, and the location is great!
mckenzie's place is cozy and nice area to walk around in. it is close to a lot of establishments. we enjoyed our time staying at her place.
kindly host, cleaned room and bathroom, close to subway station, everything perfect! but it's 3rd floor, so if you have many stuff it will be little hard to go upstair.
we loved staying here. great place to stay and walk and visit soho, little italy and china town.
agnes is a great host and the location is just a few steps always from getting the subway and in just minutes your visiting iconic new york spots
amazing stay, gracious host and safe haven from the crazy nyc! clean space with all the basic amenities.. will definitely come back:)

overall, we really enjoyed our stay here & would stay here again! with that being said, we did feel like the listing description was too vague/unclear. yes— it does state that layout options for the penthouse may vary & that the terrace is open seasonally. however, we wish that we they were more specific on when the terrace space is open as this was a huge reason as to why we booked here. but, no access. 😕 when we addressed our disappointment through their text service, we were left w/ zero response. we traveled w/ a child & loved that there was a bath tub pictured. when stated that the layout may vary, we never thought that meant the bath tub amenity wouldn’t be there, simply that it was just arranged differently. overall, great location & very clean! greattt valet guys w/ even better city suggestions! area felt safe. the complimentary turndown service each night was very nice after a busy day. 2 small elevators for 30 floors led to long wait times around check-in/check-out times

the neighborhood was very nice, lot of places to eat near by, about 4 minutes from the subway station that takes you anywhere you want in nyc. the place also had a few electrical adapters which was a life savior as we forget to bring any and they were there so we were in no rush to buy any. great place over all, would recommend.
excellent experience.

our stay this time at the sweet historic greenpoint duplex was such a great experience. last time we stayed at the beautiful landmarked duplex. you cannot be disappointed. the decoration is so charming, the location just perfect to experiment the brooklyn/greenpoint lifestyle and you are just 15 min from manhattan! and maya is such a great host, very responsive and helpful. well we will need to test one of the other places during our next visit in nyc ;-).

an incredibly comfy and private suite that was a home away from home. these accommodations were a bargain for the quality. we couldn't have picked a better place. we felt right at home. the host was top notch and communication was outstanding. stay here! you won't regret it.

kaptan exemplifies what travelers hope for when they book a super host property. friendly, communicative, welcoming, and providing a clean space to call home while on the road. from fresh turkish coffee to informal chats on the patio (with social distancing respectfully followed), this host understands the importance of making visitors feel like friends. thank you and see you soon!
had a great stay in brooklyn

this place is in a great location, was beautiful and just as described. lots of food walking distance. the only trouble we had was the place was 55 when we got there, it was cold because the cleaners left the window open. the hosts were super responsive and helped us with the thermostat but it did take ~2 hours to warm up. there is a rental above as well, so keep that in mind there may be little kids running around above you. since the area is so nice, we had trouble finding street parking but eventually parked 3 blocks away. overall, the place was beautiful, we knew there wouldn’t be parking and it was exactly what we were looking for!

i stayed there for a couple of days and really likeed the localization and the cleanness of the apartment. the building is a bit old but that's part of its charm. alejandro was very responsive and helpful in every possible way, great host.
no tv in bedroom, walls are very thin so you can hear everything thats going on in the other guest rooms, the place was ok , but a bit less than what i expected
if you looking for a great place to stay this is definitely it ! it was very comfortable clean and karen the host is awesome i will definitely be returning back there
very hospitable and gracious host, highly recommended

definitely recommend staying with cat and david! not only is the location convenient to public transportation but the apartment was clean, spacious, and both cat and david are great hosts. they were prompt communicators and assisted us with all of our needs.
we had an amazing stay. they gave us clear instructions and were extremely understanding of our travel schedule. the space was exactly as described and had lots of space for the price.

great spot! from the start communication was informative and quick with response times on any and all questions involving our reservation. on arriving, len, met us right at the door. very friendly and helpful. the apartment was exceptionally clean and looked just like the photos. right on the line which makes it an easy train ride anywhere in the city. be sure to check out the little nepalese restaurant across the street! 10/10 would recommend
great place and very convenient. the hosts are extremely lovely. highly recommend staying in this beautiful spot!
great place for a few days! only complaint was some of the other guests staying there. it was a little noisy. but everything was clean and as described. would stay again.

i would love to give this place 10 stars, but 5 is the limit. the place was spotless, the bed was the most comfortable ever, and the location was perfect. gorgeous neighborhood—convenient to the subway, shops, and charming cafes. all the amenities and more. sylvia was the perfect host. can’t wait to go back!

i have to say that i have mixed feeling .. the hosts are welcoming in some sense ( there are multiple guests in the house) . but there were different issues for which i will not recommend this place: - the house is not clean and specially the bathroom they didn’t do any effort during our stay of one week to clean. - the host is always in the living room which is the kitchen in the same time which for me was limiting specially because to go to bathroom to take a shower i should pass by living room.. - we passed one week, for the weekend days the hosts was staying in the living room making rumors and music even during the night and we had 2 years old child with us which needs to sleep so we needed to tell them. - the position is far for the interesting points in nyc even if it is somehow near to bus and metro station (metro station is 15min walking ) but it takes 30 min at least with bus to even downtown brooklyn , one hour to mid manhattan. as summary : if you don’t care about how clean the house is , if you will use the room just for sleeping and you don’t care about position or rumors could be an option..

i’ve stayed in a hostel once before, and this one is nothing like what i imagined a hostel to be. the place is wonderfully cozy, warm, and has a homey feel. the location is excellent, the pods are comfortable, place is squeaky clean and the staff is amazing. on top of that, they even offer breakfast and really great coffee for guests. for the price and location, it’s unbeatable. i would definitely stay here again!
very communicative and helpful with my stay!

andrada and will’s place is a brooklyn gem . for us , it was affordable with unique , fun decor and treats to boot ! subway was only a coupla blocks away too . we were happy we discovered this delightful airbnb location .

first time visiting nyc with the family, had an absolutely amazing time! the hotel and room exceeded expectations, was so happy with everything. not a single problem or issue! check in was easy and smooth. room was just as described and great location! will not hesitate to stay here again!
jose's studio was clean, comfortable and accurate. we enjoy our time there.

the apartment is amazing, artistic and stylish and everything you need you have it. the location is omg - no additional words are needed. not my first stay in ny but definitely the best and all because evelyn has managed to ease every possible step you can think of. she is not an ordinary airbnb host you can tell.

the apartment’s location was excellent — very convenient and close to everything we needed. however, the cleanliness left a lot to be desired. surfaces were dusty, and the space didn’t feel safe or comfortable for my three small children. i ended up wiping everything down myself. we were only staying for a short time, so i didn’t reach out to jay for a deeper cleaning, but i also didn’t feel comfortable having someone enter the unit while we were out. unfortunately, we couldn’t get the tv to work either, which would have been nice to unwind after long days of walking.
i like the place and easy to move to ms
quiet place with good amenities and kind, responsive host. easy access to subway.

hi. our stay at new york was excellent. blanca´s apartment is clean, new and beautiful. it´s near the subway, bus stops, restaurants, etc. we recommmend this appartment for our friends who want to visit the big apple. thanks for everything!

bree it’s my favorite host of airbnbn so far, she was the nicest and friendly in every aspect. she have a beautiful apartment, the cats are the cutest. also she share so much with me and have a great time living with her. i absolutely stay again with her and mochi, rocky and pasita 🐈. the apartment it’s feels like home, it’s super close to the subway, it’s a safe neighborhood, and a lot of restaurants close to the apartment. thanks so much bree i hope see you again. constanza

tiffany is a wonderful hostess and her apartment is amazing. we’ve stayed in a fair number of airbnb and it’s competitors places and this one is at the top of list. tiffany’s place is exceptionally well appointed, weaving a superb sense of style, thoughtful flourishes, and state-of-the-art appliances and fixtures. as if the accommodations were not enough, tiffany was so on-point as a communicator. she was very quick on her responses and checked in to make sure that our stay was going well. my only regret is that by leaving this very well-deserved review, that her apartment won’t be available the next time i come to greenpoint!

exactly as described in the listing. we had two couples in our group and were there for four days. we went to three shows and two jazz club performances at birdland, and all were within easy walking distance which made this place great for its location. we highly recommend hadestown and some like it hot. both shows were truly outstanding. we also took a two and a half hour cruise on circle line, which goes around manhattan island. it was well worth it and within easy walking distance as well. you can't beat the location of natalie's place if you're into theater, jazz, and seeing the sights on a cruise. we parked our car the entire time at the garage on dyer and w 42nd street and walked two blocks to natalie's place with luggage and it worked out great. we highly recommend staying here!

maya's lovely brownstone was just what i needed for a weekend getaway to new york. the place is conveniently located close to the subway and there are interesting shops and restaurants sprinkled throughout the neighborhood. i felt very much at home here and was provided with all of the amenities that i needed for my stay. i would definitely come back again!
outstanding space. very conveniently located if you need to be in park slope. 5-stars.

mary is a lovely host, happy to interact as much as your travels allow. everything from check-in to shared space was easy and comfortable. the spacious bedroom has everything you need from closet space to a suitcase stand. having your own bathroom is really nice in an airbnb. highly recommend staying with mary :)! great area too - one of my favorite spots in brooklyn.

fatou was a very nice host and very helpful. when we arrived, the ac did not work. while we were out, she worked to fix the problem. a bit pricey for the room but it is brooklyn. one recommendation is to add an inexpensive handle on the bathroom door to make it easier to open. a $5 fix.
an amazing space! the place was beautifully decorated and spotless. it was conveniently located. we enjoyed our time there. thank you barbara and jim!
david was a great host! he was flexible with our arrival and even helped carry my suitcase upstairs. the apartment was cozy and clean. we really enjoyed our stay.

anna was a very welcoming host! and the room was perfect, very comfortable. the area was filled with so many different places to eat and get a drink at. bars are less than 5 minutes walking distance. also, very easy to get to manhattan from here with the 7 train, it’s really close. i highly recommend this place to stay at for anyone that’s planning to visit new york.
great guest room, neat and clean with a tv right in front of the bed. nice kitchen as promised, and the whole place smells nice. seth and sam were very easy going and helpful people.

gregory’s place was the perfect place to stay for my family and a couple of friends. we needed a central location for sightseeing and elevator for wheelchair access. loved the windows, whimsical decor, variety of sleeping arrangements, and excellent lounging and dining options. when we had questions, he was quick to respond and patiently answered all our questions. would definitely stay in again.

this place was exactly what we needed for a weekend away. the subway is a block away and there is a convenient parking garage around the corner ($25 per day with taxes) if you are planning to bring a vehicle. secure building in a nice location with good local food options to walk to and easy access to other areas. the unit itself was clean and comfortable, the walls are thin and the space is small but to be expected for the city it looked exactly how it does in the pictures. i would definitely return here again; felt safe and satisfied.

joy was a wonderful host, and the room was perfect for my needs. the room has a/c, a mini fridge, lots of lighting, and great closet space. it was very convenient to be able to use the washer/dryer in the living area, and the kitchen is thoughtfully appointed. joy went out of her way to be a welcoming and helpful host. the area is cute and walkable, with many coffee shops, restaurants, and grocery stores nearby. this was a great value and i would stay here again. thanks, joy!
great room and location and the people working at the hotel were nice and was there to help when i needed it

maria’s apartment is clean, comfortable, spacious, and in a convenient location. it is 3 steps down from the street level in an old building. the apt is well equipped. maria was very helpful when the power went out, as she showed me how to turned the circuit breaker. we’ll definitely stay again.
great host! beautiful home!
luigi was an accommodating, communicative host. we enjoyed our stay in brooklyn.
really good location!

a great place to stay at the intersection of three fabulous neighborhoods! very walkable, metro is very close and more. the apartment was warm and welcoming, between minimalist and cozy. our host was very responsive every step of the way. we are so grateful for our stay!
no cable/internet connection on tv and wifi didn’t work. front desk was unable to help resolve. unit has a lot of wear/tear and shower tiles are mildewed.

this place was great! easy ride on the 7 or e into manhattan (less than 30 minutes). good food close by. private bathroom and a spacious room with a very nice desk if you need to get work done. one of the best “private room” airbnb’s i have stayed at. miao is a great host as well. very proactive and easy going. definitely would stay here again!
for the price it is amazing for 2 to 4 people. the carpet squares need to be set or taken off the stairs they are unsafe
a great place to stay in flushing
clean, nice setup. family friendly ! perfect place to stay. location very convenient! i loved the off-street parking 😍 ! would definitely book again in the future !

the space is so open and much larger than i thought. it is in a perfect location and was overall a wonderful stay. liron was great at communicating and making sure we were doing great. i highly recommend this place!
great host and great accommodations! i would definitely book again. thank you sonya!
wonderful place to stay in brooklyn. lively fort greene location, but quiet street and peaceful place to land at the end of a busy day in the city. communication with host was excellent and timely.
great host with a convenient place. sharon was terrific, friendly and helpful. i'd stay here again!
una estancia agradable

good space, great neighbourhood... quiet/family friendly. a short walk to shops and the subway. helpful couple with excellent communication... all in all a nice spot to relax without the hustle and bustle of being right in nyc and still close enough to enjoy all that the city has to offer.
my stay here was excellent no complaints, great staff and great security. i enjoyed my stay. thanks again

nice stay with easy instructions and good a/c that kept things cool on a hot day. appreciated vincent and andrea’s pizzeria a couple of blocks away. easy walk from the train station at 111th street. appreciated the bottled waters in the room. would stay here again!

mary ann made check in so easy. the brownstone was walkable and felt very quiet and safe. it felt older but clean! we had a bit of trouble figuring out how to keep the place cool at night without triggering the heat to come on, which made sleeping tough. beds were pretty comfy. in hindsight, we should’ve just asked mary ann! she is so responsive and friendly. we really enjoyed our mom’s getaway weekend in nyc. a well stocked kitchen made eating breakfast in easy. there were three of us. the comfortable and portable futon was handy.
great hosts! location was great, within a short walking distance to the train. the space was excellent, clean, and comfortable! safe a quiet neighborhood, i’d go back again in a heartbeat!

manuel’s place was perfect for us for our week in brooklyn. the house is immaculate, recently updated, and quiet. great family neighborhood close to prospect park. manuel is an outstanding host. we’ll be back!
great host!!!
