if you are looking for lodgings in brooklyn, i'm sure this is one of the nicest places to stay in your travel in nyc.
clean, quiet, well-run building in a great neighborhood.

we loved our stay at tonderai’s place and would highly recommend if you’re looking to stay in brooklyn or outside or manhattan, as it was an easy train ride. great nearby restaurants and close to the subway.
great location and the bonus is the parking space.
cozy, clean and a great host!
great host & great space if you are looking for a place close to the airport for a few days!
this place was awesome for a weekend stay! loved the rooftop.

awesome host, in a nice location! the subway is only a 10 min walk away, and the path is very easy to follow. i would definitely stay here again. dave is patient, and helpful; and cares for his guests as if they are family!

we had a wonderful trip to new york and ewa's apartment was a big part of that experience. location is excellent, 1 block from subway with direct train into the city. coffee shop and restaurants are half a block away. apartment is spacious, very clean and comfortable. ewa was very sweet and available for anything we needed during our stay. next time we visit new york we will check the availability of this apartment for sure!

nice hosts, comfy bed in nice, clean, large room, directly at the subway station with good connections! andrew and adriana were super easy to communicate with before and during my stay, and accommodated my late arrival after a flight delay. they were also both up for some longer, interesting chats. additionally, the room was really great, the location is good, and all was very clean. can only recommend staying here!

it is a very simple but cozy and clean place, especially with so many visitors. alex was very hospitable and personable. i rushed out early in the am for a flight so it definitely made a difference to have some quick food options before travel and the night before when i came in from partying. the rooms are about the size of a full size bed but ultimately it works since you will probably just be using as a crash pad. i will stay here again, and if you decide to stay book asap because it books up fast.
a group of us were traveling for work at the un and stayed here. it is a great location, beautiful apartment, and the front desk was very helpful! thank you!
this was so much more than what we were expecting. incredibly comfy bed in a beautiful room in a fantastic location. we loved it!
felt right at home rosianie is a wonderful host! her home is immaculate. hope to be back soon .
top appartment for a good price
a very charming place in a nice location. jazzmine is a very special host. everything was perfect!

had an amazing stay here. upon check in, we even got upgraded to a larger room with a mini fridge. host had things like plastic utensils and plates in the lobby for free usage. the communal microwave in the lobby was clean. the room was spacious. the bed was comfortable and everything was clean. the host was very quick and friendly. the location was also very convenient. most of manhattan chinatown was available within 5-15 min walk. the subway was only 1 min away too.
jeannie was very welcoming and helpful!

shay’s place was exactly as described. truly a comfortable room that is very clean. shay was helpful right from the beginning. she pays attention to each detail, which i appreciated as a guest. would definitely stay again. also, the location is very central and right near the subways.

i had a wonderful stay at jackson and michelle's home. they were extremely responsive, accommodating, and hospitable. the location was so convenient, just a few blocks away from the subway station, in a safe and quiet neighborhood. the home itself was very cozy and the room had a very comfortable bed with great natural light from the window as well as an ac unit. michelle, jackson, and their dog leo were very welcoming and kind while also leaving space to decompress after a long day in the city. would definitely stay with them again next time i am in nyc!
very good, i highly recommend this apartement, super efficient.

the studio apartment is arranged spaciously, and is very clean. the host communicated clear instructions for check-in and check-out, and when we had questions, replied quickly. we felt very cozy in this apartment, just down the road from a subway station, and right around the corner from plenty of food and grocery options. our only caution would be that, if you don't sleep through noise well, the traffic and neighbors on the street at night could keep you up. but if you enjoy feeling close to a lively brooklyn neighborhood, this is the perfect spot.
excellent attention from the host
we had a great stay at josh’s place. the place is well located for transport to manhattan and in a safe area in brooklyn. the house had plenty of space for the 6 of us.

this is a great long term rental. we stayed here for six weeks. the unit is located in a vibrant neighborhood. mostly it was quiet in the evening. this is a fun and lively place. the unit is in the back of the building so you get little street noise. we stayed here from mid december to the end of january. we only had party noise on the likely nights and it didn’t go much past midnight. the host was super responsive and helped us work through the only issue we had with the wifi otherwise everything worked perfect. the best feature of this place is the washer/dryer. we only cooked a couple of times - there are too many awesome restaurants in the neighborhood to bother. there are tons of great coffee shops here too. i would stay here again if i needed a place for a month or longer.
thanks bianca. perfect location.
such a wonderful host and comfortable apartment. i would repeat!

my daughter needed to quickly find a quiet, clean, safe and affordable place to stay in midtown to complete her 10 week clinical rotation for her doctorate in pt - needed to be within walking distance of the rehab facility, food shopping, restaurants, and stores for supplies like target. perfect building and unit for safety and quiet neighbors in nyc to get sleep and study. i was very concerned as a mom, and ignacio's immediate responses calmed my nerves! for the murray hill area, this was a great find at the last minute - we thought she would commute by train from nj for her rotation, but the unreliable train service and varying schedule of hours ruled that out. we are so grateful to ignacio for making this happen! building has laundry and was very quiet with like-minded professionals bound for ny for short-term - no elevator, but 5th top floor was great exercise for her! floors higher than 1st floor are recommended by me for safety and not hearing the main door open.
kaz is great. i highly recommend this residence. the management is attentive and professional. i am very happy i stayed for the end of the pandemic. thanks!!!

i absolutely loved my stay and demi was a terrific host. she was very responsive and accommodating and went out of her way to make sure i were comfortable. the space is extremely clean, attractive and spacious. the neighborhood is great--lively, close to subways and full of great shops and restaurants. i cannot wait to return!
the shower is too cold or too hot no in between

the unit is located at a very convenient location that is only very accessible via public transport but also has a lot of stores around to buy your necessities. henry is a very warm host who ensures your comfort.

jae was very responsive throughout our stay. even when we got stuck in customs when arriving in the us he was readily available and greeted us to hours later than scheduled. the place is nearby the metro so it is easy to get around. also some grocery stores are right around the corner. traffic noise could be an issue for some as the windows do not insulate the sounds very well.
the loft was exactly as pictured - very spacious, great natural light and tastefully furnished. the host is very prompt to respond. would recommend without hesitation.

yan house is absolutely beautiful! we lived there for more than a month and were very glad that we chose this place for such a long period. neighborhood is amazing: beautiful private houses and nature. just 5 mins walk from a huge field where u can have a run, play tennis and etc. a very good supermarket only 20 mins walk. and the best carrot cake in nyc for 3$ is right near the corner. the floor in the room was a bit cold all the time, but it's nothing considering the benefits. thank you very much yan!

nice appartement in the 3rd floor of a harlem townhouse built 1910. good heating, the rooms have much space. kitchen equipment complett.not far from the subway. save surrounding and good supermarket. adrianne was very helpful. we arrived 2 hours later than announced. the supershuttle needs 3 hours from newark.on our leaving day we take a limo-service for 70 $ best choice. axel

julio and maria are wonderful hosts and their home is in great location. maria waited up until 2am to greet me after my flight got delayed. i felt safe in their home as i traveled solo. they were friendly, welcoming, and i will stay with them in the future!

great location with plenty of comfortable space. the kitchen could use basic amenities (e.g. cooking tools) to be truly good, but otherwise a nice place to stay.

this was just what we needed for a quick trip to nyc. the hotel was clean, and everyone was friendly and helpful. we loved that our dog was welcomed to stay, and they even gave him a dog bowl and treats! would stay here again!

this is an affordable option for staying in manhattan. 10-15 minutes walk to times square and most subway trains. our room on the 15th floor was quiet, so no trouble sleeping. it was very clean, looked exactly like the picture. ac was adjustable and kept the room cool. easy check-in and check-out with polite staff. the location seemed reasonably safe overall. but my girlfriend told me she wouldn't walk that street alone after dark. it's a few blocks from most traffic, and there weren't as many people out. this was during covid-19, so perhaps foot traffic was lower than usual. we had no problems during our two-night stay. read the listing carefully because there is an extra fee on arrival. also a refundable security deposit. everything was as it was described.
liked the location and hip styling. everything was as expected. will stay again.

apartment was ok. a room with two beds and a bathroom. shampoo bottle was almost empty when we arrived, no hand soap. would be nice with some utensils. otherwise everything was clean. close to the subway. 50 minutes to the 42nd.
spacious and has enough rooms, beds and bathrooms for a large family. kitchen is spacious and up to date. subway is half a mile away.

great hosts, great location, nice neighborhood services. we had a great thanksgiving weekend in nyc thanks to eric. they were super accommodating and very friendly. you won’t be disappointed with eric’s place in chelsea!
this was my first airbnb experience and raheem has set the bar extremely high! i had an amazing stay here. he was very helpful, responsive, and kind. i'm already looking forward to coming back!

i highly recommend this airbnb. it's as clean and charming as the photos suggest. it's located in a tree-lined neighborhood within walking distance of restaurants, groceries, and subway stations. great communication.
booked now its very convient place and a near by store by the place 🔑
great host. very nice. great place. and the rooftop view was amazing!!

for two girls traveling to nyc , this was a great location that, most importantly, felt safe. super close to the subway and a bunch of good restaurants. while there was some construction happening nearby and street noise in the morning, overall the value for the price can’t be beat. abdon was a considerate, responsive host that was able to find solutions to unexpected issues. would 10/10 book again!
loved our stay here. it was exactly what we needed. a place big enough for 5, to sleep and get ready in between all the activities we had planned.
close to staten island ferry and nyc, easy access to everywhere, place nice and clean.

i stayed at eliana's on a long layover at jfk. she was super great to work with, even letting me borrow a scale so i could rejig by suitcases and make sure they were under the weight limit. the bed was super comfy and bathroom was fully stocked. overall a great stay!

a beautifully decorated home with great hospitality. unfortunately didn’t get a see patricia much but cherrise was always available, welcoming and helpful. i really enjoyed our morning conversations and not to mention the lovely cats! great location close to metro and many restaurants. thank you to you both for allowing me to stay - it was a great pleasure and i’d definitely recommend your place!
wonderful place. karter was a great host.
i wouldn’t stay here again. the place is very dirty. host was nice to talk to.

daniel is a great host! the apartment has a beautiful design and is in a good area, close to many tourist attractions in new york. the apartment is very quiet, cozy and clean. we had an excellent stay in the daniel's apartment! thanks a lot!

comfortable stay at a lovely room, with enough size for two people, sharing kitchen and living area. good connection into subway network with 20-30mins ride into central manhattan, residential area safe and close to brooklyn and bridge. all amenities as described by pictures at the flat ad.
definitely recommend this suite.

my trip to nyc was enjoyable thanks to ronnie, a welcoming host. he is accommodating, generous, and kind too. the vibrant neighborhood provided cultural experiences with easy access to the a train, linking upper manhattan's west side to harlem and brooklyn.this was my best long-term experience, and i highly recommend this listing for those seeking respectful, down-to-earth individuals, including the other guests. thank you, ronnie and teresa!
milton is such a pleasant, respectful and caring host. i truly enjoyed my start and his accommodations are highly recommended and worth the value.

this is a nice spot in a great neighbourhood! the apartment was very clean and comfortable for us and two teenagers. the neighbourhood was a great surprise - lots of neat shops and fantastic restaurants all within very safe walking distance from the location. it was also very easy to grab the train into manhattan from just a short (3-5 minute) walk to the station. james was a very responsive host and was accommodating with an early bag drop off and a slightly later checkout which we greatly appreciated!

it was so beautiful and prepped so nicely. everything was so clean and it was such a peaceful area. host was very responsive and there was cleaning supplies, along with extra sheets and towels. overall loved this listing and would stay here again!
very nice apartment in a very nice area. emma stocks the place up with anything you would need for a short stay in nyc and makes check-in/out very convenient. would recommend!
it was great our staying in willi's place. everything was cristal clean, the place is pretty , close to the subway and very quiet. also has so very good amenities! we recommend %100.
great value for midtown! very comfortable bed which is not always the case in midtown hotels. very friendly and helpful staff.

my family of 5 loved this place. the only complaint was the street noise, but based on its location in the heart of the city that was a given. overall it was a cute, clean, and comfortable place to stay!

sarah was a delightful host. really communicative and accommodating of my very late arrival. such a warm welcome and friendly face. sarah’s apartment is ideally located very close to the subway and to local amenities.
great stay as always!
superb communication, excellent place. would definitely come back and stay by kiril’s

this apartment is so cute! the decor was my favorite and the terrace was like icing on the cake! the stairs are a little steep lol but hey! upper body work out! the bathroom is quaint but the shower is love! definitely a cute room to take some selfies too!
my fav place to stay

it was perfect for what we needed which was to be near the dock for our cruise. few blocks away and we were able to walk there. pool was closed which was a bummer, the kids were disappointed about that but i’m sure it’s awesome.

enjoyed staying there with a very cool backyard. place is very comfortable and clean. pol was really helpful for answering any question and quickly respond. i did complain about one of the bed mattress in the place and it was changed in few hours with a new one. many thanks :)

elen was a wonderful host, very kind and responsive. her place is perfect for a little getaway- all the fixings of a studio apartment and plenty of privacy. it was also cozy and well decorated. it was very easy to park close by on the street. the l train is a short (and safe) walk, which made traveling in brooklyn and manhattan very easy! it was quiet and we slept very well. thanks elen, we’d love to come back!
nice bed, good size room effective heater very dusty on top of shelves shower leaks through door onto floor unstable/slow internet

we were so glad to have stayed with montifa and saint for our first airbnb experience. the location was great as it was a quiet, easy street to be picked up on by uber. also very close to public transit. a dunkin doughnuts around the corner for breakfast if we needed it. there were also great amenities from our hosts that helped with breakfast and hygiene. a very cozy, comfy place to stay while visiting new york. would absolutely recommend for anyone looking to visit new york city.
wonderful hotel and location

it said it was a party house with lights and everything but when we got there he said it was an extra 350 to party there but he said we could party and do whatever we want downstairs so we were debating then said ok then he comes into the room and sees beer and alchol and tells us 2 get out or hell call the cops and looked like he was ready to get physical with us he brought 2 goons with him for protection we ended up leaving anyhow don't stay here worst airbnb expierence

kate and nathan was super friendly and accommodating throughout my stay. i had an issue one day where i accidentally left the key inside the apartment and nathan was downstairs helping me within 10 minutes! large kitchen with plenty of space to cook and eat, big backyard nice sized livingroom. about a 7 min walk to subway that takes you directly into the city. i was a bit hesitant at first about riding late at night but there’s always a lot of people in the area so i felt safe walking home at all hours of the day/night.

the airbnb apartment was nicely put together. the first few days were very calm and cozy. i was able to do some of my schoolwork. i got a call from the host saying that she was sending someone to do a bath fitter. i was not okay with that because i just moved into the airbnb and a thanksgiving weekend. i feel like it was unfair to have construction while people are in the airbnb. i did speak to the host and she changed the date, which i appreciated. after that ordeal, i noticed we had no heat and an enormous amount of noise was coming from the upstairs apartment. i don't understand why there was so much noise past 11pm at night. there was a lot of stomping with heels, walking back and forth with loud footsteps . the host was notified of the heat and told me to put on the fireplace, which i was doing. the fireplace is small and did not warm up the bedroom. the heat was fixed like two days before my stay ended. they put the heat up to the max . i don't want others to experience this.
kiriko and dominic are quick to respond, attentive and kind. the space is large and comfy, simply set up and very functional. we had a lovely stay.
cool place in a great location. very much near it all.

this apartment was perfect for what i needed, a meeting spot for my groomsmen and i to get dressed for my wedding. the pictures shown and the actual apartment were pretty close, with the exception of a few pictures on the wall. sam was very responsive to massages and i would recommend this place to anyone.
host went above and beyond to make sure we felt comfortable at home. they made a personal connection and advised us on our travel plans. great stay!
i enjoyed the stay and appreciate uma for her responsiveness. i recommend the place to someone who is new to the area.
debora’s space in brooklyn was perfect for my group and i. the space was clean and only about 5 blocks from the kingston station. she was also very responsive. definitely would recommend.
i love staying at the box. it is modern and clean. also, it is close to shops, restaurants, and transportation. most importantly, the staff is exceptionally helpful and kind.

my 11 yo daughter and dog stayed in eduardo’s lovely home for 2 weeks. it was our first time staying in the city and eduardo was great! he was so fast to answer all of our questions and so accommodating. we were in town for my daughter to take classes and i worked all day. the location was amazing. easy walk to anywhere and the best dog park is only 10 mins away! at least 3 amazing grocery stores; a full range of restaurants if you can’t be bothered to cook; tons of work out options; and at least 3 great dog groomers all within a 5-10 min walk. there’s a reasonably priced parking garage immediately across the street and a bunch more near by and we had no problems unloading and loading up the car over the weekend. his home was so clean and comfortable and offered a perfect respite from the hustle and bustle. i was on calls all day at a desk in one of the bedrooms and it was perfect. a cozy sectional to relax on and plenty of options to stream. we were much later to check out than we originally planned and eduardo was incredibly accommodating. thank you for making our first nyc trip amazing!
one of the cleanest and most beautiful places we’ve stayed at. very responsive and nice. i would definitely recommend to stay here! close to the train station too.
absolutely excellent location. excellent price, cleanliness and attention to all details.
perfect for two weeks
amazing place in a great neighborhood! sascha was really helpful and made the stay great. the roof amenities are also a great bonus.

owen’s apartment was a unique find. probably the best connected location in all of nyc, steps away from nearly every subway and train line that exists. and despite that, it’s very quiet and peaceful inside. if you are moving, like i was, there’s hardly any better options. this apartment was extremely clean, spacious, had even more amenities than i have expected. booking this apartment will leave you with no regrets and will let you achieve your personal goals. thank you, owen!

the pictures are exactly what you get if not better! it’s a cozy basement! amazing shower! this place is definitely not for tall people. i would suggest bringing a sheet for the bed if that is what you are used to sleeping with. i would rate it a 3.5/5 just because i rarely got any sleep because of the upstairs live ins. the upstairs neighbors can be quite noisy so be prepared at all hours of the night. i would stay again if i knew they would be gone.

we had a great trip. the appartement is very nice and perfect located. near to subway, bars, restaurants and shops. greenwich village is awesome. the communication with arianna was really fast and uncomplicated. great host!!

incredible location, heart of soho, the property itself has everything you need, the host was wonderful and very accommodating, the on-site staff was friendly and helpful, could not ask for anything more
great value! had everything we needed for the stay, and was right above a great breakfast/coffee spot. can’t beat the location, and price. will definitely stay again!
yo this is a amazing little spot great close to the sub and there are a few good spot to eat from around the area def would come back again
oscar’s place is clean and in a great location! we were a family of 10 in town for a wedding and were well accommodated! oscar is attentive and quick to assist. would def recommend this stay.
exactly as advertised. everything went smoothly.

great place to stay if you don’t mind shared bathrooms. the bed was very comfortable, but the cleaning could have been a bit more thorough. found some dead gnats in room and some hair on bed from other people. nothing crazy. great location as it was easy to walk everywhere.
great place. i visit ny regularly and have stayed with them several times. extra points for nice decor, comfortable bed and homely atmosphere.

i had a really nice stay at julie's place. she's always there if you have any request about anything, but not intrusive. communication before arrival and during my stay was perfect! she's a 5 stars host ! the bedroom is nice , as described, and neighborhood awesome. even if gentryfication is on the way, you can still live bushwick experience ;) block parties around the corner and artist studios everywhere .

my 15 year old son, husband and i had a great time in ny. michael's place was in a good location about a 10 brisk walk to time square. there are great options for eating out. the only downside was the street noise at night which seemed to go on until the wee hours.
communicating with our host bobbie was so easy! it made the whole stay that much easier.
good place. nice ambiance to stay
had a great stay at lesa’s, room is exactly as pictured, clean and cosy and only couple minutes from the subway. lesa was responsive and easy to communicate with:)

edmund was very responsive and the place was as described. the back bedroom was quiet at night (and cold ac), and there was a full kitchen available if needed (we did not use). we only used the bedroom so cannot speak to the pullout bed in the living room, but was a very large space for 2 people. as described and notated in reviews, it's a 15-20 minute walk to the subway. this is no problem during the day and early evening, but i might recommend using uber/lyft from the subway late at night (we got home 11 pm or later) for ease, and not fully knowing the neighborhood late at night ($7-12; lyft is usually cheaper). the myrtle stop for the j and m trains seemed to have lots of people get off and walk if you decide to walk home later. we would stay here again :-).

excellent location to the 2/3 subway and restaurants/entertainment. the house was full of character, which we loved! elizabeth was awesome, so helpful, excellent communication and full of tips and places to go eat. there was 11 of us who stayed here, with tons of room, i would 100% go back to this brownstone! we loved it!
great location, apartment and host! will definitely be staying with chris again the next time i’m in brooklyn!

they certainly love a theme over at the pineapple hotel! pineapples pineapples everywhere, from the mosaic to the glassware to the towels. the designers somehow managed to fit barely more than a bed and toilet into the tiny rooms, but they certainly made the most of it and have creative solutions for space-saving. (suitcase drawer under the bed - folding doors on the bathroom - pullout shelf to use as a desk!) the main drawback of this place is the number of drug addicts you have to navigate past getting to it from penn station to 36th street. it truly is located right in the armpit of manhattan. but once you get inside and up to the high floors it is pretty quiet. also be warned: after you've paid your $400+ a night for 10 square feet of space to sleep they will charge you an "amenity" fee which is an additional $25 for the privilege of a bottled water and "free" wifi! how generous! the best part? the beds and pillows were very comfy, on the soft side, but it felt very clean overall. i'd spend your $400 on a much bigger place outside of midtown though, the location truly is horrid.
great location, great value, and very comfortable beds!
the apartment is exactly like it is pictured in the listing. rachel was very responsive and helpful with all of my questions. i had an amazing time - would definitely recommend staying here.

wonderful 4 bedroom town house! very clean and adorable. walking distance to many new york iconic sites and many wonderful restaurants nearby. we enjoyed our visit to new york and our restful evenings at lisa’s place!

if you are looking for a cozy stay in brooklyn, this is the spot. the host included clean towels and linens. the kitchen was very convenient. 2 really nice tvs with all of the streaming services. it is very close to subway stops in a nice residential location. we really enjoyed our stay!
good location, clean, 24/7 front desk. but i recommend bringing your own towels‼️

we loved our one-week stay here. we were a group of four adults and four kids (ages 5-7). the kids loved staying together in the room with the bunk beds and double beds. the living area and adjoining room, deck, and separate bedroom areas all provided plenty of space for us to hang out together or separately when we needed private space. we enjoyed using the grill and eating on the deck in the evenings - our own beach umbrella fit right into the picnic table to provide some shade, which was great. the supermarket is closeby, and we made many trips and prepared most meals at home. we could find almost everything we needed in the kitchen (would recommend adding some oven mitts, if possible). the kids loved the movie screen and projector for group movie nights - so did the adults! took about 15 minutes to walk to the beach with the little ones and a wagon full of supplies. we also walked to the 90s for ice cream a few times, and that was a reasonable distance as well. overall, the bungalow was bright and airy, and the breeze in the evening kept us cool with the windows open and ceiling fans. we highly recommend this home for the space itself, the location, and joe's hospitality.

unfortunately, the hygiene level of the house was quite poor. the sheets and pillowcases were not clean, so we had to purchase our own bedding and therefore did not want to use the towels provided. additionally, the temperature balance inside the house was inadequate. the heaters were extremely hot to the touch, while the areas near the windows were very cold, making it difficult to maintain a comfortable indoor temperature. on the positive side, the location was good and the neighborhood felt safe.

hind is a great host. we are originally from the area so we knew it well. we had asked to check in earlier as we arrived on an early flight and she accommodated that. there are breakfast items available and some snacks. appreciate that she also has toiletries available so if you forget something, you don't really need to go out and purchase any items. hind's place is clean. and the air freshener scent is not bothersome it's actually welcoming. it's a cozy little stay for 2. highly recommend and will definitely reach out to stay again if we ever need to be in the area in the future.

danielle is an awesome host! she's incredibly responsive and flexible. the apartment was clean and welcoming. i could not have matched with a better host and i'll be requesting danielle's next time i'm in nyc. host's like her are the reason i use airbnb. service was phenomenal and i highly recommend her place! logosou

very beautiful room in great and safe location (especially also considering that i was visiting nyc alone). michael always answered very quickly to my questions and let me check-in earlier. i had a very good experience and can recommend this fully.

decent place. you are essentially renting a room across the hall from another guest and without a private bath. finally , the room could use a touch up of paint and the blanket needs to have hair from previous guests removed. i realize hair can become woven into a blanket , however, one does not want to sleep on a not so clean blanket. overall i would say the place was o.k. , not great but not bad as well.
ryan's apartment was huge and very lovely. there was plenty if room for myself and another couple. the area is good for accessing all parts of manhattan and easy to get across to brooklyn.
great stay, thanks ken! highly recommended.

this was the most stunning place! i stayed here for a few weeks while a friend was in town and it was the loveliest little home for the time. it’s beautiful, spacious, and super clean, as well as really well located in the heart of central brooklyn. feeling very lucky to have found this spot for the holidays, and so grateful for the amazing hospitality during this stay. would do again in a heartbeat!!
very good value for money, and perfect location for public transport in manhattan with plenty of subway trains servicing the area
i loved the room and all the people at jg were very helpful and very accommodating.

the room is nice, and has an ac that works great. great location, close to the l and the neighborhood has a homey neighborhood vibe that you'd be surprised to find in nyc. the common area and bathroom could be cleaner and less cluttered. and the host is definitely friendly and courteous, and also let me keep my luggage after checkout till the afternoon which was nice.
great place

we had a lovely time at abby's. its a very cosy appartement with enough space for 4 people. the kitchen and bathroom have everything you need. the rooftop is a very nice extra where you have a beautiful vieuw on the city.
very nice and peaceful place in harlem. james is very convenient
great midtown location. wonderful space in the heart of it all
window unit air conditioner works great! small room, but exactly what i needed.
we had a wonderful stay! the home is charming, very clean and well cared for. this is a great location right near prospect park.
mariana was very nice! check in was simple and quick, place was very clean and she regularly messaged us to check up. definitely recommend!

amazing place to stay as a solo traveller in nyc! super close to the subway to take you into manhattan. the room itself was incredibly clean and had plenty of space, and andrew and adriana were lovely hosts with plenty of recommendations for the area. thank you for my time here, would love to come back. :)
great place and amazing views. i will be returning.

stayed here for a wedding 2 years ago and loved it. came back to bring my partner and we enjoyed our stay. do not expect for this hotel to be super fancy, it’s a nice hotel for the price, location, and comfortable size room for a ny hotel. would certainly come back!

a lovely, extremely clean, stylish, and quiet apartment with a nice convenient location just seconds off queens blvd. the host was not home during my stay, so i had the entire place to myself. whether this is the usual situation i can not say. alberto has many nice touches such as a small fridge right in the bedroom, plenty of bathroom supplies, and a private padlock for the bedroom door. the price is very reasonable for the location. i would definitely rent this place again on my next trip to ny. parking is a bit tight in this neighborhood, but there is a conveniently located pay garage just yards away across the street.

rory‘s place is great convenient, clean and well appointed. private and safe and only a 20 to 40 minute subway ride into various parts of manhattan. she was also very helpful in getting oriented towards her place as well as how to get around and find places to eat and get a cuppa coffee :-) i recommend her and her place highly to anyone who wants to have a affordable place to stay in the new york area while visiting :-)

wanda’s place was the perfect spot for my partner and i to call home for a weekend in the city. the area is super walkable with bodegas, cafes, and great food options within minutes. the place is very comfortable and looking forward to booking it again when we are back in brooklyn.

i guess i definitely got what i paid for. the pictures do look like the place. but their were ant all over so my daughter didn’t like walking around. i walked in to see a broken couch. then i go to watch tv in the bed room and it doesn’t work. then the master bed room is so warm even with the air. then to top it off i go to look under the sick and the whole door comes off. just wish i had a better first experience with my first airbnb but i will stick to what i know. as for allen he is an amazing person. oh and the parking is such a headache and there is a neighbor upstairs that screams for her balcony not to block her drive way.
nice airbnb, little bit loud because of the subway

our stay in new york was made even better by our host's apartment. everything we needed and more. great location, pleasant neighbors, clean and comfortable. very responsive host when we had a question. would definitely recommend!

location, location, location! we stayed here the week of thanksgiving and the location could not be more perfect. we were a short walking distance to the macy’s thanksgiving day parade as well as other city activities during this amazing time of the year including rockefeller center. we had no issues finding street parking every night which was a bonus. the unit was just as pictured, very clean and had all amenities we needed. communication with mark was great throughout as well. the location has everything you need including restaurants and coffee shop within walking distance, including central park which is down the block from the unit. a wonderful stay that i would definitely do again.
not fancy but simple and affordable for the location. convenient to the train station
it was a great stay in a busy nyc location!

great space. amazing location, clean, & our host rory was very responsive and hospitable. happy we stayed here. only complaint was that we visited in march and the apartment was so cold! so bring layers if you’re staying here in the chillier months.
very safe and clean place, walking distance from the train station and madison square garden, very friendly sunny helped with my luggage, thank you, highly recommended

inaccurate listing of fees incurred. the listing by roompick clearly stated that the resort fee is $46 per stay. instead when i checked in, the hotel informed me that i would be paying a resort fee of $46 per night. for 4 nights, it amounted to a charge of $184 instead of $46. i immediately contacted roompicks via airbnb. we messaged back and forth. they kept stating that they were looking into the issue. i contacted airbnb support and escalated the issue. on the last day airbnb agreed with me that the listing was inaccurate and refunded me the additional resort fee charges which the hotel billed me. i believe that if i hadn't escalated it with airbnb, roompicks would not have fixed the issue. therefore i would not recommend booking a roompicks listing.
chris’s place was ideal for our 5-night stay. it is spacious and homely, with comfortable beds, great kitchen, secure and quiet. chris is a friendly, welcoming and helpful host.

this was a great place to stay. it was clean, comfortable, and fully equipped with everything i needed—even for an extended stay of a week or more. while the walls are a bit thin and i could occasionally hear other guests, it wasn't bothersome or excessive. i would definitely stay here again!
one of the best host, quick and responsive, always ready to help out
me and my family enjoyed our stay, very clean and easy check in.
i can recommend that place with no doubt!
great place and great host!!
everything is great and clean .
affordable and cozy bedroom
very comfortable and clean place along the water. a great value.
great place, very clean and bright.
great space. cozy, clean and surprisingly quiet. perfect for staying the night! raffaella was great, providing clear instructions on how to access the unit and respecting our privacy as guests!
they are friendly and kind, is the second time i stay at liqin, the room is super clean, super cozy, better than many hotels around.

great room to stay, suitable for 2 or 3 people. one of the few places with a private shower, however bathrooms are shared which is no problem since they were right outside the room. definetly one of the cleanest places as well. i slept on the lower bed and the mattress was very comfortable as well as the blankets, didn't try the top bunk however but i imagine it is just as comfortable. the walls are very thin as you could here the voices and movments in the other rooms, despite this the room is very quiet and through out most of the day. the location was suitable for our needs as there was a subway station 5 minutes walking, a very delicous dinner near by for breakfast and through the subway was able to get to our tourist attractions within 15 to 20 minutes. overall will be wanting to book again in the future.

upon arrival - we received and read, but did not understand the check-in instructions and as we attempted to locate the room called "stella", we encountered the host and she pretended to be a "friend" - and began insulting us for being "unable to read". we asked for clarifications and she continued with insults, then she pretended to take us to our room but then locked herself in our room and threatened to call the police if we did not leave the premises. she refused us access to the property.
i had a lovely stay at yvonne’s. clean and in a great location, perfect for all my needs!
i had a pleasant and comfortable stay at steve’s place. he’s a fantastic host, easy to communicate with and made me feel very welcome in his home. would definitely stay with steve again!
kamilha was very a responsive host. the space was exactly as described. the decor is beautiful and the bathrobes and slippers are a great touch! i would definitely stay there again.
unbeatable location, reasonable pricing, and many extra amenities.

we had a great time at this apartment. i would prefer this to a hotel anytime - more room, more privacy and an at home feeling for less money than any hotel would take in this area. you can see the empire state building when looking out of the window and lots of cool stuff is in walking distance. sure, the furniture is not top notch anymore, but it just shows that people actually live here. would definitely recommend!

ron was a fantastic host, he was very thoughtful and kind. when we arrived we had a lovely note from ron and some chocolates to welcome us. he was always checking to make sure we were ok and if we needed anything. i would love to stay at ron's again as it was it the best location, close to everything you need.
we had a great stay here- the proximity to the subway and the ability for a place to hold a large group is a rare/excellent combination in new york!

great location in manhattan, but this unit had some serious cleanliness issues— hair in the bed, dead bug in the bathtub, grime on the floor. and the mattresses were very uncomfortable! we all awoke every morning with a backache. i have stayed with this group before, but this was not their best.

fantastic location to visit nyc! everything is within walking distance or easy to reach via the subway. the room is quiet and just off the main street backing onto a yard with trees. there is a fridge, kettle and microwave in the room. the window cannot be opened, but the air conditioning is quiet snd unobtrusive. unfortunately, the shared toilets and shower rooms are very tired and really need complete renovation. the mattress from the sofa bed has an uncomfortable lump caused by the separate cushions. check in and communication with koichi are uncomplicated and efficient.
patrick is very nice person :) he is always ready to help. не answers very quickly. thank you for your hospitality, patrick!

steven’s place was a great deal for manhattan!! a decently quiet neighborhood and a 2 min walk to the subway where i was able to travel all the way across manhattan no problem, was surprised by how easy it is to travel here in new york!! steven’s house was my last airbnb at my stay so i did my laundry at the laundromat down the street that was super helpful and easy. i loved the decor, there was a woman living in the house as well who was super friendly and welcoming, steven was also super helpful and responsive. it was a very clean home and smelled so good, it didn’t feel dirty at all it was so nice. very spacious for new york, and the bathroom that comes with your room is beautiful and big and has everything you need. will definitely stay again when traveling, thanks steven!! another comment about the decor because it was seriously amazing and i loved it, could do a whole photoshoot in there lol. oh and another note - the girl living there and steve both helped me carry my luggage!!

michelle’s place is located in a modern building with great amenities, but what stands out is michelle’s place itself : super clean, nicely equipped. michelle is a trustful host who truly cares about her place and wants to make sure you feel at home. we had a very nice personal welcome and orientation. great access to the subway to everywhere in ny is a big plus. highly recommended for long stays because michelle will have everything you need to get started and then shops close by for the necessities with short walks to lively areas in brooklyn.
we had a wonderful stay at mark’s place. the place was comfortable and very clean. mark was proactive and detail oriented, making our stay with our little just perfect. thank you!
great back garden! flexible to requested changes.
super convenient location, very comfortable base camp as described! easy to find, easy to park, easy to get nearly everyplace we wanted to visit.
sammy's place is great, easy to get to via the subway but nice and quite. very clean and comfortable. would stay again anytime.
bodrul was a great host and very helpful.
terrific space in a great location!

a cozy place that is easily accessible by the subway. there’s a nice convenient store close by. the bed was very comfortable and it was nice to have air conditioning. i felt also very safe in a secure building.

my dad and i had a very comfortable stay at michael’s place. his home was well appointed, with everything we needed. and the welcome beverages were a nice surprise! michael was attentive, responsive, and made us feel at home. would definitely stay here again - thank you!

can not beat the location! metro station right around the corner. illias keeps the place super clean. room is bright and specious with comfortable beds. very pleasant stay, felt safe in the neighborhood . was lucky to find a parking space right away (in the morning)!

paula’s place was exactly what we needed for this trip to the city! great location! so much to do and parking and transportation were a breeze. surprisingly quiet apartment for being right in the middle of things! room and bathroom were clean and perfect for an overnight stay! only thing missing was a hairdryer which was listed as an amenity but we never could find. paula was definitely responsive when you reached out and made you feel at home upon arrival. as mentioned in the listing it is a 4th floor walk up- pack light ;)
we enjoyed our stay thanks!

this is a phenomenal airbnb! i live in nyc and am fortunate that i got to stay at haffro’s place during a period when i couldn’t access my place. it is in a phenomenal location, has all necessary amenities, and truly feels like home.
a great comfortable place to stay with incredibly helpful hosts that’s a short walk to the subway and some great food and bars.

stay was beautiful. steven was helpful and timely with his response. other than it just being new york and a bit noisy at times couldn’t have picked a more perfect location. definitely recommend this stay to anyone gorgeous home and truly just a great experience.
sophia's place was very good. it was in a great neighborhood and was very clean. when im in new york and if its available i will definitely stay there again!

this was our first visit to nyc and this location was perfect! a short walk to subway and central park. the street was beautiful and quiet. the people were so friendly in the neighborhood, especially the locals. david’s place is located in a neighborhood full of wonderful restaurants and coffee shops. highly recommend!

great value and attentive host. my family, including two kids and a dog, was here for two weeks and we were very comfortable. we especially enjoyed the backyard, which was well maintained and a nice place to have a meal. james was responsive and helpful. for example, when our grocery delivery was sent next door to him, james alerted us and sent the delivery our way.

this is place is a great distance from lga (airport) very clean and modern looking home. (it’s on the third floor so, get ready to walk those stairs) subway is a couple minutes away on car. manhattan is a good 20 minutes on car, but subway is better (take the 7) but overall a great place to stay.

was there for the night very good place for one or two people especially for short stays and nice decor with lots of storage space, shilo was also very responsive and helpful which made the check-in process easy

kimberly was very nice person and host. her house was just near the subway station and it was very convenient. house is just 20-25 minutes away from city center. i felt save even if i came back home at late night. across the road there in 'dunkin' donuts' and 'subway' shops. i think it is ideal place for short stay in nyc.
it’s my second time here and i really loved

joy’s space is a clean, comfortable and well-connected home for visiting the city or getting work done. she is an incredibly attentive host who makes a point to get to know every guest, and made us all feel welcomed.
shawanda make us feels at home! the house is very spacious and cool, clean and warm. beds are very comfortable and we find coffee! thanks
enjoyed my month long stay and daniel was always prompt with everything. great host and room!
stayed the week with my family, would recommend.

the place corresponds to the description. yes, it is tiny, but that wasn’t really a problem for us because we were putside all day long visiting the city so overall we enjoyed the days we spent there. the neighborhood is great for tourism, that’s why we chose the place. i read some reviews that said that it is a very silent place and calm and i have to say : yes and no . i mean , yes you don’t hear cars, but you hear some ventilation systems that feel somehow close and if you are sensitive to those noises that may be a problem. i think the overall experience could be better if some details were improved : add some hooks to hang the towel in the shower space, and at the entrance, the kitchen could be better equiped. my problem was more with the toilet that really could be in a better shape. there is a terrible smell when you open the toilets door, the walls are dirty and you feel like peeing in a public toilet at the subway…

perfect stay for large groups, comfortable and clean pillows, towels and sheets. street parking can be tricky as many cars take up spaces, but you can always park in nearby streets. would recommend this stay!

super clean and cute apartment in the best location in nyc. we had a very good time at lauren's place. she was always available and gave us several recommendations. thank you so much for hosting us lauren!

it is a very clean and nice room, he has everything that we need basically, a refrigerator that can put ice drinks; clean trash cans; neat toiletries. there is a convenience store next to the room, which is very convenient as a short-term 1-3 day living room. because we drove to brooklyn at night, it took some time to find a parking space, and the subway was louder at night and more frequent in the morning. but since we wake up earlier, the subway sound doesn't bother us much. our communication with the homeowners is very, very quick and smooth, and questions can be answered perfectly via text messages within a short period of time. we only booked with the owner 20 hours ago, but he responded very quickly and in detail, very polite, it was a great stay experience. as this price, very recommend!
thank you for being a great host
good location

it was such a pleasure staying here. the location is incredible— located near everything you’ll need. whole foods is a couple blocks away and there are a ton of restaurants in the area. the staff provided such pleasant service and was there to help any time i needed it. i would 10/10 recommend staying here!
i would definitely come again. i had a great stay here!
clean, affordable, convenient location, with responsive hosts.
cozy spot in a good location in brooklyn. walkable distance from lots of bars/restaurants as well as a train stop.
always a wonderful stay at kerri’s place!

this spot was excellent. it’s so close to so many great spots. lots to do in the area. close to the subway so getting around was easy. the host was an excellent. very responsive and proactive. had a slight technical hiccup which got resolved super fast. the space itself is very comfortable. it has this vintage charm that made it feel welcoming. lots of reading material. it doesn’t have a kitchen but if you want to cook you could ask the host and she’s open to working around it. highly recommend!

mondell’s place is fantastic! he is incredibly friendly and makes you feel right at home. the atmosphere is warm, welcoming, and very comfortable. highly recommend visiting—it’s an amazing experience!

andres and natalia were great hosts, very loving and accommodating. their place is super comfy for a stay in new york. it’s so close to the subway which makes it really convenient. safe neighborhood, plenty of pharmacies, convenience stores and coffee shops around. would return any day, one of the best airbnb experiences i’ve ever had in new york :)

the home was very comfortable and modern, with all of the needed amenities. we enjoyed our stay, because aron and his family made us feel welcome and made their home a great place to live. the location was conveniently located to the subway, shops and restaurants. we would definitely come back to this location when coming to nyc.
clean and very nice host
great location, very clean place!

fantastic spot. in case you needed a more recent review to verify, this space is exactly as advertised, a great value in a good location. very clean, and dan was very great about recommending a lot of great spots close by. would stay here again!
we had a lovely stay. the place was nice. ludina was really friendly and welcoming. it was near a subway station, but at night it could be a little dangerous
a great place to stay!

it’s about 10 minutes walking to the subway, 5 minutes to target/costco/planet fitness. the neighborhood is very fun to stay in. there’s good food around every corner. the park is right in front of the building so every morning you’re waking up to the sound of soccer games and families grilling outside. i would definitely stay here again. just be aware that there are 3 sets of stairs to walk up and down everyday.
simple, clean, straightforward place in a good neighborhood.

angies place was perfect, it had more than enough space and brand new appliances. the location was around a bunch of restaurants including a delicious cafe right under. i would definitely recommend this place to anyone
our staying was amazing! the staff were very kind and responsive.

merlin was friendly, flexible, and helpful. the place was very clean. i am sensitive to scents and merlin uses air freshening scents in his apartment, so for those who are sensitive, it would be good to check in with him. despite the bed being the top bunk as in the picture, the bed was comfortable and sturdy and quiet. so no worries there. great host!
a great place to stay and close to subway making manhattan very accessible. comfortable neighborhood to walk through. small markets and food nearby.

rachel was very accommodating! we had initials problems with airbnb reservations but she did everything to make our stay smoothly! perfect location and neighbourhood since the house is just walking distance to queens mall and train station. highly recommended! will definitely go back next time!
it’s in an excellent location
thanks for everything! i did enjoy my stay a lot and this part of brooklyn is just beautiful. walkable distance to b, q and 2 line trains and not noisy at all.

the place was exactly what the pictures described. the space was clean and comfortable. our host would check in and make sure we had everything we needed. it was convenient to get around due to its closeness to a subway station. overall, a great stay!

we had a really lovely time in brooklyn during christmas season. the appartment is really sweet and had a wonderful christmassy touch. we felt like home right away. all necessary information and more were well prepared and also during the stay we always had the chance to get in touch with peter. i can really recommend this appartment for a great careless stay in brooklyn.

sandra is incredibly nice and has a very beautiful home. she was flexible with the check in, provided snacks and coffee, and overall just went above and beyond. the house is located in a nice area close to public transportation. thank you so much sandra for letting us into your home and for all the hospitality!
daniel was incredibly helpful and kind. any questions that i might have had, he answered. the place itself was very clean, and beautiful. i had a very great stay!!
near by buses, lovely porch, stores in walking distance. plenty of street parking it has been a while since i've lived in the city so forgot about all the noise.
great stay! home was very clean and up to date. greg was a great host and very communicative throughout the stay.

we had a wonderful time at this airbnb. the place is gorgeous and easy to get to from the train stop. laetitia and peter are great hosts and made us feel so welcome. absolutely will be looking to book here again on any future nyc trips! thank you for the suggestions, great conversations, and homecooked meals :)
rick’s place is beautiful and super convenient spot in brooklyn, right by the subway. great location and plenty of space with three bedrooms. rick was super helpful and responsive.

i highly recommend doyens' queens property. the neighborhood, the lights, the convenience of the laurelton lirr station, the choice of shops, and plazas nearby... amazing. the home is as cozy as it is clean. the home was as warm as you wish or as cool as we needed. towels and blankets were plentiful, as were dishes and complimentary water already chilled for us. we arrived early, with permission, doyen had everything ready and waiting, exactly as he had promised it would be. this host goes above and beyond what is expected. we plan to use this home again as well as look for any others this host has. communication could not have been better. hospitality from a distance... perfect. thank you.
great location and price, soli was very responsive and communicative. a fun and easy stay!

my group had such a great time! we were 5 in the one room and there was enough sleeping space and space for the little bit of luggage we had. everything was neat and clean. caroline gave us a tour and explained the house rules in detail so there was no confusion. we had our own cabinet, fridge shelf, and freezer space. the apartment is spacious with a nice living space that is shared for all guests. great price, location, and space for the price. we will definitely look this one up again if we are in the area!!
friendly host! thanks for having us, basma :)
thank you for letting us stay here, was so much better than expected!

pros: 10 mins walk to train station - felt safe at night washer/dryer offered as facility host gave plenty of privacy ample sunlight in the room to do make-up cons: no bodega or breakfast spot for quick bite area for guests is one steep flight of stairs, we had two full size bags, which were struggle to carry up things to consider for host: full size mirror floor fan for areas outside of bedroom
incredible view on central park, great comfortable space, amenities, all the ingredients for an exceptional stay at anthony’s apartment. thank you so much! we can’t wait to be back 😊
perfect. carlos and yvette are very kind, welcoming and very good advice for visiting new york. the house is very clean and the location is perfect, very close to the metro. we recommend !
nice room in brooklyn. great hospitality and very clean.

very clean and overall a great place to stay. the hosts really provide you with almost everything you need to have a comfortable stay. location can be a little inconvenient if you’re not familiar with local transit. however, it felt safe and a great place to chill out after a long day!

francesca's eclectic, historic brownstone was fantastic! what a dream to have central park "in your backyard!" excellent location to explore neighborhood mom & pop places. mani's market is a must! also excellent for subway transportation. even from india, francesca's communication was spot on.

allen and his wife were the perfect hosts. they have a beautiful house, and our room was big and with all the service details. they also prepare a great breakfast for us, and gave us all the information we needed. 100% recommended!
great location and very clean!! great staff as well
clean, spacious unit with comfortable beds. short walk to subway. fit our needs perfectly!

we were enchanted by this extremely stylish, comfortable, secure home for our celebration vacation. the host was very responsive, flexible, and helpful. was the shortest check out task list i’ve ever encountered and for this reason, i wish i could give extra stars. highly recommend!
a very nice place easy in process. and very neat and clean
nice and communicative

the listing is as pictured. it was a very clean basement apartment. small and low ceilings. if you are over 5,8”you might hit your head. i gave 5 stars for cleanliness, great wifi, good coffeemaker and refrigerator. annushka was very quick to respond and checked on me. as the listing says there is not a kitchen to cook meals. i purchased meals and was able to reheat in the microwave. be aware there is a roll of paper towels, plates, mugs and cutlery, no bowls. you need to purchase anything else. i bought filters and coffee and was able to make very good coffee in the coffeemaker. get everything you need if you are coming late including water. this listing is not far from the airport however if you are here for tourist activity you might want to be closer to the city. great tv and the bed was comfortable. i really like a full kitchen so that was inconvenient for me but i. hose to stay. . if you don’t care, are out all day and need to crash for less than a hotel it will work.
great stay in perfect location.
this place was a great comfortable spot! super close to everything we needed! i would definitely book this place again!
i wouldn’t mind staying again nice place

even with it being right next to a train stop after a long day in the city, we couldn’t hear it. especially at night when there was less trains running. close to 2 bus stops that can take you into the city or jfk. comfortable beds
cozy as described , nice place to stay. very convenient .

had a great stay at m’s i love the attention to detail as i walked in the place smelled amazing and everything was as pictured very clean and accommodating. i was able to check in and out with no issues. i will be back again, thanks m
great apartment close to subway links downtown and to yankee stadium. clean, tidy, helpful hosts. wouldn’t hesitate to stay there again.

the room was nice enough and a fairly good size for ny. there is a lot of noise from canal street and you have to sleep with ear plugs to get any kind of sleep. we did not expect that just like the price did not reflect it. also this part of canal street has a lot of street vendors and pot smokers right outside the building, which can make it seem a bit sketchy. a five minute walk and you are in much better areas.

annissa's home was exactly what she described. absolutely immaculate, very warm and cozy environment. me and my daughter will be back again in the fall. thank you ms. annissa and your respectable family.

we enjoyed our stay at d's place. she was so welcoming. we only saw her once at check-in and communicated by text throughout. the place is good especially for family vacations. it's spacious. the beds are comfortable. our host provided snacks and breakfast for us. she provided games for the kids. my kids loved the games so much that they didn't want to leave when our vacation was over. we took advantage of the staten island ferry which is a few minutes away. it is a free service between staten island and lower manhattan. we will certainly be back next summer for a longer stay. thanks d.

henry’s place is great for the price! it’s a super convenient location, and i was a solo female traveler and felt safe the whole time. it’s an older building but henry definitely pays attention to cleanliness. the room itself is fairly big compared to what i’m used to with “single room” listings. access to a window ac unit was super nice in july, as i was able to control how cold the room was. the bed is comfortable and clean. it’s obviously not the height of luxury since it’s an older building with a shared bathroom, but for the price, you really can’t beat this place! i will definitely stay again next time i’m in nyc.

staying in audrey's apartment was a nightmare as her old door lock broke in my hand as i was locking the door to go out for my pcr test on the 25th december..audrey had gone to work when it happened and she was very much upset when i reported it to her and she made me paid for a new lock which cost me $200..the locksmith reported that the lock broke because of wear and tear and also it was not a good brand .audrey also put a friend of hers on a loud speaker on her mobile phone and insinuated that i had fiddled with the lock. this made me feel very embarrassed and stressful,and i couldn't sleep all night.to make matters worse,audrey on several occasions put her tv on a high volume which consistently disturbed my sleep. her attitude and behaviour created an impression that she offered me a room for free which was not the case .at one point she came to my room and removed a brown cable without asking for permission rather she said,' i want to take something from the room' ,which i felt that she did not respect my privacy . overall ,audrey's attitude and behaviour defeated my purpose of having a peaceful a holiday in new york.

karine’s place was so cute and so clean!! it’s been recently renovated and everything was perfectly done. the bed was very comfortable with nice linens and cozy pillows. the location had easy access to the subway, great restaurants and cafes. im picky when it comes to hotels or airbnb, and i would highly recommend karine’s place. she was a great communicator and checking in and out was a breeze. we loved our stay.
jane’s apartment is beautifully decorated and in a great location. i would recommend this place to anyone!
bella is adorable and available if help is needed. my sister and i had a perfect experience at her place. the bed is comfortable and the room very quiet.

if you're looking for a clean, quiet spot to use as a home base while exploring nyc without paying manhattan prices, this is it. the studio is a well-thought-out space — everything you need, nothing you don't. it was comfortable, spotless, and genuinely peaceful after long days of walking the city. julie and nikki were great hosts — responsive, easy to communicate with, and clearly care about making sure their guests have a good experience. the location is a hidden gem for anyone willing to take a short uber to the staten island ferry (about $11 on average). from there, all of manhattan opens up. and honestly, the daily ferry rides past the statue of liberty never got old — that alone is worth the stay. free views that most tourists pay a boat tour to get. would absolutely recommend this place to anyone visiting nyc on a budget who still wants easy access to everything the city has to offer
olivier was a great host went above and beyond what was expected! felt right at home
very responsive host with a nice, clean and comfortable apartment. walkable to great williamsburg eateries and to an l subway station. highly recommend!
good location. walking distance of just about everything. rental was just as described. would stay here again.

stayed here for one night for a quick stay in nyc. location was great and view was even better (i got a room on the top floor). check in was smooth and i had no issues staying here. if you’re thinking about staying here, i encourage you to go for it!
nice and clean, everything you need for a stay in new york. responsive and easy check in.
great location! had a nice stay and lenny is super communicative and easy to get in touch with.
we absolutely loved staying here and hope to return again very soon! jeffery is a very attentive host and his place is great. we will never forget our experience here.
the house is spacious for 6 people.

gregory’s place was truly amazing. it has everything needed to feel like an actual home. i booked the place a few months ago before it was even complete but i trusted gregory as a super host. i was not disappointed! gregory was very generous with all the amenities. there are a lot of grocery stores in the area so cooking was very easy. i could get to manhattan pretty easily with the bus and the train. overall it was a great stay. i cannot recommend it enough.
great host and accommodation. recommended if going to new york for a short visit.

liqin is a splendid consistent host. the home is always squeaky clean and very comfortable to stay for quite the affordable price. whenever im in town and looking for a nice place to stay for a short amount of time i come to liqins humble abode. i do prefer the upstairs rooms though! even though the bottom rooms are just as adequate.
nice location and clean

staying at mark's place was one of the best experiences with airbnb i've had. mark is a wonderful host and was truly a pleasure to meet and talk to. he was able to accommodate when i requested a 3-week stay on very short notice, and i really got lucky because this was an amazing apartment for the price. i really felt at home the entire time and knew mark was always available if i needed anything. also, stuyvesant heights is a great neighborhood and subway access is easy and close. highly recommended!!
great place to stay. walking distance to shops, restaurants and subway. right by central park.

i had such a great experience staying at christina’s apartment. i was working long hours at the autoshow and needed a place to recharge and reset, and her room was exactly what i needed to do that. very spacious, super close to the subway, cafe’s, deli’s, restaurants all nearby. location was great. her hospitality was warm and welcoming. by the middle of my stay i started to feel like i was walking into my own place. the price is also very reasonable for the area. i hope to cross paths again. i would recommend her place to anyone. 🙏
megan is the best host! her apartment is very clean and cozy and we will definitely be staying there again the next time we are in brooklyn.

my husband and i stayed with julian for a week and had a great time in nyc. the check-in was easy and autonomous. although we never actually meet julian, he was always only a message away. the apt was awesomely close to the train station which meant we only had to walk two blocks to and from. apart from that, there was a grocery store, licores store, dominos, and popeyes a block away for any extras we may need or last minute bites after a long day. julian had a futon in the sofa, which i was apprehensive about, but it wasn’t uncomfortable at all like typical futons. it laid out like a queen size bed and i slept so good! plus, their sheets and towels were so soft and comfy! the only thing that my husband and i did not like, which may be due to our upbringing, was that whenever we’d walk back from the train, on that same block, we’d always pass a large group of adults smoking marijuana and hanging out outside of their apartment. literally anytime we walked by... morning, noon, and night. we only ever were uncomfortable when it was late at night, as some of the adults out there looked sketchy, so we chose to walk on the opposite side of the street and then cross over when we got closer to where the apt we were staying at was... all good. besides that, the neighborhood seemed nice. i totally recommend using the train to get to manhattan and investing in the unlimited weeklong metro card. it was $34 for each, but as tourists, we absolutely got our money’s worth. all in all, we had an awesome time, and being able to come back each night and unwind in julian’s apartment elevated the experience.

the room was clean and looked exactly as described. the only thing was that the heater doesn't work efficiently, however the room didn't get too cold because of the type of material the building is made of.

this place is a gem! hosts were awesome and quick on response. i loved staying at this well planned stylish spot in such a great neighborhood, felt like home away from home. highly recommend this place, and would be back in a heartbeat if and when i travel to ny again.

marjorie's place is wonderful, and is in a great location. super clean, great amenities. amazing back yard that you have access to! i was staying there with two friends (a couple), so i ended up on the futon. i probably should have tried the fold-out cot to see if it was more comfortable, but the futon was not easy to sleep on. highly recommended place for a couple or maybe a young family. if you're 3 adults, you may want to try the fold out cot or putting the mattress from the cot on the futon to make it a little more comfortable? that was the only downside.

first, the location is ideal. close to central park, time-warner with whole foods, lincoln center, starbucks, and public transportation. the apartment is exactly as the photos show; spacious, very clean, and comfortable. the bed is firm and comfortable. wonderful linens. the fold out in the living room is comfortable for a fold out. kitchen has all the utensils we needed and adequate supply of spices. linna graciously provided coffee. linna accommodated our checkin and checkout needs and attentive to our needs. outstanding place to stay. i will stay there again during my next trip to ny.
one of the best stays in new york we ever had. highly recommended - wonderful place to be.

this was our second stay at jon's place. it was perfect, just like our first stay. the apartment is just as pictured, super clean, great location and has everything you need. a great way to see nyc and not have to stay in a cramped hotel room!!!
great host! nice and clean apartment close to the subway . would definitely book again ! thanks chris
small, great location, not very clean but manageable. i would bring your own towel and shower shoes, but bedding is fine.

this hotel and room are in a great location, near public transportation that will quickly bring you to manhattan. the staff is very helpful, the rooms are clean and stylish. this is a hotel and if noise is of concern, opt for an inside room or on a higher floor as the lower floor rooms, which are nice and large, can absorb a lot of road noise from the adjacent overpass. it wasn’t a deal breaker for us and the large room with a full kitchen was great for our family of four. the free ride to the queens subway station was also great on rainy days, but the walk there was easy and we did so several times with no problems. the neighborhood is also great and we had several nice dinners there. i’d highly recommend the location as an alternative to staying in manhattan, especially if you have a family and want some extra space.

clean and comfortable room with easy access to kitchen amenities. the three other residents were all really friendly and welcoming. well-located next to the 2/3 line, with tons of good food options in the immediate vicinity.

unfortunately, our stay was extremely negative. there’s no sound proofing between the floors so we could hear the upstairs occupants conversations and hear loud stomping across the floor all hours of the night. people would come and go, stomping across the floor, slamming the front door and gate shut and a dog would run back and forth until 3-4 am every night we were there. we couldn’t sleep and felt tired and miserable our entire vacation. also, the door that separates the basement from the rest of the house doesn’t have a lock on the basement side. the upstairs renters could lock/unlock from their side and walk into the basement anytime they want. the place looked just like the pictures, water pressure was good and hot water worked but that is the only nice things i can say.

great little room in astoria, close to everything. getting the key was simple and easy and although we never met yiota or her cousin they both sent me emails to make sure everything was ok! the room was basically perfect for us, small but not too small for two people, with a cute bathroom and a walk in closet with some kitchen things. we didn't use that since there are so many awesome restaurants in the area. i'd love to stay here again!

the value is here for this property and the neighborhood is nice. comfortable bed, large space and the place was clean. not mentioned in the listing is there is no refrigerator or coffee maker in the room. both are locate outside the apartment and shared with other units. there is a long hike up to the 3rd floor but wasn't a problem for us .... it could be for someone with any physical limitations. overall, the property was nice and a good value given the price.
beautiful beach house!! joe was an excellent host. i highly recommend!
the apartment was great. it was very clean and cozy. the beds were comfortable, and most important, the bathrooms were clean.
as good as advertised!
very nice deigned apartment, warmed welcome, everything is clean and put in order. amazing stay there

this is a safe, cozy and comfortable place situated in wonderful uptown manhattan. the flat has unique old features: wood floors, built in shelving, original heavy wooden doors, all lending an authentic nyc old brownstone feel but with all the modern updates, it is a real gem on a beautiful block. you can't beat the location, with subway lines b/c around the corner it's easy to get any where in the city directly or with a quick transfer. if you enjoy an early morning run or an after dinner stroll, central park is across the street. mark, has provided all the comforts of home and trader joe is close by, making it easy to relax and prepare a meal at home.
