good things first: i was stranded at jfk at 8.00pm due to another booking i made months ago going awry due to a non-responsive host whom neither i nor airbnb could get a hold of for 48 hours before my arrival. welcome to new york. 😵‍💫 fortunately lou-ann jad availability, and promptly answered my inquiry, and i got a room booked right away. lou-ann greeted me with a very friendly attitude, and gave me information about the shared bathroom, and the shared kitchen where tea/coffee, and some snacks were readily available, free of charge. so far, so good, but.... the whole lower floor of the house is converted into airbnb rooms with the aforementioned shared kitche and bathroom. and i just hate to say this, seeing that the host is so nice, but the whole place was just not....clean. ☹️ i am no prude, but hair in the bathroom, gunk on the stove, musty smelling room, dirt in corners, etc. extremely noisy when hosts walking on floor upstairs where they reside. oh well,survived the night.
thank you for all! it was a quiet and nice stay there (for 2 months)! sara was very helpful and ready to answer to all my questions and needs! very kind for the check out! all the best!

close to jfk terminal which is good for flyin one thing which can be improved is the marking to show where the bath room switchs are that was a little trick puzzle to find out. worth the money, clean neat place.

my stay was wonderful! i love how close this hotel is to so many good restaurants and things to do. i was able to find street parking as well which is always a plus. the staff were friendly & the hotel is about a 20min walk to time square. great location!

we had a wonderful stay. the apartment’s location is ideal, incredibly central and surrounded by great restaurants and things to do. the place has a nice layout and was very clean. as it is a garden apartment the place does not get a lot of light, but we were out and about all day, so this did not bother us at all. we would definitely stay at richard’sagain.

this was a perfect place for our family of 6. we loved the location especially— having both great restaurants and a trader joe’s within a couple blocks, not to mention the proximity of the subway station, really helped.

we had a wonderful stay at j and lana's home. if you are looking for a place near nyc this is a great choice. the room was comfortable and clean and we felt very at home. we loved the neighbourhood and the proximity to the subway station was so convenient. getting into the city was easy and after a long day exploring the city we really liked going back to a nice quiet neighbourhood. we enjoyed the rocking chairs on the front porch a couple of evenings.
space was modest and cozy. it’s central to main area.
stayed in georges appartement a couple of days. lovely space, neatly clean. totally recommended!
i enjoyed my stay in this quiet, immaculate room in a beautiful, tree-lined neighborhood. the location is ideal. highly recommend this listing.
definitely will be booking back here . the host is amazing
stayed again, beautiful place very accommodating and clean. thank you

great place and excellent cobble hill location with many fun places nearby. there are some walking distance indoor play areas for kids, delicious pizza/italian, grocery stores and of course bagel places all within a 5-10 minutes walk (2-5 blocks). there is a nice little spot in the bedroom that fits a kids pack and play perfectly for our toddler. jana was nice and helpful especially to accommodate us for an additional night when a crazy snow storm hit the area. can't wait to come back in warmer temps this year.
liz was friendly and helpful. she is artist and the room was clean and comfortable and the location was great for me. i hope i can still live in here next times.

location is great, and it's a clean, affordable hotel for nyc. contactless check-in was smooth and easy, and we enjoyed our stay. rooms are very small - we had to put our suitcase on the bed anytime we needed something from it because there was no other place to set it. but, the location and savings over other expensive places was worth it!

marie-line is a wonderful host! the space was super cute and well designed. great area. marie-line had a much appreciated hair dryer and a kettle, cups and selection of teas that made the experience really comfortable.

we loved staying in maya's apartment in greenpoint. lorimer street is close to a post office, drug stores, the garden market (on manhattan), ovenly bakery and paulie g's pizza on greenpoint ave., and the g subway line to downtown brooklyn (south), queens (north), and manhattan (either direction). the apartment, on two levels, is comfortable, clean, and well stocked. we felt at home there.
sharon was a great host! the apartment was very nice and the location was great.

my stay was extremely comfortable and contributed to make my first experience in new york so delightful! leanne is an amazing and precise host, and i simply loved the energy of the place. so grateful to have found this sacred space, see you soon leanne! :)
perfect stay for a night in the city. fit my family of 5 comfortably and walkable from penn station. would definitely stay again.

the apartment itself was lovely! it was beautifully decorated, clean and conveniently located close to the subway. andrada was an amazing host and has great attention to detail with all the amenities in the apartment and was really helpful and responsive during our stay to make sure everything was perfect. would highly recommend staying here!
elma and mike were gracious, kind, accommodating and flexible. the the nearby j train provided convenient access to manhattan. the room was fine, the mattress good, the a/c a godsend.

everything was amazing, clear instructions for checkin, just got a hard time opening the door of the unit (lol). didn't expect that the area will be in a chinese community which is i was a little bit afraid because of the ncov (just saying no offense). but when i see tang's place everything was good coz it's extremely clean and the room is beautiful!
staying in james' loft in williamsburg was simply beautful! the house is well organized, clean and spacious. the roof terrace has a gorgeous view of manhattan. i hope we'll back there soon!
great place, clean, bigger and cozy
very awesome host!!!
good location near subway station and columbia university. however the rooms are very not sound proof and it can be a little noisy at night but you get use to it.

staying at valerie, melanie and callie’s place was the best decision we made in our trip to ny. they are beyond kind and helpful, the place is clean, more amenities than any other place we’ve stayed and, the most important, very comfortable bed and pillows 🙂. the subway station is one block away and you get anywhere very easily, including jfk airport. honestly we felt at home, they were always very respectful, friendly and willing to give the best advice and recommendations. we will definitely keep coming back here!

it's an amazing location and the apartment is great for the price and location. the apartment has a nice couch that extends to a bed which is comfortable. i had to use a bucket to shower which was difficult to manage with two kiddos in the house. the hot water was coming out scalding and my kids were struggling to manage the temp in the shower, so i got a bucket to mix the water to get the right temp and we showered. i reached out to nathan and there wasn't much they could do so the bucket was the option i went with.
i enjoy my stay
the location is great and the place was perfect for us! clean, good light and spacious feeling!

my partner and i stayed at d's apartment for 4 nights and we really felt like new-yorkers. the communication with d was perfect before and during our stay. the apartment is as described, nice and convenient. the location is great with a citi bike station 2 blocks away.

small unit but more than enough if you plan on staying most of the day outside. check-in and check-out is completely contactless and that also means that no one will come clean your room during your stay. we plan on coming back to this hotel next time.

the rooms are very tidy and warm. you can get what you need in the room. victor is really nice, he would answer my questions quickly and provided me a lot of information about new york. this house is really close to the bus station so you can go anywhere with the transportation. i would recommend you to stay here.
sarah’s place is a cozy place to relax from the hustle and bustle of the city, and yet close enough to the train that you can throw yourself in the middle of everything just as easy.
apartment was exactly how expected i had a really great stay. the apartment is very clean & well designed. john is easygoing and well prepared for everything his guests need. 5/5

jacqueline’s place was great! i stayed for one night and didn’t have any issues..very private and clean apartment..was a little unclear about check-in, i was under the impression that it was self check in but i met jacqueline and she explained everything and made me feel at home..i would recommend to stay at her place. thanks again!

this unit is in a great location, near subways, great restaurants , prospect park, brooklyn botanic gardens and brooklyn museum. the bedrooms are large the space has beautiful historic woodwork, hardwood floors and original stained glass. the unit was clean and beds were comfortable and clean. fresh, soft towels. the kitchen is very small , but full size frig and oven along with microwave and small coffee maker. maurice was a great host, he responded to my questions quickly and provided check in information and greetings in perfect time. i think there could have been a few more lamps in the dining/ living area along with some extra comfortable seating. very quiet at night.
amazing location! clean room and friendly staff! definitely will return!
cherisse and patricia were warm and hospitable. the place was comfortable and filled with art. i wish i could have stayed longer.

ming was an amazing host! she was very flexible concerning the arrival time, which was great since i arrived a couple of hours later than expected. the room was very clean and cozy. ming made sure to always have some breakfast ready. her dog and cat are really sweet as well! definitely recommend this place!

fantastic apartment, tony is a very thoughtful host, lots of homely touches throughout the apartment, very clean and comfortable. it's located a stones throw from the metro/bus services, although i personally didn't get chance to check out the local stores i did see quite a few close by. on arriving in the usa i hadn't counted on my mobile internet not being available, tony had set up my check in clearly with a few pictures and some information making everything seamless regardless of me not having access to my phone the 24 or so hours prior to arrival. to conclude it's a great apartment and tony is a great host, my only regret is not staying a while longer.

we had an excellent stay at 17 john apartment. the location is incredibly convenient, with easy access to a variety of amenities and nearby subway lines. the lobby receptionists were consistently friendly and helpful, making us feel welcome from the moment we arrived. inside, the apartment was quiet and clean, complete with a well-equipped kitchen that had everything we needed. we would definitely return for another stay when we’re in town.
very clean, friendly environment, quiet and close to everything your need
great place. would book again!

east harlem does not appear to be the nicest area but we had no problems and felt very secure once inside. subway is right outside and there are convenience stores, a deli, pizza place, and a liquor store right outside.
jackee is easy to talk to! she’s responsive and makes you feel comfortable.

jermaine was a respectful host, and definitely enjoyed his company as we crossed paths. location is great for bushwick as it’s close to a number of cafes and restaurants. subway accessibility is within 5 min walking radius. lastly, room was peaceful + quiet in result of being away from the street. also the dedicated ac unit made sleeping in comfy. internet is super fast so i was able to get work done w/ no issues.

such an amazing place!!!! hands down the best i've stayed at in a long time. a calm neighborhood and easy access to everything as mentioned online. i didn't get a chance of meeting lolita but she was so helpful and easy to reach for any and everything.will absolutely stay here again in the future!!!!

greg’s place is fantastic! upon arrival we got a chance to chat with greg, who provided great subway tips for our trips into the city. while the subway into manhattan is about an hour, we felt it was a part of the nyc experience and not too bad. the location can’t be beat for subway access with a station right around the corner. additionally there’s a variety of food available up the at corner as well from caribbean to sandwiches. convenience store and laundromat are also easily accessible. the accommodations are more spacious than the pictures give credit. comfortable bed, decent pull out couch, table seating and nice bathroom. the tv’s were nice and the overall decor was pleasant. the bedroom’s former closet is a functional and nice workspace. the window a/c’s were effective but loud. the off street parking was plenty to fit our minivan rental and keep it securely away from traffic. we felt very safe, comfortable, and glad to be ‘home’ each time we returned after long days of sightseeing. i would highly recommend greg’s place.
tiffany’s place was absolutely wonderful! beautiful, convenient, and spacious. it was a great retreat from the hustle and bustle of the city every evening!

kenna’s place was awesome - great location, stylish, well equipped kitchen, super clean. kenna was really responsive and accommodating, allowing us to drop our bags before check in. heaps of local tips in the manual too! definitely recommend this place if you want to stay in brooklyn!

pollina's home was beautiful. she made it very easy to understand the check in process, and responded quickly available when we had questions. the neighborhood is conveniently located near public transportation, shopping, and restaurants.

alex’s place is a great small brooklyn apartment located in a calm yet well connected street to subways, cafes, restaurants etc. + all culture-related things brooklyn has to offer. alex communicated clearly, was always helpful and responsive; the apartment was clean, tidy and everything that is needed for a quick weekend stay was available. thanks a lot and definitely first place i’d look again for the next nyc trip.
wonderful place. very clean.

i went to ny with my husband, we recently married and the place was perfect for us, everything new, clean, and leandro is very organized, which is very good ! for us from miami, not used to ny , it’s a little bit small place, but enough to rest and have a good time ! thank you leandro for having us!
shemi's place was perfect for our long weekend in crown heights. great location in a safe neighborhood and within walking distance to everything we were doing.
ryan is an amazing host. his place is very clean and tidy. i felt very comfortable staying at his place and the location is perfect for getting to know manhattan. 100% recommended.
allyson was a great host and made me feel right at home! she is respectful, nice and friendly. i would stay here again!
great location! clean room. a little small so more than 2 people would be tight

nice apt and guest. safe and easy neighborough to stay and go to/from manhattam. no problem even late in the night with our 3 teens. bushwick makes you experience hidden places you'd rarely visit as a tourist and live a resident dimension.

mary and josh were definitely the best hosts! their brooklyn apartment was exactly as described and my boyfriend and i wanted to stay there for longer! everything was spotless when we arrived and they even left us bags of cereal and oatmeal as well as sparkling water which came in so handy. the location was perfect for us since we were in town for a brooklyn wedding and we would love to stay here again!
great stay as usual will always come back
location was great and lara took lovely care of me. very enjoyable!
perfect location for my time there.

bernadette is an amazing host! it felt like i was staying with a friend. i can tell how much love and care goes into making this a great place to stay at. the space beyond exceeded my expectations. it was a great location (right by the subway), super clean, and a very cute place to stay.
jovanna has a wonderful and spacious place to stay at. it's super clean and in a quiet neighborhood. lots of shopping and eateries nearby. we highly recommend staying here.

overall, i was very impressed with angelika's place and would definitely stay there again. it exceeded my expectations, since it is described as "shared" but in reality it is an entire self-contained apartment. it is very well-equipped, clean and beautifully decorated. the bed was very comfortable.
such an amazing apartment, location, and alex was as considerate a host as i’ve ever experienced. do not hesitate with this place. truly five stars.
i absolutely love coming here it’s my 6th visit and there’s more to come !! friendly environment and the rooms are always clean.

rafael is a very attentive and friendly host. the apartment is in close proximity to the airport, the 24hr. super market across the street and has the convenience of the bus stop that connects with manhattan. very practical place to stay.
place was perfect for what we needed. solid location and good communication.

the apartment is clean and very conveniently located close to penn station - so it was a great "home base" for exploring manhattan. although there was a hick-up when we arrived (mike was a little late and his cleaning lady had mixed up her "to dos" so the apartment was not cleaned, yet - but he then took care of it himself preparing the place impeccably!), mike was a good host and everything worked out fine. we liked the wooden floor, bed was good, kitchenette and - although rather old and small - bathroom were clean and functional, wifi worked fine. for our next stay in manhatttan, we will definitely check availability of the apartment again!

we loved it! stayed with our 3 boys for a holiday weekend. east check in, spacious, we found parking super easy. close distance to the train and restaurants. about a 50 min drive to times square and 45 minute train ride. everything you could need!
we loved the area and enjoyed our stay. plenty of space and comfort as a family of 4. traveled from the west coast and having air conditioning was a treat. would love to return!
room size, location and price point were great! highly recommend if visiting new york!

great place to stay in new york, close to the subway to go downtown. hosts are super friendly and very responsive. everything is as described and clean. definitely enjoyed my stay there and recommend it !
john’s place is great! nicely decorated, comfortable and well equipped. they neighborhood is great, with lots of restaurants, bars and metro nearby.

one of the best places i’ve stayed in with airbnb. such a cool neighborhood. very clean and very quiet for ny. we will be back. also has plenty of room for 2 or more people. plenty of ac units to keep the place nice and cool in the summer. this is our new go to stay next time we visit.
loved our stay at peter's place. the whole team was very responsive and extremely helpful. exactly perfect for what we needed.

we had such a wonderful stay here! the apartment was clean, beautiful and spacious! it was my wife's birthday and she was running the half marathon. garcia surprised her with gatorades and champagne. we highly recommend this place!

nice and quite neighborhood, nice room with ac, it would be better if there is a table or a desk... bed pillows were not clean and i experienced noises at 1am at the very next room where 5 or 6 people were spending the night in the same room. otherwise, the owner was comprehensive and helpful... thanks for the host.
great space and location!
great home to stay in brooklyn!

this was one of my favorite airbnb stays. the room was a great size, in a lively area, and hugo was a lovely host. his mother was so friendly and helpful as well. the private, spacious outside area was nice as well. i highly recommend this spot. a+++
great location, fun looking apartment, had everything we needed including a very dark and quiet bedroom so we slept well. would recommend!
absolutely loved my stay. staff were very friendly and accommodating.
clean, good location, comfy. loud and lively in the lobby. front desk was very kind!
perfect location for travel, surrounded by great spots to eat and the l train. great communication, perfect for what i needed
nice location & affordable. host was very personable and gave a warm welcome.
it fit exactly what i needed. thank you.

this place is absolutely exceptional in every sense of the word and the host, morlisa, is phenomenal! i cannot think of a single item that i needed that wasn't available or offered. the entire unit is spotless, well decorated, and comfortable. this is truly a rare find around brooklyn/nyc. i'll certainly have this at the top of my list of accommodations when i return to visit my hometown moving forward.
beautiful views. great location. perfect place to stay to experience nyc.

dawud has a perfect spot to be in new york but away from the craziness. the neighborhood is residential where neighbors smile and say hello. 7 minutes walk to the subway for a 40 minute ride to manhattan. inside the place was spacious with a full kitchen and bathroom all with updated finishes. we appreciated having a cozy place to return to from the city.

beautiful studio! great location! caring hosts with prompt and generous responses. i loved all the little touches like the abundance of quality teas, bar fridge, kettle. comfy bed. nice well lit room but can sleep in if needed. amazing base for a brooklyn art retreat or ny haven. suburb is beyond cool. yoga studio , grocery stores & cafes nearby. awesome culture. safe neighbourhood. easy to subway. chefs kiss honestly, thankyou !

you get what you pay for—very affordable for ny and the hosts were very kind and responsive. the room was quite small and there’s no elevator but the location and the hosts’ responsiveness made up for it. would definitely stay again!
the place was very nice and clean. it suited all of our needs perfectly.

location was ideal for our stay as we were attending a concert at forest hills stadium. — very easy to hop on the 7, e, f, m, or r trains! quiet neighborhood was nice. and the place was exactly as described.

we had a great 5 night stay at margaret's place! the space is so cozy and immaculate. margaret had filled the fridge and kitchen with lots of treats and snacks, which was so helpful for breakfasts and snacks after long days of sightseeing. the bed was extremely comfortable and we felt very much at home. thank you margaret!

we enjoyed our stay. arielle’s place is comfortable and is in a quiet neighborhood conveniently located close to the c train, which made it very easy to get around. as noted on the listing, the family lives above with children and you will hear them running around. we spent most of our time out and about in the city so this wasn’t an issue. we would be happy to return. thank you!

niko was a fantastic host, very friendly and accomodating. he made us feel right at home. everything was perfect and as described,the room was cozy, perfect for what we needed and in a good location. thanks niko for all.

i didn’t feel comfortable having to lie to other residents about not telling them i was there in an airbnb, as asked. i would have liked to use the roof terrace more, it was beautiful and the location was perfect

a beautiful, exceptionally clean space with great views of the city. convenient to all of your favorite restaurants and shops. rony has provided a wonderful place to relax and enjoy your getaway. wayne
great location and served its purpose for pride.
great stay!! friendly host and good neighborhood. would recommend
i stayed for 7 nights. i had a peaceful and wonderful stay. only one train ride into manhattan. i loved it.
great spot next to central park.

the place was amazing, quiet, and was stocked better than my own apartment with personal touches - you could tell there's a lot of thought that went into it! the snacks were great, the laundry machine was amazing, the deli a few minutes away was super clutch, and hind was the cherry on top - super polite, respectful and welcoming :)
i stayed for a month and everything was excellent. the room was great, and herman was always friendly, welcoming, and helpful. truly enjoyed my stay and will miss the cat :)

ms. anmarie’s space was as if we were visiting family,. it was warm and welcoming. the host even provided food & beverages in the fridge for our convenience. location was quiet and for a family of four this worked out perfectly. the host was communicative and kind & we recommend . thank you for hosting us.
cute spot in a convenient location. liliannna was very nice and accommodating. the space is just as listed. def recommend a stay here!
beautiful

john and ainslie are very kind! they went out of their way to make sure we felt at home. we were traveling from dc and unfortunately, our travel plans were canceled given the poor weather conditions. they were kind enough to not charge us for the night, despite only hearing of the delay hours before we were to check in. furthermore, their communication is amazing. i left a couple of things behind and they went out of their way to make sure i was informed. the place is lovely and adorned with beautiful paintings. loved the bathroom with great water temperature and pressure. the bed was very comfortable. the location was incredibly safe and beautiful. would recommend to all!
great deal! in the heart of flushing and receptionists were very kind :)
nice clean place. you just need to park car early before 8pm preferably.

untitled is a rare thing in new york tourism, impeccable value matched with an amazing location. so clean and the staff are so awesome. kind and helpful but invisible. the free coffee and pastries in the mornings are so delicious and such a nice touch and the rooms are so quiet and well designed. i thought it was a rare and unique hidden gem.
good amenities, spacious unit, convenient location to subway station. thank you!
emmory is a great host. excellent communications, very clean and nice accommodations in a great location. i would definitely go back!

the apartment oozes character and history. it has wonderful high ceilings, fabulous artwork, an epic fireplace and plenty of space. kyle and chelsea were charming hosts and very quick to respond to any queries.
the staff were super friendly and accommodating. the room was nice and clean. i would stay here again!

we had such an amazing stay at this airbnb! this was our second unit experience and it was absolutely perfect for our needs. the host was incredibly accommodating, welcoming, and made everything so easy from start to finish. we especially loved that it’s pet-friendly, which made traveling with our family even better. the kitchen was thoughtfully stocked with all the basic essentials, and the wifi was excellent—perfect for both the kids and working parents. everything was clean, comfortable, and truly felt like a home away from home. our kids felt right at home, which made the entire experience even more enjoyable. we couldn’t have asked for a better stay and would 100% recommend this place to anyone. we will definitely be back!
the apartment was amazing, everything it said it was. the only thing that was hard was that it was on the top floor(3 flights) and we had a member of our group that had a hard time climbing them.
everything about peter’s place was awesome, we loved our stay
michelin’s was as described, very accessible to commute to and from, the q4 bus is just a few minutes walk i enjoyed my stay and she was always on hand to offer assistance and respond to request.
the stay was satisfactory/good. the place matched the listing, nice people. just almost an hour away from “the main city” but is accessible to public transportation.

joslin is of real help and quick to reply to any question. her flat is really spotless clean, quite cozy and well equiped. very comfortable bed. access is rather easy. yet the surrounding is really noisy, trains from close line even at night, police cars and fire engines, helicopters... if noise bothers you that might be an issue, if you expect to feel nyc as the city that never sleeps, that'll be quite the experience
very spacious and clean. location is great.

i had a great stay at edward's place. the place was clean and well kept. the host was super responsive and incredibly helpful. it's a great location and a wonderful house, new appliances, clean and well maintained place. the office room was a big bonus with a standing desk. thanks to yiting for all her help, very thoughtful and made many local recommendations. they were very flexible with my check out. one of my best stays and a great host. i highly recommend it and i look forward to coming back soon.
thank you
beautiful place in a great location! highly recommend

we had a great stay. the room and the bathroom couldn't be cleaner, and the bed was really comfortable. also, it is literally 30 seconds away from the subway, which makes it pretty easy to get to manhattan. sigfus was a great host, very attentive and reachable, so i absolutely recommend the place.

i chose this location for its proximity to forest hills stadium for a concert. the location was very good, and i was able to find street parking - a huge bonus! alberto greeted us when we arrived and was very good about communication before and during our stay. the room is just like the picture, although one of the beds was very squeaky. you do have to share a bathroom with other guests but it was never a problem for us. we were unable to lock the room from the inside - but i did not complain about it. we got in late and just put a chair up against the door. perhaps i just did not pull hard enough to secure the lock. the only other thing i would recommend is to inform guests on where they can dispose of larger trash (we had pizza delivered and i hated leaving the box in the room but didn't know where else to put it!). we would stay here again.
great area!

great apartment in a quiet location, close to trains and restaurants. we enjoyed the sun-lit apartment and assianti and her husband were extremely accommodating. great choice when choosing a place to stay in brooklyn.
great little spot in the city for a night or two, will definitely consider next time i’m back!

we had a good stay at bobbi’s place. we were there for us open so since the subway station was really close by it worked out really good. bobbi left us some nice snacks and communicated very well. our room was cozy and comfortable. we got to know sweet shazzy. everyone else there was really nice.
allah was very accommodating for my check-in, the apartment is very spacious, and very quite. would book again.

jess was a great host -- i highly recommend this apartment! jess made it easy for us to find the location and get in without issue. the place was clean and jess made it feel like a home away from home. the apartment is very spacious, especially with the private patio out back. easy subway access or simply wander out the front door for so much that williamsburg has to do. we hope to stay again soon!
great stay, short walk to manhattan beach, brighton beach, and coney island. very close to transit.
amazing location, great host. i felt very safe at this apartment as a single woman traveling alone.

[the host] cristina is absolutely wonderful! she's quick to respond and extremely easy to communicate with. she made the stay for my bridesmaids so easy which made them feel right back at home for a few days. she's organized and provided the information we needed to check-in which made the check-in process that much easier upon their arrival. she is also the most thoughtful host i've ever experienced (she wrote a little hand written note for my bridesmaids!). [the place] the home looked exactly like the photos that i fell in love with. it was clean, spacious, and adorable! all the amenities that she listed were on there, and then some. there were little board games in the drawers by the bed, fun activity books, the place was decorated with the cutest decor. & huge props to collecting all the take-out menus that bell blvd. had to offer! 100/10 recommend if you're looking for a place to stay.
the place was very nice, clean, spacious, close to supermarket, restaurants, will definately recomend and be back

we could not have had a better stay at john’s place. he is a wonderful communicator and was very helpful whenever we had questions. we like feeling like we are at home when we are on vacation and john’s place made us feel that way. a soft place to land after many miles walked in brooklyn and manhattan. the home is located in a wonderful neighborhood near many restaurants and parks. there is a great farmers’ market on sundays. make sure you check it out. it is also located near a subway stop, which made it very convenient to get to and from manhattan. the neighborhood is very safe. we felt quite comfortable walking around at night. there were just two of us staying this time, but it would be comfortable for a larger family. we will definitely stay here again the next time we head back to ny. thanks again, john!

the room is in basement so the smell is inevitable especially because the basement floor is hard to vent out the old air, necessarily humid. the air is really stuffy and stinks the lighting is really bad and it is worse because the sunlight is barely coming in. it is very depressing during the day and night too. the kitchen is there but there is nothing you could use but the microwave. no plates, no utensils (other than plastic fork), no pots or pans, no oven use, no stove use, just microwave. be aware that cooking here is not doable . the shower curtain smells sour and needs to be changed or at least washed. it is hard to fall asleep because you can literally hear someone in the next room yawning or snoring and also because the front door open light is constantly on and off all night and the window blind is not enough to cover it. make sure you have eye masks chang was responsive. you get what you pay for. the coffee provided was nice. no more than one night i recommend.
they charge an additional $70.17. $30 of which is a deposit which i understand and the other $40 is for more taxes and fees after the $50

gabriel's studio is perfectly located, super close to a few different subway lines and in an amazing part of town. lots of restaurants nearby and things to do. you can be in manhattan in 20 mins by subway. the apartment was clean and comfy. would definitely stay again.

"menachem's place was absolutely fantastic, and the location couldn't have been better. this accessible apartment is on the third floor (please note that there are stairs only). the kitchen is stocked with all the essentials you could possibly need. the apartment offers fantastic value for its size, especially given its prime location in nyc. i would without a doubt choose to stay here again."

milton is the best host!! i can confirm all of the other glowing reviews. he is so welcoming, helpful, and genuine, and the very few times i needed anything he was there in a matter of minutes. the place is extremely clean, comfortable, and exactly as pictured. the bed is very comfy and the kitchen is well-equipped. i would definitely stay here again!

wow! i’ve stayed in several airbnb rentals, and as far as attention to details to make the guests feel comfortable, heather’s is the best. from the phone chargers in every room, to asking what we needed, and putting some half and half in the fridge for us, heather provided everything that we needed, and things we didn’t know that we did! the apartment itself is charming and cozy. the decor made me happy, and the beds helped me go to sleep instantly. parents and kids had their own spaces, which makes for happier travelers. easy access to the subway system made it easy to get around town. there are plenty of delicious restaurants in the area so that you could support local businesses and avoid the crowds before going to a show or a tour. if i come back to nyc, i will definitely stay at heather’s again!

rochel is easily the friendliest and most responsive host i’ve encountered. her place was perfect for our needs. we were traveling with adults and small children and the toys and books available for kids were absolutely perfect. i was also impressed with the amount of space we had. no one ever felt like they were on top of someone else. it was a great landing pad for our trip.

george was an excellent responsive host, and the space was comfortable - lots of light, wood floors, and amazing art. easy access to subway, as well as to a beautiful green space nearby (the grounds of the morris-jumel mansion). recommended, and hope to stay again! thank you, george!

the apartment is clean, well appointed and in a great location. however, what stood out to me the most is the care andre showed in making sure our check-in was easy and secured. we arrived in the middle of the night, and andre stayed up until i let him know we were safely inside. i knew that if we needed anything he was there for us. that's priceless.

this was a great place to stay. the location is fantastic, there were so many great places to eat within walking distance. the private bathroom and room air conditioner were super nice as well. would definitely look to stay here again if we’re ever in the area
we loved our stay with gabriel in his beautiful airy apartment, he was very helpful and it was very comfortable and clean - we would highly recommend!

this apartment is in a great location in brooklyn and would be excellent for a long-term stay. the kitchen is amazingly well-equipped and washer/dryer are top-notch. the hardwood floors are lovely. the "garden" is more of a paved patio with a basketball hoop, but there are some plants there. we enjoyed our stay and it totally met our needs.
michael is the best! a cozy home in a great neighborhood by everything you need! would recommend.

the appartement is perfect, clean, good beds, really nice furniture and equipment. between the two bedrooms is no door but it didnt matter for us. vida is really nice, communication worked very well. and its a great neighborhood.

i had an amazing stay at this airbnb. the space is beautiful and perfect. it’s an extremely clean and trendy apartment, the bed is one of the most comfortable beds i’ve ever slept in, the desk and computer chair were comfortable to work from, the coffee maker and mini-fridge were great, and he provides you with snacks for your convenience which is extremely kind of him. this place is extremely close to manhattan on the f train which was great. frantz, the host, was such an amazing host and a great person to speak to the entire trip. he is very responsive with immediate calls and messages back, on top of being a wealth of knowledge on food and places to eat here in brooklyn and in manhattan. perfect stay and perfect location. highly recommend and would stay here again in a heartbeat. 👌

this is definitely another great listing in staten island. ayman is a great host. he is responsive to our text messages and does all he can to make our stay enjoyable and comfortable. located in a quiet yet safe neighbourhood, the room is warm, spacious and spotless with cable tv and a well-equipped kitchen. supermarkets, costco and the st. george station are all reachable within 10 minutes of driving. a good location to stay if you are planning to visit nyc. thanks again for having us, ayman!

the apartment offers a truly relaxing stay. the decor is amazing and there were thoughtful touches throughout the entire place. it is a fully equipped apartment that had everything (and more) that i needed for my stay. there are many comfortable corners to relax or to work and d was responsive to my queries. checking in and checking out was a breeze. her husband was amazing and i suggest that when booking to take advantage of the pickup service offered from the airport. one thing i really loved about the place was the balcony off the living room and the bedroom - it was very inviting and it’s the perfect place to enjoy a glass of wine at the end of the day. i wholeheartedly recommend d’s place and am looking forward to returning.
arthur’s place is a great stay. i really enjoyed the comfortability.
sam was very helpful, flexible with check in/check out times, and a prompt and friendly communicator. thank you for a great stay!

super easy check in. don was very responsive and easy to communicate with. he also brought over extra towels and let us check in earlier as we had an early morning arrival. very kind of him and it was much appreciated!! clean place, shower head pressure was perfect and water heated up quickly. comfortable bed. room stayed warm. great location, just a 5 min walk to the subway station!! about 40 min to get into the city. safe neighborhood. i would definitely stay here again

as frequent nyc visitors, this is one of the best locations to go out and experience the city. lots of hip bars, restaurants, and things to do just around the corner. marc's place is small, but cozy and clean.
great home and location! everything you need is in walking distance and the neighborhood is beautiful. will stay again!
amazing host, beautiful space 12 min walk from ferry. totally recommend this place
great little place, a bit expensive, but worth the stay because it’s close to the airport
place was way better than i expected
robson’s a good host, clean room, easily accessible by train.

great stay! extremely responsive and helpful host, incredible front desk staff, and room was exactly as described and very clean. front desk staff accommodated early check- in and was able to hold some luggage for me after i checked out before coming back to my next stay (with this host in another room). area is by major trains lines- 5 minute walk to acg lines, 2,3 lines, and qr. 15 min walk to barclays center with more train lines.

we stayed at the magnolia house while visiting manhattan. it was a perfect venue logistically for us. for our daily trips into new york, we only needed 30 minutes each way, got a free ride on the ferry into new york and enjoyed a fresh sea breeze and spectacular view each way. the home is a brisk 10 to 15 minute walk to the ferry entrance. i have been to nyc many times and can't imagine a better or more stimulating way to come into the city than this. we flew into lga, taking the q70 bus and r-train down to the ferry entrance at the tip of manhattan (whitehall-south ferry). it was actually easy to navigate, but a bit longer than uber or cab, but not burdensome for us. if you don't like walking, there is a bus route from the ferry that stops in front of the house. if you come with a car, the home is easy to find, and comes with private parking. our experience with our hosts was one of the best parts of our visit. it was like a visit to old friends. they were very welcoming, accommodated our food diet needs and breakfast times, which varied each day. the breakfasts were well prepared and perfect for our needs. we had lengthy (i hope not burdensome to our hosts) conversations with both darwin and danforth about life, culture, religion, politics. it was edifying and fascinating, even where we might not have agreed, and gently offered. their life stories are riveting. they made genuine offers of assistance to us throughout our stay. their home is beautiful, and spacious. one of the other occupants is a wonderful dog that has free reign. we love dogs so this was actually a plus for us, but if you have allergies, probably not a good fit. this was a high value stay for us. we occupied three bedrooms and had absolute comfort and privacy at a costs that was spectacularly less than staying in or even around manhattan.

great place to stay in nyc. very clean and in a good location for exploring the city. short walk to the subway and many places nearby for shopping and eating. very friendly and welcoming host who made us feel right at home. jeffrey offered many suggestions and was quick to respond. highly recommend staying here.
excellent place with tons of room, boombox, coffee maker, solid mini-fridge, and the water pressure for the shower is amazing. there was also a half rack of beer in the fridge so shit lol.

a group of boys came into the building at 3am clapping, yelling slurs, and stomping. they were also throwing food all over the stairs. because i was unable to contact the host, and so i had to confront the rude guests myself. i knocked on their door and told them off, and how i had already recorded and reported them to airbnb, and they retreated. this is a fantastic place to stay, but just understand that you will have to deal with problems like these on your own, as there is not a 24/7 phone line to contact the host/groundskeeper. other than that, amazing location, anthony bourdain's favorite pizza place is right around the corner, as well as a cheap convenience store, and restaurants/bars. this listing is perfect for two people that plan to be on their feet for the majority of the trip. no common space, however there are basic living amenities, and comfy beds. when they are awake, the hosts are very responsive and reasonable. incredible value for the location and quality.

highlights of new york include the empire state building, the chrysler building, the statue of liberty. all pale, once in the presence of danforth prince and darwin, your hosts of magnolia house. we traveled from australia to visit new york. next time we will do the same to visit magnolia house and all within. rock on.

everything was perfect. stephan and ashely are two wonderful people with a good heart. we also spent time together. the location is very convenient within walking distance of the metro and in the heart of williamsburg, the room is super clean and you feel right at home. good vibes and definitely recommended, you won't regret it❤️

we really enjoyed our 4 night stay in jinha's space. the apartment is a very comfortable place to relax and it's well located to shops and the subway. the neighborhood of park slope is ideal if you seek a place with a community feel and with many dining options.
great apartment and really lovely hosts! we enjoyed our stay and the bagels & conversation very much
this was my first time in ny and felt very safe and at home. jaleh and her daughter were very welcoming and kind. i’ll definitely choose it again when visiting ny in the future!

manny and gemma were really helpful and friendly, their dog cusca is wonderful too! they were flexible with our check in/check out times which was super helpful. lovely area and the room was great! would definitely stay again and recommend to friends. thanks for a great stay!

this is a fantastic new york brown stone apartment, that is well equiped for a family stay. it is within easy access of the metro and a number of local shops and restaurants. we had a fantastic holiday and kate made an excellent host.
great place for a quick trip. loved being in a neighborhood to get a glimpse into the culture besides being in a touristy spot. felt right at home.
great place, clean and very well located ! the host is very reactive and communicates easily !
comfortable, clean, private room with a fully equipped kitchen and a clean bathroom. i enjoyed my stay. lillian was helpful and obliging. i would stay again.

vitaliy is a great host, so friendly, always responsive and ready to help. his place is clean and comfortable and perfectly located, walking distance to theatres (gershwin theatre is across the street), concert halls, central park, and times square. perfect place to stay if you want to see midtown on foot!

we found cando's place to be as described, and it was very comfortable, conveniently-located, clean, and easy to find and access. we appreciated the oatmeal in the kitchen, so that we could get a quick breakfast before heading to jfk airport for early-morning flights. because this is a space in a shared building, we could hear some talking, walking, and maybe tv sounds coming from next door, but these things didn't bother us, and we slept well and awoke to a quiet house.

second time staying with lavonne and it is even better than the first. the renovations to the space provide a clean, comfortable, and relaxing stay. thank you one again for a wonderful weekend. lavonne is a responsive and attentive host that made sure we had everything we needed at all times.
great location, check in was smooth & very easy, thanks to host's detailed instructions. comfortable accommodation

my second time staying at this wonderful home and can't wait to stay again! the hosts are super accommodating, always responsive, and helpful! the home is clean and spacious and comfy, the neighborhood has a ton of gems, and the location has great access to the transit system to get to anywhere you need in nyc! highly recommend staying here!

the hosts were responsive and friendly. the host also sent instructions a day prior and did a check-in to ensure a smooth transition for us. it's a great neighborhood with plenty of food spots and cafes within walking distance. the subway is also easily accessible. overall, a decent place to stay.
lexia gave us an amazing stay and provided great recommendations!

i spent two lovely weeks here and it really felt like a home from home. the cottage is exactly as i pictured it -- comfortable, peaceful, and in a convenient spot for downtown brooklyn and manhattan. sarah and allon are great hosts and i would definitely recommend it.
was a really nice place to be, very close to the train station and buses, very quiet area ,you have a lot of restaurand around and a nice park to walk and visit, we really enjoy our days there..
great place to stay!

kim’s apartment if just nice, the place is clean and has everything we need for a good stay. communication with kim was really good, she always answers. the location it’s just perfect, near subway stations and there a lot of cool restaurants and bars nearby.

so glad we choose alaric's airbnb! communication with alaric was great. we arrived to brooklyn early and alaric was very accommodating in greeting us and letting us drop our bags while we went out and enjoyed our day and evening. great guy as well as his partner anne. we let them know we would be up early for a run in prospect park and coffee set-up was waiting when we woke up. loved the house tour and yes, we will be back for a longer stay in the spring.

the apartment was super cute, comfortable, and perfectly clean. we loved the decoration and feel of the space. all the practical things we needed were there (all the basic kitchen stuff you could ask for, lots of very nice towels, soft bed sheets, extra blankets and a very comfortable bed). the neighborhood is great, full of great restaurants and bars, very convenient and close to transportation. emma was a good communicator, very responsive and helpful. highly recommended!!!

location, location, location!!! 3 blocks from washington square back and 3 major subway stops. great foodie options in the area and minutes from the hudson river parkway. the place doesn’t get direct sunlight, so after rain the garden is damp and it can feel like that in the apartment a bit too. but you have a quiet garden in the afternoons- great for a quick workout and edison lights for the evening- for a glass of wine. having a dishwasher and washing machine are fantastic and any issues i had (dusty chandeliers, repair to the bathroom fan, etc 🐭) james was a text message away and very responsive. also, his art is such a great touch to the apartment! comfy beds, a great host and a can’t-be-beat location.

the place was great and very close to the train station. also there are some supermarkets around. its great that you have private kitchen and bathroom helpful to save money. richard was very kind trying to make us feel comfortable all the time.

mark’s place was amazingly to stay at. i stayed with a friend so we each had a room to ourselves. the place is really private and spacious and mark was always there with quick responses when we had any questions or needed anything. really glad we found this place. the train station is a short walk and there’s a shop very close and some amazing take outs near by!
as my first time using airbnb i did not know what to expect but christine was very accommodating as a last minute stay plus the water and snacks were a plus

this place was great! so adorable and not from the subway. we really enjoyed our stay and it worked perfectly for our trip to new york. it was a great a place to come back to after some very long and exhausting days.

this was the first time i used air bnb so i was nervous but my experience surpassed all expectations. the place is true to the photos exactly and was more than enough space for me. darya made it feel like it was my apartment. the apartment is located in a great place, couple of minutes from central park and great subway connections. the best part was darya, she's so considerate and is a great host. she also knows so much about new york and great places to see. i will be coming back here next time i am in new york.

house was exactly as photographed so had no issue there. there was a gas smell in kitchen, temperature was all over the place, freezing downstairs and too hot upstairs and the house made lots of noises at night time. i had to contact doris a couple times to get code to enter house 45 minutes after check in which i should’ve had that information beforehand.
great location by trains and quiet neighbors!!!
space was clean and host was responsive and accommodating. lovely quiet neighborhood.
the host was really nice and the appartement had a good location. unfortunately the appartement wasn‘t that clean, but we had no problem to handle it.
a beautiful top floor apartment in a lovely 3 story walkup. the space was spotless, the appliances were brand new, and maurice was kind and attentive. i'll definitely be coming back!
host is nice, the place is very convenient. highly recommended!
nice easy stay for one night. the space is bigger than appears and feels extremely separate from the rest of the house.
peaceful, clean apartment as described. hadiza goes out of her way to make stay comfortable with lots of cute little flourishes.

we had a great time staying here . the apartment was good size, well maintained , decorated and was very clean . there was enough living space for our group as well as kitchen equipped all basics. towels , bedding , toilet paper etc were all provided . assad brother was very friendly and accommodating whenever we were in contract . we were also very greatful for the air conditioning unit and car parking . this appartment is perfect for vacation .

the space was very clean and comfortable. the home has all the amenities that we could have possibly needed and is very close to public transportation. the neighborhood was quiet, and the other people sharing the space were quiet as well. we had a great trip and would definitely stay again the next time we are planning a vacation!

shelley’s place was perfect for myself and two sisters . as described, really comfortable, well equipped and great location and so quiet for being in nyc!! shelley gave us some great restaurant recommendations and we loved the bed- stuy neighbourhood. we will be back.

i loved my month in margaret and david's loft. really cozy and comfortable place. when in the kitchen i enjoyed looking out on the street and the police station and people watching. the skylights in the bedroom and the bathroom were fantastic—if i had to get up in the middle of the night there was always just enough light to see and not have to turn on a bright light. the artwork on the walls and in the hallways of the building made the place feel homey. and it was quiet and peaceful. the 7 train stop is right on the corner and so quick to get into manhattan. margaret and david were super communicative and kind hosts. really just a perfect experience all around.
i definitely suggest this place! i am a family of 3 and my daughter loved it! they even have small cups and bowls for little ones to eat. very clean and neat!

i had an amazing stay at ola's place. right away he made me feel right at home and was extremely welcoming. he is a very friendly and helpful host. the room was a good size and felt very comfortable. the house is only about a 7 minute walk to the 2 train which takes you right to downtown manhattan. the area felt very safe to walk around in during the day and at night. i would defiantly love to come back to ola's place in the future!
very nice apartment at washington heights, nice neighborhood, two subway lines nearby
everything was smooth and as expected hassle free

second time staying at this resort and it won’t be my last. it’s located just center from everything one is interested to see in ny. there’s a train station entrance right by the hotel to get you going on your way. the staff is very helpful and friendly!

i stayed in the apartment for 45 days and i had no problems during all this period. easy check in. all the facilities for the first days were provided. the host answered all my questions really quickly. the neighborhood is excelent, safe and close to the carl shurz park. it was easy to get to the main touristic attractions in manhattan through the q line or m31 bus (bus stop in front of the building, just across the street).
good apartment, nicely sized and comfortable.
sheena is a great host - super friendly and quick with responses in terms of communication. the check-in process was seamless. the location is easily accessible to the subway and bus system.

stayed for one night and would stay here again. the room was perfect for my short stay. the bed was comfortable and there was more than enough room for 2 adults. it’s about a 5 minute walk to the subway. i would recommend this home to anybody in nyc for a short weekend stay.
anadis was very helpful, and the place was exactly as shown, very cozy, toasty warm, with everything needed for the stay! thanks again!

liubov’s place was exactly what i needed while in brooklyn. it was perfectly described and very accessible to multiple train stations. it is also walking distance to williamsburg and bushwick where there is many shops, cafes and hip restaurant/bars. i was there visiting with a friend and although we didn’t spend so much time in the apartment we loved coming home. we didn’t see much of her but the time we did cross paths she was most friendly. i would definitely recommend it to anyone visiting brooklyn.

alex's place worked perfectly for me, especially the location in red hook. alex was very helpful in orienting me on some interesting cultural venues. i appreciated that she took my reservation at the busy thanksgiving period. she was very kind accommodating my late check in (my bus was almost an hour late arriving in nyc). alex's place is clean and comfortable. a great experience all the way around.
comfortable, stylish and cosy. a perfect apartment for our stay - it had everything we needed and was great to come back to after busy days out.

i met ari only briefly when i arrived. i found him cordial and helpful. he made himself available and was responsive when i contacted him with a question. my brother, son and i were in town to liquidate the estate of my aunt who had just passed. our days were long and hard and having ari's lovely place to return to at the end of the day was incredibly supportive to our well-being. his place is wonderful: loved its spaciousness, decor, light, cleanliness. it was also very convenient ( walking distance to everything we needed) . i couldn't have asked for a better place to spend our nights in manhattan.

louann was a great host. due to 4 times delayed flight, i was able to check in almost at 1.30am and she was super friendly. her place is just as described. relatively far to tourist attractions but close to public transport. my wife and i used mostly train station so it was not a big deal. the neighborhood was quiet and safe. i definitelly recommend for 1-2 days trips. the room was comfortable, it has almot everything. i really loved the coffeemaker and high speed internet :)

we had a good experience. we only met claude when we were getting ready to leave on the last morning. he did send a number of texts during our four night stay to make sure we were comfortable. the location was perfect, a block off of times square and near literally everything. i would not want to be any closer to the main streets as the noise would have been unbearable. the apartment is really simple, compact and was as described. we did not spend much time in the apartment so did not mind the close quarters. upon arrival we found a bowl of treats and drinks for our use - that was great. claude also gave us a portable wifi hotspot which was quite handy since we could take it with us to use in the city. to be fair in this evaluation, the apartment is very basic, the bathroom is very small and dated, and the noise from the streets permeates through the room so it is not quite inside. for us, none of this was that important as the location was perfect. i would stay here again.

beautiful brownstone with incredible interior architecture. favorite part were the two huge bay windows on either end of the unit! lovely for remote working and relaxing on the porch. location was a block from franklin, tons of bars and restaurants. would recommend staying here to explore brooklyn/nyc!

josh and victoria were very kind and very responsive. they were attentive and good host. the airbnb was very cute, looks just like the photos. there were a few hiccups during my stay but josh and victoria were very quick to attend to the issues and resolve it the best they could. the j is a 5 min walk away while the m is about 10 mins away. a grocery store, bakery, and bagel shop are also all in a 5 min walk. a very convenient location!
great location and very nice apartment. everything was perfect - shane is a very gracious host.

there is no reason not to book michael's place. i spent a full month staying with michael, with no problems at all. michael has been a great help, giving great recommendations and helping out with day to day question. the place is clean and stylish. the room is perfect for someone travelling for work, with a height-adjustable desk, a secondary display and a comfortable desk chair. the bed and bedding are of high quality and super comfy, i was pleasantly surprised. the room was always warm, even during the coldest nyc days. the apartment is packed with smart home tech like google home, sonos speakers, a smart tv (netflix, hbo), air purifiers, and time scheduled lights. the kitchen is fully stocked and cooking is easy, although michael can recommend some great restaurants to eat out in ;) - tip: ask him about his favourite ny pizza places. i had the pleasure of walking churro a few times, a loving little french bulldog puppy with a lot of affection to give. a great burst of welcoming excitement when you get back home every day. will book again.
highly recommended! clean and very quiet.

stayed here for a long period—could not recommend it more! fantastic placement next to the 7 and hudson yards is a great place to be. the space itself is a great use of space and very clean. d is an amazing host; he was extremely responsive and went out of his way to give us a good experience. could not recommend this place enough!
great location. repsonsive host. very private

mahmood and his wife were gracious hosts. i enjoyed interacting with them. very communicative, room is exactly as described and bed is very comfortable. would definitely recommend to anyone who is considering staying in staten island.
really good location near to the city center. good choice!
lovely convenient stay in some of the funnest neighborhoods in manhattan
good place, but kind of small. if you’re looking for somewhere to stay for a short stay it’s perfect!
beautiful, comfortable, cozy home! would definitely stay again, and recommend this to my friends and coworkers

we loved jenny's place. the apartment is beautiful and modern. the bathroom is lovely and sparkling clean. she was an incredibly accommodating host. we stayed with two kids, 7 and 9. she set up an air mattress in the main room for them and we let them fall asleep in the bedroom before while we enjoyed her record player with a great selection of music. it is an easy walk to the subway and then a short ride to manhattan. pro tip, the tv in the living room doesn't have cable or other entertainment that we could find, but it does have a chromecast device, so you can easily use your computer or android phone to watch whatever you like through the tv. one other note, there isn't a wide variety of nice places to eat within a short walk, but we found great options on nostrand and flatbush which are a longer walk, or an easy uber ride away.
staying here was perfect for us!
unbelievably welcoming host and great access to anything you could possibly need!
great host, smooth process, immaculate apartment. will always recommend this place.
bernardo and andressa were great hosts! their place was clean, modern and super close to the subway.

great location ! there is everything you need near apartment, subway is within walking distance. a pleasant, understanding host, ready to help and solve your questions. the apartment looks exactly like the photo, it is well equipped, a good mattress, there is a fireplace and everything you need is inside. i enjoyed my stay at this place i recommend it 100%! thank you tal!
extremely satisfied with my experience. everything was as advertised. i would definitely recommend this place to anyone.

i couldn't have asked for a more comfortable, convenient, and beautiful place to stay during my time in brooklyn. (not to mention, it's a rare find to have so much privacy -- including a private bathroom -- for this kind of price and in such a sought-after area.) alaric and anne were gracious and communicative hosts, and i was blown away by the restoration work alaric has done in his home. i couldn't recommend his place more.
amazing location, next to the some oft favorite restaurants in the city. ed was very responsive and accommodating. apartment was very clean and the right amount of space.
the apartment was lovely and just as pictured.
what a gem! quiet and easily accessible to everything we needed. beautiful hospitality, scenic water views - we shall be back!

our stay was wonderful. carlos and yvette are spectacular hosts; they assist with everything we need, from umbrellas for the rain to suggestions for places to visit. the location of the house is very good, close to the metro, and you can easily reach all places from there. the room is great, with a comfortable bed, very quiet, and has everything you need. several freshly washed towels, soap, toothbrush, and shampoo were provided. our room had the bathroom right next to it, which was perfect. they have a fully equipped kitchen available for any use. on our last day, our flight was delayed, and carlos allowed us to use the house for a longer time, take a shower, and head to the airport. they are true hosts. we hope to return. thank you very much for everything!

great location, and clean building. close to subways and easy walk to anywhere downtown. my complaints are that the laundry facilities are terrible, only two of the washers work and several of the dryers are broken as well. the elevator was constantly breaking down or under repair. however, for the price, the location makes up for those inconveniences.

quiet room in brooklyn next to the subway station. the room was nice and clean, a bit small but the flat itself is spacious and well equiped. you may have to wait a bit for the bathroom as you will be sharing the place with two to five other guests. considering the market in ny, this is worth the price.
nice apartment and at an acceptable distance of a subway station.

great location in the middle of two different subway stations that can get you anywhere you need to go. i stayed here for a month and found it easy to navigate the area. there were great restaurants all around. also a quick walk to grocery stores if you want to stay in and cook.

the place is awesome, super clean, elegant and modern by far marinela has been the best host i have ever had , arrived very late at night and and she was able to provide us with things we needed for the kids like chocolate powder for the milk of my kids she saved the night the place is worth every penny + more i hope and is my wish that every person that stay at this place gets to be as happy we was thank you very much for everything marinela our family appreciated you beeing very friendly and kind to us .

maurice’s place is an excellent option for exploring brooklyn and greater nyc. finding a spacious two bedroom in an ‘up and coming neighborhood’ at a reasonable price is not easy but this place offers just that. i loved exploring crown heights and walking to prospect park with my son. i also had to commute to midtown for work several days and it was easy and quick. one thing to note— the kitchen is very tiny— essentially a corner alcove— this is common in nyc so i wasn’t surprised and for most people staying a short time it likely wouldn’t be an issue as you probably won’t cook very much anyway.

we just spent 3 nights at gary's 2nd floor apartment in the west village. the apartment is spacious, comfortable, and beautifully appointed. the bed was comfy, and the apartment is light and airy, and above a cafe with great coffee. it is convenient to the whitney museum, west village eateries and the 7th ave subway line. gary was very informative, and he communicated with us perfectly. although we did not meet in person, the pickup of keys went without a hitch. there are 2 things to be aware of in renting this place: there is a fair amount of street noise from 7th avenue (which gary mentions in his listing), so for light sleepers ear plugs may be an asset, and the apartment is a walkup, so heavy baggage may be awkward to get up the staircase. if neither of those is a liniting factor for you, this is a wonderful spot. i would stay here again in a heartbeat!

this was a great airbnb - so conveniently located in a great neighbourhood and had everything we needed for our stay. sylvia and neil were quick to respond when we needed to get in touch and were really flexible. we hope to come back!

i really enjoyed staying here. the apartment is well equipped, clean and comfy, and astoria is a super fun neighborhood. clara was very responsive and it was easy to get into the place. highly reccomended!
really nice host, clean place, no issues whatsoever. thanks!

the space is efficient for short stays. the neighbor seemed safe and quiet, within walking distance to bus stop, convenience stores, and a diner. the rental space was reasonably clean but that would depend on the cleanliness of the other tenants sharing the common spaces (everything except your assigned room).
easy area to get to. great place to stay and great host

michael and his family were nothing but incredibly welcoming, hospitable, and just kind people. the apartment itself is beautiful and spacious. it’s actually a very large space for brooklyn. any questions i had during my long stay here, michael answered within 5 minutes. the apartment is very well stocked, the bed is comfy, the kitchen is fully stocked and the bathroom is really nice and has a cool view. the closet is huge and was perfect. they are all incredibly kind people and i highly recommend this place for anyone staying in brooklyn. the host responds very fast, the place is spacious and clean, and the neighborhood is cool. highly recommend.
great location with restaurants and cafes nearby and situated very close to subway stations. clean and neat accommodation.

place was great, got an earlier check in and the host was very responsive. a great bonus was walking outside and seeing the chrysler building down the road and the empire state round the corner, helps that the 28th street station is close too. no view from a window, but no point staying inside when you get killer views from the street!
very nice apartment, would stay again!

i had a wonderful stay and was very grateful to how friendly and courteous both hosts were. the kitchen was well equipped and the bedroom with a private bath was great. i loved the neighborhood that is within walking distance from so many great spots, including ornithology jazz club. hotly recommend this spot to stay. very clean and comfortable.

this apartment is centrally located and spacious. the host provided a brita in the fridge that we really appreciated so we wouldn't need to buy large amounts of water. the host was also accommodating to our check out time.
great experience!
amazing location, home and host! will definitely return!
hosts were very accommodating and space was very tidy and welcoming. location worked really well
good stay. will recommend.

that was our first time staying somewhere with airbnb and it was wonderful :-). we loved blanca's apartment, it was bigger than we aspected, really nice, clean and modern. the location is perfect, just 5 min. walk to the subway (just 15-20 min. to downtown by the subway), supermarkets and some restaurants. blanca and teddy are so nice, were super helpful with everything, gave us a lot of tips, thanks a lot for everything :-) !!! if we come back to new york, we will definitely stay again with blanca and we will recommend it to our friends. thanks blanca and teddy!

nick's place is in the historic brooklyn neighborhood of bed-sty...brownstone homes...very authentic...i arrived at night and could easily reach a chinese takeout. there are supermarkets and delis close by. the home is cosy, functional and comfortable. amenities including kitchen utensils are thoughtfully selected with close attention to design. both the bed and the couch are firm and comfortable. there are several heaters. the subway is only a few blocks away and makes it easy to go uptown.

roberto was a wonderful and thoughtful host! he answered all messages quickly and checked in to make sure we were ok. the space was clean and comfortable. perfect for solo travelers or couples looking to stay away from the madness of the city but still close enough to enjoy everything nyc has to offer. highly recommend!
clean & safe environment. host responds quickly.
hotel was clean, comfortable and spacious. highly recommend
it was a great location and a great value! had some issues with the ac working that never really got resolved so it for pretty hot at night but besides that it was a great stay.

we stayed for two weeks from april to early may, and it was wonderful. the location is great—easy to commute to manhattan and the surrounding areas. the space was clean, and our flatmates were very kind!
this is the classic stylish nyc studio. quiet for nyc too. walk up wasn’t bad and it felt safe too. great location plenty of space - yes small kitchen alcove but it worked
super clean, great restaurant, people were extremely friendly and helpful while checking in and out.

our experience with this place was great. if you’re concerned that it’s a shared space, don’t be. the apartment has a layout where you’ll be able to experience privacy and comfort. a short 10 min walk (or less) from the j-train. plus, check in and out was easy and clear. we hope to be back soon! thanks emily!
everything was great. thank you for letting us use your nice flat.
highly recommend
loved the sight of this hotel . it was beautiful and moderate. i can’t wait to visit again !!! ☺️ had a great time with daddy ❤️😉

came to brooklyn for a family event and was not able to access the apartment because the lockbox was empty and didn’t have the key needed for entry. the host had an emergency contact who disputed our claims but when we sent her pictures of the empty lockbox she said she would send her daughter over with the key. my family and i waited outside for 2 hours in the heat, after traveling across country to be stranded on the street while being bitten by mosquitoes and no one came with the key. we eventually had to make other arrangements and it was then that the emergency contact’s daughter showed up with a key. host did not offer an apology for the inconvenience and when i disputed the charges, she lied and told airbnb that we accessed the apartment and we were denied a refund. she also alleges that the key was in the lockbox, both are untrue. if i could post a picture of the empty lockbox here i would. if there was a key, why would the contact need to send someone over. we sent her a picture of the empty box. i am planning to dispute this further up the chain of command. my family reunion trip was ruined. this could have easily been resolved had the key she said would be provided was actually in the lockbox. even though host says she can be reached, she never responds to texts or calls to the number provided. i couldn’t access the airbnb app and she would respond to my text to her number in the app(which i could read only in the email format and not respond to) bottomline, i can’t speak to the actual apartment itself because we never got in but the host was less than hospitable and rude. i would not recommend this place if you are looking for good service and a responsive host. stay here at your own risk!! it seems like the quality of hosts is going down using this service. i contemplated no doing this because she may respond in kind with lies but im willing to take the risk. people should know about this host. there is no real protection for airbnb guests.airbnb has lost this customer. going to try other services from now on.

heather is a superb host. she is the most communicative and considerate hosts we have ever experienced. she greeted my elderly mother in law at the entry and carried her suitcases up! the location of the apartment is fantastic, one block from the 1 subway train. the neighborhood is quiet but lively. i would recommend heather without reservation.
family friendly and clean. this listing is in a beautiful and friendly brooklyn neighborhood. the duplex itself is spacious and comfortable. lovely backyard space.

absolutely incredible. the reality looks like the photos: all of the furnishings are high quality with no expense spared. the kitchen area is fantastic, the bathroom is beautiful and luxurious and the bedroom very quiet and peaceful with a comfortable bed. nicolette was always on hand to answer queries. i booked my trip around when this property was available and i am so glad i did. i would certainly like to return in the future. not only is the property outstanding but williamsburg is a superb base - vibrant yet safe with lots of amenities and close to manhattan. thank you so much nicolette and nick.
