we really enjoyed the time here. it was super easy and not far to get to manhattan. 10/10 would recommend staying here

we can't emphasize enough what an amazing time we had at roxanne's place in brooklyn. the set-up was perfect for everyone in our two-family covid-conscious group. roxanne was incredibly helpful and really thought of everything as she planned and stocked this beautiful space. special touches like milk and juice, cereals and snacks were very much appreciated and the pool table, video games and treadmill were a huge hit. the location is great and parking was easy -- a perfect bed stuy home away from home! we can't thank roxanne enough for letting us stay at her place and hope to return some day soon!

the month long stay was great- alejandro is very helpful and you can rely on him to be there when you need it. the location is quite convenient, with plenty of restaurants in the immediate vicinity, and just a couple of avenues over from the lexington subway station. the room is really well furnished and comfortable, and no different from the pictures shown. on the whole, the host is quite easygoing, and you can be assured of privacy during your stay.

i had a bad experience. airbnb listing stated 2 queen beds, 1 sofa bed. property had 1 queen bed and a sofa (not a sofa bed). inaccurate listing was probably airbnb's fault and not the host. i couldn't get the tv to work and host was not as helpful as i would have expected. also, i couldn't get the stove to turn on but didn't bother to tell the host. i only received a $60 refund and felt it should have been at least $100 for the 3-night stay. overall, a bad experience!
it would be great if guest would be welcomed with at least a bottle of water
amazing ! just book,no doubt you won’t love it .
omar is a great host and he is super friendly!! my family and i are really enjoy staying at his place.

john's apartment is well located in ny's financial district. it is close to several subway stations and battery park is 5 minutes away. ditto the ferry terminals. the views from the flat are ok, with the roof of the building (45th floor) providing a stunning panorama of manhattan and the river. everything you need for your stay is in the apartment, and john is a responsive host - with many suggestions provided for what to do / how to get about etc. 3 of us easily fitted into the space available. so for both a business trip or a vacation stay, john's apartment is an excellent choice.
clean beautiful place. didn’t have a single disturbance. gave clear instructions.

this place was great! check in instructions were sent the day before; they were clear and easy to follow. the apartment is on street level but the windows had bars and the curtains kept anyone from peeking in. the place looked exactly how it did in the pictures; two large bedrooms, each with large comfy beds. the bed by the entrance room was a lot softer than the one by the bathroom. water pressure in the bath was good and we had no problems getting the hot water we needed. we didn't really use much of the kitchen but having a full fridge, microwave, and utensils came in handy. we came to nyc to attend a party at the hudson, which was only an 8 min walk from this place. we felt safe enough to walk to and from, even with a six year old. the surrounding area has lots of restaurants, fast food places, and stores. best of all, entrance to the subway was close; making a quick trip to the museum more convenient. tip: just make sure to confirm the address upon booking!
very quiet and if you ask you might be able to use the driveway!
place was much better then expected. super clean and had tons of privacy. highly recommended

such a great airbnb! great size and in a wonderful location. check-in and out was super easy and the apartment is lovely. definitely plan on staying here again and also have suggested it to friends with upcoming travels.
the shared areas, room 2 and the shared bathroom need a good cleaning, there was no coffee or cereals as described.

andre's place was fantastic! great location in a very diverse and multicultural neighborhood of brooklyn and close to trains and buses, excellent amenities ranging from fresh linens to a very spacious balcony, and excellent communication when i was having trouble with wifi. i highly recommend this location if you want a well-immersed new york experience.

our stay was outstanding, the area was safe and near a community school so sounds of children playing could be heard if you had your bedroom window open which i enjoyed most of the sounds the old building made as well as the sounds of the city. parking wasn't impossible. we originally parked one block down for most of the week which was actually quite close for parking. some cars were parked in the street which is a thing in some parts of nyc. mr.lucky greeted us as we entered the home, he was such a cute dog. he was always trying to steal my socks which i suspect was because it was his way of trying to keep me around longer. we never once felt uneasy or uncomfortable with our stay. we had a soft bed, fresh sheets and plenty of clean towels. a laundry mat was right outside the complex if we ever needed to do laundry which we ended up not needing. walking distance to a few grocery stores/parks/subway. 100% warm&cozy style home. 10 out of 10 i would stay here again.
ideally located at about 15 minutes walking from time square, this bedroom+ private bathroom is ideal for two people on a short journey to new york

morlisa’s place is amazing she has done a beautiful job with this place anytime i’m in nyc and her place is available i’m staying .. i’ve stayed in several great airbnb’s hers by far was the best .. the hospitality she showed was unmatched. the pics are nice but way nicer in person .. smell delightful comfy bed .. morlisa had wine and drinks stocked in the fridge. very detailed instructions and recommendations. and a nice welcome note. the communication was great from the time of booking until we left her beautiful home.. i wish i could give 10✨✨.. morlisa’s place is definitely at 10/10 for me!!
all the amazing reviews are true. aaron is that great. space was perfect for what i needed. highly recommend!

solid space that's right in the heart of brooklyn, walkable to public transportation, restaurants, cafe, bodega, and even parks! barbara's home is cozy, adorable, and refreshing with her plants. i recommend it to anyone who wants to make it easy to traverse anywhere!
we had a great stay at sharon’s apartment. the street is quiet and walkable to two subway lines. check in was easy and communication thorough. thanks very much!

dee's place is a lovely studio. it was very clean, and has more than enough room for two. it's located in a lively neighborhood surrounded by small shops and restaurants. there's also a convenience store feet away, that stays open until later than most that i've been to. dee was very quick to respond to any questions, and communicated that with upcoming matters, david will be there for us. david was also very quick to respond and attentive. a pleasant stay, with really good hosts. thank you dee and david.
a lovely place to stay, super helpful host and a metro ride into town. would stay again, especially as i want to explore brooklyn more.
it is a nice apartment，near to the subway station. filip and his roomate are very nice

there were a few things that didn’t work too well and the space needs a bit of maintenance but location was close to central park and met. lots of great restaurants around and super close to a subway entry as well. entering the space was a bit frustrating at first and you just had to try all the keys for each of the doors. the instructions to get in wasn’t super clear, atleast to me. color coding the key would have been helpful. the apartment door could use a new knob. i was afraid it would fall apart if i twisted it the wrong way. the bathroom tub didn’t drain properly and low pressure water in the kitchen sink made washing dishes harder. the accommodation was affordable however if you want to use it just to sleep and are not very picky with amenities. the bedroom themselves felt clean.
sarah's place is exactly as advertised, clean and bright and well appointed, comfortable, convenient and ticks all the boxes.
wonderhost! very approachable & his house is beautiful.
michelle is a wonderful host and i recommend staying here anytime. was very easy to communicate with and made my stay feel like home.

loved my stay with bp. they're so responsive and attentive. i stayed for a month initially and extended. i will definitely book with them in the future as well. the location: right next to a train station to take you into manhattan, literally on the corner, so the commute was great everywhere. there are a few stragglers standing outside throughout the night so just be aware of your surroundings. i never felt unsafe but just be mindful who's around. the unit: entering the building, there are two doors to unlock, so it provides an extra sense of security. to enter the unit, and your room, its a touchpad door lock and i love that because some bnbs i've stayed at don't have locks on the doors. the kitchen and dining area are cleaned a couple times a week by a cleaning company and they replenish the bathroom and coffee areas. the kitchen and bathrooms can get a little messy at times depending on the cleanliness of the other housemates, but i just brought extra cleaning wipes. 5/5!

this is a compact apartment which has about everything you need. cooking utensils, paper and plastic utensils, linens, and towels are provided, although we brought our own towels. there is a private rear entrance. the subway is a close walk to make connections to almost anywhere. we visited new york for 6 days to visit family graduation and to be tourists. we were very happy there. there is a lot to see and do. we had fun. our lives are richer now. uri is a kind host. he texted us several times to see if we needed anything. we will try to stay there first when we come to nyc again. there is a pizza store on the corner which may have the best pizza in nyc (and maybe the world). there is a small bagel store on another corner where we often sat and enjoyed bagels and coffee for breakfast. there are small supermarkets nearby for food and fresh fruit. languages spoken in the area include english, russian, hebrew, and spanish we much recommend this place for one or two people. it is good value, and you will enjoy nyc.
nice place to be and will definitely recommend

sandra is a super host for real. she is super sweet and kind. i left a few things there as i rushed out of the house early to a few meetings, and she was kind enough to send those via mail to me. i love sandra! the place is spotlessly clean, i was not expecting that i would have to go through the bottom level of the house to go up to my room, but all was nice and beautiful. it was also a bit far from the nyc center but if you are up for a train and a bus, then you'll be in her beautiful and cozy airbnb.

michelle's room is perfect! centrally located in the neighborhood, super clean, and has all the essentials. not to mention that her communication is timely and top-notch. every time i come to brooklyn i try and book with her. thanks, michelle!

this stay was amazing! catia was great and quick to answer any questions i had! it was very clean and overall, a pretty apartment. if there were one thing i’d change about my stay, it would be to stay longer because i absolutely loved her place. it felt like home. i’m definitely booking again when i come back to new york!
florence and peter are wonderful hosts. they have great suggestions for what to do around the city, and they are great company and conversation!
everything was fabulous. i especially appreciated the coffee and pastries in the morning. very cool vibe.

we really enjoyed the trip and mia is was absolute fantastic with responses. the place was clean and as described. parking was a little difficult, but not the end of the world. we found a spot on the one-way across the street. mattress was a little firm for my liking but the kids slept fine front bedroom was a little noisy with traffic going by, but there are 5 other awesome rooms to choose from we felt safe and at home the entire stay and would recommend it to anyone looking to explore the city!
great spot to stay in the les! fun area, cool lobby and rooftop bar. small but clean rooms, good deal compared to the rest of nyc

great stay for the price. we were a little worried when we first got there because we thought we might have been directed to an abandoned house. there was trash and construction/cleaning supplies on the front porch and even inside the entrance to the house. inside the entrance, there was a lot of dust and other random stuff on the floor and the paint was peeling everywhere. however, once we got upstairs into the actual apartment, everything was clean and new, exactly like the pictures! there was wifi, a microwave, dishes, towels. pretty much everything you need from an airbnb. erika responded very quickly and had very clear, timely instructions about check-in and check-out. overall i would recommend this place!

anna’s apartment is just lovely. perfectly located with a ton of delicious restaurants and tempting bars in walking distance. there is also a gorgeous backyard which we used every day. the apartment is also super quiet even though in the heart of williamsburg. anna was the perfect host and so understanding when our flights were moved. i highly recommend and we can’t wait to go back

we enjoyed our stay. the location was close to subway and central park. gina was very helpful and prompt whenever we contacted her. her apartment was small but she did a great job with utilizing the space. we would definitely stay here again when visiting our daughter in nyc.

my family and i were very compfortable at the apartment. it is spacious, light and clean. to find free parking is also not a problem, which is a huge plus for nyc. shopping and restaurants are in walking distance. the area in the bronx where the apartment is, is very nice. you could forget that you are in the city when you are down by the bay (especially at paddy's on the bay : ) or at ferry point park. the host was very accommodating and responsive and we are planning on staying there again soon.
amazing location, quiet and clean. easy access! great hosts would stay again!

seth and his partner were so friendly and accommodating from the beginning when i started communicating until the very end when we left for the airport. we never got to spend time with them as they were busy as well as i was there for work, but we always felt welcomed! their place is super small and cozy, ideal for one person. but with two it felt a little cramped in the full size bed. however it was a very comfortable bed and there was a hot shower so i highly recommend this place.
linda and her family are lovely and the accommodations were just what we needed. we appreciated the quick response for a last-minute booking and the thoughtful amenities.
very homey and comfortable! i also had a two-year-old so it was ample amount of space for the both of us and my mother. quiet neighborhood and easy parking. well hopefully return soon.

beautiful space- full of personality and charm. artistic, practical, comfortable, lovely. an incredible space to host and cook for guests. i felt so lucky to find this spot. i hope to be back soon! a true gem in bed-stuy.

the neighborhood is great so much to do and choose from: shopping, drinks, food… everything is walking distance. i felt also super safe getting back at night. amy was very responsive and helpful. 100% recommend and place is as it looks!
a great studio space for a nyc stay. one thing to note, is this unit is located on the first floor and directly next to the building entrance with a window directly on sidewalk entry public facing.
sharon is super sweet and the room was fantastic. the energy is great being a family heirloom and it was an honor to stay. thanks again!
i recommend. safe and secure, quiet and calm host. thank you. see you a soon.

nothing bad to say about this place , i loved everything about it. it really is a little underground castle. it’s clean. it smells good. it’s bright and inviting. the bed is comfortable. the shower is great. the tvs are excellent. the check in was smooth , and the one issue we had, which was completely our fault jose answered the phone immediately and walked us through it. there were snacks, bottled water and soda (which was so nice because we were so tired and didn’t think to stop and grab anything on the way back in ). we walked from the airport in about 15 minutes. the neighborhood was safe and quiet. the bus is a block away and the train maybe 15 minutes or so. i honestly can not say enough good things about this place. well decorated and homey. microwave and keurig were a great bonus and saved us from having to go out every morning for coffee and used the microwave one day for leftovers we brought back from manhattan. i will most definitely be back. anyone having any second thoughts about this place go ahead and book it. it’s perfect
great place! would stay again.
the place is amazing and clean but hard to find parking.

the hotel was perfectly located exactly as described. the staff was friendly and our host jason was awesome. everything was in walking distance and the entrances to the subway made it a perfect to access the city. the rooftop restaurant was a nice retreat from the streets of ny and the food was delicious.
one of the best rentals i've been to on airbnb. i'm impressed & looking forward to returning.
henri was very accommodating! central location for experiencing nyc! everything we needed!

exactly like the listing in both photos and description. clean, comfortable, spacious living area and had all emenities needed. 15min walk to closest subway. can hear upstairs neighbours and noise from the street from one bedroom. however, with the ac on at night, it helps drown it out. would definitely stay again.
ame is very kind! the room is cozy & the home is beautiful!
super valuable place to stay and we really enjoyed our stay. the host is super friendly and helpful. we would definitely recommend this place to anyone who's looking for a great place to stay
kareem was a super host! i will definitely be booking with him for all my trips to nyc in the future. besides being an amazing host, the house was so futuristic! i loved it. 11/10.
the price is very reasonable for nyc. the house is right next to the train station. jose is a friendly talkative guy.
great, fantastic, better than advertised. was my first time using airbnb.....am now a superfan

this flat is in a gorgeous location with 30mins into manhattan and prospect park in walking distance. there are lots of thoughtful touches in the home for guests. shower is powerful, kitchen is well equipped, bed is huge and comfy! the aircon unit does the job on a hot day, faultless. :) thank you monique!

we had a great time at menachem’s place in nyc. it was great to find somewhere reasonably priced with two proper bedrooms. menachem was helpful with check in details and the place was clean, clutter free and in a great location
amazing place in the heart of williamsburg!
excellent place. new & modern, with fun minimalist style. view is wonderful. central air efficient and quiet. bed is super comfortable and linens new and perfect. would definitely stay here again.

cramped space compared to pictures. bathroom is nice but aside from that it's not worth it's title. thin walls could hear neighbors very easily. lady who checked us in was non communicative and passive aggressive. the man who we checked out with on the other hand was very polite and quick. ***they only accommodate guests 21+
the host samuel is an amazing person and the place was just as it is described. he’s a great guy . definitely staying there whenever i’m in queens

too bad that new york city is changing the airbnb rules. i would totally recommend staying at rebecca‘s place. it’s on the very back of the building on the fourth floor and there’s no street noise or noise from the other apartments. around 10 in the morning young kids were out into the playground that you looked down on. there is also a giant chess set that you look down at every day from the kitchen. the bedroom and bed is comfortable and the place is large. there’s a full living room and a complete bedroom with a door. it is very close to the a and the number one subway lines

catia's apartment was just what my wife and i were looking for in our trip to manhattan. close to everything and about a 7 minute walk to penn station and msg. catia went above and beyond and was the consummate host. i wouldn't hesitate to book with her again!

we go into the city multiple times a year. chris's place in in a good neighborhood. very easy to navigate from. there are plenty of great food options around without needing to go far. he is quick to respond and so helpful with any tips you might need. definitely recommend and would stay again.

location location location! if that’s what matters to you then this is the right place. are the beds super comfy? no. is it luxurious? no. spacious? no. but the apartment had everything we needed and was in the perfect location to get anywhere in the city we wanted to go. our host was really helpful and communicative. i would definitely stay again.
better than i expected!!

peter's place was perfect for a 7 day stay! he was super communicative and great host and the home itself is better than the pictures which is always a sweet surprise. the living room is roomy with really nice tv and the ac worked well (ny gets hot in the summer). there was also a really well designed private sitting area in the back with a gorgeous mural. the spot is super close to a centralized subway line that goes directly to manhattan. the temporary home away from home gets 10 out of 10!

the apartment was located so very conveniently to the train station. this made it great for our trips in to manhattan. we averaged about 45 minutes per trip into and out of manhattan. there was a construction detour on the direct line into manhattan, but we were able to adjust our trips to use connecting lines quite easily. most importantly, the apartment was very clean. everything we needed was provided, the apartment itself was comfortable and we never had a problem with the noise (except on the day we left when the city works staff decided to jackhammer the sidewalk at 7am). hearing the trains going by was almost like listening to the heartbeat of the city. street parking is a first come basis, and make sure to read the street signs for what days the city comes by to clean it. arriving later in the day meant we had to park down the street from the building, but it was never more than 1 block away, and we never had a problem. we managed to get our car in front of the property by moving it early one morning. verena and donald were in contact with us as we arrived and also throughout the stay for anything we needed to ask. if you are looking to stay within a budget, want cleanliness and comfort, and need to have convenient transit to manhattan or jfk airport, you won't go wrong here.
the apartment is gorgeous, bright, clean and spacious. sam was absolutely amazing, giving us lots of advice before and during our arrival. if you need a place to stay in brooklyn i 100% recommend!
very chill stay and a good option for me while i was looking for a more permanent accommodation. kelly was up front about the unit, the cat, etc. i had zero issues.
great location! and koichi was really good at keeping in touch -- and providing all the info you need for check-in/check-out etc. he even managed to get us an early check-in!
great awesome stay with great hosts. would stay here again if i’m traveling to nyc alone
great place, good location, thoughtful touches. would stay here again.
very cozy and comfortable. thank you for hosting!
great location, clean, easy check in and bag storage. would recommend, especially for a group of 6

stayed here for a few months - very central location that made getting around manhattan, especially on the red line super easy. the host is quite responsive over the airbnb app which is great if you need anything. there is some noise in the apartment at night, but if you turn on the ac / wear earplugs it is fine. fridge / stove / oven all worked well for me.
definitely a perfect place to stay! we had a some great days in new york!

the place is sooo good and very clean, the people we shared the space with were very quiet and kept the kitchen clean 24/7. the area is so good i think it was an asian area and h mart became our favourite night activity .
easy, great location, and a lot of space. be prepared for stairs!

had a wonderful stay in justine's apartment--highly recommend! the apartment is just steps away from the subway, and central to all of fort greene & clinton hill. justine was an excellent host, and it was a pleasure to stay there.
superb location, clean and stylish. great light.
nice affordable place and mohmood the host is a nice person
my family enjoyed the stay very much, host was more than accomodating and very understanding. wouldn't definitely recommend!!
excelent houst, beautyfull house, comfortable and clean!!!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

we loved staying at brooklyn this time to enjoy the neighborhood and so close to manhattan. spacious place, cozy, amazing shower and great stay, we felt like home away from home. can wait to come back, thanks miau for being so helpful with everything! see you next time
this is a lovely space and is ideal for private events.
thomas was amazing host, beautiful loft like apartment and amenities were endless.

david place was amazing! a spacious place to stay for a few days. very communicative. easy check in & out. supplies kitchen cookware, living essentials, and toiletries. quiet great neighborhood. public transportation was only 3blocks away. would most definitely stay there again next time me & my fiancé are in town! thank you so much david.

sheila was a wonderful host. she met us outside the unit and was very responsive in communicating. this basement unit is clean, cozy, and quiet! the private patio out back is also a really nice perk to the unit. the location in east village is great for going out, close to public transit, and priced very reasonably compared to other units in the area. i would definitely stay here again!
it’s so nice to live here! the room is clean and bright and have everything you need. the owner is so friendly and warm🥰🥰🥰

i enjoyed my stay in brooklyn! this place is tidy with a beautiful room. the location is a 5 minute walk from the c train and around 10 minutes from the j train. make sure you come early to your stay since the lock situation is a bit difficult to figure out.
great house and host. the house is accessible to 2 different subways which is very convenient. the host was very accessible and assisted quickly with every inquiry.

we had a very good time staying at ainslie's and john's beautiful house. they are interesting and very friendly people, who are helpful and kind. the connection to the subway is a short walk (about 7 or 8 minutes). there are two stations close by (prospect park or sterling).

we stayed at blair's place for 10 days. it was comfortable and very clean. the house was well kept and had every amenity we required. grocery stores were nearby, and the c train was a 3 minute walk. blair's place is comfortable for 2-3 people for a long stay!

our host was very abrasive and rude when we first met. although she did lighten up later in the day. she ended up being friendly and offered her food, kitchen and common areas to us. the apartment was in a great location, close to public transit and restaurants. cons: the bed was hard and uncomfortable. -the pictures advertised showed a tv in the room, there was no tv. -the restroom is within walking distance of the room, but used as a common restroom between other guests.
its a unique house! we loved it😊

the sweetest host — mari’s place was clean and well decorated. great location, in a beautiful part of bedstuy and a 5 min walk to the closest subway stop. had a great time exploring the neighborhood and mari was so communicative and welcoming, offering advice on where to go and what to do. a great stay, would definitely book again and recommend to anyone!
amazing host. great location by fort greene.

this place was great! nina was super helpful and communicative throughout. the location is fantastic - near lots of restaurants, markets, coffee shops, etc. easy access to the q, f and g trains, and of course, super close to prospect park. the apartment was super clean and we had everything we needed for our brief stay. would highly recommend for anyone coming to brooklyn.
we were very happy in julie’s place. quiet well equipped clean and comfortable and friendly but unobtrusive hosts
excellent communication, clean, spot on description and basically “just off” jfk.
great price and location. no need to check in at front desk, in and out. very smooth
love the place! thank you guys a ton and looking forward to coming back!

the hospitality and prompt communication from the host makes the entire stay pleasant and easy. the apartment is everything and more as described, and the location is just a dream. though we consider ourselves as new yorker, we just saw west village through an entirely different sense, largely to the convenience that your apartment brought in - close to subways, parks, restaurants, shopping, bars, running tracks and grocery stores to name a few. apartment was fully equipped, and all gadgets worked with absolute ease and convenience. we expect ourselves to reach out again in the future during our next visit to ny. thanks again!
ayman was a friendly host, the area we stayed at was very quiet and the house was clean. there were good recommendations for where to eat and visit and how to get there. it was a very good stay.

a nice affordable spot in the quieter part of brooklyn. i went up to visit some people in brooklyn so it was an extremely convenient and affordable place. but also it is a few blocks away from the 18th ave. station. the d train is one of the fastest trains in the city, so it is an easy trip to the city as well. nice guy too!

this was my first time staying in an air bnb and i had a great experience. i was a little afraid to stay in an air bnb by myself but this exceeded my expectations. carla is an amazing host. my flight came in earlier than expected and carla was able to accommodate me with an early check in. place is very clean and i felt safe there. it’s so comfy and cozy and much better than a hotel. if i come back to new york again, i definitely will be staying here.

win’s place is a cozy and well maintained place, with lots of restaurants around and connectivity to mta. the closest subway station requires a bit of travel (15 mins by walk or bus) although the bus stops are right round the corner. win is an amazing host and was gracious enough to accommodate our request for dropping off our bags at the apartment before check-in. would definitely recommend his place.

my daughter and i spent 8 days in this apartment in january 2015. steve was a terrific host, welcoming us warmly on a very cold winter night after our long flight from melbourne, australia.there were fresh flowers and he had also bought us some fruit. the apartment is very conveniently located a short walk from the subway. everything you might need is close by – the essex street fresh food market, convenience stores, restaurants and bars. even though the apartment is on a main road, it is at the back so noise was not a problem. we had a very comfortable and enjoyable stay and would not hesitate to stay here again if we are lucky enough to be back in new york. donna
the apartment served as a great crash pad during our stay in new york. it's located super close to some great bars and restaurants, and the decor in the apartment is super cute.

i came to new york by myself and choosing this place was best decision. they are so friendly, quiet, and the place was wonderful. but here is really popular place. so, if you saw this review and wanna stay here? it will be better to decide to stay as soon as possible. you will never regret!
everything was great! teola is very kind and would make sure you have everything you need. the apartment is really nice with little nice touchs and decorations.
maurice is a great host! the apartment is exactly what it promises to be! we had a very good time!

we had a great stay at julia’s place in dumbo. it was really well located, clean and peaceful. you can definitely hear the trains on the bridge during the day, but it was never disruptive for us and was much quieter at night with the windows shut. we slept well the whole time we stayed! julia was very helpful with any questions we had before and during the stay. the surrounding area was great as well, we found some excellent local spots for coffee, lunch, dinner and evening activities, as well as being really easy to get around the city from. bonus points for the nicely decorated bathroom and great shower!

trevor and toya made our stay fantastic! they were thoughtful, communicative, and helpful. the place is lovely and clean, exactly as pictured, and in a fantastic location. we loved our time here and hope others will too!
we had a good time the room was right in the best location for time square i would stay again very convenient
maya is a great persom. helped me with luggage and check in

i stayed with 2 friends for 5 nights in this beautiful brownstone and absolutely loved it! we had no trouble finding or accessing the flat, which was a relief after arriving at 1am! the flat is just how it looks in the pictures, with lots of friendly/helpful notes around to tell you where things are (like extra bedding), and all sorts of toiletries and other amenities are provided. we didn't hear a peep from peter or his family living upstairs. we didn't explore the neighborhood much other than going to a few local brunch places, but neighbors really do say 'hello'! overall we were very pleased with our stay!

yves has a very clean and stylish apartment that is conveniently located. the room was a bit small for 2 people but the bed was very comfortable. it is a good place for the price. i will recommend it.
it’s a wonderful place to stay and the host is great and responsive.
minguang replyed fast and answered my questions before booking very nice and spacious room, i like the comfy mattress , the clean private bathroom i would stay there again and recommend it
very easy communication and very clean unit!

as the pickiest person ever, i really loved staying at alina’s. it was cozy, warm, and as clean and spotless as it gets. it was quiet both in the unit and neighborhood, easy to check in and out; i would definitely stay again, and hope to! i also loved her book collection, major highlight for me.

good place and neighborhood. subway, bank and restaurants less than 3 blocks, very close. you need just one line of the subway to arrive at times square (for about 20 minutes). the room is exactly the picture. marissa and stanley are very friendly and help me too much explaining about the city. we enjoyed!!!
enjoyed my stay here! thanks for hosting me.
location was not bad. price was a bit on the higher side for the offerings.
the hotel was clean and quiet and in a great location.

michael’s place was great, decorated well and walkable. super comfy place and had everything you could need. it even had central ac which came in handy in june when we visited. he was easy to communicate with and flexible. having 2 bathrooms and showers is always helpful when traveling with a group. would recommend and definitely come back to!

i love it! for the price and the location i truly recommend the place. it looks a little bit more bigger in the photos which i don’t bother, but just to you know it’s pretty tiny, but for the locations it’s worthed. you have dunkin’ 5 minutes away and some stores to do shopping like t-j max, target, marshals, burlington, at 10 minutes away walking, and the best central park al 20 min walking.
nice and clean affordable place to stay . and train is walkable distance for transportation.

this stay in bushwick is one of a kind- the home is a great, with an amazing private backyard attached to the room. the hosts kaz and kayo are extremely accommodating and quick to respond to any questions or concerns. they are great hosts, and this home stay is great.

ayana's home is a beautiful one bedroom. it is pristine and secure. ayana makes sure that you are comfortable and she is available to assure that your needs are met. this was our first time in jamaica queens and we had an enjoyable time because of ayana's great hospitality. we we stay again.
great place and location! super friendly staff and large room for nyc.
the apartment was very nice and clean. jasmine was very helpful and friendly. our family enjoyed the stay!! definitely would rent again!

we had a fantastic stay! anthony is a very friendly , accommodating and very helpful host. the apartment is spacious, close to shops and restaurants and just minutes away from the a express train to manhattan. the surroundings feel absolutely safe to walk around and explore.

all in all...very nice. it was towards the tail end of a remodel so there was stuff undone and still left to do all around apartment. outlets, baseboards, paint, pictures on walls...kate has nice taste and it will be very nice. bed and couch were very comfortable. could have used a kitchen table or a place to eat. maybe a coffee table or end table to set a plate or glass on. washer and dryer was a huge plus. location was great. first time i ever heard of a "motion sensor" toilet. its supposed to flush when you wave your hand over the top. it stopped working a few days in. that was a pain. i was there alone because my husband was at mt sinai hospital. i felt safe there. the hum of the train going by in the distance was actually quite soothing. its a 10 minute walk to the hospital.

shane was incredibly communicative and helpful with everything. the place was larger than i imagined and had all the amenities needed. there's also a great cafe on the corner called blank slate on 30th and madison i highly recommend for coffee and breakfast.
loved the place and the area. will definitely stay here again when we return to nyc.

couldn’t have had a better stay! edgar is a great host. he’s very kind, lovely to chat with and can give you lots of tips and recommendations! the place is clean, has everything you need (especially a very comfortable bed) and as a bonus the cute digi (cat). if you’re coming to new york i highly recommend staying here!
nice place to stay some days, the neighborhood is good and there is a subway station close.

we really enjoyed our stay at this beautiful, charming brownstone property, my husband myself & our daughter were very comfortable & would love to stay again next time we’re in town because of the convenience of our very favorite park slope neighborhood & location. matthew our host was so very kind , an outstanding human with hospitality & kindness you just don’t see these days & very quick to respond. thank you for sharing your property with us we are so grateful to have found this home & had a beautiful experience!
loved staying here! very friendly and cozy. not far at all from public transportation which can take you anywhere within 30-40 mins. highly recommend if you’re staying for a few days!

pictures look more spacious then what it is in person. i do not think it’s worth the price at all. there is no room for the amount of people it supposed to hold. i would say maybe your paying for the rooftop but you can’t even access that past 10pm and it’s only connected to your room. really makes no sense. not worth the price.

the space was very spacious and beautiful. the rooms were exactly how they were on the pictures. only the living room has a tv the other three rooms don't. everything around us was walkable distance mins away from grocery stores and other convenient stores. neighborhood was quiet

michael was a great guy and very helpful, the room was very modern and clean. the area might let feel as european weird but nobody was harassing me or anything like that (very diverse ny culture). barcelona was 1000x times worse. definitely going to check in next time again in nyc!
the room was pretty small. there was mold in the shower, it smelled very moldy too.

we loved staying in this apartment, which was spacious and had everything we needed for a 4 night stay in nyc. it is close to the subway to manhattan and to explore other areas of brooklyn. we especially loved german’s coffee which he had roasted himself. would recommend - great value for money in a pricey city.

great place, as described and had everything we needed. it felt like our home and we couldn’t be happier with our stay. lots of amazing food places around and good bars. it was a little bit of a walk to either the j or a train but there was a bus right outside. to get all the way into the city was usually about an hour including the walk etc but that didn’t bother us - may be a little far for some.

we loved our stay in this quintessential nyc brownstone! it was super spacious, clean, and comfortable! we didn’t want to leave! chantal and andrew were the friendliest hosts, too! their booklet had best restaurant recommendations, all walking distance from the airbnb!
great place.

the house was not bad as long as you didn't stay up too late, it can be a bit noisy and scary at night, be careful when your girlfriend comes to work, other than that it was easy to get to the metro, there is a market next to the house, there was immediate access when needed, we were satisfied overall

you absolutely can't do better in new york! julia's place is perfectly situated, only one block from union square - easy access to absolutely everywhere on the subway, and a few mins walk from pharmacies, grocery stores, farmers markets, late-night eateries, laundromats, etc... the apartment itself is immaculately clean and tidy, really warm and cozy and is filled with beautiful, funky furniture. it takes up a large chunk of the top floor in a skinny, rectangular building, meaning the apartment itself has windows facing in three directions - two of which open onto a courtyard, so it is superbly quiet and very, very bright (unheard of in nyc). in fact, it gets uninterrupted morning sun, so if you are jet-lagged and need to sleep-in, i would recommend bringing a sleep mask. but the queen bed is lovely and comfy, so getting to sleep won't be a problem. i unfortunately didn't get the opportunity to meet julia face to face, but even though she was in a different time-zone, she was very attentive and we were in contact regularly. she was lovely, hilarious and full of great, locals-only new york-y information. if this place isn't booked, snaffle it up. you won't regret it!
i loved the stay here, very clean and well maintained. great hosts!!! they were there for all my needs!! would def stay here, highly recommended!

being from plattsburgh, a relatively small city closer to canada in upstate ny, i thought i was ready for nyc, but boy was i wrong- the walking, transit, and amount of sweat that pooled at the end of the day was seemingly washed away.. (literally) at evelyn’s place! evelyn had notes posted everywhere of any and all questions that one could think to ask, and gave not only i, but my partner a place to rest our heads after walking all of manhattan in a day. my partner and i will be coming back to nyc to explore more and if possible, would love to book again at evelyn’s place. it’s basically a studio apartment just 5 steps off the ground. clean, affordable, and downright beautiful. 10/10.
friendly and helpful host and great apartment. can definitely recommend for those visiting ny.

we don’t have enough good things to say about our experience! the location is tremendous with a beautiful park, numerous restaurants, beer gardens, and mr. mango, all on your block. the subway is also only block away, and the city is at your finger tips. she has the sweetest dog ever that, once she gets to know you, will always be excited to see you. this house is absolutely worth the stay, and you’ll always remember it.
agnes is a very nice hote. she's there if you need help about anything. the place is well-located, the subway is near the flat. i enjoyed my stay at new york. i recommend the place of agnes.

over all we had a great stay. is accessable to 4 subway stations, shops and restaurants. is quite a spacious apartment, especially for new york! sofa bed wasn’t the most comfortable but not many sofa beds are. air conditioners were very loud. fridge had some old and out of date food in it which would have been better if was cleared out before we arrived. intercom made loud whining/buzzing noise all night on last night in which we didnt get any sleep and when notified host the next morning on check out so was fixed before next booking was disappointed no apology was given. was fabulous to have plenty of towels to use, washer and dryer, and body wash/shampoo etc in bathroom. were great touches dont always get.

this was the perfect location for a visit to columbia, martin is an outstanding host and a. lovely person. communication and the whole experience were really ideal. the place was charming, very comfortable, and felt very safe. we would return again gladly!

mary’s place is wonderful, so comfortable, clean and warm and well located for both brooklyn and manhattan. great to have a private half-bathroom as well as access to the main bathroom - it felt like a self contained apartment. mary is fab - very welcoming and accommodating, and ash to arrange things with. would highly recommend! thank you for a great weekend.

a great location - just along from the empire state building. and some nice restaurant's near by. we'd recommend a restaurant called 'leslie'. suited us to have two double beds that were not in the same room. for the price this place couldn't be beaten. kimberley was friendly and helpful and went out of her way on one occasion to offer some hair straighteners.
great stay here. i’ve stayed in the area before, so knew my way around. good room, right next to shared bathroom for ease, host great and friendly. would/will stay again.

chris has fantastic communication; he responds instantly. the apartment is very comforting and homely, and is in the best location; i could walk everywhere! a daunting trip to be living abroad for the first time, but this apartment made my stay so much easier and i felt very safe. it is also equipped with everything you could need, from a hairdryer to multiple towels to organised folders with details on the local area etc. i would really recommend this home, it’s worth spending a bit more sometimes.
great hosts. easy instructions and very helpful
definitely coming back!
nice host and place, good value for nyc.
really great stay!

leona communicated very rapidly and effectively, making check-in a breeze. the space was very comfortable, convenient, and spacious, and provides a nice sitting area, and a good night's sleep with a quiet interior courtyard view and a comfortable bed. i'd be happy to stay here anytime.
ame’s home is a great location to explore brooklyn and is right near subway line. she was easy to talk to and was a great host!
do not go there! bed borken mattress sinking. view on dumpsters. no kictchen cleaning etc etc
accurate description. worked with us for checkin. great for the price.

i was most impressed by how responsive the hosts were to my questions. i had quite a few, and i got helpful answers back with an hour or two! for example, there was no neighborhood information/recommendations in the apartment, but when i asked for some, i got great recs to wonderful restaurants in easy walking distance within an hour! we found the air-conditioning units were enough to keep us cool in the heat of summer. the space is very simple, but it was perfectly adequate for our needs.

thank you so much alfred and team. so friendly and kind staff. i will definitely comeback here again every time im going to new york. you are the best. they gave me a tshirt too for free. god bless you all 😊

my friends and i had a wonderful time during our stay. the neighborhood was nice and calm, which offered lots of local spots to explore. the nearby park was also a fantastic bonus which we enjoyed. the home was clean, comfortable, and equipped with everything that would be needed. lisa was very responsive and friendly which ensured our stay was enjoyable. i highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a place to stay in new york!

mia’s studio was a great spot for our 6 night visit to ny. it was convenient to the subway to manhattan and mia provided helpful suggestions for nearby restaurants and shops. we had everything we needed and mia was very responsive and we were grateful for being able to leave our bags for a few hours after our checkout.

thank you so much, brady. it was the first time i had stayed at an airbnb and it was great and you made it so clear and easy and i hope to visit again soon. thank you so much! i had the best time with my daughter.
great place! cozy with good natural light !
nice and clean - not much of a view but great location
jaleh and her daughter are lovely hosts and i felt welcomed into their apartment! the location is in a great place near the metro station.
it is good little nice place just for you and your partner

the location is perfect for visiting the city with subway pretty close and all the main services (supermarkets, restaurants etc.) available closeby. the hosts were very nice and available all time. highly recommended!!

what an incredible find !!! elsa and juan are such incredible people, they open up their home and are such incredible humans, they're beyond accommodating and always wanting you to have such amazing experience ! the home and room are in such incredible standards for nyc accommodations without the hefty price-tag, dont think twice to stay at their place, such amazing find and amazing host. :)
very large space, accurately shown in the photos. clean and secure, a fun place. excellent wifi. hugh quickly responded to all of my emails.

this is really a one-of-a-kind listing, a completely separate structure in the heart of victorian flatbush,. the barn has been lovingly restored, with lots of great period details (original plank floors and beams), but has a very modern and well-equipped kitchen and bath, although the steep stairs to the bedroom floor could be challenging for some. the hosts are on-site (the barn is in their backyard), very friendly and helpful. it's on a lovely, tree-shaded street in a wonderful neighborhood near brooklyn college, five blocks from the q train, with quick access to prospect park, all major brooklyn attractions and manhattan. we look forward to our next stay there.

this was the first trip to new york for my wife and i. we wanted something that was close to madison square garden as we were attending a concert there. we found this place and booked it. jim was very responsive and answered all our questions (a great host). the apartment is very cozy and centrally located. if you don't mind walking a little you can hit the theater district or time square. the subways are only a few blocks away to go where ever you want or just flag down a taxi. we would stay there again.
great location.. fantastic hosts
great host and a great location on a beautiful street. would recommend naomi’s apartment to all!

stay overall was ok, our unit had a power outage for 4 days and it took them many days to respond despite multiple people contacting them to fix the issue. there is no urgency on the property manager to fix any issues. cleaning lady comes every week to clean common areas, which is nice.
wayne know how to make people feel welcomed ! beautiful room. i highly suggest
great spot in great neighbourhood. real easy to communicate with brett and appreciate his flexibility with helping me check out later. will definitely stay again.
same as other review
wonderful host! beautiful and neat apartment! i would come back again and again if need be!

amy house was a really wonderfully place for my wife and i to stay for our 10 day trip to nyc. it was exactly as advertising, in a great location, and amy was a terrific host. we would happily stay there again.
super nice host! cozy and tidy place! accessible to anywhere in ny. very recommended. thanks allison!
it was all great we really enjoyed our stay there easy to find and to access the equipment was great heat kitchen living room... we felt good highly recommanded for a group of friends or family.

this was our second time staying at the apartment – and definitely not the last! the location is perfect, with great restaurants and the buzz of nyc right outside the door, but still quiet enough to relax. the apartment was clean, comfortable, and just as described. the host is incredibly warm, always helpful, and gave us amazing local tips again. we felt totally at home.
the apartment is very comfortable and clean. sabrina was always available in case we needed anything. i would recommend her apartment 100%.
nice room, very well located in manhattan. very good communication from manuel. i recommend :)
great place! right across from the subway, great price, clean, smooth check in. would stay here again!
wonderful quaint place! great location in bk!

a great place to stay if you need/want a large enough place for a larger family. 3 bathrooms is not common when looking for a place to stay near new york. we chose this location because it was half way between ny city and bethpage (where the pga championship was held).

apartment is exactly as described, pictures are accurate. spiral stair is steep and narrow but fun! the apartment is in a great neighborhood full of restaurants and bars. communication with host was always fast.
nice, quiet place in a great location!
the host was helpful when we had to pickup our stroller that we left behind by mistake. the building front desk was helpful.

we had another host ghost us last minute and nomad stepped up and got us booked. location is amazing as far as being able to get places quickly. very noisy at night but he was upfront about that and even provided ear plugs. it is nothing fancy but it was as portrayed and met our needs. we loved the fact that there was a locked door at street level and then we had separate locks for our apartment. made us feel much safer. we will be back if this sc girl gets the nerve to take on nyc again. 😂

i stayed at waldemar's garden room for four nights. it was a very enjoyable experience. waldemar is the perfect host, extremely helpful, and offered nyc travel/neighborhood tips. he has an engaging personality and took the time to discuss not only nyc, but other issues of common interest (such as urban living and museums). his home is close to the city's subway system and walkable to lively areas for dinner, etc. loved staying at his clean, quiet place and i highly recommend it. oh ya, the room i had featured large windows that looked out into a quaint garden which i had access to. (he has a friendly cat too!)
we enjoyed close to everything defenetly go back
awesome communication and affordable place ! would definitely recommend
expect not to go

julian's place is a small studio in brooklyn. the location is great because the j train is only like a 2 minute walk away and can get you anywhere you need to go. the neighborhood is definitely not the nicest but it didn't feel unsafe. it just older and more rundown and has a lot of trash in the streets, but its new york so i mean its expected. there is a couple of food place around so that was a plus too. the studio is like any regular studio. its clean overall. nothing fancy. if you are not picky about where you stay and just need a regular inexpensive place to stay during a trip this is a good spot. it doesn't look exactly like the pictures so that took me off guard at first , but after a few hours i was actually really liking the little studio. since its underneath the apartment complex like a basement or something it feels very private and cozy. i liked it overall.
great place for a young family — super convenient and comfortable!
tunesia & john’s place was great. it was just a short walk to 125th st subway with express trains to downtown manhattan, and very close to the north end of central park. i’d recommend staying here!

clean, spacious, and in a great location. alie and pat were quick to communicate. loved the little bodega on the corner and the shared yard space for morning coffee and bagels. had a blast seeing peaches at avant gardner and exploring brooklyn. will most certainly stay again!

we had a great time staying at nicole's place! the place was perfectly comfortable, with some very cool art. there are multiple subway stops within a 15-20 minute walk, and plenty of buses go through the area. i appreciated that nicole checked in throughout our stay to make sure all was going well. :) thanks again!

donna's home is perfect! great location on a quiet street close to plenty of great options for eating, drinking, coffee etc. the place itself is super clean and charming with more than all the amenities you can think of. super easy check-in. you can tell donna really cares about this place and is very communicative and welcoming. would definitely stay again next time i'm in nyc!
jarret and dan were fantastic host and their airbnb felt like home!
thank you carlton

the apartment is perfectly situated in chelsea, close to good restaurants and bars, and also right next to a subway station. it is well kept and clean. the kitchen is small, but functional. the bathroom has something rare for american apartments, a shower with decent water pressure! be aware the building is old and in need of renovation, but the apartment itself is in good condition. there is no elevator and the apartment is on the fourth floor up a narrow staircase. chris communicates very clearly and timely, and it was very easy to check in and out of the apartment. i wish we could have stayed longer!
very clean place ,close to restaurants.
it was not worth it and this was not expected
the hotel was nice, spacious, and in a great location.

the apartment was very spacious and comfortable, and well located for any one visiting bed stuy. paul and brian also made themselves available any questions. i will likely stay there again next time i visit brooklyn.

morlisa was a great host. she was friendly and responded quickly when i reached out. the apartment exceeded my expectations. i am really glad that i booked her space instead of a hotel. the apartment made me feel at home and the extra refreshments were a plus. i felt safe in the neighborhood and will book again. i highly recommend this space.

this place is a golden spot in nyc. you get the best of brooklyn and manhattan. the place is neat. we were stoked about this finding. hosts are the best. we definitely recommend this place for anyone who wants to have a home away from home.
very great hospitality
lovely people you can ever meet! they make you feel at home and part of the family. i’m definitely coming back there anytime i visit new york! thanks guys for such a lovely though short time.

definitely the perfect spot if you're visiting the city and don't want to stay somewhere too expensive or fancy. its right on the border line of little italy and china town. in walking distance of many public transportations to get into the major parts of the city. amazing little coffee shops nearby and moying is very humble and attention to detail when it comes to keeping everything up to par.
great experience and central location!
hello ! we thank you for everything, you have a wonderful home and we were really good, you look very kind and helpful we did not try to find better! we greet you with a goodbye isabella
great location! 5 min walk from the n train. the apartment is very clean, the room is well equipped. amazing stay! highly recommend.

we really enjoyed our stay at a harold's. the location was super convenient for exploring the city, everything was very clean, and harold was kind and accommodating. we would definitely stay here again for our next trip to nyc.

taylor was really friendly and helpful and gave us a list of his favorite restaurants. the neighborhood is conveniently located and we walked to moma and the barrymore theater as well as rockefeller center and central park. the apartment had a nice living room where we could sit and a nice sized kitchen. the beds were very comfortable and the street was quiet at night so we slept well. i lived in new york in the past and was not familiar with this neighborhood but it was great and had everything we needed close by including good coffee.

i can’t recommend esters home higher for anyone wanting to visit nyc. her hospitality started even before i entered the apartment as she greeted me at the building door. she operates on a ‘my home is your home’ basis and there is everything you need and more to have a great stay. there are three different public transport routes from the island, all which use the metro card, which can get you anywhere you want in a short time. take the f train from the subway station 5 minutes away and easily explore central manhattan or take the ferry to walk along wall street and visit the 9/11 memorial and world trade centre. the place is perfect for anyone who wants to visit the city that never sleeps but sleep peacefully themselves.
excelente lugar. regresaremos

we enjoyed our stay at this clean, comfortable, and well located airbnb! the space was bright, well decorated, and had all that we needed for a short stay. easy access to shops and several train lines. thank you!

we loved our stay in brooklyn, it exceeded all expectations. adam, michal and their kids were great hosts, we couldn't ask for anything more. the location is amazing - subway station across the street, food and drink options everywhere, and most of all very welcoming people in the neighborhood. we couldn't recommend this place high enough, already looking forward to our next visit!

located in a great situation being a short walk from times square. the staff were friendly and i had excellent dealings with them. i would recommend staying at this holiday inn express for those people wanting to be close to the action of times square with great public transport options to easily move around the city also located within walking distance.
spacious accommodations in a nice location… convenient to subway, groceries, eateries. if we return to the area, we would stay here again.

mary is amazing and very kind. her home is well lived in, so if you are someone who likes living spaces with little things and areas to sit to have a coffee or a table to eat at then mary’s is not the place.. the room was clean and sparse and there was a desk to sit at to have a coffee. i really came to sleep and get up and go out so it was perfect for that. i also did not realize she had cats! this was my fault for not reading the entire description. i am allergic. again, this was my mistake. but if you have allergies please be advised. my favorite part of my stay was conversing with mary! she was a delight to talk to. i also appreciated the coffee and bread for the am. the bed was very comfortable too. and bathroom and sleeping room very clean and sparse, which i liked.
my stay at kamroon's place was great! the location is right next to the train station's entry, what makes getting around so much easier.
very detailed apartment, great host. loved the experience

this is great value for money in manhattan and very clean. the lobby is a bit shabby but clean, the staff are super friendly and helpful..we even found a decent deli at 1am thanks to the recommendation he gave! we stored bags in the lobby after checkout which was great and only $5. the area around canal can seem a bit sketchy if you aren’t familiar with nyc but i never felt unsafe at all. bathroom was clean and basic white, beds were comfortable and air con was good temp. we were on 4th floor..not too noisy as long as windows were closed. recommend. good value for money.

thanks so much to zenobia for the wonderful place; it is comfy and cozy and exactly as advertised. we had an excellent stay and found the place well located for our plans, near subway and prospect park. zenobia was so nice and helpful! thank you very much!

ana was extremely kind and helpful when we needed her help. additionally, this space is clean and well-kept. ana provided a manual with extremely helpful instructions on how to get to different locations throughout the city from the apartment, as well. this location is a gem because you don't have to pay manhattan prices, but you are a short ride on public transportation away from the city. overall, my wife and i loved our trip to the city and had a great experience staying here. definitely would recommend it to a friend!

danforth & darwin are tag team superhosts with a hospitable charm that will leave you better off for having met them. they are interested in their guests: who they are, what type of experiences they are trying to create. magnolia house is clean, well kept and is a living museum of art & artifacts collected over the last several decades. ask to sleep in theodore roosevelt’s bed. at magnolia house, dan & darwin will bring you into their fascinating world as former head writers and editors for world renowned frommer’s travel guide. having traveled much of the world over the course of several decades they returned to magnolia house with many beautiful and intriguing works of art & cultural objects from the far corners of the globe along with fascinating stories about their travels. as the headquarters for blood moon productions, the active energy of journalistic writers and biographers mastering their craft is ever-present. the way darwin and dan delve into a topic just in conversation expresses their penchant for stringing together words and facts, elevating their subject matter and giving a more profound examination and understanding of it. you will definitely learn something at magnolia house and leave maybe a bit wiser, if not, certainly with piqued curiosity and a desire to return for more of magnolia house.

andre is a great host, he is friendly and communicative. the location is near to a subway, so everything is easy and fast to reach. the flat was nice, the room we’ve slept in was big. all in one it was nice to stay there, but andre could work a little bit on his cleaning. the floor was pretty dirty as well as the bathroom.
very communicative

i had an amazing stay at this airbnb! the place was spotless and very well-maintained—everything felt fresh, clean, and comfortable from the moment i arrived. the host was excellent: very friendly, responsive, and quick to help with any questions i had. communication was smooth and easy throughout my stay. overall, it was a perfect experience, and i would definitely stay here again. highly recommend to anyone looking for a clean, comfortable place with a great host!

excellent service. the ladies at the front desk there were so nice and good service. the hotel is in a good location, you can walk to a lot of places like 9/11 memorial & museum and brooklyn bridge and a lot good restaurants. i would definitely stay at this hotel again.

horrible!!!! mold, dust, dirt and smelled! upon entering the apartment it smelled bad and musky. as i started unpacking i was getting very wheezy and itchy. i noticed black mold at the air vents and dirty insulation that was moist sticking out of a wall. the entire room had areas riddled with black mold spores and smelled of mold. also i should mention that the host said it would be her living in the apartment only to arrive to a male roommate. i was also told to tell the bellman upon checking in "i was teresa's friend"-not to say "airbnb". when i reached out to teresa about the mold she said "it's dust"...um.. no it's clearly not dust and even if it was just dust (but it was mold) -who wants to stay in a room for this price riddled with black dust everywhere...but it was clearly mold and we have urgent care bills to prove it. don't know how she got this far falsely advertising a toxic and dirty apartment. we even tried to settle w/out a bad review but she was horribly rude!

this was a great place to stay. i would definitely consider coming back when i come to ny. it was in a great, central location with access to several subway stations, making moving around in manhattan and brooklyn easy and convenient.
great place near bayside new york!

we loved our stay at the hotel hendricks. the rooms were clean and well laid out. the staff was extremely friendly, knowledgeable, and accommodating. the area was wonderful. we will definitely be staying there again!

kathleen was a such an amazing host. answered all my questions before our stay & greeted us at the cottage with a sweet treat. such a cozy touch. the place was so neat and decorated very homey. was truly such a nice relaxing stay. five stars all around. definitely will recommend and stay again for future travels 💗
shama’s place is so nice! very clean, spacious, and was able to house myself, my father in law, and sister in law very comfortably to be able to see extended family.

jenny was an excellent host, who was very responsive to messages. she made sure to welcome us personally when we arrived. check-in was easy and flexible, which came in handy. she also provided us with some useful local tips!
it was very clean and organized. had a great experience definitely will choose this any time if i need in future also!! thanks

make sure to check your messages prior to check-in, as the address is different from what’s listed. in actuality, it’s a 10min walk west of astoria n/w stop and 15min walk northeast of astoria ferry stop. that said, it’s a decent place to stay for the value and the host is responsive and proactive. having astoria park nearby was a big plus.
enjoyed my stay very much, spacious and comfortable rooms and accommodating hosts. will book again!
kevin was an excellent host, and the place was great. clean, safe, quiet, and very close to the subway. fantastic neighborhood food & drink are all within walking distance. you won't be disappointed.
excellent home and very clean. will definitely stay again!

large apartment for nyc. we enjoyed the food close by — pizza, bagels, and coffee shops. the apartment was clean, but the closet doors were off, no extra linens for guests and the dining table bench was ripped.
place was clean and very well decorated. cozy. short walk to the subway line. had everything we need in it. host was very thoughtful.
very clean, easy check-in. overall very nice apartment.
extremely clean apartment, and everything was great. jovanna was extremely nice and helpful and always responsive.

patricia's place is exactly as described. plenty of space for a couple, with additional sleeping accommodations in the living room if you have a third or fourth person joining you. kitchen has everything you need to cook or store food. plenty of fans for air circulation when it's warm. the spot was great, close to convenience stores and busses / the subway. patricia and her partner were amazing with their responses and were there to help us with anything we needed.

casey has an awesome apartment in a great area of the city, the east village. the apartment was clean and exactly as advertised. there are two other roommates living there as well, but i would not let that deter you as they are quiet and friendly. check-in process was straight forward and casey responds quickly to any questions you may have. i would definitely stay here again and recommend it to anyone who wants to visit the city!
really great host!! nice interior décor and really sanitary. nice restaurants nearby for late night memories!!

stayed for 3 nights, chose this hotel based on reviews, location, price. it was exactly as described. very close to subway station since we came by train. walkable to macys, times square, empire state building, koreatown. it's an older hotel but it was fine and still clean. plenty of elevators that moved quickly so no long wait and overcrowding. i was impressed by the cleaning crew that came everyday while we were out, not many places offer that anymore. as others have mentioned the showers were nice and hot and full of pressure. it is noisy even in the middle of the night you will hear sirens, ambulance, horns but expected since you are in midtown manhattan. room was a bit small, no bells and whistles but i was only there to sleep and it served its purpose. i would stay again. also, there is a mandatory $40-$50 fee per night that you will be charged, that is normal for everyone hotel now so do not be surprised, that information is included prior to you booking.
no wifi during stay. noisy and looks like not safe near the entrance. the building is very old. towels should be self-changable, so inconvenient.

we felt very safe at our stay with lousong, but our room was smaller than we had expected. we also didn't realize that multiple other local people utilize the living space (seems as though they rent out different rooms for a longer period of time), which made us feel like we couldn't use the space as our own. there was also a misunderstanding in relation to the parking situation, but the hosts apologized to us the next day. it was also my boyfriend's birthday and i had asked to have the room decorated by a third party, the day before, but the host was very unaccommodating. i received comments like "i don't have time to talk to you." a pro is that their place is quite close to the subway so it was easy to access all the attractions around nyc. overall, very safe area & great location, but not the best stay in terms of cleanliness and privacy.

i had a really good time with thanks to this accomodation. the metro is not that far and really accessible to get around nyc. the place itself is clean, and had a lot of amenities that made our trip easy. would defintely go back there if i had the chance.

i truly enjoyed staying here. i will do it all over again. i did not want to leave here. everything about this place felt right at home and joanna and her partner are great hostess. they are there for your every need. i truly appreciated that and i appreciate them.

honestly, i really like this place, it’s very close to time square. there are a lot of restaurants and bars near the place. i would suggest doing the check-in with the assistant instead. i would recommend it for people who want a nice place to sleep and take shower and go out since the place is kinda small.
she was very nice and very helpful. she got us everything we needed and was very polite. i'd recommend her if anybody is looking for a place in the area. i'd stay here again.
awesome apartment. thanks for the great night rachel!
great place to stay. highly recommend if your going to be in the area
unbeatable location!

a really enjoyable stay. the house is decorated in cool and quirky decor, and while the house is shared with multiple housemates, it was very quiet. we enjoyed walking a block down the street to enjoy a diverse array of yummy cuisines.

liza's place was everything and then some. liza was very welcoming and responsive. we felt right at home. the location was only a few blocks from a local train station that could get you to anywhere in nyc. the place was safe and secure. the rooms were clean, and there were comfy beds. i would stay at liza's place again when visiting the nyc area. that is a true description of the property and a wonderful host. place was better than expected.
clean, smart design. perfect amount of space for one person. i didn’t realize this was a large hotel when booking.
the host was very responsive whenever we had questions and was very kind! i would definitely book here again
very clean and new, close to different subway stations and to supermarkets. great place.
ms. thaya is wonderful and very kind hearted person. i highly recommend for all solo travelers. she is very responsive in guidance for local transport and eating places.

the house is close to the subway, which is great and is a direct line into manhattan. jose is great with communication and making sure you are comfortable and have what you need and know how to get around.

the home is in a quiet and safe area and there are a few grocery stores and restaurants within walking distance. also convenient via bus. be aware that there is no closet in the room, just a recess where you can hang a couple things. a few hangers are provided, but nothing to hang skirts.
loved the view. gave $10 food credit and citibike rental with checkin
great place to stay in brooklyn. mta just a couple minutes away. clean and cozy home. would stay again!

everything was nice there were a few extras like water in the refrigerator and shampoos in the shower - the tvs worked well and it was great being about to have extra room with a nice kitchen - the price was less than hotels in the area - very good communication and she and her helpers quickly replied to every question and concern - i would highly recommend

the location is epic, literally across the road from columbus circle, and a very short walk to the upper westside and hells kitchen. the apartment is a bit worn from age but everything worked as expected. check in was easy and allan carried our bags up and showed us everything.

we had a wonderful few nights in helen and alfred's apartment and really can't recommend it highly enough. the accommodation was perfect for the three of us and helen's warm welcome was very much appreciated; she couldn't have done more to make us feel at home. this part of brooklyn is a great place to visit (and the info folder in the apartment is packed with helpful local knowledge) but is also just a subway ride from anywhere you'd want to go. don't miss out on a great airbnb opportunity!

the apartment was awesome, excactly like the photos and very clean and comfortable. the hosts are very helpful and friendly and answered all questions extremely quick. the area in the lower east side is very busy but great. the subway is only a few minutes away. i highly reconmend this place!

you hit the jackpot when staying w such a terrific person like laurence. he's kind, helpful, and is a terrific host. the room is large w a comfy bed, n a fridge, too. excellent location n great music after u wake in the morning. laurence is such a sweet soul. very thankful for his hospitality😊👍
