hotel is well located and relatively nice. great bar with entertainment midweek , rooms are perhaps its just a little bit run down and could use a refresher, but for the price was pretty reasonable. all of the staff were excellent & attentive to our needs. the other reviews mention the elevators & that tracked but we never waited longer than 5 minutes. word to the wise if you obtain a room that smells strange immediately ask the front desk to switch out your shower curtain. the room smelled horrible when we arrived and the manager immediately recommended switching out the shower curtain & voila within a day the room smelled fine. i thought the room was quiet and comfortable & the beds were the most comfortable beds i think i've ever slept in @ a hotel ! maid service every day was excellent and they did a great job!!! tv remote wouldn't connect the way the instructions say it would but otherwise everything else worked fine & i would definitely stay here again.
the spot was cozy and close to the train. i felt safe and i stayed here in the winter so the heater was very helpful when returning from essentially the snow
good spot, smaller than anticipated and the lighting isn’t the greatest
clean, lovely room in great location, we really enjoyed our stay!
good place to stay!

the windows are paper thin and you can hear everything so the earplugs they provide are so helpful. there was hair in various places (not the bed) and a few toenails on the floor. i didn’t like having to pay more to check in early if the room was already available but rules are rules. don’t let the bustle of canal st right in front of the property scare you, it’s safe and secure inside. they have a communal fridge to keep your stuff in and portable heaters available if the central cooling is too cold for you. and the heaters work great and fast! subway is directly outside the property which is so nice. water pressure and temperature in the shower was amazing
nice place to stay, julie was gave a lot of recommendations and helped out with any questions we had. we would stay here again
barry is an amazing human being. the place was amazing. amenities are more and better than expected.
mairo is a very warm and hospitable host. his home is in a good neighborhood and nice for a small family to stay for a couple of days.
great place! clean, easy check-in, awesome cafe on the first floor for working and included pastries/coffee if you are a hotel guest.
the place is comfortable, quiet, close to everything, very friendly and flexible, all good!
it was a great apartment and lots of groceries stores and things nearby. allison was super helpful with everything. i stayed here for 3 months
great place to stay in midtown. quiet, comfortable

joseph is a great host and communicator. he was always very responsive to questions and gave clear instructions on check in, where everything was in the house, etc. the beds are very comfortable, grocery store and places to eat within walking distance. the bus stop is literally 3 houses away. i’d go back again the next time in ny.

i stayed at jessica's residence for 8 nights with my 11 year old son. we found the place to be clean and just as described. the area is family friendly and peaceful, a local park is very close and lots of restaurants nearby. jessica provided very useful information ahead of our stay to assist with our planning. overral our time in nyc was a memorable one.
i can’t believe such a spacious place exists in manhattan, new york! it was more than comfortable for our family of five.

nice house with al equipment you need and a relaxed garden - we had breakfast there every morning, which was lovely. good, safe, beautiful and typical brooklyn neighbourhood, with supermarkets and nice restaurants nearby and the metroline, which goes almost everywhere quite fast, at 5 blocks (8 minute walk) away.
nice place, not far from the subway. 👌

great location. nice and comfortable apartment in a trendy area. beautiful views of brooklyn bridge and manhattan skyline nearby. we were 7 and it was great. we had room and privacy. for the seventh perdon a really comfortablei nflatable mattress. we had everything we needed. really recommended
was a great stay!
cool spot with great decor and a comfy bed. super easy subway ride to the city. responsive, friendly hosts. my daughter and i had a great stay!
great apartment to visit ny

i was in brooklyn for a concert with my teen, and abby’s place was exactly what we needed for a short weekend stay. it was easy to access, the area felt safe, and we had plenty of privacy. easily walkable to local coffee shops, markets, and restaurants. we’re definitely keeping abby’s place bookmarked for future visits to the city!
we absolutely loved this stay. it was so clean and very nice. the bed is so comfortable and we slept so well. would recommend this place to anyone who wants a nice, clean , and private place!!!

we had a great experience at untitled. the location is perfect and the rooms are clean. checking in and out was easy and the team always responded nearly instantly to any queries. the room was for sure on the smaller side, not ideal if you are planning to work from the hotel and on the tighter side if you are a couple, but the price is really unbeatable and there are plenty of cafes and co-working spaces nearby. 100% recommend!
pros. good location. located on center of manhattan. easy to reach all kind of transportation. kind host. cons. road is too noisy. no elevator if you had lots of lugguage.
definitely worth every last dime! beautiful most comfortable airbnb i stayed in, in a long time.

thank you rachael for being a flexible and accommodating host! the place was clean, spacious, and private. check-in was smooth and we were able to drop off our luggage early and after check-out as well.

wayne and nae’s place was perfect! the location and set up fit just right for a private getaway for 2. both hosts were extremely accommodating and helpful when needed. it truly was a really nice stay.
quirky, creative, clean, high-tech space. ample shopping and an amazing array of bars and cafes within easy walking distance.

had a little hiccup with the key placement but outside of that everything was great. beds were comfy, place was clean. one of the tvs we broken and removed before our arrival but we headed out for a play and when we returned there was a tv which was pretty great as i was traveling with my children. rafael even moved one of his cars so that i didn’t have to park on the street. fresh towels were delivered during our stay which i thought was thoughtful. overall great stay.
very special experiece. i recommend it to everyone
kylie and her team were great from the start. this is an awesome apartment for groups. can’t beat the setup and location!

such a wonderful stay at this apartment, was here for two weeks and would definitely return. loads of space and fabulously comfortable bed. only thing to note is that it is quite noisy with the bar downstairs ...not for light sleepers!
great host and very responsive, great place and location. only issue was we lost light for one whole night and morning. it was 95f and that was very unpleasant…. but overall good stay.

it was very spotless and clean. nicole gave very clear instructions on where to go and what to do when we first arrived. she provided few snacks and cereal which we appreciated. the neighborhood was very peaceful and we had great access to the long island railroad and the bus. lovely experience!
great location. easy check in.
giovanni was probably the most attentive host we have ever experienced with airbnb. cannot say enough good things about him.
a very good place for spend a few days in ny
enjoyed my stay.
very clean and good location
nicole went above and beyond as a host- so accommodating, proactive, and friendly. 10/10, would def recommend

finding the apartment was a breeze. communication with eleni was easy and always timely. she was very accomadating as we arrived later than i had originally stated. the room was perfect and exactly as mentioned. my dad and i enjoyed talking with the roommates after returning from the city one night. the apartment/flat has a very welcoming vibe.

great location, clean room, all as described. millennium offered to upgrade me to a suite for a modest up-charge, so i did that, and the suite was excellent: full couch, work space, 2 tvs in the room. would stay again.

the apartment is charming and in a great location. evelyn was a good communicator and was kind. everything about the apartment was terrific except for one important issue. the listing on airbnb advertises that it is a one-bedroom. unfortunately that is not true. it is a studio. this is an essential piece of incorrect information.
lovely hotel, good view, friendly staff. would stay again.

i had a fantastic two-week stay at paige's apartment in williamsburg! paige's place is extremely clean, well-equipped with everything that you need, and is located perfectly (the l train is only a 5 min walk away). the back patio is a lovely refuge to enjoy some sunshine right at home. paige was a lovely host - super friendly and communicative! i would definitely stay here again in the future, and would highly recommend basing your nyc/williamsburg stay here as well!

this is an ideal location. it's so nice to be near manhattan in a neighborhood with great restaurants within walking distance. our host went out of his way to make our stay pleasant, and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay.
small but clean rooms, comfortable bed, nice bathroom. perfect location in midtown manhattan was a short walk to times square and hudson yards, which is just what we needed. would stay there again.
beautiful home!

silvia’s place was beautiful and just what we were looking for! she was very easy to communicate with and very helpful with my arrival and departure mess ups due to the shutdown problems. would stay again if the chance arrived!

the studio was very clean, the area for transportation was very convenient to the subway and buses. we found every one to be kind and helpful, so grateful to the wonderful people who helped us on the subways. we would stay there again, john made everything convenient and gave us some tips of places to visit

the tv was unbelievably frustrating. i almost wouldn’t market a working tv because that is hardly accurate. any time we wanted to lie down and watch a movie, it took quite literally twice as long to watch the movie. it stopped every two minutes to buffer, but then the movie kept playing so then we had to rewind and rewatch the same scene four or five times just to get past it. we unplugged and plugged in the kodi box and it didn’t help, switched between both wifi networks and neither helped. and, when we would restart it, we had to restart the box three times just to get something to play, let alone play smoothly. we were also very frustrated by the noise upstairs. i would not have chosen this place had i known i could hear the people upstairs as if i were in the same room when they were talking or moving chairs around, etc., or someone would be doing major construction and be banging on the walls or floor at 7 am every morning, loudly enough to wake us up and keep us up. paying what we paid for it was not worth it. the bed was nice, and eli was very nice in our communication. we were just not pleased with a lot of things, especially the tv and noise upstairs.
wonderful people and family, just the great conversation alone is a value. would be grateful to meet these hosts again!

we were only here for a night, but truly enjoyed our stay. janet greeted us at the door and gave us a tour. the apartment has great personality, is very comfortable and had everything we needed and more! as it was a cold rainy day we especially enjoyed the heated floors. the location is great and there are lots of restaurants and cafe’s etc in the neighborhood.
mike is great & place is cool.

had a comfortable stay at candlewood suites. the room was clean, staff was friendly, and the location was convenient for getting around new york. really appreciated the kitchenette and overall quiet atmosphere.
great location and fun airb&b. recommend staying here, clean and comfortable. everything was as promised. enjoy !!!
very clean and tidy
besides the noisy train noisy upstairs guest and no tv channel it was better than expected check in was a breeze and edward communicated very well. thanks
this place is so clean! the location is very convenient. the subway is right on the corner.

amazing and good price. maya is a very good host. we arrived really late with our flight, and maya waited for us to show us everything (keys and rooms). we had private bathrooms and access to the kitchen, so we can cook if needed or take breakfast before going to explore nyc. maya even provided tea or coffee. the neighborhood is safe and quiet and less than 10min walk to the subway and train station. (around 30min to the center of manhattan).
very clean and easy check-in! it was a convenient location and friendly staff. i would recommend for a couple wanting to explore nyc! i am definitely coming back to enjoy their bar and restaurant.

andrew was beyond friendly and hospitable to my boyfriend and me. he was very accommodating with our check-in, and even let us leave our bags there after checking out so we didn't have to carry them around the city all day. he helped us find some great spots to eat nearby, and even gave us directions to the nearest train station. his place is very conveniently located just a couple blocks from a subway station that takes you right to the heart of manhattan. andrew was easily the friendliest guy we met our entire time in new york!

rob is an easy going host. he is always available for questions/clarifications and can give you great recommendations. the apartment is super clean, the room itself bright and spacious. kitchen has everything you need to prepare some meals. ground rules are easy and understandable. access to laundry room available. apartment is located next to a train, which brings you in around 30 min to most famous places in downtown, in a lively, but quiet neighborhood. grocery shopping and restaurant all nearby. would stay there again.

the directions and instructions from song were clear and concise, song was also very responsive. the space itself was clean, had all the essentials from toilet paper, paper towels, clean towels, body soap, hand soap, shampoo and conditioner. it is a very quiet area and the tenants upstairs were quiet as well. i would highly recommend song’s place. the one thing i will say and it’s not a negative is that the space is in a basement, so take that for what it’s worth. for a basement it is very clean.

staying at leo’s place in east village was absolutely wonderful! leo was a fantastic host — friendly, responsive, and thoughtful. the apartment had everything we needed and more, super clean and cozy. the location couldn’t have been better, it is right in the heart of one of nyc’s best neighborhoods. we will definitely stay here again next time!
great host... super eco friendly clean therapy and safe for covid 19, clean space, mask worn at all times. answered all of our questions and suggested how to have fun in nyc outdoors
i have lived here twice and the room is really cozy and comfortable!

helena's place is exactly as advertised and met all of our expectations and needs during our 2-week stay. the place is walking distance to just about every major subway line, as well as a great shopping center and restaurants. her place is pretty much spotless, and i found helena very easy to communicate with. i also appreciate how flexible she was in accommodating our needs (i.e. late check out and making other arrangements for herself so that we could stay a full 2 weeks). highly, highly recommended!
comfortable stay. clean and beautiful. great location close to everything with lots to do. thanks so much for having us.
great location, quick & easy check-in! we rested well in a cozy quiet apartment after touring the city all day!! we definitely come back to studioplus again!!
the description and photos honestly undersell this airbnb. the apartment is spacious and extremely comfortable. kiriko and dominic are very responsive as well. highly recommended.

great place to stay. although in red hook, only 10 minutes to wall street by ferry which costs the same like a subway ticket. several citibike stations around for a ride along the east river. the private bathroom was great. marjorie is a great host.
great value, super nice host!

nicole's space is very lovely. it is very clean and nicely furnished. every amenity one might need for a comfortable stay is supplied. the kitchen is very well stocked with tools and spices if cooking is your thing. i also liked that i didn't have to walk to a laundromat to wash/dry my clothes. the building is very quiet and the neighbors are very nice and helpful. the location of the apartment is convenient to the subway as well as lots of restaurants, bars, and parks. i would definitely stay again the next time i am in the brooklyn/nyc area.

the apartment is located in a quiet neigthborhud. it is very clean and very cozy. when you arrive try to see everything what you have there because we found toilet paper, bags for trash and even a shopping car so you don't need to carry up your grocery bags. there's 2 subway stations close: 20 avenue and bay parkway: both the n train. life's laundry was perfect for us, it is 7 minutes by walking, you are going to have different food options and a target 10 minutes by walking. it is 55 minutes away by train from times square and 20 minutes away from coney island so if you are going on summer you are close to the beach!! we went to make an english course and it was 35 minutes away by subway so the distance wasn't a trouble for us. the wifi sometimes is not that good, but again, it wasn't a problem for us because weren't home until night. chi was very kind to us when we decided to extend our stay and she is able to help you if you need anything! we are so happy to decided booked this airbnb and if we have to book an apartment again in new york it will definitely be chi's apartment.

the house is not in anything similar to good conditions. the host and i had very different perspectives on how a paying guest should be treated. i really felt like the amount of "house rules" were excessive and made me feel unwelcomed.
she was great and nice
very nice apartment in the upper west side close to central park. marta is an impeccable host and nyc is just amazing. strongly recommended!
nice place.. very clean..
great stay in a great location

there is just so much to say about my experience here - i am not sure where to begin. so, i decided to make a pros and cons list to help readers understand where i'm coming from: pros: - literally the best airbnb experience i've ever had. - rich made banana bread and cookies for me (he needs to open his own bakery!) - rich also treated me to delicious home-cooked meals while i was his guest. - the apartment is beautiful. the neighborhood is well connected. - traveling in the city is a piece of cake thanks to rich's excellent advice. - did i mention the cookies? - kittens! stella is so much fun to hang with. cons: - the other kitten, neil, was very suspicious of me. - you may not want to leave after your visit.
place was great and host was very responsive to our needs.

it was my second time staying at jeffrey's home so that should speak for itself. jeffrey's place is very clean and i love all the touches of his family's vintage photos and artwork. perfect location close to the 1,2,3 trains and west end/riverside running areas with beautiful gardens. the building and room are quiet. the bed is very comfortable, the room is large and gets plenty of sun and it has blackout curtains if needed. bathroom is very clean and no troubles with hot water. jeffrey is a longtime local who is a classical, talented musician. he has great recommendations on nyc shows and nearby restaurants. he is a sweetheart and always helpful. i'd definitely recommend his home!
worth the price.

everything about chantal's place was amazing. not too far from the subway which it made so easy for us. she had everything u could possibly need in her place. i mean it. like from sewing kit all the way to lint roller. not even hotels have lint rollers. made right choice by staying at her place. she was very responsive to our questions. thank u so much chantal we had such a wonderful time.

there is no other place that we can highly recommend but sandra’s. her place is strategically located very near the train station, grocery, nice restaurants and other attraction. it’s very nice, clean , cozy and has those lovely touches in her interiors. but what makes it even exceptional is sandra as a host. she deserves the “superhost” title! no second thoughts in choosing her place when we come back again to brooklyn! thank you very much sandra!
excellent! would definitely recommend.

i love staying with martha the room was nice and clean and the location was great, close to public transportation. i will definitely be staying here again!! martha was very available anytime of the day, and she is very friendly as well. worth every dollar spent! thanks for having me martha

daisy was an awesome host! she was very welcoming! i loved her little place!! the space is on the smallish side, but it is very unique and homey. public transit is a little tricky if you are exploring the town a bunch…i did the subway a couple of times but then opted for lyft rides. there are several little places nearby if you need anything or want to grab a quick bite for breakfast!
great place to stay, feels like another home. the host will always answer any questions you have and gives the best tips.
amazing place! super clean and super cute. andrea herself is a very attentive host! left many cute amenities that we didn’t expect. loved it!

this airbnb is a true gem. it is nice, spacious and in a great location. it was extremely clean and there is a small deck outside which was a nice surprise although it was winter in nyc so we did not use too much but it was nice. ideally located, the neighborhood was great and it was close to mta and getting around. we thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would definitely stay again.
great place, def will considering rebooking
appreciated the accommodation. i only stayed for 3 nights. the room was clean and the host were very responsive. the best part was the convenience of being close to the subway.

this was such an amazing stay. i thought with it being close to everything we wanted to do, it may be loud but nope. it was not loud at all. such an amazing host!! leigh is genuinely a great person with such good taste might i add. we are living in buffalo now, but we are from texas so the decor was very special to us during our stay. we will absolutely be staying at leigh’s place again. thank you so much for the welcoming stay!!
really friendly and helpful, close to subway stations. water pressure on shower was good, wifi was really fast and stable, too.
shower had no pressure and was cold.
quiet, clean place and good location.
ed was a great host
the place was beautiful and i felt very safe
nana responded within 10 minutes when we had difficulty with the gate and lock. quiet setting and nice walk to prospect park.

jehan’s place was so beautiful! it was even better than the description and pictures! her place is so clean, and cozy! i was so pleased to see how neat everything was. she is also so kind and sweet. i highly recommend her place to anyone!

we just stayed overnight for a quick trip to see a friend, but it was extremely comfortable and spacious for 2 people. the building was pretty quiet and a good location, with subway stops nearby and a really nice market around the corner. we'd definitely stay here again!
james was the best host that i meet, i really appreciate to help me more than i expected. totally recomend, the place is clean, nice, close to big avenue.
nice hotel i really enjoyed my stay here!! the room was cleaned upon arrival and the hotel checkin was very welcoming and they even offered us waters!!

very clean room and house with easy access and nice porch. however, street parking was a challenge. also we thought the kitchen is off limit but later we knew we could have used it. it would be nice if we knew we could have access to coffee/tea in side the house at least in the morning. otherwise very good place to stay.
great deal for nyc! the complimentary breakfast was perfect for our family.
great stay at dawn’s, perfect for what we needed to get to public transport options. dawn was great to communicate with and the space was perfect for what we needed.

i had a fantastic stay at the m social! it was the perfect spot for a night out, with the eugene o’neill theatre and radio city music hall both within easy walking distance — ideal for catching a show and a late-night comedy set. the staff was incredibly accommodating, even letting us check in early. i also loved the convenience of the lobby store, open until 2 am, a lifesaver for any late-night cravings. to top it off, the restaurant serves absolutely amazing food.

we enjoyed our weekend stay. perfect location and super close to the train. cozy spot and had everything we needed. o.d. was an amazing host, communication was a 10/10! would definitely recommend booking:)
awesome host. thanks for everything. this is a steal.
very nice house. conveniently located. 5 mins walk to metro station. peaceful and safe area
we found it to be quite spacious for 4 people and really enjoying staying in that neighborhood. would stay again. (go to williamsburg bagels if you stay here it’s a few minute walk from the air bnb!)

we had a great stay at this apartment. it’s close to central park and the q which we took daily. there are a ton of great food options, highly recommend centro pizza for pizza and calexico if you like mexican. the bathroom is super spacious, and the kitchen is stocked with pots, pans, a coffee maker and an induction cook top. though it can be noisy when going to sleep but the double windows help and the ac in the bedroom is great white noise. we loved our stay on the upper east side with afi and definitely recommend. thanks for everything!
great location. perfect size for 2 people.

ame is a fantastic host. her house is beautiful and our room is really cozy. bathroom is spotless. we got to the city earlier and were able to check in earlier without problems. thank you ame for having us at your wonderful home.

this was my first time using airbnb and it was even better than i'd hoped it would be. marcia (mar-see-ah) was very welcoming and her communication before, during, and after our stay was great. she responds very well to messages as she wasn't always around. the loft is exactly as you see in the pics, but better. it has such a cool feeling to it and it's bigger than my three bedroom house in the 'burbs. the bed and covers were very comfortable. we opened the window for some airflow as she doesn't have air conditioning, and it was quite comfortable for sleeping. did i mention how cool the loft was was and how awesome marcia was?? it truly is an artists loft; she actually has her own painting studio there that she uses to create her amazing artwork. as for the neighborhood, i personally love it. there are plenty of little shops to check out, several grocery stores, a liquor store, close by subway stations, the water front is two blocks away where you can see the manhattan skyline. here are the favorites for the places nearby... for pizza, juliana's (about a 10 minute walk) ; for bar superfine and also superfine for dinner (two minute walk). it's owned by a neighbor and it's definitely the best place nearby. they have a full bar and also seating for dining. the menu changes daily based on what's available from local sources. i had the best burger i might have ever had and my friend had a chicken dish with mashed potatoes and some sort of slaw that was also delicious. the lemon rosemary crème brûlée was too good to even describe. they also have live music on sundays. we got coffee at brooklyn roasting company and the bagels and coffee at la bagel delight were so good! for entertainment we went in to the city one night to see a play, the brooklyn flea was really neat too. we've been to nyc quite a few times, so we tried to do more of the local stuff rather than the touristy things. staying in this neighborhood makes you feel like you live there and gives you a feeling of familiarity. long story short, the loft is awesome, the neighborhood is awesome, and the hostess is awesome.

the second time to live here, very clean and tidy, well-equipped, suitable for family occupancy, the landlord is also very good, there are problems in a timely manner, after the united states will always choose here!

m e was a great host (as well as her two kitties)! the space was beautiful and had everything we could ever need. everything was spotless and clean and m e and the kittens welcomed us with love and a bottle of wine! great location around so many great restaurants and super close to the subway and columbia university. m e was super helpful, gave us great restaurant recommendations, made us the occasional cocktail, and was so fun to talk to but at the same time gave us privacy when we wanted it. we’ll definitely be staying here again!
the house was super clean and modern inside
this place was lovely
great place to stay at! would stay again, great location & staff.
good option not too far off a subway line for one night to avoid paying manhatten hotel rates to see a show. firm bed and pillows not the best for a side sleeper.
despite a little bumpy check-in it was a great eto be in this perfectly situated, well equipped apartment. the bed is very comfortable and made me forget my jetlag. i highly recommend this location
big thanks eliana for the hospitality!😊

i couldn’t have picked a better place to stay during my trip to visit nyc. the studio was much larger than expected and very stylish and clean. ivanna added many thoughtful touches and made our stay memorable!
great spot. we will be back!
great hospitality

our stay in nyc was amazing and shante’s place was a big part of that. shantes place was very nice, clean, spacious, and quiet! there is a kitchen space to make and heat foods if needed. the bathroom is very nice and modern. the bed was very big and comfortable as well. not sure if shante does it for every guest but she left two metro cards which were so greatly appreciated and made traveling on the train hassle free. thank you for sharing your space and being quick to communicate shante. hope to stay here again!
the perfect place for our group. easy subway or taxi ride to midtown. apartment was great and clean.

this apartment is definitely worth staying! it's warm, clean, with decorations attentive to details, and with nearly everything you need for living in an apartment for a period of time. me and my roommate lived here for 3 months and we are both very happy with it. the host rt is responsive and offers help very quickly. the apartment is a 5min walk from a subway station so the transportation is very convenient as well. within 10min of walk there are 4 supermarkets where you can get groceries, and several delis where you can grab drinks and food. this is definitely a good place to live!

joanna's home is the perfect location for exploring the city. you can set out in literally any direction and find good food, historical sites, entertainment, shopping... you name it. if you are walkers like us (and the weather permits) you can see many of the city's interesting neighborhoods on foot. her home is a short subway/rideshare from central park and the uptown attractions. there is a wonderful farmer's market a few blocks away for fresh produce and all kinds of culinary treats. the 150-year-old home is filled with art, antiques, and photographs and as another reviewer stated, evidence of a life well-lived. it exudes history and charm, which we fully appreciated. be advised that with that comes steep stairs, the crackle of heating pipes (not annoying, but if you've never heard it you might be alarmed) and single-pane windows which are an issue in the upper bedroom at night when the street noise picks up. a set of earplugs was an easy remedy! the kitchen was well equipped if you want to take a break from dining out. beds were fine, though the 2nd room is a pull-out couch and doesn't sleep like a mattress. you know from your first interactions with joanna that she cares about being a good host and ensuring that your stay in her home is positive. she communicates well and is very conscientious. we had a few check-in snafus that in our book were small... she wasn't there to greet us (sent a surrogate) and she couldn't catch her cats so she could leave (we love cats and didn't mind helping). she made sure that we were set up with snacks, morning coffee, and cereal... small, gracious touches. joanna was easy to contact during our stay and addressed questions or concerns promptly. our stay at her place left us feeling like we got to experience life as a true new yorker!
very responsive host. nice building. great neighborhood. thank you!
great place to stay in nyc! it's a combination of hotel and airbnb. it has a very unique style with a soho vibe with a very helpful and friendly staff.

we had a family of four staying at this place, and the experience was fantastic! ample parking spaces, close distance to the a train (we went into manhattan), and the best of all, house was just clean, stylish, and amazing. i would highly recommend to anyone who’s thinking about visiting rockaway beach area.

the residence is very clean, it is spotless, the kitchen and the room are spacious and bright, and the living facilities are perfect, which makes us feel at home during the trip, which is very good. there is a subway station within five minutes of walking and the traffic is very convenient. there are supermarkets nearby, and the products are very rich. there are vegetables, fruits, various foods and daily necessities, and shopping is convenient. the supermarket is still open for business at 10 o'clock in the evening, and it is open early in the morning. thank you, the landlord for providing such a great place to live.

we greatly enjoyed our stay with pettrina! she was very responsive when we were arriving for check in and throughout the stay. the location is great, there were multiple very nice coffee shops within walking distance and the train station was only 2 minutes away, which made getting into the city extremely easy. overall we were very satisfied with our stay and would definitely choose pettrina again next time we visit new york city!
sumeira's place is exactly as pictured. sparkling clean and in a beautiful neighborhood. i highly recommend it. we will be back!
everything was awesome….kimberly was nice, communication/response time was good, very clean and the best part was you had your own full bathroom in your room!
we had a great time in josh's apartment, great location and exactly as described. perfect!
great place, perfect clean, beautiful backyard! olga is a great host! recommend
i would highly recommend karen’s place to anyone who is looking for a comfortable, fairly priced space in a great location and a responsive, friendly host.

i had a wonderful stay. this apartment is in a great neighborhood, close to the metro. it's clean and beautiful. barbara handled the communication very professionally--clearly and at just at the right times. checking in was a breeze. i highly recommend a stay here!

overall, jerica's apartment was ideal for us. location is great, street is very nice - quaint new york neighborhood and easy transportation by subway, bus, taxi or by foot. would definitely stay there again. good apartment for two people and jerica was extremely friendly and accessible. the stairs are surprisingly steep at first- but good for a workout and you get used to them quickly.

sooo much space and great location. definitely will be back!
fantastic stay! seamless and easy process. great location. can't wait to come back.

natalia and stefano responded to questions in a timely manner, were helpful and friendly. the place was perfect for our needs. we enjoyed sitting in the backyard. there is a great supermarket nearby.

with the time spent there yanio became like an extended family. his warmth and hospitality made my stay extremely comfortable. the area was as expected and so convinient. as a solo traveller this was by far the safest and most safest experience i had. as a host he was so friendly and made me feel like i was part of the household. i definately recommend this to anyone and for sure i will be back because this basically became my top choice of accommodation. 5+ more stars. thank you and see you soon yanio !!

edna has a lovely place by yankee stadium and the bronx terminal market. edna and her daughter were very responsive to our needs. they carefully guided us through the check-in process. everything we needed was provided. my wife and i would happily return to edna's.

convenient, clean, friendly, economical. great breakfast - and who knew about wine hour or cookies at 4pm?! highly recommend it.

quiet residential neighborhood close to public transportation, stores, restaurants. bathroom could have been a little cleaner/decluttered and use some tlc.

amazing location, relatively easy onstreet parking and great access to the subway (only 30 min to midtown manhattan on the express 4 or 5)

dylana’s place is great! you can talk with other travellers or just chill in your room. it’s quiet as long as you can get used to the subway rolling by which i did, no problem. very clean and dylana was very responsive. the mattress was good, and there’s a fully operational and stocked kitchen.
boris was very accomodating. easy to follow instructions and hassle free access. the apartment is very warm and inviting. very convenient to a train to manhattan.

perfect little place for sleep and shower. close to the subway line for easy trips. nice to have the elevator also. just what we needed.
great space and location! will use again.

the location is great. just know that there is a club across the street on eldridge so during the weekend expect to hear the bass and loud talking until at least 3 am. the room is very small but efficient. for the price it’s a great deal:)

great location, nice and clean apartment. b.'s friend alan was there when we arrived and showed us around. the sofa bed was broken, he tried to order a new one but we ended up sleeping on the crooked bed for the week. still, all in all a very nice place to stay!

vitaly was a great host! he allowed us to check in, in a reasonable time. his place was clean and well equipped with the tools we needed. he even allowed us to check out when we wanted. i would definitely recommend to a friend. plus the space was very hip and artsy, love, love, loved it!
my sister and i loved our stay! yvette is kind and flexible and a great hostess and the location was convenient.

great host, even we check in at 10:30 pm she came by and did a house tour for us and explained everything that we need to know and gave us great tips about how to get around in the big apple. the location is very close to train station. is a great place in the heart of brooklyn. also they have a beautiful german shepard is very smart and friendly, i like to play with him. use the train map provide very useful !!!

gorgeous brownstone in a really cool neighborhood. the local food and snacks they provided were such a thoughtful touch. would absolutely stay here again! :)

great place and amazing communication! victoria provided all the information required for check-in beforehand which made it super easy, would definitely stay again.
they were always on call any issues they were on top of it very friendly and about their business would i go again yes 👍🏽 👍🏽👍🏽👍🏽👍🏽

we had an amazing time. we’d stay here again whenever we’re in new york city!

tl;dr - a great place for a great value! we really enjoyed our stay at jeff´s place and would warmly recommend it. the appartment was spacious,clean and quiet. our hosts jeff and alex were wonderful and very helpful. all the information given in the advertisment above is true and correct. this was our first airbnb experience, hence we were a litte bit anxious beforehand - all in vain. everything went down smoothly - from check-in to check-out ten days later. the accommodation is located at the northern tip of manhattan island in a mostly dominican neighborhood with two beautiful parks within walking distance. the a- and 1- train are literally a 5 minutes walk away which is very convenient if you plan on traveling pretty much anywhere in manhattan and beyond. the appartment was extremely spacious and quiet for ny standards. all shared spaces were kept nice and tidy all the time. the bathroom and kitchen offer pretty much everything that comes to mind including a personal fridge. the bedroom with two king-sized beds (very comfortable mattresses and a variety of pillows to choose from) was huge (approx. 20-25 m²) and the windows, facing the inner courtyard of the appartment buildung, made the room very quiet. the gigantic tv including a ps4 and wifi as well as all the other amenities mentioned in the description put this accomodation so far ahead of every affordable and (not even) comparable hotel room. our hosts and co-host, jeff and alex, made us feel comfortable in an instant. both are open-minded, friendly, reliable as well as communicative and don`t shy away from a thoughtful conversation. especially their knowledge of the neighborhood and city enabled them to give us great recommendations on where to spend our precious time. additionally their cats, april and franklin, were absolutely adorable and made us miss ours a little less. april is the cutest bengal ever and franklin loves to snuggle and play fetch all day. we miss you. if you are a group of at least two people traveling to new york looking for a nice and quiet place to stay - this is what you're looking for. we had pretty much a perfect week and wish we could have stayed longer. thank you, a million times, for sharing your home with us!
our host annie was fantastic! we highly recommend and also would stay again!! annie was always amazingly responsive with any questions or if needed anything while we were there!
great place for a night or two!
lovely and clean place. very spacious place that can accommodate a family.
dee’s place is very charming and feels safe and cozy! very cute neighborhood with great food and coffee shops!! very good location for exploring the city overall:)

family of 5 (3 kids under 9) had a wonderful stay at joseph’s place! there was plenty of space for all of us. short walk to bus stops with a short ride to the ferry. kitchen was stocked and had complimentary coffee. lots sleeping space, extra towels, and toilet paper. joseph was very friendly and very responsive. we messaged joseph for a space heater during a cold & rainy day and he dropped 2 off quickly. much appreciated to keep the kids warm! if you’re looking for a place outside manhattan but with an easy commute, this is it! we enjoyed our stay!

i recently had a wonderful stay at this airbnb. the space was clean, cozy, and inviting. the location was perfect, with easy access to popular destinations. the host was friendly and provided excellent recommendations. i highly recommend this airbnb for a wonderful experience. 💯

place is very old. has only 2 prong outlets so make sure your devices have 2 prong outlets. couldn’t charge my laptop. also the parking is very tight and cannot fit 3 cars. place is big but it is very dark and some lights don’t work. not a modern house in the slightest.

this place is really spacious, cozy, clean, stylish and has an amazing backyard! also steps away from the subway j station and local supermarket which made it very convenient for us during our stay. chris and wesley are really friendly and responsive, and the place was fully packed with amenities and thoughtful little touches! we really enjoyed our stay at their place
this place is a little gem location is very good furniture a bit old. the host was excellent. i would recommend this place. we loved it
very nice place, convenient to get around, 24/7 supermarket around the corner, super responsive and helpful hosts. overall great place, would highly recommend!
wonderful place looking forward to use it again thank you
great location for a couple of days in nyc! we had a wonderful time :)
we had a very comfortable stay! the apartment offered everything we needed and it was close to several bus stops/subway, which made it convenient to get around ny.

our host was amazing, communicated so well, and we felt welcomed in the beautiful apartment. the city views and outdoor patio space are incredible, and the interior is elegantly furnished and quite comfortable. we were five family members arriving from three different states, and alexander's apartment is the perfect gathering place. the bedrooms and living areas are spacious, with a great kitchen to prep our meals. we are already planning our next visit to new york and look forward to staying at this exceptional apartment again!

this was a wonderful airbnb to stay in for our family. we were here for my daughter's wedding that had to be moved in dates and sami was very helpful, flexible and accommodating. it was a great location and a great price for nyc. thank you sami!

this place was amazing. the room we had was at the end of the hall and very quiet. we didn’t hear anyone. the bar was great-drinks and bartender were awesome. the outdoor rooftop overlooked times square and was never crowded. perfect location!!! this is a perfect nye view. a wonderful weekend.
the place is in a convenient, safe and central location. it had everything we needed for our stay and was a delight to come back to at the end of the day.

joseph was very attentive and addressed my requests promptly during my stay. he was very polite and didn’t disturb us while still meeting our needs! check in was straight forward and easy. there is one flight of stairs so please keep it in mind when thinking about any large luggage items. the apartment is a great value for 3 separate bedrooms, 2 full baths, full kitchen and living area! thank you joseph!

marie heléne was a great host! super friendly and flexible with check-in after i had travel issues. i truly felt like i had my own little space for my time in bushwick. neighborhood has tons to do from nightlife to hanging in the park. highly recommended!!
very small place. it was enough though to sleep and shower through our 3 day stay. it’s at a fantastic location.

great hosts, location, and unit. trecia was wonderful, checking in on us and responded quickly to any questions we had. the neighborhood was wonderful and beautiful. i never felt unsafe walking even after midnight. at night everything was so silent even with our windows open. cool bars and music venues are walking distance. the subway station is also about a five minute walk. the unit itself is new, modern, well lit, and super clean. fully equipped kitchen. our stay felt like a hotel stay because the towels and linens were impeccable and soft. trecia even provided basic toiletries. will definitely return.
great private place!

one of the best airbnb experiences ever. nelle is a great host - thoughtful, great communication. for example, i had some packages to ship to ny for my trip, and she kindly let us send to her apartment, and even brought them up to us. she showed us around the neighborhood, and made us feel right at home. my 6-year old wanted her to come back the next day to hang out with us. 5-stars all-around.

our family had a great time at rhondas place. we were so warmly welcomed and had all we needed. metro and manhattan are reachable in a very reasonable time. nice neighbourhood and good restaurants very closely. we were happy and certainly will go back to rhonda.

aldi’s place is spotlessly clean and meticulously organized. she provides her guests with wonderful storage, a super comfy bed, and a perfect lexington avenue experience. she is very respectful of her guest’s privacy. her 5th floor walk up keeps you in shape for sure...pack light and have fun!
the pictures and description matched exactly, which was a plus. comfortable space and clean too. host was very welcoming and considerate to our needs.
place was amazing and felt right at home. it was so spacious! kathryn was so responsive. would definitely come back to stay.

cute place right by the subway stop, wide variety of great restaurants, cafes and grocery stores. mirlet was so kind to meet us and drop our luggage off when we arrived too early for check in. he was also super responsive and knowledgeable with tourist questions. we loved the back patio, surprisingly peaceful at night.
the place was very clean and cozy! raiza very responsive and helpful. liked the area… lot to discover … out of the busy new york but pretty accessible. thanks raiza!
this was by far one of our favorites place we have stayed. the place was perfect a longer-term stay, classic ues spot. quiet, walkable, right by the park and we felt very much at home here.
the place is decent. easy to get in. but there is no central heater when it feels cold, and the blanket is a bit humid. nice host overall.

just book here you are so close to the j train one minute walk ins nice neighborhood and leesha and her family were so nice and welcoming making sure i had everything i needed and more. everything was clean and i felt right at home. it was my first solo trip and a young lady and it meant a lot to find a safe place.

i have no complaints about the staff. they were great people and treated us well, very pleasant to deal with. but, if the owners of the hotel are reading this, you must invest in infrastructure. you charge as a 4 star hotel but in reality you offer a 2 star hotel experience. the bathroom was dirty, the hair dryer was lousy at best, the bed was terrible, i have a back injury because of this, the windows were broken, the air conditioner didn’t work, the gym was in another hotel three blocks away, at night they block the revolver entrance with some cleaning equipment, the elevators took forever, there were construction going on inside the hotel. you can find much better hotels for the same or less money. the location is not worth it. plus, i wouldn’t recommend to stay that close of times square anyways.

the location in the les can’t be beat. the studio unit is really no frills and quite small, but the beds and bedding are more comfortable than most hotels. the free coffee and pastries and cafe for remote work is a nice cherry on top.

we had a lovely stay! the apartment is very comfortable, quiet, and spotless. it's convenient to the subway if you want to get out to see broader ny, but there are a lot of interesting sights in the neighborhood, as well - we had a great day just trolling around, shopping and snacking. :) the record player and jazz albums, along with the music-inspired pieces of artwork on the walls were also a fun touch!
great place. i have chosen to stay at this place frequently. i return to new york frequently for work, so this place will be my first choice. highly recommend.
such a lovely space! gorgeous exposed brick and felt so spacious. very much enjoyed our stay!

we had a fabulous time staying in polina's apartment. the apartment was immaculate, well appointed and very comfortable. it was just a few minutes walk to the subway and made a good base to explore manhatten and brooklyn. would happily recommend to anyone. polina also promptly responded to any queries we had. many thanks.
it was a great at place to stay! right in the heart of time square!

what a fantastic place to stay!!!! this family made me feel welcome ... even simba ( the cat) warmed to me at the end of my stay. :-). this beautiful spick and span home is perfectly placed from my work office. the bed was soooo comfortable i didn’t want to get up a couple mornings. don’t worry, if you forgot something, they have a gift basket of toiletries for your use in your room. great place to stay!!!

good stay for a good price, literally the bare minimum but it's more than enough for a trip to spend the daytime exploring nyc and have a place to crash and shower. as a few others mentioned, the hallways have a pungent smell but it stays outside, inside the room smells fine. very pleased, would stay again!
the apartment was just as imagined, and paradise was a fantastic host!
i enjoyed my stay very much. would definitely book again.

everyone was so friendly and helpful, always accommodating and i would definitely recommend it. times square is just a bit busy but you didn’t hear anything in the room, day light in the room could be better as surrounded by buildings, but overall highly recommend.

aicha was so pleasant, i just stayed for a night before my marathon. she did me a favor that could’ve spare my little time going outside but she helped with that little concern, and i really appreciate her for that big time! would definitely recommend, it’s a no brainer for me. ☺️
the location was very spacious and true to description. location wise it was great!
nice and comfortable apartment!

the room is exactly as described if not a little undersold. the space is big with very high ceilings and everything you need for a comfortable stay. the bed is super comfy and the room is nicely decorated and appointed with interesting art and furniture. the room was really clean and the host was always available, helpful, and responsive to any requests. the location is excellent. greenpoint is a nice neighborhood and there s a great market 1 block from the room. there are also several really good restaurants nearby and in walking distance. the walk to the 7 train headed to midtown is about 20 minutes and over the pulaski bridge. my wife and i traveled with two teenagers and walked all over greenpoint and to and from metro stations and never felt unsafe or uncomfortable. i would definitely stay again.
its a blast! very nice neighborhood and perfect beds!

sydney's house is perfect for visiting new york, we spent a week here and we loved it. he is an excellent host, very friendly, always has conversation. the house is very beautiful and well located, 3 minutes away is the subway to manhattan. and there is also a supermarket and laundry within 2 minutes. we'll return for sure.

teddy and blanca were the perfect hosts, welcoming, caring and really helpful. the apartment was spotless and felt homely. a safe area only 2 blocks from central park and 3 from the subway. just so easy to get around on foot or on the subway. we will definitely be back. we had the best of times . thanks blanca and teddy .x
martha and her family are great hosts . definatly recommend

we had a great time staying here to attend the us open tennis tournament. clarabel and don were so good to show us how to travel there. the home was very clean and we had everything we needed and more. they were very friendly and kind and available for help if you needed it. we really felt welcome! thank you for everything!
nice location, easy to get around the neighborhood. apartment is cozy and quiet with a/c in the bedroom. kitchen is modern and nice. house was clean when we arrived.
great location and easy to find. the beds were comfortable, although i think they need new pillows because ours were flat. other than that, great shower pressure and amenities.
chef is an excellent host! he cooked up some fantastic breakfasts with great suggestions for local restaurants. would definitely return!

place was perfect for a short stay for 1 or 2 people. i needed a place to stay before closing on a new house and this place was just right and a great value. i would stay again if i need a place in the area.

this is a lovely apartment which was clean, contempoary and spacious. high spec amenities. the apartment had a homely feel and we enjoyed the stay. local subway very convenient for accesdible travelling to tourist sites. large number of great restaurants and delis located within walking distance. we were experienced sunny days in a great city and great apartment. ravits friend met us with the house keys, gave great food and tour advise.

great communication to ensure our needs were met (we needed 6 separate beds made up) and they stayed on the phone with me the whole way until i was in the place with both sets of keys. good place, all was as described and it allowed us to have a very easy and great time.
really clean apartment great location easy check in really nice roof top a bit small for 6 people but we didn’t spent much time in the room would recommend 100% thanks for having us

staying here was great, the room and the shared bathroom are clean and i enjoyed the privacy. the neighbourhood is quiet enough, but i had some moments where i felt on edge walking home alone at night from the subway. consider taking buses or taxis if it's late.
they are phenomenal and so is the space

we stayed in park slope to be close to a friend, and william's space was cozy, clean, and had everything we needed! it comfortably fits 3-4 people, is super close to a subway, great coffee shops, and restaurants. go to runner up and winner bakery a 10 minute walk away--so good. we loved the experience. thanks william!
very helpful and thoughtful

this airbnb was exactly as pictured and in a great location. it was easy to find as nicoletta sent clear instructions before we arrived. nicoletta was quick to respond to our messages and even sent a message part way through our stay to check that we had everything we needed. we would definitely stay here again.
great little spot. around a lot. hosts were very responsive and friendly
everything was great! but beware of the hungry (but adorable) cats!

a great place to stay in new york city. very responsive hosts, a worthy five-star review

tl;dr: petra is just awesome! she’s what made airbnb great: a friendly local host who shares an extra (private) space in her house! go ahead and book this if you’re lucky enough that it’s available. we had a great time at petra’s! she’s super responsive, and extremely friendly. we only spend one night, and arrived near midnight, and still petra was there to welcome us, and help us get settled in the room. we were 4 of us, and the main bed is great, the sofa bed is very good, especially with the extra mattress cover that petra brought. she has this beautiful manicured garden, with magnificent roses. the most important plus is petra. she made sure we stayed in contact, she shared information on the easiest way to get to downtown manhattan, and she allowed us to keep our luggage in the room for a ‘late check out’ so we didn’t have to haul that around as we explored the city. thank you petra, i hope we get to stay with you again in the future!
awesome in every way! dont pass this up!
ideal place for a short-term stay. so cozy and clean, perfect location, kandi was welcoming and always available. would return in a heartbeat.

we loved our stay at jeff’s place. first time for us and the family in brooklyn which was great if you want to spend a longer time exploring manhattan. the area is really cool and shows a more real side of life in the big apple. the two rooms are really comfy with great beds and a beautiful bathroom. tips might be darker curtains for people who like to sleep in but we were up early to get going and explore. manhattan about 45 mins to mid town. the neighbourhood feels safe and like your part of the real new york, less polished and touristy and with those beautiful houses everywhere. jeff was always quick with his tips and responses and as you share the entrance you’ll run in to him or the family one day with more tips as they have lived in brooklyn all their lives. a great place and perfect base.
amazing host. amazing place. definitely recommend!!!

this is a really beautiful apartment. the decor is lovely and my husband agreed. it is also very clean. jane was quick to respond and even allowed us to check in an hour early. the apartment is walking distance from many bars and restaurant. i would definitely recommend staying here.
nice room and great location. koichi was super nice and easy to communicate with!
we enjoyed our staying in this apartment. so cozy!

room it is very good and diedi he is very nice person and hope next time i recommended her home and every thing it is good clean and comfortable and quit home and area it is safe more thanks diego and check in and check out it is very easy and he help me for more things thanks diego
much larger apartment than we expected. very spacious. nice & clean. great location - just a few blocks from subway stops. jaclyn is quick to respond back to communication.
danielle was quick to work with our immediate needs and took care of us!

fred's home is tastefully furnished! and his guest bathroom is clean and welcoming! it felt like i was in a hotel with all warmth of a "home"! and did i mention the clean and quiet serene? fred had a great smile and brilliant customer service personality all through my stay. fred is a star!!

i had a wonderful five-week stay here. it's a perfect base for one person or a couple. very quiet and cosy, with everything you need in walking distance. fort greene park is less than 10 mins away, and there are multiple subways stations 10-15 mins walk. i always felt safe walking around, even coming home late. truly felt like my home away from home. i want to stay here again!

we (my to brothers and me) had a great time at house on henry! the apartment is cosy and tastefully and personally furnished. you immediately feel home although it was a bit dusty due to the many decoration items standing around. the floor plan is perfect for 3 people. everyone can have their space without bothering or bumping into eachother too many times. the bathroom and the kitchen are clean and spacious. the neighbourhood is really very nice. we enjoyed the silence of brooklyn. there is little traffic, many families, front gardens and people having a drink in front of their houses - we really felt comfortable there and we badly needed a daily break from crowded, stressed and loud manhattan where we did sightseeing everyday. one may not like the distance to manhattan. it took us about 40 minutes to get to manhattan midtown, sometimes even more because the subway was very crowded in the morning times. annette was very nice and helpful. she lives in the house so if there where any questions we just had to walk to floors down and ask her ourselves, that's really practical. all in all we can totally recommend a stay in house on henry!

kevin is an amazing host. he checked in with us periodically to see if we were comfortable and always responded to my texts within minutes. the apartment is fully stocked with paper products, towels and soap and all the cooking basics. kevin even left me a selection of fresh starbucks coffee. when i asked about reading lights for the bedroom, he actually went out and bought a pair! the apartment is in a great neighborhood and it's quiet.
i recommend the attention was perfect the place is amazing clean feel is all you expect i feel at home
thanks freddy for everything!! nice and comfortable place. without a doubt my next trips to ny will be in freddy’s home.
place is very nice and beautiful very clean too my stay was 10/10
enjoyed the stay

daniela's place is located in the heart of washington heights, half a block from broadway and 5 blocks from the 1 train. location was very convenient for people attending courses at columbia (us), especially the upper pole on 168th - walking distance. we did not feel insecure walking in this latino-african american neighborhood at night. daniela is an excellent host that keeps the place really clean and is always happy to answer questions and give us a much appreciated late check out. at this time we had the whole place for 2 people (it was listed as a whole apartment), so we thought it was a good price/quality ratio; which could be improved a lot if there weren't some small details: the ac unit from the room has been relocated to the right window that is pictured in the living room, which means that as of our stay (july 9-16th) there is no ac in the room and the living room has 2 units of ac. the living room unit (the right one, not pictured, placed beside the bedside) is mounted is a weird fashion, leaving 2 gaps of aprox 2-3cm each side that let the air in directly from the outside (this window faces the back so noise isn't an issue, but during heavy storms it might be) the last morning we were awoken by a very rude neighbor fight starting at 6am in a sunday morning. a woman was banging on one of the neighbor doors and shouting very aggressively (i won't describe the contents since it's irrelevant for this matter) towards a man who lived in, and then another woman joined the discussion in the corridor hall, which lasted for an hour or so. we understand that this is unpredictable and you cannot control your neighbors, but might give you a hint on the precincts around you. finally, although cooking facilities are provided, there was so sponge or detergent to wash the dishes (we noticed the host about this but ended up getting some in the nearby supermarket, not a big issue). therefore, for the prices in ny, and having been twice in the city, would consider staying again mainly due to budgetary reasons.
this was a great experience for me to relax
great spot! walking distance to great bars and restaurants in red hook. the apartment is comfortable and clean with lots of natural light. exactly what i needed for a quick work trip to city.
the space between the bed and wall was neglected of cleanliness, but other than that the place felt clean. a bit unusual check in process but it felt very safe especially because of covid.
bruce is a good person, responsive with email, and his suite is really nice. when you're renting a place in a different city, trust matters, and you can trust bruce. thanks

cleaned spotless when we showed up, and check in was a breeze. it's one room with full bath and kitchenette; including a very small table with two chairs. mini-fridge and two burner hotplate. beautiful view of the historic church across the street. great neighborhood. typical nyc parking situation but a little worse that other neighborhoods, you have to move your car every day but wednesday (if you're on the wrong side of the street), and the locals end up just double-parking on many of the streets nearby; might take a while to find a decent spot if you're moving as the restrictions appear. host was very very responsive; this team is on top of it! much appreciated!!

i can’t state enough how great this place is! pictures and description accurately represent the space and the neighborhood is great! the best part though is the host, mariana. she is so kind and was very quick to respond to any questions i had. i will definitely stay here anytime i need a place in ny!!
the place is fine and very close to jfk

yes it’s a loud street and it’s a basic hotel but it was clean and safe feeling and an amazing location for everything you want to get to easily. you get used to the street noise pretty quickly and the staff are polite and the whole thing is fine. it’s just such a great location so i’d highly reccomend. thanks

my husband and i loved our 3 month stay at kady’s. the apartment is well appointed, spotlessly clean and plenty of light. kady and her team are very responsive, with maintenance around the clock. it’s an easy walk to several subway lines. the neighbourhood has charming cafés , restaurants and ofcourse whole foods. we would highly recommend a stay at kady’s.
great place to stay near soho and various subway stations.
most gracious host. we were made to feel very comfortable
great staying with pat at her place - she was very welcoming and made it feel like home. i slept real well on the soft bed

susan was very sweet. even thoe i only saw her at my checkout day. my stay there was very chill. the area there is quiet and friendly. i felt safe staying there. room i stayed in was very spacious and cozy.
very well thought out space.

nancy was there to welcome me outside the apartment on arrival with a friendly smile and a cup of tea. the room was cosy and the apartment gorgeous and unique with character attention to detail and s real flavour of new york and the sofa bed all made up and v comfy. a nice healthy breakfast and chat the following morning helped me feel safe and at home in new york and the neighbourhood was perfect. thank you to nancy and rocky the cat. oh and a great shower also! i would definitely stay here again
we had a great time at nili’s airbnb!! super friendly spot with plants and beautiful lighting.
clean, cozy and centrally located in the bronx. host was very accessible and friendly.
jaye and spike were a breeze to communicate with, and the room was clean and comfortable. also, terrific water pressure in the shower
thanks for the accommodations.

rudy is great!! & the apartment is even better! it is exactly as described and is by far the cleanest property i have stayed in. rudy even left a few welcome snacks, drinks & a note. after arrival rudy even checked in to see if i needed anything and to see if everything was okay. exceptional!! i wish i could leave more stars. best airbnb experience i’ve had. definitely worth the price & the location is great. especially parking !!! there is no alternate side parking on this block and finding parking is super easy. if this review doesn’t convince you to book here while you’re in town idk what else will. thanks again rudy!!

caroline has a lovely place. the apartment is spacious and clean, with all the amenities your may require. there is a massive tv with netflix in the main bedroom and a second one in the living room. it is only a couple of blocks from the subway and has great access to manhattan and the rest of brooklyn. check in was easy as there is a house keeper who lives in the basement. caroline answers all messages promptly and was very pleasant to deal with. i can highly recommend her apartment if you want to stay in brooklyn.

natalie’s place was an ok stay but it was way over priced. i paid $453 for 3 nights but had to deal with a broken front door knob and my bedroom door lock wasn’t working, when i reached out to the host i got advised to ‘find something flat and use to open the door’. i’ve stayed in a lot of air bnbs and always find something positive to highlight about my stay since i know people put in a lot of effort to sustain their businesses. but natalie’s place was disappointing at the price i paid and think with a little effort/improvement natalie will hit a higher mark. there was no toilet paper in the bathroom and no trash cans in the kitchen. no cutlery for guests to use and excessive rules for everything. when i had issues with something, the host responded ‘other people didn’t have this problem’ or ‘other people didn’t mind this’ and that was just so strange to me. i am obviously not other people. in my experience when air bnbs are pricey it guarantees a smooth experience but this wasn’t
great location and host! if you have an early flight from jfk, this is the location.

if you want to experience times square, m social is quite remarkable. staff is excellent, very helpful. we arrived tired from a west coast red eye flight and the agent at the desk showed us how to be comfortable until our room was ready. our stay was for 5 nights. our house keeping staff made our room tidy and clean and always was asking what could they do to make our stay better. we inquired about a tea kettle before we booked and were provided with a kettle in just a few minutes of going to our room to unpack.
beatrice is a wonderful host, warm, friendly and helpful. her apartment is super cute, clean and comfortable. the location was great too. i'd stay again in a heartbeat!
great location and host!
even though the place was small it was extremely clean! friendly staff and great location!

peter was a great host and the apartment is even better than pictured. super spacious, clean and beautifully decorated. located in the heart of williamsburg, walking distance to a ton of great restaurants, bars, clubs and the subway. i loved it so much that i am renting again in a few weeks. highly recommended.

the apartment is very clean and it looks just like the photos, it´s near to the queen´s center mall and to the subway, sussie is very kind and polite and it´s always available¡¡ i truly recomend this place¡¡

the place is stylish, cozy and most importantly very clean. the neighborhood is quiet at night and their bed is super comfortable that we had very good rest during our trip! will definitely choose to stay here next time :)

vadim is a terrific host and his place was perfect for our trip to nyc. the apartment was clean, well stocked, and food in the refrigerator when we got there was a nice touch. the location is great with spectacular views of the manhattan skyline from the apartment and even better from the rooftop. it was a quick walk to the subway and to a bunch of great restaurants. vadim gave us great advice as to places to eat as well as letting us know about the new manhattan ferry that was just a couple of blocks walk away. a great alternative to taking the subway into the city. thanks vadim for letting us stay. we will definitely be seeing you again.

it was a delight staying with reka. as a solo brit spending a few days in new york, i used the room as a base to go explore. a bus not too far away takes you to the heart of manhattan and you have everything at your fingertips. the room was so clean and comfortable, and - the view from the terrace on a clear night was something else!!!
clean apartment, quiet neighborhood.

my accommodations matched the picture exactly. i wanted to go back out to explore to the neighborhood, however the room was so inviting and comfy that i just stayed and relaxed. the neighborhood was also a pleasant surprise. i stopped by a great diner and cupcake shop.

lovely apartment close to the subway and all is good
staying at tommi’s place is great. it’s a good spot for tourists that are looking to go out during the morning and day and come back at night for a place to sleep.

staying at sam’s place was an absolute joy. the location is incredibly convenient, and the house itself is beautiful, spotless, and fully equipped (special shout-out to the amazing washing machine!). it’s the perfect spot for a long-term stay, it truly felt like a home. what truly sets this place apart is the incredible hospitality from sam and misook!🫶🏻 their warmth and genuine care for their guests’ comfort are beyond words. they go above and beyond in every way. highly recommended!
located in a nice neighborhood. host was very friendly and accommodating for a last minute booking and appreciate her flexibility!

gary’s place was a fantastic location and super easy to get around! i would highly recommend to anyone looking to explore nyc from the heart of the best neighborhood in nyc! tons of space and lighting but the windows are very thin so be sure to use the earplugs in the bathroom when sleeping and the baseboards to keep it warm!

what a fantastic apartment. beautifully decorated and super clean .jude was a fantastic host. easy access to subways so perfect location. really enjoyed our stay. would absolutely recommend jude's apartment.
excelent place in brooklyn!!

we loved staying in this home. after a few weeks it started to feel like home. the community and waterfront a block away were amazing and the convenience of one stop to manhattan made it the perfect sanctuary to stay. dom your home was so comfortable, clean and classy! and you were so helpful :) we didn't want to leave. we hope to come back another time to lic :) thank you :) this place exceeded our expectations.
-friendly host -a block away from a subway station -comfortable bedroom and bathroom -near from cheap minimarket and cheap eats -there's laundry on the building -reasonable price what's not to like?
great place, very cozy. really clean too. host is very responsive. it’s also really close to the subway. the price is really great. definitely worth every penny

appreciated how the place was a short walk to the subways. the place was a little farther from manhattan than i initially expected but with proper planning, was able to get to all our destinations without issue and in good time. scott is super quick with communication and addressed a few things i brought up immediately including temperature change. also checked in multiple times via messages to make sure everything was going well for us and if we had any concerns which i really appreciated. place is very spacious for our group of 4 and had everything we needed (brita filter in fridge for water, mini kitchen, stocked bathroom). overall a great stay and would recommend to anyone with a group of friends traveling and visiting ny/brooklyn!

great place! just as seen in photos and as described! bonus was an excellent coffee maker and bean grinder. fabulous communication with hosts and excellent recommendations! would stay here again in a heartbeat!

tom is the greatest host i can imagine. he really took good care of us and was very friendly under our stay in his big and nice townhouse. he wanted our stay to be the best, and it really was. the townhouse was clean and nothing was missing. the wifi is real good, tv with many channels, 2 baths, big kitchen, nice living rooms and great bedrooms. the public communications are very good. we could choose among 3 subways close to the apartment. there were a lot of groceries within 5 minutes walk. i can definetly recommend tom and his apartment and i will stay in his place next time i am in ny. thank you so much tom for your friendly and careful behavior! best regards rich
great for solo travelers! the location is only a 9 min walk to the subway station. the area is fairly quiet so no issues sleeping at night and there’s also a laundromat nearby.
jan was a great host. the space was perfect and charming. the location couldn’t have been better. easy to get around the city and fun local places to eat and hang!
safe, secure and clean home and good price rare find for nyc
