i arrived late in the evening after a long trip and immediately realized the place wasn’t what i expected so i contacted the host who came around 11pm when i would have liked to be asleep and began the massive job of cleaning. this is the only time i have ever left a bad review on airbnb. the pictures posted give this apartment a sort of charming, quirky look which is usually very appealing to me as i like to stay in interesting places. however there is a fine line between an interesting quirky property and a dirty one. there were old open food packages and beverages in the fridge, expired cheese and many out of date cans in the cabinets, as well as used toothbrushes, shaving blades with hair and rust and many more filthy old objects that had accumulated over time. super dirty microwave. they didn’t even have the decency to replace the old bleached bed sheets. the place is posted as 1 bathroom apartment but in reality has one toilet where if you are tall your knees will touch the wall when sitting down, a kitchen/bathroom on the other side of the apartment next to a bath tub that would fit well into a horror movie.
lou is a great host and the place is amazing....i urge anyone looking to stay here as long as i'm not staying.. lol
mary was sweet and hospitable. accommodations were exactly what i was looking for.
had a very nice time, perfect for our ny stay.

good location two blocks away from two subway stops the apartment is vary tidy and clean the apartment is on the 5th floor and without a elevator that is the main problem i would recommend this cozy apartment
overcharged for the level of comfort

seth and his friend were so kind that they were willing to answer all questions of us. the room is big and clean and there are many markets and stores near the house. if we returned to nyc, we would still stay here!

i stayed here for a month to check out astoria as a place i might want to move to. on the plus side this apartment is quiet, has decent wifi and in a great neighbourhood plus just 5 minutes from the subway. clara was also pleasant to deal with and was helpful. but the apartment is small - more of a studio size - with the bare minimum of equipment. for example there was no trash can for the kitchen, no corkscrew, no working plug for the kitchen sink, nowhere to t dry dishes, just 4 plastic "glasses" etc ... plus the building itself is pretty run down. clara provided a few extra things i asked for but spending a few hundred dollars on more things for the kitchen, glassware etc would add a lot to the comfort of the apartment.
great host, loved the buddha spirit in the air and cleaniness

the place have everything what we need to spend a good time in nyc. the room was super clean, is cozy and the bed is so confortable. the house is simple, but cute .. organized.. clean and the shower is so good! josefina is a super nice host, good chat and company ..and she has a lot of tip to turn better our time in nyc. i loved stay with her.

i definitely recommend staying with jennifer. i was able to check in early after taking a red eye flight and the location was amazing and quiet (very quick walk to the nearest subway station). overall, my stay was perfect (made friends with one of her rescue cats too). also thank you jennifer for making delicious chocolate chip cookies!

terrific! thanks kishorie for having me in your lovely space! it was very relaxing and accommodating after long flights. your kindness upon my late arrival was appreciated as well. wish i could have stayed longer and explored the 'big apple'. again, much gratitude! bart
nice place, very clean and close to the subway. you can park your car in the street right before your window for free.
great place to stay

overall, we had a wonderful experience staying in leecia’s place! so many well thought out details that help insure that guests will feel comfortable and at home. the location is great. super-close walking distance to two subway stations makes getting into manhattan quick. the neighborhood restaurant recommendations are really good choices. the bathroom is small, but it is nice and does have a tall ceiling with a sky light which makes it feel roomier. this is not a large apartment, but seriously, the amount of space, for the money – in new york city – it seems like a great deal to us. leecia was easy to contact with any questions and she was very helpful. the weather was unexpectedly warm and humid during our early october visit and we are big fans of air conditioning, so the ac unit did not quite keep us as comfortable as we like, but that may not be an issue under other circumstances or if you are not bothered by that! this may not have been a neighborhood that you would have considered a few years ago, but it seems perfectly safe to us now. we walked around during the day and night and never thought anything about it. we would definitely stay here again!
clean convenient place to stay, and close to the airport!

the place is exactly as advertised and beautiful. it is huge, very cool and v. well maintained. the bathroom and kitchen are spectacular and it is very quiet especially at the back where the main bedroom is located. it has a washer & dryer which is great. cozy second bedroom which i slept in one night and enjoyed. the location is perfect right between soho and tribecca and walking to all subways, great restaurants and shops. it is a walk up - no elevator.
great place to stay in harlem. minutes away from historic landmarks and famous restaurants. the host is very welcoming and his hospitality is unmatched!

what a great experience to stay at the box house hotel. it is really close to manhattan - 10min walk to subway. the bedrooms have a unique indistrial and comfy style. the staff is really professional and friendly. among all the hotel i stayed in europe and usa, the box house hotel is in my top 3.

i had a wonderful stay at this hotel! the staff was incredibly friendly and always ready to help, which made me feel very welcome from the moment i arrived. the room was clean, spacious, and comfortable, with everything i needed for a relaxing stay. i especially appreciated the attention to detail and the quiet atmosphere, perfect for getting a good night’s sleep. the location is also excellent – close to great restaurants, shops, and attractions (times square/broadway). my room was peaceful and safe ( not facing the road). unfortunately they don’t have breakfast. i highly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting the area. whether you’re traveling for business or leisure, it’s a great place to stay. i would definitely come back!

it was a pleasure staying at michael's apartment. the apartment was clean, neat and comfortable. it was a 15 min walk to the c train and a 20 minute walk to the 3 train. plenty of places to eat nearby (try x-cellent soulfood as it is 10 minutes away). michael was responsive and helpful. all in all 10/10 experience.
the place was perfect for 6 of us. the subway is nearby with plenty of walkable shopping and restaurants. we would stay here again
exceptional place, bus stops and subway are nearby, easy communication,wi-fi,beautiful and safe neighborhood, 3 minutes to la guardia airport, would like to recommend to friends and relatives !!!

leecia and mike are really nice hosts, let us in at night after late flight, always responded to any questions and we could even leave our luggage after check-out. apartment is well-located, close to subway station (5 min walking) and then it's 30 minutes to manhattan. there is nice bakery nearby and laundromat are just steps from their house. however, there were some issues during our stay. internet signal was very unstable and slow, i had to ask leecia to reset router many times, but it didn't helped a lot. then we saw cockroach in the sink - giant black monster, it was so disgusting! overall it is good place for budget travelers who don't intend to spend whole days at home and plan to explore nyc instead. but again, leecia is brilliant!

we had a great stay here and look forward to coming back! eleanna was very friendly & responsive and the apartment looked just as it did in the photos. it really does get great sun/natural light for a basement apartment! we were easily able to find parking on the street, which was a pleasant surprise. check-in was seamless & eleanna’s instructions were very clear & concise. the private outdoor area/patio was a really nice perk & the apartment is very sheltered from noise & quite peaceful. so much good food nearby too! all in all, we had an amazing time & would definitely recommend the place & will come back again!

the apartment was in greenpoint and the views were amazing although not exactly the appartement in the pictures. it was as food as the ohne shown. it is a bit rare that you only get to know the adress in the last minute but it worked well. maybe that is due to nyc airbnb politics

my partner and i stayed here for several weeks as we relocated to the east coast. we found the apartment to have everything we needed from laundry, heating, kitchen appliances, and outdoor space. we work remotely and the wifi was great and reliable. anna is a great and friendly host, she provided an office chair for us to use while here which was thoughtful. the positive reviews encouraged us to book this apartment and now can say they are honest and can highly recommend anna and this apartment.
everything’s excellent~~

i love sharon's place, everything is spotless, clean, exactly as described. check in was so smooth. four of us very comfortable. everything works perfectly. very comfortable bedding. thank you for the helpful coffee for our morning! we bought bagels every morning and toast them in the toaster provided. everything is so well-thought. easy walk to subway. we love staying there, and will stay again in a heartbeat whenever visiting nyc. thank you sharon for your hospitality!
really great place ,everthing is as described . clean with good amount of privacy . nicole and tommie is chill and can communicate really easily .
great place to stay right in the heart of it all!
beautifully appointed apartment. very close to bus and subway connections for trips downtown. enjoyed my two day stay.

excellent location! you couldn’t ask for a better location along the upper west side. easy connection to numerous subway routes. proximity to central park and the american museum of natural history was unbeatable! it was the perfect place for my family.

location is pretty good and price is decent. the unit is rather spacious for one person and dina generally was good with communicating. the bed and particularly the pillows are quite uncomfortable. one thing that stood out though was that upon arrival the unit smelled strongly of smoke. dina did pay for some items to help with the smell when i mentioned it, but the smell never fully went away (and i was there for about a month). once it was nice out i could leave the windows open which helped a bit i understand this smell may be from a past tenant rather than the host, but it makes me question the cleaning service/accountability that should have happened between stays as the odor was very strong and noticeable immediately upon arrival. i feel like this should have been noticed and addressed before i checked in (or at least brought to my attention).
i'd defntly stay here again!

i loved my two night stay in the jasmine suite. the apartment is just as beautifully decorated as it was in the photos and feels really peaceful. dawn, the host, was extremely communicative and provided everything i needed before i ever needed to ask. her instructions on the slightly complicated entrance were very clear (with pictures!) and even the key to open the suite was gorgeous. there was so much light coming in from the windows, which i loved, but i was grateful she gave me a heads up about the blackout curtains for when i wanted to sleep in. i'll definitely be back!
great place and great host.
it was everything we needed

great airbnb! we were traveling with two of adult kids to visit our son at pratt. this airbnb was perfect,with room for all of us. great touch of a bottle of wine and eggs, bread,butter and milk in the fridge! so nice to have breakfast there the following morning. tony is super easy to communicate with and clementine is a sweetie! great location with lots of restaurants around. highly recommended this airbnb for folks visiting brooklyn. a big thanks as well for letting us stay later than check out time. we really appreciated a warm spot to stay until our flight!

tiffany’s apartment is an absolute dream to stay in! her location is perfect for taking the train, and had plenty of parking up and down the street if you do drive in. it was in quick distance to the liquor store and deli, and is right by a grocery store. the apartment is spacious and decorated very nicely. getting in and out of the apartment was super easy, and overall it felt very warm and welcoming. i would absolutely stay here again. thanks tiffany!

henri was such a great super host! he was very accommodating and answered all of our questions efficiently. i'd stay here again and it's a good size for two people (more than that would be tight.) the location is perfect and easy to get around anywhere. we had some issues with the wifi not working but it wasn't a big deal since we didn't spend a lot of time in the room anyways. this was a great stay and i'd recommend it to others!
great stay and location
great place to stay, will recommend to others
a great home to stay close to the subway. it takes 18 minutes to get to time square and is perfect for commuters. gladys and bob are fantastic hosts and we just felt we are at home.
spot was good for few nights . definitely will return !

deacon's house is great! it's very close to the subway and there are several coffee shops nearby that are great to work at (i recommend cup of brooklyn and flowers for all occasions) and there's a grocery store just around the corner! deacon and his roommate were very kind, quiet and not intrusive at all. ladies, you will feel very safe and comfortable staying here and i would stay here again!

my stay with brooklyn was great! her communication was perfect. easy to find, easy to check in. my room was clean & comfortable. the bathroom was spotless. i hope to stay here again in the future. thanks for the hospitality! cheers
it was a wonderful experience for a quick trip to nyc. my host is great and very helpful. i would stay at her place again if i go back to visit nyc. thank you, mary.
spacious, neatly decorated and in a good location. a very positive experience.

this place was great. philip is a wonderful host and the bnb was at a perfect location. the place is very spacious which was great for my 9 guests. the unit really does make you want to buy it yourself. great experience ! would definitely stay there again.

i had a great stay at this place. the hosts were friendly, thoughtful, and wonderful. i had a living room space on the 2nd floor in addition to the bedroom. they had kindly turned on the window ac 30mins before i arrived to keep the room cool. the bedroom is not facing the main street so i had restful sleep for the duration of the stay.

the hosts are friendly and provided useful information, including metro cards. the neighborhood is very noisy, so bring earplugs for sleeping. the apartment was very neat and clean, and the bed is quite comfortable.
the place is very spacious and very beautiful! it really felt like a home away from home. it was cozy, clean, and comfy!
great location, beautiful home!
scott is a great host. he allowed us to leave our bags early prior to our check in time. plenty of space. close to two subways.
great part of the city. airport was a short bicycle ride away. lots of caribbean restaurants. pleasant host

i have been to nearly 30 countries around the world, and primarily like to use airbnb. staying at ming’s apartment in park slope was by far a top airbnb experience for me. ming is a very kind and considerate host. from the very beginning she treated my sister and me like family and went out of her way to make our time in new york special. we always felt safe knowing she was just a text message away. her birds george and micheal were also great company…..so cute. if you travel with the intention of meeting good local people then this is the airbnb you are looking for. the room: a comfy bed and ac in the private bedroom made for nice mornings sleeping in. about the neighbourhood: ming’s apartment is in one of the nicest areas of brooklyn and staying here made us feel like we were living a life out of a movie. beautiful tree lined streets and cute artisanal stores nearby. every day we would go to a nearby coffee shop kos café and just relax. easy access to manhattan.

carol ann and george are the most wonderful hosts! we enjoyed a wonderful thanksgiving gathering with family and friends. the weather cooperated and we were even able to enjoy the delightful backyard garden.

julia and john are wonderful host, they are very friendly and welcoming. we had great time chatting and would definitely recommend for those who are solo traveling. the apartment is at great location and very safe area

the apartment is as described, nice and bright and clean with good lighting for reading. david responded quickly when we needed anything. the neighborhood felt safe enough in the daytime but we would not walk around at night except to get the amazing fried chicken from peaches right on the corner. the only thing i missed was an electric coffee pot; otherwise the kitchen was well stocked with basics and nice new appliances. crocus coffee shop a few blocks away was also amazing. had a good lunch at another restaurant one block away on thompkins. the subway is less than ten minutes away. beds were comfortable. would stay here again!
walkable to many ny attractions, very clean and cozy
excellent place to rest

great apartment on upper west side. spacious, well equipped and just a great place to come home to after a day exploring nyc. half a block from central park on one side half a block from traders joe on the other side, close to subway too.
comfy, quiet, safe, and a great location. we loved our stay and would stay again!

peter’s place was exactly as pictured....clean and modern. within a 10-15 min walk to the nearest subway station which takes about 20 min or so to get to manhattan. peter met us for check-in and showed us around the place. he gave us information on local places to eat and nearest grocery store...not that i would remember it all! would’ve been better to have a little info book in the apartment with this info as a reference. this place is a great value and i would definitely stay here again! it was perfect place for my bf and me to stay.

i had the most wonderful stay at the morency group’s place. prior to my arrival, the host communicated with clearly check-in instructions. the host also checked in on me throughout my stay to ensure that i was comfortable with the temperature of the apartment, and to inquire if i needed assistance with anything or recommendations for my itinerary. the space was exactly as described and looked just like the pictures. it was cozy, clean and spacious. i felt right at home! i loved it so much i booked my next stay prior to checking out. from now on this will be my home away when traveling back to my home town.
location, location, location, and it is good.

we had a beautiful stay at angel‘s whose appartment is located in a peaceful area of brooklyn, near the prospect park. from there it was easy to reach manhattan. the room was confortable and spacious. angel and alesh were helpful and responsive to our questions. we had everything we needed. we would love to come back!
great location. clean, quiet and very comfortable
check in and check out was a breeze. the room was bigger than expected and very clean. the shower head was pretty nice too. will stay again when flying out of jfk.

amazing host! , super clean and very convenient location. super comfortable stay, truly a home away from home, definitely recommend staying here. thanks maribel, i look forward to future stays! 6 star stay for sure!
a quiet place with a warm welcome, timely communication, and considerate and kind hosts. ideal stay for avoiding the hassle of manhattan yet still within reasonable distance by subway.
an excellent stay, what you see in the pictures is exactly what you get plus more. a very spacious apartment with a great amount of amenities.

d.'s apartment was cozy and comfortable. extremely close to whole foods and the 7 train, it was perfect for my long term stay. plus d. was extremely responsive and accommodating when i had to adjust my stay length. highly recommend this place if you're looking for a place to stay in nyc!

laura’s place was great, right in the middle of astoria about four blocks to the r train. my daughter and i had a great time, the apartment was perfect for the two of us to spend some time in the city without breaking the bank of staying in manhattan.

you can't ask for a better location than this. this is my second stay here and i just simple love the place and the overall general relaxed and bohemian atmosphere. tony's description is accurate. read the description and the reviews, the place is special and unique but not everybody. just for those who "get it". i got it. thanks tony !!!

lovely clean and cosy space, in a safe and well connected area of brooklyn. check in and check out were smooth, and we generally felt really comfortable during our stay. jamal gave us clear instructions and also local food recommendations. we would definitely recommend jamal's place to others and stay here again.

my parents have stayed in this amazing apartment for 28 days. they had a wonderful moments there. samara is the fabulous host. charming apartment, comfortable sofa and bed, gorgeous deck and backyard, two nice separate bathrooms, handpicked decoration, double glass windows (so quiet) with full of light. highly recommend it.
super amazing host team. best of over 30 stays on the platform thus far. narrow but long apartment. typical old new york style. slightly gritty neighborhood but safe. highly recommend.
clean simple and plenty of room even in the small rooms! perfect placement in the mega of nyc neighborhoods!
great stay at issac’s place. beautiful home, in central brooklyn. easy to get around by walking or subway. had an amazing time in brooklyn.
the location was perfect for us to explore the city. we arrived from jfk and came from jfk with airtrain and subway. was pretty easy.
brooklyn was a very sweet person to speak with. me and my partner needed somewhere to stay for the night and her place was so cozy and cute.
the room itself is super cute, the staff was extremely accommodating and friendly.
definitely recommend, i would stay at this place again

i rent ola's apartment for 1 month and i have been really sad to leave it when i had to. the apartment is perfect: very well located, spacious, well furnished... the rooftop is great, and the wonderful view on the empire state building is clearly the cherry on the cake. ola and bami are really available and helped me during my stay anytime i needed. i will rent this condo again when i'll be in ny. if there is one apartment to choose it is this one!

we had a wonderful time in ny. the apartment was really nice and beautiful, a lot of space and well equiped. after a long flight there were some bagels and other nice things in the fridge. we were allowed to have a late check out because of our night flight so we could enjoy ny without worrying about our luggage. acces to manhattan was very easy. hope to come back again! thanks for your hospitality dawn!

the room we were given was very spacious for an nyc hotel with the most incredible view! the staff was very friendly, also very accommodating to all of our requests. there is so much to do in the area and super walkable, but also like a 15 minute subway or uber ride to some other major areas. i felt like the price was very comparable to other hotels in the area but the room/view made this incredibly worth it!
great check in and very cozy. you’ll definitely feel like you’re at home!

i booked this last minute for my dad who needed an inexpensive place close to our apartment. jeffrey was very communicative and made it easy for my dad. for one person who's low maintenance and on a budget, it's a good situation.

nicole and nathan’s place is great. very clean and comfortable with everything you need. the area has a local vibe, the real brooklyn. close to the j/z and a/c trains, a really easy trip into manhattan. i would recommend exploring the area by walking the 20 minutes into bushwick and beyond. there are some interesting neighbourhoods to discover all around the area. the l train is not too far if you’re happy to do some walking. there’s a supermarket a flew blocks from the apartment for essentials, not many places to eat out but i can recommend le fatima for some good dominican food. all in all a great place to stay, very comfortable and good value for money.
he is so caring and flexible too
clean, spacious, great location for catching the subway. very good communication on hosts behalf. would recommend to friends.

i loved staying with beth in brooklyn. she’s a warm and welcoming host. the location is waking distance to subway and there are many restaurants to explore on the way. the breakfast and coffee provided were excellent.
came here for halloween weekend and we had such a great time! not only was melberg sweet and quick to respond, her place was beautiful!!! i highly recommend staying here.

10/10 would recommend! we really enjoyed our stay in nate's appartement. it has everything you need from great kitchen facilities, tv's, a large couch and a lovely bedroom. it's also super quiet, so you can sleep very well at night. we're looking forward to come again!
it was a place that’s clean and accessible by public transpo. communication and instruction is clear. also near airport.

we enjoyed our stay at this home. we were in nyc to enjoy the us open and this home was in just the right location. however, this is pretty far east into brooklyn so there’s not much nearby in terms of restaurants and coffee shops. the home itself was well furnished and everything worked as expected. the neighborhood was extremely loud one of the nights we were there, i think the neighbors were having a party before the big caribbean day parade. all in all, we enjoyed our stay as found it convenient to get in and out of queens and manhattan.
omri is a great host! he had a lot of useful tips for restaurants and bars. the apartment is great and absolutely convenient to stay. thank you very much, omri, for a wonderful nyc and brooklyn stay!
everything was perfect, super clean, good location and beds. can’t wait to come back, will definitely recommend to all of my friends.
she is an amazing host. mad sure i had everything i needed and always kept in contact. the place looks amazing. will definitely be using this place in the future.
love this place! very clean and great location 💕

from the moment i booked, jamal proved to be an exceptional host, showing unparalleled attentiveness, kindness, and genuine care throughout our entire stay. first and foremost, i must commend jamal for going above and beyond when i made the unfortunate mistake of leaving behind something important to me. instead of brushing it off as just another guest's forgetfulness, jamal took it upon himself to make sure i got it back safely. he truly exemplifies what a remarkable host should be, and i am incredibly grateful for his dedication and compassion. upon arriving at the airbnb, i was immediately struck by the stunning beauty and comfort of the place. it was hands down the nicest airbnb i have ever stayed in! my kids absolutely loved it too; they were overjoyed with the charming ambiance and all the thoughtful touches that made them feel right at home. if you're looking for a host who cares deeply about your experience and a place that exudes comfort and charm, look no further.
on behalf of my mother -aside from the noisy neighbours , jennifer’s place was lovey to stay at and very clean
it’s a nice place, clean and is as advertised! self check in was easy, hands off. bathroom was spacious and two rooms were nice to have for my friend and i. would come back and stay again.

we've had a great couple of days in the apartment with mary & josh. we were welcomed personally and showed around in the apartment which looked even better than the pictures. it was clean, comfy and some supplies to get you trough the first morning. we were lucky they had nobody checking in the next day, so they were even kind enough to let us stay for a late check out. the neighborhood offered plenty of nice small restaurants to have breakfast/lunch or dinner. and it's quite easy to reach manhattan by subway. all in all, we had a terrific couple of days in this apartment and i can certainly recommend staying here if you want to get away from busy manhattan.
great affordable option in awesome location!

steve's place is exactly as portrayed. although i pretty much use the apartment as a place to land, it has everything i need. the location is perfect; safe, great walking along the waterfront or nearby park. you are an easy walk to the train or fabulous neighborhood restaurants. this is my second stay and i will stay at steve's the next time i am in town.
stay here if you want to add spice to your stay in brooklyn! love this spot

everything was as advertised. really friendly guy. the room was comfortable perfect for those that intend on spending the day traveling the city. had a great time we would recommend him to anyone and intend on staying here again.

we love this neighborhood and nina’s place, while small, is comfortable. shower is great, but you have to have a certain amount of agility to get in and out. there is a back yard that we were able to use during the week. nina is quick to respond to any questions or needs.

as advertised - good value, no frills 1br stay right next to central park and one block away from bc trains. some snacks in the kitchen and bottled water in the fridge. mark was very responsive and also accommodated an early check-in which was much appreciated. would stay here again.
sj's place ws great! sj was a great host who was very relaxed about our ever changing schedule. perfect place in a lovely area. thanks sj!
we really enjoyed staying at carlos'. he was so lovely and gave us everything we needed. it was close to the subway station und a nice area to live. loved it that it was soooo clean everywhere.
flexible check-in (my car broke down on the way and i didn’t check-in until 2am), had noodles, ice cream, and water stocked up! bathroom and bedrooms were super cute!
gorgeous spacious room! very clean
great location, lovely place with international vibe and style. feels very homey!

much appreciated our visit to brady’s place in lovely bushwick!! brady’s brownstone was full of character, comfort, and great ac! we rented a private room but the entirety of the home felt welcoming and comfortable. would recommend this spot for anyone looking for an affordable yet lovely stay in bushwick! close enough to the city but out of the way of all the chaos and high prices! thanks again brady!

carlyn's place is a real jewel! the apartment is spacy and clean with very comfortable beds, two modern bathrooms and a lovely living room & kitchen. we felt like staying in a four star hotel! the hosts are extremely kind and helpful. and the location ticks all important boxes: the hudson, subway 1 (15 min to central manhattan), crucial stores (foodstores, pharmacies etc) and nice restaurants almost literally around the corner. highly recommended!
jennifer’s place is cozy, spotless, and stylish! bed was so comfortable. cats were adorable!
pedro was a great host! his place was very clean, quiet, and his kitchen was nice and big. i would recommend it to anyone who would like to stay in brooklyn :)

s&g’s place is well designed, very clean and has lovely amenities and complimentary snacks. their building is beautiful and the location was supreme. for a solo traveler in manhattan, this is an excellent choice and i highly recommend it. shala happened to be in the hallway when i arrived and helped with my bag. their instructions were very clear and thorough. i’ll be back!
best host super convenient nice house great location
great location and very nice rooftop.

kimberly is very friendly. the appartment is very close to the express lines to downtown. considering the location, kimberly propose a very affordable room.excellent experience for people who loves new york.

annette has a beautifully decorated place in carroll gardens. the apartment had everything we needed and was well appointed. my husband and i had two guests come and stay with us for three nights - there are two bedrooms, one queen and one double. our guests loved the nyc brownstone and railroad style apartment experience-how authentic! the air conditioning worked well and the apartment was very clean. communication with annette was great especially considering we kept changing our dates around - she was helpful, flexible, and friendly. we would definitely stay here again!
easy to find and simple place to stay just outside of main city
great location. found parking nearby. beautiful place. beautiful room. extremely comfortable. ac was perfect.

an absolute gem of place to use as a pied à terre for a longer stay in new york. this is really a home with great neighbours on a lovely street in the amazing park slope area. i’ll be sure to return when i next get the chance to visit this cozy abode.
in as much as it looks okay, there wasn't enough clean utensils to cook.

annissa's hospitality was amazing. the house was as listed. it felt like i was home. house was comfortable and clean! i will definitely be coming back! i loved it! annissa was responsive. her instructions were clear, check in was extremely easy. overall the time was amazing!

the place is just as described and showed in the pictures. i have to mention 2 things about the place that might be useful to others: first of all, it had very few kitchen utensils, almost nothing to cook, only for precooked food. and second the water was not clean at all, it was withe instead of transparent. we didn’t even use it to cook or drink. this was very uncomfortable because we had to buy a lot from the grocery all the time. apart of that we had a lovely one month stay. there are a lot of restaurant and bar close to it and 2 subway lines connecting with all in no time!

we stayed here for three nights while apartment hunting, and this couldn’t have been a more perfect place. easy in & out, nice clean room and comfortable bed, and nearly on top of both express and local trains to everywhere. yuval is an experienced host and extremely nice guy, and i would recommend his place to anyone!
a great stay for a couple of days with pretty easy transportation options. good value for a clean hotel room and breakfast.

we spend a few days at loics home to discover nyc. it was the perfekt place to reach all the important sights shortly by subway. we also really liked the very close providence park (just a few minutes by foot). as host loci was very friendly and open. the flat is clean and very tidy and contains everything you need. thanks for hosting us. we had a great time in nyc! best vanessa and patrick

this is a wonderful place for a pair of travelers to land! i stayed for several nights with an old friend who met me in new york. the apartment consists of just two rooms, but they're both enormous, so the place feels very spacious. and it's got charm to burn--we loved the striped floor in the kitchen and the big clawfoot tub in the bath. both beds were extremely comfortable. and the place was amazingly quiet, especially considering how close it is to fulton street. no need for ear plugs to sleep! alison's system for checking in and getting keys is extremely efficient and eliminates all concerns about missed or late flights, transit delays, and so on. we never actually met our hosts, although they were around the entire time and were very prompt about returning text messages. the neighborhood is diverse and vibrant, filled with interesting places to eat and gorgeous residential architecture. i only wish we'd had more time to explore!
great amount of space for the price and proximity to tourism spots. the airbnb was clean and easy to access. the host was friendly and helpful.
great place to stay. great location and communication was very professional. i would stay again!
masud was very quick to respond to our needs and he was very understanding.
the apartment was perfect. very comfortable, clean, with all the amenities and very well located. corey was a great host, very attentive!

we had a great experience at this apartment. we used it during a semester at nyu and stayed for 3 months. apartment was clean and as advertised. safe neighborhood and building was clean and safe too. friendly young professionals in the building. lamartine was a great host.
great comfortable space. the location is close to the r train. host is very responsive.
everything went smoothly. good communication and the place was as shown in the pictures. very convenient location as well for shopping and restaurants.

had 3 couples and this place was a gem in nyc. three spacious bedrooms and great common space for manhattan. close the central park, and a whole foods (and a quick bus/metro to the main attractions and food - just a note to visiting tourists, you're trading a 'not as trendy location' for a large amount of space with this unit). so so happy with our stay :)
loved my stay here. room was a dream, great location in the city and loved how they were able to hold luggage for you prior to a later departure. i’d absolutely stay here again
great stay…i enjoy every time
this was my second stay, and i will come back again. the place is very quiet, on a nice street, and it is spacious. i slept well, and was very comfortable overall.

charles was very nice when i met him. he gave a quick tour and checked up on me through text during my stay. the place was also quite nice, with a lovely entertainment system and lots of space. the train station wasn't too far away so it wasn't hard to get around, although it does take a bit long to get to manhattan and there may be service changes/delays, so plan accordingly. overall, i enjoyed my stay!
we had a great stay at yvonne’s place. the apartment is very clean and close to the metro. yvonne was very accommodating and had some great tips for food in the neighborhood. thanks !

lovely sanctuary to reset after busy days exploring nyc. we loved the little details including the well appointed kitchen. we also appreciated the slightly quirky but charming interior design, it felt like a home away from home. responsive and communicative host.
amazing spot in brooklyn’s historic neighborhood!

great little place, that is exactly as advertised. you probably don't want to spend a long time here if you are visiting, but if you need a place for the night before a flight this is the place to stay.
great place and location!

charles was a very welcoming, friendly, and funny guy. when i arrived he showed me around the place and gave me the run down of how everything worked and where to find everything. there happened to be a black out on our block in which the power went out for a couple of hours, but charles was very helpful in running out to go grab a flashlight for me. i would definitely stay here again when i come back for another visit.

placemakr was okay. the description of pictures on the airbnb app just did not match the room i got. i hope airbnb can work on that in the future. also smelled like fish. not sure if it was because we were closer to the water or whatever it may be.

the apartment really is as presented in the photos and it accommodated me and my wife very comfortably in the 4 weeks we’ve been there. there was a good amount of extra soaps and shampoos and also a prepaid card for use of the washer and dryer. eyal welcomed us personally and was very solicitous and quick to clarify our doubts before and during our stay. certainly, we would stay there again.

alejandro was a great host. he provided some recommendations for areas to visit in brooklyn. the room was in great condition as the pictures show. easy access to the subways. just would recommend getting back to the room before it gets too late.

i had an excellent time at brady’s place! we were offered an early check-in and the home was full of nice amenities and we had our own private coffee machine for the room, despite there being a communal kitchen and shared space! both the property manager (omar) and host was incredibly responsive in all hours of the day. the area was nice and quiet and just a short walk away from the train. everything we needed for a weekend trip:)
angel is a wonderful host! had a lovely time in the apartment. angel was always attentive and checking in if i needed anything. i would highly recommend!
i’d recommend this spot to my friends and family. quick communication and clean, spacious accommodations.
this airbnb was excellent! jorge was a terrific communicator and went out of his way to make my stay, specifically, a bit more special. would stay again — thank you!

a lovely studio in the heart of the east village close to great restaurants and bars. the apartment has everything you need for your stay and sonia is available to help with anything else. considering the location as well, this is a super find. thank you!
we loved chris and his space was centrally located. would stay here again.
really good experience, if i’m back to ny definitely a place i will stay again
this place was amazing and joe was a great host. i would definitely stay here again one day.

great stay in the city, i spent a lot of mornings at the cafe conveniently across the street. for such a lively area, it’s high enough up that the noise is limited. the elevators and ac were amenities i did not think needed but came in to be so helpful during the heat wave in june with 90 degree weather. i also really loved the terrace over the evenings. reka was very lenient with my luggage during check-in and check out so that i could start explore the area more. unfortunately, we did not meet since i was so busy but the two rentals on different floors are an ideal situation for privacy of both the guests and owner. my only tiny gripe was the pick up of keys at a location a half mile away - but it is very minor in the grand scheme. i hope to stay here again as i enjoyed watching nyc unfold before my eyes. thank you, reka :)

the location was perfect! close to grocery stores and the subway. this was the perfect location for taking the subway to manhattan. niko was super friendly and had helpful suggestions. you will have to get the keys from someone in person and return them in person when you leave, so plan ahead for that.

roderick’s place was clean, tidy and well organized. no clutter. accurately described and pictured. magazines to read are a huge plus. thank you for taking my last minute request. the check in guide was perfect. was easy to follow and easy to get inside. no issues getting inside at all. the place was quiet when i stayed. price was excellent as always. m train station only 2 blocks away and get you into most of manhattan. huge plus!!

tanya’s place is very beautiful and extremely clean. it looks exactly like the photos. she is helpful, proactive, and very polite. i highly recommend her place and will definitely book again whenever i visit.

james was a great host and his place was just as advertised! check in was easy, location is great, and apartment was perfect for an extended stay. 100% recommendation for anyone traveling to the city.
the garden suite was beautiful and clean! and ivan was a very communicative host. the location was an 8 minute walk from the train and perfectly situated in park slope. we would stay here again!

the vacation rental is part of a grand house in a green and peaceful enclave that one wouldn't usually associate with the bronx. we slept well here. although there are some rough edges, perhaps because the listing is new, i expect that berthold, who is a personable and responsible owner, will get things in shape quickly. i appreciated his kindness in receiving and holding my lost suitcase, when the airlines delivered it at night.
overall, it was a great experience, and many fun and funny memories were made. we appreciated the hospitality. easy access to getting around the island and getting to the manhattan area.
my stay was awesome, great clean place, highly recommended, great communication with hosts. will definitely be back.
i spent a night in the tiny room at lakshmee’s place. she was very nice and easy to talk to. she replied fast and helped me with my heavy luggage. the place is clean and near the airport.
nice lil apt i had no problems i would rent again

don’t know where to start. the place was very well kept, the room had more than enough space for myself and other half as well as an amazing comfortable bed, tv with chromecast and a surround sound for all entertainment needs. thanks again from myself and my other half. we were more than comfortable, we’re sure the next guests will be as well!
great stay with our family of four in nyc. neighborhood was perfect - quiet but still convenient to many attractions. would stay again!
place is exactly as pictured. comes with many plates, silverware, cutlery etc. nice, central location with view and natural lighting. host responds quickly for any questions.

wow, just wow! so fresh, clean, and comfortable. such thought put into decor, design and the amenities. extra special touch was leaving eggs, bread, cream, waters, etc. in the fridge for our use. we hope to be able to book every time we visit our children who live one block away. host, anthony, came out front to greet us on day 2 and showed us his garden level space. his bed-stuy hospitality rivals our southern hospitality! i’m a clean-freak. everything was pristine. that’s difficult in a historic property! highly recommend! appreciate such a quality host and space.

we enjoyed our stay at the manhattan club overall, despite a few issues that came up during our weekend stay. the manager on duty over the weekend of our stay, did a good job of helping find a resolve to the issues, in a prompt manner! we stayed in the presidential suite. the room was clean and had comfortable sleeping arrangements, although the suite does not reflect the quality or luxury that would be assumed by the high price point/ rate for the suite. small amenities and accommodations such as a bath robe or consist daily refresh of coffee/ espresso pods in our suite were overlooked entirely. which was a bit disappointing considering the presidential suite is typically assumed to be “the best” or have a higher standard of accommodation. the biggest convince and perk to staying at the manhattan club was that we were steps from central park and numerous restaurants, entertainment and easy subway access. the neighborhood/area felt very safe & quiet. very family/ kid friendly.
clean room , big tv, had to wait to check in , great bathroom. would stay again

great place to stay ! jessie was always supportive with early luggage drop off and super communication between us that made our stay just perfect. easy access and total safety in the area ! my husband and i will definitely come back to jessie’s place !!

peter was a great host! he was very responsive and friendly. the apartment looked exactly like the photos. it was very clean and spacious. i appreciate that the kitchen had cookware, condiments, and dinnerware. it was also close to the train station, which is what i wanted. the area was a bit noisy due to train passing by, but overall my family and i had a good time!
great host. assisted with direction in use of public transportation. place was clean and plenty of space to relax. certainly pleased with our decision to stay here.
untitled was so good to us! we checked in alittle late and the host was very responsive and accommodating. the place was very clean and welcoming and there is so much to do around the area.
i would definitely stay her again. i have no complaints.
the place is great with all we needed. location good with local groceries, travel to manhattan not too long.
great location. two bedroom was really a one bedroom. the second bedroom was a bed in a living room.

this home was outstanding. very clean and prestige conditions. very much a home away from my home. the beds are so comfortable. television in each room. bathrooms are definitely updated and modern. all toiletries were included. towels galore. controlled air conditioning units and privately controlled for each room in the home. beautiful kitchen with all the bells and whistles. a lot of windows for sun light during the day. transportation is not far at all just a walk around the corner to the bus line q10 which takes you everywhere and right to subway or air train. we were returning sometimes the wee hours of the next morning and we were all safe. my son would walk the neighborhood and loved it. very quiet and beautiful neighborhood. peshla would contact me via text and make sure we were okay and wished my daughter a great fashion show walk. peshla is very kind and even let us check out past the 11 am due to our flight at 3pm. definitely would recommend this home for new york travel.
dan and jarret’s place is beautiful! the art/location is amazing and they were available if i needed anything/had questions. i would highly recommend booking if this place is available.
very helpful and friendly.
hope to stay again grateful to have had a place during the new years celebration ! thank you shully

such a lovely apartment! the apartment is full of character and the host has thought of everything you could need. solo traveler and i felt very safe. bedstuy is one of the best neighborhoods in nyc. i will absolutely stay here again!

this is a perfect place to stay if you’re wanting to explore harlem or you’re attending columbia. i stayed here for a week while attending an institute at columbia. a short walk to the university and had all the amenities you might need. the a train becomes your best friend. there is a ton of great places to go in the neighborhood and definitely check out the apollo theater. thank you qai for being flexible and for all the local suggestions.

brady’s place is great for anyone or couple traveling to ny needing a place to stay. stylish brownstone with everything you would need in your room, simple and straight forward communication will help you throughout your stay whether it’s a quick overnighter or a few days in. i’m from new york so i didn’t utilize the tips but there was a book to help guide any first timer through the city and that was a neat add on. i booked a night stay same day and it was an easy process with no hiccups so communication was great on both ends. thanks brady, would stay again!

the apartment was quite comfortable and location was amazing! it was so easy to get anywhere by foot or metro. the restaurants around the area brian recommended were all delicious! i would recommend his place to anyone wanting to stay in the city!
we loved staying here over the summer and the host, mercedes, was wonderful! the location was perfect and the host was super responsive and helpful as we navigated the city during our stay.
everything is fine except for the cleaning ladies that somehow get on your business. basically, you get blame for things someone else does.
nates place was great ! would recommend to anybody.

i rented nicole’s place in greenpoint for the wknd for my husband and his sister and brother. they flew in for the wknd to see a broadway show. they loved nicole’s space. most places we looked at in our price range had only one double bed and a pull out couch. nicole’s place was of great value and each of them them were able to have their own rooms which was a big bonus. the beds were super comfortable. it had plenty of space for the three of them. they loved the access the neighborhood had. they could walk to anything they needed. coffee, restaurants and the subway. nicoles place was also very cozy and they enjoyed just hanging out in the apartment, catching up and drinking coffee. it was a lovely place to come back to after walking all over the city. nicole was very communicative and check in was super easy for them. their flights leaving ny were late in the evening. nicole let them keep their luggage in the common area which was really helpful. they had a great time and would highly recommend staying here!

highly recommend staying at mary's place! she is super easy going, and her place has a great location with all of the amenities that you'd need. the icing on the cake was definitely the beautiful skyline view from the bedroom & rooftop.

the apartment is just as clean and comfortable as you would expect it to be from the pictures and really makes you feel as if you were at home. amir was always very quick to respond to questions and also have good advice on things to do in and around the city. the location of the apartment could hardly be better as it is located in a rather quiet area, while still offering you a great connection to manhattan via the staten island ferry. this place would definitely be my first choice if i ever happen to visit ny again.

louann is a fabulous host! she’s literally thought of everything — even extra toothbrushes, snacks and socks! the room was very comfortable and quiet. the ac unit was awesome and really helped cut the heat and humidity. the place even bigger and more beautiful than the photos represent. we’ll stay here again every time we visit nyc!! ♥️♥️♥️
loveddd my time here. would recommend it!
winston’s place worked well for my one night stay. thoughtful layout and the bathroom was clean.
he was soooo kind and help us a lot. around the location is very quiet and easy to get there. the room is so clean. i had a great time and comfortable to stay here!
super helpful and accommodating hosts. always quick responses and willing to help with anything! great experience.

we had a wonderful stay at marco’s place in the upper west side. each bedroom was comfortable and the common area was a perfect place to unwind and share our daily adventures. checking in and out was so easy, and although we happily had no issues, we knew our hosts were there and easily reachable if we needed them. thank you, marco, for providing us with such a nice place to stay in nyc!

10/10 for the whole stay. me and my partner could not fault this place at all. really cool location away from the madness of times square. really cool area with lots of restaurants around and near soho for shopping! the room was so quite could not hear a thing outside and the beds were so comfortable. the room was so clean, it is small, but that was perfect for the two of us. the staff were really laidback and friendly. reasonably priced too! just an overall unreal place and we’ll be staying here the next time we stay in new york!

the apartment is on the top floor of a 200 year old building - it is full of great character and light with a skylight, high ceilings, lots of windows. be prepared for 2 flights of stairs. it isn't modern but is setup for comfort as well with curtains to block the light in the bedroom, room to spread out, comfortable bed and good linens. it's a great location and neighborhood, close to subway, pratt art institute, a great local park (fort green). we love this part of brooklyn with lots of trees - it is a great walking area of ny. the host was super responsive, very nice, and helpful. we needed some scheduling flexility which she accommodated with no problem. she went out of her way to be helpful. we would definitely rent it again and highly recommend it.
john greeted us upon arrival which was very warm and welcoming. john went out of his way to show us around and was very responsive. the place was clean and comfortable, would definitely book again!
cute place with a very nice bed, kitchen and shower.
michelle’s place was immaculate and was just what was described and pictured.

100% a great place to live for a couple of days! describes exactly how it is - definitely a great place to just sleep at and be out for most of the day. its a very convenient spot and it was practically spotless when we came in! definitely fits only up to four people, but it works out! would come back!
super convenient location and nice

clean, neat. great location close to prospect park. oscar was an excellent host, kind and friendly and check in and out was super easy. we will consider the apartment again for when we have family or friends in town.

sheena's place was perfect. communication, cleanliness, and friendliness were superior. sheena's place is also a very close walk to the subway. i will definitely try to stay here again if i'm back in brooklyn!

this place is amazing. everything is as described the place is very private and nice. it’s located by a ton of things, also near a subway entrance. the home has a great feel to it that allows you to automatically feel comfortable. they’re quick to respond and for the price and location you can’t beat this place. whenever i come back to new york i will definitely be searching for this place!
clean and convenient location.
overall, the stay was good. great location, room was clean, and check in was easy. only hassles we’re spotty air conditioning and lack of luggage storage.
lola is an amazing host. she is kind and friendly. we always felt safe and comfortable at her place. i highly recommend her! if we go back to nyc, we would definitely stay at her place. thanks lola!
christine house very clean ,great area, it's nice place to take guys i have a lot of privacy 100% great i 😍 ❤️🙏👍

this place is as reflected in the photos. it wa very clean, comfortable and tastefully decorated. the garden was great and the showe even has a small window looking out into the garden. the place we quite and located near seventh avenue in south slope which has several nice restaurants like winner and picolli. host was very helpful and answered all questions quickly. great stay!

we had an amazing trip and the place was lovely. it was a bit rainy and they had umbrellas there for us! it was fantastic. the subway is near by if you want to travel into new york city. the delis near by are just absolutely delicious. great place with a great host.

great location, simply outstanding staff! room for improvement: the mattress is overdue for replacement. it is worth noting that there is only one set of elevators serving 30+ floors, so catching one was challenging, especially in the morning. i recommend staying either low or super high. we stayed on the 18th floor and often had to use the stairs.

modern boutique hotel with nice onsite amenities like a rooftop bar, very small rooms though with poor noise control. be aware that some common hotel room expectations are not included, such as a mini fridge or coffee station.
the place is really nice and has character! very centrally located in chinatown and is close to some speak easy bars. the host was really responsive and helpful! i would 100% recommend this place! x

a little barebones but okay place to stay compared to what you would pay for other places in new york. would rate higher but the location is a little inconvenient for accessing public transit (20 minute walk to the nearest train station) and the bathroom is not in the best shape. host was very friendly/responsive and the common areas are nice.
very clean great place would definitely stay here again

ruth's place was the perfect place for me and my husband. the location was perfect with being right next to central park and so many other attractions. we could easily come and go when we wanted to rest and recuperate. couldn't recommend her place enough!
easy check-in, good location, and a large spacious room with a good bathroom. but house is a bit creaky so you know when other guests are walking or talking.
we needed a place to stay last minute, and they came in clutch especially checking in earlier than what their usually time!

it was my first experience with airbnb and it was a great experience.victor was very receptive, answered all my questions before and during the trip. the house is really as described, my room was spacious with a very good bed. the room had no fan but has 2 windows that help with ventilation. the room is in front of the bathroom, this can be a problem if other visitors make a lot of noise when using the bathroom at night. the kitchen is well equipped, the fridge is big but there was a problem and the fridge didn't work for a few days and i ended up losing some food. just had this little problem, the rest worked very well. in general, the house is a few blocks from the subway, quiet neighborhood near supermarkets, shops and laundry. if one day i need to go back to the bronx, i would stay in this house again
great location. lots of music at his place.

amazing place! nice neighborhood, clean bathroom, warm shower, convenient kitchen, and cozy bed. it also has nice desk to work with beautiful sunshine through the window - i’ve been written my fiction here. bus stop is just near the place. definitely recommended!

one of the better managed properties we have experienced on airbnb. attentive and thoughtful hosts, always responsive. the studio is very nicely appointed and layed out, with everything updated. the property has good access to r train, citi bikes, hugh carey tunnel , and major highways. this is not a quiet treelined street in brooklyn. it is noisy and busy. huge back yard area, that in nice weather offers interesting options, but it literally is adjacent to prospect highway. we will definitely stay with them again, and bring our ear plugs for sleeping ( which the hosts thoughtfully provide if you forget).

i had a fantastic experience with urban furnished! due to an issue with my previous apartment, i needed to find a new place and move in on the same day, and they made the entire process seamless. kateryna was incredibly friendly and responsive throughout my stay, ensuring i felt supported the whole time. the apartment’s location in greenpoint is perfect! it’s just a short walk to the greenpoint ave stop on the g line, making transportation easy. the area is full of excellent dining options, and there’s both a trader joe’s and whole foods nearby in williamsburg, which is within walking distance. the walk to williamsburg is pleasant, with a nice path and multiple spots to enjoy the sunset. the apartment itself was spotless, charming, and fully equipped with everything i needed. i highly recommend staying with urban furnished, and i would definitely return to this place again. greenpoint is a wonderful neighborhood that i think anyone would love!
it was a wonderful stay. everything was up to the mark as shown in the listings. both rosemarie & her husband fritzroy went out of their way to help me whenever needed. definitely recommend it!
my husband enjoyed the apartment.
great location, great price. super helpful host. would recommend!
great room in a well kept home in a quiet neighborhood. convenient for my needs and relatively easy to find parking all times of the day.
this was the best airbnb we have stayed in. it had everything you could want. great location. the apartment layout was terrific ... bedroom, bathroom, kitchen then living area all in a row.
it’s a great place
cheap stay & great location.
this was actually a pretty nice place to stay for a last minute check-up. it was swift, and had a double sided bed to myself, which was pretty nice.
exactly as listed. nothing fancy, just a clean, safe place that is very close to jfk airport. bed was comfortable with extra blankets. very clean.

i've stayed in many airbnb's and there are some that definitely stand out and quickly jump to the oh i'll be coming back again list, wendy's place is one of them. such a super clean and very cozy spot, at the end of a quiet block with private yet kind neighbors. i appreciated the flexible check in time after a long commute, well lit block, clear instructions with helpful pics for visual folks like myself (thanks wendy), easy keyless entry, snacks and water to hold me over until i hit all the nearby stores and eateries. if you love "little caribbean" and visiting brooklyn as much i do, looking for somewhere walkable to the bus and trains and the bustling gumbo of a mix of culture and history that is flatbush then book it. the icing on the cake is wendy is a great host, respects her guests, and you can feel that she cares. hope to come again soon wendy, thank you!
this place is truly amazing! comfortable and cozy! the pillows are like heaven to sleep on! i will deff come back! hands down the best airbnb that i have had so far!

we enjoyed our stay and really appreciated the charm of this classic brownstone. the building has a lot of character and gave us a true nyc feel. the studio itself was simple but functional, and the small kitchenette was helpful. the location felt safe and convenient, with plenty of nearby options like dunkin’, starbucks, and local coffee shops for our morning coffee fix. the space is timeless and well loved. as noted in the listing bathroom setup is a bit unusual, with the toilet and sink in a hallway water closet and a very small separate shower. it may not be comfortable for everyone. our space was a bit noisy and we could hear the foot traffic as they went upstairs and, at times, the neighbors while they were in their room. overall, it worked well for our needs and our trip to the big apple.
thaya has a great place to stay and i really appreciated her helpfulness and flexibility regarding my checkin. she's a great resource for getting to know the area - long time resident of nyc.
this place was really good and comfortable.
okay place. no roof garden. no breakfast. no parking unless you’re a cop or a firefighter with a placard. it’s walkable to dumbo, brooklyn heights and ft greene.

debra are welcome us with sweet smile during our check in. she is very responsive host. nice apartment. we have our own kitchen and living room. debra was so kind since she bought a new rice cooker for us. i like the kitchen and fridge is big to store cooking stuff. the bus stop is right the corner. there is utica halal pizza and fried chicken shop nearby and so tasty. definitely will stay again. her son terry is also a nice person.

thank you very much for your hospitality! it was very kind from you to let us partying yesterday night for halloween. the airbnb was perfect but a bit expensive according to us. have a great day best regards mathilde
we loved the urban style and the good location. the room is perfect for what you need while visiting the city.
perfect location and space.

michael's apartment is exactly what it says in the description. central to times square, spacious and an all round great place to stay. michael himself, is a brilliant host. very friendly and gives very useful information. definitely would stay here again the next time i'm in the area!

gil is an excellent host and a great communicator, which is important when someone opens up their home to you. gil was very friendly and quick to respond to any questions. the room was beautiful and very clean. the neighborhood is gorgeous and my group spent a lot of time just wandering around the gorgeous tree lined streets. you should definitely book here!
small, and clean space but some noise from upstairs

me and my girlfriend stayed here to get out of town for our anniversary. it was a perfect private spot in the middle of a great neighborhood. in addition to alison's awesome dinner recommendation, we found two great bars and an incredible breakfast spot all less then a ten minute walk away. the next morning grabbing the train into manhattan was just as easy, with the subway stop only a few blocks down the street. i would definitely stay here again
great spacious spot in the les!
this was a very good place. the stay was really good. the room was very clean and spotless. the neighborhood was safe.

thank you for your nice accommodation, we enjoyed our trip. we were well received and always received a quick response to our questions. marianny and kacey were always friendly and helped where necessary. highly recommended!
this is a great room on the top floor of the house (and on top of the hill) = great views. we found the bed comfortable, room/bathroom were clean and the shower works well too!
fabulous studio in a really neat part of town. omar kept a tidy place with plenty on hand for guests.
super nice apartment, roomier than expected, comfortable and the location can't be beat.

miriam is a great host! she did an amazing job of making sure we had everything we needed. make sure you bring full length mirrors, the place doesn’t have any. other than, great place! would definitely book again.
nice place, clean, quiet, as advertised. be prepared for quite a long commute to anything in manhattan, but that's why it's affordably priced.
stefanie was a wonderful host! the apartment and location were lovely, there’s so much to do in walking distance. hope to stay again some time 😊

our stay at this brooklyn apartment was absolutely wonderful. the apartment itself is beautifully decorated and incredibly comfortable, making for a truly relaxing home base. the neighborhood is charming, perfect for exploring. jess and zach were very welcoming, provided us with many local tips and even generously gave us free museum tickets, which we were incredibly grateful for! the subway is about a 15-minute walk away, and we found it very convenient for reaching manhattan (25-35 minutes to most spots). just a small tip for light sleepers: since there's a fire station nearby, earplugs can be helpful at night. overall, we had an amazing experience and would highly recommend this fantastic apartment and its wonderful hosts.

camilla and her family we’re such great host! beautiful people with wonderful personalities and alot of respect! they made me feel welcomed from the check in to check out and gave me ample amount of space!! the room was super clean and the location was definitely a plus. parks and subways within a 10min walk! i will definitely be coming back!❤️
great location and felt safe
i can’t wait to book with them again. very accommodating

jose' is the perfect host. this space is definitely for someone who needs to be in nyc, but doesnt mind the commute to get to midtown. his home is a convenient 1/2 block walk from the trains. the kitchen is an amazing experience for those who would like to cook for themselves. just clean up after yourselves. the neighborhood has a lot flavor. i only spent one night, but hopefully if i need another night, then it is available.
very nice private room in relatively quiet neighborhood in brooklyn. excellent location for our needs. host chris extremely accommodating and pleasant.

beautiful home, inside and out, with warm charm and art throughout. stay comes with a large bedroom with closest, own sitting area, private kitchen, and spacious bathroom with tons of natural light. great location to get around, with subway minutes walk away. more than that, hosts are wonderfully kind, considerate, and helpful. would highly recommend and hope to stay again myself!

i stayed at angel’s place last weekend while visiting the nyc area. place was exactly as it was described. had my own private kitchen, bathroom and bedroom. i arrived early and the host allowed me to store my bags there until the room was ready. they even took my bags up the stairs for me which was kind of them. i didn’t need much but if i had any questions they were sure to answer them in a timely manner. the local train is about a couple blocks away and the train ride into manhattan was only a few stops maybe about 10 mins. the neighborhood was pretty quiet which was a bonus especially when i was getting home late some evenings. overall a great stay and i would stay again if i’m in the area.
great spot, felt like a safe area next to some great cafes and food. beds were comfortable, nice kitchen, clean space.
velma was great at communicating and accommodating. the space was alright.
excellent host location, everything catered for and host is available if necessary. vivian is a super host for a very good reason.

wow! michal is a great host. she was very easy to communicate with and she made check-in a breeze. she also put together a very helpful list of local restaurant and store recommendations which we used three times. the apartment was spacious and included everything we needed for a comfortable stay. it was also very convenient to transportation and entertainment.
stephany was awesome and accommodating
exactly as described, comfortable bed, grocery directly across the street, no complaints!

we had a great stay at this airbnb! it was excellent for the price and offered everything we needed for a comfortable visit. the host was very friendly and helpful, which made the experience even better. the location was perfect — close to many great tourist attractions and easy to get around. i would definitely recommend staying here and would come back again!
amazing hospitality, communication, and cleanliness in nyc! would definitely recommend to friends and family.
such a lovely apt -- great separate sleeping options, close to the beach, easy check-in, one of the best airbnbs in terms of the amentities and thoughtful offerings in the apt. highly recommend.
great apartment for a family manhattan trip! menachem and fatima were extremely responsive and helpful.
the apartment was nice and comfortable. unfortunately it'son a noisy street at street level. between the street noise and airplane traffic it was too noisy. could use soundproofing.

we stayed in the city for 4 nights and this place was ideal for all that we needed. the apartment is exactly what you see in the pictures; clean and easy! tom is a brilliant host, very responsive with super clear instructions - we opted for the self check in and was very straightforward.
great host. the apartment is lovely and i wished i had it as my personal house. chijioke was very friendly and i had a great night rest.

jill and carl are perfect hosts! not only do they provide a thorough pamphlet about the house and the area, they also leave some breakfast supplies in the fridge, which we were thankful for every morning. the ground floor apartment is spacious and clean, a perfect home base when visiting new york. subway stations and bus stops are nearby and easy to use. manhattan and all it's sights are just a train ride away. the neighborhood itself is beautiful and worth exploring. we tried several crown heights restaurants and coffee shops -- not a single one disappointed. north brooklyn is easily accessible as well, with its offerings of shops and restaurants. we highly recommend this space and would love to visit again in the future!
great stay, very nice and responsive host. instructions for check in are very helpful.
a beautiful place in a great neighborhood. ginger and victor were amazing hosts. 100% recommend.
great host and good person to talk to. home was nice and clean and made me feel at home
loved staying here would definitely recommend!
it was exactly what we were looking for! a comfortable, clean airbnb to rest our head after a long journey.

we would like to congratulate alberto for this amazing flat clean ,neat,impeccable,with all things in the kitchen that you need ,comfy beds and bathrooms. easy to check in /check out great location near the subway . ana was so kindness as well
apartment was cute and beds were super comfortable-always a plus!
clean cute place ,great price.dan was a great host and provided privacy and quick to respond.

had a great stay, a calm and light room (7th floor) in this vibrant city which was important for me to be able to rest in-between, friendly service people and a very good barista coffee and little snacks in the beautiful lobby until 2pm! lots of places possible to explore by foot (just around the corner at bowery museum, there's even a gallery (7th floor) with a great skyline view). perfect for a 4-day-trip to explore nyc downtown and midtown. very recommendable.
comfortable apartment close to all the major attractions. martin was very communicative and we loved our stay!
basma was friendly and very responsive. i had a great stay. i would come back to stay here again.

location was great, very close to times square and other interesting points. besides hidden fees after you book, i've to pay 350usd (5 nights) as a deposit, an hour after the checkout they updated the payment up to 401. finally they cancelled that payment and everything was ok after i asked why they did that. the air conditioner in the room was not working as expected, so we were cold during some of the nights. the hotel has 2 very small elevators (one on each side of the building) and you have to be too patient because they are always full of people and they go to the floor 1 to 9 and vice versa. we were at the 4th floor and we have to use the stairs most of the times.
great location, right near a subway. clean, tidy, and comfortable room. a+

we loved this space. the apartment was comfortable, welcoming and spacious. the garden was a lovely space to have tea and read in the morning. so may little thoughtful touches made us feel very welcomed. j was very communicative and helpful. we highly recommend this lovely airbnb!
wonderful stay and very close to the #1 subway line. convenient and an updated nice hotel.

great location with several train stations in easy walking distance and a nice neighbourhood with many shops and delis just around the corner. the apartment was very clean and cosy, nina was a fantastic host, being really nice and helpful. we really enjoyed our stay und would definitely come back!
highly recommended one of my favorite places to stay

excellent location. no shortage of great food and drink options. we were on the go and really appreciated the proximity to subway stations. we had several late night walks back to the apartments and never had any safety concerns. starting our day from here was great because of all the coffee/bakery/breakfast spots within walking distance. we always found something new to try and also spend a fair amount of unplanned time checking out several of the storefronts in the area. i've visited nyc several times and this is definitely an area that i will look into first when i visit next time.
i enjoyed my say i would go back great host
great apt, spacious, luminous, quiet, clean, well equipped (great pans, knives, tv, wifi). thanks.

we stayed here with a total of 3 couples on a budget trip. this place does the job; it was clean and provided us a place to sleep and get ready! it is definitely not "luxurious" but was ideal for our group. we enjoyed our stay here and would definitely stay here again the next time we come to nyc! it is in the heart of koreatown, close to the subways, close to popular tourist locations and had great food options around! the reception was easy to find and attentive! only down side was we wished we could have done early check-in at no cost.
