pamela, made my first time in nyc feel like home. great communication and hospitality. i will def be staying here again the next time i come to brooklyn.
it was a perfect stay at the flat at any time. simon is a kind person and at any time available if necessary.
place was very nice and clean. staff were very nice and helpful. the only downside is that the elevator was always packed and only one seemed operational.

don’t think about it, just book it. you won’t be disappointed 10/10. awesome staff and amazing hospitality. the rooms are clean as well as the hotel, beautiful rooftop, the host was very responsive and helpful. i had an amazing time.

stay here! check in was super easy. the space is beautiful, even more so in person. the bath tub is so luxurious and spa like. very close to some nice bars/places to grab a bite and a darling little wine shop. easily accessible to the subway and loved walking around the neighborhood. 10/10
sandra was friendly and attentive. her place located in a quiet residential area, room was exactly as pictured and described. comfortable bed, clean bathroom. i would definitely stay here again.
ramia was an excellent host. her place was pleasant, very clean with many thoughtful extras to make a comfortable stay. i would stay there again!
fantastic location in manhattan. coffee shop right below. we would definitely stay there again.

erin was a fantastic host, always available for any eventuality. the apartment was clean, fully equipped and in a great location for visiting the city, very close to the subway. the neighborhood is very nice, the street quiet, but close to bars, restaurants and supermarkets. if we go back to nyc we will definitely lighten up in erin's condo again!!

everything about our stay was wonderful. the space has oodles of character, was very comfortable and was also more spacious than we imagined. everything we could need was right there. we appreciated the staples in the kitchen and very much enjoyed chatting with both lory and cindy. and we had some great meals in the neighborhood. thank you for being great hosts.

we had a great time here. chris met us and showed us around. we know the area well and it is a very safe area, close (about 10 minutes stroll) to subway into nyc. we were going on a week long holiday to the caribbean after our stay in astoria and then returning for another 4 days. chris very kindly suggested storing some luggage (winter clothes) until our return. much appreciated.
had a good time only problem was it was freezing in there and the heat would not cut on...

this is a chill spot. i really enjoyed my stay. being by the beach made the experience so peaceful. if you’re a big & tall guy like the bathroom may be an issue. enjoyed the complimentary champagne! i will definitely recommend and will book again.
good so good wonderful living experience in new york city

obed is an amazing host! even though we were unable to meet in person, he made sure to give us tips about everything from grocery stores and restaurants in the area, to best travel options to our airbnb from the airport. the accommodations were also great! very clean and it was a pretty close walk to most subways and the park.

we had an amazing stay at jamal's place. the space is perfect for a couple, clean and well served. jamal was super available and nice all the times we meet him. we also enjoyed pretty much the neighbourhood with very good subway connections with other areas in brooklyn and manhattan.

my daughter & i enjoyed our recent stay at the “quaint” sweet pea cottage. kathleen made sure that we were comfortable & was available for anything we needed. we hope to go back sometime & would recommend it to others looking for a nice place to stay.
great location; comfortable and discreet apartment; great communication; i'll be back
good location, nice private room. and michael is an excellent host with great local tips. would recommend.

the location of this hotel was perfect. very close to many subways entrances. also very close to many restaurants but not close to any convenience stores. the other downside was that the description of the hotel room was not accurate. from the pictures, there is more space and even a desk. my room did not have this space and didn’t have a desk. i was here for a conference so it would have been nice to have that. additionally, the front door code stopped working on the last day of my stay. it seems like other guests were given new codes and were able to get in. once i called the phone number, they apologized and gave me another set of codes. it was good that the person on call was available. or else i would have been stranded outside in the middle of the night.

first time staying in nyc, very grateful that mike has his place on airbnb. really cool and unique place. mike was a kind and helpful guest. will recommend to others and hopefully come back again. thank you again mike!
i was there to sleep primarily. it was a smooth check-in/out. the host was hospitable/ accessible.
a wonderful immaculate space & experience! i hope to be a frequent guest when visiting my daughters & their families who live nearby!

really enjoyed our stay at chambers, we brought our puppy and it was a very dog-friendly hotel. very convenient location close to 5th ave and central park. we also loved the nightly wine hour and turn-down service.

i had a great stay here. the location is very convenient. i just a 5-minute walk to the red line, so getting around anywhere the train goes (mainly the west side) is super easy. it didn’t feel particularly dangerous even when coming back late at night, but like anywhere in nyc, you might occasionally run into some strange people, so i’d still recommend walking around mostly during the day. as for the apartment itself, it has almost everything you need, and considering the price, the size and overall condition are excellent. you can hear people walking in the hallway and sometimes a bug might get in, and because it’s a semi-basement unit, it can feel very dark with the windows closed. but compared to most places in manhattan, it’s much more spacious and comfortable, and the value for the price is honestly unbeatable. the host was incredibly kind and helpful throughout my stay. if i come back to new york on a budget trip again, i would definitely stay here. highly recommend!
christina was awesome and the space was perfect for what i needed. plus, conveniently located to the airport. highly recommend!
very good! exactly what we expected and in the heart of new york!

fantastic apartment and incredibly responsive and helpful hosts! the bed is very comfortable and the apartment is clean and great to spend time in. gorgeous view of the statue of liberty at sunset too. highly recommend!
great place

we are repeat visitors to kevin and karen's place. the apartment is very comfortable and conveniently located to prospect park, restaurants, and shopping. we would be happy to come back anytime we want to stay in brooklyn.

the apartment is only one flight up from the street, in a location with tons of restaurants and bars nearby, and is tastefully decorated and very clean. we found the place to be a great base of operations for our visit. if you like mexican food there are some places near by as well as late night bars.
silva was very responsive as i organized my arrival. her place is in a great neighborhood with lots of delicious food options. it was perfect for my short stay in nyc!
this is a great spot. and i highly appreciate the decor and the touches to make it feel more comfortable. everything went smoothly and great.

my host nehprii was a sincerely friendly & considerate host. she made me feel very welcome right away. the house is a 100 yr. old, classic brooklyn brownstone that is essentially original. clean as a whistle with a really comfy bed! the neighborhood is beautiful and quiet with friendly neighbors. a few blocks from the train with great bars, retaurants & shops just short walks away. if you love new york and want to experience "classic brooklyn" living..this is your place! you'd be foolish to spend twice the money at a hotel! the house also has very positive vibes...if you believe in that type of thing!

peter's place was amazing. the place was well furnished and even had decorations all over the place. it was extremely clean and had lots of places to sit and open room. he was nice enough to stock the place with snacks and even provided towels and toiletries which came in handy. he was extremely gracious at all times and was available for communication but gave us our privacy as well. it was a really pleasant experience staying at his apartment. there's a subway stop not to far from his place that can take you anywhere you want and also a rite aide. me and my friends really enjoyed staying here and are so glad we picked this place. the host and the place itself were both amazing!
our second time here 🙂 perfect location in nolita, beautiful apartment, kitchen, rooftop. lindsee was helpful, again we were very happy here. not cheap (it’s nyc) but highly recommended!

jean is a great host! his place is safe, clean and comfortable! heat temp inside was cozy, bed/sheets and comforters were super comfortable. jean also accommodated holding my luggage for a few extra hours, which was super helpful. a really great place to stay for sure!!

everything was great. tash is a nice and helpful person. room was cozy, looked just like in the pictures. subway stations are close. i can’t imagine a better place for my stay in nyc. if i ever visit nyc again, i will choose this airbnb again 100%.
the location of this airbnb is amazing! 10 mins walk from soho and brooklyn bridge! also, right in the heart of chinatown. the interior is really nice and the beds were comfy as well.

fantastic place with central location to many things in queens. jay was a fantastic host that was super responsive and always did his best to help out in providing basic supplies, recommendations, and other information in a timely manner. for information, this is a 1 bedroom 1 bath 2nd floor apartment. incredibly quiet, peaceful area. great ac unit that got super cold, and everything functioned as it should. less than 5 min walk from the bus stop to downtown flushing. he made this stay so great for me during my hospital rotation. i would 100% stay back here if given the chance.
madison was a great host. she helped us in many ways, many hints to reach sites and supermarkets. great. she is very special. i suggest everyone to go there. lovely. i hope to go there once again.

the location was perfect! super close to domino and the subway. spacious and hosts were very communicative . only complaints would be it could use a deep clean and some new appliances (for example there were huge holes in the pillow cases and the floor/bathroom was dirty) otherwise really enjoyed our stay here :)

such a charming place <3 the room was just as described—even cuter than the pictures. plus, minutes from the subway, which made exploring easy. thank you to the hosts for their kindness and hospitality!

this loft is great ! the real nyc loft ! i want to buy it ! seriously, best air bnb experience ever ! the room is away from the living room and bathroom; so perfect to cook or watch tv while somebody else is sleeping . the living room is super comfy , has everything you need . super well decorated, cosy , hugh ceiling . the bedroom is cosy , the bed is super comfy . no noise . i dont know what to say : rent it ! everything was super clean ! didn't get the chance to meet sylvana but communication was super smooth ! thanks again ! your place is great !
air conditioning not working and unresponsive hotel manager. location remote hotel not very clean with room very dark

the host was nice and responsive. he also provide toast and bread when we arrive. however, there was one night that the power went off. no air conditioner when nyc was 90 degrees. also, the tenant above was super noisy after midnight. lastly, the some of the furnitures are probably super cheap. it's really hard to close the dish washer. the mattress are not comfortable.
great location! would definitely stay again!

extremely convenient location! about a 10 min walk to l train perfect for heading back to manhattan or towards downtown brooklyn! just remember the l runs every 20 mins after 1030 and on the weekends so expect delays! the place itself was super spacious and clean! i would definitely stay here again!

mark was an extremely gracious and considerate host, personally giving us a good lay of the land (explaining apartment, building, neighborhood, and also checking in with us mid-way to make sure all was well. the apartment was as described, very comfortable for an upper east side one-bedroom. it was nice to have the separation of bedroom and living space on two floors. this is not typical for a smaller apartment in new york and was kind of cool. most ny one bedrooms don't have the extra half bath, so this was a plus. also, for a smaller building, it was nice to have an elevator. there are buildings that are cared for, and there are buildings that are not. this one is well maintained. the air conditioning was more than adequate to help us through some warm days. it's in the middle of a typical upper east side neighborhood, which is to say, plenty of nice restaurants and shops from very casual to very fine, and including steps away one of my personal favorite's, luke's, which serves a pretty good lobster role and is kind of a cute faux-maine lobster shack. you are minutes from the met and central park, and it's a nice walk to get there. for runners, it's 10 minutes or so to the cp reservoir, one of my favorite runs. or do the whole perimeter of the park, which is six miles and a spectacle of nature and the human parade. the nearby neue gallery, another favorite, now has a line literally around the block, as a result of the movie lady in gold. maybe this will settle down after a few months, because the neue is a gem. you can get a good work out at crunch fitness, right across 3rd ave., one minute from apartment, at a day rate of $35. if you're someone who feels you just need a workout now and then, particularly because you'll want to eat well in ny, this is a worthwhile convenience. bottom line. nice apartment, with a very thoughtful and attentive host. i would return. thanks, mark.
loved my stay! felt very safe for solo traveling, would definitely book again!
the place is perfect, there are a lot of restaurants, target and a subway just 2 blocks away. also april was really helpful, i would definitely recommend it.
good value but not very clean
the location could not have been better. also very quiet!

the apartment is big for nyc standards. subway was an easy walk and it was only one train to get as far downtown as the west village (as far as we went). greg also had some small details such as fresh flowers which we loved. would absolutely stay here again.

what a vibe! jiyoun’s place is perfect for an affordable spot in brooklyn. the plants give the place the feel of a secret garden. bathroom, bedroom spotless. i could have sat in living room for hours just enjoying the vibe. jiyoun’s wifi is ‘lovewins’ and you can tell he takes that affirmation seriously. glad i got to stay.

jazzmine is very responsive. the apartment is an easy two flight walk-up. getting the keys was without fuss. the room is sheltered by the granite building next door. it is quiet and private. the bedroom with ensuite half bath includes adjacent bath & shower. her private quarters are well away from our's. the apartment shares a generous living room space and open plan kitchen. so it feels like we had plenty of private space. she provides a gracious amenity selection for quick breakfast and a space in her common refrigerator for food we bought. local bodegas supplied milk, fruits, cereals, eggs, cheeses that we could cook if we wanted to using her substantial gas stove. restaurants and coffee shops also near. convenient to ft. hamilton station for us. our family lives nearby. good deal.
i was busy with my trip, however very nice and accommodating hosts.
will definitely stay again
good stay in a good location.

josefina is a warm and engaging person. she's very eager to ensure guests enjoy their stay. she went the extra mile to help us. her advice about transportation was extremely useful. and the bed was great!
fourth is a great host. very responsive and attentive. all the the while being non intrusive, giving us privacy .
jules was very accommodating. centrally located for queens and brooklyn
great place with a great host. would come back.
everything was good it looked just liked the pictures i loved my stay .

i had a fantastic stay in this room ! the space was impeccably clean and well-maintained. one of the highlights was how wonderful everything smelled, especially the bed sheets. it was a pleasant environment. i highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a room.

great location in brooklyn with metro nearby to reach manhattan in less than 15min. check in was easy. however the apartment is quite messy in the common areas with lots of boxes and slightly dusty especially in the bathroom. martin let you leave your life and is discret. but he is also quite strict with rules in his house which can make you feel uncomfortable.

had to find an airbnb last minute, and james was a great host. he made sure we checked in smoothly and followed up to see if we needed anything during our stay. the place was clean, comfortable, and even stocked with hygiene supplies, which was a nice touch. really appreciate the hospitality thanks again, james!
great place with large room and convenient travel to manhattan. will definitely come again.

sharon's place was perfect for our trip. the place is very spacious with separate work area, well maintained, clean and exactly as pictured. it has very good quality bedding. just a home away from home. the apartment is at a very convenient location. subway station is only few minutes walk. we can reach manhattan or other brooklyn area very easily. sharon, thank you very much for your help during our stay. you and your family are great hosts. we will definitely stay here again!

it's a death trap. excessive lineups to get on an elevator just to get to the lobby. one of the elevator's was broke and if there was a fire or emergency, i could not imagine the panic and congestion getting out of the building from the floor the lobby is on. the button on the floor we were on was broke every day. had to go up before we could go down. the carpets in the hall were gross. the mold in our bathroom was appalling. i would not let a child into the shower with the mold growing. the wall paper in the bathroom was peeling off the walls. they say a billionaire has a new brand, well there was nothing new about the place. sorry, other than the location it was a very disappointing destination stay. we had to leave a day early for a family emergency, no compassion and no refund for last day of the stay. we have never experienced this in the years we have been with airbnb. sorry.. 2 thumbs down for the condition of the hotel. staff were nice, the bartender was great. do not say here
kerri was a great host. very clean place and let me check in early so i could get some extra rest before i had to work for my trip.
a very nice accommodation, close to the city center, the metro, the central park! everything was perfect!
great value for the price, you will enjoy your stay.
loved my stay on the island. super peaceful out there and the room was amazing. the hosts were great and extremely helpful. would stay there again in a heartbeat!

ken and his family were very kind and helpful to us. their house is nice and cozy, located in a quiet neighborhood. the attic room is full of natural light and well-equipped. easy access to downtown brooklyn and manhattan. highly recommended!
the neighborhood was awesome, close to amenities and the subway. fourth was a wonderful host.
we had a great stay at oyo’s! the location was great! super easy to walk around and be right in the heart of new york city. would definitely visit again.

the room is small but was exactly all i needed for a good price. it is very close to the subways. it's in a good neighborhood. on top of that the entire apartment , in addition to my room, was absolutely spotlessly clean. stayed a week and i'll consider this place again when i come back.

chester is an excellent host. the communication is great, helpful and very straightforward. his location is near subway so if you use public transportation that will be an advantage. will book again if i travel to nyc next time.
great place to stay and will be staying again next time.

kumar is a very responsive host. his place was nice clean and quaint. he had everything we needed to make ourselves at home while we run and play in the city. very convenient to train stations and restaurants. would highly recommend this place. only concern is the locks on the doors, they are a little hard to use, nothing a quick fix can't do. nonetheless would love to use kumar's place for future visits. thanks again!
great staying at inna place again ! i’d def stay here again

if i could give this place 7 stars i would. i stayed for over two months and wished i could've moved in permanently! the apartment is fantastic - very cozy, bright and spacious, very clean and comfortable. and that king-size bed tho! the whole place has such good welcoming energy. keishera was just the world's greatest host. excellent fast communication throughout the entire time. she struck the right balance between attentiveness and autonomy. the neighborhood is so awesome. safe, quiet and friendly with lots of nice little restaurants, bakeries, grocery stores - including several organic markets. there were several cool bars and pubs close by too, not to mention 2 yoga studios within walking distance. within 10 min you're close to the a,c,e on one side and the 2,3,4,6 on the other. such a perfect wonderful stay. highly recommended!
great place to stay in nyc, sparkling clean, good amenities and amazing location!
angelika's place was perfect for our trip to brooklyn. space was large, clean, and bright. we will definitely stay here again!

lovely comfortable apartment. spacious enough for three couples (which is unusual for new york!) subway stations close by. only fifteen to twenty minutes walk to the shops and restaurants in the bedford avenue area. we look forward to staying again.

geoffrey’s place was just as described. check in was a breeze, the place is spacious, comfortable and most importantly clean. it was exactly what we needed and we had everything we needed through our stay. our nights were restful and we felt safe throughout our stay. anytime we return to brooklyn we would love to stay at geoffrey’s place again
john’s place was very cozy and made us feel right at home. the apartment is very cute and clean. park slope brooklyn area fit these angelenos just fine! thank you for your hospitality sir!

great place to stay, especially if you’re looking for something homey. denise is so caring, she did her best to make my stay enjoyable but she also gave me a lot space. this was my first time using airbnb and i’m glad i stayed with her
definitely it is going to be my place to stay for my coming nyc trips.

winston was very friendly, responsive and accommodating. i felt right at home and loved the fact that i could cook and bring back groceries. the bedroom was very cozy and everything i needed was right at my fingertips.
loved the atmosphere! really warm and cozy home. mercedes and her family were very nice, shared some very nice and fun things i could do around the city, would definitely stay here again!

i really enjoyed my stay here. the room was clean, cozy and the privacy provided for me was a huge plus. this room has its own private full bathroom and shower. an absolute plus! the location was quite convenient. only a 15 min walk from central park, i walked this distance several times during my week-long stay. sometimes i'd get back late at night and felt pretty safe. there are several coffee shops, restaurants and convenient stores, many open late, all within a 5 min walking distance. there is also a fancy shopping center only 20 mins away, a place that looks busy with people all evening. lola is very kind and friendly. she's also very accommodating; she made extra arrangements on checkin day so that i could get settled with ease (even though i ended up checking in much later than arranged) and she also made extra arrangements on my checkout day so that i wouldn't have to carry my heavy luggage around the city until my final departure in the evening. and finally, lola was very responsive. she responded to all my texts and queries immediately and never left me hanging.
min was a great host - place was perfect for the price.

the space is perfect for a short stay, close enough to the subway (~0.5 miles) and lots of food spots and stores. the space is a bit small but it has everything you need and the host was kind enough to leave some water and snacks out. its the little things i would stay here again and i would recommend to others.

noémie & nick's apartment was the perfect place for family from out of town to stay for the weekend. they were quick to communicate and provided lots of helpful information about the apartment and neighborhood. the apartment was well situated and has incredible views of the city - a great gem in the neighborhood.
was awesome stay (: high recommend
this is the best airbnb i have ever stayed.
amazing location, great wifi, and convenient amenities in stock for the apartment!
great place and great neighborhood!

this is expensive for what it is; a small room and bathroom with no windows. the space was sparkling clean but i did get bitten by some kind of bug while i slept. could be the unusually warm weather in november. it’s not a quiet place the walls are thin and other guests are cramped making them fairly loud. the kitchenette is very well painted but no coffee or tea is provided and it’s not available in the lobby vending machines. that’s not fair. the location is great for proximity but it’s not especially high tone. i’m a new yorker so i felt perfectly safe but it’s a pretty scruffy area. i wouldn’t teeter around on high heels and a short skirt on that street after dark.

we stayed for a month. the apartment is well located close to lots of restaurants, bars and walking distance to the park, 5th ave, times square etc. whilst a studio it’s well laid out and doesn’t feel cramped. looks exactly like the pictures. nicely furnished and well equipped. the terrace is huge and has a nice seating area to relax on. the team were very responsive on messages and always friendly. thank you for a great stay.
the place is exactly as advertised. quiet, clean, and very cute!
our stay was great. the apartment was as described and very clean. it was easy to get to and close to good transport links. we have a great time.
another great stay at nia's place.

anna's listing was everything i was looking for: a clean simple room for one with natural light, a full modern bathroom and kitchen, an apt close to nature (prospect park), park slope and the q train, and an all around atmosphere of serenity during a busy trip. the most important part of all was anna herself, and her pup phoenix. apart from being thoroughly responsive, she genuinely wants others to experience her home and the neighborhood, and to make a personal connection with and learn about her guests if possible. a true hosting experience, not just a nameless hotel room.

that's an amazing apartment. it's very clean and modern and we had everything we needed. the apartment has a very good location . everything is very close: beach, subway, restaurants. you can even try different food at the restaurants ! moreover it takes you 30 minutes to get to the centre of the city! it's very convenient to stay with children, as it's a quiet place! hosters are very hospitable and always ready to help.
easy access to transit, large enough space with private clean bathroom
perfect spot for a fantastic weekend with friends!

ben was an amazing host - super responsive and helpful. we thoroughly enjoyed his place in brooklyn. it is the perfect location to explore williamsburg. we especially enjoyed the nearby cheese shop and grocery. the apartment itself is lovely and spacious. it is nicely appointed, clean, and without clutter. the patio is spacious and private. we loved our stay and would go back anytime. thank you, ben, for having us!
great stay, very helpful

this place was perfect for a weekend getaway to the city. while we didn’t do much in harlem itself there was a subway station a block away that took us all over. the apartment was clean and full of amenities (full size kitchen, pots/pans, dishwasher, and my personal favorite a washer/dryer) that definitely would have benefited us if we stayed longer than a weekend. the host was beyond helpful and polite. i knew that if anything were to go wrong she would be there to help in a heartbeat. i will definitely be booking again!

great space. everything needed is inside. clean, private. a little bit noisy, because of people living above. they seem to fight the world war ii with their banging, yelling, stomping, running. but the whole noise stops at a convenient hour, so no disturbance during the night. apart from this. i recommend denise’s space to everyone. thank you

that's serious competition there:)! karen helped me host stranded french tourists and they landed in ...heaven! she welcomed them with warm cookies and goodies, a lovely smile and a superb place. i have to keep up with my place to be on karen's level:), definitely a place i would send my guests without any hesitation. don't get turned off by the location, it's a wonderful part of manhattan ..yes it's part of manhattan. you will get a wake-up call from the birds instead of the car horns of midtown, and the express train on 145th street will take you midtown in 15 minutes. it's a keeper in my phone book! thanks again karen
the most helpful host! the area was perfect and i’d for sure go back in a heartbeat! transportation and eateries were always walkable and nearby ! if you’re looking - book here!
geralde was very kind and was extremely responsive to our needs. she was an excellent host and her home-away-from-home was perfect. thanks so much for your hospitality!

these hosts have it figured out! i had an absolutely lovely stay here on a safe and very quiet street in harlem, only ½ block from the train that goes directly into midtown and lower manhattan. these hosts are by far some of the best prepared for guests that i've experienced. the place was spotlessly cleaned and unbelievably well equipped, right down to the pots and pans, silverware, dishes, glasses, feather comforters, and even laundry detergent and dryer sheets. nighttime was dead silent, the bed was firm like i like it, and the heat and hot water were more than generous. their communication went above and beyond, which really made me feel welcome. the next time i’m in nyc i’ll check their availability before any other.
one of the best part of my trip was mrs wilda listing. made me feel like home, we did not missed anything. all the family enjoyed.

this hotel was great! our room was not facing 8th ave so it was quiet, could only hear the occasional honking and some airplane traffic overhead. the room was perfect for what we needed, though small, it was a great little pad to reset and sleep. the hosts were very responsive and the hotel staff was friendly and easy to work with. the beds were also comfortable and the ac worked great. you are just a few blocks from times square so there is lots to do and very walkable to central park and other fun activities! i highly recommend staying and would absolutely stay again.

i had an awesome time at this airbnb! the place was super clean and cozy, even better than i expected. the host was incredibly friendly and hooked me up with everything i needed. the location was perfect too, walkable distance to beach, easy to get around and explore. overall, it was an amazing experience and i totally recommend this airbnb for anyone looking to have a great time!
very clean. we really liked the location.

terrific location at le meridien hotel, you have a $45/ day room charge but $25/day can be credited at their restaurant or rooftop bar which are both excellent and we highly recommend both. service is warm and friendly, very lively attentive staff. room has everything you need with a lovely bathroom and tasteful decorations. 2 short blocks to central park, russian tea room is 1 block away, it was perfect for a fun nyc weekend for us!

excellent location, lovely street, super convenient to the subway and easy walking distance to anything important. very comfortable and safe neighborhood even with young kids. host was very responsive and helpful when we had questions/problems. there aren't enough linens or dishes for 10 people. there is much "differed maintenance" on the the property... filthy carpets, windows difficult to operate, leaking airvents during the rainstorm. we even got locked in when the keycode entry failed one evening and we had to wait for a locksmith to let us out. generally, it wasn't the "clean and fresh" hotel experience, but the location and price for a large group made it absolutely worth it.
very affordable and sizable space, walking distance of several subways. commutes to times square and manhattan run about an hour however very worth it in terms of cost. would reccomend!!
clean and perfect location!

carlos and yvette were awesome hosts - they made us feel at home the entire time plus the helpful recommendations. we stayed during the winter holidays so it was nice that all the trains, subway stations are all walkable from their listing - even the free bus station to laguardia. their home was cozy and well maintained. neighborhood was safe and no incident while we were staying. would love to book their home again when we will go back to ny.

i had a wonderful stay at daniel's apartment😊lam a woman, alone, and this is my first time in new york and i am very glad that i chose daniel's apartment. it was very reassuring to know that security cameras were installed on the stairs of his apartment. the room was very clean and i was able to sleep peacefully. i was also pleased that the apartment was very quiet. the apartments are very close to the train station and the neighborhood has never felt scary. the room is very warm and inviting as you can see in the pictures! daniel also respected my privacy, which was very helpful to me. i was also reassured that his staff lived within the apartment. when the battery in the front door of my room needed to be replaced, the staff contacted daniel immediately, and the staff, daniel, and daniel's father were very helpful! he and his father are so cheerful, kind, and truly wonderful that i am sure they will make many guests happy during their stay!
calm place to come to when you want to get away from home not to far from the boardwalk
nice stay in a well located appartment. exactly as announced.

i don't really want to tell anyone else how great this place is because it will get too busy and won't be available to us when we come back. i would say the best thing was the location. literally right at the subway stop to get you anywhere. as a visitor and not wanting to drive anywhere near manhattan, this is the place to be. mimi and andres spoil you rotten with a spacious, clean home to crash after a long day of touring. the kitchen is great to prepare breakfast each day before heading out to explore. andres and mimi were always right there to help and suggest local eateries. we really felt at home and even part of the family. thank you so much for your warmth and hospitality. i really got the feeling it is more than just added income for you, it is as way to meet and help people as you would a friend or family. cheers. tim

i really liked suliman's warmth. he was always there to answer any of my concerns. it was a pleasure exchanging some conversations outside of the renting matters. i would have loved that he was available to keep me company while visiting some touristic areas. i enjoyed some of the scenery i could visit on my two-day solo trip. nonetheless, it would have much better to have a local to experience that with. overall, i hope i return there in the future. the only things i hated were the subways/trains. they made me miss my bus back to maryland.
small, cute, comfortable, relaxing place. loved sitting in the yard relaxing. definitely will book another stay sometime in the future.

i had a great stay. the place is very clean and looks modern. lively neighborhoods all around it, near two different metro lines (yellow and brown). the communication is professional. laundry room is clean. i would not hesitate to book here again. thanks a lot for the late check out!

i absolutely loved my stay at stephen’s apartment! it was fantastic across the board—beautiful space, extremely clean, fabulous location, and stephen was an exceptional host. he really went above and beyond to make my stay comfortable and to make the space so welcoming. i hope to have an opportunity to stay here again!
my favorite place to stay at when i’m in ny for work! location is very convenient, place is secure, cozy and safe. in addition a gaming lounge / gym great touch. always pleased!

the description is very accurate of the area and room. it has a very comfortable bed and i slept well. the building is very very old and it was a bit warm inside, but there was a window unit ac to cool it slightly. the cat was the best :)
great place—everything you could need plus more-very comfortable and petra and tony were fantastic!

this a lovely apartment. extremely well-equipped. lots of extra sheets and towels which meant i didn’t have to do as much laundry. lots of cleaning supplies and toilet paper which made my 3 week stay easier. on my first day, i had difficulty connecting to the internet and the owner responded immediately and came down and helped me connect. very friendly and helpful. there is noise associated with the nearby train and occasionally the owners kids running on the floor above but i was appreciative of being able to bring my small dog who occasionally barked so it was fine. overall, this place suited my needs well.

nice little apartment exactly as described in the description and in the pictures. short (5min) walk to subway that can access all manhattan and all sights in the city. cathy is great host and is very laid back. always on hand to assist in any way possible. very flexible and allowed us for a late check out which we really appreciated as we had a late flight. if you don't want to stay in the hustle and bustle of the city and don't mind sitting on the subway, then would definitely recommend!

very cozy and clean apartment with tile throughout in the basement of alex's house. the first step going down is a doozy, and parking is a bit of an issue unless you don't mind parking several blocks away, but other than that our stay was great.
we had a joyful time in a fine town house in a lovely neighborhood.

beautiful space! i felt like i was at home with all of the beautiful plants, great lighting, and birds chirping from the city trees! she had a plethora of coffee and teas which was so helpful for early mornings and relaxing nights :) reka was very flexible when my arrival time changed. checking in and out was a breeze! the shared bathroom was extra clean and i’m not even sure it was used at all by the other guest. comfortable bed! well lit bedroom and a lot of long mirrors. i was there for work and there is nothing worse than a lack of light for makeup and not being able to see your whole outfit lol. totally loved the neighborhood...go check out the amazing people and live music at the wayland down the street! i’ll be back.

karen was an outstanding host. quick response and very kind. her place was way better than i was expecting and much larger than most new york apartments. the house was very clean and stylish. completed renovated. she had a basket of snacks, lots of coffee and creamer, drinks in the fridge and lots of kitchenware to use. the neighborhood was very quiet and parking was easy to find. my family enjoyed the stay and look forward to booking this home again.
it was cool with little to offer.

jhohana was lovely. i had a great time at her place— a few helpful tips for those looking to stay: make sure to read the check-in booklet and communicate with johanna before planning your check-in ahead of time, as she will be handing over a physical set of keys (aka it’s not a remote check in). also, she has a friendly dog, and she will give you some space in the bathroom to put your toiletries. overall, it was a great place to stay and johanna was very friendly. i would love to stay longer if possible!

kareem’s place was amazing! great location, great set up, warm and cozy. more than enough room for 3-4 people if in your party. there were only is 2 and it was perfect! great communication, and allowed me to stay an extra hour due to scheduling. thank you!

i can't thank our wonderful hosts, mark and deanna enough taking such care of us above and beyond our expectation. firstly, the apartment is perfect - cosy, very well equipped, spotless home from home in a lovely part of brooklyn. just 2 mins from the subway for easy access into manhattan and surrounded by a wide choice of delicious delis, shops and restaurants, it's the perfect location to stay. communication with mark prior to arrival was excellent and we received a warm, personal welcome. however, the care didn't end there. an unfortunate trip resulted in a visit to the emergency room and mark and deanna couldn't do enough to help. this was so reassuring when so far from home! we can't wait to return to complete our new york adventure and have already shared their listing with all our friends. we can't recommend mark and deanna enough: thank -you both.
best view of the manhattan skyline while taking a shower. meghan is great.

we had a great time staying at julio’s he was very nice snd very responsive always making sure we were ok and if we needed anything to contact the location was perfect right there an on 3rd ave 149th st train station was walking distance and a lot of stores for shopping i will be booking her again thank you so much for your hospitality and continued blessings on your journey
had a great time at elliot’s!

i liked my stay at leroy's apartment. he responded always fast. he is a nice person. he provided very good detailed instructions how to get to an apartment. the location is very close to the subway that take you to manhattan in 20-25 mins.

sheila is a nice, caring host but unfortunately the room is a little messy. we had to climb over the sofa to get to the bathroom and also our room and the bathroom were not cleaned. one night there were indeed sounds of her (or someone else)running up in the room above us but it was only for a short time and i can't agree with people complaining about this. the room and bathroom are beautifully designed and also the kitchen is full of odd and fascinating things. she also left us 2 beers in the fridge and you can get breakfast there. the air mattress beds are really amazing and all in all we can say we got a good sleep there!

jon’s place is fantastic in every sense, the location is amazing and in the best neighbourhood. i couldn’t believe how quiet it was for such a busy and noisy city! it was so comfortable and was the perfect place to unwind after a crazy day of walking everywhere! jon was great and left plenty of tips on restaurants, etc which we found very helpful. i couldn’t recommend jon’s place enough!!
wonderful stay! close to metro. great host, clean place. free morning coffee is awesome. would stay again.

we had a really good time staying at andres and natalia’s place while visiting nyc! the apartment is super clean and tidy and the hosts are extremely nice and helpful. of course you have to take the subway to get to the city but the apartment is located to easily reach two different metro stations (seneca ave or myrtle ave) from where you can go to different spots in the city in a reasonable time. it can be a bit loud at night, so if you are a light sleeper, bring earplugs - with those you will sleep well even if there are e.g. sirens outside. all in all, we can only recommend staying with andres and natalia whilst in nyc. it will be enjoyable 😊
we loved staying here! an easy walk to the subway, very clean, and felt private & safe. would stay here again!
lovely place! definitely would stay here again!

it was such an amazing experience staying at jesse‘s place. everything is so tidy and the trains did not disturb too much. we didn’t hear them at nights. we were also lucky to meet jesse personally. he is an absolutely awesome host with a lot of suggestions for every question and he is very kind and fun to talk to. the district is a great area to have a good time. bars and restaurants as well as supermarkets and metro are in walking distance so nothing was missing. check out apollo theater and red roosters too. thank you so much jesse!!!

jonathen and daphne were outstanding hosts—the best that any of us in my party have experienced. the listing exceeded our expectations and provided us with a comfortable stay. jonathen and daphne went out of their way to make sure that everything was in perfect condition and made themselves readily available to help us. the beds were beyond comfortable. honestly, cannot complain about one thing. if i’m ever in ny again, i’ll definitely try to stay here! thanks again jonathen and daphne!
i am satisfied with this stay.
we had a great stay here! the host was very friendly and accommodating and we were only a few minute walk away from the metro.
responsive and proactive host. clear communication and value for money place.

great value, given the location and proximity. clear instructions to check in and room was small but good enough considering we weren’t in the room for most part of the day. tiny building so you’ll have a bit of a workout carrying luggage especially if you’re on one of the higher floors. overall good and i’d come back again.

i loved the location of eli’s place, only a 3 min walk to the nearest metro station (dekalb st) and the supermarket is literally a stones throw away. i loved bushwick area, it is colourful, edgy and a vibrant part of brooklyn, i always felt safe coming home in the evenings. a very comfortable bed in a lovely light filled room and it was a bonus to have a fridge in the room. tidy clean bathroom that is shared with other guests if they are there at the same time. occasionally street noise at night so if you are a light sleeper you may need ear plugs. construction noise usually starts up around 8am in the mornings. be sure to read house rules especially timings for kitchen use. eli is an excellent communicator and was always there to help when needed. it usually took me around 35-45mins to travel to most parts of manhattan each day and i really enjoyed coming back home’ at the end of the day. thanks eli for all of your help (and for the coffee mug :)

in reality vadim's place is even more spacious than in the photos with private entrance + bathroom + living room & kitchen. nice + quiet neighborhood with plenty of street parking options. super clean. ~ 20 mins walk fm the staten island ferry. vadim is a great attentive host with one of the most amazing occupations (and stories about it) :) will definitely try to stay here again when in nyc !
vito was a clear communicator, personable, and his apartment was clean and in a great location. we would stay here again!
we enjoyed staying here, it’s close to manhattan by ferry and very convenient. value for the price is great
beautiful place. just as pictured. the host was very respectful of our privacy. i would definitely book again.
he was extremely helpful and accommodated all my requests. the unit is very cute and compact but still very cozy. 10/10 recommend any couple or solo traveler to stay here

very easy communication with anastasiya. of course there are a few dog hairs in the apartment, but overall they didn‘t bother us and nabu himself didn't cause any „problems“ anyway. such a cute dog! the room is a bit tiny, which is perfect for one person. we were in two and knew that the room is basically for one person. so, if you‘re in nyc for exploring the city and are not spending much time in the room, it is a perfect place to stay. public transport very close. anastasiya even was fine with us leaving the luggage there for a late checkout. would recommend!

the neighborhood was peaceful and we had no issues with the surroundings. we did find the stairs a bit challenging due to our age and heavy luggage. the restroom on the 3rd floor was very nice, though the 2nd floor one could use some improvement. the brick-style walls are as pictured, though they didn’t quite suit our personal preference. overall, a decent stay with room for small enhancements.

i had a wonderful stay at this brooklyn apartment. it was just an 8 minute walk to the utica ave subway station and there were nice restaurants nearby. the hosts were very communicative about check-in/check-out process, responded quickly, and were very kind as well. i would absolutely stay again and definitely recommend!

aldi was awesome. she was incredibly sweet and accommodated my stay on a last minute request, which was incredibly helpful. the place was better than advertised and she was respective of privacy and extremely kind.

jewel is a great host. she is communicative and helpful. she is thoughtful as well, that she provides many things we need, such as earplugs, international electric plug/ socket, wipes, etc. she is very responsive… when i contacted her at 2 am, she replied me immediately. the house is just like in the photos. what i like the most from it are the cleanliness of bedroom, bathroom, and kitchen; and it’s very close to subway and prospect park. overall, i am happy that i chose this house and thank you so much, jewel, for your excellent hospitality.

space just as described, clean and very functional. we each had a separate bedroom and large tv which was very nice and gave everyone space to wind down at the end of the day. i had neglected to read that it wasn't perfect for small children as there are a few stairs but we made it work with a two year old however, nobert is correct it is not ideal for smaller children. we were able to walk to every site we had planned to visit and never had to move the car. nice to have a safe place to park. thank you
nice little place for sleeping. it doesn't have much of a living room. but great air condition. not the usual window units you see in nyc. close to subway.
safe and easy to find. good communicatiin. bathroom is stocked.
great quiet, neighborhood. i love walking the streets of brooklyn, and the easy access to the promenade can’t be beat! lots of good food options nearby, very convenient to subway too.
nice clean place, quick response

amazing place and would definitely stay again. i'm quite sad i only booked a few days for this stay. i wish i stayed a month here at least! located a few minutes away from the subway station (111th st) and you can't even hear the noise of the subway at all. it's also located within walking distance to the forest park! location and the cleanliness was amazing. anna was also a super friendly host and i greatly appreciate her hospitality during my stay. i was super worried about the wifi since i had to work and the wifi held up well and was very fast. thank you again for everything!
great place

bobby’s place was great! very clean and all the amenities we needed. it was a central location for a short uber ride to brooklyn and other parts of the city. bobby was great with communication and quick with responses. would definitely stay again!

the apartment is beautiful - utterly clean, extremely comfortable, and wonderfully located. while i didn't get a chance to meet jon, he was terrifically generous in terms of check-in and check-out times, left helpful suggestions as to the neighborhood, and a lots of yummies in the refrigerator. i recommend jon and his apartment most highly.

we were warmly welcomed by olivia, who responded directly when we had questions. the apartment was spotless and well equipped with everything we needed. the appartment is within walking distance of the metro, it takes about 40 minutes to get to manhattan. we slept very well, no noise at all.

perfect!… allegra’s place was wonderful… close to public transportation, just as described in the pictures, snacks and even a bottle of wine!!..it’s a perfect space for couples… we truly enjoyed the the space!
would definitely stay again. super central location. could walk everywhere or hop on the metro
this is a great place 6mins from jfk airport so good if you need a place if overnighting between flights. you share the space with other guests.

very comfortable, cozy room. clean and comfortable apartment, wonderful kitchen, wonderful neighbors. all is fine. very-very glad i stayed there, beautiful district near the river and washington-bridge, 1 minute to subway. thank you, helen, very much for opportunity to stay in your room :)
tong's place was fantastic! the closeness to the train and buses, restaraunts and supermarkets. will definitely return. thanks tong!!
brandon was a great host, friendly and made sure i knew everything needed about the rental unit. spot was very clean as well.
this was a great place to stay! great location & so helpful to anything we needed. always communicated very promptly. would definitely stay here again – and recommend it!!

clear instructions from host, great location & access to restaurants/central park/subway. heat is not controlled by unit and was therefore exceptionally overpowered. even with window wide open (in the low 40s at night) + a fan, it was very hot in the room and uncomfortable to sleep. because of that, i probably wouldn't stay again but everything else was great.
good location.
we had a wonderful stay. the condo was beautiful, very clean and had everything that we needed.

this is a very nice studio in a residential area with a 10-minute brisk walk to the subway along 49th street - manhattan in about 20 minutes. astoria itself has good restaurants, coffee shops, places for a drink, etc. peter is a great host, always available, although everything i needed was there so there wasn't much i had to ask for. the place is comfortable, cozy and very clean. it is as seen in the pictures and the windows let in lots of light. thank you peter (and alba) for making me feel so comfortable. it was a pleasure to meet you.

our group of 6 friends from across the country had the best time at this bnb. spacious enough that everyone had the option of privaxy when needed, warm and welcome enough to share a lot of meals and memories in the main spaces. we intend to return! thanks, chris & maya. we hope to see you again, soon.
we had a great time! it’s brooklyn a perfect blend of cultures! it’s a vibe.
good price for the location, the walls are a little thin but it did its job and the description was very accurate!

a really nice, airy two bedroom in a great location with many great bars and restaurants within walking distance. kian is quick to respond and flexible to your needs. if you're an out of towner, i would keep in mind that the location doesn't have the best access to the train in terms of getting around brooklyn. but i would definitely recommend this spot to others, and would be happy to stay again!
great location, good for family of 3.

gus and his wife are really nice and welcoming. the apartment is huge, clean and equipped with everything. very well located in williamsburg and connected to manhattan...i guess it's the perfect stay!!
great location amazing hospitality

we stood here due to its proximity to memorial sloan kettering. it was peaceful once inside and an easy walk to our appointments. like having a little sanctuary in nyc. lots of good food nearby as well.
misbau place is very clean and very nice kitchen everything is organised, nice bedroom,bathroom and kitchen. misbau is very accommodating, kind and very responsive, great value for money.
great host and a great place!
great location, nice neighborhood. rented for two months and very pleased with everything.

do not hesitate to book this apartment for your trip to nyc! it’s cute, spacious and clean. the location is great too. the host, michael, was very quick to respond! check in was as easy as it can get. highly recommended.
great unit with an amazing view! khizer was a great host too.
we just love this apartment--it is clean, perfectly set up, and in the ideal location. thrilled to have stayed a second time. micah and tony are communicative and everything was smooth and easy.
amazing stay, definitely recommend.
lovely apartment fairly close to a metro stop. cute cafes and restaurants within walking distance. diavanna was very helpful and quick to respond when i had questions.
miriam and mimi are both lovely and warm! and very kind and supportive with my situation. i recommend this home highly:)
great location! room was clean. breakfast line can be long at peak time but that was expected. staff was courteous. overall good value. would come back!
great place looks exactly like the pictures
very nice stay with friendly hosts. the room is bright and clean. it is close to the subway which takes you to manhattan in 20mins.

andrew and his wife made us feel very welcome in brooklyn, offered a lot of tips for both the area and nyc, made time to chat and even treated us to some birthday donuts! the room and the flat were very clean and tidy at all times and every guest had assigned space to put their things in bathroom, kitchen and fridge which was very helpful and convenient. andrew was super quick to reply to all messages and always made sure to check we were okay. the room doesn’t have windows but is still airy and very quiet since it’s kind of at the heart of the house. the place has a little supermarket near by which came in handy and the subway is literally in front of the door. would love to come again!

perfect location and most kind and generous hosts - they even insisted for me to take food the day i left (because ny is expensive!!). you need to know that the room is as small as it looks and you may hear noise if other guests don't respect the rules, but the staff is very careful in intervening. this is a good place to stay if you spend your entire day outside.

the most kind, genuine & caring host i've ever met in life. i would give it 6/5 stars if i could. very clean washroom. private room with fan. comfortable bed. dunkin donuts is right across the building. very accessible. my flight was delayed and she stayed up till 1 am to open the door for me. god bless them. worth every penny.

my stay in harlem was wonderful! the photos and description of the apartment matched exactly with what i found on arrival. the location was great as it was quite easy to walk around the area to restaurants and public transportation. m. elizabeth was very communicative and provide clear instructions for check-in and check-out. i would happily stay here again if i was coming to the harlem area.

i had a great stay, it took awhile for someone to arrive at the desk to check-in but i also booked fairly last minute. when i needed the hair dryer replaced they did this quickly and the room was very comfortable and the location is so convenient. would stay again :)
this wonderful place to stay for our out-of-town relatives - incredibly charming - and spacious! like a french country cottage in the middle of brooklyn. thanks again, we will be back!

the container home is a unique place to stay in a great neighbourhood. it is in the spirit of what airbnb was set up for. you feel like you are sharing a home and a lifestyle rather than being a tourist. highly recommend.

nice/safe location. we had the whole top floor and it was lovely. very clean and nicely decorated. had a kitchen area, own bathroom with a deep tub, and a separate room area for the closet. it felt very roomy and made you forget you were in the busy crowed area of brooklyn.

the apartement is great. my only suggestion is to bring snacks, water for late nite munchies since there are no many places open and close by. you will be away from the big city but you are in a quiet vecinity if you are to rest. there are to close stations and can take aprox 40 mins to hit the city. beds are super comfy. my only concern was that there is nothing to do around if you just want to walk around. but in general, it is a good place to stay.

great place to have ample space in new york and also one of the coolest/nicest brownstone houses in brooklyn. very easy to get around brooklyn too staying at the house. the amenities are great and really nice and makes you feel right at home. the owners are also amazing and very responsive to any needs you might have. definitely a gem in brooklyn and if you’re looking to get a real local feel and stay outside of manhattan this is the place to be!
this place was great. super good value for the location. surprisingly quiet for being right in the heart of the village. a+
good location and space for extended stay. be noted about annual multi-day street fair/road closure during the month of september.
amazing space, amazing people around
great host, very clean house and responsive
great location, very welcoming hosts, clean bathroom.
great place in ny

my family of five, including three young kids, stayed here very comfortably. babajide was very helpful and welcoming. the location is wonderful right next to the subway and close to prospect park. thanks very much!
very good person, he helped me from first time to arrive and stayed in contact until the last day. very good person!

allison was a gracious and welcoming host! i felt right at home, and she went out of her way to make sure i was always comfortable and had anything i could need. i was at allison’s for three weeks, and i felt like i was staying with a close friend the whole time.
nice place to stay at and clean

my boyfriend and i stayed with brian for a night in order to catch a couple of broadway shows on my days off. brian was more than accommodating with or flexible check in and check out times, and we are so grateful to him for that! so much better than a hotel. brian's place was comfortable and clean and beautifully decorated. i definitely recommend staying with him!
very impressive communication! we really appreciate that!
short but sweet stay with seth. he was very helpful and communicative and kindly carried my bag up the stairs as well. the room was comfortable and furnished well.

we had a great stay. the place was very clean and the room spacious. omri gave us good recommendations and was quick to help us when we had issues. the location is great super close to a subway stop, perfect for going to manhattan. it’s also very close to a supermarket and convenience stores. the only thing to know is that the keys have an airtag, so the owner doesn’t lose them!
ryan was awesome. responsive, easy to work with. 10/10, i'd stay with him again
rudy’s stay was nice and clean! also smelled amazing. love the complimentary snacks and cute little card. felt welcome, had a great stay !

stephen’s place is in a great spot walking distance from the metro and is peaceful but very close to cafes and restaurants. it was easy to get to manhattan via the metro and also take my meetings online at home as i had total privacy. there are also many little details he’s set up for the guests such as a cool lp game as well as little notes to explore the local places. most importantly his place is always super clean! thanks again for hosting me!
the place was clean. great location
it was great.

comfortable, clean, and so easy. i attended a course at the brooklyn botanical gardens and this location could not have been more ideal. the room was spacious, great natural light, and the host makes you instantly relaxed. i would absolutely stay here again.

mark & tracy are exceptional hosts. the flat is well located and well equipped. the climate control works well. the kitchen facilities are good and there is a lot of sapce (400 sq feet doesn't sound like a lot but we didn't feel like it was small at all with a comfy bed and a large sofa and desk etc. the space feels roomy, and the daylight issue was as described (they under promise and over deliver) - though the ceiling lights are so bright that it didn't affect us even when we needed to get some work done. the location near the university, & facilities made it perfect for our 7 day stay and with hindsight we wish we had booked a little longer as we still had some more business to attend to in nyc. our hosts kindly went above & beyond. we probably would like to book this flat again if it's available for when we return to nyc in the coming months.
friendly people, safe place, good service , i will be back next year!
very clean and comfortable. convenient to the bronx
someone was snoring really loudly every night

nina‘s place was great, and just what i needed. close to my daughter, clean, comfy bed, air filters in room, fairly quiet neighborhood, great decor and artwork, fabulous shower in bathroom. building is new and all fixtures, heating/cooling, etc. worked well. jaime and nina were great hosts. they were around a lot, which was nice when we had questions. helpful with recommendations and a few things i forgot (charge cube and umbrella:) very hospitable and made us feel right at home. love the cats, too.
this is simply the most magical place in nyc. location perfect!

we've been 3 months at luis place and it's been amazing! the apartment was perfect for us. it has a lot of space for new york apartments and the garden is beautiful to sit outside or have a decent bbq. luis also provided us with all of the information we needed for the stay and was responsive if we needed something. the area is peaceful and its an 8 minute walk to the next l train station where you can go directly to manhattan from. supermarket and mexican street food are also around the corner. it was the perfect stay for us!!
great spot in east village! jeremy is super reactive and communicative!!
this place is great if you are focused on getting from point a to b. it’s very affordable and easy to access the train and the host is also very friendly.
great room, very comfortable and quiet, extremely friendly and helpful host
the hosts were very welcoming and the complimentary breakfast was substantial. the rooms are small but fine given the price.
excellent place, excellent host.

it's hard to find an affordable place in ny for a group of people or large family to stay but this house solves that and was perfect for us. the main level is on the second story with the rooms on the third. the main level is plenty big enough for your family to hang out, make plans, eat or whatever you have going on. i think it was four blocks to the subway and you can take that train all the way to oculus or the 9/11 memorial without having to change trains. it's in a regular neighborhood so there are markets to shop at if you want to make your own food and other places to eat as well.
we had the best time in nyc! the studio was very clean, well equipped and a few minutes walk from the tube station. miao is a great host, highly recommended.
had a wonderful stay at rockaway beach! the accommodation was perfect for a weekend away - very cute beach decor and a gorgeous apartment. host is super friendly!
hghly recommend craig !!!! beautiful loft but also the absolute perfect location for everything!!!!!!! coming back forsure craig !!!

an amazing room! really spacious, well maintained and clean. the ensuite is also likewise. has all the amenities for staying either single, as a couple or with family. conveniently located near to the subway stops, buses, shops, restaurants, laundromat etc. and just 20 mins. from manhattan. the kitchen if also well equipped. and the room does has extra secure doors and well safe guarded. i was visiting nyc for the first time as a tourist, on work and for personal reasons and as a first time user of this service, i was really impressed and would highly recommend anthony's place where i stayed for 10 days and would definitely stay when i visit again. anthony was a gem of a person and a great host who made all the arrangements to make my stay really comfortable and also assist me when i needed help. in short - does more than it says on the tin! :o)

walking into the magnolia house feels like walking into a whimsical world filled with items from everywhere you'd want to travel. our hosts, danforth & darwin, are two of the most interesting and kind people we have ever had the pleasure to meet. if we could have made our stay longer just to hear their stories and spend more time with them then we would have. stories of old hollywood and foreign lands kept us captivated and made it difficult to want to explore outside of the home. they were both hospitable and gracious- you will not find a host that will go as far as they do to make you feel at home. they insist on making you breakfast and i encourage you to take the time to join them and be carried into their intriguing lives.
i have no complaints it was all good

if i could give more stars i would! marianny is a wonderful and attentive host, each day of our stay she would check in with us to make sure everything was going well and ask if we needed anything. kacey(manager) was also very helpful! the neighborhood itself was a little sketch at first but the neighbors were nice and the block was quiet. the apartment was beautiful, better than expected! marianny left a guidebook as well as offered her own suggestions for things to do in the area and her favorite places to eat. overall it was a great stay and i will definitely be back!
justina’s place is great. she is very accommodating. the apartment is near the subway and also in a cool neighborhood.
just awesome!
sharon's place is great and she was so hospitable. easy travel to manhattan. highly recommend
wonderful stay at todd and sam’s place. they are friendly and helpful hosts and the place had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. highly recommend!
great place to stay if you’re looking to do a weekend in nyc on a budget!
lovely stay. quiet, clean, and a very comfortable bed. the house also happens to smell delicious (a unique benefit to having a host who works in food media).

i had a great stay with laurence, the room feels tucked away and private while still being quite spacious and open. the location is perfect for visiting prospect park, taking the train around brooklyn / manhattan, and is a short walk from some amazing food spots. would highly recommend staying here, even if just for a few nights! laurence is very accommodating and thoughtful of everything a guest might need. thanks again!

we had an incredible stay at this airbnb in manhattan. the apartment was far more spacious and well-appointed than the photos suggested, which was a pleasant surprise. everything was clean and comfortable, perfect for our trip. one important note, the address provided for the building was slightly off. the actual location is right next to 10th avenue pizza and cafe, which turned out to be a hidden gem. we highly recommend stopping by for a bite. overall, this airbnb exceeded our expectations, and we would happily stay here again. just double-check the location details before arriving!

this is an outstanding airbnb, and one i would definitely stay at again. let me start first with the negatives, since there are so few: -the stairs down to the apartment are a bit steep, and there’s no handrail. make sure to watch your step! -the apartment isn’t insulated, so it got a bit chilly at night. i enjoy the cold, so it didn’t bother me, but keep it in mind if booking during the winter. there are ample blankets available, however. and that’s it! the hosts are wonderful. they let me check in a bit early, were very attentive and responded quickly whenever i had a question, and otherwise provided me with privacy. the space is nice, very clean, and more spacious than it appears in the pictures. the kitchen area is small, but more than adequate unless you’re looking to do some serious cooking; likewise, the bathroom does the job. as someone who grew up in woodlawn, whenever i need to make a lengthy visit in the future, i’ll always check to see if this is available.

very cute little hotel, love the aesthetic of it.there was free refillable water and a complimentary snack of your choice. the place was very close to time’s square and the main manhattan areas. thank you!
best place first time at a airbnb but natalia made us feel like home great place and great ppl

my sister and i had a small reunion in nyc during spring break, and we decided to stay at hector's. we absolutely loved it! the place is really nice and clean, and there's pretty much everything you need and more. the kitchen is a huge plus because we were able to store our leftovers. there's also a ton of dishes and utensils in case you want to have breakfast before heading out and exploring the city. the apartment is in a very convenient location, the subway is super close, there's a lot of good food around, supermarkets, etc. hector was also really helpful and ready to give recommendations when my sister and i were out of ideas of where to eat or go next. he's super friendly! my sister and i loved it and we wouldn't hesitate staying here again!

if you’re looking for a place that’s affordable i recommend staying with digna. her place was nice and clean, only a 10 min walk to the station or a 2 min walk to bus stop and 3 stops to the station. the station takes u right downtown as well which makes it so much more convenient. the station also connects to jfk airport by air train so it’s perfect because it’s only 20 mins away. i will definitely be staying here again when i’m back in new york
thanks for the service it was great meeting u well c u again

this was one of the best locations i ever stayed. not only that the appartement is super clean, as described and close to metro and supermarket, richard makes you feel you know someone in nyc. he makes the stay super comfy and is always available and super flexible. we will be back!

the place is in a great location for subway use. its on the 5th floor and steps were somewhat small. not recommended for those will climbing issues. everything we need was well within walking distance. i would recommend highly if you are traveling in a group. host was very attentive and answered all our questions with patience amd kindness.
great host. a/c worked perfectly and beds were very comfortable. no problems whatsoever. would recommend
the place was nice and clean . easy walk to the subway j and not for from the l. 30 mins in to the city . 40-60 dollars uber felt safe walking back very late at night . also close to air port

great location in manhattan. it has easy access to the subway and a cab ride or uber up is not crazy expensive. it's a small and cozy space, perfect for travelers who don't plan on spending a lot of time in the room.
loved this place! and the view was so nice! everything was clean and everything was close! my boyfriend and i loved it!
perfect location, great apartment with art work and great communication with the host :)
extremely comfortable place to stay. safe street and a very resourceful market on the street. walking distance to grand central makes for easy subway travel. can’t wait to visit again.

the gregorian hotel was a convenient location, very close to macys and a short walk to the subway. the hotel was quiet & clean. the one thing i would have liked to see is that they’d list the extra taxes and fees in their description instead of waiting until you’ve already booked to let you know that there will be significant charges upon arriving/departing. for 3 nights, we paid an extra $280 on top of our airbnb fees that were already paid. the hotel also had a very odd smell in the main floor & lower level, which thankfully could not be smelled on the 10th floor.

we have a very great time by lived this lovely room during the trip to ny. the room is neat and clean, more importantly it's quite near to the subway so that could be much easier for travelers daily commute to downtown. top of that, paulo is good person as he is very handy and nice, he provided us shower towels, closet and even metro cards. i would highly recommend you come to his apartment!!!

i have given 5 star review before but this place is beyond 5 starts i have seen before . michael went above and beyond to accommodate us . this experience was perfect in every which way ! it couldn’t be better . we will be back and definitely recommend it to others !
it was a decent stay. just make sure to read the full listing and house rules.
this place was great!! the views are gorgeous!!

little bolt hole in uptown manhattan. this quaint little spot is in a very quite location but just 2 minutes walk from the subway to down town manhattan. we didn’t spend much time in hamilton heights but felt safe walking around at all hours of day or night. if you have an aversion to using the subway and wish to spend your days in downtown manhattan this might not be the place for you, but for me it was perfect and i would stay again.

we enjoyed our stay at this cozy brooklyn b&b. the was clean and had all the amenities necessary. we were even able to wash our clothes before checking out, which was a plus! good restaurants nearby and a 5 min walk to the subway. prospect park is also not too far away. we truly enjoyed our stay. i would recommend to anyone traveling to the area

this queens home is just as pictured. very tidy and well laid out. there was plenty of space for my family of 4. street parking was a breeze. it was nice having a tv in each bedroom; we also enjoyed playing pacman and galaga in the game room whenever we had downtime. i also appreciated that the host respected our privacy even though he lives next door. i would love to stay here again when visiting ny.

the space is in the heart of brooklyn among beautiful brownstones. parking can be very easily gotten right in front or on the same block if you look during the day. all the amenities were provided with loads of fresh towels and other toiletries. space was very clean and everything was as advertised. would definitely stay here again.
the room is amazing. maggie made us feel at home the moment we got there. the view was amazing and the bed was so comfy. i'll definitely be booking again.
thanks for preparing this elegant and beautiful bedroom for us to stay.

henri was an amazing host! he was very flexible and did everything to make our stay as easy and pleasant as possible. i highly recommend this stay if you want a great place to stay central to most things in manhattan!
really nice place to stay. loved the private entrance and the very clean space. cando's easy to communicate with and it's not very far from the jfk airport.
