mindia was an excellent host very very clean place as soon as you walk inside and everything was as described in listing , he was also very responsive and made getting inside very easy , i’f you’re looking for a nice couple get away this place is definitely recommended for sure !

tonderai was an excellent host. he checked on is frequently to see if we needed anything. the accommodations were lovely, the beds and pillows most comfortable. it was such a lovely place. close to the subway stop. he explained about the parking, which was so helpful!
great location. wonderful view. felt like home with all the amenities . loved the claw foot tub.

cora's place was amazing to stay at. neighborhood was quiet for being in the city didn't have any trouble checking in and finding the place. it is about a 30 min walk to the l train but you can take the bus which drops you off right in front of the station if you catch the bus on time. this is a room stay with a shared bathroom so it does come with its shortcomings but besides that if you are a single traveler its perfect for the price.

deidra was an amazing host from the moment i messaged her about renting the airbnb she was a great help with getting us to the right train on time and her house was absolutely stunning and in an amazing neighborhood!!
great place, clean, tidy & the outside area was just perfect. highly recommended. thanks vana

unfortunately we had a few inconveniences - the heat in our room broke 2 nights, we didn’t have toilet paper in the room on arrival, two lamps were burned out, and the safe was broken. maintenance did a great job fixing what could be done, but just a poor reflection on the rooms readiness upon arrival.
no complaints! very spacious and extremely clean. all amenities were good quality and like new. i would be happy to stay again.
very easy check in and good location

it’s a good location to travel into manhattan and it has a good shower and the bed is comfortable but overall for the price the place could do with a bit of a tidy up for example the electrical fittings are loose and there are stains and marks around the place
super hosts. great spot right next to george washington bridge and columbia medical. fifty feet from haven ave.

i really enjoyed staying at jason’s place, kinda felt sad leaving !! the room and rest of the house is very clean, there’s everything what you need and jason is an amazing host. we didn’t see each other much but we had nice talks and he’s very open to give help and suggestions. i felt at home and very welcomed! thank you jason, i hope to come back one day!!

this really is a wonderful place to stay. it’s so comfortable and pleasant and, also, jazmin is wonderful - and a very interesting person! she was helpful and accommodating with whatever i needed or had questions about. it was a restful place……good sleeping. i found the balcony overlooking the green space courtyard to be a big plus for when you’re staying in the city.

it was my first airbnb experience and i was a little scared, but when we arrived and they gave us the keys, i felt secured. negra is a very good host and always sends us messages asking if we need anything. she has a great communication. the apartment is the same as the photos. the neighborhood is quiet and the street is safe. 1 minute walk to subway and 15 subway to manhattan. they bought eggs, cereal, bread and milk for us. me and my girlfriend loved the stay and we recommend it. in our check out she gave us chocolate!
amazing place. very comfortable

our stay at lena’s was a fabulous experience. the apartment was amazing and so clean, had everything you needed on hand. lena was easy to contact and was always quick to respond. the area was easy to get around and close to the highline which was wonderful to walk most days. i would definitely recommend staying here to anyone.
we had a lovely time staying at fatou & bira’s place. the supplies were kept up, the a/c felt great, and the spacious room with sink and fridge were perfect for us. thank you!

had a great stay, location near the heart of manhattan and close to the subway which it was what i was looking for, also i would like to add that the people were very friendly and helpful during my stay.

stop looking around. this is the best apartment in nyc. we absolutely loved it. perfect location. walking to 100s of amazing restaurants, close to downtown, soho…could not imagine staying anywhere else. we traveled with a large family with children and it was superb. very spacious. beds were comfortable. hot water for days. a+++
we recommand melissa for her logement. she is attentionned. the bus stop is at 100 meters to jfk airport, the metro at 0,5 miles (a c) go to manhattan.
todo impecable
great place! definitely worth it. it felt just like being at home. the vibes were amazing. it was an amazing space for our mini vacation.
clean and comfortable. second floor, requires climbing stairs, but cuts down on noise from relatively busy street. great location on the g line. plenty of dining and bar options in the neighborhood.

it was okay. the communication was really really good. i was just so surprised that i went there in the winter and there wasn’t a proper blanket on the bed. i was so shocked about that. there wasn’t a full length mirror, no rags, toothbrushes or toothpaste or soaps. that’s my only complaints though. apart from that it was a pretty decent stay, very close to the airport and very very close to times square as promised. thank you.

we had a great stay at david's apartment! the location is amazing, the subway is just steps away; the restaurants are all in walking distance with great many food options, and the park is right across the street. we made good use of the pharmacy and trader joe's very close by. i loved staying in upper west side - it's so calm and relaxing compared to downtown. the apartment is just as described, plenty of linens and towels, well stocked kitchen. we loved having a bottle of sparkly wine in the fridge - thank you, david!! i personally appreciated that david had good sharp knives in the kitchen! we made breakfast every morning, and the dishes are so well chosen, made our life easy. even though the apartment sleeps four with a queen bed in the bedroom and a pull out sofa in the living room, david also provided a queen size blow-up mattress of really good quality! it saved our trip, because my sons didn't want to share a bed. i would absolutely come stay in this apartment again!!

we really enjoyed staying at andre's place, it is a brooklyn gem with unique artist's touch. my guests and i highly recommend this beautiful and comfortable brownstone to anyone who wants an authentic brooklyn experience. julie julie

this is a nice homely stay in a nice neighborhood, plenty of space in the unit. communication was excellent and check in was a breeze. however a few things to consider about this stay: the upstairs floors are so thin that you will hear every single step someone takes on the first floor. meaning when they wake up, you wake up. the wi-fi stopped working after an hour and did not work for the rest of the night. the bed is a bare minimum wooden frame so sleeping on it can feel very rigid.

the place was very convenient in terms of location. metro is only a 5-10 min walking distance and there are plenty of restaurants nearby as well as laundromat. the place itself is nice and cozy with a comfortable bed and sofa! the only thing i have to say is that it can get a little cold at night (i visited in mid september to october). momoyo was very kind and welcoming. overall, i would definitely recommend!

clean, comfortable, and well furnished apartment in a wonderful neighborhood! jing was so responsive and helpful for any of our questions or needs. i would absolutely stay here again when we come back to visit family!
great location in brooklyn, close to subway. the communication with the host saw easy

excellent location!!! walkable to lots of restaurants, shopping, and iconic tourist spots. great space and provided all we needed. the bed is super comfy and there is lots of storage for your luggage/personal belongings. jak is very friendly and was super quick to respond when we had a question or needed something. highly recommend!!

geoffrey and marta’s place was the perfect spot for my family to be in the neighborhood while my sister was expecting a baby. after 18 months apart due to covid being able to have the space to hang out in the really nice living room and plenty of space for everyone was priceless. it was extremely clean and anything we needed was just a text away. very close to easy transit and lots of things to do. we will definitely be back!

kevin and karen’s flat was fabulous. it’s a lovely space and surprisingly quiet for the city. we slept well and i was able to get the work done i needed to thanks to the high speed wifi. it’s also so well situated on a quiet block, yet so close to everything: great restaurants, shopping, subway - we will definitely be back!
nice apartment and excellent service from neil
little loud but it’s nyc. bring ear plugs. easy to get in, easy to check out.
nice location. decent place for your money. little rundown in areas but the room itself is clean. check in was easy.
great place to stay in the city! the room is nice and comfortable, and the rest of the house is lovely. and it’s close to the subway station, so it is super easy to get to downtown ny
great hosts. quick and responsive and great value to stay there

i enjoyed my stay. the street noise didn't bother me, as it died down later at night when it matters just like in any other average neighborhood. i had no problem sleeping. whole foods is a short walk away, so you have easy access to groceries. there's a subway entry nearby as well, so you can easily access the whole city from the ridge. if you drive in, there's a safe parking facility nearby. there are restaurants right next door and all around. my clean room had a tv, fridge, microwave, ironing board, hair dryer, adjustable thermostat, coffee maker with coffee, and a little bag of popcorn. for the price, location, and execution, i have nothing to complain about. the ridge does basic well.
great welcome, nice house, happy that our first air bnb stay was so good. thanks, tanya.

wing's home is truly unique in terms of location, interior design, and comfort! he is the best airbnb host i have ever encountered, and we especially liked the easy keyless access to the home! we really enjoyed getting to know this historic n'hood of howard beach, called ramblersville--via articles provided by wing. loved the back porch views of the canals and ocean breezes, with occasional kitty sightings/visitors. we are used to lga plane noise from jackson hts, so this may or may not be an issue for some given the close proximity to jfk. we strongly recommend his lovely home and we hope to revisit again in the future!

the apartment is in a good location close to restaurants and fort green park , but a bit far from the subway. it is in an older building . it has good light in the morning but it is dark in the afternoon. however, there’s plenty of electric light. the building was surprisingly quiet. we only had one evening when there was noticeable noise from an upstairs neighbor. the mattress had a plastic cover that was crinkly . the kitchen was adequately equipped for basic cooking. there was only one window in the apartment that you could open to get fresh air. i marvin was very responsive and helpful and flexible.
great, convenient place to stay in midtown!!

i’m leaving the united states with a heavy heart because i will truly miss you. thank you so much for the warm way you treated me, as if i were your own son. i felt at home, and i will keep your names in my memory forever. wherever i go, i will always remember you — you are the only family i have in new york. due to lack of time, i wasn’t able to write a handwritten letter to leave in an envelope, like the one you gave me when i arrived. thank you so much, and may god bless you both. when i arrive back home, i will write a heartfelt review of your home on the airbnb app. goodbye! *roque dos reis tito suequel*

solid location in astoria/lic, near bus routes, supermarkets, gym, cafés, bars, walking distance to trains. room was minimalist as shown in listing. bed was comfortable, sheets were clean, temperature was good, restroom and kitchen clean, stocked. really just hits all the key elements one would expect for a stay. shared kitchen and bathroom, but i didn't run into other guests while i was there - so it felt private. solid, great value.💯
had a good experience. a nice and quiet place to stay.

i have already sent the link out for this listing to family and friends. it is such a beautiful place and definitely surprised me. very spacious which was great to have. the washer and dryer was definitely an added bonus. i do read reviews before hand and expected the noise from upstairs but if i wasn't aware it would definitely be a deal breaker. i'm still trying to figure out what the extremely loud bag is that i heard every night. it actually i gets worse the later it gets. also i wouldhave loved to have at least 4 pillows on the bed for two guest. nonetheless we made it work. jerry was a great host! & i will definitely be staying here again soon.
excellent host, the apartment was perfect. subway was at most a 5 minute walk, connecting us with every area of the city. would love to do it again!
was wonderful and would definitely book again!

do not stay here. unfortunately when went to lay down for the night there was a bed bug running around on top of the sheets, if there’s one i’m sure there’s plenty. it was 2am so unfortunately i didn’t have anywhere to go so i sent him a picture of the bug & he only said sorry at first, i demanded a refund which he cash apped me then asked where i was going to go, i said i couldn’t go anywhere due to how late it was. he proceeded to say he had an exterminator coming very early to i had to be out… no time given. at 7am i woke up to him walking in the room as i was sleeping on the floor. truly was the worst experience ever. not only was there bed bugs but the place definitely hadn’t been cleaned in quite awhile.
great location, near major subway lines. room is as pictured (maybe smaller than imagined, but it is new york so that’s expected). very clean & host was very nice! easy check in/check out process!
really nice place if you’re traveling alone or with a partner/friend for a quick nights rest.

i have a daughter who lives in the neighborhood of this apartment, so i am in bed-sty several times a year. i have stayed in numerous airbnbs, and this one is by far my favorite. i love that it has so much natural light, and is well-designed for easy living. is is an attractive and upbeat space, probably relatively newly remodeled (it lacks the bed-sty airbnb old victorian look, that tends to be drab and dark). also, the kitchen had plenty of good quality pots and pans, and kitchen tools were numerous. moreen is a wonderful host. she was so responsive and thoughtful, and she clearly cares a lot about helping people have a positive experience. i hope i will be able to stay here again.
so simple. so clean. so nice. so hospitable. i will be there again!
very nice place enjoyed my stay
great communication, clean space, all good! thank you!
hi, it was a pleasure to stay at this place during 2months, i have nothing bad to say about this place ! thanks, noa
this apartment is affordable and well located but needs to be properly cleaned. i had to leave..

this is a lovely apartment in a wonderful neighborhood! everything is nearby and anything can be delivered. the garden is fantastic - a zen oasis in the city. arianna is an awesome host, very responsive and a pleasure to communicate with - thank you! i look forward to visiting again in the spring!
comfortable room. nice host. loud train.
communication was great. nice view from the balcony!

we stayed at this specific location to attend a graduation at columbia university and it worked really well for that. we would just take a short ride on the subway and maybe a bit of walking depending on your route. we had various entrances to the subway near us that made it easy to get around. the place itself was better than expected. it was very well maintained and modern. all the rooms were cozy, neat, and clean. although the living/dining room is small, i felt like the whole place in general was spacious enough to be comfortable for our group of 6, especially considering it’s in manhattan. the hosts were very responsive in communicating everything to me before and throughout my stay. i had a great experience with the host and the place and would recommend this stay to anyone traveling in a group.
best hotel and best location in manhattan and brooklyn areas
i had an amazing time here,it was soooo comfortable. i highly recommend.

muhan was great and we got the place mostly to ourselves. amazing location right next to the m and l trains as well as a bunch of great local spots. super easy check in and out, and he let us bag drop earlier than usual. clean and convenient amenities (laundry in unit, great outdoor space). overall great stay if you have the budget.
great location, open, easy, and comfortable. hard to imagine better for the price!
great place!!!

the place was beautiful as far as looks and aesthetics. the bed was super noisy and loud so if you’re a couple that plan on having some action with your loved one this bed will be very distracting. the bathroom was super tiny especially that i’m a tall person. the bathroom needs mats on the floor for guests. the unit owner could’ve provided condiments to make coffee or tea. it was extremely difficult to find parking every single day. the owner should at least let the guest park in the driveway or on the sidewalk near the apartment i also messaged her and asked her about parking and i never received a response. on the first afternoon upon check in we received 2 unit keys which we assumed worked for both unit doors. we went out later that evening and we closed both doors to the unit for security when we got back home one of the doors would not open with neither of the keys and because it was after 3 in the morning it was very hard to get onto the owner so i had to contact airbnb support

i cannot rave enough about our stay at nick’s place! nick was super easy to communicate with and was really accommodating when we landed in nyc super early. he even proactively reached out to me the day of check in to be sure nothing had changed with our timing. i usually avoid stays at places that are the host’s primary residence, because i always feel like i’m intruding on their space. however, nick’s place had that sweet spot of having everything you need but being simple enough to where i didn’t feel like i was in someone’s home. the location is fantastic! chelsea has so much happening but doesn’t feel like a tourist trap like other areas of the city, and that subway line allowed us to cover as much ground as possible during our short stay. i would definitely stay here again. be sure to stop by the donut pub just a few steps away and rosetta’s pizza a couple blocks down was the best!

this place is absolutely gorgeous. the pictures are exactly what it looks like and it felt spacious and an amazing place to live. the owners are very responsive and helpful about anything you need. my group checked in very late from a late flight and they were responsive even then! just a short 5-8 minute walk to the subway station too. amazing place, first place i’ll look to stay if i’m back!

it was truly an enjoyable stay at frances’ place. it was clean, spacious, and quiet. frances is a great host with quick responses and provided excellent service. this place is also close to everything: mall, parks, restaurants, and transportation.

our first time in nyc and this location was perfect for the places we visited. walking distance to cafes, stores and yankee stadium. beautifully restored home with so much character and a gourmet kitchen with lots of room. the bedrooms and restrooms were all meticulously clean. our host was attentive and genuinely cared we had a great experience. thank you very much for allowing us to make great memories in this space.
we enjoyed our stay at jojo's place. would definitely recommend.
very clean and quiet. no one bothers. just like the pictures!!

my wife, my father and i enjoyed staying at the 2nd floor home in astoria. the rooms were clean and i liked the color of the quilt on the two twin beds. the neighborhood is a short cab ride from laguardia airport. having multiple metro lines to use is a benefit, especially when train service is reduced during the weekends.
great apartment in the heart of north williamsburg, close to parks, restaurants and night life. cathy is a great host, very responsible and helpful!

my wife and i throughly enjoyed our 5 night stay. we were on the 3rd floor (no elevator) and shared a bathroom with 2 other rooms on the floor. everything was very clean, felt safe and secure, and rarely saw any other tenants. our room was roomy, had fridge, microwave, coffee pot, and had the softest sheets and an awesome bed, we slept amazing! it’s about 10 min walk to the a/c train and a 25 min train ride to midtown manhattan. great place to explore the city from, and several markets nearby for food. also checkout nest bagel nearby, amazing food! street parking was available, but a bit annoying with alternate side parking rules. would recommend 100%!
roomy, close to our desired location
easy check-in, with ideal location. apt was quaint and tidy. great experience overall
my first time booking for a stay in new york and was the best! friendly and clean! also helpful! 5 ⭐️
very nice and clean apartment ! short walk to the subway
nice and comfy room. michel is a very kind and responsive host. i recommend this place

nina’s place was great - as described - good choice for a couple or solo traveler. located in a quiet neighborhood - it is close to the park, subway, all that park slope has to offer. nina was a great with communications and easy to work with. the process was seamless from check-in to check-out.
it was nice and she was very understanding and available. i would stay there again

it was comfortable to stay at yana's lovely studio. i think that the studio's old, but well maintained. n train station is very close and there's a lot of shops near. target's opened last november and it's only 3 minutes away! i saw yana, and she's very nice. her parents're also so nice that they always asked me if i needed anything. it was a comfortable to stay. i really recommed yana's lovely studio.
had a wonderful and comfortable stay. thank you!
very nice hosts. very welcoming. very friendly apartment was very well equipped, super clean, and very comfortable
this is a very clean and great place to be at . the host is very professional and patient and provides everything you need. the place is spotless clean.

what a perfect nyc spot, facing central park and a quick walk to the subway. location wise it’s hard to beat. the apartment itself was great, renovated, good space , very clean with everything we needed including toys for kids. we would definitely stay there again.
really responsive host! comfortable living space.
milton was very helpful and the apartment was very neat!! i would definitely recommend it to family and friends.

we had a very good stay in roman’s airbnb. he’s very thoughtful, kind and respectful towards his guests. he definitely makes an effort to make his guests feel welcomed and comfortable. communication was great, check in easy and room clean, as described/shown. we were able to use the kitchen for breakfast (that he provided) and dinner. supermarkets are within 10mins walking distance, subway 8mins. areas was ok, we didn’t spend much time there. it took 30mins to get to lower manhattan. room runs hot in summer, there is an ac that can be used though. overall we were happy to have chosen this accommodation and can recommend it to people/couples who are planning to stay here for a couple of days. thanks again roman for your kindness and help especially!
had very good short and quick stay at romels place. great host. place is nice and clean.
a nice stay indeed! had some good rest to start early the next day magdalene was able to confirm my request promptly despite the short notice its a great deal; worth the monies!

this place was perfect for our family of five from the location, to the space in the home, it was everything we needed. rochel had great communication and was able to answer my questions very quickly. the subway is about a five minute walk and there are tons of corner stores, restaurants, etc. nearby. there is a park close as well with lots going on in the summer. the noise from the brownstone it’s actually pretty low compared to most nyc homes. the only time we noticed was mid day because kids were playing. overall, i would definitely recommend this home if you are looking for a spacious, nice place that allows you to see brooklyn while conveniently being able to go to the city too.

to all those looking for a nice place to stay in brooklyn, jeremy and angela's place is a gorgeous must-add to your list. i had a great time at their place while attempting to outlast winter. the place was very roasty-toasty with a beautiful design, right in the mix of the now-happening myrtle avenue. please stay at this place and i guarantee that you'll want to come back annually.

comfortable and cozy place to stay! jonathan's home is perfect for a getaway or a multi-week stay. the place is sufficiently furnished and comfortable. kitchen is fully functional with everything you need to cook meals and enough countertop space to work. i highly recommend this spot. it is pleasant, safe, and rest assured you will be taken care of.

the place was super cool. love all of the antique tocues around the apt and the room was perfect. the bed was amazing after a long days work. host was super responsive and answered all the of the questions i had. nice are with super nice deli on the corner. if you are lloking for a simple room with nice touches, this is the place for you.
great location! easy to get in and out. would def stay there again!

if you are looking for a well located place, you have found it. this location was easy access to the bus and subway. the neighborhood was quiet. you are even close to a park. the owners are proactive and responsive. i would definitely book again.
i had the most amazing time at johnny’s place! great conversation, beautiful space, and everything you’d need nearby! i highly recommend staying with johnny 💗 i can’t wait until my next trip 🥰

beautiful, quaint space with a newly remodeled bathroom. the perfect place for a solo traveler or two people. norman was very responsive. it truly has the charm of a brooklyn brownstone and i loved the historical molding and architecture. between the kitchenette and the bathroom and seating area, it has everything that you need.
great place, spacious for two travelers, quiet, parking available on the street (late weeknight be prepared to circle the next couple blocks), easy access to subway/public transport
needed to extend my stay by a few days. james was flexible and very hospitable. highly recommend.
great stay! very convenient, spacious, wondering rooms.

this was my second stay at jeanne's, and it was as excellent as the first. jeanne is stunningly easy to work with, crystal clear about everything, and gracious to boot. the apartment is immaculate and quiet. heaven for anyone looking for a place that both soothes the nerves and feels homey. be sure to try the east river ferry service at india st., as it is a great alternative to the subway. also, be sure to try anella's or the recently opened gwynnet street. fantastic food. and the nearby ashbox cafe is a great place for breakfast (cash only).
i canceled the reservation at the last minute, when i was already in front of the gate, now it is becoming very difficult for me to find a place to stay
very cute space perfect size for 2. the bed was comfy and clean and the tv was a nice amenity to relax at night.
nice apartment in a neighborhood with the best vibes!
david and his wife camila are a wonderful, warm, caring couple that are so welcoming that it felt as though we were old friends.

great location. a few steps from time square. appreciate the key card/security to access each floor. very safe and quiet. the breakfast provided is not a hot breakfast, but a grab and go muffins, fruit with coffee . there is a great breakfast spot minutes from the hotel called the red flame diner. very reasonable and yummy! i recommend this hotel and plan on staying here again. margie

it was an amazing stay. sayeed was very flexible with our check in time and i am grateful for that. like it was listed, there’s a private entrance, own bathroom. there’s a mini fridge but no microwave. the neighborhood is a quiet place so be mindful of your voices.
amazing host and amazing place. super clean and modern

great location. quiet street. a little walk to 2 subway stations but we'll located to see everything in brooklyn and the city. could have been a little cleaner but still fine. beds very comfortable and thy left us to take care of ourselves.

wonderful location on the ues, close to subway stops, grocery, nice restaurants, and central park. super quiet street and building. apartment felt large because of high ceilings and large living room, it was frankly bigger than i expected. i walked every day over to central park and felt quite a local. the apartment building is surrounded by other places that have a doorman, so always felt safe at night, even at midnight!

i was quite pleased with my stay at dena's. she was honest about her apartment and quite clear in her instructions for getting the key. we didn't get to meet this trip but her courtesy and clarity along with the quality of her building including doorman insure that i will avail myself of her apartment again.
lakshmee is the best host i’ve dealt with. she was very attentive to our needs and proactive at providing solutions and recommendations! excellent host!
loved it. alejandro is so lovely and helped to carry my bags upstairs and generally made me feel welcome. definitely recommend staying here!
beautiful apartment - even better than the pictures! clean, comfy, close to the subway, in a quiet street. perfect for a group of friends or a family to recover after a busy day in manhattan!

very nice and quiet apartment. i stayed 5 weeks in new york. there's a lot of shops and restaurants. the bus 72 ( crossing central park) and the q line are are close to the apartment. the apartmentis small but really fully f equipped. inna and di respond quickly. i spent a very nice stay. i recommand it.

i did not get to meet olivier when i was there but we kept in touch via text, especially when my flight was cancelled and i could not arrive as planned. he was very helpful and made sure someone in the apartment could help me get in late. i really liked the apartment overall, everything is clean and organised and the room was perfect. he also left a lot of useful tips and asked me how i was doing now and then! which i really appreciated since i was travelling alone. i used the a and c subway lines most frequently and these are just 10 minutes' walk away. i would definitely stay with olivier again next time i am in new york!
great overall experience
an amazing place and great atmosphere close to everything

sandy is a great host, she let me in and showed me how to use everything. she had prepared a list of nearby restaurants, shops etc, which was very helpful. the location across the road from fort greene park is very good and it is close to lots of great restaurants. the apartment is just as described and in the photos. it is a lovely apartment, very spacious. i had a great time here.

when i saw alex listing i was pleased with the look, location and what the listing had to offer. i arrived at the location and followed the easy directions he gave. everything he showed in the listing was the same when i was there in person. nice spacious bedroom, kitchen was nice and the bathroom was clean. i had no issue with the place and would definitely book that room again. the area was nice and since the weather was nice i could walk around and take advantage of what the area had to offer.
great value and location

thank you for the hospitality!
perfect pied a terre. exceeds expectations.
a very nice room in convenient location for reasonable price, will definitely rebook next time visiting nyc!

in august i attended a week long course for teachers in manhattan and rented the house barge because it was affordable. my fianace' came along for the trip too. it was a bit of a commute to columbia from the boat but so worth the subway ride. the barge was better than expected. it was cozy, had a stove for cooking quick meals and was close to the bus, subway, grocery store and subway.lisa and angus were more than hospitable! they offered us rides to the subway, gave us directions for places in the area and lisa even joined us for a bike ride on a biking path in brooklyn. they are truly good people! the neighborhood was quiet and relaxing and the neighbors were friendly and helpful. great free parking too! we enjoyed our stay very much .

koichi's room is a great price for the location. i found the room to be perfect for my needs; i just needed somewhere to crash at night after a busy day of sight-seeing. it is a very bare-bones and simple room. it's in an older building that has thin walls. i recommend bringing earplugs and a white noise machine if you are a light sleeper, because you will hear your neighbors enter and exit their rooms. the kitchen area was very clean and surprisingly well equipped. the bedroom was very tidy. the shared bathrooms were as clean as they could be, but they are not new or renovated spaces, so keep your expectations in check! overall, i would stay here again because of the ease of getting in/out, koichi's great communication, and the good price.

this place was perfect for our group, lots of room to sleep, sit, and settle. walking distance from the subway so its's perfect for city/borough excursions! clean and very well taken care of, perfect for a short trip like ours :))
such a lovely flat to stay in. brady’s apartment was cute as had everything you could think of. omar was sweet and responsive. would absolutely stay again.

great value in a great location. i love the east village neighborhood and the ridge is right in the heart of the action. super close to very important subway lines and right next to great coffee shops/bars/restaurants. the room is small, of course, because it's new york. but it's the perfect home base for a fun trip to nyc.
ranita is a best host✨ the room is tidy and clean, feel like home. highly recommended!!

great room and loved that i had my own bathroom. of course, i go to brooklyn during a heat wave and i was very grateful that the room had a window a/c and fan i used them both. the house and location is quite and i slept well.
great apartment. comfortable beds and a helpful host
one of the best places i’ve been to and such a wonderful time, stay you again 🫶
elen’s place was clean, comfortable, and cozy. would definitely recommend to others!

i came to juanita's place on the occasion of visiting my son's family. it was very comfotable being at her place. the room was very clean, cozy and i liked so much it's decore. juanita was very freindly.
the environment is good, the host is kind and helpful. the house is clean. everything is good
the apartment is big, very clean and very illuminated. it's only a few steps from the bus stop and very close to the subway. lily, thank you so much for everything. it was a good stay.
great stay for 2 nights
the room and my stay were fine. room was clean and quiet. bed was firm. ana and william were considerate and helpful. everything worked out very well.

we really loved our stay at rhonda's - she was warm, welcoming and helpful! the space was perfect for our needs, and rhonda went above and beyond to ensure we had what we needed and knew how everything worked. space was comfortable and as described and the location was very convenient for everywhere we needed to go. would definitely stay again when back in nyc! note, this is a much more "traditional" airbnb in that you are staying on the bottom floor of a family home, so know that you'll sometimes hear footsteps from above and the normal bustle of life. thank you rhonda for the hospitality and welcoming us into your home!

i very much enjoyed my stay with luz. she’s a wonderful host and the space was very clean. beautiful room with tv and bed was sooo comfortable. her daughter was a ray of sunshine kept me smiling and luz was thoughtful and kind. i recommend this place.
nice and clean, super friendly cat.

our stay here was fantastic! i have a health issue and some special needs and alain went above and beyond without hesitation to make my stay comfortable. it’s a beautiful apartment with a lovely view; we spent the morning sipping tea and looking out on the tree out front, and all the people passing by. the location is unbeatable; you can be in a beautiful part of prospect park in just a couple minute’s walk. we walked easily to the botanical gardens, the museum, and the library. the apartment has a lovely feel and so we chose to enjoy dinner in. i highly recommend a stay here, especially at such a low price for what you get; we fully intend to return. thank you, alain!

this place was even more beautiful in person! the room was large, and it was very far from the host's, so very private. the location couldn't be more ideal if you're looking to stay in williamsburg. it's close to the water and surrounded by restaurants. thanks, christina!

fantastic apartment! we loved staying with noelva. she and her family went out of their way to welcome us to city island - we truly felt at home. the apartment itself is very well appointed and tidy. the real gem is the property - right on the water with amazing views. the perfect place to sit and watch the tide come in! staying with noelva in the heart of city island was the perfect way to spend the weekend. we will definitely be back!

our stay at carlton’s was nothing short of perfect! the neighborhood, his apartment, his communication, as well as his willingness to go above and beyond truly made our short stay a memorable experience! everything about our stay was seamless, carlton allowed us to check-in early and even offered airport pick-up and drop-off, would 100% stay here again.

positive aspects: * the location is excellent — right in the city center, so everything is easily accessible. * the service was great. whenever we needed something, the staff responded quickly. * an iron is available upon request. * it is possible to leave your luggage after check-out. * housekeeping is provided every day, including fresh towels and bed-making. * the windows can be opened. negative aspects: * the rooms could be cleaner — the carpet was quite dirty, especially in the corners. * there is no proper duvet on the bed, only a blanket placed between two sheets that cannot be fastened together. it does not seem very hygienic and is not very comfortable. * water kept collecting in the sink because the drainage was very poor (probably partially clogged). * there is no fridge or kettle in the room. * there is no netflix option available on the tv.
great place to stay, she is really nice.

i absolutely loved the space. although i wish the 2 apartments were connected instead of having to go outside to get in between the 2 spaces. other than that it was perfect. i will be using her again this summer 2019

jim and barbara are very nice persons, apartment is clean, stylishly decorated and very well equipped, good coffee maker, comfortable bed. also it is very sweet of the owners to put some drinks in the fridge. all necessities are provided for your arrival and it makes you feel very welcomed. neighborhood is quiet with plenty of diverse cousine restaurants, close to the subway.

we are a theatre/dance company based in australia and two of our members stayed at grovers place and loved the space, the area and the experience. grover is very professional and a great communicator. harlem is on a direct line to the city and nice escape from inner city hustle and bustle. grovers place is very spacious, clean & well appointed ( the photos reflect the space. would be great place for larger group.

everything about this airbnb is absolutely perfect!! from dawn’s attention to detail and genuine hospitality to the convenient location of the airbnb to the clear and transparent check in/out process, i can guarantee you will not find a better listing! from the start, the airbnb was even more gorgeous in person and was very specious. i was able to enjoy a lovely bubble bath with a bottle of wine that was purchased at the cute little shop down the street. there’s tons of stores, cafes, bars and restaurants within walking distance and the subway station is only a 10 minute walk away! dawn made me feel welcomed and at home! if you’re thinking about booking this stay then do it!! this airbnb made my trip to nyc feel so worry-free and seamless.
we loved staying at fee’s place! 100% coming back! the atmosphere of the home was wonderful and we lacked nothing. best airbnb i’ve stayed in!
this room was very nice and the balcony was a cute added touch the apartment was clean and other guest were quiet i enjoyed my stay. very close to public transportation
super relaxed place to stay for a few nights in new york. metrostation is like 10 minutes walking and there are nice pubs and coffee places nearby. would recommend it!
shreen and her cats were very nice to me. if you have something you wanna ask (providing breakfast etc), it might be better to text her.
our stay was wonderful with great communication and location was close to everything!
a charming loft in a great neighborhood! alessandra was super responsive and a really gracious host. thanks so much!
enjoy staying in michael’s place. c train only a 10 minute walk. peaceful and quiet. will definitely be back !

my big ticket items were safety and cleanliness when finding an airbnb in nyc, so this quiet pocket in williamsburg was perfect. this is a great area that is walking distance to shops, restaurants, bars, and the l train that takes you directly to manhattan (3 stops to manhattan and 5 stops to 14 st-union square where you can transfer to other lines). the apartment was well equipped with an in unit washer/dryer, full kitchen, and updated bathroom. the windows also opened up all the way which was great for fresh air. julian was very helpful and responsive during my stay. would highly recommend if you want to enjoy nyc from the peaceful, quiet side.

alison was great! she is an airbnb pro. her entire apartment was set up for a perfect stay. small details were addressed, which made you feel like it was better than staying in a hotel. the apartment is close to several subway stops.
we enjoyed our stay! it was only a 15-minute walk to the 7 train station. our host was very kind and let us store our luggage before and after check-out.
great place - highly recommend!
super charming space in a great location. amazing host- quick to respond.

great place to stay. i lived in williamsburg few years ago and i knew the place well. it is a place with clean, safe and great vibes. some info who wanna stay in there: little bit noisy during weekend, but it is because the place is great place to visit good restaurants and others. three floors walkup: maybe difficult for some people who wanna elevator something like that. no washer and dryer: need to use nearby laundromat. 10 mins by walk.

this apartment is located in an amazing location and it was easy to get all over the city from there. it was also very close to countless bars, restaurants, coffee shops and everything else that makes nyc special. it is very small—almost too small for four adults, but we made it work by not spending too much time there. (that’s not why we visited the city anyway!) also, i would have personally preferred it to be a bit cleaner, but for the price and location it was worth the dirty coffee pot and grimy bathroom door. bella was very responsive about check in and i am sure she would have made an effort to fix anything had i made a fuss while i was there which i didn’t.
excellent location and price. but could be much better if it was cleaner...
nice neighborhood in brooklyn with great cafes nearby. we had a convenient trip to brooklyn botanical gardens when we were there, and it's a short train ride into the city.
it was great thank you aaron
great space! loved how easy everything was neighborhood was nice. street parking was east to find daily.

i stayed in 3 rooms with my family. the three bedrooms, the living, the kitchen, the bathroom were lovely and felt like a place of beauty. we loved it. i recommend every room. andrada is the most kind and helpful host.

yesica's place is a true gem. not only it is sparkling clean, it is stylish, new, warm, well-equipped and offers you complete privacy in the likes of a hotel room, as it has its own door and you can go in and out without passing through shared space. i should also mention the extra towels, smart tv and netflix. yesica is very nice, happy to help and quick to respond. the neighborhood has a pretty nice vibe and is surprisingly rather safe to walk at night. it has cute family bakeries and restos. bars and clubs too, although we didn't get the chance to try them. a 15-min and straight-forward walk to the metro, from where 7 takes you to times square in like 23 minutes. i know i may sound overly excited about this place, but it really is like a home away from home and was extremely reasonably priced for new year's eve, nothing like other questionable options. if it is going to be new york, it is going to be at yesica's.

i would highly recommend byron's place! i have no complaints whatsoever. his place is meticulously clean, which made for a very comfortable stay. grocery stores, pharmacy, and subway are all close by. his apartment is beautiful and has many nice touches. byron himself is very nice and interesting to talk to. i would definitely stay there again!
make sure you understand that it’s a vegan place only lol. made me eat my popeyes outside

fantastic apartment to stay in nyc! super chic styling and great amenities! i stayed for 2 months and had to work from home, so it was a perfect amount of space to live & work! fully furnished 1 bedroom and the couch pulls out to a bed too! there's a lot of silverware & cups to have guests over! the upper east side is so quiet and safe. and the apartment is within a 10 min walk to the subway and bus stops, so getting around was so easy. also there are 2 supermarkets and a drug store within a 5 min walk! and there are tons of great restaurants! furnished quarters customer service was great too! they allowed me to check-in early and they were fast and responsive when i found out the toaster was broken! couple downsides: - the apartment building is pretty old and the stairs, hallways, and basement are pretty shabby. - there are 2 washing machines & 2 dryers in the basement that you have to climb down really narrow stairs to get to. it's not accessible through the elevator. also laundry is $2.50 per cycle, so it costs $5.00 to wash & dry one load. - there's no mail room, so packages are just left out in the hallway. fortunately, no one seemed to steal them. - toiletries (e.g. toilet paper, paper towel, garbage bags) are not replenished for long-term stays. overall, i highly recommend staying in this apartment! you're going to have a fantastic stay!
had a great experience. jason was very helpful and accommodating.

we liked our stay at anthony's place. we've got every thing around us, shopping, markets, parks ... we never needed a car for moving around. plus, anthony himself is very helpful and supportive. i really recommend his stay.
close to a lot of eating places, laundrette and the subway and bus stops
great location with access to everything!
great room at a affordable price. they were flexible with scheduling and the room was cozy would definitely go back.
luis was very responsive and accommodating. super friendly. would definitely stay here again.
aracelis is an amazing host with a great place. very welcoming, i highly recommend !
exactly what we needed. nice stay in brooklyn

lucas is amazing!!! extremely friendly also respects guests’ privacy. he is really good at being invisible but comes out the right timing when you need him. when i stayed at his home, i felt like i was at my own cozy home. everything is spotless clean and modern, you can tell he put a lot of details inside the house. he always checks on the guests and makes sure everyone’s need is met. location is surrounded by peaceful and quiet neighborhoods. there’s a subway station (#2 & #5) about 12 mins walking distance. i feel i can really relax in my bedroom and enjoy privacy. he is absolutely the best host. i will for sure come back next time!

win and his family were absolutely lovely. they have a beautiful home and our room was spotless and gorgeous. they had breakfast for us and we were very happy and would love to come back again and again!
a great place to stay especially in between sightseeing. it was very homey, cozy, quiet, and clean. we had everything we needed during our weekend stay.

the place was very nice and clean. christian is receptive and responds quickly. he really tries to make everything smooth. we did have to walk about 10-15 to the train station. i had kids with me so it was a little much. also if you get an uber from the city make sure they drop you off at the correct location. we had an uber take us back and drop us off like 10mins away! other wise it is a good place to come and rest for the night. two of the beds are futons but it did the job since we only stayed for one night.
great staten island location. it has everything that you would need. great wifi for working from home. would stay again next time i’m back on staten island to visit family.

i tired for two days straight to find a place in queens for a concert and finally finding her place was like finding gold. great space, easy check in and check out, very clean and well decorated, good price, and michelle is an amazing host so responsive! would highly recommend!

location, location, location!! what a really great place- expansive and comfortable. close to huge transit center and so easy to get to from jfk. we loved our stay here! jacob was very responsive and was extremely proactive to fix a hvac issue during our stay. would 10/10 recommend staying here.
we found found our stay good, it’s in a convenient location to get around. they have an amazing library of books in the apartment.
great place close to lga!
great location, matches the description, good value.

lovely place in brooklyn. very tastefully decorated, nice backyard view and space for a large family. andrea was available at check-in time to walk us through the house and was communicative through the stay. we enjoyed our stay and would recommend to folks!

great space, very clean, very cozy, nice surrounding neighborhood a lot of stores and restaurants near by and it’s very close to the subway stations. strong recommend booking this bnb when you’re visiting nyc.
private and tons of parking. we stayed for a week, and i worked from there, and the wi-fi was stable.
a tremendous bargain in brooklyn. our daughter was in the marathon and the apartment was steps from the course! amenities excellent, very clean and welcoming, had a great stay in sunset park.

jasber's place is spotlessly clean, well appointed and conveniently located place if you're looking to stay near jfk, la guardia, or the van wyck expressway. there's an air conditioning unit in the main bedroom which will keep you cool at night, but it's not powerful enough to cool down the whole place during a really hot day. thankfully there's a ceiling fan in the kitchen, but not in the main living-tv area. the bathroom is spacious and airy and very clean. the kitchen has loads of space and all the appliances seemed fairly new. the neighbourhood doesn't have a lot of offer in terms of entertainment, being more of typical residential jamaica neighbourhood. the bedroom and kitchen windows back on to a honda dealer/garage and it can be a bit noisy at night if cars are being delivered. getting to nyc can be a bit of a trek: to midtown it will take you approx. 50 min. having said that, overall it was a great stay for us as we were looking for something close to jfk.
celia was a great host and very responsive. her place was great and very cozy and stylish. i would definitely stay there again.
kin’s flat is a good stay with nice updated finishes and good privacy. the neighborhood is amazing.
great stay and affordable
shayla is a very kind host, her flat and the room is absolutely clean and well equipped. recommended.
great flexible hosts and very conveniently located

this stay was so delightful! a little neighborhood home tucked away from the city, and close to public transport which made going into the city easy and breezy. their home was fantastic and gave me a nice place to rest after long days of traveling around. truly a great experience.

we planned a long weekend in ny with 6 friends. location was perfect for us: brooklyn & manhattan around the corner, easy acces by public & bike. williamsburg with his nice vibe on walking distance. apartment was also good for us, just what we needed: beds, kitchen and bathroom. unfortunately the warm water for showering was not working, but glenn & ginger offered us to shower in their place, just on the other side of the entrance hall, very nice of course. only there was cold water as well. ..shit happens!! after 1 day it was all sorted, so no stress ;) we even go some refund, which is of course a very nice gesture of g & g, tanx again! communication was quick and constructive, would recommend everybody to stay here who is looking for a nice place to stay for a couple of days and explore nyc.

chia was an exceptional host, going above and beyond to ensure our stay was perfect. the kitchen was incredibly nice, allowing us to prepare meals with ease. and let's not forget about the bed - it was unbelievably comfortable, guaranteeing a good night's sleep. this was our second time staying with chia, and without a doubt, they will always be our top choice when we find ourselves in new york. their hospitality and attention to detail are unmatched. thank you, chia, for making our stay truly memorable. we look forward to returning in future! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ best regards, jody

no frills, clean in the areas the matter. gets the job done. this isn’t the place for the gourmet or picky traveler. the area is real nyc, not times square. it’s not glamorous, but it has that nyc charm.

we had a wonderful stay at audrey’s airbnb in brighton beach. the apartment was spacious, spotless, and had everything we needed. the beds were very comfortable, the kitchen was well equipped, and the location was perfect. we already knew and loved brighton beach, but staying right there made all the difference. the neighborhood is vibrant, surrounded by diverse cultures, close to the beach, and just steps from the q train. audrey was a fantastic host, always responsive and accommodating. we can’t wait to come back!
beautiful apartment! great amenities.
sophia was a very responsive host that provided a clean and functional space. the location was about a seven minute walk to stores- very convenient.

laura's home is in a beautiful residential area of brooklyn famous for its victorian homes and tree lined streets. restaurants and grocery stores (including a great organic one on cortelyou) are within walking distance. room #5 was spacious and the bed was comfortable. bathroom was spotless. laura is a very friendly host and made my stay so pleasant.
i was staying at mari j's for 7 days and it was excellent. the house is very organized and clean. i loved it!
was in town to visit family. very walkable and easy access to buses and metro. lots of unique food options nearby. apartment was welcoming and a respite.

we had an amazing stay at lucelia and anthony’s place. right from the start they were so welcoming, with excellent communication the whole way through. we stayed for 7 nights and the room was spotless, warm, quiet, and super comfortable. the bathroom was spacious and modern, which made the stay even better. their home is also just a short walk to one of the main subway stations in queens, which made getting into manhattan really easy. we will most definitely be back.
great modern amenities. clean rooms with comfortable furniture. great location!

great quiet space, really close to subway and always felt comfortable in the neighbourhood. would definitely recommend for cost effective, comfortable and friendly place to stay while visiting new york.
great location, great service. the reception was extremely nice.
a great experience, lovely spot, and awesome location (a bit of a touristy street.) the roof deck was amazing.
andre's place is perfect. it is so well done and super clean. great location, so easy to walk to the beach! we will be back!
we enjoyed our stay. it’s conveniently located next to subway stations, and is clean and cozy. heather is very responsive .
patrick was a great host. he was very easy to communicate with and was very friendly.
very nice place. great stay overall, but the door code didn't work on the 2nd night. we returned from manhattan just after 1am and could not get inside.

coach was a wonderful host and was easy to reach whenever we needed him. we checked in a little pass 9pm and was greeted at the front steps. coach gave us a tour of the apartment and even left a housewarming gift upon settling in. the apartment was comfortable and had all the necessities. we definitely felt safe in the neighborhood and had no problem walking to and from the subway during the wee hours of the night.

very clean, and updated space that was perfect for 3 people. comfy beds, spacious bedrooms, fully equipped kitchen and nice bathroom. reasonably priced for holiday weekend. convenient location for what i needed it for. near bus stop and walkable to caribbean restaurants and shopping. i visit ny often and this is the friendliest neighborhood i’ve experienced in brooklyn. responsive host. everything was as described.
sidney is a great host and a very fun person to be around and to talk to. it was very relaxing to stay at his house in brooklyn and a great experience. we hope to come there again!

this place does look like the photos and that’s it. there were dirty dishes left behind and dirty knives. the coffee maker was broken an they had old dried up coffee there an when i did tell her she did have a replacement coffee maker sent but with kcups which does not work with the replacement coffee maker. i tried to explain it to her but she did not understand which was frustrating on my end. my family was not happy about the cleanliness of the place an that we had to go and buy things for our stay that was suppose to be provided. the response time was not in a timely manner until my last day when we were checking out. also there is no place to hang your towels. the living room ac did not work but the room acs did. this is not a place to stay if u are going to a wedding or fancy party. there are also traps everywhere that had my kids on edge the entire time.
very nice location, easy to find and check in.
extremely close to time square and all things new york. across the road from kinky boots, a great show, we went. claude's apartment provided us with what we wanted. would stay again.

it was great having a kitchen where we could really cook. we found the home comfortable and perfect for our needs. renters should realize that it is urban and can be a bit noisy. it's an older building, but it feels like home. brooklyn museums and gardens are easily walkable. trains are about a 7-minute walk.
great host!
warm welcome by desiree! very accessible by train and very well deserving manhattan! also we looooved melanie!
we had a wonderful stay. the location was perfect, the host was great, and we’ll absolutely be booking again next time we’re in nyc.
future travelers to michals place can expect to receive excellent concierge services and to meet all their immediate needs.

my stay at joyce's was wonderful. the place is more than spacious and i was even able to find parking in the neighborhood. joyce was a very gracious and helpful hostess. i would recommend this place to anyone who is staying in the area. the place was excellent, and the internet was fast. overall it was a stellar experience.
very clean and understanding hosts! definitely worth the stay.

the room was perfect! however, the instructions for finding the flat were not very clear. fortunately, the host helped us right away, even in the middle of the night. there's one thing we didn’t like about the flat, the noise. the walls between the rooms are very thin, and you can hear absolutely everything. if you’re unfortunate enough to share the flat with inconsiderate roommates (there are two extra rooms), i recommend looking for another place or complaining, as i did, to the guest who were staying the same days. it's a shame because the room and the flat were beautiful—very cozy, clean, and equipped with all the necessary amenities.
can’t complain! for a new york apartment very good. communication with ermal was great and the location felt safe.
great location, very clean, and very updated.

jennifer's place was a great accommodation for us to stay for 5 nights around new years. jennifer is a very nice person and took time for us to show us the house and tell us information about the neighborhood. she also had some few pages/folder thing with information about the house and surroundings which is very useful and makes you feel very welcome. the place is very well located, it's near a subway station and within 15 minutes you are in the city center. for us it was a big plus to stay in brooklyn because we liked to stay somewhere else instead of downtown new york. the house is clean, looks just the same as in the photos and has everything you need to have a great stay in new york!
we were traveling to nyc for a couple of days. lauryn’s place is great, simple and very clean. we enjoyed our time in the big apple.
the check-in was great and the room was very peaceful. the commute into manhattan was fairly quick. all in all i enjoyed my stay.
it's a nice place to stay in new york city.

this place is definitely a hidden gem - i couldn't have asked for a better location for my one month stay in manhattan. the posting says it's located in soho, but it really was that and so much more. i got to experience basically 4 neighborhoods in one - soho, little italy/nolita, and chinatown. walk a block in any direction and you get a completely different taste of what new york has to offer. it's very close to multiple subway stations, and you can easily walk to east village, the lower east side, and greenwich village. it's also super easy to get groceries from the neighborhood of your choice, or just forget cooking altogether because there are so many affordable food options. there's also an awesome rooftop for the perfect view of the city - i definitely recommend checking it out. finally, our host was very responsive and quickly resolved any issues we found with the apartment - they repaired the lightbulbs, fixed the radiator noise, and toilet leakage promptly. you can trust that you'll be in good hands!

our stay at shuly location was awsome, beautiful and very clean house, great location, very safe neighberhood, many testaurants and shops, train station within walking distance. i highly recommend shuly house to anyone. thank you.
space was very clean, comfortable, and homey. host was kind and helpful when we needed it. she also has the sweetest cat in the world! if you need a place in brooklyn, this is it.

although i didn't get to spend the night at alice's because i had to make an impromptu trip to washington heights, i did get to spend a few hours there. the apartment was very spacious and clean. i actually got to take a nap for a few hours while i was there and really enjoyed the comfortable bed. the location was great; it was only a few blocks away from the l train, which (based on my experience) is the fastest and most reliable train line in ny. alice was very accommodating and friendly. a lovely place overall!

gloria place is a nice accommodation for a budget friendly visit to new york. its clean with well stock kitchen as well as enough linens. this place only has one private room. the other rooms are pass through but it worked well for us.
great place to stay , clean and quiet

great location in the flower district and very easy to walk to chelsea pier, highline, subway etc..comfortable bed, however, it had some kind of covering on the mattress that was noisy. wifi didn't work in room on 15th floor but worked in lobby. no bathrobes as advertised. extra resort fee of $42 a night that was mentioned in the abnb write up but not included in the "now you'll see one price for your trip, all fees included" as abnb states. despite these couple of things, i would stay again. fresh croissants brought in every day for complimentary continental breakfast, quiet and location can't be beat.
dreamy design for a small apartment—everything in paris's apartment was so thoughtfully placed! also the location is awesome. i would definitely come back to stay here again.
place is worth the price- i was upgraded due to a little confusion during the check in process but was happy at the outcome. will definitely recommend and stay in this place again.

yolanda was awesome!!! she exhibited compassion and concern, which are rare in a hotel experience. this was my first time staying in an airbnb, so while i wasn't nervous, i was ignorant of how it would work out. yolanda provided me with peace of mind. she would check on me, even driving me to my first event at no charge. even when i insisted that her concern was over and above, she informed me that it was no problem. i felt safe and worry-free!!! thank you for a great experience, yolanda!!!

i thoroughly enjoyed my month in east flatbush at dadrine's airbnb. she is super nice, has great hospitality, and gives amazing haitian food recommendations. the 3/4 train is a short, peaceful walk away. on church ave, you have fresh produce markets & a brooklyn public library. great location for commuting into manhattan. do not hesitate to book!!!!

this was a great stay. very thankful for them offering a clean, nice place to stay for my weekend away. it does say “offer on street parking” i wouldn’t recommend it, we ran into a hick up with that. overall very happy with my experience and had a great weekend!
alfredo and his mother showed a lot of hospitality. we appreciate the privacy and cleanness of the apartment. very close to the subway and a very calm neighborhood.

we had a great time at gian's airbnb, it's very spacious and we really liked how the house was decorated. the location of the airbnb is perfect, it was a good starting point for our many day trips in nyc. being able to park in front of the house was also very convenient. we would definitely recommend gian's airbnb to anyone who wants to visit nyc.
booked this last minute and the host was accommodating. location and apartment were perfect
shemi and family were wonderful hosts. the place is exactly as described and felt cozy. it was just what we needed for the duration of our stay.
this place was great for a weekend trip to new york 🫶🏽
it was a short stay but very comfortable and private.
what a wonderful place and a lovely gentle host. would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a pristine place to stay with a great host.

the apartment is very cozy and homely, which makes it a pleasant place to stay. the space is also bright. the beds and bathroom are good, and the kitchen is fully equipped, as is the living room. lashanda responded very quickly to questions, even during the holidays, which was much appreciated. the subway is a 10-minute walk away and takes you to manhattan in 30 minutes. there are many dining options in the area. although it may not seem very safe at first, it actually is. thank you for the pleasant stay.
perfect location. super clean and comfortable accommodations. hostess is knowledgeable and helpful and kind.

everything about the stay was perfect. my brother stayed for 6 weeks during his rotation at the hospital close by. very clean, rose responded quickly when booking and when we needed to add days to the reservation. i highly recommend this space to those who are doing their rotations at king county hospital. thanks again rose!

this is the first time for me to use airbnb during the trip and i'm glad that i made the right decition. the apartment is much better than my expectation, even better than all the hotels i used to live. it is located in a safe place that is less than 5-mins walking distance from the subway station, about 15 mins to midtown. very convenient! additionally, the co-host is very kind, quick responsed to any question we asked. the apartment is so clean and great that we treated it as our home during our stay, especially the comfortable beds that offer us very good sleep at nights. if i have the chance to come back new york, i would definitely choose this apartment again.

apartment looked exactly like what was in the photos, even though the exact address was different from the listing (same street). communication was great. location convenient. close to penn station so there were some unhoused in the area. nothing unusual for ny. would recommend.

nehphrii's place is a sanctuary for your soul! i felt safe and at home. this was my first airbnb experience and i was very pleased. i was so grateful for nehprii's generosity as a host. she was very welcoming and prompt with her replies via text and airbnb. the location is ideal, as it's just a couple of blocks from the subway. street parking was ample.

fantastic space and it was a perfect home base for our weekend in brooklyn! the bed was cozy, the interior was charming and clean, and the gorgeous hardwood floors were amazing. a very walkable neighborhood to restaurants and subway stations. i would definitely stay here again, it was exactly what we were looking for!

this is easily one of the best bnbs i’ve ever stayed at—a true hidden gem in brooklyn. the space was clean, welcoming, and beautiful. it felt like we were right at home. the location is fantastic, right next to georgetown and just down the street from the flatlands shopping center, making everything incredibly convenient. kamran’s hospitality and generosity are unmatched; he even offered to share extra food he had ordered, which was such a thoughtful gesture. the atmosphere of the home is peaceful and welcoming, making it the perfect place for solitude and relaxation. i wanted to extend my stay, but unfortunately, the dates were already booked. even as a brooklyn resident, i can see myself returning whenever i need a quiet retreat. this house is truly blessed, and i’m grateful for the experience. i absolutely recommend putting this at the top of your list when considering visiting brooklyn and where to stay! 10/10 - great job kamran!
nice, spacious studio apartment with ample lighting, located on one of the cleanest streets i’ve seen in new york.
the place was clean and as advertised. rooms clean, spacious, nicely decorated. every time we communicated, steven replied promptly. the metro is very close. it was a good experience.
hyacinth was such a nice host, she helped us a lot during our stay in new york and made us feel like home. thank you for everything!! :d
the house was just as described, cesar was an amazing host we had a great stay here.
very good plawto stay, very easy access to transport to manhattan and shops. that was also the closest i have been near a friendly dog😉

was easy to find and there’s walkable parking nearby that’s not too pricey depending on the length of your stay. the bathroom smelled like cigarettes which is why i didn’t rate it higher but other than that it was a decent stay. would come back again!

georges apartment has an excellent location very close to times square. lots of good places to eat nearby. communication was easy, check in and out easy and flexible. georges is very welcoming :) the room has a very confy bed and air conditioning. we recommend staying with georges!

this is a great studio on the upper east side. i stayed for the entire month of january. at the time, nyc was in a deep freeze. fortunately, the apartment had plenty of heat and hot water. the kitchen is spacious with a high ceiling, a full-sized refrigerator, and a place to sit. there is a good-sized desk in the living area. i was on zoom a lot during my stay, and i always had internet access. the star of the show is the bed. not only is it big, it's also very comfortable and cozy. the neighborhood is safe and there are lots of restaurants and grocery stores in the area. the subway is about a 10-minute walk and taxis and ubers are readily available. the hosts were friendly and responded quickly. i had one small light issue and it was repaired by the next day. the building itself can be a bit lively, but that is just life in the big city. overall, it's a wonderful little home away from home.

this was such a great stay! i would definitely stay here with my little baby again. both of the hosts were so sweet, organized, easy to access with any questions and in general very kind personable people! 5/5! i would highly recommend.

really lovely apartment - just as it looks in the photos. super comfortable big bed, beautifully equipped kitchen, great goodies left for breakfasts, and great local eateries suggested by maribel very near by. yes harlem is a bit mixed, and yes it is quite a way on the subway to the main sights - but station is close by, and when you are back at the flat you really feel like you are living like a new yorker. lovely stay, highly recommended.
great stay in a very nice part of williamsburg, easy in and out great location!!
perfect hotel, thanks a lot for your work!
great spot for exploring the heart of new york city.
great hotel, in a nice area with access to a park within walking distance. everything was accommodated for with plenty of space.
very private and spacious. would recommend.

having a private back garden was an absolute must after a long day of visiting the ny sights. also we had the best pizza of our lives at ops and it’s quite close to the airbnb. sammir was super flexible with checkout time and we appreciated that with little kids. thanks guys for a great stay
m social was perfect place for us, a family of 3. easy access to subways, employees friendly and helpful would definitely stay here again and recommend it to anyone

wonderful stay! you cannot get a better neighborhood - it truly feels like a small town in the middle of manhattan and the apartment is extremely quiet. the team was extremely responsive throughout my stay. we will absolutely be back!!

convenient location, safe building. i was to check in at 9 pm and i walked in after 9 pm but my room was not ready, host’s partner was doing the bed. so i left and returned after an hour to find crumpled bedsheet on and equally crumpled pillow case, halfway through on the lonely pillow, and not in a proper way. all available electric sockets via connections were dead. there was a weird smell. place was ok yet not ok. i do not know what else to say. oh and if you are driving.. this location can be a nightmare! no parking.
olas residence is comfortable and clean, he is very responsive, communicable and will go the extra length for his guests. i would recommend him to my family and friends!
the place was really calm and clean , a little far from my work , but i didn’t want to leave , unfortunately the day after was already booked , i recommended! and will definitely come back

last-minute booking between evening arrival at jfk and morning departure at lga. close to eateries and a bus line. irina was responsive online and had little sweet treats waiting for us. the kitchen was great to heat up dinner leftovers for breakfast. cute, clean, and convenient accommodations. would stay again & recommend.
awesome stay in nice neighborhood, everything perfect and as described
second time staying with christophe & felix and definitely will be staying again next time we are in ny! wonderful hosts, & great neighborhood ☺️

sophie's apartment is perfect if you are looking for a budget accommodation in new york. it is clean and offers all the amenities you need. it is 10mins walking from the closest tube station, but it takes a while to get to manhattan or other areas of brooklyn in the evening or weekends.
nice size room with private bath. very clean place and the bus stop is right at the corner. great value!
great location and stay just needs to be cleaned throughly before swapping new residents.

j is a great conversationalist and was very hospitable. it was great hearing about his upcoming projects and inspirations. i stayed for a week and he was accommodating when i needed to extend my stay. we did have some issues with the temperature of the shower during my stay (which he noted he was working on fixing).

we enjoyed our stay, the apartment is fantastic and comfortable, the beds are comfy, kitchen is well equipped. very easy to find and access the apartment. subway station within a short walking distance. neighborhood is nice and quiet. we'll come back!
amazing stay! very clean house. host was extremely responsive and left clear directions for everything. would definitely stay again!

this space is quite simply a jewel. every return visit is better and better! quiet,peaceful and roomy. nyc access is easy when you need to go in.both the j train and the lirr are less than a 15 minute walk. if you want to stay in. queens- then lounging in this glorious space is easy and relaxing . if you drive-a parking space can be challenging so allow extra time. joel and jaribel are excellent hosts who are available with rapid response to any issues. looking forward to our next stay!

we loved staying here! it was exactly how it appears in the pictures, and great location. the price was great for the time of year we went (right before christmas) and it was such an added benefit that we could store our luggage there without added expenses. we will definitely look into this location next time we come to the city!
