brendan was a great host! my family and i - 6 of us had a very comfortable stay in his beautiful home. the home is exactly as shown in pictures. there was more than enough room for all of us. the place was well stocked with pots, pans, plates, cups, silverware, linens, toilet paper, paper towels, etc. he stopped by the next day to deliver more toilet paper and paper towels. there was even hand soap in one of the bathrooms. we came in late at night and tired, the last thing we wanted to do was to go out looking for hand soap, so that was a very nice touch! overall, we had a very pleasant stay and would definitely love to stay here again if we come back to the new york area. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
great value for a room in nyc - don't expect too much on the breakfast though

i warmly recommend the experience of staying with rachael. upon arrival i found the building older than i had expected, and i mistakenly thought the bathroom was private, while actually it is shared with her. but during a whole week none of this mattered. i never once had to wait to use the bathroom, and toilet, sink and shower were always perfectly clean. i found the room comfortable, and had plenty of pillows and clean bath towels. rachael was extremely caring and welcoming, and i found the neigbourhood friendly and safe, as well as very convenient for the subway. totally worth the experience!
100 meters from the subway, in the same block. 20 minutes to time square. quiet neighborhood and confrotable room. renata responds quickly, always available.
highly recommend this spot mike is very communicative and his place is stunning! the heat system had an issue but there was a small space heater available for use so it was ok.

great place clean and private just what i look for when i’m out on the road working. also rolando is an excellent host helped me out finding the place very pleasant to deal with i’ll definitely be back again

i lived here for 3 months and my stay was amazing. my room was nice & spacious and the kitchen & bathroom offered everything i needed. the shared spaces were always very clean, which was a plus. the location is perfect, very close to the subway (red line). vanessa is a great host, you can text her whenever you want and she will always answer and help you immediately!! very happy i chose this place for my short term stay in nyc, so totally recommend. thank you vanessa!
great host! even better human being!

great stay. convenient location (1min walk to subway line j - then easy access to brooklyn and manhattan), comfortable & clean place. quiet neighborhood and house. was really good especially for that price. sweet attention for us, like water bottle, cereals and fresh milk for breakfast, extra blanket.
i'll be back. as good as it gets
great stay! rodolfo is an amazingly accommodating host and his place is clean, cool, and secure in a very comfy neighborhood. definitely would book again!

stayed at robert's place for five nights in june - a lovely nest in a nice and quiet area, a couple of blocks walk from subway. robert and cristina were the most charming and easy-going hosts and we felt really welcome. the only thing perhaps, ac was very noisy so bring earplugs for the night when staying in summer.
great location to stay, price is right, and the hosts are very friendly. shout out to ravindra!

niko's apartment is close to nearly everything in manhattan. if you're happy to walk, you can walk pretty much everywhere, otherwise there are plenty of subway stations nearby. there are tonnes of food options around, and plenty to do. the room itself is a good size, the bed is comfy and everything was clean. the wifi was very quick! niko is so friendly, he gave us ideas on what to do and was just great to chat to. we would happily stay here again next time we're in new york.
this place was honestly perfect for our group of 6! the pictures don’t do it justice! it was really clean and everything in the house was very organized. a really cute place!

gorgeous space and great location! the hosts were very responsive and welcoming. the neighborhood was very quiet and i felt totally safe staying there. add in free wifi and and hulu and netflix, and you’re all set for a great stay.
do not hesitate. she is a great superhot and deserve even more. great and very safe location.
great stay, kind receptionist, rooms had no issues and would love to come back and stay there again
my girlfriend and me stayed at kathryn´s for 4 days and i highly recommend her place. we felt it like home.
felt very safe and the room was exactly as described. thanks!
great accommodations and walking distance to everything! i highly recommend!

came to this house after a terrible ordeal at a diff rental, was late at night and the host couldn't be more accommodating. would love to visit again being that this place had a very positive vibe. thx again would recommend to anybody.
great hotel, low price and super friendly
we had a great stay. walking distance from many cool locations. good pizza and nice coffee bar right next door.

great, cozy place! stayed for a month and the area was nice, relatively quiet with lots of things to do. easy access to the q and 6 line. had large kitchen table used as a co working spot. kitchen appliances worked well.

really cool shared space. the other tenants i met there were very welcoming. very relaxed atmosphere. no luck on room which might be an issue for some but it didn't bother me. you will hear everything in the main area so ear plugs are advised if you are a light sleeper.

we reached out to pol about his beautiful space because we were looking for a comfortable place to stay and work for our first ny wedding. pol and his daughter kara were incredibly kind and responsive to our every need from our first inquiry to our booking through to our arrival. the place was so lovely in design, very spacious and immaculately clean. my assistant and i felt comfortable and so at home. i was also surprised by how quiet it was, something i did not expect so close to manhattan. the central location made it so easy to get everywhere we needed to in the city and far enough away from the metropolis to make us feel comfortable and safe in the evenings. pol was sure to greet us after giving us a few days to settle in and we were very happy with his hospitality. i was so happy with the stay that i am recommending this airbnb to all my jet-setting colleagues in the industry. highly recommend for families, personal vacation or work travel!

we had an amazing time at nate’s place! room was good, kitchen was great (it turned into a tradition to end the day with drinks with shaved ice from the fridgedoor) and the area was perfect for us. some great little coffeeshops and restaurants around. the other guests staying at the apartement were superfriendly as well. would stay here again in a heartbeat!

kevin’s place was great! close to groceries (whole foods) restaurants, and public transportation. it was clean and had everything we needed. bed was comfortable. we had a 22 month old with us so the stairs were a bit worrisome but we knew that going into it. no air conditioner downstairs but the air did flow downstairs and the little fan helped. great for 1-2 people.

i had a fabulous time in new york, and a little part of that was because of kate, her little dog blu and the authentic place. during my stay at kate's place, she was on vacation herself. her friend was there to welcome me very friendly and explained everything. the little dog "blu" was indeed very lovely and welcomed me every time i came back from a trip to the city. for the loft: what you see is what you get. the photos are very accurate. one thing to keep in mind is that the apartment is directly next to the bridge, and trains are going there till late night. you will hear them. for me that was part of the experience, but others may be annoyed by that noise.
very nice location, close to everything you need. clean studio. host is very helpful and definitely thought about every single detail to make sure you will be enjoying your stay.

we enjoyed our stay with michael, he was friendly and helpful with local information. the apartment was a decent size with a good living area, and space in the bedroom to spread out a bit. the bunks were comfortable. it is 4 flights of stairs to walk up with your bags but that also makes it quieter at night, and warm. we were close to lots of interesting and useful shops, wholefoods where you can get buffet breakfasts, hot soup etc., lots of coffee and food places, not far to penn, art galleries around, and you can walk easily to flatiron, fashion ave and other interesting locations. great location, great guy.
fabulous stay! great communication and the apartment was very comfortable.

daniel is great, quick to respond and very accommodating. this was my first time sharing an apartment, i usually rent the entire space. i would have preferred more privacy, the walls are thin, and the quarters are tight, so i heard my housemates as clear as day despite being in my room. having said that, it was worth the low rent for me.
great location and an amazing space

i just stayed overnight and even though i arrived quite late, carmen was very friendly and helpful. the neighborhood seemed safe, the room and bathroom were great. extremely convenient to go to la guardia airport. will definitely stay there again.
great place, gets the job done for travelers coming in late to jfk. try to book early, i think they raise the rates if you book same day.

ting yi’s place was very pleasant soothing and just a relief . i honestly couldn’t ask for anything more .. maybey a extra t.v in the room but i told her that she has a tv in the master bedroom ok the first floor for those interested. every day waking up i had to remind my self it wasn’t my home i got so comfortable and was at peace i did not want to check out that was the saddest part of the trip having to leave such a calm beautiful place in brooklyn .
home was perfect for a quick weekend trip. very spacious with good amenities, i would definitely go back!

xenia's place is great if you're looking for a good deal. xenia was very communicative and everything was easy. the room i was in was spacious and sharing the bathroom wasn't a problem at all. it's right next to a beautiful park where i would play basketball and the train is only a ten minute walk. there's also a great breakfast/coffee spot and deli right on the block. i would stay here again. make sure you bring a roku or apple tv though if you want to watch things. the tv is nice though. hooked up easily with my roku. thanks xenia!
a perfect place to stay for visiting williamsburg, brooklyn. convenient to everything! subway, restaurants, parks, shopping. we will definitely stay here again! jess does an amazing job.
very clean and cozy place in a vibrant neighborhood. quite fast to get to manhattan with a express subway. the hosts are very friendly and welcoming.

jenny is a great host! despite our late arrival at 11:30 pm she met us and did introduction to the house and the neighborhood. the apartment itself is really spacious, bright, clean, filled with a lot of cool artworks on the walls and very comfy big bed and linens . the kitchen is equipped with everything you may need during the long-term stay. the neighborhood feels pretty safe. the nearest g-line’s subway station “myrtle–willoughby” is about 7 min walk from the house. in the nearest (within 5 min walk) big supermarket “lincoln market” you will find the wide selection of the eco/organic products and various tasty prepared food in the deli section. ps: the charming and unexpected bonus of the apartment is a quirky local squirrel that you will see from time to time in the mornings right in front of your windows.
perfect location! the room was well appointed and nice personal touches for guests! host was super responsive and helpful when assisting with a few concerns upon check-in.

the place is just as advertised and very well kept. the location of this place is perfect! we very much appreciated the quite neighborhood and ability to walk to prospect park and various restaurants. brian and rachel also were so welcoming and prompt responders to messages. you can’t go wrong with staying here.
lovely place and lovely host! she was very helpful and kind. would definitely recommend to anyone.

this was my first time using airbnb for a long-term stay so i was a little apprehensive at first, but as soon as i checked in i felt right at home. it is really set up for you to have as much freedom as possible, the stay was so private at times i forgot i had roommates lol, i will truly miss my time spent here. andrew was essentially my landlord because my stay was so long, and any issue i experienced he resolved in 24hrs or less. when the a/c unit needed to be replaced he made it happen on labor day! rain or shine, andrew was available and incredibly kind. i'd recommend this place for anyone looking for a comfortable, stress free stay. i have nothing but great things to say about andrew, his family, and his lovely home, i wish i could've stayed longer haha.

my trip to new york city was worderful. blanca and ted's place was perfect for my visit. short walks to the subway made it super easy to go anywhere in the city. central park is nearby and there are plenty of shops and restaurants in the neighborhood if you choose to stay close to home. the area is safe and i've already made reservations to stay with blanca and ted at the spaha house again in late september. thank you so much for the warm, welcoming hospitality!!
i’m so glad we found this hotel on airbnb, it was much more affordable than other hotels, and a very convenient location
nice place and nice location!
loved staying here, great location, good price, good communication, easy check in. room was clean and comfortable with a nice bathroom. would definitely stay here again.

we spent 8 days at sarah' s and we were very satisphied with everything. the place was clean, instructions easy to follow and as we like our peace, nobody disturbed us during the stay. the temperatures were pretty high but sarah did what she could to keep us cool. the location of the flat is in a very interesting neighborhood, ať a convenient distance from main attractions.
antonio was an amazing host husband place was nicer than he described, very private and very clean and super comfortable, i definitely recommend his place and him as a host!!
it is a very nice appartement in harlem; everything went well. ig you want to use the appoartement for seven persons it is a litle bit small.
good location, peaceful & clean.
great location, great price. 15mins walk to flushing downtown
i’ve stayed here before and love it. sunlit, impeccably clean, super private: like a hotel but in bushwick, which is way more fun.

it was my first traveling with airbnb and i was really very happy to have karen and her husband being my hosts. the room was very comfortable and exactly the same as in the pictures. the location was very convenient and easy to orient. the hosts were very friendly and talented. i would definitely recommend the place to my friends.
cozy, clean, and quiet!! perfect getaway!
the check in was easy and the room was clean. the parking was easy to find i would come back again!

our stay was phenomenal! aracelis and her husband made certain that we had everything we needed, i even remember one night when i wanted to watch tv and the power cable was missing i messaged her at around 1:30am not expecting to hear back until the next morning, but i was pleasantly surprised to get a response back asap and her husband came upstairs to give me the power cable needed. 10/10 would recommend
it was a great place to stay and close to other spots i wanted to see in the city! would absolutely recommend to people looking for a hotel-alternative.
very clean, friendly, and nice place to stay
happy with the stay
everything was perfect ... can not wait to go back!
toby’s place was spacious, spotless, and well-maintained. the bed was very comfortable, and the location was great—close to the train and surrounded by delicious restaurants. highly recommend!
the apartment was well kept, checkin was smooth, my early checkin request was also handled with no charge. free street parking which is a bonus. i never had any difficulty finding a spot.
friendly staff delicious breakfast great location

probably the most beautiful studio space i’ve ever seen, airbnb or not! my boyfriend and i kept talking about how we never thought we could live in a studio until we spent a weekend in this one - everything was beautiful, comfy, and made perfect use of the space! the bed was super comfy and there was even a pendleton blanket (my favorite!!) to get cozy with. the kitchen was great for cooking and had all sorts of cute retro touches. there’s a really nice little corner store less than a block away and the subway is right there as well as a bagel shop so you have everything you need! can’t recommend this space enough and i can’t wait to go back next time i’m in the city. hosts were very proactive in communication too - awesome experience overall!

alice was an excellent host. she was easy to communicate with and accommodating when our arrival time changed at the last minute. the apartment was as described and shown in the photos and parking was available. although there were no animals in the apartment, it smelled of cats which may be an issue for some one with allergies.
amazing location, spotlessly clean. super quick responses to queries, would highly recommend.

could not be happier with the stay! everything from the beautiful apartment to the wonderful area was perfect. adam was a great host with detailed instructions for a super easy check in and quick responses. would recommend this place to anyone staying in brooklyn

expect to feel right at home. jeannie offered to pick us up from the train station but i unfortunately had already ordered a lyft. she treated myself and my guests as family, she has a beautiful home and a place you really feel safe, welcome and respected. people like jeannie and homes such as hers truly make a difference. my trip had some unexpected turns but my time spent at jeannie’s was definitely a light at the end of the tunnel. stay here!

the space was very clean and pristine, located in a nice neighborhood that is close to lively main st. i enjoyed my stay here as it was very private and the host communicated amazingly fast when i had questions, looking forward to staying again
great place well located for subway. lots to do locally and easy to get to downtown manhattan. very kind and responsive hosts, highly recommended.

the apt is beautifully decorated and homey. check in and check out were hassle free. during my stay they ensured i was comfortable and assisted with guiding me around the city. i had no issues or complaints. if staying in the brooklyn area they are highly recommended. well worth the stay!
excellent location. bathrooms could use some updating.

the check-in was friendly and we were thankful for the opportunity to drop off suitcases earlier. we came back to the property at 20:00. however, it was the first time in my 12 years on airbnb when the host's family was making so much noise during so called "quiet hours". between 22:00 and 01:00 i personally was woken up 3 times by the host's family: it was either screaming child or loud adults. at 01:00 i had to ask the host family member to be quiet. after that the loud talking stoped, but the walking back and forth to the bathroom continued. the household went quiet only at 02:30 and there was no sleep for me any more. i left the house around 05:00 for my early flight. my adult daughter later told me that she did not sleep all night either for the same reasons. the bed was smallish, the room is tiny and hot. hugely overpriced. no sleep. there are so many requests to "respect this and that" (coming from the host), but not much was given back during that night. not recommended.

this well-located hotel served our family of four adults well. the beds were very comfortable, and it was great having 2 bathrooms. some of the reviews we read prior to booking referenced significant noise. we did not have any issues with noise whatsoever. i recommend!
it’s was nice and clean!

the place was clean, quiet and as described. beware the host has a very proactive kitty and it’s mentioned in the ad so be careful. the hosts are quiet and nice. there’s lots to do in the area you just have to find it. also this apartment was plus size friendly. i would stay here again.
great place to stay, very clean and safe! close to the metro and various restaurants.

room was pretty clean and i barely saw other people in the apartment. it was very close to subway, the only problem was the noise that was coming from the heater pipe once in a while and woke me up in the middle of the night:(

it was a quiet place, kitchen was complete. bathroom was very small and we cleaned the bath, because it was a bit dirty. laura was very handsome and gentle and offered us to stay a bit longer, before we went to the airport. she is a nice host.
very clean and bigger than what it appeared in pictures. in walking distance to so many authentic chinese restaurants and a cute coffee and pastry shop. also, very close to lirr. very friendly host.
would stay again

evan's apartment is one of the nicest places we've stayed with airbnb. it is close to the subway and to activities in manhattan. it is a comfortable and enjoyable apartment. ditto to all the other positive reviews.
it was very conveniently placed in chelsea

very nice studio, clean space, safe. kitchen is stocked with a ton of cooking supplies. big closet, big windows, big tv that easily connects with devices via apple tv. nice markets, restaurants, and a food hall nearby. not to mention the parks around the area: central park, riverside park, and this middle courtyard of sorts.
pretty dangerous place would not recommend to anybody. locals of new york, had their eyebrows raised when we told them where we were.

we loved this apartment. self contained, super clean and heaps of room. really nicely decorated. it’s in a local brooklyn neighbourhood but easy enough to see the sights of new york. lauren and anthony were away when we stayed but gave us clear instructions and were easy to contact when we needed anything. we love brooklyn!
laurence is an exceptional host and the accommodations and location are excellent. he is a warm and thoughtful soul. we recommend him to anyone who is looking for an outstanding brooklyn experience.

amazing property. sparkling clean. fantastic location. beautiful property. house has everything one would need. beautiful beautiful property. by far the most beautiful property we have visited. host is very responsive.

i came from the west coast to here and to have razia as my host was amazing! she’s super attentive and supportive. her communication is great. the place we stayed in was clean, very private, and it felt like home. what you see in the pictures is what you get. the beds are comfortable and the bathroom + bedrooms are really spacious. when she said queens is the place to be, it truly is! the food places around here are great and there’s many options. there is flavor and the portions are great. the area is very cultural and it‘s easy to get places. you can definitely tell and feel that jackson heights is a community and that made my friends and i feel good. the mall is nearby if you want to shop and manhattan + brooklyn is not far at all by transit. this is a great place to stay, especially during a long stay! i definitely would come back again.

mateo and gregory are so wonderful at hosting and knowledgeable about the area and happenings in brooklyn. i definitely felt like i was at home here! definitely recommend even if just for a short stay, but if you are coming to brooklyn for a while, stay the whole time! you won’t regret any part of it. they were very responsive/kind/lighthearted folks, the room, bed, and bathroom (well the whole house i’m sure) were sparkling clean, and the location is just fantastic.
sean’s place is great. quiet hood but close to dumbo and trains. it was very easy checking in and the place has great amenities. highly recommend!

i stayed at cynthia's place for almost two months. the location is perfect; close to union square which is a big subway hub, and walking distance to tons of amazing restaurants. cynthia is a friendly and accommodating host -- she gave me lots of great recommendations for places to check out and restaurants to try in the neighborhood. the apartment is super clean and quiet. no problems of any kind during my relatively long stay. i'd recommend this place to any solo traveler.
fantastic host. very good location. will definitely recommend. will be back.

this was a perfect space for me, a solo traveler meeting friends in the city. i was able to relax in comfort, cook food in the lovely open kitchen, and share a meal with friends in the backyard. the bed was very comfortable. i’m familiar with the neighborhood but the location of the apartment was perfect, some great restaurants/bars very nearby, cute little stores, and mostly quiet location especially for a garden level unit. anna was a very communicative and welcoming host. would definitely stay again.

when i arrived the first night, it was dark, and a group of guys was hanging in front of a building next to the house. we left because it was too noisy and the smell of drugs. the next day my daughter returned and was locked up in one of the bedrooms due to being in fear. we tried to use the living room tv, and the wifi was not working. in addition, some of the windows were broken. look like a bullet hole in one window. manager stated someone would come. i refused due to i was feeding my mother dinner. but, someone came down from an upstairs apartment and said the wifi should work, but it never worked. i noticed a disconnected wire. the day was hot, so we tried to open the door, and then i saw the group of guys again; this time, i noticed one of them was armed. the manager called me simultaneously, and i told her we could not stay. she asked why, and i told her i would call or text. my mom was in a wheelchair, so we had to get her out first, and i packed up my family and left.

johan is a great host! the check-in details were clear, the room looked exactly as advertised, and the location is a 15min walk from the subway station to take you places. johan was also kind enough to provide some local recommendations, and the room had a brief summary of the area in print, which was a great starting point for navigation.
check in process was seamless. location is accessible to multiple train stations and easily walkable distance to atlantic terminal.

our stay was amazing and reginald really helped make sure we had everything we needed. it was my first time visiting the city and our original place was cancelled by the host. reginald accepted our request right away after scrambling to find somewhere to stay. he made check in easy and checked in with us regularly to make sure everything was going well. he also recommended great food and suggested things to do in the city. the apartment is very clean and comfortable. we felt right at home and were able to rest comfortably after exploring the city. i definitely recommend staying here!
a wonderful place to stay! highly recommend!

this sunny apartment is a perfect place to explore nyc from! it’s close to public transit and less than a mile from prospect park where you can run, bike, see free concerts and go to smorgasburg ( lots of foot stands) in the summer. there’s also a great haitian restaurant on the corner and coffee shop two blocks away, as well as a nearby grocery store. we had a very comfortable 5 day stay here

we highly recommend joseph's place. it was our first complete experience on airbnb and we couldn't be more grateful. the apartment is located in a quiet block in a beautiful neighborhood surrounded of many restaurants and coffee places. greenpoint is great for those who want to live in brooklyn and easy come and go to manhattan. joseph was very communicative and easy-going. he answered all our questions instantly and allowed us to stay at the apartment until 4pm, making our going to the airport much more easy. definitely great apartment! thank you very much and hope to come back soon!
great place in the best neighborhood in nyc. you have a lot of places around. cozy and confortable room.
good location, friendly staff, check in process very easy.
great host, huge space and an awesome location to hit all the top sites!

very happy with my stay at daniela’s!! the building was charming and i felt like i was getting an authentic nyc experience. the train being a five minute walk, it was easy and cheap to explore several parts of the city. although it was freezing outside when we visited, the apartment was a warm and cozy oasis. we had everything we needed and more and i felt right at home :) my partner was worried about staying in a shared space, but we didn’t even see the other guests and they were respectful of the space. we did meet daniela, who is absolutely lovely. i would definitely stay here again and i recommend it to anyone!
wonderful place with a location that can’t be beat, we enjoyed 4 lovely days here and would definitely stay again.
clean, modern studio is very comfortable and perfect for a short stay in brooklyn. r, j was responsive, understanding and made me feel as if i was at home. highly recommended! thank you!!
great place to stay, very clean and responsive host!
the place is so short, there is literally no place to stand in the room. it has one shower for 20 ppl, i had to wait for 15 mins. add to that the staff is so rude, there are not at all hospitable

thank you, thank you, thank you. i loved staying with you. i feel so lucky to have found you and your place. once gain, if you ever want to come out to ca. and see the giant trees, come see me, and i'll give you a great deal. i hope to be back again soon!!!
we really liked the apartment as it offered us what we needed. it was clean and comfortable and the communication with the owners was very easy.
this place is in a fabulous location. just a 5 minute walk to the highline. immediate neighborhood has great local restaurants and many options for groceries.
my home in the bronx
love it love it love it great location and the room is awesome
romel was a great host and accommodated well for my trip! very responsive and helpful! definitely the best airbnb host i’ve had would definitely recommend and most certainly would stay again!
great location, extremely clean, great hosts!

prime location, cant be beat! comfy and quality furnishings, do note the bedroom and living room windows face the wall of the opposite building and the building’s interior - it gets next to no sunlight. having a passcode alternative to the app for unlocking doors was very helpful. there was loud renovation going on in the apartment next door for about a week during the stay. fenix are responsive and accomodating hosts!

mike’s place was great! super clean, and super close to transit stops which i can’t express how convenient that was for us! mike was great at communicating and even offered us a list of places to visit, along with a whole basket of brochures for attractions! would def recommend for a nice weekend in ny!
it was a great.

cute place in crown heights neighborhood in brooklyn. neighbors in building were very, very friendly which was a nice change from some other places i’ve stayed where the neighbors weren’t too thrilled about having an airbnb next to their home. it is directly across the street from brower park in what seems to be a very family oriented carribean neighborhood. for those taking public transportation, the nearest subway station (kingston–throop) is about a 10 minute walk away, and there is a bus station around the corner next to park. the apartment itself is very cozy and clean. i’ve read some other reviews, and i’d you are expected a luxury hotel stay then this is not for you. if you are expecting what the host describes which is cozy and clean actually-lived-in apartment then it will happily meet your expectations. there aren’t really sponges or towels to do dishes, but we mostly ate out anyway. if you happen to be looking for a vegan plant-based meal nearby, i highly recommend greedi kitchen about an 8 min walk away on bergen. for coffee lovers, i recommend cotton bean which is on the same street.
extremely nice host, great location, beautiful patio. small space, but everything i needed.

this was an excellent choice. i wanted a covid safe astoria rental with easy parking and this place was a great find. dedicated off street parking, a full kitchen and an excellent bakery down the street were outstanding features. the studio was cheerful, well designed and modern. i slept well on a very comfortable bed. laura was a pleasure to work with and also provided a variety of drinks and snacks.
rosa is the best. this is a great location and you couldn't ask for more at such affordable rates. when i am back in nyc i am definitely staying at rosa's.

great place to stay visiting new york with the kids. with the subway station nearby, it was a perfect place to start our visits to manhattan and other parts of new york. and of course a perfect place to experience brooklyn. shelley, the host, helped us out "big time" when we realized we made a booking error, and needed accommodation for one extra night. #gratefull ;-)

jak's place was very comfortable, well located with a great washer/ dryer. the kitchen appliances worked fine, however they could use more glassware & pots & pans. coffeemaker was great. the communication & response time were excellent. when we had trouble with the tv, natalya immediately helped us to connect. we really enjoyed our time in rockaway beach.
great host and a very nice apartment well served by public transport

“adam’s place was exactly as described and looked just like the photos. it was very clean with a warm, cozy feel. the neighborhood was walkable, with local stores and coffee shops nearby, and transportation was close for those who didn’t drive adam was incredibly responsive and readily available to answer all of my questions. i would happily stay here again. thank you so much for sharing your cozy home!”
great place to stay
lovely and simple place that was put together with care. very clean! and new appliances everywhere. highly recommend!
very welcoming and friendly host in a great location. apartment was very clean and comfortable, recommended!
someone's home
beautiful house only 10 min walk to subway and 1 min to bus stop. perfect for a group. lovely kitchen and dining area. comfortable beds. as described. thank you.
we had a terrific stay here, and were pleasantly surprised by the breakfast each morning…well worth the stay!

this is a clean and comfortable apartment on a relatively quiet block. my husband and i stayed for a weekend and it gave us easy access to the upper west side where we were visiting family. the apartment definitely feels like you are staying in someone's home and not like a traditional vacation rental (personal photos and belongings are all around), but the overall experience was positive.
great location! clean. great check-in experience.
you get what you pay for but could definitely do with some more cleaning on weekly basis and more cleaner bed sheets and cleaner bathroom. the rest was fine. city is about 1.5hrs from the place.

have stayed here multiple times and will continue to do so. the property is clean, well located and the rooms, while small, are very comfortable. love the addition of the cafe. our favorite place to stay in nyc.
chris was super responsive at all times!!! apartment was decorated cute

this house is really comfortable. the location is great too. the host is very kind and helpful for guest. i and my daughter hope we stay here when we visit new york again. we already miss new york. thank you for leaving us good memories in new york.

the bnb was clean, great location, at check in the staff was nice. i gave low ratings because when i returned after a night on the town, my code to get into the hotel didn’t work. i tried contacting the host and no response. as a solo traveler, stranded outside in nyc, it was cold and rainy that weekend, i had none of my things because they were in the bnb, and it’s was at 1:30am, so nothing was open at this time. this was scary to say the least, and i had to book a last minute hotel around the corner soi would be stranded on the streets. i’m sure if i didn’t have that experience with the key pad i probably would’ve enjoyed my stay there, but after being traumatized, i requested airbnb make other arrangements for the remainder of my stay.
the home was very nice, spacious and well decorated. the hosts are very friendly. it has everything you need in it. overall, we had an amazing stay !
great location in a quiet area of nyc. very easy to get anywhere in the city. my bed was very comfortable and we had everything we needed. the host was extremely responsive.
lori's space is spic and span clean, and comfortable in a safe and very convenient location. somewhat dated living room furniture but a good value.

great location, close to multiple subway lines. not much in the neighbourhood, but easy to get to places where the action is! very easy to get to from the airport, and wes and jess had everything set up and ready for us to go. i loved the message board on the door to our room - such a friendly touch! they also had information about the city (brochures, maps, etc.) conveniently laid out on a table in the apartment to help us plan our trip. everything went smoothly and we had a great time! un gros merci, wes and jess!
very nice room. we liked the heated towels even tho that seems frivolous. lol!
everything was amazing will be back soon
a clean lodging. 10 minute walk to metro station. generally safe neighborhood but i would not walk alone at night. neighborhood a little strewn with garbage. excellent lodging for the cost.
had a great stay, very good communication the whole through to check in. space was great and perfect for a get away.
perfect spot for a brooklyn stay!

jon is an exceptional host. if you are fortunate enough to stay at his place, you will want to return again and again. it is so comfortable and cozy. close to central park, the met, museums, time square and subway stations for excursions further away. and if you want to save money by eating in ... terrific places for take out, no matter what your taste. enjoy.
great stay! a few issues at the beginning, but all were eventually resolved. room is so spacious, and the private bathroom is nice.
great stay, easy location
clean and convenient place to stay. the host reached me 2 days earlier to make sure i can check in smoothly

the rooms were clean and the communication was perfect.(as it was really hot this weekend after a single request we got an ac). the location was alright but i wouldn’t recommend it to walk around on your own after a certain hour there. although it took like an hour to get to manhattan it was really easy.- a bus and a subway(1 transfer)
we had a great stay. nyeelah was quick with communication and offered flexibility which was super appreciated.
really convenient location. spotless apartment with the most comfortable mattress i've slept on apart from my own!
it’s really nice of veronica,she’s absolutely perfect owner i met ever,everything goes smoothly in new york.the house was gorgeous,everything is perfect

this place was great for a weekend trip. the location has great bars/restaurants/stores all within walking distance. the check in was easy which was great since our flight arrived later at night. the space was clean and stylish. my husband and i had an amazing time.

we loved our stay in brooklyn! the apartment is in a great location for exploring both brooklyn and manhattan. it's only a 10 minute walk from the subway, but also a 10 minute walk to some lovely restaurants and shops in the neighbourhood. we went to dot and line for some lovely coffee which was recommended by paget. one thing we would highly recommend in brooklyn is visiting the botanic gardens - it was a highlight of our trip and truly an oasis of calm within the craziness of the city. pagets apartment had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. we loved the garden, especially watching the fireflies in the evening. thanks for a lovely stay.

ryan was a great host! he accepted my last-minute (same day!!) request after my hotel room was cancelled and was extremely nice and kind to me during my stay in his place. his place is located in a great area, within walking distance to many great bars and restaurants, and it's an easy commute to manhattan. also, i must say that the bedroom has a great view of ny's skyline :)
im very grateful to connect with this hospitable family, they made me feel at home, with a very good location and beautiful village highly recommended🙏
great location close to public transport and felt safe walking home at night. the private kitchenette and bathroom was such a bonus and made the place definitely worth the price!
we booked a last minute room a the manhattan club. the valet and check in was easy! the room was great and we loved the location. would definitely recommend it. we will be back!

great location, roof is wonderful, easy check in and check out. rooms are definitely small, but good for one person. bathroom was clean, bed mattress could have been better, sunk in too much, seemed tired and worn. wifi was a bit slow. overall location and rooftop vibe was perfect for a short trip.

diana is very welcoming, and the place is cool, with unique deco and nice backyard. having a bathroom (very neat) to myself inside the bedroom really was perfect! the place is easy to find, close to subway stations and buses. if i come back to brooklyn, i hope i get the chance to book one of the rooms here. thx diana!

we had a great time during our stay! the place is located in a quiet part of astoria and is about a 10 min walk from the subway. it is also a 15 minute walk to the ferry stop, which i recommend taking at least once as it provides a great view of the manhattan. conveniently located nearby are a deli, grocery market (c-town) and liquor store all within 5 minute walking distance for essential needs. the apartment has great amenities to accommodate for a long stay. outside of the listed amenities, they had central heating as well as individual ac/heating units in every room so we had a comfortable stay throughout our stay there.
great place!

we really enjoyed our stay at goran's apartment. the best thing about it is the location: just a few steps from the subway, and a few minutes from manhattan. the neighborhood is really cool too, tho a bit noisy at night. goran is a really friendly and helpful host.

what made our trip amazing was that annie’s location made getting anywhere so easy! between a good pick up or drop off for an uber or access to subway. we loved the subway so didn’t use bus system. we walked in and were just smiling and in awe of this cozy space that’s even warmer in person than the pictures. this was what i think anyone wants on vacation. a great location with enough space for those traveling with you. a kitchen big enough to cook in but small enough it doesn’t take away from the beautiful woodwork in the home that gives it such beauty and personality. we did what we needed and got moving in the am, shopped, made a quick run to 5th avenue for shipping and then took subway back to annie’s dropped bags and got right back on the subway to go catch a show on moulin rouge (phenomenal btw). seriously just so close to all transportation and so simple to get in and out of the airbnb. we literally were in and out in like 8 minutes. (four women)
this is a great space in nyc. the apartment is exceptionally furnished and has great views.
very nice and cozy little place in beorum hill. great access to many different subway lines. also close to other cool brooklyn neighborhoods.

the flat of michael and angela is located in a quiet and nice area of brooklyn, very convenient to explore both brooklyn and manhattan. the tube is at 10 mnts walking distance, you can easily reach lower manhattan in 15 minutes. the flat is spacious, bright, well equipped and pleasant, a nice small garden is a special plus, unfortunately we stayed here for 5 nights in december and could not use it. michael and angela were very kind and helped us with the transfer back to airport. a place to be recommended for sure!
michael’s place is a great base to explore manhattan. nyc is really the city that doesn’t sleep especially at xmas time so be prepared for crowds !
very nice thank you. lovely stay. very communicative. a++

just spent a weekend at chad's. very smooth stay and very pleased with everything really. the apartment is clean and spacious and has everything you need for a quick getaway to nyc. the layout is a little unconventional but that didn't bother us in the slightest and it's kinda quirky fun. chad was very proactive in providing clear instructions for everything and the whole process was very smooth. apartment is close to 2 subway lines, so very convenient. would recommend to take the green line as the area around the blue subway entrance is a little more dodgy at night.
the place was absolutely stunning. my family came down for my wedding and absolutely felt at home in the space. i would absolutely recommend for any stay in nyc. thanks for having us!

upon arrival the woman at the front desk was on her cell phone with her back to customers. she was very rude and condescending towards me. they had one working elevator! the tv didnt work! the only thing that made my stay good was antonio at rhe front desk! he went above and beyond to accommodate me! the front desk agents all need a class on customer service and hospitality! i sat in the lobby and watched how they interact with customers, it wasn't good i'll say that!

great stay in brooklyn, steps to the c train, and easy ride to manhattan. everything was as described, and a great value. the room had everything i needed, comfortable bed, really nice shower. would definitely stay again!

really enjoyed the stay! amazing view from the balcony. communication was easy. svetlana had a list of local places to dine and attractions to see, which was great as it was my first time in nyc. would definitely stay here again. rated 10/10.
i loved this place! the rooms were small but worth it! very aesthetically pleasing! the staff was kind and helpful! the club was super cute!
manuel is such a nice guy and very helpful. highly recommend to family and friends who wants to live at a nice clean house.
everything as advertised. staff was amazing, quick check in and beautiful room near wall st. highly recommended

if you want a quiet comfortable place: you have found it. you can hear the birds singing and the ocean is a short walk away. the apartment is extremely clean. i have stayed in 3&4 star hotels with worse linen and towels! araz’s towels are soft and the linen is crisp and white. he is also very helpful and as a solo traveler i felt very safe at his place. he was very responsive and considerate. the room is big and sunny, with a huge bathroom; the bed is super comfortable. the location is great: close to the metro and the beach! i felt at home straight away and would definitely stay there again.
great location clean small but perfect for a couple
great spot in carroll gardens!
seriously best stay and host near the airport! also very comfy bed :) the host is so sweet and accommodating. hope to come back soon!

always like airbnbs better than hotels. walkable to the beacon, central park, guggenheim. had fun, easy in/out. there's not always street parking, but sometimes. parking garage about a block walk. couch not too comfy for an extended sit. bed very comfy. all amenities as needed.
fantastic place,much bigger that we expected. super comfy beds and very neat and tidy. would definitely recommend.
this place is in the perfect location! within walking/subway distance of everything you would want to see in the city. the cute balcony was everything to me. definitely recommend!!
the place is spotless, only 1 block away from halsey st subway station and right in the corner is citi bike. safe neighborhood. the host respond quickly. i enjoyed my stay here!

absolutely loved this place, clean, spacious, not difficult to find and thankful for a very sweet host as well for our very first trip to nyc and with our 8 month old baby.. 10/10 will probably rent again if we return for vacation!! thank you jose 😊

i be was pleasantly surprised at how the space matched the pictures . tge neighborhood and overall atmosphere was great . my only complaint would have to be the ant infestation. only because we were extremely excited and anticipating the jacuzzi experience . due to that one thing we declined to get in. other than that everything was great !

vapee's place was great around the corner from restaurant row, and just a couple blocks from broadway shows and times square. the inside was spotless, and communication was great. would definitely stay again.
adam is a friendly and communicative host. everything was easy and comfortable. we really enjoyed our stay! thanks for having us

loved my stay with romulo & vicky during my short trip to nyc! will definitely book again. they made me feel like home. great accessibility to train station if you're planning to frequently visit downtown manhattan. very clean home and well furnished. can't wait to return and book with them on next trip! 100 % recommended.

great location, close to major subway lines taking you into manhattan and beyond. albert's place was clean and had all necessary amenities. during our stay, we had a minor leak caused by the upstairs neighbors. albert was very communicative, spoke to the upstairs neighbors to warn them of the leak, ordered a dehumidifier, and even proactively refunded us a night's stay. would absolutely stay here again.
the best place to stay you will ever find. amazing host!!!

john was a great host and we felt very comfortable .we had our own personal space, and often had the apartment to ourselves. the apartment is beautifully appointed, spotlessly clean with a large bathroom, kitchen and living space. the location was ideal. just out of the craziness that is ny but close enough to walk to it. subway, ferry and bus terminal were also really close. it was perfect for us.

we had a truly wonderful stay at the appartment. david and janet are really welcoming, and were available any time we needed for help or suggestions, making our 3-days trip very easy. the place is really spacious, amazingly clever and practical, perfectly located to take a dive into the williamsburg surroundings, and a few steps from l station to manhattan. our hosts were kind enough to give us a tour of their appartment, and invite us to a rooftop bbq... which we unfortunately missed, only regret of this trip! we'll definitely come back, and highly recommend this place.

john is very easy going. he responds quickly and has great communication. he is concerned that you have a pleasant stay. he is respectful, quiet and clean. i wouldn’t hesitate to stay again. i recommend him highly

the apartment is spacious and has everything you need. the neighbourhood is lively and close to a lot of cool stuff to discover. close to the subway and easy bus rides to other part of the city. would stay here again!
i recommend akem place if you planning to visit new york. the house is very clean. restaurant and store are very close in the area.

if jennifer's place is available, i strongly recommend you snap up a booking asap! she is the most professional, warm, welcoming, friendly and helpful host i could ever hope for. for my first time in new york, the location in lower east side is perfect - central enough for all the coolest places for a feed and to hang out at; whilst being amazingly quiet to the extent that every night i slept even better than in my own home. the room is super spacious, with plenty of storage (a necessity for winter coats!), lighting, powerpoints and the comfiest bed i could dream of. her place is always spotlessly clean, tidy and everything is well appointed with quality. when i come back to nyc, i'm definitely rebooking! made my trip magical :)

great little spot right in greenwich village. walkable distance to a lot of cool stuff. pedro is also a super nice, interesting, and helpful guy. would definitely stay here again if i was solo in nyc!
the room matched the pictures. everything was clean. easy access with no need to speak with anyone in person.
the place was nice and just as we expected. many thanks!
jodie is very nice i felt safe the subway station is very close

rosa s house is beautiful, lovely old furniture, lots of plants, super clean, well located and she is a perfect hostess, easy going, helpful and excellent to communicate. this is the perfect place to stay in greenpoint!!

you will really enjoy staying at jerry's appartment. his private and well appointed appartment has everything that you need, including special little touches in the kitchen and bathroom. short and easy walk from the subway. we recommend you stay at jerry's.

ana’s & jorge’s apartment ist just perfect for days in brooklyn. the area is super nice, cool bars, vintage shops und streetart, especially the bushwick collective. you can easily go to manhattan by train but i bet you will be happy being back after a loud day in busy manhattan :) bushwick is a relaxed and authentic neighbourhood. the apartment is clean and comfy, jorge & ana even had welcome snacks and drinks for us which was so nice. and don’t worry: the apartment high is not to bad, my boyfriend is quite tall (1,87 - 6,2 inches) and he could easily stand. we had a fantastic time, thank you ana & jorge.

dave was extremely accommodating despite our reservation being so last minute. if you’re a junk food junky there are a wealth of option within a very convenient walking distance from the home. thank you for having us! blessings to you in the coming year.

wonderful location, super close to the q train with easy access to manhattan. apartment was comfortable, clean & bright. very secure and private building. very safe and beautiful neighborhood. amenities are all close by. nice big kitchen/eating area. plenty of space to spread out in the living room. overall, great and affordable apartment in an ideal location. thank you!!
very nice flat in a nice area! the host was very flexible to get and give back the keys.
fantastic stay! kat’s mom was really nice and always asking if everything was okay. the place is really spacious, clean and convenient. would definitely consider staying again!
super cute, great location and easy to get everywhere. great host!

this property was such a great launching pad for so many things to do around brooklyn and new york city, and then it was very relaxing being there once we got back each night! there was a tremendous amount of space for a couple, wi-fi was easy to connect with, really just one flight of stairs to get to the apartment, and trains, restaurants, and shops were all nearby to take care of anything you need on an nyc visit :)

andrew is a great host. the airbnb was very comfortable. very clean and looks just like the photos! andrew also lets you keep your luggage at his home after check out time so it’s safe if you have a late flight!

the place is really good for families. we were all four people, and we only used two rooms out of three since the place was really spacious! moreover, the hosts are really friendly and we were very happy with their greetings. we had great conversations, and they gave great tips and information which were very helpful. the subway station is close, so taking subway to get manhattan was not challenging at all even for my parents. i definitely recommend this place!
lovely stay, easy check-in
loved staying here! amazing house and time! could not recommend more!

the old fashioned style is beautiful, this 1879 building is still alive by the paintings by hotel owner. i saw the other side of crowded new york city. the room is small, but convenient and cozy. many subway stations and lines nearby, you can get to the attractions very easily. there is a cafe in the first floor. they making various dessert by themselves, very delicious. people here are generous and friendly. i like them. they made me really feel like home. i had great time here. i swore to them, i will stay here next time i visit ny.

filip was great communicating prior to our arrival, which made me feel very confident that we had a bed waiting for us when we flew in to a foreign town late at night. he has set up an amazing apartment with very comfortable and clean decor/ furniture. it felt like we were living like a local, an artistic lively local with great taste. we visited briefly with filip and got great tips for the public transit system and for awesome things to do in the city that perfectly matched our style. if our travels take us through nyc again we would book with filip in a heartbeat.

we had a very good time in helens and alfreds nice flat. we enjoyed their kindness and helpfullness and their good tips for our stay in brooklyn. we felt comfortable and loved the garden and the flat. park slope is a very good and pleasant place to live with short ways to subway, shops and touristic attractions. if we come back to new york, we would like to stay in this flat again.
overall good value for the stay!
great apartment with fantastic views. easy communications with the owner. highly recommend.
beautiful apartment. we had a wonderful weekend and will be back!

a great stay, the location was fantastic, close to public transport. soho has a vibrant community, excellent for walking and easy access to, restaurants , shops and galleries. the room and bathroom were modern, compact, clean and bright with reasonable wardrobes. excellent views and quiet for sleeping. the staff were extremely friendly and helpful.

great time at patrick’s! and in new york. comfy bed, great location. the air-con was great and definitely needed in the humidity. it did leak quite a lot so we had to put some towels down to soak it up. patrick was great in helping us carry bags up those killer stairs! overall great stay if you’re just looking for a room to sleep whilst exploring the sites of nyc. thanks patrick, hayley and matt

the room was very clean and bright. location was good (7-10 min by walk from subway) and safety. marialuisa very polite and friendly. she gave us everything we needed (clean towels, shampoo, etc), recommended good places for breakfast not far from her place. she has a very polite cat:) our staying was very comfortable.
amazing place in a great neighborhood! everything was clean and just as described, loved the space and how homey it felt. will definitely love to stay here again!

had a great one month stay. conveniently located a couple blocks from the subway q line and close to cvs, target and restaurants. though no elevator, the walk up the two flights was not bad at all. also, very little if any noise coming through the walls, compared to other places i’ve stayed where i can hear everything. the kitchen is petite but sufficient for basic cooking and is stocked well with the essentials. very prompt with communication via email and text. would return for another stay!

our stay at matt’s place was great. he was gracious to allow us to enter the airbnb well before check-in time, which was greatly appreciated, especially by our two elderly family members. the apartment was clean and large enough to accommodate our party of 8. we were able to get water, drinks and snacks at nearby stores, as well as, try some of the local restaurants for takeout. larger grocery stores are within walking distance. there are stairs that could be an issue for some. our 80 & 82 year old family members managed carefully with a little assistance. overall, we enjoyed our trip and would stay again.
it was a comfortable stay host was very fast to respond and willing to help if any issues..

patrick's place was in a great location and we were able to walk to everything we needed in williamsburg and take the train 20 minutes into manhattan. the place was tight for 4 adults, but we made it work. the apartment itself is nothing to write home about but was clean and perfectly fine for a few day stay in ny. overall, a positive experience!
highly recommend. i would loved to had be stayed there a long time. it was beautiful and amazing
the hosts are very responsive and accommodating. the place is just as described.
marc was a great host and very accommodating. the lower east side is always an energetic place to stay.

super cute place, true to the pictures! everything was clean, we had parking right in the front after each time we left. any questions i had radeisha answered right away. really enjoyed my stay at this location!

had a great stay at desiree's place :) super friendly and comfy room. i did get woken up by the dog in the backyard a few times, but earplugs helped. + melanie the cat is the sweetest ever, super affectionate, i will miss her!!

good site; the subway station is close to the accommodation, clean and good attention from the host, the surrounding streets close to the accommodation if they can look a little bad at night but nothing to worry about.

stayed one night and had a lovely time in the city they offered to hold our bags for us when we went to dinner after we had already checked out they were quick to get our bags on short notice and were very happy to help would definitely stay again
great location and friendly host.

linda is such a good host. she gives awesome local tips on what to do, what’s free, and great places to visit. her place is amazing and she has the cutest dog. her place is so close to the subway station and the police station so they i feel safe. the price is great too. i would 100% recommend to everyone going to visit nyc to stay at linda’s airbnb.
thx，we enjoy

i had a fantastic experience with melisa. the place was impeccably clean, and melisa's kindness and helpfulness truly stood out. she went above and beyond to ensure everything was perfect. highly recommended!
vicky was very accommodating and quick to answer our many questions! she helped us to feel right at home.
as described, great location and neighborhood. proactively communicated and it was easy to check in and out.

richie's place was very clean and as described. we had a comfortable stay and it has great access to public transport and other necessities. the place is stocked with basic necessities and access to laundry for long term stay is huge plus . the only inconvenience we had was they didn't allow to get any packages although they did handle couple of urgent packages that we had to get in.
round the corner from subway, fun (if you like chinese food) place to explore; c.45 mins from manahattan on the subway. decent value.
great location
miriam was super friendly and helpful. we had a wonderful stay in her beautiful home. her dog may was so sweet and friendly also!
overall really liked it - would recommend

host deirdre was very accommodating from the check-in/out process to all of the complimentary items. it was comfortable for what we needed; a place to sleep and shower comfortably while exploring ny for the first time.

smaller than expected. slow response from host. stains on ceilings from water coming from top floor. dusty. trash smell outside unit. also be aware of the steep flight of stairs you need to climb with your suitcase. hear is controlled by only 1 thermostat that’s on the 3rd floor. the upstairs person was turning it up to 83 at night. we had to open windows and turn on a/c units. the host doesn’t put any of that in the description.

james was a great host, generous in providing services and advice. he was very approachable and communication was easy and straight forward. location is nearby a subway line connecting brooklyn with manhattan. recommended!
diallo is a very down to earth person and a great conversationalist. he also can tell when to give gracious space. i recommend staying here.
clean, friendly - a nice respite from the busy city life.

thanks kevin! the location is just a block away from the hospital. kevin was very helpful in answering questions. there was a sofa bed and extra sheets and blankets we were able to utilize which was nice.
great stay, ruben was not there but he would always answer our questions very quickly.
everything was fine. good value
lara was a great host! smooth check in. the place is immaculate. super close to central park and perfect walking score. i highly recommend it. definitely coming back!
this place was great! i only wish that parking was better.

like others said this is a 2 story house w 3 rooms and one bathroom w bathtub shower and downstairs is an open plan living room and kitchen. there is a toilet downstairs also. i was the only one staying at the home so ended up being a good value and bathroom was private. majority of things were very clean but i was very tired and just sleeping for like 3 days. this home was. good for that because it’s in a quiet residential area and you feel relaxed like you’re at home i. the bedroom. feels like suburbia. you get very very clean thick towels (i know some people hate thin towels there felt like just from a store) sheets were synthetic though so they did get dusty pretty fast. there wasn’t extra anything except toilet paper (like a second garbage bag or another paper towel roll etc) i extended my stay there. wish i was more proactive and asked for change of sheets more than once bc i def needed that.
thank you

located next to a mta d station, the airbnb has quick and easy access to manhattan despite being located so far. the above-ground station is can be quite loud if that’s something you’re not used to. the airbnb itself is spacious and clean. bathrooms and kitchen are both super nice and well kept. a steal considering the value and cost of living in nyc.
our stay with devon was lovely. the apartment was bigger than expected, we had lots of private space and the location was amazing. it was the perfect place to stay on our trip.

had a great stay and irfan was super nice. would totally recommend. some brief feedback: there was no hand towel or toilet paper in one of the bathrooms. other than that, sincerely perfect! thank you so much.
great place and amazing host!
very nice place would visit again

dawn's place is in an amazing location, clean, and dawn is incredibly kind and welcoming. the bathroom was immaculate. the room i stayed in is on the street side, and the building walls are quite thin, so i occasionally heard street noise or sounds from other apartments. if you need a lot of quiet, you might consider the other room. the room is beautiful and very cozy, even when it was 7 degrees outside!

beautiful apartment located in the charming district of sunset park and in the vicinity of industry city. i arrived after a conference with a cold and was nursed back to health with delicious breakfasts. cherisse and patricia are amazing hosts who truly made me feel at home. thank you so much for everything!
the place was beautiful & surrounded by so many things to do it was clean & spacious to me i had so much fun & will book again

overall great stay. lorelei and alex were very communicative and accommodating. the location was perfect for me to explore the neighborhood and easy access for me to get into manhattan for work. this is also a relatively large and definitely comfortable space to have in ny that helped me get back into city living. thanks again, both, and hope to be back soon.

customer service is absolutely awful! booked this stay by accident and wrote immediately after and called airbnb. she wrote “this is a business not a charity case” and refused to refund me though i explained i didn’t find it suitable for 3 4 year olds. the rental agreement she makes you sign upon check in states under no circumstance will you get a refund regardless if bugs are found or anything else impedes your stay/comfort. no cleaning supplies were provided we were using cardboard and paper plates to sweep. the bathroom has a higher (harder) level and my daughters stubbed their toes. i asked for an additional garbage bag and tp and no response. luckily we had a long ride so brought our own pillows and blankets because those provided are wool and not very comfortable. strange noises came from pipes. cleaning companies on site are separate and wouldn’t help. the worst airbnb experience i’ve had. only in it for the financial gain, does not care for guests comfort or experience.
highly recommend, will be returning on future trips to the area.
very affordable cozy room in a convenient area. also sarah is very kind! highly recommended!
parking was terrible as anywhere in ny lol
place was clean and comfortable during our stay! pol also would quickly respond to my messages when i needed help.
everything was amazing! the location is very close to the train that takes you to manhattan. the place was lovely and the people even lovelier! dobey is the best dog.
good place, very close to subway station. host is very accommodating and very responsive. overall experience was good and would recommend.

yaniv was very kind and helpful through my first new york visit. his apartment was in the finest location in new york where everything was easily accessible, with superbly-clean bathroom and comfy bed. i highly recommend yaniv's place!
it was a perfect place to stay. it was clean i didn’t have to worry about anything. she communicated well with me. great stay overall.

brady was a great host and made our short stay very comfortable and enjoyable. he really easy to communicate with and answered to all our request, we really appreciate that! the house is well decorated and very clean, easy to connect with public transport. recommend +++

this is the best stay in park slope. the building is perfectly located: close to the business corridors of 5th & 7th avenues, blocks from prospect park (which might actually be the best park in nyc) and easily accessible to several train lines (easy walk to 7th ave station and a easy walk to grand army plaza station. the library is perfect for homebase for a nyc trip. the apartment has a great vibe, is super comfy and a great comfy bed to rest in after walking nyc all day. beautiful & chill decor in the apartment really enhances the wonderful vibe of the building and neighborhood. nina's library has an ac in the living room and in the bedroom for summer, great water pressure in the bathroom, and the kitchen has all the necessities. great welcoming touches such as extra towels set out, smooth check in process, and excellent communications make this a beyond great stay. people in the neighborhood are outgoing and friendly, and nina the host is wonderfully friendly and attentive if you need anything. this is a great stay, and its a crazy good value. if you are looking in brooklyn, look no farther than park slope. in park slope you can not beat nina's stay. this is a 10/10 spot in park slope. do not miss this one.

i have always been hesitant to do a room share so i was very happy this was my first one, and it was a great one! eliana’s place is super super close to jfk airport making it extremely convenient for those seeking cheaper hotel alternatives and airport convenience. her home is cozy and the furry welcome committee was the highlight. the room was more than adequate and comfortable and i had everything i could possible need. eliana and her husband are very quiet so i barely heard them. you can walk nearby to get chinese, indian, caribbean or take a quick ride to where you need to go. neighborhood is safe and very peaceful. i walked at night with no issues. i will definitely stay here again! it’s a bit out of the way from the actual city, but plenty of transportation options available. thank you for hosting me and having a comfy space for me to rest in between flights 🙏
great location above good restaurants/bars. nice place. host was very accommodating.
rooms are tiny. smaller than jail cells. this is a religious retreat so there is no talking or noise allowed inside. also no meats or eggs allowed. it was relatively clean and the hosts were okay.
nice stay, generous host, respectful rules, park nearby is wonderful. you get your moneys worth.
everything is as described, the best is the location 1 block away from subway and some space for parking in the street. private room was clean and cozy. i had a great stay.
great location, host was super nice.

my experience was fantastic! i had an internship in harlem, and i could not have asked for a better home base. my room was very large, clean, and a great place to rest after very long, busy days. location was excellent, and steps from public transportation. i will definitely stay here again. this place is a hidden gem in nyc.

this place was great. first, the cleanliness was impeccable. the view was nice. the location was perfect. there were so many places to eat, lounge, shop etc. the neighborhood felt safe day and night. the unit was comfortable and equipped. i would stay again for sure!
julien is a great host! he is very friendly and accommodative. i felt right at home and comfortable staying in this apartment. it’s clean and in a great location. i highly recommend staying here.
jodi was so helpful during my trip and her place is gorgeous! thanks for a great stay, will definitely be back again :)
clean and comfortable and quiet. only thing is that it’s a 15-min from subway, but bus is very convenient.
nice place to stay will probably book it again

jason's lovely apartment was very convenient for our stay in brooklyn. it is close to the subway in a quiet neighborhood of beautiful historic brownstones. we had everything we needed and street parking was relatively easy. communications about how to enter and lock the doors were communicated clearly by jason. there was even a jacuzzi tub in the bathroom. we hope to come back again!

raymond’s place was excellent - easily the best stay we’ve ever had at an airbnb in nyc. incredibly quiet space, very cool in the summer heat, super accessible to everything, lots of food options nearby, and it’s clear a lot of love has gone into it over the years. he was also very communicative about the only you should absolutely stay at raymond’s place - we will be again the next time we’re in town. thank you raymond!!
great stay, would recommend to anyone needing a short trip as the location is close to lga and easy to get into manhattan. host was fabulous !
stay for about a week! the place was super clean and nice! would def stay again 😊
very clean, no fuss, adorable cat.
we had a wonderful stay — thank you, jeffrey! it was our first time in new york, and we absolutely loved it. we’ll definitely be back and highly recommend this place to everyone!

my stay with gus and holly was delightful, which was a great first experience with using airbnb. as hosts, they were very attentive to anything you may need and had great suggestions for local food, coffee, and bars. not to be missed: their mind blowing theories about jon snow if you are a fan of game of thrones! their apartment is cozy and homey which is exactly what you need when you are so far from your own home. it's a great place to hang out, cook, drink, and unwind. there's also plenty of incredible books and music references and star wars memorabilia. (spoiler alert: there is a light saber in your room!) i stayed in the loft bedroom which was perfect because it has a desk and plenty of storage space. gus & holly are located right in the heart of williamsburg, which is the hippest part of brooklyn. so many things to do, so little time! it was just blocks from the l train so getting to manhattan was very easy. also, i felt very safe walking home alone at night. *note: must love cuddly friendly cats. also, there is a three story walk-up so don't bring too much luggage like i did! amazing place to crash while visiting the city! i would definitely stay here again and recommend it to anyone! ;)
beautiful and a clean home. the hosts were kind, helpful and communicative. definitely recommend it!

this apartment understood the assignment: great location w/easy access to manhattan & other parts of brooklyn (just around the corner from g train, not far from a/c trains too) & plenty of shops & restaurants within a few blocks. cute studio in classic walk-up w/big, tall, operational windows on an elevated first floor overlooking a tree-lined street. wifi/desk met my needs, comfortable bed. a few notes : i struggled w/lockbox upon entry, fortunately host was able to come out & help (it was late & pouring rain!) & he also was there to assist w/departure. agree w/other reviewers that they could be more generous w/towels - but i asked for & received extra as needed. would also be nice if the shower had a shelf for products. it's nyc, there's noise (including one night a repeating, odd, electronic/music sound) - but earplugs, a pillow over my head, & white noise app on my phone did the trick. (host might consider providing a fan for this purpose too.) overall excellent value for the $$!
worth it, good place just for crashing a day or two. host(s) were very responsive and i had the option to extend my check-out time by a couple of hours for minimal cost.

my god, this place. gloriously appointed simplicity. the profoundly thoughtful interior passive house design perfectly embraces a dual concern for the space's environmental footprint and for the comfort and wellbeing of the humans who spend time within its walls. i adore what bobby and ruth have done. and in our short interaction, i deeply appreciate them for who they seem to be...genuinely loving people, who listen actively and create bravely.
amazing location. definitely worth the trip! the staff were all so friendly and helpful too
great hosts. would book with kate and danny again

alicia’s place is like a perfect little cottage getaway from the hustle and bustle of the city. very clean, and had everything we needed for exploring the city during the day and getting a good sleep at night. i would definitely stay here again!
our stay here in brooklyn was wonderful! it’s only about 10 mins walking to the subway which was handy for us as we were in the city majority of the time. very quiet neighborhood.

very nice apartment in one of the best neighborhoods in brooklyn. the hosts were kind and extremely prompt with communication. the apartment is newly renovated with hardwood floors, a nice kitchen and a very comfortable bed. the places is near a nice grocery store and just blocks from some of the best restaurants and coffee shops around. the g line train is two blocks away and you can get into manhattan in 35 minutes. pretty dreamy. just what you want.
the house was exactly as advertised, and cheryl was great. responded very quickly.
