this is a great place to come to with a large number of people. you can cook easily for many people, and it’s fun to sit around the living room and socialize. we very much appreciated the washer, dryer, and dishwasher. there are interesting books and pictures around. the immediate neighborhood isn’t exactly fun, but there are some nice places within walking distance and it’s convenient for getting to places.
cozy room, well located, very welcoming host. perfect for short stays
perfect shared space in brooklyn

joo’s place was exactly as described. very responsive and helpful. there were lots of snacks, drinks and water as mentioned. the bed was comfortable, easy location to get around, the shower head was very nice and plenty of hot water. plenty of towels provided. room stayed a comfortable temperature even though it was 38° out. it was quiet considering where you are in nyc! the price is good for what it is. if you are a neat freak, you should get a hotel. for the rest of us, everything that matters was clean. i would stay there again for the location (easy access to museum row and central park), the friendly vibes and it was pretty quiet.

this was truly such an incredible stay. our family of 6 had to visit ny for a funeral and jesse’s place made everything that much less stressful. it was clean, spacious, parking right out front…just everything we needed. 10/10 would stay here again! we can’t wait to be back at this perfect brooklyn cutestory.
great hosts. friendly, made us feel welcome from start to finish. if in the area again i would stay here again. thank you guys!

i loved oscar's place. felt homey and was a great space to work as well. i had everything i needed for the month stay and oscar was very responsive for what i needed. quite neighborhood and easy walk to the subway and great restaurants nearby. hope to be back.
great location. karen is very responsive with quick reply’s.

the walk to and from subway stations were close and within minutes. the bathroom is shared with the tenants of the apartment. has a/c in bedroom, drawers to put in your things and a small desk. the company of the two cats is nice. they’re very sweet. alexandra and reha are nice people.
svea’s place was great! it was as expected, just like the pictures! check in was a breeze as well, and it’s in an awesome location! we all felt very safe, and enjoyed our stay very much!!
great place, very clean and we wanted something close to ubs arena and it was perfect

naveen is a great host who offers help while respecting her guests' privacy. her basement in-law unit in brooklyn's northwestern greenpoint neighborhood is comfy, pleasant, and modern. it benefits from its location on a quiet residential block that is still very close to restaurants, markets, shops, parks, and the subway (with easy connections to manhattan and queens).

great location and beautiful view from the top, a little far from the touristy spots which meant it was quieter and a lot less crowded. we had a small issue with our air conditioner but they responded super quick and fixed it the same day. overall, great stay!

unique, clean space with lots of charm and an easy walk to the ac trains. deirdre is a considerate host that makes the process easy. later than most checkout tim makes up for the late check in time. only word of caution is to anyone sensitive to noise.
it was a nice place, and the hosts were very helpful and responsive!
peter's place was comfortable with lots of amenities. spacious. easy to get in and out, perfect for our needs
five stars. thank you 👍🏼

very comfortable very nice. the host was very helpful. place was clean. stayed clean all in all very nice place. i would definitely stay there again. how the host is a great guy service was excellent.
alicia is very nice sweet lady ! her house is very lovey, comfortable and clean !
lakisha's place was really nice, clean and spacious. thanks for having me.
loved having two bathrooms. very convenient.

the location was hard to beat! being in lower manhattan we could easily get anywhere on the island and also get to brooklyn super easy. right by little italy and soho and chinatown we were surrounded by incredible food options. this place was cheaper than most hostels we looked at with communal bathrooms and we had our own room and bathroom to ourselves with an incredible view of the city. we will absolutely be staying here again!
it's a cute apartment with a little work out space. we had trouble with the tv and wifi not working, and there was limited linens. it is in a great area, easy to get to, and was clean.
i received warm hospitality at adriana’s house. it is great, and the location is really convenient. i feel just like home.

chris’ place is definitely one of the most conveniently located airbnb’s in brooklyn. right near grand army plaza, prospect park, the brooklyn museum, plenty of subway stations to get in and out of manhattan quickly, you can’t go wrong! the area around the airbnb is beautiful, located just on the outskirts of park slope. take a walk and admire the buildings in the neighborhood, and definitely go to the recommended places to eat in chris’ guide book, because the places around the apartment are delicious and the best! the airbnb itself was great, comfortable bed, nicely decorated room, with access to the full bathroom just outside the bedroom door. chris was very responsive to all messages, and was a great host. i highly recommend staying here!

hands down best airbnb experience i’ve ever had! i stayed at amri’s place a little over a month and have no complaints about my experience. the place itself is even better than the photos in my opinion. clean, quiet, and safe with lots of great restaurants and shops near by. also very close to domino park with amazing water views. highly recommend this place!!

thanks alan, our experience in your beautiful apartment was excellent. we appreciatte your kindly service and hospitability. the acommodations were exactly that you descript in the annoucement and we think you offered too much more than we expect. when we return to ny, we will take your service again. thanks you so much.

jessica’s place is extremely well situated to get around brooklyn, manhattan, and queens. everything is walkable and lots to do in the neighborhood. jessica was friendly and super understanding with our travel plans since we were traveling with our twin toddlers.

in short: extremely messy and cluttered apartment. pictures do not reflect the current state of the place. i have stayed at many airbnbs, and this has been the messiest by far. i had immense trouble in regards to the cleanliness of the communal space of the airbnb. for example, the kitchen space was cluttered with half-eaten food items, the refrigerator was stocked with raw, unwrapped meats, the sink always had a pile of unwashed plates/utensils, and the living room area was packed with items. the bathroom is filled with personal items. overall, there is no space for yourself. you can refer to past airbnb reviews, as they mention about the clutter/uncleanliness of the apartment. mid stay, i spoke to sing, the host, in the hopes that she would be able to adjust her cleanliness habits so that we can cohabitate for the remainder of my stay. instead, sing stated that i had to vacate the apartment by, "tomorrow at 11 am." with such short notice, i had to find another airbnb listing.
nice place. off the busy section so not too much noise. easy to walk to everything we wanted to see.

perfect studio apartment with well equipped kitchen. easy entrance, tv the with ability to access streaming services (if you have your own account!). enough space to sit on the sofa if you want to. clean and tidy. overall great stay on a nice street in brooklyn. easy transport to manhattan. also has good working aircon.
a lovely place and surprisingly quiet spot, for being so close to the bustle!
the location is perfect. there is a lot of space in the room. the host is friendly and nice. we would definitely come back.
was a pleasure to stay at aswad's. huge space and great location for the price. he was available quickly with any questions we had. definitely recommend.

i had some issues understanding how to use the tv, wifi (im a boomer, shrug). they personally came up on move in and helped me out immediately! awesome assistance. i recommend them to all age groups of travellers.
ness’s place is very close to public transportation. big space, two floors; ness and the property manager were reachable and tried their best to make sure we get everything we needed.

a lovely apartment in a quiet location away from the hustle and bustle of manhattan. however it is a short walk to the staten island ferry which takes you to downtown manhattan inside 30 minutes.... for free, and 24 hours a day. it is in a great location, is great value and is immaculately clean. we highly recommend this apartment.

for having a private (and clean) bathroom on top of a spacious (and clean) bedroom, this place is worthwhile! if anything, it looked even better in person than the photos. nicole is a helpful and responsive host, too. to address a concern i saw in a past review about a smell, there was a little bit of a musty smell, but nothing that i’d consider atypical for a ground-level dwelling in an older townhome. finally, to address a concern i saw in the past about feeling safe or not in the area: candidly, there’s only one block that might seem unnerving to a solo traveler when going between the place and the nearest subway station. that’s because the block isn’t as well-lit. but, i honestly think any poorly lit block should be cause for heightened self-awareness and caution. i don’t think the neighborhood should be considered, as a whole, unsafe. the block is clearly cared for by the residents who live there. i can’t recommend this place enough!
over all great place to stay! excellent location and very nice appartment with cool details. would definitely book there again.
kerri’s hospitality and communication is something unique. a very comfy and clean place to stay, close to jfk, and safe.

great location near lots of delis and restaurants near college point. the host was very accommodating even during a late night where we unfortunately locked ourselves out and they were prompt in letting us get back into the home. highly recommend!

amazing space in a great location. great subway access and great restaurants. i loved my experience. lots of sunlight, which is great but just bring an eye mask if you want to sleep in. the building is old but so is everything else in the west village. it's worth it though. best neighborhood in the city.

i really enjoyed my stay here! the location was great, near transportation. wish i had more time to explore the neighborhood. jazz was really communicative at every step. the place was spotless, and had everything we needed and more! toiletries, towels, clean sheets, comfy beds, keurig and everything you need for coffee, water bottles, etc! would definitely stay again.
everything was great. there was some construction happening next door, but it's new york!
irfan is a great host and the place is very well kept and clean, highly recommend to anyone looking to visit brooklyn
king-bed room was nice. it was quiet and warm on a cold winter day.

the area was nice and the street wasn’t busy at all, very peaceful and pretty. raychelle was very sweet & hospitable, sending a message making sure we were enjoying our stay. we had everything we needed in the bnb and felt very comfortable. however if you’re on the taller side you may not feel as comfortable because the ceiling is a bit low :) also loved the outdoor sitting area!

looking for accommodations in brooklyn only a few days before traveling meant that we needed to moderate our expectations in many ways. however, we found sherryl’s place exceeded our expectations in many ways. the kitchen was spotless and appeared to never have been used before. the living and dining room were spacious and elegant; each including a few design conscious touches, but in no way cramped or cluttered. needless to say, everything worked and the entry system was simple and secure. we felt safe during our stay. finally, and importantly, the price was right. we would definitely stay there again.
comfortable and felt right at home 100/10

eric was a great host. the place was nice and clean and eric was very responsive and even accommodated an early check in. no complaints about the actual space. only downside is the location. a local friend told me after we got in that the area is supposedly one of the roughest neighborhoods in brooklyn. i probably should have done more research before coming, but regardless i see what they mean. i grew up near an area not too dissimilar from this area so it didn't bother me as much, but i can see how it might put some people off that aren't used to being in or around that environment. the nearest subway stop is about an 8/9 minute walk from the place. which isn't too bad, but it was about a 30/40 minute trip to downtown brooklyn and an hour+ trip into parts of manhattan and harlem. so keep that in mind. overall, again, eric was a great host and the actual place was very gracious. but if location is important to you then that's something to consider.

this garden apt of a brownstone is hamilton heights is a fabulous place to stay in upper manhattan. the layout is spacious, the details very thoughtful and the backyard/outdoor space is a super bonus! just blocks to multiple subway lines this spot is great for getting around the city! for a family w two teens we appreciated the fold away cots for sleeping. the only issue we had was that the main bedding had a musty smell to it, however it wasn’t an issue for us bc there was extra bedding for the cots available. also, based on jude’s responsiveness i don’t doubt it will be quickly remedied. i would absolutely stay here again!

the hotel and the rooms were really good and clean. hot water in the shower is also good. there is an ice-machine that also gives tap water on the 7th floor. breakfast is ok, no hot milk though. good stay, would recomend.
great stay and location
very easy to get to central everyday and communication with carlos was excellent

i had a great stay with cherisse and patricia! cherisse was so much caring and the breakfast she prepared everyday was extremely delicious. with cherisse, i felt home immediately. i would come again when in new york!
very nice room in a beautiful apartment. it's around 10min to walk to the closest subway stop which make it easy to get to any point in ny. michael was a very helpful and friendly host.

great place for us to stay overnight. juan allowed us to have a late check out since our flight wasn’t until the afternoon. great location. felt safe. easy transport to the city. we even walked to lga the next day for our flight! would stay here again.

we had a great stay, the apartment was exactly as described. one bedroom did not have a door, just a curtain. it was not a big deal for us at all. location was fantastic, with a starbucks and a brand new wegman's within steps to grab any essentials. if my son is accepted at nyu, we will be back!

this was a great experience! kimberly was there when i arrived late in the evening. i immediately felt welcome and enjoyed my simple room with roomy storage for my clothes. it was easy to find room in the fridge and pots and pans for making breakfast, although with all the restaurants and cafés nearby, i did not often cook! i had the opportunity for uninterrupted privacy or conversation with other guests, a perfect balance! i highly recommend this fun neighborhood and this place in particular as you can quickly take the subway wherever you want, or take a stroll and explore the great places in a 10 minute walk radius.
a nice spot to stay while in brooklyn with shakima providing a warm welcome and insight on what to do in the area. would book again
great place and great location.

i stayed with my family at jp's for a few months. it's such a well-stocked apartment - everything you could possibly need for cooking is there (i loved the beautiful array of spices). the apartment is a happy space, with nice natural light in the bedroom. it's very comfortable (the bed and sofa are great). it was fantastic being close to sunset park - the view of the ny harbor is amazing, and every sunday there is a lively market with delicious food. 9th ave is lined with bakeries selling delicious fresh buns, all at super reasonable prices. several grocery stores to choose from. industry city is also a pleasant walk away - a great place to see a repurposed industrial space with restaurants, shops, and cultural happenings. the 9th ave subway is right down the street - the d train zips you into central brooklyn (atlantic ave) and manhattan in no time at all. the greenwood cemetery is nearby - an absolutely beautiful place to wander. jp was very helpful and very kind. i would stay again.

nicholas is an awesome and super friendly host! we had a pleasant and wonderful vacation. a nice room, which has all needed comfort for two guys, discovering nyc. very high speed reaction and reliable communication. immediately open for any questions. thanks for all! chris and alex

dan's apartment is perfectly located in manhattan and easy access to reach the subway, as well as some focal points to visit like the rockfeller center, top of the rock, 5th avenue, madison etc... being in the heart of downtown is quite unique, and the apartment is well soundproof so we didn't get disturbed by the city noise. the place is nice and cosy, perfect for our week retreat, just too short to be able to visit evertyhing so we'll have to come back again !
carmen’s place is absolutely amazing! she is also a great host who is very responsive and accommodating.
super clean! comfortable bed! good location!

tong was a great host. if the temperature dropped a bit , she was quick to ask if we needed extra blankets, ect. always checking in to see if our stay was going great and it was. great location in my opinion. anything you needed wether it was to take the train, food , home supplies ect, was only a 5 min walk. will come back for sure !!
large and stylish 1-bed in amazing location, right next to a park and 10 minutes' walk from several train lines. comfortable, warm, easy!
great place and host. stayed one night and loved it.

rian and asad's place was perfect. very good prixe compared to other airbnb's of similar size. it was very spacious and well lit. the apartment was clean and right as per the listing. neighborhood was quiet even though only 5 mins to la guardia. would highly recommend!

i loved staying here, everything about it. loved the neighbourhood, the private entrance, private toilet, and private balcony which i took advantage of every night (so peaceful and quiet). kelly was also so kind and accommodating, i would definitely look to stay here again <3
place was nice and clean with good locations. however, a little noisy to get asleep since there is a bar downstairs

ryan was so organized and delivered all information and guide before our trip and arrival. check in is easy and simple, we were welcomed with snacks and bottle of wine. place is spacious, comfortable and clean. location was perfect for our event. we enjoyed our stay very much. thank you ryan!
nice place to relax amid an area full of good restaurants and galleries

we spent 5 days at monica’s apartment during our one month long honeymoon travelling around the usa and canada and we really enjoyed our stay. easy check-in, spacious and very stylish apartment in a great and safe location in a quit street with an easy access to metro and sergio was very responsive. we found in the apartment everything what we needed for our stay. many many thanks to both monica and sergio! lucia and tomas
place was very clean and jean made sure to message back quickly whenever we need anything!
it's near the park, a quiet and nice place. the landlord is warmhearted. good choice!

i chose the studio because of the location. having lived in nyc for two years, i knew i wanted to stay on the upper west side. it's just a wonderful part of manhattan. even without taking anything else into account, the location is perfect. it's a couple of blocks from various subway lines, including express lines; bus stops, restaurants, grocery stores, and not to mention central park! so, for example, if you want to go to times square, you can walk two and a half blocks from the studio and take the express subway line and be in times square in literally two stops. this is a great neighborhood to experience life "as a new yorker," if that makes sense. you have access to everything, but are not staying in a tourist trap. every morning i walked a couple of blocks to an italian coffee shop to have a chocolate croissant and a cappuccino, and passed by locals walking their dogs and commuters going to work. just a great neighborhood vibe. in terms of the studio itself, you can't ask for a better air bnb. the host (marty) is professional and well organized, and he takes his role as host very seriously. he really cares about your comfort and is easy to reach. that said, he also expects you to follow very reasonable rules he has set out. when you go into the studio and you understand the neighborhood dynamic, it becomes evident why those rules are in place. i would say that if you're looking for a place to party and make noise at all hours, this studio (or this neighborhood) may not be a good fit. by nyc standards, you have plenty of space and you have a private patio, which is unheard of! the studio also has a remodeled sink and shower with fancy jets. the bedding is very comfortable, and there are enough places to sit, as well as surfaces to set things down. again, this is by nyc standards. (new york is a place where physical space is always in short supply.) highly recommended!

had a wonderful stay at sarah's. if you are traveling to park slope solo or going as a couple this is the perfect spot. it's close to so much on a beautiful brown stone block. it doesn't get any better. i hope to stay there again the next time i visit.
super clean, price was perfect for the area. it’s a bit of a climb of the stairs to your room but once there it’s worth it. remember to remove your shoes they have cute slides for you.

i enjoyed my stay with andrew and adriana very much. using the subway was very convenient since the subway stations are either right across the street or right around the corner. the room i stayed in is very cosy. and i had great talks with andrew and adriana.

merine was very friendly and accommodating when we arrived and made sure everything was to our liking. the space was very clean and spacious! perfect for our group of three and a very easy walk to the subway. the surrounding neighborhood also has a lot to offer. we had a great time!

love the charm and convenience of this stay! the room i got didn’t have a window, but a covered first floor balcony — so you might want to call ahead about which room you’re getting! also the sauna didn’t work :/ so you might want to call ahead about that. but the staff was very helpful and i felt really safe staying there. i loved the cherry wood! great stay 👍
filip was very responsive and had lots of options for my arrival. the place was clean, great size and very comfortable. showers were great and i would definitely stay again.
excellent park slope location and wonderful thoughtful hosts! great communication and easy lock box for entry. highly recommend.
what a great find and location. we'll be back. thanks for a great stay.

lee was an amazing host. he gave us local recommendations, was very polite and friendly, and responded quickly. the room was very clean and tidy, and the apartment was so nice! it was a ten minute walk to two different ways of getting to the city. the neighborhood had lots of walkable food destinations and delis. i would recommend this stay 100/10!

a fantastic spot well placed within east village surrounded by a fantastic neighbourhood. the flat was quiet, clean and a nice refuge at the end of a day of running around the city. checking in with renee was super simple and the whole setup was without stress. will be staying here again when coming back to nyc
overall good place to live

this apartment is perfect for up to 2 people. in the heart of brooklyn, the neighborhood is walkable and extremely accessible by train (f, g, r lines). walk up to smith or court street for awesome food/coffee options! the space is very comfortable and clean, and had all necessary amenities. the bed is super comfortable and it really felt like home away from home. would absolutely stay again!

we loved our stay at richard's place...being just a block from the park, walking distance to f/g trains and lots to eat/see & do was perfect. the home is big enough for our group and meetings went well. we would definitely stay here again!
great location!
i stayed briefly but the place was not bad at all

my sister and i had my mother stay at airbnbs in brooklyn over the winter, and she spent two of three months here. in her words: "they were absolutely lovely, very accommodating, very responsive if i needed anything, the place was beautifully appointed and very comfortable, great backyard. i was very comfortable during my stay and would gladly stay there again!" in my words: we managed to lock ourselves out of the apartment and keith could not have been more helpful in taking time out of his day to help us get back in, which involved an unbelievably helpful neighbor going above (literally) and beyond. it is clear that they have great relationships with the people on the block, which is added value to how comfy the place is. they were extremely responsive, had great and clear instructions. great hosts. location: it is at the very nicest part of park slope, a block from the f train, a 5 minute walk to prospect park, could not be located better. tons of restaurants in the area.

dana's studio was the perfect home from home for myself and partner whilst we visited new york for the week. the studio was exactly as it appeared in the pictures and was ideal for our 5-day stay. dana was an excellent host, really helpful and provided great advice on local places and subways (there is a stop on the c train to manhattan within a few hundred yards - we paid $29 each for unlimited 7-day subway passes). dana even gave us a ride to jfk after our stay as she was headed there herself! although on a busy street, the flat was quiet and clean and had brilliant air-conditioning and hi-speed wi-fi. we would stay again if we returned to new york!
nice place so clean
a bit expensive for what it is, but this is nyc... located near some of te best places in the city. the space is a bit old and the bathroom is shared and small, but ideal for young travelers.
great place to stay!
great apartment, great location and very clean
very nice stay. clean house, short walk to subway. friendly host. overall very great.
great loction close to beach. very comy room.
this was a great place to stay at! so conveniently close to the subway and ken is a great host. very communicative and friendly! would recommend staying here to anyone!

the perfect quintessential brooklyn brownstone experience! fantastic accommodations, wonderful neighborhood, excellent location, and a very knowledgeable and helpful host, not to mention an incredibly reasonable price! we loved our time here!

host is terrific - will respond quickly to questions. the apartment is nice, clean and updated. 3 bedrooms on 2nd floor. 2 bedrooms have queens and the 3rd has a twin with an additional twin mattress that can be used on the floor. the other option for sleeping is the couch which when it's extended feels like a full size. neighborhood is a little sketchy but we never felt unsafe. the location is nice because the train is 2min away.
kevin is a great host! i was running around to meetings and definitely needed a stress free stay which it was! i would definitely book with kevin again.
great location, easy access to public transportation and great places to eat around town. awesome to have two bathrooms for a family of four.

my stay at phillipa's place was outstanding!!! her hospitality was on point and she made us feel at home and welcome. she definitely was open as it relates to our check out time. we definitely want phillipa to know that we appreciate everything and if we are ever in nyc again.... her place will definitely be somewhere we want to say.
a quirky flat in a fantastic location.
this is our favorite place to stay in brooklyn. as someone who grew up here, this space is gorgeous, offers a ton of privacy, and yet still is in the hub of the city. can’t wait to be back in august!
awesome accommodations, great price for a 4 br. centrally located, just minutes from the rail system and about 15 minutes from the airport.
the sweetest host i have ever had
great space! comfy beds, two bathrooms and a wonderful neighborhood! super, super clean. close to great restaurants and bars. highly recommend.
great host! clean place, and fun execution.

julie was a treat. she was a wealth of information about the neighborhood and how to get the most out of my frequent excursions around brooklyn. she was nice i enough to let me have some space in the fridge (i hadn't read the fine print about that in the space's listing) and made me feel at home. the space is small but comfortable and you have everything you need in order to use it as a crashpad- a comfy bed, space in a drawer and hooks for your clothes. the neighborhood is great- plenty of grocery stores and lovely to walk around. i would definitely stay with julie and her nice roommate again!
had a wonderful stay, it was more spacious than expected, with a well-equipped kitchen, big screen tv - very comfortable and cozy.
neelu's place was great for my 4 night stay. great location, clean space. it was pretty minimal but had everything i needed. communication was quick and easy. i would stay here again next time!
the place was great value for money and spacious. host was responsive and accommodating

the nicest place i've stayed in or out of nyc. really comfortable and well appointed, awesome location, clean, comfortable, and a small outdoor space which is to nice in nyc. we loved it and i'd stay there again in a heartbeat.

absolutely and highly recommend staying here. it was the first time we've ever used airbnb and, based on the experience, we may never book a regular hotel again. the apt is in a perfect location in brooklyn. subway station across the street, plenty of bars and restaurants within walking distance, safe neighborhood. the apt itself exceeded all expectations. clean, bright, plenty of room. there are maps of the city, pamphlets, city guides, in the apt to help make your trip all the more enjoyable. they've thought of everything and are fantastic hosts. the espresso machine was great... i'll be buying one just like it for myself! if you're planning a trip to nyc, this is exactly where you'll want to stay.
very nice room, not to far from everything, easy check in, but fair warning there's no windows in the room.
good location and there’s a nearby train station so getting to and from the city is really easy. check-in is also easy and the place is really clean.
aicha!!! keeps a tidy home and her warm nature exceeds my expectations not only the first time but the second i stayed here too. my stay was wonderful and my room was clean and cozy.
great place to stay. close to subway stops, food, and other attractions. the place is pristine and very comfortable. quiet neighborhood. i’d definitely come back.
amazing stay, cute pets and very nice host. everything was accommodated for 😍
very neat place looks exactly like pictures quiet location

fantastic location. steps from prospect park train station, prospect park zoo is nearby and the brooklyn botanic gardens are a 3 minute walk away. it was super easy to get around. a great grocery store and the brooklyn beer and soda store is across the street. it was just a super location and a solid neighborhood.

julian was an excellent host who was able to respond quickly to any requests we had. the apartment is really good, it is very large and spacious, bathroom and kitchen areas are great too. however, bringing earplugs are a must as the noise for the tenants above is very loud and was normally starting around 6:00am in the morning. the location of the apartment is great, easy access to halsey station for the subway to manhattan, there is a t-mobile store close by where we were able to purchase a tourist sim upon arrival. there are at least two laundromats and convenience stores all within walking distance. overall a great place that i would recommend to anyone visiting nyc.

i stayed in this apartment for almost 6 weeks. i will definitely be booking again with jeniffer. they fixed the minor issue that i had immediately and the office was on site. they were also flexible with my checkout time, which i really appreciated. at the time of my staying there, there was some construction on a new building on the block, which led to some morning noise, but this was not the fault of the building, and the sound was manageable. i did buy some creature comforts while i was there for the kitchen/bathroom, but in general, the kitchen had what i needed for a nice stay. i thought that the value and neighborhood was very nice and the pictures were as advertised.

the place is beautiful, clean, the host pays attention to every detail. we didn't miss anything during our stay. perfectly located near train stops. (2stops) from manhattan. we'll book again if we get the chance.
lovely room in a beautiful home in a vibrant and historical part of nyc

we loved the apartment and really impressed with its cleanliness! joe and carmia are super friendly and accommodated to all our needs right down to the epsom salts (we were there for the ny marathon). very thoughtful hosts indeed. joe provided ample information about the subway and amenities to be found nearby. would definitely recommend them highly and would definitely come back to stay if the opportunity permits. thanks again joe and carmia for your hospitality and friendship!
very good host, lovely home. spacious and clean nice neighbourhood
everything about this place was great! it truly is a great place to go if you’re looking for a nice getaway from your daily life! i recommend this place to any and everyone!

the apartment isn’t luxurious. it’s simple and it has only the basics. it was clean enough and gave us a dry, safe place to sleep, shower and keep the luggage as we explored the city during the days. the fact that it’s a fifth floor walk up is no joke— the stairs are steep and there are a lot of them. the shower takes some getting used to as the dial is confusing so have patience as you try to get hot water. it does come eventually being from london, i found it frustrating that there was no kettle so i used a pot of water for boiling— but i think this is probably a niche request. overall, our stay was enjoyable and we were grateful to have a quiet and private location in midtown tucked away from everything. we would book again.
great location! it locates in such a convenient place. there are great bars and restaurants on that street. the room is sparkling clean! thank you guys for hosting such a great room!
anthony was a great host, i would recommend it again

rachel was a wonderful host! she replied on time and made sure everything went smooth from the beginning to the end of our stay! the duplex is absolutely gorgeous, it was a truly a treat to stay here. the rooms are spacious, the kitchen is magnificent and the spa bathrooms were just the icing on the cake. overall, i would recommend this to place to anyone and hope to stay here many times in the future! great host and an amazing place!!

valentin’s place was extremely clean and comfortable. the studio was exactly as listed. everything about it was modern, chic, and high tech. bathroom and shower was my fave part of the place. the studio overall was very comforting and felt like home. valentin was also extremely responsive and answered all of my questions. one of the best airbnb’s i have ever stayed in. i definitely recommend and would reserve again in the future. ☺️

aswads place has very good localisation. 3 metro stations, makes you can go wherever you want to. place is very clean and spacious. neighbours are very nice :) aswad is very nice ane helpful person. we were still in touch during our holidays. if we had any questions, he answered every time. it was a good choice! thank you for all!

this is definitely a perfect place to stay. we were 2 adults and 2 childrens 10&15. the place is very clean and has everything you need. not too far from the public transportation (bus and train) so perfect to reach downtown manhattan. what to say about keren who was absolutely awesome ! she is professional, always available and above all a very kind human being person. we were feeling at home and for that we are grateful, as we enjoyed so much our visit of nyc ! again many thanks to keren for the sweet attentions.

everything went great!!! very clean place and photos are accurate except the bedroom is a bit smaller than what it actually looks like in the picture. the bed was comfortable. one major issue was the heat. it was very hot in the apartment. there was an a/c in the living room but was not cold enough. other than that, everything else was great. finding parking spot might be a little tricky but we were lucky enough to get a parking spot on the same day we checked in. we did not move our car after. however, if you are planning to stay for more than 3 days you will need to move your car from one side to another side due to garbage.
this was a great place to stay. very convenient. super comfortable bed. it has all the amenities. brad is very responsive. high recommend!

excellent! the apartment was great for my husband and i. we stayed a whole month. so lovely to have the balcony and the space. we loved the neighborhood, there are a few great food spots and a local bar with live music. the apt was perfect and very cozy, amy was very accommodating and responsive. i would recommend for a long stay for sure.
very accomodating stay in a older part of brooklyn. historic homes abound in this neighborhood and alaric has stayed true to the days when they were in their prime! very unique place and a good host!

i truly enjoyed my stay at casey’s apartment. check-in instructions and overall communication were stellar. casey even let me store my bags there a couple hours before check-in, which was greatly appreciated. the place itself was clean and stylishly decorated. the room is private while common areas, kitchen and bathroom were shared - this wasn’t an inconvenience and it fact made me feel safer than staying by myself. my only complaint is that the door for my (a) didn’t stay shut. there was a piece of fabric that was left to presumably bridge the gap, but i still had a hard time getting it to stay. all in all, i would recommend this place to my friends and family in a heartbeat!

comfortable, clean & serene. great art! awesome outdoor space! having car service available to/from the airport & market is an awesome amenity. cannot beat the location to the subway. excellent host & delightful “co-host” carlton.

aaron's apartment offers excellent value for money. he was very friendly and the check in and check out were very easy. something to highlight is its proximity to the subway... you can commute to any place from there, it is highly convenient and it make your life simpler. the bedroom was very comfortable and homelike. in general, aaron's apartment is highly recommended for a vacation weekend or business trip.
beautiful place with easy check-in / check-out process. it was clean, cozy and exactly as described. highly recommend.

my daughter and i had a wonderful stay at yochi and yochi's manhattan loft. our hosts were incredibly gracious - making sure that we had anything we needed including a great breakfast and delicious coffee to start our day - and their home was absolutely lovely and immaculately clean. i wouldn't hesitate to recommend staying here and would definitely stay again when traveling to nyc. thank you yoshi and yoshi!
this place is amazing. five of us stayed here last october and i still talk about it to my friends. loved the rooftop sitting area. i can't wait to come stay here again.
awesome unit! wonderful host, definitely worth it. no issues at all during my stay.
great stay in brooklyn. only 2 1/2 blocks to the subway and access to manhattan! yaakov was super friendly and responsive to texts. would definitely stay here again!
prime location! anthony's communication was consistent. he went out of his way to make sure i had everything i needed. i was even able to check in early. will definitely be back!

the stay was pleasant! we were warmly welcomed by the owner, and we were pleased with the location and condition. it was clean and ready for our stay as soon as we arrived, and the owner even checked on us before and during the stay.

great location on a quiet street. very clean and functional space. subway stations, restaurants, and central park within walking distance. highly recommend if you are looking for a relaxing place with convenient access to the city.
space was great. close to train, warm in winter. had a lot of little extras. clean, would return again.
excellent location , clean place , pictures were accurate ,cozy place , i would stay there again . great communication , and great host

doris was one of the best hosts i've had the pleasure of staying with, she maintained contact and checked in with me throughout my stay to ensure the space was good and we had all we needed. the apartment itself is gorgeous, from the updated appliances to the peaceful backyard you truly have a small slice of heaven in harlem. my friend and i were comfortable the entire time. if you're looking for a place to stay that feels like home, look no further.
very clean, and great location. we enjoyed our stay very much and highly recommend! just note the unit is up a couple flights of stairs.

because there is no staff or front desk worker or anyone really for that matter, it presented a problem for any packages arriving in my name there. since there's no one to accept or receive mail for the hotel. also, no ice machines or much else that could've been useful for me as a dancer, especially since it is advertised as a hotel. however, the communication via email to answer these type of questions was fast and concise. so i do truly appreciate that. all in all, for the price i paid for this rental,,, i would come back and stay here again and again! thank you!!! 4/5
great stay and clean

17 john was incredibly responsive, clear, and easy to work with in organizing accommodation. i even extended my stay last minute and it was handled smoothly without any issues. great experience overall, i’d happily come back and highly recommend.
this is just amazing place！beautiful views and so close to the airport！
a very cool room with view to manhattan skyline in the most beautiful neighbourhood in astoria/ queens. very clean, easy to access and very calm. a great one to explore new york!

i had a really great stay here. ervis, the host, is always available for the tenants. he will answer promptly and will be there in a heart beat if need be. i felt safe in the house because he selects the tenants who can stay here. for instance, there are lots of medical students since the hospital is close by. it's very quiet and everybody keeps clean. the shared kitchen is always clean and ready to cook. also, ervis takes the tenants who need it grocery shopping so it's convenient if you don't have a car. thank you so much! this stay helped me get going for the next chapter of my life ;) .
great position and great host. the quality is correctly related to the price. iradj is always available and helpful.
amazing stay! samuel is a great host, always responsive and proactive. definitely recommended!
a great and clean spot in a cool neighborhood. worked well for our family of four (kids slept on the sofa bed). close to several subway lines.
wonderful apartment in a lovely area of brooklyn. very much recommended!

reka’s place is actually as pictured. it was a great place to spend the week in a neighborhood i lived in 30 years ago. the bed was comfortable and i slept very well, and the coffee shop across the street was awesome and exceeded my expectations. it was also super easy to get around by foot, subway or citibike. i’d glad i chose her place and i hope to be back in the future. reka is also a really great person and she invited me to join the fourth of july bbq on the terrace with her and her friends and to watch the fireworks. thanks for providing such an awesome place for my new york adventures, reka! 🙏❤️

helpful, friendly hosts and a private, comfortable stay in an immaculate set of rooms. highly recommended. we were visiting family and could easily hop on the c just a short walk away. we would be delighted to stay there again. thank you, kate and lee!

i arrived around 12pm. it was really dark outside, it was a little hard to find out with build it was. host were still up at the time i arrived, it was really nice of her to show me around. carmen looks different with the picture showed here, but i was fine for me. the room was old, and a little bit hot. however, if you open the window a little bit, it would be too much trouble with it. one thing i found sorry about is, as for a light sleeper, i can hear almost every sound in this house. the bird singing, the talk in the next door, and the outside noises. i think the host kinda slept really late. other then this, nothing has too much issue with.

easy check in & check out. very friendly host. clean, comfortable and spacious room. private bathroom. great location for accessing chelsea companies. highly recommend for tourist and even business travelers.

we loved our stay at michael's place! the house is clean, spacious, comfortable and the location is just perfect. the terrace is great, we were able to use the bbq and enjoy the outdoor space. the rooms are very comfortable, the kitchen is well equipped. michael was very communicative and flexible with check-in/check-out times, so much appreciated! we'll be back!
amazing place and host

great location right next to brooklyn museum and barclay’s center. mimi’s place is as described, nice and clean, with a private bathroom all to myself! check-in was easy and flexible. mimi was super responsive and friendly. i enjoyed my stay at mimi’s place.

this is a lovely little apartment on the bottom floor of a brownstone. you have everything you need besides toiletries and groceries, and communication is quite easy as the housekeeper (a very nice man named malose) is usually on site. the plumbing, heat and cooling, and cleanliness is great. there’s netflix in the bedroom. the beds were of good quality as my mother and i stay in separate rooms. that’s not to say it’s perfect. the mirror in the bathroom is too high and the door into the brownstone is tricky, as well as being located in a sketchy neighborhood (try williamsburg instead of bed-stuy if you’re worried about this). the major downside, however, is that this airbnb is treated like a regular apartment listing. i had to sign a separate “guest agreement” as did my mother and talk to the lister on the housekeeper’s flip phone upon arriving and leaving. we had to give our ids so photos could be taken also. this is more than i’ve needed to do with actual apartments i’ve rented in 3 different countries, and airbnb takes care of this so you’re not inconvenienced when getting in. otherwise the communication was nice and prompt. i would actually stay again if it weren’t for the neighborhood and the door—you have to be shown how to open it by malose. we took lyfts instead of hazarding the subway, and they were really affordable to get to any of the boroughs or just to williamsburg or downtown. i highly recommend it for low maintenance guests and short stays.
the flat is very clean with nice beds and closed to subway.
i had a terrific stay at alex's place. clean, quiet, convenient--beautiful views. he and his wife are welcoming and easy going. i hope to stay in their apartment again next summer!
very nice apartment and very clean but due to certain circumstances the experience was subpar.
everything is really amazing and peaceful 20/10

i cannot say enough wonderful things about d’s place!! she and her husband were such wonderful and accommodating hosts! the home is beautiful, comfortable, looks even better than the photos, and was the perfect place to spent the last 6 weeks of summer! the bed was super comfortable, the central a/c worked beautifully, which was a godsend on some hot and humid days. the kitchen had everything needed to be able to prepare meals during the stay…and having the luxury of a nespresso machine to make coffee every morning was wonderful! convenient street parking right outside; a train is an easy 5 min walk. recent renovations to the kitchen and living area…just adorable! and having a dedicated work space with a desk, comfortable chair, even office supplies…made working from home even better. smart tvs with soundbars, fast internet, beautiful washer and dryer. and last but not least, the beach and boardwalk are a literal 2 minute walk from the condo…need i say more?! highly recommend!
lovely experience will come back again !!
very clean and centrally located. feels like a hotel but for a much better value. would recommend!

we loved our stay at freehand! our room was small but the space was utilized efficiently - very comfortable and clean overall. staff was super friendly and helped us with storing our luggage for a few hours after we checked out. would definitely stay here again!
eleonora is an amazing hostess. she was so accommodating to us! her place was great, perfect location & very comfortable. we would definitely stay again.

amy’s space was great! spacious, comfortable and very, very clean. near some amazing restaurants, bars, coffee and book shops, and not too far of a walk from the train station. we are grateful for the time we got to spend here…
the space was exactly as described, easy to get into and out of. right around the corner from the train station. very good experience
kenny’s place is at a great location in harlem. the apartment is spacious. the noise level is manageable. there are lots of good restaurants and cafes nearby.

best airbnb and host. if you are the creative type it will inspire you and get the creative juices flowing. close to all the trains and awesome food and coffee shops. super short train ride to soho, chinatown, domino park, and a quick transfer will get you to dumbo super fast. very clean and super fast internet. definitely my airbnb of choice for when i’m in new york!
ayman was very welcoming, and check-in was easy. communication response was very fast if ever we had questions. stay was very clean!

book it! great find, great value! i stayed for a month and couldn't have been happier (and i am pretty particular). sara and dan are really nice and friendly and made me feel welcome. the apt looks just like the pics. in addition, it feels newly renovated with fresh, clean paint, new floors, a great modern kitchen and bathroom, no clutter. the shower was nice, and the bed was one of the most comfortable beds i have ever slept on! i would especially recommend this spot if you have a car. the parking is truly a breeze - i usually found a spot right in front of the house and always on the block. if you don't have a car, it's an easy, straight-shot and flat walk to the train. so easy to get into the city. i also loved being just a few blocks from a big grocery store, which was very helpful. lastly, as i was there on my own, i found that i actually liked hearing the family moving about upstairs (i never heard voices, just footsteps). for me, it was comforting to know they were nearby.
nice spot, fair enough for the price. close to utica subway station about 30min ride to times square. there's a grocery store just across the street.
my stay was great! highly recommend!
was chill, peaceful, almost like a fun roommate.
i recommend staying here. yvonne is a great host and very quick to respond.

great little apartment , clean and easy to walk around in a nice location. sole was easy to communicate with and over all we had no problem at all staying at here apartment. would stay there again. thanks.

our stay with carla was amazing! the apartament is very cozy and clean, the location is perfect and carla herself was an awesome host. she made us feel very at home and gave great tips and suggestions. we definitely recomend her place and we will be returning as soon as we can!

space was exactly as promised and advertised and the clean design and mood of the rooms were perfect for us to relax after a long day of walking around soho. we loved how clean and well oriented the entire space was with the minimal wood inter design. staff was very friendly and useful. they helped us out with all our questions and holding onto our luggage on our last day before our time to head back to our flight. i highly recommend staying here and its perfect walking distance to so many of the shops and restaurants! i’m definitely returning here if i’m in the area again.

overall we had a good stay. the space was nice and the location was great. it’s walking distance to a lot of popular areas and restaurants which made getting around really easy. the host was very responsive throughout our stay. the shower did not drain well during our stay. we did mention this to the host so hopefully it gets resolved for future guests. the entry and access to the unit can also be a bit confusing and the staircase is very narrow. if you have larger luggage you may need to make multiple trips up the stairs. there is no elevator, which is mentioned in the listing. the neighbors were fairly noisy. the listing asks guests to respect quiet hours, but the host also mentioned the surrounding environment can be loud, so just something to keep in mind. overall we enjoyed the space and the location and would stay here again.
it was cute, loved it. zaza had great recommendations.

this is a great little place to stay when you're in brooklyn. it's very well located, very clean, and has everything you need. it's not a luxury apartment, but it's a terrific budget option. we stayed here for one night after closing on our house, and it was perfect for us. they also have a great selection of books in the living room! the only drawback is the traffic noise. i've lived in places in brooklyn and manhattanwhere the noise was worse, with lots of trucks and sirens, this is more of a susurrus of background noise. but if you're not used to a noisy environment, you may find it bothersome. but once you're in the bedrooms in the back and close the doors you can't hear it at all. if you're concerned just bring earplugs.

our stay with anita was absolutely wonderful! the first day we arrived, anita was very welcoming and kind, and gave us a tour of the apartment and did everything to make us feel comfortable. anita was located right next door and was always available to answer all of our questions. the apartment itself is great! it's, just as the description says, very cozy and comfortable and was very clean. it's located in an extremely friendly neighborhood with a lot of little shops around the block and is just a short 10 minute walk to the nearest subway station.
chunhsien was extremely helpful and accommodating throughout our stay. it was everything we had hoped for during our stay.

i booked a same day for a overnight stay and got a response immediately, when i arrived the front desk greeted my by name which was very kind and made me feel special the check in online was super easy all i had to do was show my id and he showed me to my room , this building has great amenities and lots of nearby food options as well as a 7/11 across the street everything was extremely clean and the staff were very welcoming and kind i will definitely be coming back here & i recommend you guys to stay here if interested :)
great location, clean space and a great host! easy to check in and out. just be prepared for noices from the streets during night. recomend!
very lovely stay! 2 blocks from the subway and a very sweet host. had wine and beer available for purchase in our room as well. very amazing! would stay again!
kim is very nice , her house is very clean and i highly recommend to stay over there for a quick visit in ny

i really felt comfortable in mario place it was very clean and he responds back very rapidly and he even gave me the option to check in early also left snacks for my family and myself ty for letting us stay in your home

zero complaints about the stay. all of the things that you want out of an air bnb (location, host, price, etc..) made this a place that was the most ideal for a small group of people (2-3) that want to experience the new york lifestyle for a couple of days.
great location and place if you want just a place to rest over the nights. can get loud being right on canal st but did not bother us and the place provide earplugs.
great place to stay in manhattan. reasonable price for nyc, well located and connected.

rachel was an amazing host. the apartment was absolutely spotless, very clean and tidy. rachel was very welcoming and her little dog was adorable too. the room is huge and tastefully decorated and the bed was super comfy. location was perfect - minutes away from union square station with good links to manhattan. i had a brilliant time staying with rachel and would thoroughly recommend staying with her. only one downside was the wifi was a tad sketchy in the room, but apart from that everything was perfect.

ada was very accommodating especially when our flight was delayed, her communication was excellent too. the room was clean and tidy plus the towels very very soft!! the location was perfect for us with prospect park across the road and the subway close by.
very great host, recommended

my husband and i stayed for 3 nights at ivan's places. the location, it's around 30 to 40 min to get to times square. his flat is very close to subways and buses. there is a nice café in the conner. the bed is comfortable, and the room is very clean.

jeremy and carsten's place was awesome for our group of three adults and one child. the condo is spacious and the beds and pillows were so comfortable. i usually have a hard time sleeping in beds other than my own, but i slept great the whole week we were there. it was a nice, quiet place to relax after busy days in the city. we tried out three different coffee shops while we were there and thought they were all great. jeremy and carsten provided detailed arrival information and were very responsive. they even checked in on us mid-week to make sure everything was going okay. i would definitely stay in their place again!
great location and the service was perfect. from the friendly doorman to the helpful housekeeping, they made sure we were always comfortable.

fab place. we are returning customers of charlie and edmunds...both of their apartments in this building are beautiful and in an ideal location. we will always rent from charlie when we are in nyc! clean...affordable..safe..comfortable....who could ask for more?
very accommodating & helpful definitely recommend

everything about this unit was excellent. very clean, great location near the metro/bus, easy to ride all the way down to manhattan and all the attractions. near to fast food and grocery stores. tasteful decorations and plenty of space. nice 2nd floor private patio for sipping a chilled beverage at the end of a busy day. carlos was very friendly and helpful. check in was a breeze. i highly recommend giving his place a stay!
very comfy and spacious. will definitely be staying again!

we had the whole third floor to ourselves. it was a great place to say for the night. sidney was nice. great host. he went out of his way with parking locations and giving us directions around the city and gave us a great location for a great diner to have breakfast at.

the apartment is very well located and the building is very nice. but, the kitchen is very small and the sets of cutlery and dinnerware aren’t complete. you get like 2 forwks, 2 knives and 3 spoons. there’s no dishwasher and no dish rack, no space to leave the stuff to dry. also, i believe the communication could improve, there were 2 flood alerts during my stay and no recommendations from the host, that’s the first time i haven’t received any communication from a host in a situation like that. walls are very thin and you can hear everything from one apt to another. or smell everything if they smoke too. and somehow there are a lot of flies in the building, that’s so annoying. i’m not sure i would stay here again. i would recommend it for a short stay but they only accept 30 days and i think it’s not a good place to stay that long.
nice place in an excellent location. dan was very helpful and responsive. it was my first time visiting ny and he recommended some great spots for me to check out while i was there :)
great staying, very close to the subway station, room is optimal and clean, excellent cost benefit, gonna return to the ridge when going to nyc again!
incredibly clean place. she is an excellent knowledgeable host.

rodney was incredibly welcome and friendly and provided great recommendations for spots in the neighborhood. the experience was like that of a hotel, with a lot of care taken to providing a clean and curated space with fresh towels, linens, and plenty of storage space. the brownstone house was itself gorgeous and cozy, and it provided the perfect amount of anonymity. i would definitely come back!
great place to stay

we loved staying at this secluded beautifully taken care of property. chelsea made us feel like we were renting a home rather than a representative from a company. there were such beautiful special touches all around the house, from the sweet thoughtful notes, the essential oils near the bathtub, the beers in the fridge on a hot day (and a long day of travel) and the lovely smelling clean sharp linen. if we had more time we would have explored the grounds a bit more, but the windows and skylights were a lovely glimpse into the forest. thank you so much for the hospitality!

quiet hotel. near main subway lines and a 29 min walk to broadway shows and times square. staff was friendly and helpful. the only issue were the amenities, specifically the wifi which is important for asking your “hey pineapple” device in your room for room service etc … rooms aren’t big but the bed/robes etc… we’re comfy and cozy!

the neighborhood is great. the room is nice, but i heard my neighbors when they shower, talk, and sneeze. also you can can hear every door that gets opened or closed and everyone walking/talking in the hallway, and of course the cleaning lady in the morning. the kitchenette was a useful addition. my room window was looking at another building and it’s the same one in the photos but as they seemed a bit far from each other i thought i’d see the street but there was no street, only the back of the building. check in was really smooth though, but i kept worrying about forgetting my keys cause there’s no one there to help you if you did. also jennifer is not the fastest to respond and sometimes doesn’t care to respond at all. overall it was okay. but i won’t stay there again.
pleasure to meet you, although brief! dan has a beautiful home and he made checking in and out so easy for us. thank you for the hospitality.

amy's apartment is in an amazing location! amy is a fast and clear communicator and was very thoughtful and responsive. i really enjoyed my stay in her lovely apartment, which is really quieter than i thought it would be from her caveats about the kitchen being above the bedroom!

a really nice and clean apartment. looks exactly like the pictures. the neighbourhood can be a bit noisy at times, but that no fault of brice’s — it’s ny after all. and just note if you’re doing stuff in manhattan/brooklyn, it’s a bit of commute to get there. all in all i’d def recommend, brice was very responsive and accommodating!
i really enjoyed my stay here

staying here comes with a lot of perks - you’re close to public transportation and a lot of great coffee shops. during our entire 5-day stay, the hosts were attentive and ensured we felt heard whenever we needed something. this is a great spot for people on the move and busy, a small group of friends, or individuals looking to explore their surroundings. it was wonderful staying here and feeling safe and comfortable after a busy day in nyc!
the place is great. we will stay there when return.
great host. easy to find. everything was as posted. would definitely stay again.

our visit was great. antonio and gypsy were so attentive to our needs, even the really small ones. i was letting antonio know that the coffee frother wasn't working properly, but said it was ok, as we didn't have to use one. clearly that wasn't acceptable, and we had a new frother at our door the next day. impressive!
great place accessible to things you need (food, groceries and package stores

great place to stay! our queen room was pretty small room, but very clean, stylish, has all listed amenities, very walkable and serve great coffee and pastries in the morning. we felt very comfortable and safe during our stay. highly recommend!

very convenient location. short, pleasant walk to subways stations. close to brooklyn museum and botanical garden. close by convenient stores and restaurants. apartment has 4 rooms and 1 bathroom so be patient. bathroom and kitchen need good cleaning. other guests we met during our stay were great and very pleasant.

elizabeth’s apartment became our home for a whole month when we had relocated to new york from europe. liz is a great host! she was extremely helpful right from booking all the way to check-out, went above and beyond to help in all ways. we appreciated daily communication and detailed instructions. the apartment itself is lovely, clean and has everything you need. location is excellent: quiet yet close to shops, restaurants and the train station. highly recommended!
great location close to prospect park with great local restaurants, bars and shops. close to two subway stations making access to manhattan easy.
super friendly and accommodating hosts! me and my roomie had a blast! 👍😄

we had a wonderful stay at irena's brownstone, which was even better than it appeared in the listing. it's very much a "real home" that's spacious, comfortable, and beautifully appointed. there are a few reasonable rules you'll need to observe, such as not wearing shoes inside, which mostly help protect the old home's and furniture's surfaces and finishes. and being an old home, you'll need to take care to make sure the doors and windows close completely (the large front door in particular.) you'll also need to be okay with climbing flights of stairs, which is part of the classic brownstone experience. although it's in the center of everything the park slope neighborhood has to offer, it was remarkably quiet inside. restaurants of nearly every sort are just a short walk away, as is prospect park. the subway is also relatively close by, though we didn't need it during our stay. it was easy communicating with irena, who sent a very thoughtful and comprehensive guide to all the home's features. check-in and check-out was easy, using a lock box system. and thank you, irena, for opening your home to us.
i enjoy being there

we have rented several homes in the new york area and were eager to stay in this townhouse. unfortunately, we were greatly disappointed upon checking in. upon entering the front door we were hit with a very unpleasant “mothball” odor. we moved to the bedrooms and found them to have only sheets on the bed and a very lightweight throw at the end of the bed. one of the two beds had a stain on the sheets. the window in the first bedroom sounded like it was open to the backyard. turns out it was closed but would not latch. latch was broken. the sliding door in that bedroom was also not latched when we arrived. there were no smoke alarms in the entire place. just wires hanging from the ceiling. the “luxury” towels that were listed in the posting were anything but luxury. they were older than any towel i’ve ever used. 2 had stains. no washcloths, hand towels, dish cloths ,dish towels, or paper towels. you literally had nothing to dry your hands on we moved out next morning.
great location with an amazing view from the rooftop. however, the host was quite slow to respond.

i could not imagine a better stay for a first time in nyc. meital has been a true compass and welcomed me with a lot of kindness. the neighborhood is a great area to start discovering the city and gathering locals tips. i could always count on meital to share with me unexpected places and events but you'll find them by yourself just asking people in the street. the room was as expected, clean with a nice view and quiet. the cat is friendly if you approach him ; and if you need space alone you can always have it. don't hesitate, and enjoy your experience. see you next, mei 🤗
great place ! had everything i needed and driveway parking was perfect.

my husband and i spent ten days at jovanna's place, and were very happy. the space is as described, very comfortable and roomy for a nyc apartment. the kitchen was well-equipped, and we appreciated the complimentary bottles of water. jovanna and helen were very responsive to our texts, and very helpful in their advice about the neighborhood. the apartment is located almost equidistant between two subway lines, about a 8- to 10-minute walk either way, which got us everywhere we needed to go. we felt quite safe in the area at all hours of the day and night. in short, we were very pleased.

amazing little slice of nyc. very comfortable space, kept very clean. had a breeze checking in and were able to check out late as well. super comfortable bed. it’s an old space so the kitchen is small with an old electric stove but with so many great restaurants around no real need to cook. bathroom included lots of clean towels and soap but no shampoo. quiet neighborhood no traffic noise but you will hear the child upstairs running around a little, just part of vertical living! overall would stay again.
great responsive hosts. nice area, loved my stay!
jing was so responsive and very accommodating. we even got to store our luggage there on the last day. loved the area and it was a short walk to times square and broadway.
great place. location good if hanging out downtown and in tribeca. even good to hop to soho.

super easy stay. the apartment has everything needed. washer/dryer was very convenient, bed was comfortable, and the space was really well laid out. i appreciated having both dresser and an extra rack for hanging clothes. the host is very communicative.

our first trip to nyc was amazing and we loved the penthouse suite at the manhattan club. it is hard to find a larger space with extra bathrooms that close to times square. we can't wait to return for another stay!

🌺🐎🌺maxime home 🏡 is the place to stay & be in middle of everything in harlem. his home 🏡 brings love ❤️, peace, happiness & joy to your life. there is a beautiful church ⛪ a half of block from his home 🏡 that is a landmark. i believe it is over 100 years. i had the pleasure to attend one of the services awesome. i pray & know that god will continue to bless maxime because he is truly a blessing & his home 🏡. we love 💕 you maxime: mrs. robinson, honey 🍯 & princess lola my two little doggie 🐶.the love ❤️ of my life.

we recently had the pleasure of staying at this airbnb. from start to finish, our experience was nothing short of exceptional. leo's warm and welcoming nature made my family and i feel right at home from the moment we arrived. he went above and beyond to ensure our stay was comfortable and memorable, which truly made our trip extra special. the place itself is captivating with its charm and beauty that surrounded us. it was an absolute gem, from its location to the interior design, which was tastefully done. the accommodations were pristine and spotless, it was clear that leo had thought of every possible need a guest might have. the proximity to local attractions and amenities made it incredibly easy to explore the area. lastly, i must mention leo's excellent recommendations and local tips. he was more than happy to share his knowledge of the area. we will definitely be returning in the future, and we’re already looking forward to our next stay.
very nice place quiet and clean! would highly recommend for a quick getaway

loved this place, definitely staying here anytime we visit nyc. 17min straight walk to time square, easy to find friendly staff even the guy that helps with cleaning and hold your luggage if you have arrive earlier then check in. honestly loved it. safe, friendly, close to lots of tourist attractions… definitely highly recommend!

1. the room cannot be locked from other guests. it has a slide door that is accesible to anyone in the house. i had to tie a shirt around to make it “safer” 2. the bed is thin as a paper sheet. needs to be changed asap 3. people upstairs were super noisy. apparently a kid lives there and is constantly running in the early morning and at night 4. nowhere to put the trash in the room 5. no ac just a fan 6. only a couple usable power outlets i do not recommend it

for new york, that was really top. it was a very quiet environment, and very clean. there was coffee and tea, and granola bars. and my room was very clean and matched the descriptions and the photos. there was air conditioning in the room, which i used. i am very satisfied and i will definitely be back.

where do i begin...the space is beautiful. the decor, the art, the books...we actually spent one rainy afternoon of our vacation just enjoying the apartment. every window has a beautiful view of the hudson river!steed was such a gentile host. he made a point to relax us and encouraged us feel as if we were at home. our children never want to share cramped hotel digs with us again! it was our first foray into air bnb and i couldn't be more pleased. do not hesitate to book this unit. a gem like this in nyc should not be missed.
great customer service and convient to public transportation. the breakfast could have been better tasting and a higher quality. overall, worth the price.

this is a great apartment in a great location, close to numerous cafes and a quick walk to the subway entrance. staircase is narrow so i wouldn’t recommend bringing gigantic luggage (which i did but had no choice since i traveled to nyc straight from a dc work trip). it was spacious and easily accommodated myself, best friend and brother.
great stay. responsive host
we had a wonderful stay at aka times square right in the heart of midtown and with great connectivity the all parts of nyc.
abby’s place is adorable! very comfortable and we had a great time! thank you abby for making my 50 th even better!

this is a great space. bright and sunny. clean. safe. i really like this location everything you could need for the day to day is a block away. the train is close so you can get anywhere in the city. it was great. would rent again. thank you.
i loved this apt. it is well kept and very comfortable. jeremy is a great host.
above and beyond. i'd pay twice as much for this level of service :)
beautiful home …very clean and spacious 5 stars all around … recommend anyone looking for a nice stay to book with andrea ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
perfect location, walking distance to so many great restaurants and shops!
i got a great experience at one night here, everything is good! the host is nice.
sandra has a lovely family and made me feel welcome. the room was great.
the place was well kept and kevin was friendly.
i had a great stay at this spot. adham was very friendly and responsive whenever i had questions or ran into a small hiccup. beautiful place, truly cozy. i'm glad i had the privilege to be there!

you cannot choose a better location in the city. it's convenient to everything, restaurants, shops, one block from union square with the farmers' market and whole foods. the place is sparkling clean, spacious, comfortable and very safe. the master bathroom is amazing. the water takes a few minutes to heat up, but you learn to run it before you want to get into the shower. they are very quick to respond to questions. the only minor note is that the small refrigerator does not have a freezer. i would stay here again in a heartbeat! highly recommended.

2 blocks from the subway. a lot of good food nearby too. my favorite part is how close central park is (10 min walk max). if it’s your first time in ny this is the place to be because it’s outside of all the big crowds but accessible enough to get to the busy parts of the city! would recommend, and would book again !

a hostel-style stay, the rooms are well maintained and clean, generally equipped with a mini-fridge, a microwave, a kettle, mugs, and a sink. space heater, a/c, and hair dryer were also in my room. the bathroom and shower were shared for the floor, but very convenient and kept clean. given its proximity to moynihan, madison square garden, times square and really all of the major manhattan hotspots (and the subway), it's a super convenient and comfortable place to stay. definitely will keep it in the back pocket for anytime i want to take a weekend trip to nyc. thanks!!
excellent place! we had a great stay. mary ann was responsive and attentive to our needs.
great listing! host communicated well. i booked the spot last minute and there was no mishaps with the space, or check in.
clean apartment, great location. jeniffer was a very accommodating host in setting me up and kept good communication throughout my stay.
great place to stay if you’re looking to be near time square.
great stay! nice location and cool rooftop accessibility. clean and affordable

very nice, clean, charming one bedroom. just as advertised. has everything one needs for a short stay. close to broadway (about s 20 minute walk) and a few blocks from the high line and hudson river. typical small new york flat, and may feel cramped with more than two people. was absolutely fine with two of us. on a busy street, so some traffic noise. catia was extremely responsive, thoughtful and helpful. thanks!
easily the best value you will find for a private apartment in nyc! i loved my stay, it was very calming and quiet and a very nice space. the host was very communicative, helpful, and kind!!
the flophouse is absolutely beautiful and has easy access to subway. lots of great food and attractions nearby — downtown is only about a 20 min ride south. just sad we missed the cat!
great place, great location
very well located, right by the subway. clean, practical and well-organized and has everything needed for using as a base to discover nyc.
