chris was an excellent host, responded quickly to messages and answered any and all questions we might have had. the place was conveniently located between two subway stops, which was perfect for us as headed out to explore the city. it was clean, well stocked with all the necessities and very comfortable to be in. the neighborhood was quieter than i expected and we had no issues walking around, nor coming back later in the evening. however, i am an ex-nyer, so am still comfortable with whatever the city has to offer. chris' place worked well for us (4 adults). one fyi - the small bedroom is as chris has shown, small, and is probably best suited for teens and children. but not a deal breaker and we'd stay here again when the opportunity arises.
i had a lovely experience in daniel's home. casual elegance... all was as it should have been. also, the piano was a godsend! looking froward to returning soon...

for the second time i rent this flat. always very clean with furniture of beautiful quality and very comfortable. the apartment is ideally situated, in a street quiet and close to businesses and restaurants. the owners are charming and welcoming. i recommend this apartment to the quiet and respectful people, it is a haven of peace.
felt at home. responsive host. i would definitely recommend and book again. thank you hurshum.
kim was spectacular, i couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay while i was in nyc, her home is a treat and she her self went out of her way to make my stay better.

had a great stay! in the heart of korea town and near subway stations. easy to find, and the apartment was comfortable for 5 adults for a few nights. secure building, clean and cozy rooms, and clear instructions from host. towels, shampoo, and soap provided. no views but windows in both bedrooms. offered free luggage storage. would return!

the room was spotless, super cozy spot to stay at, not that far away from the train station to about an 8$ uber to take you to manhattan, clear instructions and also in a very safe area, i highly recommend this spot, not only is it quite at night, but it has a tv with netflix and a banging ac to!!!, super satisfied with this bnb

jae was really pleasant and super communicative even though he was traveling! very easy to work with, the apartment was quite clean and modern, the bed was super comfortable and the living room had amazing lighting from a skylight. great stuff!
best bnb i’ve been to so far

our hosts daniel, dean and nancy were more than helpful and made my friend and me welcome. the listing description was accurate. location is great - 3 minutes walk to metro station and 10 minutes ride by metro to manhattan. we felt safe in this neighbourhood, even at night, coming back from manhattan - and we have stayed there for 19 days. lots of markets, restaurants and good vibrations all around.
the stay was quite pleasant, with a beautiful kitchen and bathroom. the only negative was the noise from the next room, which is not the host's fault.
jonathan was very accommodating during the course of my stay. place was very clean and peaceful. highly recommendable!!
jacob’s place was great. comfortable bed, friendly host, and pretty close walk to the train. the location worked out perfectly for my trip. would recommend

sandra’s apartment was sooo comfortable, spacious, super clean, and has evertyhing you need, you can definitely feel at home. the bus stop is no more than a 5 min walk, those buses connect you to the subway stations that can take you to any nyc attraction. there is also a little market on the corner and the neighborhood is super quiet and felt safe. thank you sandra!!!
aldi was a great host! she was very responsive to emails and has a clean apartment in a great location.

very nice and clean home! just a short walk away from the subway trains coming and going to the city. our host was proactive with making accommodations for our infant offering a crib and other thoughtful amenities! the house is gorgeous inside and beds were comfortable!

my son and i had a great stay. the room as well as the bathroom and shower were spotlessly clean. the location was very convenient—we walked back each evening after seeing a broadway show. we are from a small town and felt very safe.

olu's place worked well for us as we needed to be near columbia. he was a wonderful and attentive host and the neighborhood is full of great entertainment opportunities. it is a very active and busy street so knowing that as long as you have great ear plugs you'll sleep soundly as his mattress is heavenly. it was a great visit.
very spacious and clean - great spot for our quick vacation!
great comfortable stay & great location.

very happy with our stay, beautiful view of central park and manhattan skyline. the hosts were very responsive and proactive in answering our requests. the only improvement i can see is that the kitchen lacks essentials to cook - such as pans, pots, cooking oil, salt, kettle, etc. it would top the experience if the hosts would supply these too.

we had a great time in new york! joseph is a awesome host not sure you can find anyone better that knows the city, wants to help you with what to do in the city, how to get around and is very polite person. the room is very comfortable, and looks exactly like the photos. the only problem was that the internet was a bit slow. but still i was able to do everything, and even more than what i planned. this place is very well located in the city very close to columbus circle and time square so getting on the subway was very easy. joseph also taught us how to use the subway in new york witch was a big help. i am very pleased to say that this was a very successful trip and every time i come back i will be staying at joseph's room.
great value and comfortable place. very close to subway, fairly quiet area. netflix is available and the place was clean and comfortable. both bedrooms are nice.

i stayed for one month while working in nyc. it is a short walk to the l and the f trains which makes it easy to get into the city and to and from jfk. the room and apartment are exactly as described and pictured and julie is a lovely host/roommate! she was patient and kind to my small dog who took some time to adjust to her new surroundings. she even helped me to arrange a dog walker while i was working in the city. i would highly recommend and would definitley stay again!

we stayed in jo & brian's over the halloween holidays. we were slightly anxious regarding the area, however straight away felt safe when we arrived. the neighbour is great we found locals very friendly, gesturing a friendly hello on the street. location is brilliant to explore williamsburg, queens, brooklyn and manhattan. there is a subway station just 2 blocks away 'classon avenue', brilliant for links everywhere and safe, we used at all times of the day. the apartment check in was seamless, due to the excellent communication maintained by jo. the apartment is clean, huge and has everything you may need. the bed was comfortable and thw shower powerful. we spent very little time there but of what we did, we have no complaints. likewise check out was brilliant, joanna and brian accommodated are late check which i am very grateful for. overall the whole experience with joanna and brian was top class. we are very grateful for the assistance and help they provided. we will definitly be checking availability of this place next time we come back and i have already recommended to friends and family.
beautiful and amazing space. susan's home was warm, cozy, and in an extremely convenient location. susan was quick to respond to any questions/issues we had. couldn't recommend this place enough!
honestly super clean and it was a great time! the host was super communicative and accommodating.
shama's room is comfortable and easy to get by subway and bus. looking forward to checking in again.

came to brooklyn to run a half marathon at prospect park and found the place to be exactly what we needed! bigger than we expected and the interior design was lovely. you can hear the trains nearby but that wasn’t bothersome at all for us, and was close enough for us to bike/ walk to prospect park

my partner and i had a great extended stay at daniel’s apartment. the location puts you in the middle of williamsburg with great restaurants, shops, bookstores and cafes all super close. we loved the design of the space, the tasteful furniture and the great kitchen where we cooked many meals. the historic block the apartment is on is very special, with lots of families and friendly folks all around. the garden is lovely too although it being cold out we didn’t use it tons. daniel is friendly and helpful and was always quick to respond to any questions or concerns. this is a great place for a couple or solo traveler. i’d definitely stay here again.

parking a little difficult to find till the evening however an overall great place to stay and explore the heart of new york city. host was very attentive and respectful. place had just about everything you can need for a welcoming quick stay. enjoyed my stay and hope to come back soon.
pleasant experience. we had good conversation over coffee. wayne was knowledgeable about getting us around the city. we would stay here again in the future.
leon is a great man!!!...place was what i needed!!!

great to stay at james' place. wonderful neighbourhood with all you need, say restaurants, groceries, cafes, cleaners, and train station. always a parking space available in front of the house. nice place to stay in.
very comfortable room, good public transport access, no interaction with guest yet very responsive to all requests. great!
the room is clean and comfortable. the communication was very good. this was a very good no frills experience.

staying at lily's place was a very nice experience! the description of the room and the facilities are as described. she has a very good bed, i slept really well. the neighborhood is nice. not too busy and with enough good and affordable restaurants. it's a 40 minute walk to times square. lily is really a awesome host! she's very friendly, helpful and flexible. i would really recommend to stay at her place!
james’s place was great! pretty easy walk to the subway and there’s a lot to do in the neighborhood. it was a very comfortable stay.
we’ve stayed here before and came back. room is small. bed comfortable. great location.

dear hollis and marlyn, we enjoyed staying in your appartment for a week. there were so many things to eat and to drink. even bottles of water filled the fridge. you thought of everything! the appartment was very clean and cosy and near the subway. thank you for your kindness and good luck in your life. marja, imre and ilja.
everything was truly great... well stocked, very nicely furnished, great location, quiet, had a lot of fun... and shelley was excellent!
loved staying at your place. the deck was very large and we enjoyed star gazing. very conveniently located, near time square and nice restaurants next door. very clean!
this what the best bnb i experienced!
outstanding apartment. convenient location in chelsea for subway, shops, restaurants etc. great space, really well setup inside for a large group to explore new york!

great stay at mary’s place. host was very welcoming and responsive, making the whole experience smooth from check-in to check-out. the place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. the location was perfect, close to transit, restaurants, and everything nyc has to offer. would definitely stay here again!
this was perfect for my quick trip to nyc. i'll definitely look for this one again.
